aa1.text: U+4E2B ngaa1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.74 丫) 木之枝頭也 (Page 1 #4: (1)丫) A fork, a crotch (Kangxi: 物之岐頭); the parting of two branches, fingers, or tines; _(1)(a/) (4)t(')au_ (aa1 tau4 丫頭) or _(1)(a/) (4)w(a/)n_ (aa1 waan4 丫鬟), a slave girl; _(1)(a/) kok(8) kai(3)_ (aa1 gok3 gai3 丫角髻) a little boy; _(1)(a/) (1)ch(')(a/)_ (aa1 caa1 丫杈), a fork, a rest for clothes' sticks; _sh(u(6) (1)(a/)_ (syu6 aa1 樹丫) fork of a tree; _(1)s(a/)m (1)(a/) l(o\)(6)_ (saam1 aa1 lou6 三丫路) meeting of three ways, a trivium. Williams' 丫頭, 丫鬟: Yes, people kept slaves in the 19th century. Williams' 丫頭, 丫鬟, 丫角髻: From the double-bun hairstyle. Williams' 三丫路: Now rarely heard; 三叉路 is more common.

U+5416 呀 (Cantonese) 啊 (Cantonese) a1 (shorter syllable) (Page 1 #1: (1)吖) A colloquial word. An interrogative particle; also one indicating that the affirmation is indisputable; a mere final answering tone, having no meaning; _(2)h(o\) (1)(a/)_ (hou2 aa1 好吖) well, very well; _(1)(a/) wai(3)_ (aa1 wai3 吖？) poor, necessitous; _(5)k(')(u (2)k(o\)m w(a/)(6) (1)(a/)_ (keoi5 gam2 waa6 aa1 佢噉話吖), he said so; _mat(7) (5)y(e/) (1)(a/)_ (mat1 je5 aa1 乜嘢吖), what? _(2)k(o\)m ts(o\)(6) (1)(a/)_ (gam2 zou6 aa1 噉做吖), no, this is the way to do it. (Page 1 #3: (1)呀; here normalised to 吖) A colloquial word. An interjection used in answers, denoting surprise or alarm; alas! dreadful. 【吖】 (a1, aa1) An interrogative-ish final particle suggesting the preceding. 今晚吖 (gam1 maan5-1 a1): "How about tonight." 你行先吖 (nei5 haang4 sin1 a1): "Why don't you go first." An imperative-ish final particle (when the preceding is spoken with force). 飲吖 (jam2 a1): "Drink it." An emphatic final particle. 好吖 (hou2 a1): "OK" (as an active, enthusiastic endorsement). 【吖嘛】 (a1 maa3) An indicative-ish final particle pointing out the preceding. Similar to ending on a falling intonation in English. 天氣凍吖嘛 (tin1 hei3 dung3 a1 maa3): "Because the weather's cold." An interrogative-ish final particle seeking affirmation of the preceding. 今晚吖嘛 (gam1 maan5-1 a1 maa3): "That's tonight, right?" The spellings 吖 and 吖嘛 are arbitrary.

aa4.text: U+5440 a4 (shorter syllable) 【呀-particle】 (a4) An interrogative-ish final particle of surprise, suspicion, disappointment, etc. 今晚呀 (gam1 maan5-1 a4): "Tonight?" 唔飲呀 (m4 jam2 a4): "Oh, you're not drinking it?" 噉呀 (gam2 a4): "Oh, it's like that..." (used to indicate need for reconsideration in light of new or surprising information). A vocative particle, especially used before asking a question. 爹爹呀 (de1 de1 a4): "Daddy," (followed by a question). 女呀 (neoi5-2 a4): "Daughter," (followed by a question). The spelling 呀 is arbitrary.

aa6.text: U+5440 十 (Page 1 #7: 呀(3)) A colloquial word. Also spoken _(a/)(6)_ (aa6); ten, used ~~after a higher number~~ between syllables; an answer, a word of reply like Aye! _(a/)(6) (2)h(o\)_ (aa6 hou2 呀好), yes, well; _sz'(3) (a/)(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (sei3 aa6 cin4 四呀錢), forty cash. 【呀-ten】 (aa6) Elided reading of 十 sap6 "ten", when forming a number whose tens component is thirty to ninety. 卅呀蚊 (saa1 aa6 man1): "Thirty bucks." 四呀幾 (sei3 aa6 gei2): "Forty-something." 六呀三 (luk6 aa6 saam1): "Sixty-three." 九呀歲 (gau2 aa6 seoi3): "Ninety years old." The spelling 呀 is arbitrary. In practice, "ten" is spelt 十 whether elided or not.

ngaa4.text: U+5440 (Page 1 #3: (1)呀) Read _(4)ng(a/)_ (ngaa4)_;_ the wrangling of children; to open the mouth wide; _(4)ng(a/) (1)l(a/)n (5)mai_ (ngaa4 laan1 mai5 呀囒米), cochineal. It is tempting to declare that the "wrangling" and "wide-mouth" senses ought to be read _(1)h(a/)_ (haa1) per 《廣韻》許加切, but it is more complicated than that. The character 呀 also appears under 《廣韻》五加切 _(4)ng(a/)_ (ngaa4), explained 吧呀. In turn, the character 吧 has two readings: 普巴切 _(1)p(')(a/)_ (paa1), explained 吧呀大口皃 (whence big-mouth); and 伯加切 _(1)p(a/)_ (baa1), explained 吧呀小兒忿爭 (whence children wrangling).

aa3.text: U+554A 呀 (Cantonese) a3 (shorter syllable) (Page 1 #7: 呀(3); here normalised to 啊) A colloquial word. A final particle, adding intensity to the meaning; _(4)'m (2)h(o\) (a/)(3)_ (m4 hou2 aa3 唔好啊) not at all good. Williams' 唔好啊: Also an emphatic form of the imperative "don't". 【啊-final】 (a3, aa3) A final particle (with a hint of emphasis). 到未啊 (dou3 mei6 a3): "Are we there yet?" 未到啊 (mei6 dou3 a3): "Not there yet." 有排啊 (jau5 paai4 a3): "It'll be ages." A vocative particle, especially used before airing a grievance. 阿爹啊 (aa3 de1 a3): "Dad!" 【啊-list】 (aa3) A particle used after each item in a list of examples. Similar to the non-falling intonation for list items in English. 例如蘋果啊、橙啊、香蕉啊 (lai6 jyu4 ping4 gwo2 aa3, caang4-2 aa3, hoeng1 ziu1 aa3): "Such as apples, oranges, bananas, ...." The spelling 啊 is arbitrary.

aa1.text: U+555E 唖 哑 (Mainland simplified) ngaa1 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 1 #5: (2)啞 _(2)(A/)_ (aa2); here corrected to _(1)(A/)_ (aa1)) The confused noise of children ~~studying~~ learning to speak (Kangxi: 啞嘔小兒學言);

aa2.text: U+555E 唖 瘂 哑 (Mainland simplified) ngaa2 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.75 啞) 口不能言曰啞 (F2.75 瘂) 同上 (F2.75 𤺘) 同上 (Page 1 #5: (2)啞) dumb (Kangxi: 瘖也); to keep silent (Kangxi: 不言也), for which the next (瘂) is used; _(2)(a/) ~~mai(6)~~ (4)mai_ (aa2 mai4 啞謎) an enigma; _(4)ts(')ing (4)n(a/)n (2)(a/) (2)yan_ (cing4 naan4 aa2 jan2 情難啞忍), hard to bear it patiently. (Page 1 #6: (2)瘂; here normalised to 啞) Dumb, unable to speak (Kangxi 瘂: 瘖瘂也, 同啞, 瘖也); dull, faded; a cracked sound, as a bell; wheezing; _(2)(a/) (2)tsai_ (aa2 zai2 啞仔), a dumb boy; _(2)(a/) (2)hau (4)m(o\) (4)(i/)n_ (aa2 hau2 mou4 jin4 啞口無言), will not speak, sulky; _(2)(a/) tuk(9)_ (aa2 duk6 啞毒) dumb people are revengeful; _(1)sheng t(a/)i(3) (2)(a/)_ (seng1 daai3 aa2 聲帶啞), the sound is indistinct. Williams' 啞謎: Changed _mai(6)_ (mai6) to common reading _(4)mai_ (mai4). 【啞】 ('aeX) (_adjective-like_) dumb

ak1.text: U+555E 唖 哑 (Mainland simplified) aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 1 #5: (2)啞) Also read _ak(7)_ (ak1)_;_ _ak(7) ak(7)_ (ak1 ak1 啞啞) the sound of giggling (Kangxi: 笑語之聲也).

aa1.text: U+9D09 雅 鵶 鸦 (Mainland simplified) ngaa1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.74 鴉) 鳥名 (F2.74 鵶) 同上 (Page 1 #2: (1)鴉) A raven with a white streak on its breast (Kangxi: 小而腹下白 etc.); _(5)l(o\) (1)(a/)_ (lou5 aa1 老鴉), a raven or crow; _(4)t(')(o\) (1)(a/)_ (tou4 aa1 塗鴉), written roughly; _(1)(a/) p(')(i/)n(3) (4)nai_ (aa1 pin3 nai4 鴉片坭), opium. Williams' 鴉片坭: Dated; opium is now simply called 鴉片. 【鴉】 ('ae) (_noun-like_) crow, raven

aa2.text: U+7602 痖 (Mainland simplified) (F2.75 啞) 口不能言曰啞 (F2.75 瘂) 同上 (F2.75 𤺘) 同上 (Page 1 #6: (2)瘂) nape of the neck (Kangxi: 人身項後入髮際五分爲瘂門);

aa3.text: U+4E9E 亜 亚 (Mainland simplified) ngaa3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.76 亞) 次也孟子曰亞聖 (Page 2 #1: 亞(3)~~阿(3)~~) Hunchbacked (Kangxi 亞: 象人局背之形); to esteem lightly, to regard as inferior; second, next to, junior, inferior (Kangxi 亞: 亞次也); _pat(7) (a/)(3) (1)(u (4)yan_ (bat1 aa3 jyu1 jan4 不亞於人), not inferior to others. Williams does not provide separate entries for 亞 and 阿, but notes that 阿 is "often used" for the name prefix sense. I have split things up accordingly. 【亞】 ('aeH) (_adjective-like_) second

U+5A6D 亞 娅 (Mainland simplified) ngaa3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.76 亞) 姻婭兩壻相謂曰婭 (Page 2 #2: 婭(3)) Brothers-in-law (Kangxi: 兩壻相謂曰婭 etc.); _(1)yan (a/)(3)_ (jan1 aa3 姻婭) relatives by marriage, especially brothers or parents; _(4)m(o\) tik(7) (1)yan (a/)(3)_ (mou4 dik1 jan1 aa3 無滴姻婭) I am not related to him at all.

U+963F 亞 (Page 2 #1: 亞(3)阿(3)) a syllable prefixed to proper names, for which the second (阿) is often used; it also impersonates epithets; _(a/)(3) m(u/)i(6)_ (aa3 mui6-2 阿妹) a younger sister, a lass; _(a/)(3) mat(7)_ (aa3 mat1 阿乜) Mr. So and So; _(a/)(3) p(i/)(6)_ (aa3 bei6 阿？) a silly fellow; _(a/)(3) (1)ch(')o_ (aa3 co1 阿初), a raw hand; _(a/)(3) (1)p(a/)_ (aa3 baa1 阿爸), papa; _(a/)(3) (5)t(')ai_ (aa3 tai5 阿娣), boy, you lad; Williams does not provide separate entries for 亞 and 阿. I have split things up accordingly.

aai1.text: U+6328 𢰇 ngaai1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.25 挨) 屋齋切倚也推也擊也又背負也 (Page 2 #10: (1)挨) To lean upon, to trust to; to push away (Kangxi: 推也), to carry on the back; to place alongside (Kangxi: 旁排也); to strike (Kangxi: 擊也); to force, to crowd (Kangxi: 强進曰挨), as with the elbows; to graft; next, near (Kangxi: 今俗凡物相近謂之挨); passable; to lie down, to recline; _(1)(a/)i (4)m(a/)i (1)n(i/) p(i/)n(6)_ (aai1 maai4 ni1 bin6 挨埋呢便) lean it against here; help here a little; _(5)yau tak(7) (1)(a/)i pang(6)_ (jau5 dak1 aai1 bang6 有得挨憑) has some dependance or resource; _(5)yau t(a/)i(6) (1)sh(a/)n (1)(a/)i_ (jau5 daai6 saan1 aai1 有大山挨), he has powerful friends; _(1)(a/)i (5)h(a/) tik(7)_ (aai1 haa5 dik1 挨吓滴) lie down a little; _(1)(a/)i tak(7) h(u(3)_ (aai1 dak1 heoi3 挨得去) it will answer; _(1)(a/)i (4)m(u/)n (1)(a/)i (u/)(6)_ (aai1 mun4 aai1 wu6 挨門挨戶) to gad and stare, as a virago; to go from door to door to examine; _(1)(a/)i (2)(i/)_ (aai1 ji2 挨倚), to mutually rely upon; _(1)(a/)i l(a/)i(6)_ (aai1 laai6 挨賴) to trust for help; _(1)(a/)i (5)m(a/)n_ (aai1 maan5-1 挨晚), towards evening.

aai3.text: U+55CC ngaai3 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 3 #2: 嗌(3)) A colloquial word; to call after, to bawl; to quarrel; crowded, thronged; _(a/)i(3) (1)k(a/)u_ (aai3 gaau1 嗌交), to wrangle, to dispute; _(a/)i(3) p(')o(3) (4)hau (4)lung_ (aai3 po3 hau4 lung4 嗌破喉嚨), hallooed till he split his throat; _(a/)i(3) n(a/)u(6)_ (aai3 naau6 嗌鬧) thronged; brawling; _(a/)i(3) mat(7) (5)y(e/)_ (aai3 mat1 je5 嗌乜嘢), what are you scolding about? _shap(9) (a/)i(3) (2)kau (1)ch(a/)ng (4)ngan_ (sap6 aai3 gau2 zaang1 ngan4 十嗌九爭銀), ten to one it is a quarrel about money. Williams' 十嗌九爭銀: "Ten to one" is perhaps better rendered "nine in ten". To choke (Kangxi: 嗌噎也 etc.). 【嗌】 (aai3) To shout. 大聲嗌 (daai6 seng1 aai3): "Shout out loud." To quarrel. 你哋嗌飽佢啦 (nei5 dei6 aai3 baau2 keoi5 la1): "Why don't youse quarrel over it to your heart's content." 又嗌交喇 (jau6 aai3 gaau1 laa3): "They're quarrelling again." To order food. 嗌餸未 (aai3 sung3 mei6): "Ordered dishes yet?" The spelling 嗌 is arbitrary (but well established).

ak1.text: U+9628 隘 aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.32 阨) 困窮也 (Page 3 #1: 隘(3) _(A/)i(3)_ (aai3); here corrected to _Ak(7)_ (ak1) and normalised to 阨) impeded, stopped up; (Page 3 #7: 阨(7) _Ak(7)_ (ak1)) An obstruction (Kangxi: 限也), a stop (Kangxi: 塞也); embarrassed, distressed, poor; _kw(')an(3) ak(7)_ (kwan3 ak1 困阨) hampered, restrained. Most modern speakers prefer the longer syllable _(a/)k(7)_ (aak1). Williams' "embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed". 【阨】 ('eak) (_noun-like_) pass

aai3.text: U+9698 阨 ngaai3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.28 隘) 窄狹也陋也塞也 (Page 3 #1: 隘(3)) A pass, a defile (Kangxi: 古之爲軍也不以阻隘也 etc.); narrow (Kangxi: 陋也, 陝也), confined, straitened; distressed, urgent (Kangxi: 急也); narrowminded, mean; _(4)yan k(o\)m(3) (a/)i(3)_ (jan4 gam3 aai3 人咁隘) way is all crowded, a jam; _h(a/)p(9) (a/)i(3)_ (haap6 aai3 狹隘) narrow as a pass; a contracted mind. (Page 3 #7: 阨(7) _Ak(7)_ (ak1); here corrected to _(A/)i(3)_ (aai3) and normalised to 隘) a defile, a pass (Kangxi 阨: 或作隘阸陋也); a dangerous path; 【隘】 ('eaH) (_noun-like_) defile (_adjective-like_) narrow

ak1.text: U+5384 戹 阨 (for "adversity" sense) aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.33 厄) 困窮也阻難也 (F2.33 戹) 同上 (Page 3 #6: 厄(7)~~𢨪(7)~~) small door in a house (Kangxi 厄: 同戹); impeded, cramped; to be ill-used, to be straitened; _ak(7) (4)k(')ung_ (ak1 kung4 厄窮), poor; _(4)ngai ak(7)_ (ngai4 ak1 危厄) in danger. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 卮 to 戹. Most modern speakers prefer the longer syllable _(a/)k(7)_ (aak1). Williams erroneously has 𢨪 for an alternative form instead of 戹. Adversity, hardship. 【厄】 ('eak) (_noun-like_) adversity, hardship

aak1.text: U+5443 阨 (Cantonese) ak1 (shorter syllable) ngaak1 (alternative) (Page 3 #11: 阨(7) _(A/)k(7)_ (aak1); here normalised to 呃) A colloquial word; also pronounced _ak(7)_ (ak1) and _ngak(7)_ (ngak1) To deceive, to delude, to take in; _(2)k(o\)m y(e/)ung(6) (a/)k(7) (4)yan k(e/)(3)_ (gam2 joeng6-2 aak1 jan4 ge3-2 噉樣呃人嘅) are you going to cheat him so! 【呃】 (aak1, ngaak1) To deceive, to trick, to scam. 你呃人 (nei5 ngaak1 jan4): "You're deceiving others." 呃錢 (aak1 cin4-2): "That's a scam for money" (i.e. a rip-off). The spelling 呃 is arbitrary.

ak1.text: U+627C 㧖 搤 搹 aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.33 扼) 持也抑也 (Page 3 #8: 扼(7)) To seize or hold with the hand (Kangxi 㧖: 把也); to gripe, to clutch; the grasp; to pull; _ak(7) (2)(u/)n ~~(2)k(a/)u~~ (2)kau (1)ch(i/)_ (ak1 wun2 gau2 zi1 扼腕久之), held him by the wrist a long time. Williams' 扼腕久之: Corrected _(2)k(a/)u_ (gaau2) to _(2)kau_ (gau2). To control. To suppress (Kangxi 㧖: 抑也), to block.

U+63E1 aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.32 握) 持也 (Page 3 #3: 握(7)) To grasp, to hold within the hand (Kangxi: 搤持也 etc.); a little, as much as the palm can hold; _ak(7) teng(6)_ (ak1 deng6 握定) to grasp firmly; _ak(7) (2)shau_ (ak1 sau2 握手), to shake hands; _ak(7) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (ak1 ci4 握持), to hold in the hand; _ak(7) i(u/)(3)_ (ak1 jiu3 握要) necessary. Most modern speakers prefer the longer syllable _(a/)k(7)_ (aak1). 【握】 ('aewk) (_verb-like_) to grasp

aak1.text: U+8EDB 厄 扼 軶 轭 (Mainland simplified) ak1 (shorter syllable) ngaak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.33 軛 _Ak(7)_ (ak1)) 轅端橫木駕馬頸者 (F2.90 軛 _(A/)k(8)_ (aak3)) 牛軛 (Page 3 #10: 軛(7)) A yoke (Kangxi: 轅端橫木駕馬領者); the yoke of a carriage; a yoke, a restraint, a principle of conscience. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 本 to 木. 【軛】 ('eak) (_noun-like_) yoke

aak3.text: U+922A aak3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) ngaak3 (alternative) (F2.90 鈪) 哀百切鈪鐲也 (Page 3 #9: 鈪(8)) An unauthorized character. A bracelet; a bangle; _k(e/)uk(8) (a/)k(8)_ (goek3 aak3-2 腳鈪) an anklet; _(1)kam (a/)k(8)_ (gam1 aak3-2 金鈪) a gold wristlet; _(1)s(e/)ung (a/)k(8)_ (soeng1 aak3-2 鑲鈪) a plated or gilded ring; _(a/)k(8) (4)t(')au_ (aak3-2 tau4 鈪頭), clasps of bracelets. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 表 to 哀, and 燭 to 鐲. 【鈪】 (aak3-2) A bracelet or bangle. 手鈪 (sau2 aak3-2): "A hand bracelet." The spelling 鈪 is arbitrary (but well established).

aam2.text: U+83E1 (F2.64 菡 _(2)(A/)m_ (aam2) or _(2)H(a/)m_ (haam2)) 菡萏荷花也 (Page 4 #1: (2)菡) Fan Wan entry: The initial is uncertain.

haam5.text: U+83E1 aam2 (per Williams) (F2.64 菡 _(2)(A/)m_ (aam2) or _(2)H(a/)m_ (haam2)) 菡萏荷花也 (Page 4 #1: (2)菡 _(2)(A/)m_ (aam2); here normalised to _(5)H(a/)m_ (haam5)) An unopened flower (Kangxi: 菡猶含也未吐之意); _~~(2)(a/)m~~ (5)h(a/)m t(a/)m(6)_ (haam5 daam6 菡萏), the lotus flower; a poetical name. Fan Wan entry: The initial is uncertain. 【菡】 (homX) Used in 菡萏. 【菡萏】 (homX domX) (_noun-like_) lotus flower

aan3.text: U+664F aan3-2 (rising second in vernacular 晏晏地) ngaan3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.70 晏) 日旰也晚也又安也 (Page 4 #2: 晏(3)) Evening, sunset; a serene, clear, sky (Kangxi: 天淸也); tardy, behindhand (Kangxi: 晚也); peaceful, gentle (Kangxi: 和柔也); rich, full, said of furs (Kangxi: 鮮盛也 etc.); a tiffin; _(2)h(i/) (1)shan (a/)n(3)_ (hei2 san1 aan3 起身晏) to rise late; _sh(e/)ung(6) (a/)n(3)_ (soeng6 aan3 上晏) forenoon; _fan(3) (a/)n(3) k(a/)u(3)_ (fan3 aan3 gaau3 瞓晏覺) to take a siesta; _fong(3) (a/)n(3) hok(9)_ (fong3 aan3 hok6 放晏學) recess in school; _shik(9) (a/)n(3)_ (sik6 aan3 食晏) to eat lunch; _(a/)n(3) chau(3)_ (aan3 zau3 晏晝) noon; _ts(o\)(6) (a/)n(3)_ (zou6 aan3 做晏) to get tiffin; _k(o\)m(3) (a/)n(3)_ (gam3 aan3 咁晏) so late! Fan Wan entry: Corrected 旴 (dawn) to 旰 (late). Williams' "tiffin": British for "lunch". Williams' 上晏: Now rarely heard; 上晝 is more common. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【晏】 ('aenH) (_adjective-like_) clear, cloudless (_adjective-like_) serene (_adjective-like_) late 【晏】 (aan3) Late (in the day). 三點咁晏 (saam1 dim2 gam3 aan3): "3 o'clock? that late?" 晏得嚌 (aan3 dak1 zai6): "That's too late in the day." 晏啲 (aan3 di1): "Later in the day." Lunch. 食晏未 (sik6 aan3 mei5): "Eaten lunch yet?" 【晏晝】 (aan3 zau3) Afternoon. 晏晝有戲睇 (aan3 zau3 jau5 hei3 tai2): "There's a movie to watch in the afternoon." Olden attestation for 晏 _(a/)n(3)_ (aan3) meaning "late": 《廣韻》烏澗切 晏 柔也天淸也又晚也又姓左傳齊有晏氏代爲大夫 《康熙字典》晏 《唐韻》烏㵎切《集韻》《韻會》《正韻》於諫切𠀤音曣...又《玉篇》晚也《儀禮士相見禮》問日之早晏《淮南子天文訓》日至于桑野是謂晏食《屈原離騷》及年歲之未晏兮...

U+9DC3 鴳 ngaan3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.70 鷃) 鳸鷃鳥名 (Page 4 #3: 鷃(3)) A kind of small (Kangxi: 小雀也) partridge, which breeds on the ground (Kangxi: 鷃不木處), and is said to crow in the morning (Kangxi: 常晨鳴如雞). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰斤鳥 to 鳸. 【鷃】 ('aenH) (_noun-like_) quail

aang1.text: U+7F4C 罃 甇 甖 罂 (Mainland simplified) ang1 (shorter syllable) ngaang1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.30 罃 _(1)Ang_ (ang1)) 魏侯名 (F2.30 罌 _(1)Ang_ (ang1)) 瓦屬 (F2.88 𦉍) 屋坑切瓶屬 (F2.88 ？) 同上 (Page 4 #5: (1)罃 _(1)Ang_ (ang1); here normalised to 罌) An earthen jar, with a narrow neck, to hold oil, &c. (Kangxi 罃: 備火長頸甁也); _(1)ang ong(3) (2)tsai_ (ang1 ong3 zai2 罌盎仔), a tadpole. (Page 4 #10: (1)甖(1)罌) Used with the last but four (罃 _(1)Ang_ (ang1)). a vase, a jar, a gallipot, an earthen pitcher (Kangxi 罌: 缶也, 甁也, 瓦器也); _(4)t(')ong (2)kwo (1)(a/)ng_ (tong4 gwo2 aang1 糖果罌), a jar of sweetmeats; _(4)yau (1)(a/)ng_ (jau4 aang1 油罌), an oil can; _yat(7) (1)(a/)ng (5)y(e/)_ (jat1 aang1 je5 一罌嘢), a thing; _(2)shui (1)(a/)ng_ (seoi2 aang1 水罌), a water pitcher. 【罌】 ('eang) (_noun-like_) jar 【罌】 (aang1) A jar or cylindrical-ish container. 罌鹽 (aang1 jim4): "The jar of salt." 買多罌 (maai5 do1 aang1): "Buy one more jar."

aap3.text: U+62BC (F2.65 押) 管押簽押 (Page 5 #2: 押(8))

aat3.text: U+62BC aap3 (per 《廣韻》烏甲切) ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.65 押 _(A/)p(8)_ (aap3)) 管押簽押 (Page 5 #2: 押(8) _(A/)p(8)_ (aap3); here normalised to _(A/)t(8)_ (aat3)) To sign, to affix a seal, to stamp (Kangxi: 署也 etc.); to control, to guard (Kangxi: 按也一曰管拘也); to arrest, to seize, to detain; to compel, to force; to escort; to suppress; a lockup or detention room in a y(a/)mun (衙門); _w(a/)k(9) (1)f(a/) ~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8)_ (waak6 faa1 aat3 畫花押) to make one's mark, to write a device; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) fo(3)_ (aat3 fo3 押貨) to escort goods; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (5)k(')(u ts(o\)(6)_ (aat3 keoi5 zou6 押佢做) make him do it; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) sung(3) (4)yan_ (aat3 sung3 jan4 押送人), an escort; _(4)'m (1)k(a/)m ~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (5)n(i/)_ (m4 gaam1 aat3 nei5 唔監押你), I'll not keep you; not detain you; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) ~~wan(6)~~ (5)wan_ (aat3 wan5 押韻) to rhyme; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (4)sh(un_ (aat3 syun4 押船), custom-house boats, guard-boats; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) chan(6)_ (aat3 zan6 押陣) to go into battle; _(1)ts(')(i/)m ~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (4)fong_ (cim1 aat3 fong4 簽押房), a lockup; _(1)ts(')(i/)m ~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8)_ (cim1 aat3 簽押) to endorse an edict, in red ink; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (1)pong_ (aat3 bong1 押幫) to look after, to escort; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (1)tung_ (aat3 dung1 押冬), kept over winter; left over the season, as teas. (Page 5 #5: 押(8) _(A/)t(8)_ (aat3)) To pawn for a time; to reserve, to keep back; _(a/)t(8) kwai(6)_ (aat3 gwai6 押櫃) deposit money; _(2)h(e/)ung (a/)t(8)_ (hoeng2 aat3 餉押) recognized pawn-shops; _kai(3) (a/)t(8)_ (gai3 aat3 髻押) a hair band-pin; _(a/)t(8) p(')i(u/)(3)_ (aat3 piu3 押票) to pledge or shave a pawn ticket; _(2)kau (5)'ng (a/)t(8)_ (gau2 ng5 aat3 九五押) a five per cent. discount pawnbroker; _(2)si(u/) (a/)t(8)_ (siu2 aat3 小押) a little pawn-shop; _tong(3) (a/)t(8)_ (dong3 aat3 當押) to pawn. Williams has the non-pawn senses under _(A/)p(8)_ (aap3) and the pawn senses under _(A/)t(8)_ (aat3). Whilst _(a/)p(8)_ (aap3) is expected from Middle Chinese 烏甲切, the common reading of 押 is _(a/)t(8)_ (aat3). Note that 押 is (probably) cognate with 壓, and while 壓 also has a Middle Chinese reading of 烏甲切, its modern reading as aat3 is uncontroversial. Williams' 押韻: Changed _wan(6)_ (wan6) to common reading _(5)wan_ (wan5). 【押】 ('aep) (_verb-like_) to stamp, to seal

aap3.text: U+9D28 鸭 (Mainland simplified) aap3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) ngaap3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.65 鴨) 家鶩又名田鳧 (Page 5 #1: 鴨(8)) A duck, a mallard; _(2)h(i/)n (a/)p(8)_ (hin2 aap3-2 蜆鴨) a wild duck; _l(a/)p(9) (a/)p(8)_ (laap6 aap3-2 臘鴨) dried ducks; _(2)ch(')(a/)u (a/)p(8) p(')(i/)n(3)_ (caau2 aap3 pin3-2 炒鴨片) fried duck cutlet; _(a/)p(8) (4)mi(u/)_ (aap3 miu4 鴨苗), ducklings; _p(u/)i(6) (a/)p(8) (2)tsai_ (bui6 aap3 zai2 焙鴨仔), to hatch ducks artificially. 【鴨】 ('aep) (_noun-like_) duck 【鴨】 (aap3-2) (_slang_) A male prostitute. Compare 雞 gai1 "chicken" for female prostitute. (TODO) 做鴨 (zou6 aap3-2): "Be a male-prostitute."

aat3.text: U+58D3 压 aap3 (per 《廣韻》烏甲切) ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.72 壓) 鎮也覆也 (Page 6 #1: 壓(8)) To overthrow, as a wall (Kangxi: 壞也); to supply a want (Kangxi: 塞補也); to press down, to steady, to settle (Kangxi: 笮也); to bend; to subject, to suppress, to conquer (Kangxi: 一曰鎭壓); to injure, to oppress; to repress, as alarm; to intimidate; _(a/)t(8) w(a/)i(6)_ (aat3 waai6 壓壞) to crush, to hurt by laying on; _(a/)t(8) p(a/)k(8) sing(3)_ (aat3 baak3 sing3 壓百姓) to vex the people; _(4)t(')(a/)n (a/)t(8)_ (taan4 aat3 彈壓) to subdue, to put a stop to, as a row; _(a/)t(8) (1)king_ (aat3 ging1 壓驚), to quiet one's fears; _(a/)t(8) ch(u(6)_ (aat3 zyu6 壓住) to steady; _chan(3) (a/)t(8)_ (zan3 aat3 鎮壓) to repress (a revolt); to remove evils; _(a/)t(8) shat(9)_ (aat3 sat6 壓實) to press solid. 【壓】 ('aep) (_verb-like_) to press down, to suppress

U+605D gaat3 (per 《正韻牋》訖黠切) ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.72 恝) 恝然無愁之貌 (Page 5 #9: 恝(8)) To dismiss care; contented, lighthearted; ~~happy looking~~ without sorrow (Kangxi: 無愁貌); _(a/)t(8) (4)(i/)n_ (aat3 jin4 恝然), ~~pleased~~ indifferent. 【恝】 (keat) (_adjective-like_) indifferent, sorrowless

U+63E0 ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.72 揠) 拔也助禾苗長也 (Page 5 #7: 揠(8)) To pull up (Kangxi: 拔也); to eradicate; _(a/)t(8) (4)mi(u/)_ (aat3 miu4 揠苗), to pull up a shoot in order to hasten its growth. 【揠】 ('eat) (_verb-like_) to pull up
U+79F8 (F2.72 秸) 禾稾去其皮曰秸 (Page 5 #8: 秸(8))

U+904F ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.72 遏) 止也絕也 (Page 5 #4: 遏(8)) To stop, to bring to a standstill (Kangxi: 遏止也); unforeseen obstacle; to reach, to arrive (Kangxi: 逮也); to cut off, to put a stop to (Kangxi: 絕也); _(2)cho (a/)t(8)_ (zo2 aat3 阻遏) to stop one doing, to restrain; _(a/)t(8) tek(9)_ (aat3 dek6 遏糴) to hold on to rice; _(a/)t(8) yuk(9) (4)n(a/)n_ (aat3 juk6 naan4 遏慾難), hard to curb one's lusts. 【遏】 ('at) (_verb-like_) to curb, to arrest

U+95BC 阏 (Mainland simplified) ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.72 閼) 閉也塞也又音謁又音煙 (Page 6 #2: 閼(8)) To shut, to stop up (Kangxi: 遮壅也); to obstruct (Kangxi: 止也塞也); to suffocate; to prevent superiors knowing; _(a/)t(8) sak(7)_ (aat3 sak1 閼塞) to stop up, as water. 【閼】 ('at) (_verb-like_) to block

U+981E 齃 ngaat3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.72 頞) 額也 (Page 6 #3: 頞(8)) The root of the nose (Kangxi: 鼻莖也); the frontal sinus; a saddle (Kangxi: 頞鞍也); _ts(')uk(7) (a/)t(8)_ (cuk1 aat3 蹙頞) to knit the brows; _(1)yau (a/)t(8)_ (jau1 aat3 幽頞) a lemur. 【頞】 ('at) (_noun-like_) nosebridge

aau1.text: U+5773 ngaau1 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 6 #12: (1)坳) A colloquial word. Poor, destitute; _(1)(a/)u ai(3)_ (aau1 ai3 坳屭) in want.

aau3.text: U+5773 㘭 aau1 (per 《廣韻》於交切 for literary "uneven-ground" senses) ngaau3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.42 㘭) 地㘭下也不平也 (Page 6 #12: (1)坳 _(1)(A/)u_ (aau1); here normalised to _(A/)u(3)_ (aau3)) A furrow, a hollow (Kangxi: 窊下也); an unevenness in the ground; undulations; rolling, as land. (Page 7 #3: 坳(3)) A colloquial word; a turn, a corner; _(2)ch(un (a/)u(3)_ (zyun2 aau3 轉坳) turn the corner. The reading _(a/)u(3)_ (aau3) is not unattested; Kangxi has 《集韻》於敎切音拗義同. 【坳】 ('aew, 'aewH) (_noun-like_) depression, uneven-ground

aau2.text: U+62D7 抝 ngaau2 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.42 (上聲) 拗) 屋狡切以手拉折物 (Page 7 #1: (2)拗) To snap a thing in two (Kangxi: 手拉也, 折也); to twist, to break; ~~to drag along;~~ _(2)(a/)u ch(i/)t(8)_ (aau2 zit3 拗折) to break in two; _(2)(a/)u sui(3)_ (aau2 seoi3 拗碎) to snap in shivers; _(2)(a/)u (2)shau (2)keng_ (aau2 sau2 geng2 拗手頸), to try the strength of the hands; to fall out about a matter; _(2)(a/)u (2)ch(un (2)kong_ (aau2 zyun2 gong2 拗轉講), to speak in irony, badinage; _(2)(a/)u (4)(u_ (aau2 jyu4-2 拗魚), to catch fish in a lifting net. A colloquial word. Warped, bent; curved; _(2)(a/)u (2)(a/)u tik(7)_ (aau2 aau2 dik1 拗拗滴) a little crooked; _(2)(a/)u (1)l(un_ (aau2 lyun1 拗攣), to curve. Williams' "to drag along": This is a misreading of Kangxi 手拉也. 【拗】 ('aewX) (_verb-like_) to snap 【拗】 (aau2) To bend or curve. 拗手瓜 (aau2 sau2 gwaa1): "Arm wrestle." 拗柴 (aau2 caai4): "Sprained ankle."

aau3.text: U+62D7 㑃 抝 ngaau3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.42 (去聲) 拗) 偏急不相合也 (Page 7 #2: 拗(3)) Obstinate, self-willed, perverse (Kangxi: 拗戾); to rush against madly (Kangxi: 固相違也); _(a/)u(3) (2)keng_ (aau3 geng2 拗頸), stiffnecked; _(a/)u(3) h(i/)(3)_ (aau3 hei3 拗氣) disputatious, opinionated; _(a/)u(3) t(o\)(3) t(i/)m(6) (4)wai (2)ch(i/)_ (aau3 dou3 dim6 wai4 zi2 拗到掂為止), I must have it so or not at all; _chap(7) (a/)u(3)_ (zap1 aau3 執拗) set in his way; _(2)f(a/)n (a/)u(3)_ (faan2 aau3 反拗) whimsical, contrariwise.

U+51F9 aau1 (per 《集韻》於交切) ngaau3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.42 凹) 灣也曲也 (Page 7 #4: 凹(3)) Indented (Kangxi: 窊也); meandering; the dip of the horizon, the undulations in hills; a hole, a depression, a pit; _(1)sh(a/)n (a/)u(3)_ (saan1 aau3 山凹) a valley; _(a/)u(3) tsz'(6)_ (aau3 zi6 凹字) characters cut in bas relief.

U+8A4F 拗 (Cantonese) ngaau3 (hypercorrected initial) Defiant in speech (Kangxi: 言逆也). 【詏】 (aau3) To argue. 詏撬 (aau3 giu6): "Argument." 詏贏 (aau3 jeng4): "Win the argument." Olden attestation for 詏 _(a/)u(3)_ (aau3) meaning "argue": 《康熙字典》詏 《集韻》《正韻》𠀤於敎切妖去聲言逆也

ai1.text: U+54CE 𫫃 (Cantonese) 唉 (Cantonese) (Page 2 #3: (1)𫫃; here normalised to 哎) A particle of surprise or pain; _(1)ai (1)y(a/)_, (ai1 jaa1 哎吔) whew! halloo! oh, dear! _(1)ai, mat(7) (5)n(i/) (2)k(o\)m ts(o\)(6)_ (ai1 mat1 nei5 gam2 zou6 哎乜你噉做) oh! why did you do so? <## Williams' 哎求你: Corrected _(1)k(')au_ (kau1) to _(4)k(')au_ (kau4). ##> 【哎吔-pain】 (ai1 ja4) An interjection of pain, mistake, etc. 哎吔 (ai1 ja4): "Ouch", "Whoops", etc. 【哎吔-indignation】 (ai1 jaa1) An interjection of surprise, shock, indignation, etc. 哎吔 (ai1 jaa1): "Oh dear!", "How dare you!", etc. So-called, or nominal. 哎吔經理 (ai1 jaa1 ging1 lei5): "So-called manager." The spelling 哎吔 is arbitrary.

e1.text: U+2BAC3 nge1 (alternative for onomatopoeic whine sense) (Page 42 #9: (1)𫫃) A final particle, denoting are you willing, if you please, is it not so? _(5)Ngo k(a/)u(3) (5)n(i/) tuk(9) (1)(e/)_ (ngo5 gaau3 nei5 duk6 e1 我教你讀𫫃), shall I teach you to read? _sh(i/)(3) yat(7) sh(i/)(3) (1)(e/)_ (si3 jat1 si3 e1 試一試𫫃), try, will you? (Page 713 #5: (1)𫫃) A tone, a whine; _(1)(e/) (1)(e/) (1)sheng_ (e1 e1 seng1 𫫃𫫃聲), the whining moan of a sick child. Also pronounced _(1)ng(e/)_ (nge1).

nge4.text: U+2BAC3 (Page 724 #4: _(4)Ng(e/)_ (nge4); here assigned to 𫫃) A colloquial word. A low tone; _(4)ng(e/) (4)ng(e/) (1)sheng_ (nge4 nge4 seng1 𫫃𫫃聲), a grumble, indistinct muttering.

ai2.text: U+77EE 躷 ngai2 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.31 矮) 不高也 (Page 2 #4: (2)矮) Low; diminutive, short (Kangxi: 短人也, 矬也); _(2)ai ~~(5)l(o\)~~ (2)l(o\) (2)tsai_ (ai2 lou2 zai2 矮佬仔), a pigmy, a little old man; _(2)p(i/) (1)ch(e/)ung (2)ai tang(3) (2)tsai (5)n(i/) ~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o_ (bei2 zoeng1 ai2 dang3 zai2 nei5 co5 畀張矮凳仔你坐) get a low stool for you to sit on---to delude one; _(2)ai tak(7) tsai(6)_ (ai2 dak1 zai6 矮得嚌) too low. Williams' 矮佬仔: Corrected _(5)l(o\)_ (lou5) to _(2)l(o\)_ (lou2). Williams' 畀張矮凳仔你坐: Corrected _tso(6)_ (zo6 去聲) to _(5)ts(')o_ (co5 上聲). 【矮】 ('eaX) (_adjective-like_) short

ai3.text: U+5C6D 屓 屃 (Mainland simplified) ngai3 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 2 #8: 屭(3))

hei3.text: U+5C6D 屓 屃 (Mainland simplified) (Page 2 #8: 屭(3) _Ai(3)_ (ai3); here corrected to _H(i/)(3)_ (hei3)) Strong, herculean, athletic (Kangxi: 壯大貌).

ai3.text: U+66C0 ngai3 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.32 曀) 陰而風也 (Page 2 #9: 曀(3)) Cloudy and windy (Kangxi: 隂而風也); the sun obscured and nearly hid by the clouds (Kangxi: 雲風曀日光 etc.). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 𦠉 to 曀. 【曀】 ('ejH) (_adjective-like_) (windily) overcast (_adjective-like_) obscured

U+7E0A 缢 (Mainland simplified) ngai3 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.32 縊) 懸樑自縊也 (Page 2 #5: 縊(3)) To hang, to strangle one's self (Kangxi: 經也, 懸繩曰縊); ~~the warp of cloth;~~ _ai(3) (2)sz' (2)kwai_ (ai3 sei2 gwai2 縊死鬼), ghost of a suicide; _ai(3) (2)keng_ (ai3 geng2 縊頸), hung by the neck. Williams' "the warp of cloth": This is a misreading of Kangxi 經也. 【縊】 ('ejH, 'jieH) (_verb-like_) to hang, to strangle

U+7FF3 屭 (in Cantonese 閉翳 spelt 贔屭) ngai3 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.32 翳) 障翳 (Page 2 #6: 翳(3)) A feather fan or screen, a flabellum (Kangxi: 華蓋也); to screen, to intercept (Kangxi: 翳猶屛也); to seclude from observation (Kangxi: 翳障也); to keep close, to repress (Kangxi: 隱也蔽也, 䕃也); to destroy (Kangxi: 一曰滅也); anything that intercepts; an obscurity in the eyes; trees ~~dying~~ dead and not standing (Kangxi: 木立死曰葘自死爲翳); a fabulous sort of pheasant (Kangxi: 鳥名也似鳳). A colloquial word. Feverish; sultry, hot; hurried breathing, a stricture in the breast; _ai(3) h(i/)(3)_ (ai3 hei3 翳氣) difficulty of breathing; _ai(3) (i/)t(9)_ (ai3 jit6 翳熱) hot weather; _(1)shan (2)tsz' ai(3) (i/)t(9)_ (san1 zi2 ai3 jit6 身子翳熱) feverish; _ai(3) fai(3)_ (ai3 fai3 翳肺) to feel grieved; _ai(3) chai(6)_ (ai3 zai6 翳滯) indigestible. (Page 2 #8: 屭(3); here normalised to 翳) A colloquial word; grief, sorrow; _pai(3) ai(3)_ (bai3 ai3 閉翳) trouble, resulting from affliction or poverty. 【翳】 ('ejH, 'ej) (_noun-like_) screen (_verb-like_) to screen, to cover (up) (_noun-like_) fallen-tree 【閉翳】 (bai3 ai3) To be exceedingly afflicted or troubled by something. Commonly spelt 贔屭.
U+26809 ngai3 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 2 #7: 𦠉(3)) Lean, cadaverous, meager, poor (Kangxi: 瘦也). Fan Wan entry: The headword 𦠉 is a misprint of 曀.

ak1.text: U+5E44 aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.32 幄) 覆帳也 (Page 3 #5: 幄(7)) A curtain, a screen (Kangxi: 帳也, 幬也); a large tent, a markee (Kangxi: 大帷); to protect, to shelter. 【幄】 ('aewk) (_noun-like_) tent, canopy

U+6E25 aak1 (longer syllable) ngak1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.32 渥) 厚也沾濡也洽也潤也 (Page 3 #4: 渥(7)) To moisten, to soak (Kangxi: 霑也); to enrich with favors; to fertilize; to cover or daub thick (Kangxi: 厚漬也); shining, rich; _ak(7) (4)mung_ (ak1 mung4 渥蒙), deeply grateful for; _(1)yan ak(7)_ (jan1 ak1 恩渥) imperial favor; _ak(7) (1)t(a/)n_ (ak1 daan1 渥丹), to make very red. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 沽 to 沾. 【渥】 ('aewk) (_verb-like_) to moisten, to imbue

am1.text: U+557D ngam1 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 724 #12: (1)啽) _(1)(o\)m mak(9)_ (am1 mak6 啽默) to be silent; to give no answer~~, as one whs is very sleepy~~. The reading _(1)(o\)m_ (am1) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 烏含切, explained 啽嘿不言.

U+5EB5 菴 ngam1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.87 庵) 園屋小草舍也又僧寺也 (F2.87 菴) 同上 (Page 341 #3: (1)庵(1)菴) A round hut (Kangxi 庵: 圜屋爲庵), a thatched cottage, a straw hovel (Kangxi 庵: 小草舍也) for soldiers or guard; a nunnery; _(1)sz' (1)k(u/) (1)(o\)m_ (si1 gu1 am1 師姑庵), a Budhist nunnery; _yap(9) (1)(o\)m_ (jap6 am1 入庵), to become a nun; _(1)(o\)m (4)t(')ong_ (am1 tong4 庵堂), a convent.

ap3.text: U+5EB5 ngap3 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 341 #3: (1)庵~~(1)菴~~ _(1)(O\)m_ (am1); here corrected to _(O\)p(8)_ (ap3)) a pig-sty (Kangxi 庵: 豕屋);

am1.text: U+83F4 (F2.87 庵) 園屋小草舍也又僧寺也 (F2.87 菴) 同上 (Page 341 #3: (1)庵(1)菴)

U+8AF3 闇 谙 (Mainland simplified) am2 (per Fan Wan) ngam1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.87 諳 _(2)(O\)m_ (am2)) 諳練曉也 (Page 342 #1: (2)諳 _(2)(O\)m_ (am2); here normalised to _(1)(O\)m_ (am1)) Accustomed, skilled in, versed (Kangxi: 練也歷也, 熟聞也); to know, fully acquainted with (Kangxi: 悉也, 知也, 曉也); knowing thoroughly, to commit to memory (Kangxi: 記也, 憶也), to recite, to chant or repeat (Kangxi: 誦也大聲也); _~~(2)(o\)m~~ (1)(o\)m l(i/)n(6)_ (am1 lin6 諳練) well practiced in, mature; _(4)'m ~~(2)(o\)m~~ (1)(o\)m shai(3) (4)ts(')ing_ (m4 am1 sai3 cing4 唔諳世情), unacquainted with the world; _~~(2)(o\)m~~ (1)(o\)m tsung(6)_ (am1 zung6 諳誦) to repeat exactly.

am2.text: U+8AF3 (F2.87 諳) 諳練曉也 (Page 342 #1: (2)諳)

am3.text: U+95C7 am2 (per Fan Wan) ngam3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.87 闇 _(2)(O\)m_ (am2)) 暗也 (Page 342 #2: (2)闇 _(2)(O\)m_ (am2); here normalised to _(O\)m(3)_ (am3)) To shut the door (Kangxi: 閉門也), to withdraw from society, to retire from; retired, dark, an obscure recess (Kangxi: 冥也, 幽也); ignorant, dark minded; badly lighted, unenlightened (Kangxi: 不明也); evening (Kangxi: 闇夜也); an eclipse (Kangxi: 闇日月食也); _~~(2)(o\)m~~ (o\)m(3) (4)m(u/)n ts(e/)(6) h(a/)k(8)_ (am3 mun4 ze6 haak3 闇門謝客) to decline to see friends; _~~(2)(o\)m~~ (o\)m(3) y(e/)uk(9)_ (am3 joek6 闇弱) unenlightened. 【闇】 ('omH) (_verb-like_) to shut away, to conceal (_adjective-like_) gloomy, unenlightened

am1.text: U+9D6A 䨄 鶕 䳺 鹌 (Mainland simplified) ngam1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.87 䳺) 䳺鶉鳥名 (Page 341 #4: (1)䳺; here normalised to 鵪) A quail (Kangxi 䳺: 䳺鶉); _(1)(o\)m ~~(4)shun~~ (1)ch(')un_ (am1 ceon1 鵪鶉), a quail, under which two or three species of Coturnix are included; _(4)lung (1)(o\)m_, (lung4 am1 籠鵪) quails beaten in fight, which are then put aside for the table. Williams' 鵪鶉: Changed _(4)shun_ (seon4) to common reading _(1)ch(')un_ (ceon1).
U+4CFA (F2.87 䳺) 䳺鶉鳥名 (Page 341 #4: (1)䳺)

am2.text: U+5535 ngam2 (hypercorrected initial) (Page 3 #12: (2)唵 _(2)Am_; here corrected to _(2)(O\)m_) To feed with the hands (Kangxi: 手進食也); to hold in the mouth (Kangxi: 含也); a word used by Budhists (Kangxi: 釋呪多用唵字). Corrected the Williams pronunciation from _(2)am_ to _(2)(o\)m_ per 《廣韻》烏感切 (notwithstanding both map to am2 in modern Cantonese). Williams' "a word used by Budhists": A transliteration of the Sanskrit ॐ (_Om_).
U+63A9 (Page 3 #13: (2)掩) Williams has am2 "cover" twice: once as 掩 _(2)Am_ (am2) on Page 3, and once as 掩 _(1)(O\)m_ (am1) as a variant of 揞 _(2)(O\)m_ (am2) on Page 341.

U+63DE 掩 (Cantonese) ngam2 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.87 揞) 藏也覆之也 (Page 3 #13: (2)掩 _(2)Am_ (am2); here normalised to 揞 _(2)(O\)m_ (am2)) A colloquial word. To cover with the hand (Kangxi 揞: 手覆也); to conceal from (Kangxi 揞: 藏也); _(2)am (4)m(a/)i (1)sh(e/)ung (5)ng(a/)n_, (am2 maai4 soeng1 ngaan5 揞埋雙眼) to cover both eyes; _(2)am ch(u(6)_ (am2 zyu6 揞住) hide it; _(2)am tik(7) p(u/)i(6) (2)shau_, (am2 dik1 bui6 sau2 揞滴背手) give him a little sop, cover his palm. (Page 341 #5: (1)掩(2)揞) To cover, to hide, to screen, by putting something on (Kangxi 揞: 掩也); ~~to extinguish, to suppress;~~ _(2)(o\)m ch(u(6) (2)hau_ (am2 zyu6 hau2 揞住口), to put the hand over the mouth; _(1)ch(e/) (2)(o\)m pat(7) ch(u(6)_ (ze1 am2 bat1 zyu6 遮揞不住) can not be hid; _(2)(o\)m ch(u(6) (4)t(')au hok(8)_ (am2 zyu6 tau4 hok3 揞住頭殼) to lean the head on the hand; _(2)p(i/) (2)shau (2)(o\)m ch(u(6)_ (bei2 sau2 am2 zyu6 畀手揞住) cover it with your hand; _(2)(o\)m mat(9) (4)lo (2)k(u/)_ (am2 mat6 lo4 gu2 揞密鑼鼓), "muffle the gong," _i. e._ keep it quiet; _(2)(o\)m (1)fung (4)k(')am_ (am2 fung1 kam4 揞風琴), to play a piano; ~~_(2)(o\)m m(i/)t(9)_ (am2 mit6 揞滅) to put out, as fire; to quash;~~ _(2)(o\)m ~~p(a/)k(8)~~ p(a/)k(9) (4)mai (4)mung_ (am2 baak6 mai4 mung4 揞白迷濛), blindman's buff; _(2)(o\)m ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u (1)sh(e/)ung (5)ng(a/)n_ (am2 zyu6 keoi5 soeng1 ngaan5 揞住佢雙眼), blindfold his eyes; _(2)(o\)m mak(9)_ (am2 mak6 揞脈) to feel the pulse; _(2)(o\)m p(u/)i(6) (2)shau_ (am2 bui6 sau2 揞背手) to give hush-money, to bribe. The first character (掩) is read _(2)(i/)m_ (jim2), but also used with this meaning in the _p(')ing shing_ (平聲). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𡈼 to 也. Williams' "to extinguish, to suppress", 揞滅: These are dubious. Kangxi 揞 has 《揚子方言》滅也荆楚曰揞 under the reading 於咸切黯平聲 _(1)am_ (am1). But 《抱經堂叢書》本 annotates a reading of 烏感反 _(2)am_ (am2), and says that 滅 is a typo for 藏. Williams' 揞白迷濛: Corrected _p(a/)k(8)_ (baak3) to _p(a/)k(9)_ (baak6). Williams' 揞背手: Now rarely heard; 揞口費 is more common for "hush money". 【揞】 (am2) To cover with the hand. 揞口費 (am2 hau2 fai3): "Hush money." Olden attestation for 揞 _(2)(o\)m_ (am2) meaning "cover": 《廣韻》烏感切 揞 手覆 《康熙字典》揞 《唐韻》《集韻》《韻會》《正韻》𠀤烏感切庵上聲藏也手覆也...
U+6B3F (F2.87 欿) 欿然不足之貌 (Page 342 #4: (2)欿)

U+9EEF ngam2 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.87 黯) 黯黯不明貌又漢臣汲黯 (Page 342 #3: (2)黯) Dark, pitch dark (Kangxi: 深黑也), dark as a midnight; astonied and silent, as if lost in amazement; _K(')ap(7) (2)(O\)m_ (kap1 am2 汲黯) a distinguished statesman of the H(a/)n (漢) dynasty. Saddened at parting (Kangxi: 黯然傷別貌). 【黯】 ('eamX, 'eam) (_noun-like_) pitch-black (_adjective-like_) dejected

am3.text: U+6697 闇 am3-2 (rising second in vernacular 暗暗地) ngam3 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.88 暗) 不明也又目不明貌 (Page 342 #5: 暗(3)) Sun obscured by clouds or otherwise (Kangxi: 日無光也); dark, dimly lighted (Kangxi: 不明也), sombre; gloomy, not shining bright; clandestine, unobserved, secret, underhand; dull, not perspicacious; private, mental; _hak(7) (o\)m(3)_ (hak1 am3 黑暗) dark; _(1)t(')(i/)n shik(7) (o\)m(3)_ (tin1 sik1 am3 天色暗) a dark day; _(1)tang (o\)m(3)_ (dang1 am3 燈暗) a dim lamp; _(o\)m(3) (2)s(e/)ung_ (am3 soeng2 暗想), to think over; _(2)t(a/) (o\)m(3) h(o\)(6)_ (daa2 am3 hou6 打暗號) to give a hint; _(o\)m(3) (1)chung ts(o\)(6) sz'(6)_ (am3 zung1 zou6 si6 暗中做事) to do things in the dark; _(o\)m(3) m(u/)i(6)_ (am3 mui6 暗昧) dull of perception; _(4)ho (1)p(a/)u (o\)m(3) (5)nam_ (ho4 baau1 am3 nam5 荷包暗稔), a full purse, well supplied with cash; _(o\)m(3) (1)k(a/)n_ (am3 gaan1 暗間), in the dark; _(o\)m(3) (5)li(u/)_ (am3 liu5 暗了), it is now night; _(o\)m(3) hoi(6)_ (am3 hoi6 暗害) to privily injure. 【暗】 ('omH) (_adjective-like_) dark, dim (_adjective-like_) covert 【暗算】 (am3 syun3) To wound (usually mortally) with a hidden weapon.

ang1.text: U+56B6 (F2.30 嚶) 鳥鳴聲之和 (Page 4 #6: (1)嚶)

U+9DAF 鸎 莺 (Mainland simplified) ngang1 (hypercorrected initial) (F2.30 鶯) 黃鶯鳥名 (Page 4 #4: (1)鶯) The nightingale or a gay species of thrush (Kangxi: 鶯鳥也卽黃鸝), that nestles on the willow and sings well; variegated plumes (Kangxi: 鳥羽文); _(4)wong (1)ang_ (wong4 ang1 黃鶯), the mango bird; _(1)ang (1)ko_ (ang1 go1 鶯哥), a parrot; _(1)ang (1)ko p(i/)(6)_ (ang1 go1 bei6 鶯哥鼻) a Roman nose. A colloquial word; a knot in a stick of wood; _p(')ek(8) kau(6) (4)ch(')(a/)i (1)ang_ (pek3 gau6 caai4 ang1 劈嚿柴鶯), split this knot for me. 【鶯】 ('eang) (_noun-like_) oriole (_adjective-like_) variegated

ang2.text: U+54FD (F2.31 哽) 鶯上聲哽咽 (Page 4 #7: (2)哽)

U+3F98 哽 (Cantonese) ngang2 (alternative) (Page 4 #8: (2)㾘) A colloquial word; to stick up, to press into or on; to inchase or emboss; _(2)ang tak(7) k(e/)uk(8) t(')ung(3)_ (ang2 dak1 goek3 tung3 㾘得腳痛) they hurt my foot; _(2)ang (1)f(a/)_ (ang2 faa1 㾘花), to emboss; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng shek(9) (2)ang_ (saang1 sek6 ang2 生石㾘), to have a stone bruise; _(2)ang (1)sam_ (ang2 sam1 㾘心), to disturb one, as bad news; painful. Williams' 生石㾘: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【㾘】 (ang2) To exert (or experience) a pressing force over a smallish or lump-sized area. 㾘牙 (ang2 ngaa4): "The food is hard and presses against my teeth." 㾘腳 (ang2 goek3): "It presses against my foot." The spelling 㾘 is arbitrary.

ang3.text: U+66F4 (Page 4 #9: 更(3)) A colloquial word, a corruption of _kang(3)_ (gang3). More, still more; try again; _ang(3) (5)yau (1)t(')(i/)m_ (ang3 jau5 tim1 更有添), there are more; _ang(3) noi(6) ~~t(i/)(6)~~ (1)t(i/)_ (ang3 noi6 di1 更耐啲) rather longer time. Williams' 更耐啲: Corrected _t(i/)(6)_ (dei6) to _(1)t(i/)_ (di1).

ap1.text: U+6D3D ngap1 (alternative) (Page 4 #11: 洽(7)) A colloquial word. To cover, over, to keep from the air; to cover, as with a poultice; poor, inferior; slovenly, neglected; _ap(7) w(a/)i(6)_ (ap1 waai6 洽壞) spoiled by mold; _ap(7) ap(7) ts(')ui(3)_ (ap1 ap1 ceoi3 洽洽脆) crinkling, as light pastry; _ap(7) chap(7) p(')(o\)(3)_ (ap1 zap1 pou3 洽汁舖) a miserable, dirty shop; _ap(7) (1)ch(')ong_ (ap1 cong1 洽瘡), to poultice; _(1)(u/)i (4)sh(u ap(7) (u/)(6)_ (wui1 syu4 ap1 wu6 煨薯洽芋) to roast a potato or taro in ashes; _met._ to enjoy one's self secretly. (Page 716 #8: 洽(9)) See _ap(7)_ (ap1). 【洽】 (ap1) To cover and keep wet (when undesirable to do so). The spelling 洽 is arbitrary.

au1.text: U+5340 区 (Mainland simplified) ngau1 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.49 區) 人姓又音拘 (Page 6 #4: (1)區) A surname (Kangxi: 姓); a measure of four pecks (Kangxi: 四豆爲區); _puk(9) (1)au_ (buk6 au1 蹼區), to conceal. Williams' "four pecks": It is disputed whether one 豆 is 0.4 pecks (豆實四升) or 1 peck (豆當爲斗毛居正曰豆古斗字). To conceal (Kangxi: 匿也). 【區】 ('uw) (_noun-like_) urna (_verb-like_) to conceal
U+5614 呕 (Mainland simplified) (Page 6 #9: (2)嘔 _(2)Au_ (au2); here corrected to _(1)Au_ (au1)) a child's prattle (Kangxi: 唲嘔小兒語也); _~~(2)au~~ (1)au (1)(a/)_ (au1 aa1 嘔啞), children humming;

au2.text: U+5614 歐 呕 (Mainland simplified) ngau2 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.54 嘔) 吐也 (Page 6 #8: (1)歐 _(1)Au_ (au1); _(2)Au_ (au2) implied) Used for the next (嘔), to vomit; (Page 6 #9: (2)嘔) Interchanged with the last (歐) (Kangxi: 與歐同吐也). To vomit (Kangxi: 吐也); the noise of retching; to spit out; _(2)au h(ut(8)_ (au2 hyut3 嘔血) to spit blood; _(2)au (1)f(a/)n ch(')ut(7) (4)lai_ (au2 faan1 ceot1 lai4 嘔返出嚟), to disgorge; to pay back; _tsok(8) (2)au_ (zok3 au2 作嘔), a disposition to vomit; _(2)au (1)hi(u/) (2)k(i/) t(a/)m(6)_ (au2 hiu1 gei2 daam6 嘔嘵幾啖) threw up several times; _(2)au t(')(o\)(3)_ (au2 tou3 嘔吐) to puke; _(2)au long(6)_ (au2 long6 嘔浪) seasick. 【嘔】 ('uwX) (_verb-like_) to vomit

au1.text: U+6B50 欧 (Mainland simplified) ngau1 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.49 歐) 歐陽覆姓也 (Page 6 #8: (1)歐) _(1)au (1)t(o\)_ (au1 dou1 歐刀), a headsman's sword (Kangxi: 𠛬人之刀也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). Used in 歐侯 and 歐陽 (compound surnames) (Kangxi: 歐侯歐陽俱複姓).
U+6F1A 沤 (Mainland simplified) ngau1 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.49 漚) 水上泡 (Page 6 #11: 漚(3)) Read _(1)au_ (au1)_;_ bubbles on the water (Kangxi: 浮漚也); frothy spume.

au3.text: U+6F1A 沤 (Mainland simplified) ngau3 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.55 漚) 以水久浸物曰漚 (Page 6 #11: 漚(3)) To soak, to macerate, to steep (Kangxi: 久漬也); to soften by soaking (Kangxi: 漚柔也); _au(3) l(a/)n(6)_ (au3 laan6 漚爛) soaked and spoiled; to macerate to rags; _au(3) (4)m(u/)i_ (au3 mui4 漚霉), soaked till moldy; _(4)'m (1)k(')am au(3)_ (m4 kam1 au3 唔𠸐漚) it will spoil if soaked long; _au(3) t(o\)(3) ch(')au(3)_ (au3 dou3 cau3 漚到臭) soaked till it stinks; _au(3) nau(6)_ (au3 nau6 漚腬) glutted, loathing food; _(4)t(')ang ~~sh(i/)n(6)~~ (5)sh(i/)n au(3) (1)ch(u yuk(9)_ (tang4 sin5 au3 zyu1 juk6 藤鱔漚豬肉) to fry eels in pork fat, _met._ to add insult to injury. Williams' 藤鱔漚豬肉: Corrected _sh(i/)n(6)_ (sin6) to _(5)sh(i/)n_ (sin5). 【漚】 ('uwH) (_verb-like_) to steep 【漚泥】 (au3 nai4) To rot in mud. Used to express discontent, contempt, etc.

au1.text: U+750C 瓯 (Mainland simplified) ngau1 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.49 甌) 茶甌 (Page 6 #5: ~~(7)甌~~(1)甌) A bowl (Kangxi: 小盆也, 瓦器), a deep cup (Kangxi: 今俗謂盌深者爲甌); _(5)ng(a/) (1)au_ (ngaa5 au1 瓦甌), a basin to hold water; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)au_ (caa4 au1 茶甌), a tea-cup; _(1)(i/)n (1)au_ (jin1 au1 煙甌), a tobacco-cup; _p(u/)n(3) (1)au_ (bun3 au1 半甌), half a cup, as of wine; _muk(9) (1)au_ (muk6 au1 木甌), a wooden bowl. Williams misprints the headword tone marker (1) as (7); here corrected.

U+8B33 嘔 歐 讴 (Mainland simplified) ngau1 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.49 謳) 謳歌長吟也 (Page 6 #7: (1)謳) To sing songs in recitative (Kangxi: 歌也); a chant (Kangxi: 吟也); a ballad, a ditty; _(ut(9) (1)au_ (jyut6 au1 粵謳), Canton Songs; _(1)au (4)yam_ (au1 jam4 謳吟), to sing songs. (Page 6 #8: (1)歐) To sing; to crow merrily; in which it is like the last (謳) (Kangxi 歐: 與謳同氣出而歌也). (Page 6 #9: (2)嘔 _(2)Au_ (au2); here corrected to _(1)Au_ (au1)) to sing, to make a glad noise (Kangxi 嘔: 與謳通); 【謳】 ('uw) (_verb-like_) to sing

U+9DD7 漚 䳼 鸥 (Mainland simplified) ngau1 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.49 鷗) 水鳥 (Page 6 #6: (1)鷗) A gull (Kangxi: 鷗水鴞也); _p(a/)k(9) (1)au_ (baak6 au1 白鷗) or _(4)h(a/)n (1)au_ (haan4 au1 閒鷗), a kind of gull found about Canton; _(1)sh(a/) (1)au_ (saa1 au1 沙鷗), a white gull.

au2.text: U+6BC6 歐 殴 (Mainland simplified) ngau2 (hypercorrected initial) (F1.54 毆) 毆辱捶擊也 (Page 6 #10: (2)毆) To fight, to hit with a stick (Kangxi: 捶毄物也, 以杖擊也); to strike, to knock; _tau(3) (2)au_ (dau3 au2 鬥毆), to wrangle, to fisticuff; _(2)au yuk(9)_ (au2 juk6 毆辱) to disgrace a man by knocking him; _(2)au (2)t(a/)_ (au2 daa2 毆打), to beat, to take a stick to. 【毆】 ('uwX) (_verb-like_) to beat

caa1.text: U+53C9 义 (Page 8 #11: (1)义; here normalised to 叉) A fork in a road; a prong, a crotch; to cross or interlace the fingers (Kangxi 叉: 手指相錯, 指相交也); _(4)wo (1)ch(')(a/)_ (wo4 caa1 禾叉), a pitch-fork; _(4)ngan (1)ch(')(a/)_ (ngan4 caa1 銀叉), a silver fork; _(4)(u (1)ch(')(a/)_ (jyu4 caa1 魚叉), a fish grains; _(1)ch(')(a/) (1)shi(u/)_ (caa1 siu1 叉燒), to roast on a fork; _(2)sh(a/) (1)ch(')(a/)_ (saa2 caa1 耍叉), to fence with tridents. 【叉】 (caa1) Short for 叉燒 (char shiu). 叉鴨米 (caa1 aap3 mai5): "Char shiu, roast duck vermicelli." Euphemistic substitute for any profane intensifier. 冇叉用 (mou5 caa1 jung6): "Bleeping useless." 【叉燒】 (caa1 siu1) Char shiu, a type of barbecued pork. 叉燒包 (caa1 siu1 baau1): "Barbecued-pork bun." 叉燒腸 (caa1 siu1 coeng4-2): "Barbecued-pork rice-noodle rolls."

U+5C94 caa3 (per 《字彙補》丑亞切) (Page 8 #10: ~~(1)汊~~(1)岔) (...) roads diverging (Kangxi 岔: 三分路也); _(1)s(a/)m (1)ch(')(a/) l(o\)(6) (2)hau_ (saam1 caa1 lou6 hau2 三岔路口), a trivium; The reading _(1)ch(')(a/)_ (caa1) is not unattested; the character 岔 appears under 《正韻牋》初加切逸字. Williams does not provide separate entries for 岔 and 汊, probably following Kangxi, which has 與汊同 under 岔. I have split things up accordingly. Williams' 三岔路口: Also spelt 三叉路口.

U+5DEE (F2.74 差) 差錯舛謬也 (Page 8 #9: (1)差) Mistaken (Kangxi: 舛也); to err, to differ (Kangxi: 貳也不相値也); to miss the mark, to exceed; error, fault, discrepancy, excess, differing, unlike, unassorted; _t(a/)i(6) (1)ch(')(a/) tak(9) (1)ch(')(a/)_ (daai6 caa1 dak6 caa1 大差特差), very wrong; _(1)ch(')(a/) tak(7) (5)(un_ (caa1 dak1 jyun5 差得遠), very different; _(1)ch(')(a/) ts(')o(3) k(e/)uk(8)_ (caa1 co3 goek3 差錯腳) a blunder, a faux pas; _(1)ch(')(a/) t(i/)t(7) (4)'m (4)t(')ung_ (caa1 dit1 m4 tung4 差啲唔同), differ very slightly; _(1)ch(')(a/) pat(7) (1)to_ (caa1 bat1 do1 差不多), nearly the same; _(1)ch(')(a/) ts(')o(3)_ (caa1 co3 差錯) a mistake; _ch(')ing(3) (1)ch(')(a/) s(a/)i(3)_ (cing3 caa1 saai3 秤差嗮) all weighed wrong. (Page 615 #2: (1)差 _(1)Ts(')z'_ (ci1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')(a/)_ (caa1)) _~~(1)ts(')z'~~ (1)ch(')(a/) (2)ho (4)yan (i/)(3)_ (caa1 ho2 jan4 ji3 差可人意) like what most men think. 【差-discrepancy】 (tsrhae) (_noun-like_) discrepancy, error 【差】 (caa1) (_derogatory_) South Asian. The etymology of 差 as a slur for "South Asian" is unclear. The spelling is well established.

caai1.text: U+5DEE (F2.25 差) 使也 (Page 11|n54 #1: (1)差) To commission, to send on a message (Kangxi: 差使也); to manage, to act; a messenger, an envoy; a legate, a commissioner; _(1)ch(')(a/)i sz'(3)_ (caai1 si3 差使) a bailiff; _(1)ch(')(a/)i yik(9)_ (caai1 jik6 差役) a policeman, a lictor; _(1)ch(')(a/)i sz'(6)_ (caai1 si6 差事) an errand; _k(a/)i(3) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (gaai3 caai1 解差), a criminal's guard; _(2)f(u/) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (fu2 caai1 苦差), an unpleasant duty; _ch(')ut(7) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (ceot1 caai1 出差), sent as legate; _(2)p(')(a/)u (1)king (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (paau2 ging1 caai1 跑京差), a courier with dispatches. To select, to choose (Kangxi: 擇也, 簡也). 【差-send】 (tsrheaj) (_verb-like_) to send (_noun-like_) messenger (_verb-like_) to select 【差】 (caai1) An officer. 差人 (caai1 jan4): "Police officer." 差佬 (caai1 lou2): "Copper." 差婆 (caai1 po4): "Copperess." 當差 (dong1 caai1): "Serve as a copper." 郵差 (jau4 caai1): "Post officer."

ci1.text: U+5DEE (F2.34 差) 參差不齊 (Page 615 #2: (1)差) Uneven, projecting irregularly (Kangxi: 不齊等也); _(1)ts(')(a/)m (1)ts(')z'_ (caam1 ci1 參差) irregular, not uniform; Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(')(i/)_ per 《廣韻》楚宜切. 【差-uneven】 (tsrhje) Used in 參差.

caa1.text: U+6260 (Page 8 #12: (1)扠) To fork out, to nip (Kangxi: 挾取也); to drive out, to pitch out, to strike; _(1)ch(')(a/) ch(')ut(7) h(u(3)_ (caa1 ceot1 heoi3 扠出去) turn him out; _(1)ch(')(a/) ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u_ (caa1 zyu6 keoi5 扠住佢), harpoon it.

U+6C4A caa3 (per 《集韻》楚嫁切) (Page 8 #10: (1)汊~~(1)岔~~) Streams (...) diverging (Kangxi 汊: 水岐流也); _(1)s(a/)m (1)ch(')(a/) (4)ho_ (saam1 caa1 ho4 三汊河), a river in Li(a/)utung (遼東). Williams does not provide separate entries for 岔 and 汊, probably following Kangxi, which has 與汊同 under 岔. I have split things up accordingly.

U+8256 co1 (per Fan Wan) (F2.58 艖 _(1)Ts(')o_ (co1)) 舟名 (Page 583 #5: (1)艖 _(1)Ts(')o_ (co1)) A skiff (Kangxi: 小舟也); _(4)(i/)m (1)ts(')o_ (jim4 co1 鹽艖), a salt boat, vessels used in salt transportation. Also read _(1)ch(')(a/)_ (caa1).

caa2.text: U+9454 镲 (Mainland simplified) caa4 (for onomatopoeic senses, and low first in reduplication 鑔鑔) A (usually small) cymbal. 打鑔鑔 (daa2 caa4 caa2): "Play the cymbal." 京鑔 (ging1 caa2): "The capital-style cymbal." (_onomatopoeia_) The sound of cymbals in Chinese opera. 鑔鑔拼 (caa4 caa4 peng3): "Char char pang!"

zaa1.text: U+5412 Used in mythological names. 哪吒 (naa4 zaa1): "Nezha."

zaa3.text: U+5412 咤 zaa1 (alternative per 《集韻》陟加切) (F2.76 咤 _Ch(')(a/)(3)_ (caa3)) 叱咤怒也噴也 (Page 9|n52 #6: 吒(3)咤(3) _Ch(')(a/)(3)_ (caa3); here corrected to _Ch(a/)(3)_ (zaa3)) To foam and sputter in anger (Kangxi 吒: 噴也叱怒也); to talk angrily; to grumble; _ch(')ik(7) ~~ch(')(a/)(3)~~ ch(a/)(3)_ (cik1 zaa3 叱吒) to rail at. 【吒】 (traeH) (_verb-like_) to sputter

caa3.text: U+54A4 (F2.76 咤) 叱咤怒也噴也 (Page 9|n52 #6: 吒(3)咤(3))
U+597C 姹 zaa3 (per 《廣韻》陟駕切) (F2.76 奼) 美女也 (Page 9|n52 #7: 奼(3)) A handsome girl (Kangxi: 美女也), a beautiful unmarried young lady (Kangxi: 少女也).
U+8721 (F2.28 蜡 _Ch(')(a/)i(3)_ (caai3)) 釵去聲祭名八蜡所以報土也 (F2.76 蜡) 八蜡祭名 (Page 9|n52 #8: 蜡(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰釒⿱丿乂 to 釵, corrected 入 to 八, and corrected 士 to 土.

ceoi3.text: U+8721 (Page 596 #4: 蜡(3)) A flyblow, eggs of the common fly (Kangxi: 蠅膽也). 【蜡-unvoiced】 (tshjoH) (_noun-like_) maggot

zaa3.text: U+8721 䄍 caa3 (per Fan Wan) caai3 (per Fan Wan) zaa6 (per 《廣韻》鋤駕切) (F2.28 蜡 _Ch(')(a/)i(3)_ (caai3)) 釵去聲祭名八蜡所以報土也 (F2.76 蜡 _Ch(')(a/)(3)_ (caa3)) 八蜡祭名 (Page 9|n52 #8: 蜡(3) _Ch(')(a/)(3)_ (caa3); here normalised to _Ch(a/)(3)_ (zaa3)) To bind up, sealed up, as in winter (Kangxi: 蜡也者索也 etc.); _p(a/)t(8) ~~ch(')(a/)(3)~~ ch(a/)(3)_ (baat3 zaa3 八蜡) a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the earth in winter for ripening crops. (Page 596 #4: 蜡(3)) Read _ch(a/)(3)_ (zaa3)_;_ the sacrifice made at the winter solstice (Kangxi: 年終祭名), when the cold binds everything close (Kangxi: 蜡也者索也 etc.). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰釒⿱丿乂 to 釵, corrected 入 to 八, and corrected 士 to 土. 【蜡-voiced】 (dzraeH) (_noun-like_) winter-sacrifice

caa3.text: U+8A6B 吒 咤 诧 (Mainland simplified) (F2.76 詫) 誇也 (Page 9|n52 #5: 詫(3)) To talk extravagantly, to vaunt (Kangxi: 誇也); to deceive (Kangxi: 誑也); _ch(')(a/)(3) (i/)(6)_ (caa3 ji6 詫異) ~~strange, foolish~~ wonder, astonishment. (Page 9|n52 #6: 吒(3)咤(3)) Used for the last (詫). Astonished.

caa4.text: U+55CF caa1 (per 《字彙》初加切) (F2.75 嗏) 唱曲長聲也 (Page 9|n52 #1: (4)嗏) A euphonic final sound used in chanting, to prolong the line (Fan Wan: 唱曲長聲也).

U+643D 塗 (Page 9|n52 #2: (4)搽) An unauthorized character. To smear, to rub in; to anoint; to rub in; _(4)ch(')(a/) p(a/)k(9) p(i/)(6) (1)ko_ (caa4 baak6 bei6 go1 搽白鼻哥), to whiten his nose, _i.e._ to palm off, to dupe; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)f(a/) (2)hau m(i/)n(6)_ (caa4 faa1 hau2 min6 搽花口面) to disguise one's face; _(4)ch(')(a/) y(e/)uk(9)_ (caa4 joek6 搽藥) to spread a plaster; _(4)ch(')(a/) (2)fan_ (caa4 fan2 搽粉), to rub on cosmetics. 【搽-spread】 (caa4) To apply, rub, or spread an ointment, cream, etc. 搽牛油 (caa4 ngau4 jau4): "Spread butter." 搽藥膏 (caa4 joek6 gou1): "Apply ointment." The spelling 搽 is arbitrary. Olden attestation for _(4)ch(')(a/)_ (caa4) meaning "apply", "rub", etc. exists in an alternative reading of 塗 (per Zhengzhang's analysis): 《廣韻》宅加切 塗 塗飾又音徒

caa5.text: U+643D 扠 (Cantonese) 【搽-smudge】 (caa5) To smudge or scribble out. 搽咗佢 (caa5 zo2 keoi5): "Scribble it out." 【搽禍】 (caa5 wo5) To ruin or spoil. 搽禍咗個計畫 (caa5 wo5 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6): "It's spoilt the plan." The spelling 搽 is arbitrary (but attested in Eitel (1877)). Wiktionary as of 2025-02-01 takes 䵦 to be the original character, but I am not convinced of this. While the classical meaning (to dirty) is reasonable, the reading per 《廣韻》徐野切 is _(5)ts(')(a/)_, not _(5)ch(')(a/)_. The second is required if it is cognate with level-tone 搽 caa4, from 塗 read _(4)ch(')(a/)_ per 《廣韻》宅加切.

caa4.text: U+67E5 (Page 9|n52 #4: (4)查) A raft, a float (Kangxi: 水中浮木); to examine, to inquire into (Kangxi: 考察也); it appears that, having learned, I have ascertained; _(4)ch(')(a/) ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (caa4 caat3 查察) to examine, to scrutinize; _(2)fong (4)ch(')(a/)_ (fong2 caa4 訪查), to ask about; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)k(a/)i_ (caa4 gaai1 查街), to patrol the streets; _(4)ch(')(a/) kwo(3) s(a/)i(3)_ (caa4 gwo3 saai3 查過嗮) inspected them all; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)shau_ (caa4 sau1 查收), I find it has been received; _(4)ch(')(a/) (4)ch(')(a/) (2)l(a/) (2)l(a/)_ (caa4 caa4 laa2 laa2 查查拉拉), idle prying into matters, tedious questioning.
U+69CE (F2.75 槎) 水中浮木 (Page 9|n52 #3: (4)槎) Drift-wood (Kangxi: 同查); a small raft (Kangxi: 桴也); to fell trees, to hew wood (Kangxi: 衺斫也); _(4)shing (4)ch(')(a/)_ (sing4 caa4 乘槎), to raft timber.
U+75C4 (Page 8 #1: (2)痄 _(2)Ch(a/)_ (zaa2); here corrected to _(4)Ch(')(a/)_ (caa4)) a severe disease (Kangxi: 痄疨病甚);

zaa3.text: U+75C4 zaa2 (per 《廣韻》側下切) (Page 8 #1: (2)痄 _(2)Ch(a/)_ (zaa2); here normalised to _Ch(a/)(3)_ (zaa3)) A running ulcer (Kangxi: 瘡不合也); _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng ~~(2)ch(a/)~~ ch(a/)(3) (1)soi_ (saang1 zaa3 soi1 生痄腮), a swelling on the cheek. Williams' 生痄腮: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1).

caa4.text: U+82F4 Plants floating in water (Kangxi: 水中浮草也), or withered plants (Kangxi: 苴是草木之枯槁者 etc.). 【苴-plant】 (dzrae) (_noun-like_) floating withered-plant

zeoi1.text: U+82F4 ceoi1 (per 《廣韻》七余切 for "grass-insole" sense and 《集韻》千余切 for "hempseed" sense) zeoi2 (per 《廣韻》子與切 for "grass-insole" sense) (F1.44 苴) 蔴無子曰苴又受賄賂曰包苴 (Page 594 #8: (1)苴) ~~The female~~ hemp ~~plant~~ (Kangxi: 麻也) or hempseed (Kangxi: 苴麻子也); sackcloth; a rush, a sedge used for sandals (Kangxi: 履中草); coarse, unpolished; _(1)ts(u p(o\)(3)_ (zeoi1 bou3 苴布) mourning sackcloth; _(2)p(o\) (1)ts(u_ (bou2 zeoi1 補苴), to correct bad composition; _(1)ts(u ch(e/)ung(6)_ (zeoi1 zoeng6 苴杖) the mourner's staff. Grass padding (Kangxi: 苴藉也). 【苴-hemp】 (tshjo) (_noun-like_) hemp, hempseed 【苴-insole】 (tshjo, tsjoX) (_noun-like_) grass-insole 【苴-padding】 (tsjo) (_noun-like_) grass-padding

caa4.text: U+8336 荼 (F2.75 茶) 茗也華烹之可止渴 (Page 8 #13: (4)茶) Tea (Kangxi: 春藏葉可以爲飮, 茗也); the infusion of tea, tea; _(1)p(o\) (4)ch(')(a/)_ (bou1 caa4 煲茶) to make tea; _h(i/)n(3) (4)ch(')(a/)_ (hin3 caa4 獻茶), to hand tea; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)f(a/)_ (caa4 faa1 茶花), the Camellia; _hak(7) (4)ch(')(a/)_ (hak1 caa4 黑茶), black tea; _luk(9) (4)ch(')(a/)_ (luk6 caa4 綠茶), green tea; _kuk(9) (4)ch(')(a/)_ (guk6 caa4 焗茶), to draw tea; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)p(u/)i_ (caa4 bui1 茶杯), a tea-cup; _(4)ch(')(a/) (4)(u/)_ (caa4 wu4-2 茶壺), a tea-pot; _(4)ch(')(a/) ~~(4)sh(i/)~~ (4)ch(')(i/)_ (caa4 ci4 茶匙), a tea-spoon; _(4)ch(')(a/) (4)sh(un_ (caa4 syun4 茶船), a long tea saucer; _(2)ch(')(a/)u (4)ch(')(a/)_ (caau2 caa4 炒茶), to fire tea; _ts(o\)(6) (4)ch(')(a/)_ (zou6 caa4 做茶), to cure tea; to set out tea; _(4)ch(')(a/) (4)lam_ (caa4 lam4 茶林), a tea store; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)k(u_ (caa4 geoi1 茶居), a tea-saloon; _(2)t(o\) (4)ch(')(a/) (4)lai_ (dou2 caa4 lai4 倒茶嚟), bring tea to the visitor; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)s(e/)ung_ (caa4 soeng1 茶箱), a tea-caddy; _yat(7) (1)s(e/)ung (4)ch(')(a/) (i/)p(9)_ (jat1 soeng1 caa4 jip6 一箱茶葉) a box of tea; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)k(i/)_ (caa4 gei1 茶几), a teapoy; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)sz'_ (caa4 si1 茶師) a tea-taster; _(4)ch(')(a/) m(u/)t(9)_ (caa4 mut6 茶末) tea dust. Williams' 茶匙: Changed _(4)sh(i/)_ (si4) to common reading _(4)ch(')(i/)_ (ci4). 【茶走】 (caa4 zau2) Milk tea but with condensed milk in place of normal milk and sugar.

caai1.text: U+640B 搓 To knead, to rub. 【搋波】 (caai1 bo1) (_ball games_) To pass the ball back and forth.

co1.text: U+6413 (F2.58 搓) 挪然也 (Page 583 #4: (1)搓) To twist by rubbing on the knee; to rub or roll between the palms (Kangxi: 搓挪也); _(1)ts(')o (4)m(a/)i yat(7) (4)t(')(un_ (co1 maai4 jat1 tyun4 搓埋一團), roll it into a ball; _(1)ts(')o s(i/)n(3)_ (co1 sin3 搓線) to twist thread; _(1)ts(')o (1)h(e/)ung_ (co1 hoeng1 搓香), to cover incense sticks by rolling; _(1)ts(')o (4)(un kam(6) (2)p(i/)n_ (co1 jyun4 gam6 bin2 搓圓撳扁), can be rolled or flattened; _met._ an easy obliging man; _(1)ts(')o (4)no_ (co1 no4 搓挪), to roll and mix between the hands; rustling, flexible, like willow twigs. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 梛 to 挪.

caai1.text: U+731C May appear as either ⿰犭靑 or ⿰犭青 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.25 猜) 疑也度也 (Page 11|n54 #3: (1)猜) To guess; to doubt, to conjecture (Kangxi: 疑也); to dislike; to abhor (Kangxi: 恨也); to fear, to apprehend, lest (Kangxi: 懼也); _(1)ch(')(a/)i yat(7) kuk(9) (1)chung_ (caai1 jat1 guk6 zung1 猜一焗盅), to bet a glass of wine; _(1)ch(')(a/)i kwat(7) (4)p(')(a/)i_ (caai1 gwat1 paai4-2 猜骨牌), to guess on dominoes; _(1)ch(')(a/)i tok(9)_ (caai1 dok6 猜度) an opinion or idea, to guess; _(1)ch(')(a/)i (4)m(u/)i_ (caai1 mui4-2 猜枚), or _(1)ch(')(a/)i (5)m(a/)_ (caai1 maa5 猜馬), morra, to guess at the fingers---a game; _(1)ch(')(a/)i (4)(i/)_ (caai1 ji4 猜疑), to suspect, to doubt of; _(1)ch(')(a/)i (4)(i/)m_ (caai1 jim4 猜嫌), to suspect and dislike; _(1)ch(')(a/)i (1)ng(a/)m_ (caai1 ngaam1 猜啱) guessed right; _(1)ch(')(a/)i yat(7) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (caai1 jat1 caai1 猜一猜) make a guess; _(5)n(i/) sh(i/)(3) (1)ch(')(a/)i~~, h(a/)(6)~~ (5)h(a/)_ (nei5 si3 caai1 haa5 你試猜吓) just guess. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ts(')(a/)i_ per 《廣韻》倉才切. Williams' 你試猜一吓: Corrected _h(a/)(6)_ (haa6) to _(5)h(a/)_ (haa5).

U+91F5 钗 (Mainland simplified) (F2.25 釵) 婦人之簪 (Page 11|n54 #2: (1)釵) A broad hair-pin (Kangxi: 筓屬); _met._ females; _puk(7) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (buk1 caai1 卜釵), to divine by a hair-pin when a husband will return; _(4)kw(')an (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (kwan4 caai1 群釵), a bevy of women; _(1)king (1)ch(')(a/)i_, (ging1 caai1 荊釵) a thorn hair-pin, _met._ poverty; _fung(6) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (fung6 caai1 鳳釵), an ornamental hair-pin with a phoenix.

caai2.text: U+8E39 踩 (in modern Cantonese) (F2.27 踹) 足踐踏也 (Page 11|n54 #7: (2)踹) To stamp, to trample, (...); _(2)ch(')(a/)i (5)(un sok(8)_ (caai2 jyun5 sok3 踹軟索) a treader on rope ladders---a thief; _(2)p(i/) (1)sai (1)kw(a/) (4)p(')(i/) (5)n(i/) (2)ch(')(a/)i_ (bei2 sai1 gwaa1 pei4 nei5 caai2 畀西瓜皮你踹), let you step on a melon skin---trip you up; _(2)ch(')(a/)i p(')o(3) (4)ying (4)p(')(u/)n_ (caai2 po3 jing4 pun4 踹破營盤), to remain victorious; _(2)ch(')(a/)i ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u_ (caai2 zyu6 keoi5 踹住佢), step on it; _(2)k(i/) (4)sh(i/) (4)ngau (2)ch(')(a/)i k(e/)uk(8)_ (gei2 si4 ngau4 caai2 goek3 幾時牛踹腳) when is your birthday? _(2)ch(')(a/)i shat(9)_ (caai2 sat6 踹實) to tread on firmly; _(2)ch(')(a/)i (1)tang (1)f(a/)_ (caai2 dang1 faa1 踹燈花), to tread on lampwicks (a thief); _(2)ch(')(a/)i (4)shing yuk(9) ts(e/)ung(3)_ (caai2 sing4 juk6 zoeng3 踹成肉醬) trampled to death. The character 踩 is an alternative form in modern Cantonese to the extent that both 踩 and 踹 are pronounced caai2 and mean "trample". However, note that: The Mandarin readings of 踩 and 踹 are distinct (being cai and chuai). The character 踩 is not attested in the Middle Chinese rime books. The pre-merger reading for 踩 would be _(2)ts(')(a/)i_ instead of _(2)ch(')(a/)i_ based on the initial of the phonetic 采, but the syllable _ts(')(a/)i_ does not exist under any tone in Fan Wan. Williams fuses into a single entry two distinct words: a relatively recent word meaning "trample" (caai2), and a relatively historic word meaning "heel" (see 踹 cyun2). I have split things up accordingly, with duplication where appropriate.

cyun2.text: U+8E39 cyun5 (per 《廣韻》市兖切) dyun3 (per 《廣韻》丁貫切) (Page 11|n54 #7: (2)踹 _(2)Ch(')(a/)i_ (caai2); here corrected to _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2)) Also read _~~(2)t(un~~ t(un(3)_ (dyun3). To stamp, to trample, to tread on with the heel (Kangxi: 踹足蹀足也); to rase, to destroy; the heel (Kangxi: 足踹也, 足跟也); Williams fuses into a single entry two distinct words: a relatively recent word meaning "trample" (see 踹 caai2), and a relatively historic word meaning "heel" (now commonly read cyun2). I have split things up accordingly, with duplication where appropriate. Williams' "Also read ...": Corrected _(2)t(un_ (dyun2) to _t(un(3)_ (dyun3).

caai3.text: U+562C saai3 (alternative per Williams) (F2.28 嘬) 齧也一舉盡臠又捐其食曰嘬 (Page 11|n54 #10: 嘬(3)) To gnaw, to bite (Kangxi: 齧也); to eat rapidly; to swallow, to bolt; _ch(')(a/)i(3) h(ut(8)_ (caai3 hyut3 嘬血) to suck blood; _ch(')(a/)i(3) ng(i/)t(9)_ (caai3 ngit6 嘬齧) to eat with a noise. Also read _sh(a/)i(3)_ (saai3). 【嘬】 (tsrhwaejH) (_verb-like_) to gnaw
U+7625 (Page 583 #9: (1)瘥 _(1)Ts(')o_ (co1); here corrected to _Ch(')(a/)i(3)_ (caai3)) To get convalescent, to recover (Kangxi: 疾愈也, 瘥癒也);

co4.text: U+7625 co1 (per Williams) ze1 (alternative per 《廣韻》子邪切) (Page 583 #9: (1)瘥 _(1)Ts(')o_ (co1); here normalised to _(4)Ts(')o_ (co4)) a slight ailment (Kangxi: 病也), slight epidemic, like influenza. 【瘥】 (dza, tsjae) (_noun-like_) ailment, (_met._) plague

zaai3.text: U+7635 caai3 (per Fan Wan) (F2.28 瘵 _Ch(')(a/)i(3)_ (caai3)) 勞病 (Page 11|n54 #9: 瘵(3) _Ch(')(a/)i(3)_ (caai3); here normalised to _Ch(a/)i(3)_ (zaai3)) Weary, sick (Kangxi: 勞病也, 病也); _(4)l(o\) ~~ch(')(a/)i(3)~~ ch(a/)i(3)_ (lou4 zaai3 癆瘵) consumption, a wasting disease; _tsz'(6) ~~ch(')(a/)i(3)~~ ch(a/)i(3)_ (zi6 zaai3 自瘵) to bring trouble on one's self. 【瘵】 (tsreajH) (_noun-like_) distress (_noun-like_) disease, wasting-disease

caai3.text: U+8806 䘍 虿 (Mainland simplified) (F2.28 蠆) 蜂毒也 (Page 11|n54 #8: 蠆(3)) The sting of a bee, or other insect; a sort of scorpion with a long tail (Kangxi: 螫蟲). 【蠆】 (trhaejH) (_noun-like_) scorpion, sting

caai4.text: U+5115 㑪 侪 (Mainland simplified) (F2.26 儕) 等也輩也 (Page 11|n54 #5: (4)儕) A class, a company (Kangxi: 等輩也); persons of the same sort; it makes the plural of the first person; _(4)'ng (4)ch(')(a/)i_ (ng4 caai4 吾儕), we. 【儕】 (dzreaj) (_noun-like_) class, compeer

U+67F4 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.26 柴) 薪也 (Page 11|n54 #4: (4)柴) Firewood, faggots; brushwood (Kangxi: 小木散材); fuel; to stop up (Kangxi: 塞也); _yat(7) (2)p(a/) (4)ch(')(a/)i_ (jat1 baa2 caai4 一把柴), a faggot of firewood; _(4)ch(')(a/)i (4)t(')au_ (caai4 tau4 柴頭), half burned sticks; _(1)kon (4)ch(')(a/)i pang(6) (2)fo_ (gon1 caai4 bang6 fo2 乾柴憑火), if dry wood is near the fire, will it not catch? _(4)ch(')(a/)i (1)f(a/)_ (caai4 faa1 柴花), kindlings; _(4)ch(')(a/)i (2)fo_ (caai4 fo2 柴火), firewood; _p(')o(3) (4)ch(')(a/)i_ (po3 caai4 破柴), to cleave wood; _(4)ch(')(a/)i (4)m(u/)n_ (caai4 mun4 柴門), a cottage door; _(4)p(')(a/)u (4)ch(')(a/)i_ (paau4 caai4 刨柴), shavings; _(4)ch(')(a/)i (1)san_ (caai4 san1 柴薪), faggots of wood. To burn firewood (for sacrifice) (Kangxi: 燔柴曰柴). To protect (Kangxi: 護也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【柴】 (dzrea) (_noun-like_) brushwood, firewood

U+8C7A 犲 (F2.26 豺) 狼屬 (Page 11|n54 #6: (4)豺) A ravenous beast (Kangxi: 豺貪殘之獸); a lynx or wolf (Kangxi: 狼屬); _(4)ch(')(a/)i (4)long (1)tong t(o\)(6)_ (caai4 long4 dong1 dou6 豺狼當道) the wolf is in the way---said of oppressive rulers; _(4)ch(')(a/)i (4)long_ (caai4 long4 豺狼), a wolf; _(4)ch(')(a/)i (4)long sing(3) (4)ts(')ing_ (caai4 long4 sing3 cing4 豺狼性情), a wolfish disposition. 【豺】 (dzreaj) (_noun-like_) dhole Used in 豺狼. 【豺狼】 (dzreaj lang) (_noun-like_) wolf

cak1.text: U+60FB 恻 (Mainland simplified) caak1 (longer syllable) (F2.32 惻) 隱傷也痛也 (Page 12|n55 #7: 惻(7)) Secret grief, distress (Kangxi: 痛也); to pity, to commisserate, to sympathize; _ch(')ak(7) ~~(4)yan~~ (2)yan (1)ch(i/) (1)sam_ (cak1 jan2 zi1 sam1 惻隱之心), kind-hearted, humane. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𭙡 to 痛. Williams' 惻隱之心: Corrected _(4)yan_ (jan4) to _(2)yan_ (jan2). 【惻】 (tsrhik) (_verb-like_) to compassion

U+6E2C 测 (Mainland simplified) caak1 (longer syllable) (F2.32 測) 度也 (Page 12|n55 #6: 測(7)) To sound, to fathom (Kangxi: 度深曰測); to estimate, to measure (Kangxi: 凡測度之稱); clear, as varnish (Kangxi: 淸也 etc.); _ch(')ak(7) tok(9)_ (cak1 dok6 測度) to comprehend, to conjecture; _ch(')ak(7) tsz'(6)_ (cak1 zi6 測字) to dissect characters, as when divining; _pat(7) ch(')ak(7)_ (bat1 cak1 不測) unexpected; _~~(1)t(')ui~~ (1)t(')(u/)i ch(')ak(7)_ (teoi1 cak1 推測) to explain, to reason; _pat(7) (2)ho ch(')ak(7)_ (bat1 ho2 cak1 不可測) incomprehensible. Williams' 推測: Corrected _(1)t(')ui_ to _(1)t(')(u/)i_. Extreme depth (Kangxi: 深所至也). Deep. 【測】 (tsrhik) (_verb-like_) to fathom

caak3.text: U+518A 册 策 (for "bamboo-slip" sense) (F2.89 冊) 排門冊黃冊又皇后初立曰冊立 (Page 14|n57 #2: 册(8); here normalised to 冊) A slip; an inventory, a register, a list; a patent or commission of nobility; a census book; to choose; to plan, to make a plan or scheme; _(4)t(')(i/)n ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (tin4 caak3 填冊) to enrol, to write a list; _(u/)(6) (2)hau ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (wu6 hau2 caak3 戶口冊) a register, a census of people; _(4)p(')(a/)i (4)m(u/)n ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (paai4 mun4 caak3 排門冊) the register of families; _(4)wong ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (wong4 caak3 黃冊) imperial census. 【冊】 (tsrheak) (_noun-like_) slip, register, book

U+577C 拆 (Page 14|n57 #5: 坼(8)) To rive, to crack (Kangxi: 裂也); to open, to burst open, as buds (Kangxi: 植物房初開也); split, riven, cracked; _k(a/)p(8) ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (gaap3 caak3 甲坼) bursting of buds; _(2)h(o\)m ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (ham2 caak3 砍坼) cracked, as a bowl; _ch(')(a/)k(8) ch(')(a/)k(8) t(i/)(6) (1)sheng_ (caak3 caak3 dei6-2 seng1 坼坼地聲), a wheezing, cracked voice. (Page 14|n57 #4: ~~拆(9)~~拆(8); here normalised to 坼) (...) _ch(')(a/)k(8) (2)hau yat(9)_ (caak3 hau2 jat6-2 坼口日) unlucky days for consulting; _ch(')(a/)k(8) (2)hau (1)k(o\) y(e/)uk(9)_ (caak3 hau2 gou1 joek6 坼口膏藥) plasters for chapped feet. 【坼】 (trhaek) (_verb-like_) to rive, to crack 【爆坼】 (baau3 caak3) Chapped. 皮膚爆嗮坼 (pei4 fu1 baau3 saai3 caak3): "The skin's all chapped." Olden attestation for 坼 _ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (caak3) meaning "cracked": 《康熙字典》坼 《唐韻》丑格切《集韻》《韻會》《正韻》恥格切𠀤同𤖴裂也《禮月令》仲冬地始坼《後漢安帝紀》日南地坼長百餘里《晉史天文志》惠帝中張華爲司空三台星坼...

U+62C6 (F2.90 拆) 分開也又拆卸 (Page 14|n57 #4: ~~拆(9)~~拆(8)) To break up or open (Kangxi: 裂也開也); to split, to unrip; to destroy (Kangxi: 毀也), to pull down, to take away; to dissect, to take to pieces; _ch(')(a/)k(8) sh(e/)(3)_ (caak3 se3 拆舍) to pull a house down; _ch(')(a/)k(8) s(a/)n(3)_ (caak3 saan3 拆散) to scatter, by breaking or taking to pieces; _ch(')(a/)k(8) (1)fung_ (caak3 fung1 拆封), to open a letter; _ch(')(a/)k(8) (1)(i/) (4)sh(e/)ung_ (caak3 ji1 soeng4 拆衣裳), to unrip clothes; _ch(')(a/)k(8) s(a/)i(3)_ (caak3 saai3 拆嗮) pulled to pieces; _(5)yau mat(7) ch(')(a/)k(8) f(a/)t(8)_ (jau5 mat1 caak3 faat3 有乜拆法) what way shall we arrange the matter? Williams' 拆散: Note the subtle difference between the two readings _ch(')(a/)k(8) s(a/)n(3)_ (caak3 saan3) "scatter" and _ch(')(a/)k(8) (2)s(a/)n_ (caak3 saan2) "break up". 【拆】 (trhaek) (_verb-like_) to dismantle, to open (up)

U+67F5 栅 (F2.90 柵) 營寨編木爲之 (Page 14|n57 #3: 栅(8); here normalised to 柵) Posts of a stockade (Kangxi 柵: 編樹木也, 豎木以立柵也); a railing; a palisade; _(1)hon ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (hon1 caak3 看柵) a guard at gates; _ch(')(a/)k(8) (4)l(a/)n_ (caak3 laan4 柵欄), gateway of streets; _(4)m(u/)n ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (mun4 caak3 門柵) door posts.

U+7B56 (F2.89 策) 簡策謀策籌策 (Page 13|n56 #12: 策(8)) A bamboo slip (Kangxi: 策簡也), such as books were once engraved on; a book, writings; a stratagem, a plan, a means, an expedient, a scheme (Kangxi: 籌也謀也); a switch, a whip (Kangxi: 馬箠); a divining slip; to switch; _(2)k(a/)n ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (gaan2 caak3 簡策) books, chapters, &c.; _(4)m(o\) ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (mou4 caak3 無策) without plan, schemeless; _(4)ch(')au ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (cau4 caak3 籌策) to contrive; _ch(')(a/)k(8) (5)m(a/)_ (caak3 maa5 策馬), to whip a horse. ~~Used for the next (茦).~~ Yarrow for divination (Kangxi: 蓍也, 策神蓍也). 【策】 (tsrheak) (_noun-like_) slip (_noun-like_) strategy, scheme (_noun-like_) whip (_noun-like_) yarrow-stalk
U+8326 (Page 14|n57 #1: 茦(8)) A thorn, a spike, a prickle (Kangxi: 莿也, 茦刺); to prick, to pierce with a thorn.

caak6.text: U+8808 賊 (F2.33 蠈) 蟊蠈食禾之虫也 (Page 551 #2: 賊(9); here normalised to 蠈) a fly in grain (Kangxi 賊: 害苗之蟲); (Page 551 #3: 蠈(9)) A fly which eats the grain at its joints (Kangxi: 食禾節蟲); a sort of Hessian fly, commonly called _(4)wong (4)ch(')ung_ (wong4 cung4 黃蟲) or the yellow bug.

U+8CCA 贼 (Mainland simplified) caak3 (vernacular) caak6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.33 賊) 盗賊又賊害 (Page 551 #2: 賊(9)) A thief, a robber, a highwayman (Kangxi: 盜也); a bandit; seditious, those who rise against the government; the enemy; a term of contempt; to rob (Kangxi: 刧人也), to murder (Kangxi: 殺人曰賊); to maltreat, to oppress (Kangxi: 賊虐); _(5)l(o\) ts(')(a/)k(9)_ (lou5 caak6-2 老賊) an old robber; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (2)k(o\)m (5)ng(a/)n_ (caak6 gam2 ngaan5 賊噉眼), eyes sharp as a thief's; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (1)ping_ (caak6 bing1 賊兵), the enemy's force; _(2)hoi ts(')(a/)k(9)_ (hoi2 caak6 海賊) a pirate, corsair, freebooter; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (4)t(')au_ (caak6 tau4-2 賊頭), a ringleader of robbers; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (2)tsai_ (caak6-2 zai2 賊仔), a rascal, a pilferer; _ts(o\)(6) ts(')(a/)k(9)_ (zou6 caak6-2 做賊) to turn robber; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (1)chong_ (caak6 zong1 賊贓), booty; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (4)ying_ (caak6-2 jing4 賊型), a suspicious looking fellow. To injure (Kangxi: 賊傷害也). 【賊】 (dzok) (_verb-like_) to injure (_noun-like_) bandit, renegade
