zik1.text: U+9BFD May appear as either ⿰魚即 (+7 assumed here) or ⿰魚卽 (+9), depending on the font. 鲫 (Mainland simplified) The crucian carp.

caak6.text: U+9C02 賊 䰹 鯽 鱡 鲗 (Mainland simplified) Used in 鰞鰂 (cuttlefish) (Kangxi: 鰞鰂魚名, 一名墨魚). Note that in Cantonese, the synonym 墨魚 "inkfish" is preferred.

zak1.text: U+9C02 鯽 鲗 (Mainland simplified) (Page 551 #1: 鯽(7); here normalised to 鰂) A species of bream _(Cyprinus gibelioides)_ with a long dorsal, called _tsak(7) ~~(5)n(a/)~~ (2)n(a/) (4)(u_ (zak1 naa2 jyu4-2 鰂乸魚)_;_ _shuk(7) kwat(7) tsak(7)_ (suk1 gwat1 zak1 縮骨鰂) the blunt headed bream _(Cyprinus abbreviatus);_ _(1)kam tsak(7)_ (gam1 zak1 金鰂) the red tailed bream _(Cyprinus auratus)_. Used in 鰂魚涌 Quarry Bay, in Hong Kong. Williams' 鰂乸魚: Corrected _(5)n(a/)_ (naa5) to _(2)n(a/)_ (naa2).

caam1.text: U+53C3 叅 参 (Mainland simplified) (F2.62 參) 參差不齊又干預也謀度也又音深 (F2.62 叅) 叅考叅拜上官論下官亦曰叅 (Page 553 #4: (1)參(1)~~？~~叅) To be concerned with (Kangxi 參: 干與也), to join with for consultation (Kangxi 參: 相謁也), to advise, to give counsel to; to blend, to mix, to form one of three (Kangxi 參: 三相參爲參); to have an audience, to salute, to see one (Kangxi 參: 覲也); to impeach, to report to the throne on other officers; confused, mixed, as colors; a deposition, an impeachment; _(1)ts(')(a/)m tsau(3)_ (caam1 zau3 參奏) to memorialize against; _(2)t(a/) (1)ts(')(a/)m_ (daa2 caam1 打參), to make an obeisance; _(1)ts(')(a/)m p(a/)i(3)_ (caam1 baai3 參拜) to visit one; to worship; _(1)ts(')(a/)m (1)ts(')(a/)m (1)ts(')z' (1)ts(')z'_ (caam1 caam1 ci1 ci1 參參差差) uneven, not well ranked, unassorted; _(1)ts(')(a/)m k(a/)k(8)_ (caam1 gaak3 參革) to degrade an officer and report it; _(1)ts(')(a/)m ts(a/)p(9)_ (caam1 zaap6 參雜) to throw into confusion; _(1)ts(')(a/)m ts(e/)ung(3)_ (caam1 zoeng3 參將) a colonel; _(1)ts(')(a/)m (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (caam1 coeng4 參詳), to consult upon; _(4)ch(')i(u/) (1)ts(')(a/)m_ (ciu4 caam1 朝參), admitted to a levee; to worship the Supreme; _(1)ts(')(a/)m ting(3) (4)m(o\) (4)ngo_ (caam1 ding3 mou4 ngo4 參訂無訛), I've examined it and found no mistakes. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰阝頁 to 預. 【參】 (tshom) (_verb-like_) to form three, to partake (in) (_verb-like_) to pay visit (unto) (_verb-like_) to consult, to examine (_verb-like_) to impeach Used in 參差. 【參差】 (tsrhim tsrhje) (_adjective-like_) uneven
U+53C5 (F2.62 參) 參差不齊又干預也謀度也又音深 (F2.62 叅) 叅考叅拜上官論下官亦曰叅 (Page 553 #4: (1)參(1)~~？~~叅)

caam2.text: U+647B 撡 掺 (Mainland simplified) saam2 (per 《廣韻》所斬切) (F2.64 摻) 羅而取之 (Page 554 #8: (2)摻) to take up with the hand (Kangxi: 取也一曰執也). 【摻】 (sreamX) (_verb-like_) to take (hold)

cim1.text: U+647B 撡 掺 (Mainland simplified) saam1 (per 《廣韻》所咸切) (F2.47 摻) 與纖同又音覽 (Page 554 #8: (2)摻 _(2)Ts(')(a/)m_ (caam2); here corrected to _(1)Ts(')(i/)m_ (cim1)) A delicate hand (Kangxi: 女手貌), a hand with tapering fingers; fine, tapering, small; The reading _(1)ts(')(i/)m_ (cim1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 思廉切, explained 摻摻女好手貌.

caam1.text: U+6519 摻 (for "support" and "mix" senses) 搀 (Mainland simplified) caam4 (per 《廣韻》士咸切 for "stab" sense) (Page 16|n59 #5: (4)攙 _(4)Ch(')(a/)m_ (caam4); here normalised to _(1)Ch(')(a/)m_ (caam1)) To stab (Kangxi: 刺也); to sustain, to support (Kangxi: 一曰扶也), to lead; to divide with another; _~~(4)ch(')(a/)m~~ (1)ch(')(a/)m fan(6) (4)lai (1)t(')(i/)m_ (caam1 fan6 lai4 tim1 攙分嚟添), make another share for him; _~~(4)ch(')(a/)m~~ (1)ch(')(a/)m (4)f(u/)_ (caam1 fu4 攙扶), to uphold. Whilst _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ (caam4) is attested in Middle Chinese, it is only explained "stab" (刺也). Kangxi records the canonical reading 楚銜切 _(1)ch(')(a/)m_ (caam1), explained both "stab" (刺也) and "arm-support" (一曰扶也). It is possible that Williams has mistakenly parsed 楚銜切 as 陽平 rather than 陰平. To mix, to blend.

zaam6.text: U+6519 搀 (Mainland simplified) (Page 16|n59 #5: (4)攙 _(4)Ch(')(a/)m_ (caam4); here corrected to _Ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6)) to supply a want, to make up (Kangxi: 完補也); to pull out (Kangxi: 一曰旁掣也);

caam1.text: U+7BF8 (Page 554 #9: (2)篸 _(2)Ts(')(a/)m_ (caam2); here corrected to _(1)Ts(')(a/)m_ (caam1)) Bamboos varying in length (Kangxi: 篸𥰭竹貌); a pandean pipe (Kangxi: 洞簫也); Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(')(a/)m_; 《集韻》 has the reading 初簪切, explained 篸差竹貌. Kangxi spells this as 篸𥰭, making it the bamboo version of 參差.

caam2.text: U+7BF8 (F2.64 ？) 竹器 (F2.64 篸) 同上 (Page 554 #9: (2)篸) an open basket like a fan; _fat(7) (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (fat1 caam2 㧾篸), a basket scuttle; _(1)f(u/)i (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (fui1 caam2 灰篸), a mortar-hod; _kuk(7) (1)tau (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (guk1 dau1 caam2 榖兜篸), a grain fan; _l(a/)p(9) s(a/)p(8) (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (laap6 saap3 caam2 垃圾篸), a dirt basket.

caam1.text: U+9A42 骖 (Mainland simplified) (F2.62 驂) 駕車外兩馬曰驂馬 (Page 553 #5: (1)驂) Three horses abreast in a chariot (Kangxi: 驂馬, 駕三馬也); the horses outside of the thills (Kangxi: 車中兩馬曰服兩馬驂其外小退曰驂); _(1)ts(')(a/)m shing(6)_ (caam1 sing6 驂乘) three sitters in a carriage; _t(')(ut(8) (1)ts(')(a/)m (4)(i/) tsang(6)_ (tyut3 caam1 ji4 zang6 脫驂而贈) he unhitched the wheelhorse and gave it to him. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿰馬叅 to 驂. 【驂】 (tshom) (_noun-like_) outside-horse

caam2.text: U+6158 𢡖 惨 (Mainland simplified) (F2.64 𢡖) 酷毒也愁戚也甚也 (F2.64 慘) 同上 (Page 554 #6: (2)慘(2)𢡖) Cruel, hard-hearted, inhuman (Kangxi 慘: 毒也); to be afflicted, injured, wounded in the mind (Kangxi 慘: 痛也); a superlative, applied to sufferings; _(1)p(i/) (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (bei1 caam2 悲慘), extreme grief; _(1)sh(e/)ung tak(7) (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (soeng1 dak1 caam2 傷得慘), horribly wounded; _(2)ts(')(a/)m huk(9)_ (caam2 huk6 慘酷) unfeeling, callous; _(2)h(o\) (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (hou2 caam2 好慘), very shocking; _(2)ts(')(a/)m hak(7)_ (caam2 hak1 慘刻) oppressive, fleecing the people; _(2)ts(')(a/)m (1)ts(o\) (4)w(a/)ng wo(6)_ (caam2 zou1 waang4 wo6 慘遭橫禍) to meet with cruelty and misfortunes.

U+61AF (F2.64 憯) 痛也 (Page 554 #7: (2)憯) Pained, feeling acutely, grieved; distressed; sickened from former sufferings; already. The Kangxi entry is simply 《正字通》俗？字, where the illegible character is one of ⿰忄⿱⿰兂兂曰 or 㦧, neither of which I can locate.

caam3.text: U+5133 caam4 (per 《廣韻》士咸切 for "ugly" sense and Kangxi 士咸切 for "quick" sense) zaam6 (per 《廣韻》仕陷切 for "imprudent-speech" sense and 《集韻》仕懺切 for "flippant" sense) (F2.64 儳) 儳越叅雜也 (Page 16|n59 #8: 儳(3)) Irregular, disorderly (Kangxi: 儳互不齊也), as undrilled troops (Kangxi: 師次不整); ~~unequal,~~ uneven (Kangxi: 亦不齊也); _(4)l(a/)m ch(')(a/)m(3)_ (laam4 caam3 儖儳) ugly (Kangxi: 惡貌); confused, disorderly~~, sulky~~. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 叅 and 雜. Williams' "Irregular, disorderly, as undrilled troops": Kangxi has this sense under 士咸切 _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ (caam4). Still, the reading _ch(')(a/)m(3)_ (caam3) for "disorderly" is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 叉鑑切, explained 儳仾不齊也. Kangxi paraphrases this as 又《集韻》初鑒切音懺亦不齊也又雜言也. Quick (Kangxi: 疾也). Imprudent speech, words spoken without due consideration (Kangxi: 輕言也). Flippant, unserious (Kangxi: 謂苟且不整肅也, 可輕賤之貌). Confused speech (Kangxi: 雜言也). 【儳-flippant】 (dzreamH) (_adjective-like_) flippant 【儳-jumbled】 (tsrhaemH) (_adjective-like_) jumbled
U+61FA 忏 (Mainland simplified) (F2.64 杉) 懺悔自陳其悔也 (Page 16|n59 #7: 懺(3)) To repent (Kangxi: 悔也); to confess one's errors; _ch(')(a/)m(3) f(u/)i(3)_ (caam3 fui3 懺悔) to repent.

U+6749 檆 saam1 (per 《廣韻》所咸切) (F2.64 杉) 木名 (Page 16|n59 #6: 杉(3)) Fir, pine (Kangxi: 煔似松); _ch(')(a/)m(3) muk(9)_ (caam3 muk6 杉木) deal; _yat(7) ~~luk(9)~~ luk(7) ch(')(a/)m(3)_ (jat1 luk1 caam3 一碌杉) a block of pine, a blockhead; _ch(')(a/)m(3) muk(9) (4)ling (4)p(')(a/)i_ (caam3 muk6 ling4 paai4 杉木靈牌), a pine tablet---is worthless. Williams 一碌杉: Corrected _luk(9)_ (luk6) to _luk(7)_ (luk1).

caam4.text: U+5296 (F2.63 劖) 錐也刺也 (Page 553 #7: (4)劖) To cut apart, to chop (Kangxi: 斷也); to chissel off (Kangxi: 劖鑿也); to cut with a burin; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (1)t(o\)_ (caam4 dou1 劖刀), a beveled knife or chissel. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ per 《廣韻》鋤銜切.

U+5DC9 嶃 漸 磛 𥕌 zaam6 (alternative per 《廣韻》仕檻切) (F2.63 巉) 高危也 (F2.63 磛嶃) 俱同上 (Page 554 #1: (4)巉(4)𥕌) A high, inaccessible peak or cliff (Kangxi 巉: 巉巖高也); a cloud-capt summit; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (4)ng(a/)m_ (caam4 ngaam4 巉巖), a lofty, craggy summit; also high piled up rocks. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ per 《廣韻》鋤銜切. 【巉】 (dzraem, dzraemX) (_adjective-like_) precipitous

U+615A 慙 惭 (Mainland simplified) (F2.63 慚) 愧也作也 (F2.63 慙) 同上 (Page 554 #5: (4)慚(4)慙) Ashamed, mortified, chopfallen (Kangxi 慙: 媿也); to feel ashamed of, to blush for; to be sensible of one's defects or failure; _(1)sau (4)ts(')(a/)m_ (sau1 caam4 羞慚), to redden from mortification; _t(a/)i(6) (4)(i/)n pat(7) (4)ts(')(a/)m_ (daai6 jin4 bat1 caam4 大言不慚), he does not blush for a lie, he has no modesty; _(4)ts(')(a/)m tak(7)_ (caam4 dak1 慚德) conscious of one's defects. 【慚】 (dzam) (_adjective-like_) ashamed

U+6BDA (F2.63 毚) 狡兔也 (Page 554 #2: (4)毚) Crafty, wily, artful, as a hare (Kangxi: 狡兔也), which has many ways of escape; _(4)ts(')(a/)m t(')(o\)(3)_ (caam4 tou3 毚兔) a crafty rabbit. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ per 《廣韻》士咸切 and 鋤銜切. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 免 to 兔. 【毚】 (dzream, dzraem) (_adjective-like_) wily
U+6F38 Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ per 《集韻》鋤銜切.

zim1.text: U+6F38 渐 (Mainland simplified) (F2.50 漸 _Ts(i/)m(6)_ (zim6)) 次也徐也稍也漬也 (Page 571 #6: 漸(6) _Ts(i/)m(6)_ (zim6); here corrected to _(1)Ts(i/)m_ (zim1)) to find its way in, as water does (Kangxi: 流入也); to flow; to imbibe, to tinge, to soak, to penetrate (Kangxi: 漬也濕也, 浸也染也); 【漸-level】 (tsjem) (_verb-like_) to inflow (_verb-like_) to soak

zim6.text: U+6F38 渐 (Mainland simplified) zim6-2 (rising second in reduplication 漸漸) (F2.50 漸) 次也徐也稍也漬也 (Page 571 #6: 漸(6)) Name of an affluent of the Y(a/)ngtsz' ki(a/)ng (揚子江) near Ng(a/)nking f(u/) (安慶府) (Kangxi: 水名, 水出丹陽黟南蠻中東入海); to advance by degrees, slowly, by little and little (Kangxi: 漸次也進也稍也 etc.); stealthily, as decay; _ts(i/)m(6) ts(i/)m(6) (4)loi_ (zim6 zim6 loi4 漸漸來), came on gradually; _ts(i/)m(6) yap(9) (1)k(a/)i (2)king_ (zim6 jap6 gaai1 ging2 漸入佳境), opens up a fine prospect; gradually improving, as one's prospects; _ts(i/)m(6) ts(')z'(3)_ (zim6 ci3 漸次) many times, gradually; _(4)ts(')un ts(u(6) ts(i/)m(6) tsun(3)_ (ceon4 zeoi6 zim6 zeon3 循序漸進) to follow on regularly, to advance in order. 【漸-rising】 (dzjemX) (_adverb-like_) gradually (_verb-like_) to proceed gradually, to graduate, (_met._) to increase

caam4.text: U+8836 蚕 蝅 䗞 䘉 蠺 (F2.63 蠶) 吐絲之虫 (F2.63 蚕) 同上 (Page 553 #6: (4)蠶(4)蚕) The silkworm (Kangxi 蠶: 絲蟲也); caterpillars which weave coccoons (Kangxi 蠶: 任絲也); _(4)ts(')(a/)m (4)ch(')ung_ (caam4 cung4-2 蠶蟲), the silk-worm; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (4)ch(')ung (1)kon_ (caam4 cung4-2 gon1 蠶蟲乾), dried silkworms used for food; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (1)k(u/)_ (caam4 gu1 蠶姑), goddess of silkgrowers; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (2)hau_ (caam4 hau2 蠶口), silken, silk fabrics; _(4)ts(')(a/)m shik(9)_ (caam4 sik6 蠶食) to gnaw like a silkworm, to incroach on other's domains; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (2)k(a/)n_ (caam4 gaan2 蠶繭), a coccoon. 【蠶】 (dzom) (_noun-like_) silkworm

U+8B92 谗 (Mainland simplified) (F2.63 讒) 讒佞也毀譖良善曰讒 (Page 554 #3: (4)讒) ~~To adulate, to humor, to flatter;~~ to misrepresent, to gloss over, to calumniate, to asperse, to traduce, to detract (Kangxi: 譖也, 崇飾惡言毀善害能也, 傷良曰讒); ~~servility;~~ detraction, malignity; _(4)ts(')(a/)m ning(6)_ (caam4 ning6 讒佞) to cajole and asperse; _(4)ts(')(a/)m ~~(2)ch(i/)m~~ (2)ch(')(i/)m_ (caam4 cim2 讒諂), to intrigue against, to slander; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (4)yan_ (caam4 jan4 讒人), a backbiter; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (4)(i/)n (5)y(e/) wo(6)_ (caam4 jin4 je5 wo6 讒言惹禍) calumnies induce troubles; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (4)shan_ (caam4 san4 讒臣), an intriguing officer; _(4)ts(')(a/)m (2)hau (1)k(a/)u (1)k(a/)_ (caam4 hau2 gaau1 gaa1 讒口交加), he is everywhere spoken against. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ per 《廣韻》士咸切. Williams' "To adulate, to humor, to flatter": Kangxi 佞也 is unhelpful. Williams' 讒諂: Corrected _(2)ch(i/)m_ (zim2) to _(2)ch(')(i/)m_ (cim2). 【讒】 (dzream) (_noun-like_) calumny

U+995E May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 馋 (Mainland simplified) (F2.63 饞) 貪饕也 (Page 554 #4: (4)饞) To gormandise, to be fond of eating; greedy, gluttonous, voracious (Kangxi: 不廉, 饕也); _(2)hau (4)ts(')(a/)m_ (hau2 caam4 口饞), omniverous. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(4)ch(')(a/)m_ per 《廣韻》士咸切.

caam5.text: U+68D6 枨 (Mainland simplified) caan5 (per Williams) (Page 20|n63 #6: (5)棖 _(5)Ch(')(a/)n_ (caan5); here normalised to _(5)Ch(')(a/)m_ (caam5)) A colloquial word. A door sill; a threshold; _(5)k(')(i/) (4)m(u/)n ~~(5)ch(')(a/)n~~ (5)ch(')(a/)m_ (kei5 mun4 caam5 企門棖), standing in the door-way. 【門棖】 (mun4 caam5) A doorsill. The spelling 棖 is arbitrary.

caang4.text: U+68D6 枨 (Mainland simplified) (F2.88 棖) 兩邊門枋曰棖又人名申棖 A door-post (Kangxi: 棖謂之楔, 棖門兩旁長木). 【棖】 (draeng) (_noun-like_) door-post

caam5.text: U+93E8 劖 (for Cantonese "pierce" sense) 錾 (Mainland simplified) zaam6 (alternative per 《廣韻》藏濫切) (F2.64 鏨) 鉄鑿 (Page 553 #2: (5)鏨 _(5)Ts(a/)m_ (zaam5); here corrected to _(5)Ts(')(a/)m_ (caam5)) A stone-cutter's chissel; a small cold chissel (Kangxi: 小鑿也); to pierce, as a thorn; to cut in, to cut or chissel out; to carve, as flowers; _~~ts(a/)m~~ (5)ts(')(a/)m (1)f(a/)_ (caam5 faa1 鏨花), to carve flowers; _~~ts(a/)m~~ (5)ts(')(a/)m (1)t(o\)_ (caam5 dou1 鏨刀), a stone chissel; _~~ts(a/)m~~ (5)ts(')(a/)m (1)hoi (1)p(i/)n_ (caam5 hoi1 bin1 鏨開邊), to split open an edge; _(2)p(i/) lak(9) ~~ts(a/)m~~ (5)ts(')(a/)m_ (bei2 lak6-1 caam5 畀竻鏨), the thorn pierced me. Whilst Fan Wan does not explicitly record the reading of 鏨 (as is the case for most entries), the tone at the very least can be inferred based on the ordering with respect to other entries. Because 鏨 appears in the rising tone section, and strictly after 攬覽擥, which are 陽上 (tone 5), we conclude that 鏨 also is 陽上 (tone 5). Williams' placement of 鏨 under _(5)Ts(a/)m_ (zaam5) is problematic as an unaspirated initial cannot occur with 陽上 (tone 5). I have corrected this to the aspirated _(5)Ts(')(a/)m_ (caam5), because: It is consistent with the vernacular _(5)ts(')(a/)m_ (caam5) for "pierced"; and It is consistent with 《廣韻》才敢切 if aspirated rising _(5)ts(')(a/)m_ (caam5) is not recast to unaspirated departing _ts(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6). 【鏨】 (caam5) To pierce, especially in a wedging or chisel-like fashion. 鏨刺 (caam5 ci3): "Pierced by a thorn."

caan1.text: U+9910 飡 (F2.67 餐) 熟食也 (F2.67 飡) 同上 (Page 555 #9: (1)餐(1)飡) To swallow (Kangxi 餐: 吞也), to eat; a meal (Kangxi 餐: 飮饌曰餐); a classifier of meals; to gather and to select (Kangxi 餐: 採也); _yat(7) (1)ts(')(a/)n f(a/)n(6)_ (jat1 caan1 faan6 一餐飯) a meal; _(2)ts(o\) (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (zou2 caan1 早餐) breakfast; _t(a/)i(6) (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (daai6 caan1 大餐), dinner; _(5)m(a/)n (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (maan5 caan1 晚餐) supper; _yat(9) shik(9) (1)s(a/)m (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (jat6 sik6 saam1 caan1 日食三餐), three meals a day; _(1)ts(')(a/)n (4)t(')au f(a/)n(6)_ (caan1 tau4 faan6 餐頭飯) a common meal; _ch(a/)n(6) (1)ts(')(a/)n shik(9)_ (zaan6 caan1 sik6 賺餐食) works for his food; _sau(3) shik(7) (1)h(o\)m (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (sau3 sik1 ham1 caan1 秀色堪餐), handsome enongh to be eaten; _(2)p(a/)u (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (baau2 caan1 飽餐), a good meal; _(1)ts(')(a/)n (4)wan (4)m(i/)n (ut(9)_ (caan1 wan4 min4 jyut6 餐雲眠月) dines in the clouds and sleeps on the moon --- an enthusiast; _(1)ch(')(i/) f(a/)n(6) (1)ts(')(a/)n_ (ci1 faan6 caan1 黐飯餐), a diner out; _(1)ts(')(a/)n chuk(7) (1)ts(')(a/)n f(a/)n(6)_ (caan1 zuk1 caan1 faan6 餐粥餐飯) a meal of congee and of rice --- poor. Williams' 大餐: Dated; 大餐 now simply means a big meal, or feast. Williams' 黐飯餐: A diner out in the sense of freeloading food. 【餐】 (tshan) (_verb-like_) to swallow, to consume (_noun-like_) meal

zin2.text: U+5257 刬 (Mainland simplified) (Page 20|n63 #4: ~~(2)剷~~(2)剗 _(2)Ch(')(a/)n_ (caan2); here corrected to _(2)Ch(i/)n_ (zin2)) to reap (Kangxi 剗: 刈也);

caan2.text: U+5277 May appear as either ⿰產刂 (assumed here) or ⿰産刂, depending on the font. 剗 鏟 铲 (Mainland simplified) (F2.69 剷) 削平也 (F2.69 剗) 同上 (Page 20|n63 #4: (2)剷(2)剗) Interchanged with the next (鏟). To level off (Kangxi 剗: 削也, 平也), to spade up; to trim iron; _(2)ch(')(a/)n t(')ai(3) (1)t(o\)_ (caan2 tai3 dou1 剷剃刀), to plane a razor; _h(o\)m(6) (1)k(a/) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (ham6 gaa1 caan2 冚家剷), may your race all be cut off; _(2)ch(')(a/)n (1)h(e/)ung_ (caan2 hoeng1 剷香), sandalwood shavings burned for the dead. 【剷】 (caan2) To delete, especially permanently. 剷咗佢 (caan2 zo2 keoi5): "Delete it." 【冚家剷】 (ham6 gaa1 caan2) A curse that someone's entire family be annihilated.

U+5D7C May appear as either ⿰山產 (assumed here) or ⿰山産, depending on the font. (F2.69 嵼) 𡾰嵼山屈曲貌 (Page 20|n63 #3: (2)嵼) Tortuous paths among the mountains (Kangxi: 𡾰嵼山屈曲貌); _(2)k(i/)n (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (gin2 caan2 𡾰嵼), winding, crooked, as paths.

U+7522 産 产 (Mainland simplified) saan2 (per 《廣韻》所簡切) (F2.69 產) 生業也又生產 (Page 20|n63 #2: (2)產) To produce, to grow (Kangxi: 生也); to bear, to increase; an estate, a patrimony; an occupation (Kangxi: 民業曰產); the productions of a country (Kangxi: 本其所生長之地曰產); natives; a sort of flageolet (Kangxi: 大籥似笛三孔而短); a birth, act of parturition (Kangxi: 婦生子曰產); _(2)p(o\) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (bou2 caan2 保產), a strengthening pill for pregnancy; _(2)si(u/) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (siu2 caan2 小產), ~~an~~ a spontaneous abortion; _(1)fan (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (fan1 caan2 分產) to divide the patrimony; _(1)shang (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (sang1 caan2 生產), an increase, to have a child; _(2)ch(')(a/)n (i/)p(9)_ (caan2 jip6 產業) one's property, real estate; _(1)k(a/) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (gaa1 caan2 家產), family possessions; _(2)t(')(o\) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (tou2 caan2 土產), native productions; _(1)k(')ing (1)k(a/) p(a/)i(6) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (king1 gaa1 baai6 caan2 傾家敗產) the family lost everything. Williams' 小產: Now called a miscarriage. 【產】 (sreanX) (_verb-like_) to produce, to bear (_noun-like_) property

U+93DF May appear as either ⿰釒產 (assumed here) or ⿰釒産, depending on the font. 剷 铲 (Mainland simplified) (F2.69 鏟) 平木之器 (Page 20|n63 #5: (2)鏟) A thin iron plate (Kangxi: 鏶也); a shovel, a plane; a spoke-shave, an iron shave (Kangxi: 一曰平䥫, 平木鐵器); to cut and pare (Kangxi: 損削也); to level; _wok(9) (2)ch(')(a/)n_ (wok6 caan2 鑊鏟), a rice shovel; _yat(7) f(u/)(3) (2)ch(')(a/)n (4)k(')(i/)m_ (jat1 fu3 caan2 kim4 一副鏟鉗), a set of shovel and tongs; _(2)ch(')(a/)n (2)ts(')(o\) (4)ch(')(u (1)kan_ (caan2 cou2 ceoi4 gan1 鏟草除根), to root out, to extirpate; _(2)ch(')(a/)n (1)sh(a/)n_ (caan2 saan1 鏟山), to scarp hills, to dig in a level. 【煙鏟】 (jin1 caan2) A heavy smoker. 正煙鏟 (zing3 jin1 caan2): "He's a right smokaholic."

caan3.text: U+71E6 灿 (Mainland simplified) (F2.70 燦) 光明也 (Page 556 #3: 燦(3)) Resplendent, clear (Kangxi: 燦爛明瀞貌); attractive, bright, gay; _ts(')(a/)n(3) l(a/)n(6)_ (caan3 laan6 燦爛) lustrous, brilliant; _ts(')(a/)n(3) (4)t(')au_ (caan3 tau4 燦頭), you're a bright one! The (now) derogatory sense of "immigrant from the Mainland" is ultimately traced to the 1979 TVB Series 網中人 (''The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly''). For an in-depth discussion on the term 阿燦, see the Chinese Wikipedia article. 【阿燦】 (aa3 caan3) (_derogatory_) An immigrant into Hong Kong from Mainland China.

U+74A8 (F2.70 璨) 玉名 (Page 556 #4: 璨(3)) The lustre of gem, a bright gem (Kangxi: 玉光也); _(1)ts(')(u/)i ts(')(a/)n(3)_ (ceoi1 caan3 璀璨) pendent gems, said of hanging flowers like the Vanda. Beautiful jade (Kangxi: 美玉).

U+7CB2 (F2.70 粲) 美也 (Page 556 #2: 粲(3)) ~~Half a _(2)tau_ (dau2 斗) or peck;~~ a meal (Kangxi: 餐也); many, much, a multitude (Kangxi: 衆意); clear, bright (Kangxi: 察也明也, 光明也); to agree upon; fine, excellent (Kangxi: 優也); beautiful, as a woman; to laugh, smiling (Kangxi: 笑貌); fine rice (Kangxi: 精鑿食也); _p(a/)k(9) ts(')(a/)n(3)_ (baak6 caan3 白粲) white rice, anciently picked over by criminals (Kangxi: 漢𠛬有白粲 etc.); _ts(')(a/)n(3) ts(')(a/)n(3)_ (caan3 caan3 粲粲) elegant, as dress; _ts(')(a/)n(3) (4)(i/)n (4)(i/) si(u/)(3)_ (caan3 jin4 ji4 siu3 粲然而笑) he laughed outright; _ts(')(a/)n(3) (4)t(')au_ (caan3 tau4-2 粲頭), a worthless fellow --- a colloquial phrase. Williams' "a meal": According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, this sense is an alternative form of 餐, rather than just a synonym (鄭風傳曰粲餐也此謂粲爲餐之叚借也). A corollary of this view is that the reading ought to be level, rather than departing. Williams' "Half a _(2)tau_ or peck": This is a misreading of Kangxi 爲米六斗大半斗曰粲, which puts the measure at 6⅔ pecks, not half a peck. 【粲】 (tshanH) (_noun-like_) polished-grain (_adjective-like_) splendid, beaming

zin1.text: U+6214 㦮 戋 (Mainland simplified) caan4 (per 《廣韻》昨干切) (F1.20 戔) 戔戔淺小之貌 (Page 573 #2: (1)戔) Small, narrow, cramped (Kangxi: 戔戔淺小之意); contracted, as one's mind. The reading _(1)ts(i/)n_ (zin1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 將先切, explained 戔戔猥積皃 (cramped?). The reading _(4)ts(')(a/)n_ (caan4) is the sole reading that appears in 《廣韻》, explained 傷也 (the sense interchangeable with 殘) and 戔戔束帛皃易曰束帛戔戔 (bundley? in the Classic of Changes). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 少 to 小. 【戔】 (dzan, tsen) (_adjective-like_) slender, cramped

caan4.text: U+6B98 戔 残 (Mainland simplified) caan4-2 (rising second in vernacular 殘殘地) (F2.68 殘) 傷殘餘也落也賤也害也 (Page 556 #1: (4)殘) To ruin, to destroy (Kangxi: 賊也); to injure, to spoil; to mangle, to tread on (Kangxi: 殘踐也); to kill, to slaughter (Kangxi: 殺也); mischievous, wicked, cruel (Kangxi: 惡也); spoiled, pillaged; withered; broken food, leavings (Kangxi: 食餘也); deficient (Kangxi: 殘缺也), nearly used up, ready to vanish away; _(4)ts(')(a/)n hoi(6)_ (caan4 hoi6 殘害) truculent, savage; _(2)shau tsuk(7) (1)s(e/)ung (4)ts(')(a/)n_ (sau2 zuk1 soeng1 caan4 手足相殘), fraternal strifes; _(4)ts(')(a/)n (1)f(a/)_ (caan4 faa1 殘花), a withered flower---a prostitute; _(4)ts(')(a/)n (4)n(i/)n_ (caan4 nin4 殘年), year going ont; an old man; _shik(9) (4)ts(')(a/)n_ (sik6 caan4 食殘), leavings, orts; _(4)ts(')(a/)n (4)yan_ (caan4 jan4 殘人), to injure people; a villain; _(4)ts(')(a/)n (1)p(u/)i_ (caan4 bui1 殘杯), heeltaps; _(4)ts(')(a/)n k(')(ut(8)_ (caan4 kyut3 殘缺) deficient, injured; _(4)ts(')(a/)n (2)yan_ (caan4 jan2 殘忍), cruel, unfeeling. (Page 573 #2: (1)戔) Used for _(4)ts(')(a/)n_ (caan4) 殘 cruel (Kangxi 戔: 通作殘). Remainder, leftover. 【殘】 (dzan) (_verb-like_) to hurt, to damage, to deteriorate (_adjective-like_) cruel (_adjective-like_) fragmentary

caang1.text: U+6399 挣 (Page 21|n64 #3: 掙(6)) Read _(1)ch(')(a/)ng_ (caang1); to pierce, to stab (Kangxi: 刺也).

zaang6.text: U+6399 挣 (Page 21|n64 #3: 掙(6)) A colloquial word. To caulk; to wedge in, to squeeze in, to force in; _(2)t(a/) ch(a/)ng(6)_ (daa2 zaang6 打掙) to caulk seams; _ch(a/)ng(6) (4)ng(a/)_ (zaang6 ngaa4 掙牙), to get between the teeth; _ch(a/)ng(6) (1)sh(a/) (1)kai_ (zaang6 saa1 gai1 掙沙雞), to stuff a cock with sand; _ng(a/)ng(6) ~~ch(a/)ng(3)~~ ch(a/)ng(6)_ (ngaang6 zaang6 硬掙) determined, energetic, as in bearing pain. Williams' 硬掙: Corrected _ch(a/)ng(3)_ (zaang3) to _ch(a/)ng(6)_ (zaang6). 【掙】 (zaang6) To wedge in or stuff in, especially for the purposes of sealing off or widening. 掙住 (zaang6 zyu6): "It's wedged in and stuck." 掙闊啲 (zaang6 fut3 di1): "Wedge the gap and make it wider." 掙爆咗 (zaang6 baau3 zo2): "Burst from stuffing." The spelling 掙 is arbitrary.

zang1.text: U+6399 挣 To struggle, to break free. 掙扎 (zang1 zaat3): "Struggle."

zang3.text: U+6399 挣 (Page 21|n64 #3: 掙(6)) Read _chang(3)_ (zang3); ~~to file~~ to break, to snap (Kangxi: 掙剉也)~~;~~.

coeng1.text: U+6436 槍 抢 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 搶) 拒也 (Page 567 #2: (1)搶) To defend, to withstand (Kangxi: 拒也); to thrust at (Kangxi: 搶猶刺也); to rush against (Kangxi: 突也); _(5)(i/) (4)t(')au (1)ts(')(e/)ung t(i/)(6)_ (ji5 tau4 coeng1 dei6 以頭搶地) to knock the head against the ground. (Page 567 #7: (1)槍; here normalised to 搶) to ~~bow~~ knock the head low (Kangxi 槍: 抵也); 【搶】 (tshjang) (_verb-like_) to knock (against)

coeng2.text: U+6436 摤 抢 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 搶) 搶奪 (Page 568 #7: (2)搶) To take, to extort, to force away, to ravish, to snatch (Kangxi: 爭取也); to dispute for, to struggle for; ~~sudden, abrupt, rude;~~ to rob, as bands do; _(2)ts(')(e/)ung p(a/)k(9) (2)k(i/) k(u(3)_ (coeng2 baak6 gei2 geoi3 搶白幾句) he denounced him in many phrases; _(2)ts(')(e/)ung k(i/)p(8)_ (coeng2 gip3 搶劫) to take by force; _(2)ts(')(e/)ung (1)s(i/)n (4)hang_ (coeng2 sin1 hang4 搶先行), to thrust one's self forward; _(2)ts(')(e/)ung ~~p(')au(3)~~ p(')(a/)u(3) (4)t(')au_ (coeng2 paau3 tau4 搶炮頭), to struggle for the rocket stick on the 2d of 2d month; _(2)ts(')(e/)ung t(ut(9)_ (coeng2 dyut6 搶奪) to snatch; _t(un(3) (2)ts(')(e/)ung_ (dyun3 coeng2 斷搶), to grab at all. ~~Read _(1)ts(')ong_ (cong1)_;_ to saw (Kangxi: 搶搪鋸也).~~ Williams' "sudden, abrupt, rude": This is a misreading of Kangxi 突也. Williams' 搶炮頭: Corrected _p(')au(3)_ (pau3) to _p(')(a/)u(3)_ (paau3). Williams' "to saw": This sense should actually be written 槍, as seen under 《集韻》千剛切. Kangxi 搶搪 is a typo for 槍搪.

caang1.text: U+6490 撑 樘 牚 (F2.30 撐 _(1)Ch(')ang_ (cang1)) 窓爭切駕船也 (F2.30 撐) 策平聲以物撐物也 (Page 21|n64 #4: (1)撐(1)撑) To prop, to shore up; to fasten open, as with a stretcher; to pole; to push off (Kangxi 撐: 撥也); to make a show; an inclined post (Kangxi 撐: 與樘同, 樘衺柱也), a fulcrum, a prop, a stay; to border on, to adjoin, to stretch or run up into; _(1)ch(')(a/)ng (4)sh(un_ (caang1 syun4 撐船), to pole a boat; _(1)ch(')(a/)ng t(o\)(6)_ (caang1 dou6 撐渡) to pole across the ferry; to intrigue for a friend with the officer; _(1)ch(')(a/)ng (4)'m (4)lai_ (caang1 m4 lai4 撐唔嚟), he could not show off long; _(1)ch(')ung (1)ch(')(a/)ng_ (cung1 caang1 充撐), to curry favor among friends; _(1)ch(')(a/)ng (5)sh(e/)ung h(u(3) sh(a/)i(3)_ (caang1 soeng5 heoi3 saai3 撐上去曬) stretch them up to dry. Williams' "inclined post": According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, the qualifier 衺 (inclined) should not be present before 柱 (pillar).

caang3.text: U+6490 橕 (Cantonese) 撑 (Cantonese) (Page 21|n64 #5: (1)橕; here normalised to 撐) Read _ch(')(a/)ng(3)_ (caang3)_;_ a colloquial word. To stretch out, to open; _ch(')(a/)ng(3) (1)i(u/) (5)k(')(i/) ch(u(6)_ (caang3 jiu1 kei5 zyu6 撐腰企住) to stand akimbo; _ch(')(a/)ng(3) (1)hoi (1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)m(u/)n_ (caang3 hoi1 coeng1 mun4-2 住開窗門), fasten open the window; _ch(')(a/)ng(3) ch(u(6)_ (caang3 zyu6 撐住) to open by a stretcher; _ch(')(a/)ng(3) (4)ng(a/) k(a/)u(3)_ (caang3 ngaa4 gaau3 撐牙鉸) to praise one's self. Williams does not consider leg-thrusting 𨅝 to be a different word to the generic 撐. I have split things up accordingly.

caang1.text: U+69CD 搶 枪 (Mainland simplified) (Page 567 #2: (1)搶 _(1)Ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')(a/)ng_ (caang1) and normalised to 槍) a comet (Kangxi 搶: 欃槍或作攙搶彗星也);

coeng1.text: U+69CD 鎗 枪 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 鎗) 刀鎗 (Page 567 #7: (1)槍) Interchanged with the last (鎗); a spear, sharp at both ends (Kangxi: 木兩頭銳也); a lance, a boarding-pike; _(1)ts(')(e/)ung f(a/)t(8)_ (coeng1 faat3 槍法) the hand manual; _(1)ts(')(e/)ung (4)t(')au_ (coeng1 tau4 槍頭), a spear head; _h(a/)(6) (5)m(a/) (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (haa6 maa5 coeng1 下馬槍), to give a back thrust when unhorsed, to leave in the lurch, to outwit.

caang1.text: U+6A55 撐 樘 牚 (Page 21|n64 #5: (1)橕) A branch stretching out; a fulcrum; a prop (Kangxi: 橕之言䟫也).
U+9397 (Page 567 #6: (1)鎗 _(1)Ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')(a/)ng_ (caang1)) the tinkle of bells, a jingling sound (Kangxi: 鐘聲也);

coeng1.text: U+9397 槍 枪 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 鎗) 刀鎗 (Page 567 #6: (1)鎗) a gun; a spear; _~~(2)ni(u/)~~ (5)ni(u/) (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (niu5 coeng1 鳥鎗), a fowling-piece, a matchlock; _shik(9) (1)ts(')(e/)ung (4)l(e/)ung_ (sik6 coeng1 loeng4 食鎗糧), to be a soldier; _(2)shau (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (sau2 coeng1 手鎗), a pistol; _(1)fung (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (fung1 coeng1 風鎗) an air-gun. Williams' 鳥鎗: Corrected _(2)ni(u/)_ (niu2) to _(5)ni(u/)_ (niu5).

caang1.text: U+943A 罉 (for Cantonese "pot" sense) 𦉘 (for Cantonese "pot" sense) 鎗 铛 (Mainland simplified) cang1 (shorter syllable) (Page 567 #6: (1)鎗 _(1)Ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')(a/)ng_ (caang1) and normalised to 鐺) a sort of pot (Kangxi 鐺: 釜屬, 鬴有足曰鐺) to hold spirits (Kangxi 鐺: 三足溫酒器也); 【鐺】 (caang1) A cooking pot with a flat bottom. 飯鐺 (faan6 caang1): "Rice cooking pot." 鐺湯凍咗 (caang1 tong1 dung3 zo2): "The pot of broth has gone cold." Olden attestation for 鐺 _(1)ch(')ang_ (cang1) or _(1)ch(')(a/)ng_ (caang1) meaning "pot": 《廣韻》楚庚切 鎗 鼎類 《廣韻》楚庚切 鐺 俗本音當 《康熙字典》鎗 《唐韻》楚庚切《集韻》《韻會》楚耕切𠀤音璫... 又《廣韻》鼎類《六書故》三足鬴也俗作鐺... 《康熙字典》鐺 ...又《廣韻》楚庚切《集韻》《韻會》楚耕切𠀤音鎗釜屬《通俗文》鬴有足曰鐺... The full story is that: The original character is 鎗, read _(1)ch(')ang_ (cang1), meaning a pot with legs. Later, 鐺 is used vulgarly for 鎗. Later, the characters 罉 and 𦉘 are created for the Cantonese vernacular sense of flat-bottomed pot.

caang4.text: U+6A59 棖 caang4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.88 橙) 棑橙果名 (Page 21|n64 #6: (4)橙) The coolie orange (Kangxi: 橘屬 etc.); _(4)ch(')(a/)ng (2)tsau_ (caang4-2 zau2 橙酒), spirits in which orange peel has been soaked; _(4)t(')ong (4)ch(')(a/)ng_ (tong4 caang4-2 糖橙), orange sweetmeats; _(4)ch(')(a/)ng k(o\)m(3) (4)m(a/)n_ (caang4-2 gam3 maan4 橙咁蠻) sharp as an orange; _(4)t(')(i/)m (4)ch(')(a/)ng_ (tim4 caang4-2 甜橙), sweet oranges; _(1)sh(a/)n (4)ch(')(a/)ng_ (saan1 caang4-2 山橙), a melodinus. The original level reading caang4 is almost never heard, having been supplanted by vernacular rising caang4-2 in all senses. The colour orange. 【橙】 (dreang) (_noun-like_) orange-tree, orange

caang3.text: U+2815D 橕 (Cantonese) 䟫 (Cantonese) jaang3 (alternative) (Page 21|n64 #5: (1)橕; here normalised to 𨅝) Read _ch(')(a/)ng(3)_ (caang3)_;_ a colloquial word. kick at; _ch(')(a/)ng(3) (5)k(')(u ch(')ut(7) h(u(3)_ (caang3 keoi5 ceot1 heoi3 𨅝佢出去) kick him out; expel him; Williams does not consider leg-thrusting 𨅝 to be a different word to the generic 撐. I have split things up accordingly. 【𨅝】 (caang3, jaang3) To thrust outward or down with the leg or the foot. 一腳𨅝開 (jat1 goek3 jaang3 hoi1): "Thrust away in one action of the foot." 𨅝樓梯 (jaang3 lau4 tai1): "Leg-thrust stairs" (i.e. climb stairs). To brace or support by extension of the leg. 【𨅝檯腳】 (caang3 toi4-2 goek3, jaang3 toi4-2 goek3) To eat or discourse at the same table. (Literally, "kick/brace with legs the table's legs".) The spelling 𨅝 is arbitrary.

caang4.text: U+5000 伥 (Mainland simplified) (Page 21|n64 #7: (4)倀) The reading _(4)ch(')(a/)ng_ for 倀 is present in Williams, but not with the correct senses. Standing alone (Kangxi: 獨立貌).

coeng1.text: U+5000 伥 (Mainland simplified) (Page 21|n64 #7: (4)倀 _(4)Ch(')(a/)ng_ (caang4); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1)) Groping, going blindly (Kangxi: 狂行不知所如也 etc.); madly (Kangxi: 狂也), carelessly; to fall down (Kangxi: 一曰仆也); _~~(4)ch(')(a/)ng~~ (1)ch(')(e/)ung (2)kwai_ (coeng1 gwai2 倀鬼), a lares eaten by a tiger, _met._ one who entices to evil courses. 【倀】 (trhjang) (_adjective-like_) frenetic

caang4.text: U+252C7 caang4-2 (rising second in vernacular 𥋇𥋇地) 【𥋇】 (caang4) To dazzle or glare. 畀太陽𥋇住 (bei2 taai3 joeng4 caang4 zyu6): "Glared at by the sun." 【𥋇眼】 (caang4 ngaan5) Dazzling or glaring to the eyes. 太𥋇眼 (taai3 caang4 ngaan5): "It's too dazzling." The spelling 𥋇 is arbitrary.

caap3.text: U+6271 (F2.66 挿) 以手刺人 (F2.66 扱) 同上 (Page 23|n66 #2: 扱(8)) Wrongly used for the last (揷). To take, to receive (Kangxi: 收也, 取也獲也); to raise (Kangxi: 引也舉也); to curtsey with the hands bowed to the ground (Kangxi: 拜手至地也); to tuck up the skirts (Kangxi: 扱衽曰襭 etc.). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 剌 to 刺. 【扱】 (tsrheap) (_verb-like_) to collect (_verb-like_) to tuck
U+633F (F2.66 挿) 以手刺人 (F2.66 扱) 同上 Fan Wan entry: Corrected 剌 to 刺.

U+63D2 挿 揷 (F2.66 挿) 以手刺人 (F2.66 扱) 同上 (Page 23|n66 #1: 揷(8); here normalised to 插) To insert, to pierce, to set in, to stick into (Kangxi 插: 刺肉也, 刺入也); to tuck in, to thrust into or through; to transplant; to set in a socket; to meddle, to interfere in; an iron pointed pole used to carry sheaves (Kangxi 插: 插者擔也 etc.), or pry up clods, for which 鍤 is also used (Kangxi 插: 與鍤同刺土器也); _ch(')(a/)p(8) (1)y(e/)ung_ (caap3 joeng1 插秧), to set out rice shoots; _ch(')(a/)p(8) (2)tsui_ (caap3 zeoi2 插嘴), to interrupt (in talking); _ch(')(a/)p(8) yik(9) (4)n(a/)n (1)f(i/)_ (caap3 jik6 naan4 fei1 插翼難飛) he can not fly away; _ch(')(a/)p(8) (1)tsong_ (caap3 zong1 插贓), to implicate one by leaving something in his house; _ch(')(a/)p(8) (1)pi(u/)_ (caap3 biu1 插標), to stick on labels; _ch(')(a/)p(8) (1)shi(u/)_ (caap3 siu1 插燒), a stuffing put into roast pigs; a concubine's child; _(4)sh(i/) ch(')(a/)p(8)_ (si4 caap3 匙插) a narrow purse; _ch(')(a/)p(8) (2)shau lok(9) h(u(3)_ (caap3 sau2 lok6 heoi3 插手落去) to meddle in officiously; _p(a/)t(8) (4)t(')oi p(a/)t(8) ch(')(a/)p(8)_ (baat3 toi4 baat3 caap3 八擡八插) eight bearers and eight outriders; _ch(')(a/)p(8) (5)(i/) (4)yau (4)ying_ (caap3 ji5 jau4 jing4 插耳遊營), to stick flags in the ears when whipping a thief. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 剌 to 刺. 【插】 (tsrheap) (_verb-like_) to insert 【插】 (caap3) To criticise. 【插贓嫁禍】 (caap3 zong1 gaa3 wo6) To plant evidence and shift blame (onto another). (Literally, "insert loot and transfer disaster".)

caat3.text: U+5237 㕞 caat3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) saat3 (per 《廣韻》數刮切) (F2.72 _Sh(a/)t(8)_ (saat3)) 成也歸也又振作也 (Page 427 #6: 刷(8) _Sh(a/)t(8)_ (saat3); here normalised to _Ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (caat3)) A brush, a scraper; a curry-comb; to brush; to cleanse, to scour (Kangxi: 刮也), to scrub (Kangxi: 刷淸也); a card for cotton; to print, as the Chinese do; _(2)hon ~~sh(a/)t(8)~~ ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (hon2 caat3 刊刷) to cut and print books; _~~sh(a/)t(8)~~ ch(')(a/)t(8) (2)ch(')(i/) (2)koi hang(6)_ (caat3 ci2 goi2 hang6 刷恥改行) to wipe off disgrace by reforming, According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, 刷 "scrub" (with a knife) should be distinguished from 㕞 "wipe" (with a hand). 【刷】 (srjwet, srwaet) (_verb-like_) to scrub
U+524E May appear with bottom-left component 朮 (assumed here) or 术, depending on the font.

U+5BDF 詧 (F2.72 察) 審也考也省也又察察潔淨貌 (F2.72 詧) 同上 (Page 24|n67 #11: 察(8)) To examine, to judge, to search out the truth (Kangxi: 覆審也, 諦也知也); to observe closely, to inquire into all particulars (Kangxi: 考也廉視也); _(4)ch(')(a/) ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (caa4 caat3 查察) to scrutinize; _k(a/)m(3) ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (gaam3 caat3 鑒察) beg you to look at, said by suppliants; _(1)king ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (ging1 caat3 京察) in the censorate; _ch(')(a/)t(8) t(ut(9)_ (caat3 dyut6 察奪) examine and decide respecting the petition. 【察】 (tsrheat) (_verb-like_) to inspect

U+64E6 caat3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.72 擦) 粲入聲揩必也磨也 (Page 560 #1: 擦(8)) To rub hard, to brush; to feel for; a brush; _(4)ng(a/) ts(')(a/)t(8)_ (ngaa4 caat3-2 牙擦) a toothbrush; _ts(')(a/)t(8) (1)n(i/) t(u/)i(3) (4)h(a/)i_ (caat3 ni1 deoi3 haai4 擦呢對鞋) brush this pair of shoes; _(4)mo ts(')(a/)t(8)_ (mo4 caat3 磨擦) to make smooth; _ts(')(a/)t(8) (1)kon tseng(6)_ (caat3 gon1 zeng6 擦乾淨) brush it clean; _ts(')(a/)t(8) l(a/)p(9)_ (caat3 laap6 擦蠟) to wax and brighten. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 摖 to 擦. The character 擦 is not attested in the Middle Chinese rime books. Kangxi has 《篇海》《字彙》𠀤初戛切音察, which is _ch(')(a/)t(8)_ rather than _ts(')(a/)t(8)_. In modern usage, the noun sense of "brush" is borne by the word 刷; see 刷 caat3. 【擦膠】 (caat3 gaau1) A rubber or eraser. 【擦鞋】 (caat3 haai4) To bootlick, to brownnose. (Literally, "polish shoes".) 【擦紙膠】 (caat3 zi2 gaau1) Synonym of 擦膠.

U+737A 㺚 獭 (Mainland simplified) taat3 (per 《廣韻》他達切) (F2.72 獺) 水狗食魚之物 (Page 24|n67 #13: 獺(8)) An otter (Kangxi: 如小狗 etc.); _(1)sh(a/)n ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (saan1 caat3 山獺) a beaver, or fresh-water otter; _(2)hoi ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (hoi2 caat3 海獺) a seal; _ch(')(a/)t(8) ~~(5)ling~~ (5)leng_ (caat3 leng5 獺領), seal skin collars or tippets; _ch(')(a/)t(8) (2)tsai_ (caat3 zai2 獺仔), a tanka woman. Williams' 獺領: Changed _(5)ling_ (ling5) to vernacular reading _(5)leng_ (leng5). 【獺】 (that, trhaet) (_noun-like_) otter

caau1.text: U+527F 𠞰 勦 To plagiarise, to copy.

ziu2.text: U+527F 𠞰 劋 勦 (F2.6 勦) 征勦截殺也又勦集 (F2.6 剿) 同上 (Page 581 #4: ~~(1)剿(1)𠞰~~(2)剿(2)𠞰) To destroy utterly, to exterminate, to devastate; _(2)tsi(u/) m(i/)t(9)_ (ziu2 mit6 剿滅) to extirpate, to rase, as is done to rebels or their towns; _(2)tsi(u/) ts(ut(9) (2)tong (5)(u_ (ziu2 zyut6 dong2 jyu5 剿絕黨與), to extirpate all the adherents of a cabal. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 王 to 上. To sever (Kangxi 𠞰: 絕也). 【剿】 (tsjewX) (_verb-like_) to sever, (_met._) to extirpate
U+52E6 (F2.6 勦) 征勦截殺也又勦集 (F2.6 剿) 同上 Fan Wan entry: Corrected 王 to 上. To toil (Kangxi: 勞也). 【勦】 (tsjewX) (_verb-like_) to toil

caau1.text: U+6284 剿 𠞰 勦 鈔 (F2.41 抄) 抄寫 (Page 29|n72 #9: (1)抄) To take, to seize (Kangxi: 略取也); to search; to engross, to transcribe (Kangxi: 謄寫也); to lade out, to spoon out (Kangxi: 叉取也); to confiscate, to escheat, to sequestrate, to resume; _(2)shau (1)ch(')(a/)u_ (sau2 caau1 手抄), a MS. copy; _(1)ch(')(a/)u (1)ts(')ing (1)k(a/)_ (caau1 cing1 gaa1 抄清家), all his property is taken; _chi(u/)(3) (2)p(u/)n (1)ch(')(a/)u (4)t(')ang_ (ziu3 bun2 caau1 tang4 照本抄謄), copied exactly; _(1)ch(')(a/)u (2)s(e/)_ (caau1 se2 抄寫), to copy; _(1)ch(')(a/)u p(a/)k(9)_ (caau1 baak6 抄白) it is copied clearly; _(1)ch(')(a/)u s(a/)i(3)_ (caau1 saai3 抄嗮) it is all copied. (Page 30|n73 #6: 鈔(3) _Ch(')(a/)u(3)_ (caau3); _(1)Ch(')(a/)u_ (caau1) implied) Interchanged with 抄 to copy (Kangxi 鈔: 今俗別作抄, 謄寫也); 【抄】 (tsrhaew, tsrhaewH) (_verb-like_) to seize (_verb-like_) to copy

U+9214 钞 (Mainland simplified) caau3 (per 《廣韻》初敎切) (F2.42 鈔 _Ch(')(a/)u(3)_ (caau3)) 鈔錢又畧取也 (Page 30|n73 #6: 鈔(3) _Ch(')(a/)u(3)_ (caau3); here normalised to _(1)Ch(')(a/)u_ (caau1)) a document, a government paper, a receipt (Kangxi: 官收物而給印信文憑也); paper money (Kangxi: 楮貨名); _(4)sh(un ~~ch(')(a/)u(3)~~ (1)ch(')(a/)u_ (syun4 caau1 船鈔) tonnage dues, charges on ships; _fong(3) ~~ch(')(a/)u(3)~~ (1)ch(')(a/)u_ (fong3 caau1 放鈔) to burn paper money to the gods; _(4)ts(')(i/)n ~~ch(')(a/)u(3)~~ (1)ch(')(a/)u_ (cin4 caau1 錢鈔) bills and money; _~~ch(')(a/)u(3)~~ (1)ch(')(a/)u (1)kw(a/)n_ (caau1 gwaan1 鈔關), a custom house; _shui(3) ~~ch(')(a/)u(3)~~ (1)ch(')(a/)u_ (seoi3 caau1 稅鈔) duties on goods, transit dues. Both the level reading 楚交切 _(1)ch(')(a/)u_ (caau1) and the departing reading 初敎切 _ch(')(a/)u(3)_ (caau3) are attested in 《廣韻》, explained 略也 "seize".

caau2.text: U+5435 (Page 30|n73 #5: (2)吵) To clamor, to wrangle; _(2)ch(')(a/)u n(a/)u(6)_ (caau2 naau6 吵鬧) to scold; _(4)ts(')(o\) (2)ch(')(a/)u_ (cou4 caau2 嘈吵), to raise a row; _t(a/)i(6) (2)ch(')(a/)u yat(7) ~~(2)ch(')(e/)ung~~ (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (daai6 caau2 jat1 coeng4 大吵一場), a great hubbub; _(2)ch(')(a/)u (4)yan (5)(i/)_ (caau2 jan4 ji5 吵人耳), a din in the ears. Williams' 大吵一場: Corrected _(2)ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng2) to _(4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng4).

U+7092 焣 㷅 煼 𩱦 (F2.42 炒) 乾熬食物曰炒 (F2.42 煼) 同上 (Page 30|n73 #4: (2)炒) To roast in a boiler; to fry (Kangxi: 熬也) in fat or batter; _(1)kon (2)ch(')(a/)u_ (gon1 caau2 乾炒), to fry brown; to roast to dryness; _(2)ch(')(a/)u (4)ch(')(a/)_ (caau2 caa4 炒茶), to fire tea; _(2)ch(')(a/)u ~~(1)k(a/) (1)f(i/)~~ k(a/)(3) (1)f(e/)_ (caau2 gaa3 fe1 炒咖啡), to roast coffee; _(2)ch(')(a/)u m(a/)i(6)_ (caau2 maai6 炒賣) to cook and sell; _(2)ch(')(a/)u (1)fung lut(9)_ (caau2 fung1 leot6-2 炒風栗) to roast chestnuts; _(1)ts(i/)n (2)ch(')(a/)u_ (zin1 caau2 煎炒), to fry; _(2)si(u/) (2)ch(')(a/)u yuk(9)_ (siu2 caau2 juk6 小炒肉) fried hash and vegetables; _(2)ch(')(a/)u shuk(9)_ (caau2 suk6 炒熟) to fry thoroughly. Williams' 炒咖啡: Changed now dated _(1)k(a/) (1)f(i/)_ (gaa1 fei1) to modern _k(a/)(3) (1)f(e/)_ (gaa3 fe1). This change is perhaps inappropriate as it is anachronistic for 1856; see the page-level commentary at fe. Williams' 炒賣: Now to buy speculatively and sell. 【炒】 (caau2) To stir-fry. Short for 炒魷魚. 炒咗佢 (caau2 zo2 keoi5): "Fired him." To speculate, or to flip. 炒賣 (caau2 maai6): "Speculate and sell." 炒樓 (caau2 lau4-2): "Flip property." To crash. 炒單車 (caau2 daan1 ce1): "Stacked my bike." 【炒魷魚】 (caau2 jau4 jyu4-2) To sack, to fire. 【炒魷】 (caau2 jau4-2) Short for 炒魷魚.

caau3.text: U+6477 【摷】 (caau3) To rummage or rifle through. 摷鎖匙 (caau3 so2 si4): "Rummage for the keys." 摷垃圾 (caau3 laap6 saap3): "Rummage through rubbish." The spelling 摷 is arbitrary.

caau4.text: U+5DE2 caau4-2 (rising second in vernacular 巢巢地) (F2.41 巢) 鳥在木上曰巢 (Page 29|n72 #10: (4)巢) A nest on a tree (Kangxi: 鳥在木上曰巢 etc.); a den, a retreat; a lurking place; to nestle, to make a nest; _(4)ch(')(a/)u (ut(9)_ (caau4 jyut6 巢穴) to skulk in, as a brigand; _(4)ch(')(a/)u (1)wo_ (caau4 wo1 巢窩), or _ts(e/)uk(8) (4)ch(')(a/)u_ (zoek3 caau4 雀巢), a nest; _ts(')(a/)k(9) (4)ch(')(a/)u_ (caak6 caau4 賊巢), a den or resort of robbers; _p(a/)k(8) (5)ni(u/) (1)kwai (4)ch(')(a/)u_ (baak3 niu5 gwai1 caau4 百鳥歸巢), the birds have gone to roost. (Page 30|n73 #2: (4)窠; here corrected to 巢) A colloquial word. Crumpled, wrinkled, corrugated, rough; shriveled, as dried fruit; _(2)h(o\) ~~(2)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z' (a/)(3) (4)p(')o (4)p(')(i/) k(o\)m(3) (4)ch(')(a/)u_ (hou2 ci5 aa3 po4 pei4 gam3 caau4 好似阿婆皮咁巢), wrinkled as a granny's face; _(4)ch(')(a/)u (1)mang (1)mang_ (caau4 mang1 mang1 巢𠵼𠵼), creased, rumpled. Williams' 好似阿婆皮咁巢: Corrected _(2)ts(')z'_ (ci2) to _(5)ts(')z'_ (ci5). A large free-reed instrument (Kangxi: 樂器, 大笙謂之巢). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【巢】 (dzraew) (_noun-like_) nest 【巢】 (caau4) Wrinkled. 巢皮 (caau4 pei4): "Wrinkled skin." 【巢𠵼𠵼】 (caau4 mang1 mang1, caau4 mang1 mang3) Wrinkly. The spellings 巢 and 巢𠵼𠵼 is arbitrary.

U+6F05 巢 ziu2 (per 《廣韻》子小切) (F2.41 漅) 湖名在合肥亦作巢 (Page 30|n73 #1: (4)漅) Name of a large lake in the south of the province of Ng(a/)nhwui (安徽) (Kangxi: 湖名). Also read _~~(1)tsi(u/)~~ (2)tsi(u/)_ (ziu2). The last (巢) is usually used for this (Kangxi: 亦作巢). The reading _(4)ch(')(a/)u_ (caau4) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 鋤交切, explained 湖名. Williams' "Also read ...": Corrected _(1)tsi(u/)_ (ziu1) to _(2)tsi(u/)_ (ziu2).
U+8F48 (F2.41 轈) 兵車加轈以望敵也 (Page 30|n73 #3: (4)轈) A turret on a chariot, from the top of which to observe the troops (Kangxi: 兵高車加巢以望敵也).

cai1.text: U+59BB (F1.28 妻) 夫妻 (Page 549 #5: (1)妻) A wife, a partner (Kangxi: 妻與己齊者也), a spouse, a consort who is taken with legal ceremonies; _(1)ts(')ai (2)tsz'_ (cai1 zi2 妻子) a wife; _ling(6) (1)ts(')ai_ (ling6 cai1 令妻), your wife; _h(a/)k(8) (1)ts(')ai_ (haak3 cai1 客妻), a courtesan; _l(o\)(6) (4)t(')au (1)ts(')ai_ (lou6 tau4 cai1 路頭妻), a wayside wife, one taken while sojourning elsewhere; _(4)p(')ing (1)ts(')ai_ (ping4 cai1 平妻), equal to a wife, _i. e._ a concubine; _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (1)ts(')ai_ (ceoi2 cai1 娶妻), to take a wife; _(4)(i/)n (1)ts(')ai_ (jin4 cai1 賢妻) my good wife, a virtuous wife; _(1)ki(u/) (1)ts(')ai (5)m(i/) ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (giu1 cai1 mei5 cip3 嬌妻美妾) an accomplished wife and handsome concubine. Williams' 娶妻: Changed _ts(')(u(3)_ (ceoi3) to common reading _(2)ts(')(u_ (ceoi2). 【妻-level】 (tshej) (_noun-like_) wife

cai3.text: U+59BB (F1.32 妻) 以女嫁人曰妻 (Page 549 #5: (1)妻) Also read _ts(')ai(3)_ (cai3)_;_ to give a daughter as wife to one (Kangxi: 以女嫁人曰妻之). 【妻-departing】 (tshejH) (_verb-like_) to wive

cai1.text: U+60BD 凄 (Mainland simplified) (F1.28 悽) 悲也 (Page 549 #7: (1)悽) grieved, afflicted, sorrowing (Kangxi: 痛也, 悲也); suffering from hunger (Kangxi: 悽悽饑病貌); _(1)p(i/) (1)ts(')ai_ (bei1 cai1 悲悽), pitiable, suffering; _(1)ts(')ai (1)ts(')ai_ (cai1 cai1 悽悽), gaunt, famishing.
U+6816 (F1.28 栖) 依也宿也 (Page 550 #2: (1)棲(1)~~梄~~栖) Williams misprints 栖 as 梄; here corrected. (The character 栖 appears correctly on Page 771 in the character index.)

U+68F2 捿 栖 sai1 (per 《廣韻》先稽切) (F1.28 棲) 棲息又牀也 (Page 550 #2: (1)棲(1)~~梄~~栖) To roost, to perch, to nestle (Kangxi 栖: 日在西方而鳥棲 etc.) (Kangxi 棲: 同栖鳥棲也); to sojourn, to stay at, to reside; to settle down, to rest, to repose (Kangxi 栖: 凡物止息皆曰栖); at peace; a perch, a roost; a sleeping-place (Kangxi 棲: 棲謂之牀); a lodging-place; _(1)kai (1)ts(')ai_ (gai1 cai1 雞棲), a hen-roost; _ts(a/)m(6) (4)sh(i/) (1)ts(')ai ch(u(6)_ (zaam6 si4 cai1 zyu6 暫時棲住) to live here for a while; _(4)m(o\) teng(6) (1)ts(')ai (1)shan_ (mou4 deng6 cai1 san1 無埞棲身), no place to stay at; _(1)ts(')ai s(i/)t(8)_ (cai1 sit3 棲屑) to and fro, like a stranger. Williams misprints 栖 as 梄; here corrected. (The character 栖 appears correctly on Page 771 in the character index.) 【棲】 (sej) (_verb-like_) to roost

U+6DD2 凄 悽 (for "grieved/afflicted" senses) (F1.28 淒) 寒也又淒凉 (Page 549 #6: (1)凄(1)淒) Intense cold (Kangxi 淒: 寒涼也); bleak, cloudy, wintry (Kangxi 淒: 雲雨起貌); a cold wind; shivering, freezing; calamitous, afflicted, grievous; _(1)fung (5)(u (1)ts(')ai (1)ts(')ai_ (fung1 jyu5 cai1 cai1 風雨淒淒), sleety rain and wind; _(1)ts(')ai ts(')(i/)t(8)_ (cai1 cit3 淒切) bitter suffering; _(1)ts(')ai (4)l(e/)ung_ (cai1 loeng4 淒涼), grievous; _k(o\)m(3) (1)ts(')ai (4)l(e/)ung_ (gam3 cai1 loeng4 咁淒涼), so sad; so serious, as consequences; _(1)ts(')ai (2)ts(')(a/)m_ (cai1 caam2 淒慘), oppressed, borne down; _(1)ts(')ai (2)ch(')o sham(6)_ (cai1 co2 sam6 淒楚甚) in urgent case, needy. The second (淒) also means gathering clouds. (Page 549 #7: (1)悽) Similar to the last (淒); 【淒】 (tshej) (_adjective-like_) cold (_adjective-like_) sad
U+7DC0 cai2 (alternative per 《廣韻》千禮切) (F1.28 緀) 緀斐文章相錯貌 (Page 549 #8: (1)緀) The stripes, colored or plain, in silken fabrics (Kangxi: 帛文貌); ornamented, blended colors and stripes (Kangxi: 緀斐文章相錯貌).

U+840B (F1.28 萋) 草盛 (Page 549 #9: (1)萋) Luxuriant foliage (Kangxi: 草盛貌); _(1)ts(')ai (1)ts(')ai_ (cai1 cai1 萋萋), moving clouds (Kangxi: 雲行貌); a man exerting himself (Kangxi: 萋萋臣盡力也). 【萋】 (tshej) (_adjective-like_) luxuriant

cai3.text: U+5207 (F1.32 切) 齊也衆也 (Page 550 #8: 切(3)) All, every, the whole; _yat(7) ts(')ai(3)_ (jat1 cai3 一切) the entire lot (Kangxi: 一切大凡也); _chi(u/)(3) k(u/)(3) yat(7) ts(')ai(3)_ (ziu3 gu3 jat1 cai3 照顧一切) I thank you for all your kindness. 【一切】 ('jit tshejH) (_noun-like_) everything 【切-departing】 (tshejH) Used in 一切.

cit3.text: U+5207 (F1.26 切) 近也要也 (Page 580 #4: 切(8)) To cut, to carve, to mince, to slice (Kangxi: 割也刻也); to urge, to press (Kangxi: 迫也急也); a superlative, very, vehement, earnest, eager, pressing, important, serious, momentous; the important parts, a resume (Kangxi: 切要也); sincere (Kangxi: 愨實也); to feel, as the pulse (Kangxi: 切按也); to spell, to express a sound by joining initials and finals (Kangxi: 反切); _ts(')(i/)t(8) i(u/)(3)_ (cit3 jiu3 切要) important; _t(')au(3) ts(')(i/)t(8)_ (tau3 cit3 透切) plain, lucid; _ts(')(i/)t(8) yuk(9)_ (cit3 juk6 切肉) minced meat; _ts(')(i/)t(8) mat(9) h(u(3)_ (cit3 mat6 heoi3 切勿去) stay, don't go; _ts(')(i/)t(8) mak(9)_ (cit3 mak6 切脈) to feel the pulse; _ts(')(i/)t(8) oi(3)_ (cit3 oi3 切愛) warm love; _ts(')(i/)t(8) t(o\)(3) sui(3)_ (cit3 dou3 seoi3 切到碎) cut to pieces, cut fine; _ts(')(i/)t(8) (1)ts(')o_ (cit3 co1 切磋), to turn in a lathe; to work and carve; ~~to dehort, as a friend;~~ _ts(')(i/)t(8) (1)yam_ (cit3 jam1 切音), to spell, to join an initial and a final; _k(')ok(8) ts(')(i/)t(8) pat(7) (4)(i/)_ (kok3 cit3 bat1 ji4 確切不移), unchangeably fixed. Williams' 切磋: Not to dehort, but to learn from one another, especially through an activity (e.g. sparring, a game, etc.). Used in 反切 (back-dissection) or alone, referring to the method of indicating (Middle) Chinese pronunciation by two characters, marking the initial (consonant) and the final (rime) respectively. To bite or gnash (the teeth). Close (in the sense of near). 【切-entering】 (tshet) (_verb-like_) to cut, to dissect, (_met._) to gnash (_verb-like_) to take (pulse) (_adjective-like_) (_met._) pressing Used in 反切. 【切】 (cit3) In time. 嚟唔切 (lai4 m4 cit3): "Can't make it in time." 趕得切 (gon2 dak1 cit3): "Rushed there in time." Short for 白切雞 (plain cut chicken). 叉切飯 (caa1 cit3 faan6): "Char shiu, plain cut chicken rice." 【切雞】 (cit3 gai1) Short for 白切雞 (plain cut chicken). 切雞飯 (cit3 gai1 faan6): "Plain cut chicken rice."

cai3.text: U+780C (F1.32 砌) 堦基也 (Page 550 #9: 砌(3)) A stone step (Kangxi: 階甃也); ornamented tiles laid for steps; to lay, as tiles; to place regularly, to fit in; _ts(')ai(3) (2)h(o\)_ (cai3 hou2 砌好), lay them even, as bricks; _ts(')ai(3) (4)m(a/)i_ (cai3 maai4 砌埋), place them straight; _ts(')ai(3) shek(9) l(o\)(6)_ (cai3 sek6 lou6 砌石路) to pave with stones; _ts(')ai(3) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (cai3 coeng4 砌牆), to lay a wall; _ts(')ai(3) (5)ng(a/)_ (cai3 ngaa5 砌瓦), to tile roofs. 【砌】 (tshejH) (_noun-like_) step (_verb-like_) to assemble, to lay

cai4.text: U+568C 哜 (Mainland simplified) (Page 549 #4: 嚌(6) read _(1)Tsai_ (zai1); here corrected to _(4)Ts(')ai_ (cai4)) ~~Read _(1)tsai_ (zai1).~~ a plaintive sound (Kangxi: 鳥哀聲).

zai6.text: U+568C 哜 (Mainland simplified) (Page 549 #4: 嚌(6)) ~~Read _(1)tsai_ (zai1).~~ To taste (Kangxi: 嘗也), to sip, to wet the lips; A colloquial word. A superlative, denoting that the extreme has been reached; _~~t(a/)m(6)~~ (5)t(')(a/)m tak(7) tsai(6)_ (taam5 dak1 zai6 淡得嚌) excessively weak, as tea; _(5)m(o\) mat(7) tsai(6)_ (mou5 mat1 zai6 冇乜嚌) not much there, nothing to speak of; _t(a/)i(6) tak(7) tsai(6)_ (daai6 dak1 zai6 大得嚌) far too large; _hai(6) tak(7) tsai(6)_ (hai6 dak1 zai6 係得嚌) certainly. Williams' "Read _(1)tsai_": This is probably an incorrect parsing of Kangxi 音劑, which is intended in the departing tone. Williams' 淡得嚌: Corrected _t(a/)m(6)_ (daam6 去聲) to _(5)t(')(a/)m_ (taam5 上聲). Williams' 係得嚌: Dated. 【嚌】 (dzejH) (_verb-like_) to taste 【得嚌】 (dak1 zai6) A final particle of excessive degree. 多得嚌 (do1 dak1 zai6): "Too much." 熱得嚌 (jit6 dak1 zai6): "It's too hot." 【咁嚌】 (gam3 zai6) A final particle of almostness. 熱到死咁嚌 (jit6 dou3 sei2 gam3 zai6): "It's so hot we've almost died." 食完咁嚌 (sik6 jyun4 gam3 zai6): "We've almost finished eating." 【乜嚌】 (mat1 zai6) A final particle of almost-nothingness. 冇乜嚌 (mou5 mat1 zai6): "Almost nothing." 冇食乜嚌 (mou5 sik6 mat1 zai6): "Barely ate any of it." The spelling 嚌 is arbitrary.

cai4.text: U+61E0 zai6 (alternative per 《廣韻》在詣切) (F1.32 懠 _Tsai(3)_ (zai3)) 怒也 (Page 549 #3: 懠(3) _Tsai(3)_ (zai3); here corrected to _(4)Ts(')ai_ (cai4)) Angry, enraged (Kangxi: 怒也); _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)ch(i/) (1)fong ~~tsai(3)~~ (4)ts(')ai_ (tin1 zi1 fong1 cai4 天之方懠) when heaven is angry. 【懠】 (dzej, dzejH) (_adjective-like_) wroth

zai1.text: U+61E0 (Page 549 #3: 懠(3) _Tsai(3)_ (zai3); here corrected to _(1)Tsai_ (zai1)) suspicious, envious of (Kangxi: 懠疑猶猜疑也); to doubt;

cai4.text: U+8810 蛴 (Mainland simplified) (F1.30 蠐) 螬蠐蟲名 (Page 550 #4: (4)蠐) ~~A maggot~~ The scarab beetle grub (Kangxi: 蠐螬); _(4)ts(')ai (4)ts(')(o\)_ (cai4 cou4 蠐螬), a grub, larvae in mulberry and other trees. 【蠐】 (dzej) Used in 蠐螬, 蝤蠐. 【蠐螬】 (dzej dzaw) (_noun-like_) scarab grub 【蝤蠐】 (dzjuw dzej) (_noun-like_) tree grub

U+9F4A 亝 斉 斊 齐 (Mainland simplified) (F1.30 齊) 整齊不參差也又國名 (Page 550 #3: (4)齊) Even (Kangxi: 整也), equal (Kangxi: 等也), uniform; to equalize, to tranquillize; to adjust, to classify, to arrange methodically or according to rank; at once, all, together, alike; quick, smart; ~~good;~~ to discriminate (Kangxi: 辨也); an ancient feudal state comprising the part of Sh(a/)ntung (山東) east of T(')(a/)i sh(a/)n (泰山); the 210th radical (U+2FD1 ⿑ "even"); _(2)ching (4)ts(')ai_ (zing2 cai4 整齊), well arranged, properly placed; _(4)ts(')ai (1)chau_ (cai4 zau1 齊州), an old name for China; _yat(7) (4)ts(')ai h(u(3)_ (jat1 cai4 heoi3 一齊去) all go at once; _(1)shau (4)ts(')ai ch(e/)ung(3) muk(9)_ (sau1 cai4 zoeng3 muk6 收齊賬目) to collect all the accounts; _(4)ts(')ai (4)m(i/)_ (cai4 mei4 齊眉), an old couple; _(4)'m p(i/)n(3) tak(7) (4)yan (4)ts(')ai_ (m4 bin3 dak1 jan4 cai4 唔變得人齊), he was not turned out a full man --- said of a young scapegrace; _(1)t(o\) ts(')(i/)t(8) k(o\)m(3) (4)ts(')ai_ (dou1 cit3 gam3 cai4 刀切咁齊), trimmed even, all of a size; _(4)ts(')ai (1)sam_ (cai4 sam1 齊心), of one mind; _(2)tang (4)ts(')ai_ (dang2 cai4 等齊), wait till all come; _(4)ts(')ai p(i/)(6)_ (cai4 bei6 齊備) all are ready, fully prepared; _pat(7) (4)ts(')ai_ (bat1 cai4 不齊), incomplete, unequal; _(4)ts(')ai (1)k(a/)_ (cai4 gaa1 齊家), to govern a family. Williams' "good": Kangxi has 又《廣韻》好也, but it is unclear whether 好 is rising-tone "good" or departing-tone "fond". A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【齊】 (dzej) (_adjective-like_) equal, uniform (_verb-like_) to equal, to uniform, (_met._) to put in order (_adjective-like_) together, complete

zaai1.text: U+9F4A (F2.25 齊) 竹佳切莊也恭也潔也洗心曰齊 (F2.25 齋) 齋成又燕居之室曰齋 (F2.25 斋) 同上 (Page 10|n53 #4: (1)齊)

ci2.text: U+6CDA May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. cai2 (alternative per 《廣韻》千禮切) cai5 (per Fan Wan) (F1.31 泚 _(5)Ts(')ai_ (cai5)) 汗出貌 (Page 550 #7: (5)泚 _(5)Ts(')ai_ (cai5); here normalised to _(2)Ts(')z'_ (ci2)) Perspiring (Kangxi: 汗出貌), sweating on the forehead; clear water (Kangxi: 水淸也); fresh, clean; 【泚】 (tshjeX, tshejX) (_adjective-like_) limpid (_adjective-like_) perspiring

cai5.text: U+85BA 萕 荠 (Mainland simplified) (F1.31 薺) 甘菜 (Page 550 #5: (5)薺) Cress, shepherd's purse (Kangxi: 甘菜); a term for small esculent plants like pepper-grass, cress, mint. 【薺】 (dzejX) (_noun-like_) shepherd's-purse
U+9B86 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 550 #6: (5)鱭(5)鮆)

U+9C6D 鮆 鲚 (Mainland simplified) 𫚖 (Mainland simplified) (Page 550 #6: (5)鱭(5)鮆) A thin fish, with a silvery belly; a mullet; _(5)m(a/) (5)ts(')ai_ (maa5 cai5 馬鱭), a kind of anchovy _(Coilia playfairii);_ _(4)wong (5)m(i/) (5)ts(')ai_ (wong4 mei5 cai5 黃尾鱭), yellow tail mullet _(Mullus xanthurus);_ _p(a/)k(9) (5)ts(')ai_ (baak6 cai5 白鱭), green ish mullet _Mugil ventricosus_.

cam1.text: U+4FB5 㑴 (F2.36 侵) 侵占侵凌侵害 (Page 552 #1: (1)侵) To usurp, to incroach upon, to enter gradually (Kangxi: 漸進也); to appropriate, to plunder, to invade (Kangxi: 朘削也); possessed, by as a spirit; bad, calamitous, as a year (Kangxi: 歲凶); _(1)ts(')am hoi(6)_ (cam1 hoi6 侵害) to injure insensibly; _(1)ts(')am ch(i/)m(3)_ (cam1 zim3 侵佔) to unjustly incroach on; _(1)ts(')am (2)p(u/)n_ (cam1 bun2 侵本), to draw on the principal; _(1)ts(')am tik(7) yap(9) h(u(3)_ (cam1 dik1 jap6 heoi3 侵滴入去) stick in a few bad ones; _(1)ts(')am (1)p(i/)n (4)p(')(a/)i_ (cam1 bin1 paai4-2 侵辮牌), to braid in false hair; _t(a/)i(6) (1)ts(')am (1)ch(i/) (4)n(i/)n_ (daai6 cam1 zi1 nin4 大侵之年), a bad year; _(1)ts(')am (4)ling_ (cam1 ling4 侵凌), to intimidate, to oppress. 【侵】 (tshim) (_verb-like_) to invade, to encroach 【侵】 (cam1) To add in. 侵水 (cam1 seoi2): "Add in some water." To join in. 侵埋我玩吖 (cam1 maai4 ngo5 waan2 a1): "Let me join in too."

cam2.text: U+4FB5 (F2.37 侵) 漸進也 (Page 552 #1: (1)侵) Read _(2)ts(')am_ (cam2)_;_ diminutive, small (Kangxi: 貌不揚也, 短小曰侵). Fan Wan entry: The explanation 漸進也 is erroneous (it should apply to the level-tone reading _(1)ts(')am_ (cam1)).

cam1.text: U+6D78 寖 㴆 濅 zam3 (per Williams, common) (Page 551 #5: 浸(3) _Tsam(3)_ (zam3); here normalised to _(1)Ts(')am_ (cam1)) _(4)k(')(i/) sh(ut(8) ~~tsam(3)~~ (1)ts(')am (4)yam_ (kei4 syut3 cam1 jam4 其說浸淫), his words are insidious and persuasive;

zam3.text: U+6D78 寖 㴆 湛 濅 zam6 (for Cantonese "drown" sense) (F2.38 浸) 漬也潤也 (Page 15|n58 #2: 浸(3) _Cham(3)_) A colloquial word. A coat, as of paint; a thickness, an envelop, a skin; _ts(')at(7) (1)s(a/)m cham(3)_ (cat1 saam1 zam3 漆三浸) varnished it three times; _mok(7) yat(7) cham(3) (4)p(')(i/)_ (mok1 jat1 zam3 pei4 剝一浸皮), pull off one covering. (Page 16|n59 #1: 湛(3) _Ch(a/)m(3)_ (zaam3); here corrected to _Tsam(3)_ (zam3) and normalised to 浸) to soak, to immerse, to imbibe, as a sponge (Kangxi 湛: 與浸同漬也); to plunge in (Kangxi 湛: 投物水中也); (Page 551 #5: 浸(3) _Tsam(3)_) To soak through, to penetrate (Kangxi: 漬也); to saturate, to steep in, to macerate, to wet (Kangxi: 潤也); to submerge, to immerse (Kangxi: 沒也); to flood, to lay under water, as fields (Kangxi: 涵也沈也澤之總名也); drenched, wet, imbued with, watered; gradually, gently (Kangxi: 漸也); _tsam(3) (2)sz'_ (zam3 sei2 浸死) drowned; _tsam(3) (4)t(')ong_ (zam3 tong4 浸糖) soaked in syrup; _tsam(3) yun(6)_ (zam3 jeon6 浸潤) to imbue with, to prejudice against, to bias; _tsam(3) ch(a/)(6)_ (zam3 zaa6 浸？) niggardly, closefisted; _(2)shui tsam(3)_ (seoi2 zam3 水浸) overflowed, flooded; _hon(6) tsam(3) (4)hung (4)ng(a/)n_ (hon6 zam3 hung4 ngaan4 汗浸紅顏), the perspiration rolled down his face; _tsam(3) shap(7)_ (zam3 sap1 浸濕) wet it, soak it; _(2)p(i/) (2)shui tsam(3) ch(u(6)_ (bei2 seoi2 zam3 zyu6 畀水浸住) cover it with water; _tsam(3) (2)tsau_ (zam3 zau2 浸酒), spirits in which fruits have been soaked; _tsam(3) yap(9) (1)sam_ (zam3 jap6 sam1 浸入心), it is wet through. Some hold that the reading variation zam6 for the Cantonese "drown" sense is from Middle Chinese 直禁切 _cham(6)_ (zam6) for 沈 (now spelt 沉). For this departing-tone reading of 沈, note that: 《廣韻》 provides no explanation (it simply cross-references the level-tone reading _(4)ch(')am_ (cam4) as 又直壬切). 《集韻》 has the explanation 沒也. Kangxi has 亦沒也 followed by the alternative sense 一曰投物水中也. Williams' 汗浸紅顏: Although 紅顏 does not preclude men, it is generally used to describe a lady's face. 【浸】 (tsimH) (_verb-like_) to soak, to immerse, (_met._) lake (_adverb-like_) gradually 【浸】 (zam3) Classifier for layers. 剷甩浸油 (caan2 lat1 zam3 jau4-2): "Strip away the layer of paint." 有浸肥膏 (jau5 zam3 fei4 gou1): "There's a layer of fat." The spelling 浸 is arbitrary.

cam1.text: U+7972 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.36 祲) 精氣感祥也 (Page 552 #3: (1)祲) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 䘲 to 祲.

zam1.text: U+7972 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. cam1 (per Fan Wan) zam3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子鴆切) (F2.36 祲 _(1)Ts(')am_ (cam1)) 精氣感祥也 (Page 552 #3: (1)祲 _(1)Ts(')am_ (cam1); here normalised to _(1)Tsam_ (zam1)) To influence, to act upon; a malign halo (Kangxi: 妖氛也); abundant, great, full (Kangxi: 盛也). The reading _(1)ts(')am_ (cam1) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 七林切, explained 精氣感祥又日旁氣. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 䘲 to 祲.

cim1.text: U+92DF 锓 (Mainland simplified) cam1 (alternative per 《集韻》千尋切) cam2 (per 《廣韻》七稔切) zim1 (per 《廣韻》子廉切) (F2.36 鋟 _(1)Ts(')am_ (cam1)) 刻也 (Page 552 #4: (1)鋟 _(1)Ts(')am_ (cam1); here normalised to _(1)Ts(')(i/)m_ (cim1)) To cut, to engrave (Kangxi: 刻也); sharp-pointed (Kangxi: 錐也); a point; an awl, a graver. The reading _(1)ts(')(i/)m_ (cim1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 千廉切, explained 刻也.

cam1.text: U+99F8 骎 (Mainland simplified) (F2.36 駸) 馬疾行也 (Page 552 #2: (1)駸) ~~Occurs used for the preceding (侵);~~ properly a ~~swift~~ horse moving swiftly (Kangxi: 駸駸馬行疾貌); _(1)ts(')am (1)ts(')am_ (cam1 cam1 駸駸), a fast running courser. 【駸】 (tshim, tsrhim) (_adjective-like_) galloping

cam2.text: U+5BE2 寑 寝 (Mainland simplified) (F2.37 寢) 臥也息也又內室曰寢室 (Page 552 #12: (2)寢) To sleep (Kangxi: 臥也); rest, sleep; to rest, to desist, to repose (Kangxi: 息也); a back chamber, a bed-chamber (Kangxi: 堂室也); an adytum in a temple (Kangxi: 寢廟凡廟前曰廟後曰寢); a retiring-room in a palace; a dwelling-house (Kangxi: 凡居室皆曰寢); a mausoleum or house near a grave (Kangxi: 陵寢); _(1)on (2)ts(')am_ (on1 cam2 安寢), to sleep quietly; _(4)k(')(i/) sz'(6) sui(6) (2)ts(')am_ (kei4 si6 seoi6 cam2 其事遂寢), the affair then terminated; _(2)ts(')am shat(7)_ (cam2 sat1 寢室) a dormitory; the ancestral hall in a mansion; _(4)n(a/)n (2)ts(')am_ (naan4 cam2 難寢), I cannot get asleep; _(2)ts(')am (1)ping_ (cam2 bing1 寢兵), to give rest to troops; _(4)ling (2)ts(')am_ (ling4 cam2 陵寢), the imperial mausolea near Mukten (瀋陽); _ching(3) (2)ts(')am_ (zing3 cam2 正寢), room behind the hall. Ugly in appearance. 【寢】 (tshimX) (_verb-like_) to sleep, to repose (_noun-like_) chamber

cam3.text: U+8B56 (F2.37 譖) 讒言毀人之行也 (Page 15|n58 #7: 譖(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 殷 to 毀.

zam3.text: U+8B56 僭 谮 (Mainland simplified) cam3 (per Fan Wan) (F2.37 譖 _Ch(')am(3)_ (cam3)) 讒言毀人之行也 (Page 15|n58 #7: 譖(3) _Ch(')am(3)_ (cam3); here normalised to _Cham(3)_ (zam3)) To slander, to vilify (Kangxi: 愬也, 䛼也, 讒也); to discredit; _~~ch(')am(3)~~ cham(3) (4)(i/)n_ (zam3 jin4 譖言), slanderous aspersions; _~~ch(')am(3)~~ cham(3) (4)yan_ (zam3 jan4 譖人), to asperse one. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 殷 to 毀. 【譖】 (tsrimH) (_verb-like_) to slander

cam3.text: U+8B96 唚 (for Cantonese "long-winded" sense) 譖 (for Cantonese "long-winded" sense) 谶 (Mainland simplified) caam3 (common for "prognostic" sense) (F2.37 讖) 符讖騐也凡讖緯皆以術數言將來之騐也 (Page 15|n58 #8: 讖(3)) To verify, to prove (Kangxi: 驗也); a prognostic (Kangxi: 凡讖緯皆言將來之驗也); to fulfill; _ch(')am(3) (5)(u_ (cam3 jyu5 讖語), a prophecy, a hidden meaning; _ch(')am(3) h(i/)(3)_ (cam3 hei3 讖氣) tiresome, talkative; _ch(')am(3) ~~(2)wai~~ (5)wai_ (cam3 wai5 讖緯), to agree with the prophecy. Williams' 讖緯: Corrected _(2)wai_ (wai2) to _(5)wai_ (wai5). 【讖】 (cam3) Long-winded or verbose. 又長又讖 (jau6 coeng4 jau6 cam3): "Both long and verbose." 咪咁讖啦 (mai5 gam3 cam3 la1): "Don't be so long-winded!" The spelling 讖 is arbitrary.

cam4.text: U+5C0B 𢒫 寻 (Mainland simplified) (F2.37 尋) 搜求也覓也 (Page 552 #6: (4)尋) To hunt after, to search, on the track of; to seek, to investigate (Kangxi: 繹理也, 求也); to use, to employ (Kangxi: 用也); to continue, to connect with (Kangxi: 仍也繼也); usually, ordinarily; temporary, unexpectedly (Kangxi: 俄也); ~~for a long time;~~ common (Kangxi: 俗謂庸常爲尋常); a measure of eight cubits (度名, 八尺曰尋), or like the outstretched arms; _(4)ts(')am (4)'m ch(e/)uk(9)_ (cam4 m4 zoek6 尋唔着) I can not find it; _(4)ts(')am m(i/)(6)_ (cam4 mei6 尋味) to wish more of, as of a tidbit; _(4)ts(')am (4)t(')au l(o\)(6)_ (cam4 tau4 lou6 尋頭路) seeking for work; _(4)ts(')am (4)sh(e/)ung_ (cam4 soeng4 尋常), usual, common; _(1)kan (4)ts(')am_ (gan1 cam4 跟尋), to hunt after one; _(4)ts(')am m(u/)t(9)_ (cam4 mut6 尋歿) died unexpectedly; _(4)ts(')am (4)t(')i(u/) kai(3)_ (cam4 tiu4 gai3-2 尋條計) to think out a plan; _(2)ch(a/)u (4)ts(')am_ (zaau2 cam4 找尋), to seek everywhere for; _(4)ts(')am ch(')an(3) t(o\)(3) (5)k(')(u_ (cam4 can3 dou3-2 keoi5 尋趁到佢), I've got track of him; _(4)ts(')am (1)kan man(6) (2)tai_ (cam4 gan1 man6 dai2 尋根問底), to investigate thoroughly; _(4)ts(')am sz'(6)_ (cam4 si6 尋事) to meddle with; _(4)ts(')am mat(9)_ (cam4 mat6 尋物) a colloquial phrase for yesterday. Fan Wan entry: The headword 尋 is printed like ⿳彑⿰工几寸. Williams' "for a long time": Kangxi's explanation 長也 is accompanied by an example ending in 凡物長謂之尋, so it appears to indicate spatial length rather than temporal. Williams' 尋物: Probably assimilation of 尋日 (cam4 jat6) into 尋物 (cam4 mat6). 【尋】 (zim) (_noun-like_) fathom 【尋日】 (cam4 jat6) Yesterday. 尋日病咗 (cam4 jat6 beng6 zo2): "Yesterday I got sick." The spelling 尋 is arbitrary (but well established).

U+6C89 沈 湛 㴴 cam4-2 (rising second in vernacular 沉沉地) (F2.37 沉) 汲也溺也 (Page 15|n58 #4: (4)沉(4)沈) To sink (Kangxi 沈: 沒也); to immerse; to put under water, to be lost; to quash, to suppress; muddy, deep, dull, as colors; a lake (Kangxi 沈: 齊人謂湖曰沈); _shat(9) (2)shau (4)ch(')am chui(6)_ (sat6 sau2 cam4 zeoi6 實首沉墜) garrulous; _(4)ch(')am (4)lun_ (cam4 leon4 沉淪), lost, ruined; _(4)ch(')am m(u/)t(9)_ (cam4 mut6 沉沒) to lose in the water; _(4)ch(')am (1)(un_ (cam4 jyun1 沉淵), lost in the depths; _(4)ch(')am on(3)_ (cam4 on3 沉案) to quash a case; _(4)ch(')am ~~nik(9)~~ nik(7)_ (cam4 nik1 沉溺) drowned, in doting on; _(4)ch(')am ~~chung(6)~~ (5)ch(')ung_ (cam4 cung5 沉重) very sick; _shap(9) (4)ch(')am (2)kau (4)p(')(o\)_ (sap6 cam4 gau2 pou4 十沉九浮), the odds are against him; _(4)ch(')am (1)h(e/)ung_ (cam4 hoeng1 沉香), aloes. (Page 16|n59 #1: 湛(3) _Ch(a/)m(3)_ (zaam3); here corrected to _(4)Ch(')am_ (cam4) and normalised to 沉) to sink in (Kangxi 湛: 與沈同); Williams' 沉溺: Changed _nik(9)_ (nik6) to common reading _nik(7)_ (nik1). Williams' 沉重: Corrected _chung(6)_ (zung6 去聲) to _(5)ch(')ung_ (cung5 上聲). For commentary on departing-tone 直禁切 _cham(6)_ (zam6) in relation to the vernacular zam6 for "drown", see 浸 zam3. 【沉】 (drim) (_verb-like_) to sink

zaam3.text: U+6E5B 㴴 zaam6 (per Kangxi 宅減切 for non-surname senses and 丈陷切 for surname sense) (F2.65 湛) 澄湛清也淡也又姓 (Page 16|n59 #1: 湛(3)) A northern affluent of the Yellow R. near Sh(a/)ns(i/) (山西) (Kangxi: 一曰湛水豫章浸 etc.); deep (Kangxi: 深貌), limpid, still (Kangxi: 澄也澹也), as water; clear, calm (Kangxi: 湛安也), as a quiet moonlight. Heavy, thick (Kangxi: 重厚貌), abundantly dewy (Kangxi: 露盛貌). A surname (Kangxi: 姓也). 【湛】 (dreamX) (_adjective-like_) heavy, thick (_adjective-like_) deep

cim4.text: U+71C2 燅 燖 cam4 (per 《集韻》徐心切) taam4 (alternative per 《廣韻》徒含切) (F2.37 燖 _(4)Ts(')am_ (cam4)) 火熟物也 (Page 500 #10: (4)燂 _(4)T(')(a/)m_ (taam4)) Also read _(4)ts(')am_ (cam4). To heat up (Kangxi: 火熱也, 燂溫也). To roast, to burn (Kangxi: 燂炙爛也, 火孰物也或作燖燅, 火爇也). 【燂】 (dzjem, zjem, dom) (_verb-like_) to heat (_verb-like_) to roast, to burn

cam4.text: U+71D6 尋 燂 燅 𬊈 (Mainland simplified) (F2.37 燖) 火熟物也 (Page 552 #7: (4)燖) Fan Wan entry: The component 尋 of the headword is printed like ⿳彑⿰工几寸. To heat, to warm (Kangxi 燅: 燅溫也). 【燖】 (zim) (_verb-like_) to heat (up), (_met._) to reheat, to revise, to renew

U+7213 煔 燅 燖 cim4 (per 《廣韻》徐鹽切 for verb(?) sense) (Page 552 #7: (4)燖; here normalised to 爓) To scald, as a fowl, in order to pluck it; to steep in hot broth (Kangxi 爓: 爓沈肉于湯也), to make a broth of. Poached meat for sacrifice (Kangxi: 湯肉曰爓, 音尋). 【爓-noun】 (zim) (_noun-like_) poached-meat 【爓-verb】 (zjem) (_verb-like_) to poach
U+9414 镡 (Mainland simplified) jam4 (alternative per 《廣韻》餘針切) (F2.37 鐔) 劍鼻 (Page 552 #10: (4)鐔) The guard on the hilt of a sword (Kangxi: 劒鼻也); a dagger, a dirk (Kangxi: 鐔似劒而小);
U+9703 (F2.37 霃) 天久陰 (Page 15|n58 #5: (4)霃) Dark, cloudy for a long time (Kangxi: 久隂也); _(1)yam (1)yam (4)ch(')am (4)ch(')am_ (jam1 jam1 cam4 cam4 陰陰霃霃), dull, rainy-looking.

U+9B35 cim4 (alternative per 《廣韻》昨鹽切) (F2.37 鬵) 釜鬵 (Page 552 #11: (4)鬵) A vase with a large belly and small mouth (Kangxi: 一曰鼎大上小下若甑曰鬵); a large kettle or boiler (Kangxi: 大釜也). Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𩰿 to 鬵. 【鬵】 (zim, dzim, dzjem) (_noun-like_) cauldron

U+9B6B sam2 (per 《廣韻》式荏切) zam2 (per Fan Wan) (F2.37 魫 _(2)Cham_ (zam2)) 魚名 (Page 15|n58 #6: (2)𩵫 _(2)Ch(')am_ (cam2); here corrected to 魫 _(4)Ch(')am_ (cam4)) The roe or eggs of fish (Kangxi 魫: 魚子); the name of a fish (Fan Wan 魫: 魚名). The reading _(4)ch(')am_ (cam4) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 持林切, explained 魚子也. Williams' placement under _(2)Ch(')am_ (cam2) is erroneous because it does not follow any of the following: _(2)cham_ (zam2) per Fan Wan (which places it between 枕 and 怎) _(4)ch(')am_ (cam4) per 《集韻》持林切. _(2)sham_ (sam2) per 《廣韻》式任切 rising. It is possible that Williams has simply misprinted _(4)_ as _(2)_, in which case _(4)ch(')am_ (cam4) is intended.
U+9C4F (F2.37 鱏) 魚名 (Page 552 #9: (4)鱏) An enormous fish, with a long nose (Kangxi: 鱏長鼻魚也重千斤), found in the Y(a/)ngtsz' ki(a/)ng (揚子江); probably a sturgeon.

U+9C58 鲟 (Mainland simplified) (F2.37 鱘) 鱘龍無鱗魚也 (Page 552 #8: (4)鱘) The sturgeon; _(4)ts(')am (4)lung (4)(u_ (cam4 lung4 jyu4-2 鱘龍魚), the sturgeon. Fan Wan entry: The component 尋 of the headword is printed like ⿳彑⿰工几寸.

can1.text: U+55D4 May appear as either ⿰口眞 or ⿰口真 (assumed here), depending on the font. 㥲 謓 (F1.81 嗔) 怒也 (Page 17|n60 #8: (1)嗔) To get angry (Kangxi: 怒也); passionate, angry; to rail; _(1)shang (1)ch(')an_ (sang1 can1 生嗔), to get into a rage; _(1)ch(')an kw(a/)i(3)_ (can1 gwaai3 嗔怪) to scold.

U+56AB 親 (Cantonese) (Page 554 #10: (1)親; here normalised to 嚫) _(2)kong (1)ts(')an (2)h(o\) (2)hau l(a/)n(6)_ (gong2 can1 hou2 hau2 laan6 講嚫好口爛) split my mouth if I ever said so; _p(')ung(3) (1)ts(')an_ (pung3 can1 碰嚫), to run against; _kw(a/)n(3) (1)ts(')an_ (gwaan3 can1 躀嚫), to slip down; Williams provides no explanation for the vernacular _(1)ts(')an_ (can1), notwithstanding he has supplied examples of its use. 【嚫】 (can1) Suffixed after a verb to mark negative consequence. 冷嚫 (laang5 can1): "I've caught a cold." 撞嚫 (zong6 can1): "I've bumped something." 整嚫 (zing2 can1): "I've hurt myself." 跌嚫 (dit3 can1): "I've had a fall." Suffixed after a verb to indicate "every time". 上嚫都漏 (soeng5 can1 dou1 lau6): "Every time I chow, I leak good tiles." 射嚫都中 (se6 can1 dou1 zung3): "Every time he shoots, he's on target." 飲嚫都係當歸 (jam2 can1 dou1 hai6 dong1 gwai1): "Every time she drinks medicine, it's dong quai." The spelling 嚫 is arbitrary.

U+778B May appear as either ⿰目眞 or ⿰目真 (assumed here), depending on the font. 嗔 䀼 (F1.81 瞋) 怒而張目也 (Page 18|n61 #1: (1)瞋) To stare at angrily, to glare at (Kangxi: 張目也, 怒也); _(1)ch(')an n(o\)(6) (4)m(o\) t(o\)(6)_ (can1 nou6 mou4 dou6 瞋怒無度) angry beyond measure. 【瞋】 (tsyhin) (_verb-like_) to glare

U+89AA 亲 (Mainland simplified) (F1.81 親) 愛也近也姻也眷也 (Page 554 #10: (1)親) To love, to be attached to (Kangxi: 愛也); liking, pleased with; near, intimate (Kangxi: 近也); near to, belonging to one's self, personal, myself (Kangxi: 躬也, 親猶自也); a relative, related to, having affinity, kindred, kin, kith (Kangxi: 襯也, 姻也, 親者屬也, 親九族也); parents (Kangxi: 六親父母...也); a wife (Kangxi: 六親...妻...也); affianced; used for _(1)san_ (san1 新), new (Kangxi: 通作新); _(1)ts(')an ts(')ik(7)_ (can1 cik1 親戚) one's relatives; _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (1)ts(')an_ (ceoi2 can1 娶親), to take a wife; _(4)shing (1)ts(')an_ (sing4 can1 成親), to ~~consummate a marriage~~ become married; _(4)(i/)m (1)ts(')an_ (jim4 can1 嚴親) or _f(u/)(6) (1)ts(')an_ (fu6 can1 父親), a father; _(4)ts(')z' (1)ts(')an_ (ci4 can1 慈親) or _(5)m(o\) (1)ts(')an_ (mou5 can1 母親), a mother; _(4)ying (1)ts(')an_ (jing4 can1 迎親), to escort the bride; _teng(6) (4)t(')au (1)ts(')an sz'(6)_ (deng6 tau4 can1 si6 定頭親事) contracted the marriage; _(5)yau (1)ts(')an_ (jau5 can1 有親), related to him; _(1)ts(')an pat(7) (2)s(e/)_ (can1 bat1 se2 親筆寫), wrote it myself; _(1)ts(')an (i/)t(9)_ (can1 jit6 親熱) very intimate; _(1)ts(')an oi(3)_ (can1 oi3 親愛) to love much; _(1)ts(')an kan(6)_ (can1 gan6 親近) near to one; nearly related; _(1)ts(')an (2)tsui_ (can1 zeoi2 親嘴), to kiss; _(1)ts(')an (5)ng(a/)n k(i/)n(3)_ (can1 ngaan5 gin3 親眼見) I saw it myself; _(1)ts(')an sh(e/)ung(6) (1)k(a/) (1)ts(')an_ (can1 soeng6 gaa1 can1 親上加親), to be doubly connected; _(4)p(')an (4)k(')ung t(un(6) luk(9) (1)ts(')an_ (pan4 kung4 dyun6 luk6 can1 貧窮斷六親), nobody knows his poor relations. Williams' 娶親: Changed _ts(')(u(3)_ (ceoi3) to common reading _(2)ts(')(u_ (ceoi2). Williams' 成親: There is no connotation of sexual consummation in 成親. Although 成 can mean "complete" or "fulfil", I think it is better rendered here as "become". 【親-level】 (tshin) (_noun-like_) close one, parent (_verb-like_) to be close, to touch, (_met._) to love (_adjective-like_) close, (_met._) one's own

can3.text: U+89AA 亲 (Mainland simplified) Pertaining to the in-laws. 親家 (can3 gaa1): "The in-laws' family of my son/daughter." Olden attestation for 親 _ts(')an(3)_ (can3) meaning "in-laws": 《康熙字典》親 ...又《唐韻》七遴切《集韻》《韻會》七刃切《正韻》寸遴切𠀤七去聲... 又《廣韻》親家也《集韻》婚姻相謂爲親... 【親-departing】 (tshinH) (_adjective-like_) in-law

can2.text: U+54C2 (F1.82 哂) 微笑 (Page 18|n61 #7: (2)哂) To smile, with slight contempt (Kangxi: 笑也, 微笑); to look pleased; _(2)ch(')an si(u/)(3)_ (can2 siu3 哂笑) to smile; _(2)ch(')an n(a/)p(9)_ (can2 naap6 哂納) to smile on receiving. 【哂】 (syinX) (_verb-like_) to smile (at)

U+755B zan1 (per 《廣韻》職鄰切) zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 畛) 田間水道 (Page 18|n61 #8: (2)畛) ~~To~~ Roads that divide fields (Kangxi: 井田閒陌也); to come before the gods and pray unto them (Kangxi: 致也); to announce ~~the emperor's coming~~ (Kangxi: 吿也); to ~~die~~ exterminate (Kangxi: 殄也, 謂殄絕); a motive; _(4)kw(')ai (2)ch(')an_ (kwai4 can2 畦畛), dikes between fields. 【畛】 (tsyinX, tsyin) (_noun-like_) interfield-path, (_met._) demarcation (_verb-like_) to announce (unto)

U+75A2 疹 can3 (per 《廣韻》丑刃切) (F1.82 疢) 熱病 (Page 18|n61 #6: (2)疹(2)疢) Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𤍠 to 熱. Williams incorrectly considers 疢 as an alternative form of 疹 when it is actually the other way round. An entry for 疢 (not 疹) is here supplemented. Fever (Kangxi 疢: 熱病也). Sickness (Kangxi 疢: 疢猶病也). 【疢】 (trhinH) (_noun-like_) fever, sickness

U+75B9 胗 zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 疹) 豆疹 (Page 18|n61 #6: (2)疹~~(2)疢~~) Pustules of any kind (Kangxi 疹: 疹診也有結氣可得診見也); eruptions, pimples (Kangxi 疹: 癮疹皮外小起也); a cutaneous disease; sore lips (Kangxi 疹: 脣瘍也); _tau(6) (2)ch(')an_ (dau6 can2 痘疹) small pox pustules; _(1)p(a/)n (2)ch(')an_ (baan1 can2 斑疹), eruptions.

U+77E7 矤 訠 (F1.82 矧) 况也 (Page 18|n61 #5: (2)矧) To stretch; still more, how much more (Kangxi: 况也); ~~to grin wide;~~ _(2)ch(')an ~~(ut(8)~~ (ut(9)_ (can2 jyut6 矧曰) to say further. Williams' "to grin wide": This is a misreading of Kangxi's example 笑不至矧, in which 矧 means "tooth-base", not "grin wide". Moreover, this sense should be read _(4)ngan_ (ngan4) as it is an alternative form of 齗. Williams' 矧曰: Corrected _(ut(8)_ (jyut3) to _(ut(9)_ (jyut6). 【矧】 (syinX) (_conjunction-like_) moreover, let alone

U+7D3E zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 紾) 縳也繩以縳之也 (Page 18|n61 #9: (2)紾) To bind with cords; to turn, to twist (Kangxi: 轉也); to revolve; a revolution; perverse, crabbed (Kangxi: 戾也). 【紾】 (tsyinX, trjenX) (_verb-like_) to twist

U+7E1D May appear as either ⿰糹眞 or ⿰糹真 (assumed here), depending on the font. 缜 (Mainland simplified) zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 縝) 結也縷也 (Page 18|n61 #13: (2)縝) Filaments from a coccoon (Kangxi: 縝緻也); a thread (Kangxi: 縝纑縷也); to tie (Kangxi: 結也單也); black (Kangxi: 縝黑也); _(4)shui (2)ch(')an pat(7) p(i/)n(3)_ (seoi4 can2 bat1 bin3 誰縝不變) whose black hair will not change?

U+8897 振 裖 zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 袗) 單也衣服也盛服也又畫也 (Page 18|n61 #10: (2)袗) Single thin garments (Kangxi: 單也), black silk worn in summer (Kangxi: 玄服); embroidered garments (Kangxi: 畫衣); _(2)ch(')an (1)h(i/) kwik(7)_ (can2 hei1 gwik1 袗絺綌) single grasscloth. 【袗】 (tsyinX, tsyinH) (_noun-like_) unlined-garment

U+8A3A 胗 诊 (Mainland simplified) zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 診) 視也騐也又診脉 (Page 18|n61 #11: (2)診) To examine, to look at (Kangxi: 視也); to try, to verify (Kangxi: 驗也); _(2)ch(')an mung(6)_ (can2 mung6 診夢) to interpret a dream; _(2)ch(')an mak(9)_ (can2 mak6 診脈) to feel the pulse. 【診】 (tsyinX, drinH) (_verb-like_) to examine

U+8EEB 轸 (Mainland simplified) zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 軫) 車橫木所以斂載也又宿名 (Page 18|n61 #12: (2)軫) The boards of a carriage (Kangxi: 車後橫木也); the cross board; to move (Kangxi: 轉也動也); a carriage; cramped, disturbed, distressed (Kangxi: 軫懷痛念也); the last of the 28 constellations (Kangxi: 宿名), _β_, _δ_, _η_, _γ_, in Corvus; pegs of a lute (Kangxi: 琴下轉絃者謂之軫); _~~(1)h(u~~ (1)(u (2)ch(')an_ (jyu1 can2 紆軫), crooked, winding. Williams' "boards of a carriage": Strictly speaking, 橫木 does not specifically refer to boards, only to "horizontal timber". Williams' 紆軫: Corrected _(1)h(u_ (heoi1) to _(1)(u_ (jyu1).

U+9B12 May appear as either ⿱髟眞 or ⿱髟真 (assumed here), depending on the font. 㐱 zan2 (per 《廣韻》章忍切) (F1.82 鬒) 髮之黑也 (Page 18|n61 #14: (2)鬒) Bushy, black hair (Kangxi: 稠髮也, 黑髮也); a fine head of black hair. 【鬒】 (tsyinX) (_noun-like_) bushy-hair, black-hair

can3.text: U+6AEC 榇 (Mainland simplified) (F1.85 櫬) 棺櫬 (Page 19|n62 #1: 櫬(3)) A coffin (Kangxi: 棺也); to collect firewood (Kangxi: 櫬采薪); _(1)k(u/)n ch(')an(3)_ (gun1 can3 棺櫬) a coffin; _(1)k(u/)n ch(')an(3) uk(7)_ (gun1 can3 uk1 棺櫬屋) a sort of dead house or shed at a grave. Hibiscus flowers (Kangxi: 櫬木槿, 今王蒸). The Chinese parasol tree (Kangxi: 櫬梧, 今梧桐).

U+896F 衬 (Mainland simplified) can3-2 (rising second in vernacular 襯襯地) (F1.85 襯) 貼身衣也又襯貼 (Page 18|n61 #15: 襯(3)) Inner garments (Kangxi: 近身衣也); to help, to assist; to patronize; to befriend; to give (Kangxi: 施與亦曰襯); to give effect to, to show off; to match; _ch(')an(3) (1)kan_ (can3 gan1 襯巾), a sash; _ch(')an(3) (1)sh(a/)m_ (can3 saam1 襯衫), inner skirts; _(1)pong ch(')an(3)_ (bong1 can3 幫襯) to give custom to; _ch(')an(3) ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u_ (can3 zyu6 keoi5 襯住佢), to fellowship; _ch(')an(3) (2)ch(i/)_ (can3 zi2 襯紙), a flyleaf in books; _ch(')an(3) t(')(i/)p(8)_ (can3 tip3-2 襯貼) plaits on a petticoat. 【幫襯】 (bong1 can3) To patronise (be a customer of a business). 【襯】 (can3) To match, to suit. 佢哋幾襯吖 (keoi5 dei6 gei2 can3 a1): "They do quite match each other." 撞色唔襯 (zong6 sik1 m4 can3): "The colours clash and don't suit." 【老襯】 (lou5 can3) A gullible person. 做老襯 (zou6 lou5 can3): "Be a mug." 搵老襯 (wan2 lou5 can3): "Find a sucker of someone" (i.e. trick a gullible person).

U+8D81 趂 (F1.85 趂) 及時也逐也從也 (Page 19|n62 #3: 趁(3)趂(3)) To follow, to come up behind, to walk after (Kangxi 趁: 𧾍也, 自後及之也, 逐也); to avail, to take; to embrace an opportunity; at the time of; _ch(')an(3) (1)h(u (2)t(a/) (5)sh(i/)_ (can3 heoi1 daa2 si5 趁墟打市), to go to market; _ch(')an(3) (4)sh(i/) hau(6)_ (can3 si4 hau6 趁時候) to improve the time; _ch(')an(3) (1)k(i/) (u/)i(6)_ (can3 gei1 wui6 趁機會) take advantage of the opportunity; _ch(')an(3) (1)fung (2)shai (5)l(i/)_ (can3 fung1 sai2 lei5 趁風駛𢃇), hoist sail when there's a wind; _ch(')an(3) (un(6)_ (can3 jyun6 趁願) as I wished it; _ch(')an(3) shai(3)_ (can3 sai3 趁勢) avail of a favorable time. Williams' "improve": In the (now) dated sense of employing to good purpose.
U+8D82 (F1.85 趂) 及時也逐也從也 (Page 19|n62 #3: 趁(3)趂(3))
U+9F54 齓 龀 (Mainland simplified) (Page 19|n62 #2: 齔(3)) To shed the milk teeth, as children do (Kangxi: 毀齒也 etc.); shedding or renewing the teeth.

can4.text: U+5875 尘 (F1.82 塵) 塵上塵埃 (Page 18|n61 #4: (4)塵) Dust, small particles (Kangxi: 埃也); effluvia, atoms, molecules; the world; worldly vice and pleasures; confused times; _(4)ch(')an (4)t(')au t(a/)i(6)_ (can4 tau4 daai6 塵頭大) a cloud of dust; _(2)sai (4)ch(')an_ (sai2 can4 洗塵), to wash down the dust, to give a feast to friends come back; _p(o\)(6) hau(6) (4)ch(')an_ (bou6 hau6 can4 步後塵), to follow another's example; _(4)ch(')an (1)oi_ (can4 oi1 塵埃), dust; _(4)ch(')an ~~(2)kau~~ kau(3)_ (can4 gau3 塵垢), covered with dust; _(1)fung (4)ch(')an_ (fung1 can4 風塵), dusty from travel; _(4)m(o\) yat(7) (2)t(i/)m (4)ch(')an_ (mou4 jat1 dim2 can4 無一點塵), clean; _(4)ch(')an tsuk(9)_ (can4 zuk6 塵俗), _(4)ch(')an shai(3)_ (can4 sai3 塵世), or _(4)hung (4)ch(')an_ (hung4 can4 紅塵), the dusty world; _fat(7) (4)ch(')an_ (fat1 can4 拂塵), to dust. Williams' "confused times": Especially warfare. Williams' 塵垢: Changed _(2)kau_ (gau2) to common reading _kau(3)_ (gau3). 【塵】 (drin) (_noun-like_) dust 【沙塵】 (saa1 can4) Arrogant or cocky. 咁沙塵 (gam3 saa1 can4): "So arrogant of him." There is also the extended version 沙塵白霍, but that leads into a rabbit hole of debate about the origins of the phrase, and whether 塵 should be spelt 陳, and whether 霍 should be spelt 攉 or 醭.
U+852F (Page 18|n61 #3: (4)蔯) A medicinal herb (Kangxi: 茵蔯也), good for rheumatism; _(1)yan (4)ch(')an_ (jan1 can4 茵蔯), a plant like origanum.

U+9673 敶 陈 (Mainland simplified) can4-2 (vernacular rising-tone for endearment) (F1.82 陳) 列也張也敷也告也又姓 (Page 18|n61 #2: (4)陳) To arrange, to set in order, to spread out (Kangxi: 列也布也); to say, to reply; to state, to express; to memorialize; a long time, an old thing (Kangxi: 故也, 久也); many, all (Kangxi: 衆也); a feudal state (Kangxi: 國名) near the present capital of Hon(a/)n (河南); _tsoi(6) (4)ch(')an ~~ts(')(ut(9)~~ ts(ut(9) (4)l(e/)ung_ (zoi6 can4 zyut6 loeng4 在陳絕糧), to lack food in Ch(')in---to be in straits; _(1)p(')(o\) (4)ch(')an_ (pou1 can4 鋪陳), to seat or rank in order; _(4)ch(')an ch(')(i/)t(8)_ (can4 cit3 陳設) to arrange in order; _(5)sh(e/)ung (2)pi(u/) (4)ch(')an (4)ts(')ing_ (soeng5 biu2 can4 cing4 上表陳情), to state one's thoughts to H. I. M.; _(4)ch(')an (4)p(')(i/) k(o\)m(3) kau(6)_ (can4 pei4 gam3 gau6 陳皮咁舊) old as a dried orange skin, faded. Williams' 在陳絕糧: Corrected _ts(')(ut(9)_ (cyut6) to _ts(ut(9)_ (zyut6). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【陳】 (drin) (_verb-like_) to arrange, to display (_verb-like_) to describe (_adjective-like_) aged

cang4.text: U+5C64 曾 层 (Mainland simplified) (F2.31 層) 重叠也 (Page 557 #3: (4)層) A story of a house; a layer, a strata, a tier, a stage; a lamina, a plate, or whatever is piled or laid on; still more, added to; a step, a degree above (Kangxi: 級也); a classifier of stories; _(1)k(o\) (5)k(')(u yat(7) (4)ts(')ang_ (gou1 keoi5 jat1 cang4 高佢一層), one peg higher than it; _(4)m(o\) (4)ts(')ang_ (mou4 cang4 無層), no progress, it can't be done; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (4)ts(')ang (2)ch(i/)_ (cin1 cang4 zi2 千層紙), foliated mica; _(5)sh(e/)ung tai(6) (1)s(a/)m (4)ts(')ang_ (soeng5 dai6 saam1 cang4 上第三層), go up to the third story; _~~chung(6)~~ (5)ch(')ung yat(7) (4)ts(')ang_ (cung5 jat1 cang4 重一層), one degree heavier; _(5)yau (4)ts(')ang (5)yau ts(')z'(3)_ (jau5 cang4 jau5 ci3 有層有次) there are proper gradations. Williams' 重一層: Corrected _chung(6)_ (zung6 去聲) to _(5)ch(')ung_ (cung5 上聲). A multi-storey house (Kangxi: 重屋也). Multi-layered (Kangxi: 凡物之重者通曰層). 【層】 (dzong) (_noun-like_) storey
