U+66FE May appear with top component 丷 (assumed here) or 八, depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 曾 as a component. 曽 (F2.31 曾) 嘗也又不料之詞又反詞 (Page 557 #2: (4)曾) An adverb of time; past, already, done (Kangxi: 經也, 嘗也); how? a sign of past time; _(4)'m (4)ts(')ang_ (m4 cang4 唔曾) or _m(i/)(6) (4)ts(')ang_ (mei6 cang4 未曾), not yet; often a polite way of saying no; _(5)y(a/) (4)ts(')ang ts(o\)(6) kwo(3)_ (jaa5 cang4 zou6 gwo3 也曾做過) it is already done; _(4)ho (4)ts(')ang_ (ho4 cang4 何曾), when ~~will it be~~ was it? _(4)ts(')ang k(i/)n(3)_ (cang4 gin3 曾見) I have seen it; _ts(o\)(6) (4)'m (4)ts(')ang_ (zou6 m4 cang4 做唔曾), is it done yet? Williams' "how?": This appears to be an attempt at rendering the very vague and unhelpful 《說文》詞之舒也. Note that Kangxi has this sense under 昨稜切 _(4)ts(')ang_ (cang4), and includes such examples as 《論語》曾是以爲孝乎 that other sources would instead put under the reading _(1)tsang_ (zang1). For example, 萌典 puts the "astonishingly" sense (乃、竟然) under zeng with the example ...曾是以為孝乎. Williams' 唔曾: Dated. Astonishingly. 【曾-voiced】 (dzong) (_adverb-like_) once, ever (_adverb-like_) astonishingly, (_met._) and yet, dare

zang1.text: U+66FE May appear with top component 丷 (assumed here) or 八, depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 曾 as a component. 曽 (F2.29 曾) 則也乃也又曾祖曾孫 (Page 556 #5: (1)曾) To duplicate (Kangxi: 曾猶重也), (...); _(1)tsang (1)s(un_ (zang1 syun1 曾孫), a great-grandson; _(1)tsang (2)ts(o\) (5)m(o\)_ (zang1 zou2 mou5 曾祖母), a great-grandmother; _(1)tsang (2)ts(o\)_ (zang1 zou2 曾祖), a great-grandfather. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【曾-unvoiced】 (tsong) (_adjective-like_) great-

cap1.text: U+54A0 緝 zap1 (alternative per 《廣韻》子入切) To whisper in the ear (Kangxi: 聶語也, 咠咠口舌聲也, 咠咠譖言也). 【咠】 (tship, tsip) (_verb-like_) to whisper

U+6222 zap1 (per 《廣韻》阻立切) (F2.39 戢) 安集也止也歛也藏也 (Page 557 #5: 戢(7)) To collect in an arsenal, to store up weapons (Kangxi: 藏兵也); to gather (Kangxi: 斂也); to desist from (Kangxi: 止也), to lay aside, as arms; to fold, as wings; _(4)ts(')ai ts(')ap(7) ts(')ap(7)_ (cai4 cap1 cap1 齊戢戢) to cut off evenly; _(2)ch(')(a/)i ts(')ap(7) t(o\)(3) shat(9)_ (caai2 cap1 dou3 sat6 踹戢到實) tread it, press it down very solid; _~~(2)tsoi~~ tsoi(3) ts(')ap(7) (1)kon (1)kwo_ (zoi3 cap1 gon1 gwo1 載戢干戈), to lay by shields and spears. Williams' 載戢干戈: Corrected _(2)tsoi_ (zoi2 上聲) to _tsoi(3)_ (zoi3 去聲). 【戢】 (tsrip) (_verb-like_) to store (up), to gather (in), (_met._) to restrain, to check 【齊戢戢】 (cai4 cap1 cap1) Neat and even (not jagged).

U+6FC8 zap1 (per 《廣韻》阻立切) (F2.39 濈) 口舌聲 (Page 557 #6: 濈(7)) Water rapidly flowing out (Kangxi: 濈水行出也); rapid (Kangxi: 疾貌); cordial, harmonious, agreeing (Kangxi: 和也); to accord with. 【濈】 (tsrip) (_adjective-like_) huddled, accordant

U+7DDD 缉 (Mainland simplified) (F2.39 緝) 繼續也續也 (Page 557 #7: 緝(7)) To twist a cord (Kangxi: 績也); to join, to continue (Kangxi: 續也); to come after, to follow, to succeed; to pursue, to follow after, to be on the search for; to apprehend; _ts(')ap(7) wok(9)_ (cap1 wok6 緝獲) to pursue and seize; _ts(')ap(7) (1)sz'_ (cap1 si1 緝私) to watch smugglers; _ts(')ap(7) (1)sz' (4)sh(un_ (cap1 si1 syun4 緝私船), revenue cutters; _ts(')ap(7) ch(e/)uk(9)_ (cap1 zoek6 緝着) caught him; _(4)ch(')(a/) ts(')ap(7)_ (caa4 cap1 查緝) on the search; _(4)ts(')un ts(')ap(7)_ (ceon4 cap1 巡緝) to get on the trail. 【緝】 (tship) (_verb-like_) to spin (thread), to hem (_verb-like_) to continue Used in 緝熙. 【緝熙】 (tship xi) (_adjective-like_) brilliant

U+847A zap1 (per 《廣韻》子入切 for spinous-grass sense and Kangxi 子入切 for "piled" sense) (F2.39 葺) 修補也 (Page 558 #2: 葺(7)) To put in order, to repair (Kangxi: 修補也); to cover, to thatch (Kangxi: 覆也, 苫也); a spinous grass (Kangxi: 茨也); _(1)sau ts(')ap(7)_ (sau1 cap1 修葺) to refit, as a house; _ts(')ap(7) (2)p(o\)_ (cap1 bou2 葺補), to repair. Piled, stacked (Kangxi: 累也).

U+8F2F 辑 (Mainland simplified) zap6 (per 《廣韻》秦入切) (F2.39 輯) 斂也聚也集也 (Page 558 #1: 輯(7)) To collect the materials to form a chariot, a car well arranged (Kangxi: 車和輯也 etc.); union, concord, agreement (Kangxi: 和也, 睦也); to make every thing agreeable, put in its proper place; to compile; to act gently and cordially (Kangxi: 顏色和柔亦曰輯); to collect, to congregate (Kangxi: 斂也); _(4)wo ts(')ap(7)_ (wo4 cap1 和輯) in good accord, to pacify; _(4)ning ts(')ap(7)_ (ning4 cap1 寧輯) peaceful; _(1)sau ts(')ap(7) (4)lun (1)pong_ (sau1 cap1 leon4 bong1 修輯鄰邦), to induce the neighboring states to be at peace. Classifier for parts, volumes, etc. of published works. 【輯】 (dzip) (_adjective-like_) concordant (_verb-like_) to gather (up) (_verb-like_) to compile

cat1.text: U+4E03 柒 (anti-alteration) (F1.86 七) 數名 (F1.86 㭍) 同上 (Page 559 #7: 七(7)柒(7)) Seven; _ts(')at(7) shap(9)_ (cat1 sap6 七十) seventy; _shap(9) ts(')at(7)_ (sap6 cat1 十七) seventeen; _ts(')at(7) (4)ling p(a/)t(8) lok(9)_ (cat1 ling4 baat3 lok6 七零八落) near destruction, devastated, almost ruined; _ts(')at(7) (4)ts(')ang (1)kung (1)f(u/)_ (cat1 cang4 gung1 fu1 七層功夫), a work nearly done; _ts(')at(7) tsik(9)_ (cat1 zik6 七夕) 7th evening of the 7th month, a festival; _ts(')at(7) ts(ut(9)_ (cat1 zyut6 七絕) a pentameter of four lines; _ts(')at(7) ~~lut(7)~~ lut(9)_ (cat1 leot6 七律) one of eight lines; _yat(7) yat(7) ts(')at(7)_ (jat1 jat1 cat1 一一七) I don't think much of that, so so; _ts(o\)(6) ts(')at(7)_ (zou6 cat1 做七) to attend to the funereal rites on every seventh day; _tsok(8) ts(')at(7) (1)p(')(i/)n_ (zok3 cat1 pin1 作七編), to write seven essays. The second (柒) is used for the compound form (...). Williams' 七絕: While each seven-character line can be though of as being in pentameter, the Chinese view does not have a notion of stressed vs unstressed syllables; rather, the phrasing of the line is viewed as a four-character run followed by a three-character run. Williams' 七律: Corrected _lut(7)_ (leot1) to _lut(9)_ (leot6). 【七】 (tshit) (_noun-like_) seven (_verb-like_) to sevenfold
U+67D2 (F1.86 七) 數名 (F1.86 㭍) 同上 (Page 559 #7: 七(7)柒(7)) The second (柒) (...) is also a sort of tree (Kangxi 柒: 木名) (...).

U+6F06 柒 桼 (F1.86 漆) 木之滓也可以漆物 (Page 559 #7: 七(7)柒(7)) The second (柒) (...) is also (...) a contracted form of the next (漆) (Kangxi 柒: 俗漆字). (Page 559 #8: ~~？~~漆(7)) Varnish, lacquer; viscid or resinous juices which can be used in painting (Kangxi 漆: 木汁可髤物); to paint, to varnish; black, as lacquer (Kangxi 漆: 物之黑者曰漆); adhesive; exceedingly friendly, doating on; _(4)yau ts(')at(7)_ (jau4 cat1 油漆) to paint and varnish; _(4)yau ts(')at(7) (2)l(o\)_ (jau4 cat1 lou2 油漆佬), a house-painter; _ts(')at(7) shik(9)_ (cat1 sik6 漆蝕) poisoned with lacquer; _ts(')at(7) h(i/)(3)_ (cat1 hei3 漆器) lacquered-ware; _(2)fo ts(')at(7)_ (fo2 cat1 火漆) sealing-wax; _(2)fo ts(')at(7) p(')(i/)n(3)_ (fo2 cat1 pin3 火漆片) wafers; _(2)h(o\) ts(')at(7) (2)shui_ (hou2 cat1 seoi2 好漆水), lustrous varnish; _ts(')at(7) (1)tsing_ (cat1 zing1 漆精), fine varnish; _(4)ts(')ing (4)(u (1)k(a/)u ts(')at(7)_ (cing4 jyu4 gaau1 cat1 情如膠漆) his disposition is very affectionate; _(1)kam ts(')at(7)_ (gam1 cat1 金漆) gilt lacquer; _yap(9) ts(')at(7)_ (jap6 cat1 入漆) been varnished; _ts(')at(7) sh(u(6)_ (cat1 syu6 漆樹) the varnish tree. 【漆】 (tshit) (_noun-like_) varnish-tree, varnish

cat6.text: U+28CCD 𫵱 (Cantonese) 【𨳍】 (cat6) (_vulgar_) A flaccid penis. **One of the five profanities censored on Hong Kong television.** A literal translation would be "droop-dick". For non-literal senses, see the Wiktionary entry for 𨳍. The spelling 𨳍 is arbitrary. Suprisingly, the alternative form 𫵱 is recorded in Eitel (1877) under _ts(')at(9)_ (cat6); the entry simply reads "_Vulgar._ the penis".

ciu3.text: U+5062 (Page 562 #6: (1)偢 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1); here corrected to _Ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (ciu3)) Malevolent (Kangxi: 傻偢不仁); ill-natured;

cau1.text: U+59AF cau4 (alternative per 《集韻》陳留切 for "moved" sense) dik6 (alternative per 《集韻》亭歴切 for "moved" and "unsettled" senses) duk6 (alternative per 《集韻》徒沃切 for "moved" sense) luk6 (alternative per 《集韻》盧谷切 for "moved" sense) The heart moved (Kangxi: 心動也). Moved (Kangxi: 動也). Unsettled (Kangxi: 人不靜曰妯 etc.). 【妯】 (trhjuw) (_verb-like_) to move

zuk6.text: U+59AF suk6 (per Fan Wan) (F1.66 妯 _Shuk(9)_ (suk6)) 妯娌嬸姆曰妯娌 (Page 35* #14: 妯(9)) Two sisters-in-law call each other _chuk(9) (5)l(i/)_ (zuk6 lei5 妯娌) (Kangxi: 兄弟之妻相呼曰妯娌)_;_ ~~also called _chau(3) (5)l(i/)_ (zau3 lei5) in Canton.~~ Fan Wan entry: Corrected 口 to 曰. Williams' "also called ...": I suspect _chau(3)_ (zau3) is a typo for _chau(6)_ (zau6), which would be a misreading based on analogy with 袖.

ciu2.text: U+6100 cau1 (alternative per 《集韻》雌由切) cau5 (alternative per 《廣韻》在九切) (F1.50 愀 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1)) 色變也 (Page 562 #9: (1)愁 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1); here corrected to 愀 and normalised to _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2)) ~~To blush, to redden,~~ to change ~~color~~ the countenance (Kangxi 愀: 容色變也); 【愀】 (tshjewX, dzjuwX) (_verb-like_) to change countenance

cau1.text: U+62BD 𢭆 㨨 㩅 (F1.50 抽) 收也援引也 (Page 26|n69 #10: (1)抽) To take from, to take out (Kangxi: 拔也除也); to take a dividend; to expand, as spring does; to lift; to levy, to assess, as duty; ~~to select,~~ to draw out (Kangxi: 引也); to utter aloud (Kangxi: 讀也); to whip; to receive one's portion (Kangxi: 收也); to raise water; a tenth, a tithe; _(1)ch(')au (2)shui_ (cau1 seoi2 抽水), to take the fee at gaming; _(1)ch(')au (1)kan_ (cau1 gan1 抽筋), spasms of the tendons; _(1)ch(')au (2)h(i/)_ (cau1 hei2 抽起), lift it out; _(1)ch(')au ch(')ing(3) (5)k(')(u (4)lai_ (cau1 cing3 keoi5 lai4 抽秤佢嚟), bring him along; _(2)t(a/) (1)ch(')au (1)fung_ (daa2 cau1 fung1 打抽風), to beg aid; _(2)p(i/) (1)p(i/)n (1)ch(')au (5)k(')(u_ (bei2 bin1 cau1 keoi5 畀鞭抽佢), drive him off with a whip; _(1)ch(')au (5)k(')(u (5)l(e/)ung (5)h(a/)_ (cau1 keoi5 loeng5 haa5 抽佢兩吓), whipped him twice; _(1)ch(')au (1)shau_ (cau1 sau1 抽收), to levy duty on; _(1)ch(')au (1)shan pat(7) h(a/)(6)_ (cau1 san1 bat1 haa6 抽身不暇) no leisure at all; _(1)ch(')au shat(9)_ (cau1 sat6 抽實) lift it up firmly; _(1)ch(')au ~~mok(9)~~ mok(7)_ (cau1 mok1 抽剝) to extort, to exact a high fee; _(1)ch(')au (4)ch(')au_ (cau1 cau4 抽籌), or _(1)ch(')au (4)t(')au_ (cau1 tau4 抽頭), to divide winnings; _(1)ch(')au (4)h(a/)n_ (cau1 haan4 抽閒), to take a leisure hour; _(1)ch(')au (1)fan_ (cau1 fan1 抽分), to take a commission, to reserve a part; _(1)k(a/) yat(7) (1)ch(')au_ (gaa1 jat1 cau1 加一抽), take a tenth. Williams' 抽筋: Medically, these are skeletal muscle contractions (i.e. cramps). Williams' 抽剝: Corrected _mok(9)_ (mok6) to _mok(7)_ (mok1). 【抽】 (trhjuw) (_verb-like_) to pull out 【抽】 (cau1) Classifier for things in a bunch that will fall together when carried by holding the top (or a handle or similar at the top). 大抽鎖匙 (daai6 cau1 so2 si4): "Big bunch of keys." To fight. (See 隻抽.) (_Chinese chess_) To win a piece with check, either by skewering, forking, or discovery. 將軍抽車 (zoeng1 gwan1 cau1 geoi1): "Check, skewering a chariot." 抽炮 (cau1 paau3): "Check, winning a cannon." 【抽氣扇】 (cau1 hei3 sin3) A ventilating fan. 【一抽二褦】 (jat1 cau1 ji6 nang3) Many bags or much baggage to be carried. (Literally, "one carried-bunch and two linked-bunches".) 【老抽】 (lou5 cau1) Old soy sauce (dark coloured but less salty). 【生抽】 (saang1 cau1) Young soy sauce (light coloured but more salty). 【隻抽】 (zek3 cau1) To fight one-on-one.
U+63AB (Page 560 #9: (1)掫 _(1)Tsau_ (zau1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')au_ (cau1)) to seize, to take with the hand (Kangxi: 手取物也);

zau1.text: U+63AB (F1.50 掫) 擊也守夜擊刀斗之類 (Page 560 #9: (1)掫) To strike the rounds at night, to pace the beat at night (Kangxi: 夜戒守有所擊也); _(2)kan (1)tsau (1)tsau_ (gan2 zau1 zau1 緊掫掫), tie it up very tight,---a colloquial phrase.

U+63EA 揫 cau1 (per Fan Wan) (Page 562 #7: (1)揫(1)揪 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1); here normalised to _(1)Tsau_ (zau1)) To bind, to gather in sheaves (Kangxi 揫: 束也, 斂也); to compress in binding; to collect, to assemble (Kangxi 揫: 聚也); to lift, to grasp, to clutch; to gripe; _~~(1)ts(')au~~ (1)tsau ch(u(6)_ (zau1 zyu6 揪住) to seize fast; _~~(1)ts(')au~~ (1)tsau (5)(i/)_ (zau1 ji5 揪耳), to nab by the ears; _~~(1)ts(')au~~ (1)tsau ch(')uk(7)_ (zau1 cuk1 揪束) to bind up, as a sheaf is. Modern dictionaries distinguish 揫 for the "bind" sense, and 揪 for the "grasp/clutch" sense. Kangxi considers 揪 to be the same as 揫, and their separation to be erroneous: 按揪揫同字分音各訓誤. 【揪】 (zau1) To catch or capture. 畀差佬揪 (bei2 caai1 lou2 zau1): "Caught by a copper."
U+63EB

cau1.text: U+6978 (F1.50 楸) 木名 (Page 562 #8: (1)楸) A strong wood; the tree is like a yew or cypress; _(1)ts(')au (4)p(')ing_ (cau1 ping4 楸枰), a chess-board (Kangxi: 棊局也). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 本 to 木. Williams' 楸枰: Specifically, a surrounding-chess (go) board.

U+6E6B (F1.50 湫) 水名 (Page 562 #10: (1)湫) A pond, a fish-pond, a pool (Kangxi: 北人呼水池爲湫); Kangxi has the "pool" sense under 卽由切 or 將由切 _(1)tsau_ (zau1), but 《廣韻》 has 七由切 _(1)ts(')au_ (cau1), explained 水池名北人呼.

zau1.text: U+6E6B cau1 (per Fan Wan) (F1.50 湫 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1)) 水名 (Page 562 #10: (1)湫 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1); here normalised to _(1)Tsau_ (zau1)) a small tributary of the Yellow R. near Lin hien (臨縣) in Sh(a/)ns(i/) (山西); cool (Kangxi: 涼貌); mournful (Kangxi: 憂愁貌), to excite sad feelings.

ziu2.text: U+6E6B Narrow (Kangxi: 湫隘也). Low-lying (Kangxi: 湫下也).

cau1.text: U+714D cau5 (per 《玉篇》慈糾切) ziu2 (per 《玉篇》子了切) (Page 563 #1: (1)煍) To change the color of (Kangxi: 變色也); to colly, to blacken, as with smoke; _(2)fo (4)t(')(a/)m (1)ts(')au_ (fo2 taam4 cau1 火燂煍), the fire blackens it; _(1)ts(')au ~~h(a/)k(7)~~ hak(7)_ (cau1 hak1 煍黑) smoked and blackened. Williams' : Changed _h(a/)k(7)_ (haak1) to _hak(7)_ (hak1).

U+7633 (F1.50 瘳) 病好曰瘳 (Page 26|n69 #12: (1)瘳) Convalescent (Kangxi: 疾病瘉也); curable; to cure; _k(')(ut(8) tsat(9) pat(7) (1)ch(')au_ (kyut3 zat6 bat1 cau1 厥疾不瘳), his disease was incurable. Williams' 厥疾不瘳: 《書經》 has 厥疾弗瘳. To diminish, to damage (Kangxi: 損也). 【瘳】 (trhjuw) (_verb-like_) to recuperate

U+7785 偢 cau2 (possibly from Mandarin-matching) (Page 562 #6: (1)偢; here normalised to 瞅) _(4)'m (1)ts(')au (2)ts(')oi_ (m4 cau1 coi2 唔瞅睬), not to speak to, the cut direct. The character 瞅 is not attested in the Middle Chinese rime books, nor is it recorded in Kangxi. Modern Cantonese dictionaries typically record a reading of cau2 (rising tone), which I wager is from analogy with the Mandarin reading chou. And yet: The variant form 偢 appears under the Kangxi entry for 睬, with the explicit reading _(1)ts(')au_ (cau1) in level tone: 《康熙字典》睬 《字彙補》此宰切音彩偢睬俗言也詞家多用此字偢音秋 The common Cantonese reading is cau1, consistent with Williams, and as sung by Alan Tam in 誰可改變 (1984) (containing the phrase 不瞅不睬).

U+79CB 秌 龝 (F1.50 秋) 四季之一 (F1.50 龝) 同上 (Page 562 #5: (1)秋) Autumn (Kangxi: 金行之時); harvest, the time of reaping; the return of the year, a year; autumnal; sorrowful, unhappy (Kangxi: 西方者秋秋愁也 etc.); _mak(9) (1)ts(')au_ (mak6 cau1 麥秋), wheat harvest; _(1)ts(')au (1)fan_ (cau1 fan1 秋分), autumnal equinox; _(1)ch(a/)ng (1)ts(')au (i/)t(9)_ (zaang1 cau1 jit6 爭秋熱) heat of dog-days; _(1)ts(')au (1)t(')(i/)n_ (cau1 tin1 秋天) autumn; _(1)ts(')au (4)h(o\) (4)m(o\) f(a/)n(6)_ (cau1 hou4 mou4 faan6 秋毫無犯) not the error of an autumn's down; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (1)ts(')au_ (cin1 cau1 千秋), a thousand autumns --- a birthday; _(1)ts(')au (1)k(u/)n_ (cau1 gun1 秋官), a judge, because cases are decided in autumn; _(1)ts(')au (1)shau_ (cau1 sau1 秋收), harvest; _(1)ts(')au hau(6) sh(i/)n(3)_ (cau1 hau6 sin3 秋後扇) a fan in winter --- a useless thing; _(1)ts(')au h(i/)(3)_ (cau1 hei3 秋氣) cool autumnal weather. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 土 to 上. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【秋】 (tshjuw) (_noun-like_) autumn
U+7BD8 醔 (F1.50 篘) 酒篘 (Page 26|n69 #11: (1)篘) A strainer made of wicker or bamboo for straining spirits (Kangxi: 酒籠漉取酒也).

U+7D2C 䌷 (Mainland simplified) (Page 27|n70 #7: (4)紬 _(4)Ch(')au_ (cau4); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')au_ (cau1)) to draw out threads for weaving (Kangxi: 紬抽也); to arrange the details of a subject, to search for first causes (Kangxi: 紬繹者引其端緒也);

cau4.text: U+7D2C (F1.52 綢) 綢緞又密也纏也 (F1.52 紬) 同上 (Page 27|n70 #7: (4)紬)

cau1.text: U+97A6 秋 (F1.50 鞦) 馬靷又鞦韆 (Page 563 #3: (1)鞦) The traces of a carriage (Kangxi: 車鞦也); _(1)ts(')au (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (cau1 cin1 鞦韆), a swing, a whirligig, a see-saw; _(2)t(a/) (1)ts(')au (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (daa2 cau1 cin1 打鞦韆), to swing. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 䩑 to 靷. In Cantonese, 韆鞦 (cin1 cau1) "thousand autumns" is preferred over 鞦韆 (cau1 cin1) "autumns thousand". See 韆鞦.
U+9C0C (F1.50 鰌) 與鰍同泥鰌又海鰌魚 (Page 563 #4: (1)鰌(1)鰍)

U+9C0D 鰌 鳅 (Mainland simplified) (F1.50 鰍) 魚名 (Page 563 #4: (1)鰌(1)鰍) An eel; the mud or conger eel (Kangxi 鰌: 鰼也); _(4)nai (1)ts(')au_ (nai4 cau1 泥鰍), a freshwater eel; _(2)hoi (1)ts(')au_ (hoi2 cau1 海鰍), a sea-dragon, myriads of miles long; a long, narrow boat; _(1)ts(')au (4)(u kwat(7)_ (cau1 jyu4 gwat1 鰍魚骨) whalebone. Williams' "eel": More a loach than an eel.

U+9D96 𪀖 鹙 (Mainland simplified) (F1.50 鶖) 秃鶖食魚之鳥 (Page 563 #5: (1)鶖) A long legged bird like an adjutant, having red eyes and bare neck (Kangxi: 水鳥也 etc.); it eats snakes. 【鶖】 (tshjuw) (_noun-like_) marabou

cau2.text: U+4E11 (F1.54 丑) 辰名 (Page 28|n71 #3: (2)丑) The second of the 12 horary signs; the 4th watch, from 1 to 3 A. M.; it is denoted by an ox, and persons born in this hour are likely to be dull. A clown, a fool character. 【丑】 (trhjuwX) (_noun-like_) ox-branch
U+8DA3 Horse master (Kangxi: 趣馬, 趣七口反掌馬之官). 【趣-rising】 (tshuwX) Used in 趣馬. 【趣馬】 (tshuwX maeX) (_noun-like_) horse master

ceoi3.text: U+8DA3 ceoi3-2 (rising second in vernacular 趣趣地) (F1.48 趣) 趣味趣致 (Page 596 #2: 趣(3)) Similar to _(1)ts(')(u_ (ceoi1) 趨 to run; to go, to advance quickly (Kangxi: 疾也); to see what is proper and agreeable, and hasten to do it; to show alacrity or haste to please (Kangxi: 遽也); to regard pleasurably; sprightly, playful, graceful; amusing, pleasing; _(4)'m shik(7) ts(')(u(3)_ (m4 sik1 ceoi3 唔識趣) unaccommodating, mulish; _tak(7) k(o\)m(3) ts(')(u(3)_ (dak1 gam3 ceoi3 得咁趣) very agreeable, humorous; _(2)h(o\) ts(')(u(3)_ (hou2 ceoi3 好趣) very lively, gleesome; _ts(')(u(3) m(i/)(6)_ (ceoi3 mei6 趣味) entertaining, as a friend; _ts(')(u(3) ts(')(u(3) tik(7)_ (ceoi3 ceoi3 dik1 趣趣滴) rather pleasing, novel; _ch(i/)(3) ts(')(u(3) hai(6) k(o\)m(3) ts(')(u(3) tik(7)_ (zi3 ceoi3 hai6 gam3 ceoi3 dik1 至趣係咁趣的) this is truly exhilirating, this is exquisite. 【趣-departing】 (tshjuH) (_verb-like_) to haste 【趣趣地】 (ceoi3 ceoi3-2 dei6-2) Used to indicate relative smallness or unimportance of a matter or a quantity. (Literally, "slightly interesting".)

cuk1.text: U+8DA3

cau2.text: U+919C 丑 (Mainland simplified) (F1.54 醜) 惡也不美也又醜類 (Page 28|n71 #4: (2)醜) Ugly, deformed, vile, ill looking (Kangxi: 貌惡也); disagreeable; disgraceful, shameful, ashamed (Kangxi: 羞也); to hate, to dislike (Kangxi: 惡之也); shamefaced; ashamed of; to compare (Kangxi: 比也); a group, a sort (Kangxi: 類也); _k(i/)n(3) (2)ch(')au pat(7) (4)(u (4)ts(')ong ch(ut(8)_ (gin3 cau2 bat1 jyu4 cong4 zyut3 見醜不如藏拙) to shame one is worse than keeping one's incapacity private; _~~ming(6)~~ meng(6) (2)ch(')au_ (meng6 cau2 命醜) an unhappy lot; _(2)ch(')au (4)'m (2)ch(')au_ (cau2 m4 cau2 醜唔醜), are you not ashamed? _(2)ch(')au m(a/)u(6)_ (cau2 maau6 醜貌) ill-looking, cross, unbeseeming; _pat(7) (1)ch(i/) (2)ch(')au_ (bat1 zi1 cau2 不知醜), brazenfaced; _k(i/)n(3) (2)ch(')au_ (gin3 cau2 見醜) ashamed for; _(2)ch(')au ok(8) (4)p(')(i/) h(i/)(3)_ (cau2 ok3 pei4 hei3 醜惡脾氣) vile disposition, an ingrate; _(2)ch(')au lui(6)_ (cau2 leoi6 醜類) a vile set; _(2)ch(')au lau(6)_ (cau2 lau6 醜陋) unworthy of him, disgraceful, wicked; _p(')(a/)(3) (2)ch(')au_ (paa3 cau2 怕醜), bashful; _(2)ch(')au y(e/)ung(6)_ (cau2 joeng6-2 醜樣) bad looking; _(2)ch(')au sz'(6)_ (cau2 si6 醜事) a disgraceful affair. Willliams' 命醜: Changed _ming(6)_ (ming6) to vernacular reading _meng(6)_ (meng6). 【醜】 (tsyhuwX) (_adjective-like_) ugly (_verb-like_) to abhor (_noun-like_) humiliation (_noun-like_) sort, (_met._) peers 【醜樣】 (cau2 joeng6-2) Ugly. 【怕醜】 (paa3 cau2) Shy or bashful.

cau3.text: U+55C5 㗜 臭 齅 hung3 (per 《集韻》香仲切) (F1.55 嗅) 鳥哀鳴聲 (Page 28|n71 #7: 嗅(3)) To smell (Kangxi: 以鼻就臭, 以鼻取氣), to perceive odors as a dog does; the plaintive cry of birds (Fan Wan: 鳥哀鳴聲). 【嗅】 (xjuwH) (_verb-like_) to smell

U+6E4A 凑 輳 (for "gather" senses) (F1.55 凑) 會合也 (Page 563 #9: 凑(3)湊(3)) To collect, to gather (Kangxi 湊: 一曰聚也); to run together; to run into each other; a gathering on the water, as at a regatta (Kangxi 湊: 水上人所會也); a reunion; to go with one, to take care of; with, together; a concurrence of circumstances, to estimate the probabilities of; to strive to excel (Kangxi 湊: 競進也); for; _(5)n(i/) h(u(3) ts(')au(3) (5)ngo (2)t(a/) ~~t(')eng(3)~~ t(')ing(3)_ (nei5 heoi3 cau3 ngo5 daa2 ting3 你去湊我打聽) will you go and learn about it for me; _ts(')au(3) (2)h(a/)u_ (cau3 haau2 湊巧), a lucky guess, a fortunate coincidence, just as; _ts(')au(3) (1)ng(a/)m_ (cau3 ngaam1 湊啱), a lucky hit; just the thing; _(2)p(i/) (1)sam (1)k(i/) ts(')au(3) (5)k(')(u_ (bei2 sam1 gei1 cau3 keoi5 畀心機湊佢), look carefully after him; _(2)t(')ai (4)lai ts(')au(3)_ (tai2 lai4 cau3 睇嚟湊) I'll see how I can do; _ts(')au(3) kau(3)_ (cau3 gau3 湊夠) to make up enough; _(4)'m ts(')au(3) (5)n(i/) (2)h(o\)_ (m4 cau3 nei5 hou2 唔湊你好), I'll have nothing to do with you; _ts(')au(3) (4)m(a/)i yat(7) h(i/)(3)_ (cau3 maai4 jat1 hei3 湊埋一氣) lump it all in one; _ts(')au(3) h(o\)p(9)_ (cau3 hap6 湊合) to group. (Page 563 #10: 輳(3)) Similar to the preceding (湊) (Kangxi 輳: 通作湊); Williams' 你去湊我打聽: Corrected _t(')eng(3)_ (teng3) to _t(')ing(3)_ (ting3). The use of 湊 as "for" is very dated. 【湊】 (cau3) To look after, to raise, to baby sit. 湊仔 (cau3 zai2): "Look after kids." 湊大佢 (cau3 daai6 keoi5): "Raised him up."

cok3.text: U+7C07 (Page 599 #3: ~~蔟(9)~~簇(9) _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6); here corrected to _Ch(')ok(8)_ (cok3)) a mold for cakes (Kangxi 簇: 作餠具); head or barb of a dart (Kangxi 簇: 矢金也);

cuk1.text: U+7C07 蔟 (for "collect" sense) zuk6 (per Williams) (F1.66 蔟 _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6)) 聚也又音秀 (Page 599 #3: 蔟(9)簇(9) _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6); here normalised to _Ts(')uk(7)_ (cuk1)) ~~These two (蔟, 簇) are used interchangeably.~~ Tufts of small bamboo (Kangxi 簇: 小竹); to collect, to crowd together (Kangxi 蔟: 與簇同聚也攢也); a crowd of people; _~~tsuk(9)~~ ts(')uk(7) (2)yung (4)ts(')(i/)n (4)loi_ (cuk1 jung2 cin4 loi4 簇擁前來), came pressing on in a crowd. Williams' "used interchangeably": Here only for the "collect" sense. Williams does not provide separate entries for 簇 and 蔟. I have split things up accordingly.

cau3.text: U+7CD7 hau2 (per 《廣韻》去久切) jau2 (common) (F1.55 糗) 乾粮 (Page 28|n71 #8: 糗(3)) Roasted or parched wheat or rice (Kangxi: 熬米麥也又乾飯屑也); coarsely pounded rice like grits; _ch(')au(3) (4)l(e/)ung_ (cau3 loeng4 糗糧), dried or cured grain. 【糗】 (khjuwX) (_noun-like_) parched-grain

U+81ED cau3-2 (rising second in vernacular 臭臭地) (F1.55 臭) 氣息也又臭穢 (Page 28|n71 #6: 臭(3)) To track by the scent (Kangxi: 禽走臭而知其迹者犬也); effluvia, savor, smell, putridity, odor, stench (Kangxi: 凡氣之總名); to stink (Kangxi: 惡氣); scent (Kangxi: 香也); to rot (Kangxi: 敗也); to smell; disreputable; a bad name; _ch(')au(3) h(i/)(3)_ (cau3 hei3 臭氣) a bad breath; a stink; _ok(8) (4)man ch(')au(3) h(i/)(3)_ (ok3 man4 cau3 hei3 惡聞臭氣) vile language; _ch(')au(3) (1)hang (1)hang_ (cau3 hang1 hang1 臭亨亨), a vile stench; _ch(')au(3) (4)ming_ (cau3 ming4 臭名), a bad reputation; _ch(')au(3) (4)ch(')ung_ (cau3 cung4 臭蟲), bedbugs; vagabonds, foulmouthed fellows; _(4)t(')ung ch(')au(3)_ (tung4 cau3 銅臭) purseproud; _ch(')au(3) k(e/)uk(8)_ (cau3 goek3 臭腳) foul footed, said of a woman; _(1)seng ch(')au(3)_ (seng1 cau3 腥臭) rank, noisome, as bad fish; _ch(')au(3) m(i/)(6)_ (cau3 mei6 臭味) a bad ~~taste~~ smell. Williams' "To track by the scent": This verb sense is now written 嗅. Note that 禽走臭而知其迹者犬也 is a quote from 《說文》 explaining the presence of the component 犬 (hound). 【臭】 (tsyhuwH) (_noun-like_) smell

U+851F 簇 (Page 599 #3: 蔟(9)簇(9)) These two (蔟, 簇) are used interchangeably. Also read _ts(')au(3)_ (cau3). Williams intends the reading _ts(')au(3)_ (cau3) as an alternative for the other senses, but strictly it is for the musical-pitch sense, here supplemented. Used in 太蔟 (one of the twelve musical pitches; the first lunar month).

cuk1.text: U+851F zuk6 (per Fan Wan) (F1.66 蔟 _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6)) 聚也又音秀 (Page 599 #3: 蔟(9)~~簇(9)~~ _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6); here normalised to _Ts(')uk(7)_ (cuk1)) a nest (Kangxi 蔟: 巢也); a framework or whisk on which silk-worms spin coccoons (Kangxi 蔟: 行蠶蓐); Williams does not provide separate entries for 簇 and 蔟. I have split things up accordingly.

cau3.text: U+27F52 hung3 (per 《廣韻》香仲切) (Page 28|n71 #5: (5)𧽒) Read _ch(')au(3)_ (cau3)_;_ to walk, to go as if weary (Kangxi: 行也, 䠢𧽒疲行貌).

cau5.text: U+27F52 (Page 28|n71 #5: (5)𧽒) A colloquial word. To sprain the ankle; _(5)ch(')au (1)ts(')an k(e/)uk(8)_ (cau5 can1 goek3 𧽒嚫腳) sprained the foot.

cau3.text: U+8F33 辏 (Mainland simplified) (F1.55 輳) 輻輳猶聚集也 (Page 563 #10: 輳(3)) centre of a wheel, place where the rays centre (Kangxi: 輻輳輻共轂也); to collect, to bring together (Kangxi: 輳聚也); concentrated.

cau4.text: U+4EC7 (F1.52 讐) 寃讐 (F1.52 仇) 同上 (Page 26|n69 #13: (4)讐(4)仇) Williams does not provide separate entries for 仇 and 讐. In modern usage: The "enmity" sense is spelt 仇 and read _(4)shau_ (sau4); see 仇 sau4. The "proofread" sense is spelt 讎 and read _(4)ch(')au_ (cau4); see 讎 cau4. I have split things up accordingly.

U+5114 俦 (F1.52 儔) 侣也衆也等類也 (Page 27|n70 #6: (4)儔) A company of four (Kangxi: 四人爲儔); a party (Kangxi: 衆也); a comrade; a mate, fellows, friends; a class (Kangxi: 等類也); _(4)ch(')au lui(6)_ (cau4 leoi6 儔類) a concourse; to assist, to sympathize; _(4)ch(')au (2)tong_ (cau4 dong2 儔黨), to join one's clique or party.

U+56DA (F1.53 囚) 囚犯拘罪人也 (Page 563 before #6: (4)囚) (The three next (囚, 酋, 遒) are often read _ch(')au_.) (Page 563 #6: (4)囚) To imprison, to confine, to cage (Kangxi: 繫也, 拘也); to ~~handcuff~~ restrain (Kangxi: 囚拘也主拘繫當𠛬殺者); a prisoner, a felon; a prison; _(4)ts(')au (4)lung_ (cau4 lung4 囚籠), a cage in which criminals are carried; _yap(9) (4)ts(')au_ (jap6 cau4 入囚), to imprison; _(4)ts(')au f(a/)n(6)_ (cau4 faan6-2 囚犯) a criminal. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰才巳 to 犯. Williams' "to handcuff": Kangxi has 囚拘也主拘繫當𠛬殺者 followed by commentary on various wooden restraints depending on the crime/punishment. In particular, 桎 applies to the feet, so 囚 is better rendered generically as "restrain", rather than "handcuff". 【囚】 (zjuw) (_verb-like_) to imprison (_noun-like_) prisoner
U+5E6C 帱 (Page 27|n70 #2: (4)幬) ~~A single~~ An unlined curtain (Kangxi: 襌帳也) on a carriage (Kangxi: 車帷也); a leather screen or partition (Kangxi: 幔轂之革也); 【幬】 (drjuw) (_noun-like_) drape
U+60C6 (F1.52 惆) 惆悵 (Page 27|n70 #9: (4)惆) Disappointed (Kangxi: 失意也); ~~deceived;~~ frustrated; _(4)ch(')au ch(e/)ung(3)_ (cau4 zoeng3 惆悵) sad, sick at heart.
U+6906 (Page 27|n70 #3: (4)椆) A hard kind of wood resembling rose wood (Kangxi: 木也);

zau3.text: U+6906 (Page 27|n70 #3: (4)椆 _(4)Ch(')au_ (cau4); here corrected to _Chau(3)_ (zau3)) a pole for poling boats (Kangxi: 木椆船篙木).

cau4.text: U+72A8 (F1.52 犨) 白色牛又牛息聲又生 (Page 28|n71 #1: (4)犨) A white ox (Fan Wan: 白色牛); the lowing or snorting of a cow (Kangxi: 牛息聲); ~~to issue from, to proceed from~~ protruding (Kangxi: 出也).

U+7587 儔 (for "who" sense) 畴 (F1.52 疇) 耕治之田也又衆也類也 (Page 27|n70 #5: (4)疇) A cultivated field; to till, to cultivate (Kangxi: 耕治之也); a field of hemp (Kangxi: 麻田曰疇); formerly, time past (Kangxi: 曩也); to class; a class, sort (Kangxi: 類也); who? (Kangxi: 疇誰也) _(4)ch(')au sik(7)_ (cau4 sik1 疇昔) formerly, in time past. (Page 27|n70 #6: (4)儔) Used for the preceding (疇) (for the "who" sense) (Kangxi 儔: 誰也...與疇同). 【疇】 (drjuw) (_noun-like_) farming-field, hemp-field (_pronoun-like_) who (_noun-like_) category Used in 疇昔. 【疇昔】 (drjuw sjek) (_noun-like_) former day

U+7A20 綢 (F1.52 稠) 密也 (Page 27|n70 #8: (4)綢) close, thick, crowded (Kangxi 綢: 綢者綢緻之言故爲密也); (Page 27|n70 #10: (4)稠) Grain growing close (Kangxi: 穊也); thick set, close together; crowded, dense (Kangxi: 密也); _(4)yan (1)(i/)n (4)ch(')au mat(9)_ (jan4 jin1 cau4 mat6 人煙稠密) people closely crowded; _(2)hung (4)ch(')au (4)yan (1)chung (4)mai shat(7)_ (hung2 cau4 jan4 zung1 mai4 sat1 恐稠人中迷失) lest they should lose each other in the crowd; _(4)ch(')au mat(9)_ (cau4 mat6 稠密) close, crowded, intimate. 【稠】 (drjuw) (_adjective-like_) dense

U+7C4C 筹 cau4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.52 籌) 算也又壺矢也 (Page 28|n71 #2: (4)籌) To compute, to calculate (Kangxi: 籌算也); to devise, to plan, to arrange (Kangxi: 籌策); a lot; a reed; a time, a tally, a tillot; _chap(7) (4)ch(')au_ (zap1 cau4-2 執籌) or _(4)ts(')(i/)m (4)ch(')au_ (cim4 cau4-2 撍籌), to draw lots; _~~(1)kang~~ (1)k(a/)ng (4)ch(')au_ (gaang1 cau4 更籌), a watchman beating the hour; _tuk(9) (2)k(i/) (4)ch(')au (1)sh(u_ (duk6 gei2 cau4 syu1 讀幾籌書), how many times have you studied it? _p(')(a/)i(3) (4)ch(')au_ (paai3 cau4-2 派籌), to give tickets; _(4)ch(')au ch(')(a/)k(8)_ (cau4 caak3 籌策) a stratagem; to scheme; _(4)ch(')au w(a/)k(9)_ (cau4 waak6 籌劃) to settle a plan of action; _(4)ch(')au (2)ch(')(i/)_ (cau4 ci2 籌矢), wands thrown into a jar, a sort of game. Williams' "To compute, to calculate": Alternatively, a counting-stick. Williams' 更籌: Corrected _(1)kang_ (gang1) to _(1)k(a/)ng_ (gaang1). 【籌】 (drjuw) (_noun-like_) throwing-arrow (_noun-like_) counting-stick (_noun-like_) plan 【籌】 (cau4-2) A ticket or a token for a queue or allocation. 派籌 (paai3 cau4-2): "Handing out tickets." 攞籌 (lo2 cau4-2): "Getting a ticket."

U+7DA2 紬 (for "silk" sense) 绸 (Mainland simplified) (F1.52 綢) 綢緞又密也纏也 (F1.52 紬) 同上 (Page 27|n70 #7: (4)紬; here normalised to 綢) Silk (Kangxi 紬: 大絲繒也); pongee, senshaw, levantine, lustring; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng (4)ch(')au_ (saang1 cau4 生綢), stiff pongee; _shuk(9) (4)ch(')au_ (suk6 cau4 熟綢), soft silk; _(4)ning (4)ch(')au_ (ning4 cau4 寧綢), finest pongee; _(4)sh(u (4)l(e/)ung (4)ch(')au_ (syu4 loeng4 cau4 薯莨綢), rust colored senshaw; _(4)ch(')au t(un(6)_ (cau4 dyun6 綢緞) silks and satins; _(2)fong (4)ch(')au_ (fong2 cau4 紡綢), reeled pongee; _(4)m(i/)n (4)ch(')au_ (min4 cau4 綿綢), fabric of silk and cotton; _(2)k(a/)n (4)ch(')au_ (gaan2 cau4 繭綢), coarse rough serge; _(1)ch(')(un (4)ch(')au_ (cyun1 cau4 川綢), Sz'chuen (四川) pongee. (Page 27|n70 #8: (4)綢) Used for the last (紬), when denoting silk; to bind, to wrap around, to twine about (Kangxi 綢: 繆也, 綢縛束也); _(4)ch(')au (4)mau_ (cau4 mau4 綢繆), to tie up; to be intimate with, to consult upon. Williams' 生綢: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【綢】 (drjuw) (_verb-like_) to wind Used in 綢繆. 【綢繆】 (drjuw mjuw) (_verb-like_) to wind and bind

U+88EF (F1.52 裯) 單被也 (Page 27|n70 #4: (4)裯) ~~A single~~ An unlined coverlet (Kangxi: 被也, 襌被也); a bed curtain (Kangxi: 牀帳也); an under-shirt; to cover, as with bed clothes. 【裯】 (drjuw) (_noun-like_) bedsheet

U+8B8E 讐 雠 (Mainland simplified) sau4 (common) (F1.52 讐) 寃讐 (F1.52 仇) 同上 (Page 26|n69 #13: (4)讐~~(4)仇~~; here normalised to 讎) to verify, to collate with (Kangxi 讎: 應驗也); _(4)ch(')au t(u/)i(3)_ (cau4 deoi3 讎對) to collate; Williams does not record the form 讎, and does not provide separate entries for 仇 and 讐. In modern usage: The "enmity" sense is spelt 仇 and read _(4)shau_ (sau4); see 仇 sau4. The "proofread" sense is spelt 讎 and read _(4)ch(')au_ (cau4). I have split things up accordingly.

U+8B90 (F1.52 讐) 寃讐 (F1.52 仇) 同上 (Page 26|n69 #13: (4)讐(4)仇) Williams does not provide separate entries for 仇 and 讐. In modern usage: The "enmity" sense is spelt 仇 and read _(4)shau_ (sau4); see 仇 sau4. The "proofread" sense is spelt 讎 and read _(4)ch(')au_ (cau4); see 讎 cau4. I have split things up accordingly.

U+8E8A 踌 (Page 27|n70 #11: (4)躊) Embarrassed (Kangxi: 躊躇也); _(4)ch(')au (4)ch(')(u_ (cau4 cyu4 躊躇), undecided, undetermined, unable to progress. Williams' "Embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed".

U+9052 逎 (F1.53 遒) 聚也 (Page 563 before #6: (4)囚) (The three next (囚, 酋, 遒) are often read _ch(')au_.) (Page 563 #8: (4)遒) To urge, to constrain, to press upon (Kangxi: 迫也); a crowd, a throng; to exhaust, to carry to the utmost, to end (Kangxi: 盡也); brave, strong, unyielding (Kangxi: 健也勁也); to bring together (Kangxi: 聚也); _(4)ts(')au (4)yan_ (cau4 jan4 遒人), a herald. 【遒】 (tsjuw, dzjuw) (_verb-like_) to rally, to consolidate
U+914B (F1.53 酋) 夷狄有酋長 (Page 563 #7: (4)酋)

U+916C 詶 讎 讐 酧 醻 (F1.52 酬) 答也報也 (F1.52 酧) 同酬 (Page 26|n69 #13: (4)讐~~(4)仇~~) used for the next (酬) (Kangxi 讎: 通作酬); (Page 27|n70 #1: (4)酬(4)酧) To pledge a guest (Kangxi 酬: 主人實觶酬賔); to recompense; to make a return; to invite a guest to drink; _(4)ch(')au tsok(9)_ (cau4 zok6 酬酢) pledging as host and guest; _(4)ch(')au ts(e/)(6)_ (cau4 ze6 酬謝) to return thanks, to present in return; _(4)ch(')au t(a/)p(8)_ (cau4 daap3 酬答) to recompense, to respond; _(4)ch(')au (4)shan_ (cau4 san4 酬神) to thank the gods; _(4)ch(')au (un(6)_ (cau4 jyun6 酬願) to make a thank offering; _(4)ch(')au (4)l(o\)_ (cau4 lou4 酬勞), present for carefulness, as to workmen; _(4)ch(')au (4)w(a/)n_ (cau4 waan4 酬還), to pay, as a vow; _(4)ch(')au t(a/)p(8) (1)t(')(i/)n (1)yan_ (cau4 daap3 tin1 jan1 酬答天恩), to requite heaven's favor---in being saved from fire. 【酬】 (dzyuw) (_verb-like_) to toast (in return) (_verb-like_) to repay

ce1.text: U+5513 ce5 (lower-pitch alternative) The rising tone variation is often re-falling at the tail. 【唓】 (ce1, ce5) An interjection of dismissal or dissatisfaction. 唓、得兩個人 (ce1, dak1 loeng5 go3 jan4): "Pff, only two people." The spelling 唓 is arbitrary.

U+5962 May appear with 者 dotless (+8 assumed here) or dotted (+9), depending on the font. 奓 se1 (per 《廣韻》式車切) (F2.83 奢) 侈也泰也 (Page 31|n74 #7: (1)奢) Wasteful, extravagant (Kangxi: 侈也); to spread out (Kangxi: 張也); affluent; _(1)ch(')(e/) mong(6)_ (ce1 mong6 奢望) extravagant hopes; _(1)ch(')(e/) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (ce1 ci2 奢侈), prodigal; _(1)ch(')(e/) (4)w(a/)_ (ce1 waa4 奢華), gay, wasteful. 【奢】 (syae) (_adjective-like_) extravagant
U+5C3A 伬 (for an octave lower) 鿈 (for an octave higher) ce2 (possibly from Mandarin-matching) (_music_) Rough equivalent of solfege _re_ in 工尺譜 (Gongche notation).

cek3.text: U+5C3A cek3-2 (in 間尺) cik3 (uncommon) (F1.78 尺) 十寸曰尺 (Page 15* before #4: 尺(9)) (The next character (尺) is usually pronounced _ch(')ek_ (cek).) (Page 15* #4: 尺(9) _Ch(')ik(9)_ (cik6); _Ch(')ek(9)_ (cek6) implied by variational note; here corrected to _Ch(')ek(8)_ (cek3)) A cubit, or 10 _ts(')(un(3)_ (Kangxi: 十寸也)_;_ the Chinese foot; _~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) ts(')(un(3)_ (cek3 cyun3 尺寸) regular, proportioned; _(2)k(i/) (1)to ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) ts(')(un(3)_ (gei2 do1 cek3 cyun3 幾多尺寸) what are the dimensions? _(4)'m kau(3) ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) ts(')(un(3)_ (m4 gau3 cek3 cyun3 唔夠尺寸) not of full stature; _(1)s(a/)m ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) f(a/)t(8)_ (saam1 cek3 faat3 三尺法) laws of the land, prohibitions; _(4)p(')(a/)i (4)ts(')(i/)n ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8)_ (paai4 cin4 cek3 排錢尺) the full length cubit; _k(a/)n(3) ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8)_ (gaan3 cek3-2 間尺) a ruler; _(4)l(e/)ung (1)t(')(i/)n ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8)_ (loeng4 tin1 cek3 量天尺) a quadrant; _~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) ~~wok(8)~~ wok(9)_ (cek3 wok6 尺蠖) a geometrical worm; _~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) yat(7) (1)ch(i/) (1)sh(u_ (cek3 jat1 zi1 syu1 尺一之書), an epistle, a note; _~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) t(o\)(6)_ (cek3 dou6 尺度) ~~to~~ measure, measurable; _luk(9) ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) (1)ch(i/) (1)k(u/)_ (luk6 cek3 zi1 gu1 六尺之孤), a minor reigning; _(1)s(a/)m ~~ch(')ek(9)~~ ch(')ek(8) p(a/)k(9)_ (saam1 cek3 baak6 三尺帛) a halter, a short rope. Williams has been misled by Fan Wan's placement of 尺 (_ch(')ik_) in its own series *after* 劇屐 (_k(')ik(9)_) and 溺 (_nik(9)_), which are 陽入 (see F1.78). Based on this ordering, Williams has inferred that the character 尺 is read 陽入 _ch(')ik(9)_ (cik6). However, since Fan Wan has a separate series for 勅勑敕斥叱螫𪅙赤 (_ch(')ik(7)_), it appears that its authors have attempted to distinguish the vernacular rime _-ek_ from the literary rime _-ik_, notwithstanding all series appear under 第七英影應益. I have corrected Williams by placing 尺 under _ch(')ek(8)_ (cek3) here. Williams' 尺蠖: Changed _wok(8)_ (wok3) to common reading _wok(9)_ (wok6). Williams' 尺一之書: From the length of 1.1 _ch(')ek_ for the writing-boards used for imperial decrees. Williams' 尺度: Not the verb "to measure", but the noun "measure", as 度 is in departing tone. 【尺】 (tsyhek) (_noun-like_) ruler, rule 【間尺】 (gaan3 cek3-2) A ruler.

ce1.text: U+8ECA 车 (Mainland simplified) (F2.83 車) 輪輿總名車屬 (Page 31|n74 #8: (1)車) A chariot, a carriage, a cart, any vehicle (Kangxi: 輿輪總名); a framed wheel; to turn a wheel, to roll over; _(2)shui (1)ch(')(e/)_ (seoi2 ce1 水車), a fire-engine; _(1)ch(')(e/) luk(7)_ (ce1 luk1 車轆) a caster; _(1)ch(')(e/) (1)f(u/)_ (ce1 fu1 車夫), a charioteer; _(1)ch(')(e/) ~~(4)m(e/)~~ (2)m(e/)_ (ce1 me2 車歪), a teetotum; _(1)ch(')(e/) ~~(4)m(e/)~~ (2)m(e/) k(o\)m(3) ~~(2)ch(un~~ ch(un(3)_ (ce1 me2 gam3 zyun3 車歪咁轉), fidgetty as a teetotum; _(1)ch(')(e/) (4)lun_ (ce1 leon4 車輪), a wheel; _(1)fung (1)ch(')(e/)_ (fung1 ce1 風車), a windmill; _(1)ch(')(e/) (4)ch(')ong_ (ce1 cong4 車床), a lathe; _(5)m(a/) (1)ch(')(e/)_ (maa5 ce1 馬車), a horse and carriage; _(2)fo (1)ch(')(e/)_ (fo2 ce1 火車), a locomotive. (Page 183 #3: (1)車 _(1)K(u_ (geoi1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')(e/)_ (ce1)) the jaw-bones (Kangxi: 牙車牙所載也 etc.); Williams' 車歪: Corrected _(4)m(e/)_ (me4) to _(2)m(e/)_ (me2). Williams' 車歪咁轉: Corrected _(4)m(e/)_ (me4) to _(2)m(e/)_ (me2), and corrected _(2)ch(un_ (zyun2) to _ch(un(3)_ (zyun3). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). Used in 子車 (a compound surname) (Kangxi: 子車複姓). 【車】 (tsyhae) (_noun-like_) carriage, (_met._) lower-jawbone

ce2.text: U+4E14 (F2.84 且) 語詞 (Page 31|n74 #9: (2)且) A conjunctive particle; and, further, moreover, still; also, and also (Kangxi: 又也); thus, so (Kangxi: 此也); still, yet; ~~a word of doubt,~~ if, should (Kangxi: 借曰之辭); _(4)hang (2)ch(')(e/)_ (hang4 ce2 行且), on the point of being; _(2)ch(')(e/) ~~san(3)~~ sun(3) (2)ch(')(e/) (4)(i/)_ (ce2 seon3 ce2 ji4 且信且疑), half believing, half doubting; _f(u/)(3) (2)ch(')(e/) kwai(3)_ (fu3 ce2 gwai3 富且貴) rich and so honored; _(2)kau (2)ch(')(e/) (5)li(u/) sz'(6)_ (gau2 ce2 liu5 si6 苟且了事) slovenly way of doing things; _fong(3) (2)ch(')(e/)_ (fong3 ce2 況且), still further; _(2)ch(')(e/) m(a/)n(6)_ (ce2 maan6 且慢) ~~by and by, presently~~; _(1)k(u/) (2)ch(')(e/)_ (gu1 ce2 姑且) or _ts(a/)m(6) (2)ch(')(e/)_ (zaam6 ce2 暫且), for a time. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(2)ts(')(e/)_ per 《廣韻》七也切. Fan Wan groups it with 扯 (same as 撦), whose reading is _(2)ch(')(e/)_ (ce2) per 《廣韻》昌者切. Notwithstanding, this is all academic given the initials _ts(')_ and _ch(')_ are now considered merged. Williams' "a word of doubt": This is an attempt at rendering Kangxi 未定之辭. A better rendering is "a word indicating uncertainness". Note that this is a separate sense to subjunctive "if", "should". Williams' 且信且疑: Corrected _san(3)_ (san3) to _sun(3)_ (seon3). Williams' 富且貴: This example is suspiciously similar to that in Section 2.11.2 (_Examples of ts(')i(e/)_, 且) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. Williams' 且慢: Not an adverbial "soon" or "shortly", but an imperative "slow down" or "hang on". Temporarily, for now. Shall, about to (Kangxi: 將也). Still. Or. 【且-rising】 (tshjaeX) (_conjunction-like_) and (also), moreover (_determiner-like_) this (_adverb-like_) for now (_auxiliary-like_) shall, about to (_adverb-like_) still (_conjunction-like_) or

zeoi1.text: U+4E14 (F1.44 且) 語詞 (Page 594 #5: (1)且) A phonetic particle, used in the Sh(i/) King (詩經) at the end of sentences, as an affirmative (Kangxi: 語餘聲). Numerous, many (Kangxi: 多貌). The sixth lunar month (Kangxi: 六月爲且). 【且-level】 (tsjo) (_speech-assist_) (_adjective-like_) many

ce2.text: U+54C6 (Page 12* #5: (2)哆) _~~(2)ch(')(i/)~~ (2)ch(')(e/) (4)(i/)n_ (ce2 jin4 哆然), sneering at, disobedient (Kangxi: 哆然衆有不服之心). Also read _(2)ch(')(e/)_ (ce2)_;_ the lower lip hanging down (Kangxi: 脣下垂貌). Williams' 哆然: Corrected _(2)ch(')(i/)_ (ci2) to _(2)ch(')(e/)_ (ce2).

ci2.text: U+54C6 de2 (per 《集韻》丁寫切 for "fish-gape" sense) (Page 12* #5: (2)哆) Gaping (Kangxi: 張口也); an open mouth, like a fish (Kangxi: 魚口張貌); large lipped; (...). 【哆】 (tsyheX) (_adjective-like_) open-mouthed

ce2.text: U+626F 撦 (F2.84 抯) 止也拽也 (F2.84 扯) 同上 (Page 31|n74 #10: (2)撦~~(2)抯~~(2)扯) To tear open, to pull apart (Kangxi 撦: 裂開也); to tear away; to pull up or on; to haul, to drag; _(2)ch(')(e/) (5)sh(e/)ung_ (ce2 soeng5 扯上), haul up; _(1)l(a/)i (2)ch(')(e/)_ (laai1 ce2 拉扯), to pull and haul, to borrow and lend; _(1)l(a/)i (1)l(a/)i (2)ch(')(e/) (2)ch(')(e/)_ (laai1 laai1 ce2 ce2 拉拉扯扯), borrowing here and there; on the average, lumping the whole; _(2)ch(')(e/) (1)hoi_ (ce2 hoi1 扯開), to pull apart; _(2)ch(')(e/) (4)m(a/)i_ (ce2 maai4 扯埋), to pull up, to close, as a skylight; _(2)ch(')(e/) ch(u(6)_ (ce2 zyu6 扯住) to stop from going. A colloquial word. To clear out, to go off, to abscond; to send off; to go away, to take one's self off; _(2)ch(')(e/) (1)lo_ (ce2 lo1 扯囉), go! let us go; _(5)ngo (2)ch(')(e/) lok(8)_ (ngo5 ce2 lok3 我扯咯) I'm off. Fan Wan (and Williams following it) considers 抯 the same as 扯. Strictly, this is erroneous; the three readings of 抯 in 《廣韻》 are: _(1)ch(a/)_ (zaa1) per 側加切, explained 挹也 (per 說文); _ts(e/)(6)_ (ze6) per 徐野切, explained 取也 (or _(5)ts(')(e/)_ (ce5) if insisting on rising tone); and _(2)ts(e/)_ (ze2) per 兹野切, also explained 取也. None of these are 陰上 _(2)ch(')(e/)_ (ce2). 【扯】 (ce2) To leave. 你扯啦 (nei5 ce2 laa1): "Leave!" The spelling 扯 is arbitrary.
U+64A6 May appear with 者 dotless (+11 assumed here) or dotted (+12), depending on the font. (Page 31|n74 #10: (2)撦~~(2)抯~~(2)扯)

ce3.text: U+659C ce3-2 (rising second in vernacular 斜斜地) (Page 565 #2: 斜(3)) A colloquial word. Not level, rising, as a road; _fong(3) ts(')(e/)(3)_ (fong3 ce3 放斜) lay it one end higher; _ts(')(e/)(3) ts(')(e/)(3) lok(9)_ (ce3 ce3 lok6 斜斜落) go down winding; _ts(')(e/)(3) (1)po_ (ce3 bo1 斜坡), an ascending plain; _(4)hau (4)t(')au ts(')(e/)(3)_ (hau4 tau4 ce3 喉頭斜) greedy. 【斜路】 (ce3 lou6-2) An incline, slope, or ramp. 行斜路 (haang4 ce3 lou6-2): "Walking up/down a ramp" (as opposed to stairs). 寫字上斜路 (se2 zi6 soeng5 ce3 lou6-2): "Your writing is going up an incline" (i.e. not level). 【長命斜】 (coeng4 meng6 ce3) A long and steep incline or slope. Williams views departing-tone 斜 _ts(')(e/)(3)_ (ce3) as a word in its own right, but personally I view it merely as a vernacular reading variation of level-tone 斜 _(4)ts(')(e/)_ (ce4). (E.g. 斜坡 is read both as _ts(')(e/)(3) (1)po_ (ce3 bo1) and as _(4)ts(')(e/) (1)po_ (ce4 bo1).) Some point to 笡 as the original character for the departing-tone reading, per 《廣韻》遷謝切. But I am not convinced of this. Whilst the reading _ts(')(e/)(3)_ (ce3) is a match, the explanation 斜逆也 seems more a metaphorical "heretical" than a physical "inclined" or "sloped".

ce4.text: U+659C 衺 邪 (F2.84 斜) 歪斜 (Page 565 #1: (4)斜) Slanting, inclined, oblique, across, crisscross, diagonal, aslant, not with the rule (Kangxi: 不正也); distorted, scattered (Kangxi: 散也); ~~often used for the preceding (邪);~~ _(4)ts(')(e/) (4)man p(o\)(3)_ (ce4 man4 bou3 斜紋布) drillings, twilled cloth; _(i/)t(9) (4)t(')au (2)p(a/)i (4)ts(')(e/)_ (jit6 tau4-2 baai2 ce4 熱頭擺斜), the sun is declining; _(4)ts(')(e/) sh(i/)(6)_ (ce4 si6 斜視) to look askance; _(4)ts(')(e/) (4)ts(')(e/) tik(7)_ (ce4 ce4 dik1 斜斜滴) it is rather awry; _(1)sai (4)ts(')(e/) (i/)t(9)_ (sai1 ce4 jit6 西斜熱) the afternoon sun is hot; _(4)ts(')(e/) (1)fung_ (ce4 fung1 斜風), an unsteady wind; _(4)ts(')(e/) (5)ng(a/)n_ (ce4 ngaan5 斜眼), cross-eyed. 【斜】 (zjae) (_adjective-like_) slanted 【西斜】 (sai1 ce4) Exposure to the western sun.

U+90AA 衺 ce4-2 (in 唔信邪) (F2.84 邪) 邪曲不直也又奸佞也 (Page 564 #5: (4)邪) Deflected, inclined, swerving from the right line (Kangxi: 不正也); whatever leads astray; depraved, bad, crooked, vicious, corrupting, obscene (Kangxi: 姦思也); specious, deluding (Kangxi: 佞也); heretical, illegal, not acknowledged by the state, or in the classics; _(4)'m sun(3) (4)ts(')(e/)_ (m4 seon3 ce4-2 唔信邪) don't believe heresies; _(4)ts(')(e/) t(o\)(6)_ (ce4 dou6 邪道) erroneous doctrines; _(4)ts(')(e/) peng(6)_ (ce4 beng6 邪病) epileptic sickness; _(4)ts(')(e/) f(a/)t(8)_ (ce4 faat3 邪法) sorceries, tricks; _(4)ts(')(e/) (4)shan_ (ce4 san4 邪神), illegal, unacknowledged gods, those whose worship corrupts; _(1)k(a/)n (4)ts(')(e/)_ (gaan1 ce4 奸邪), malicious, fornicating, illicit; _(2)koi (4)ts(')(e/) (1)kwai ching(3)_ (goi2 ce4 gwai1 zing3 改邪歸正) ~~forsake errors~~ alter from wickedness and ~~cleave~~ return to the right; _(4)ts(')(e/) shut(9)_ (ce4 seot6 邪術) charms, philtres, black art; _(1)sam (4)ts(')(e/)_ (sam1 ce4 心邪), impure, lewd in mind; _(4)ts(')(e/) (4)yam_ (ce4 jam4 邪淫), obscene, licentious. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 㚥 to 奸. 【邪】 (zjae) (_adjective-like_) wicked 【唔信邪】 (m4 seon3 ce4-2) Not believing in negative superstitions.

cek3.text: U+24DEB 赤 (Cantonese) cek3-2 (rising second in vernacular 𤷫𤷫地) cik3 (alternative) (Page 571 #4: 𤷫(8) _Ts(')ik(8)_ (cik3); _Ts(')ek(8)_ (cek3) exemplified) A fullness in the stomach; a pain from laughing; rheumatic twinges, pain in the bones; _si(u/)(3) t(o\)(3) (5)t(')(o\) ts(')ek(8)_ (siu3 dou3 tou5 cek3 笑到肚𤷫) laughed till he ached; _kwat(7) ts(')ek(8)_ (gwat1 cek3 骨𤷫) shooting pains; _(1)sam ts(')ek(8)_ (sam1 cek3 心𤷫) sorry for, deeply pained for; _(4)t(')au ts(')ek(8)_ (tau4 cek3 頭𤷫) nervous headache. 【𤷫】 (cek3) Pain or aching. 頭𤷫 (tau4 cek3): "Headache." The spelling 𤷫 is arbitrary.

cik3.text: U+8D64 灻 烾 cek3 (alternative) (F1.74 赤) 赤色 (Page 14* #8: 赤(8)) Carnation, purplish or light red (Kangxi: 朱色也); flesh color (Kangxi: ...肉色也); naked, destitute, barren, poor (Kangxi: 空盡無物曰赤); to redden; to denude (Kangxi: 裸裎曰赤體見肉色也); the 155th radical (U+2F9A ⾚ "red") of characters referring to red; _ch(')ik(8) (2)t(a/)m_ (cik3 daam2 赤膽), pureminded; _ch(')ik(8) t(o\)(6)_ (cik3 dou6 赤道) the equator; _ch(')ik(8) yat(9)_ (cik3 jat6 赤日) full day; heat of the day; _ch(')ik(8) (5)mai_ (cik3 mai5 赤米), red rice; _ch(')ik(8) (2)tsz'_ (cik3 zi2 赤子) an infant; we, the people; _ch(')ik(8) (1)shan_ (cik3 san1 赤身), naked; _ch(')ik(8) (1)sam_ (cik3 sam1 赤心), guileless, sincere; _ch(')ik(8) p(a/)k(9) (4)n(a/)n (1)fan_ (cik3 baak6 naan4 fan1 赤白難分), hard to distinguish; _(2)t(a/) ch(')ik(8) k(e/)uk(8)_ (daa2 cik3 goek3 打赤腳) to bare the feet; _ch(')ik(8) t(i/)(6)_ (cik3 dei6 赤地) barren wastes. Ardent, loyal. 【赤】 (tsyhek) (_adjective-like_) red (_adjective-like_) bare Used in 赤子. 【赤子】 (tsyhek tsiX) (_noun-like_) babe

ceng1.text: U+9751 (Page 577 #5: (1)靑(1)青 _(1)Ts(')ing_ (cing1); _(1)Ts(')eng_ (ceng1) implied by variational note)
U+9752 (Page 577 #5: (1)靑(1)青 _(1)Ts(')ing_ (cing1); _(1)Ts(')eng_ (ceng1) implied by variational note)

cing1.text: U+9752 靑 ceng1 (vernacular for "green" senses) (F1.68 靑) 東方水色 (Page 577 #5: (1)靑(1)青) The color of nature, as the azure of the sky or the green of growing plants (Kangxi 靑: 靑生也); a very light green or blue tint; wan, fading away, pale; the 174th radical (U+2FAD ⾭ "blue"); _(1)ts(')ing (2)kwo_ (cing1 gwo2 青果), the olive; _fat(9) (1)ts(')ing_ (fat6 cing1 佛青), ultra-marine; _(4)(un (1)ts(')ing_ (jyun4 cing1 玄青), black; _(1)ts(')ing (1)kam_ (cing1 gam1 青金), lapis-lazuli color; _luk(9) (1)ts(')ing_ (luk6 cing1 綠青), copperas; _(1)ts(')ing (4)f(a/)n_ (cing1 faan4 青礬), blue vitriol; _(4)y(e/)ung (1)ts(')ing_ (joeng4 cing1 洋青), smalts; _~~(1)ts(')ing~~ (1)ts(')eng (4)t(')oi_ (ceng1 toi4 青苔), ~~mossy, slippery, as stones~~ moss; _(1)ts(')ing (1)t(')(i/)n p(a/)k(9) yat(9)_ (cing1 tin1 baak6 jat6 青天白日) a clear bright day; _(1)ts(')ing (4)n(i/)n_ (cing1 nin4 青年), young in years; _m(i/)t(9) (1)ts(')ing_ (mit6 cing1 篾青), bamboo splints; _(4)t(')ang (1)ts(')ing_ (tang4 cing1 藤青), rattan cords; _k(o\)m(3) (5)ng(a/)n (1)ts(')ing_ (gam3 ngaan5 cing1 咁眼青) in such a fury, outrageous; _(1)pi(u/) (1)ts(')eng_ (biu1 ceng1 標青), new style, fine; _t(a/)p(9) (1)ts(')eng_, (daap6 ceng1 踏青) to worship the tombs; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)ts(')ing_ (caa4 cing1 茶青), a yellowish green; _(4)k(')(i/) (i/)p(9) (1)ts(')eng (1)ts(')eng_ (kei4 jip6 ceng1 ceng1 其葉青青), tender and green are the leaves. Williams' 青苔: Changed _(1)ts(')ing_ (cing1) to vernacular reading _(1)ts(')eng_ (ceng1). 【青】 (tsheng) (_adjective-like_) blue, green, black 【標青】 (biu1 ceng1) Outstanding, excellent. 【青】 (ceng1) Green, especially light green. 青吡吡 (ceng1 bi1 bi1): "Limey-green." 採青 (coi2 ceng1): "Plucking the green" (i.e. the lettuce in a Lion Dance). Green garnishes (spring onion, coriander, parsley, etc.). 走青 (zau2 ceng1): "Without any green garnishes." Faded or cut close to the scalp (of hair). Unclear if this should be spelt 清 instead. 兩邊剷青 (loeng5 bin1 caan2 ceng1): "Faded on both sides." 飛青啲 (fei1 ceng1 di1): "Cut it closer." 【青啤啤】 (ceng1 bi1 bi1) Very light or lime green. The spelling 啤啤 for the suffix bi1 bi1 is arbitrary. 【青豆】 (ceng1 dau6-2) Green peas. 【青瓜】 (ceng1 gwaa1) Cucumber. 【青檸】 (ceng1 ning4-2) Lime. (Literally, "green lemon".) 【面青】 (min6 ceng1) Pale complexion (as a sign of unhealth).

ceng2.text: U+8ACB May appear as either ⿰訁靑 or ⿰訁青 (assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 578 #3: (2)請 _(2)Ts(')ing_ (cing2); _(2)Ts(')eng_ (ceng2) implied by variational note)

cing2.text: U+8ACB May appear as either ⿰訁靑 or ⿰訁青 (assumed here), depending on the font. 请 (Mainland simplified) ceng2 (vernacular) (F1.72 請) 敬請迎請又托也 (Page 578 #3: (2)請) To request, to ask courteously, to pray, to beg (Kangxi: 謁也, 求也, 乞也問也, 祈也扣也); to request liberty to do, to ask, as for orders; to invite, to bid, to engage; to confess, to acknowledge; to inform (Kangxi: 吿也); _(2)ts(')ing ~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o_ (cing2 co5 請坐) please be seated; _(2)ts(')eng (2)tsau_ (ceng2 zau2 請酒), to ask to a dinner; _(2)ts(')ing (2)tsau t(')(i/)p(8)_ (cing2 zau2 tip3-2 請酒帖) an invitation to dinner; _(2)ts(')eng k(a/)u(3)_ (ceng2 gaau3 請教) please tell me; _(2)ts(')ing (4)k(')(i/)_ (cing2 kei4 請期), to appoint the time of marriage; _(2)ts(')ing p(i/)n(6)_ (cing2 bin6 請便) don't let me take your time; _(2)ts(')eng (5)li(u/)_ (ceng2 liu5 請了), has been invited; _(2)ts(')eng (1)s(i/)n ~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng_ (ceng2 sin1 saang1 請先生), to engage a teacher; _(2)ts(')ing (4)ch(')(a/)_ (cing2 caa4 請茶), please take your tea; _(2)ts(')ing (1)ts(')(a/)m_ (cing2 caam1 請參), to request dismissal from office, to throw it up; _(2)ts(')ing k(a/)(3)_ (cing2 gaa3 請駕) please go, Sir; _(2)ts(')ing ming(6)_ (cing2 ming6 請命) what do you wish? _(2)ts(')ing (a/)(3)_ (cing2 aa3 請啊) please; your good health; _(2)ts(')ing ts(u/)i(6)_ (cing2 zeoi6 請罪) to apologize, to confess; _(2)ts(')eng yik(7)_ (ceng2 jik1 請益) please let me know; _(2)ts(')eng man(6)_ (ceng2 man6 請問) to beg, to ask; _(2)ts(')ing (2)ts(')ing_ (cing2 cing2 請請), thank you; good bye; (the word _chin-chin_ is derived from this phrase;) _(2)ts(')eng h(u(3) shik(9) ~~f(a/)n(3)~~ f(a/)n(6)_ (ceng2 heoi3 sik6 faan6 請去食飯) invited out to dine. Williams' 請坐: Corrected _tso(6)_ (zo6 去聲) to _(5)ts(')o_ (co5 上聲). Williams' 請教: To ask or consult with someone (more knowledgeable than oneself). Williams' 請先生: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). Williams' 請命: More a third-person indicative than a second-person interrogative. Williams' 請益: More a third-person indicative than a second-person request. Williams' 請問: More a second-person interrogative than a third-person indicative. Williams' 請去食飯: Corrected _f(a/)n(3)_ (faan3) to _f(a/)n(6)_ (faan6). 【請】 (tshjengX) (_verb-like_) to request, to ask

ceoi1.text: U+50AC (F2.80 催) 促也趲也 (Page 598 #3: (1)~~傕~~催) To urge, to press, to egg on (Kangxi 催: 促也迫也); to importune; to hasten, as the payment of a debt; ~~to reiterate;~~ _mok(9) ko(3) (1)ts(')(u/)i (5)ngo_ (mok6 go3 ceoi1 ngo5 莫個催我), don't hurry me; _(1)ts(')(u/)i pik(7)_ (ceoi1 bik1 催逼) or _(1)ts(')(u/)i (2)kam_ (ceoi1 gam2 催？), to urge on, to stimulate; _(1)ts(')(u/)i (5)k(')(u f(a/)i(3) tik(7)_ (ceoi1 keoi5 faai3 dik1 催佢快滴) hurry him on a little; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) k(a/)i(3) (2)tsau (1)ts(')(u/)i_ (fat6 gaai3 zau2 ceoi1 乏价走催), I've no servant to send to hasten you --- a phrase on invitation cards; _(2)h(i/) shai(3) k(o\)m(3) (1)ts(')(u/)i_ (hei2 sai3 gam3 ceoi1 起勢咁催), hurrying and urging one rather causelessly. Williams misprints 催 as 傕; here corrected. (The character 催 appears correctly on Page 741 in the character index.) Williams' 乏价走催: Changed _f(a/)t(9)_ (faat6) to modern _fat(9)_ (fat6). 【催】 (tshwoj) (_verb-like_) to press (upon)

U+5439 炊 龡 (F2.55 吹) 風吹又吹噓 (F2.55 龡) 同上 (Page 34* #3: (1)吹(1)龡) To blow (Kangxi 吹: 噓也, 出氣也), as the wind or by breath; to whistle; to puff (Kangxi 吹: 吹噓相佐助也); a blast, a gust; to play on a wind instrument; _(1)ch(')ui (1)h(u (5)h(a/)_ (ceoi1 heoi1 haa5 吹噓吓), recommend him; _(1)ch(')ui ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (ceoi1 coeng3 吹唱) singing and playing; _(1)ch(')ui (4)t(')ung_ (ceoi1 tung4 吹筒), to blow the sumpitan; _(1)ch(')ui (1)tang_ (ceoi1 dang1 吹燈), blow out the lamp; _(1)tang (1)ch(')ui_ (dang1 ceoi1 燈吹), a blowpipe; _(1)ch(')ui (2)t(a/) (2)l(o\)_ (ceoi1 daa2 lou2 吹打佬), musicians; _(1)ch(')ui (2)fo (4)t(')ung ch(')ut(7) (1)shan_ (ceoi1 fo2 tung4 ceot1 san1 吹火筒出身), began life as a firelighter. (Page 34* #4: (1)炊) Used for the last (吹) (Kangxi 炊: 與吹同). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword (with 比-like centre-left instead of ⿲口口口) to 龡. 【吹】 (tsyhwe) (_verb-like_) to blow 【吹】 (ceoi1) Short for 吹水. Short for 吹脹 in the rhetorical interrogative sense, where one taunts a victim for retributive action after inflicting an injustice upon them. 吹呀 (ceoi1 a4): "Gonna rile me?" (i.e. what can you do in response?) 吹咩 (ceoi1 me1): "Gonna rile me?" (i.e. what can you do in response?) 【吹水】 (ceoi1 seoi2) To brag, to boast, to exaggerate. 又吹水 (jau6 ceoi1 seoi2): "Talking big again eh?" 正一吹水哥 (zing1 jat1 ceoi1 seoi2 go1): "He's a right big-mouth." To converse casually. 得閒吹吓水 (dak1 haan4 ceoi1 haa5 seoi2): "When we're free let's have a chat." 【吹脹】 (ceoi1 zoeng3) To vex, to irk. 真係吹脹 (zan1 hai6 ceoi1 zoeng3): "It's really riled me up!" 吹佢唔脹 (ceoi1 keoi5 m4 zoeng3): "Can't rile him up."

U+5D14 ceoi4 (per 《廣韻》昨回切 for "lofty" sense) (F2.80 崔) 高貌又姓 (Page 598 #2: (1)崔) Lofty, mountainous (Kangxi: 高大也, 崔嵬也); rugged, as a hilly country; _(1)ts(')(u/)i (4)ngai_ (ceoi1 ngai4 崔嵬), lofty, rocky hills and peaks. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【崔】 (dzwoj) (_adjective-like_) lofty, mountainous
U+63A8 (F2.55 推) 讓也奬也薦也又尋繹也 (F2.80 推 _(1)T(')(u/)i_ (teoi1)) 透杯切盪也排擠也祛也 (Page 34* #5: (1)推)

U+6467 ceoi4 (per 《廣韻》昨回切) (F2.81 摧 _(4)Ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi4)) 挫也折也抑也阻摧 (Page 598 #6: (4)摧 _(4)Ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi4); here normalised to _(1)Ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi1)) To stop, to drive back, to repress (Kangxi: 挫也抑也); to overpower, to set down; to push upon, to thrust forward, to crowd against, to impel (Kangxi: 擠也); to break (Kangxi: 一曰折也), as the wind does trees; to reach (Kangxi: 摧詹至也); to put out, to extinguish, as a family (Kangxi: 滅也); _~~(4)ts(')(u/)i~~ (1)ts(')(u/)i yik(7)_ (ceoi1 jik1 摧抑) to abate, to put down; _~~(4)ts(')(u/)i~~ (1)ts(')(u/)i ch(i/)t(8)_ (ceoi1 zit3 摧折) to break off by pushing against. 【摧】 (dzwoj) (_verb-like_) to push (_verb-like_) to break, to destroy

ceoi4.text: U+6467 (F2.81 摧) 挫也折也抑也阻摧 (Page 598 #6: (4)摧)

ceoi1.text: U+708A (F2.55 炊) 炊爨 (Page 34* #4: (1)炊) To dress food; to cook (Kangxi: 爨也); _(1)ch(')ui f(a/)n(6)_ (ceoi1 faan6 炊飯) to cook rice. Fan Wan entry: Corrected bottom component of 爨 from 夾 to ⿳林大火.
U+7480 ceoi2 (per 《廣韻》七罪切 ) (F2.80 璀) 璀璨丰彩貌 (Page 598 #4: (1)璀) The lustre of a gem (Kangxi: 璀璨玉光也); a gem hanging down, as from the girdle (Kangxi: 璀璨珠垂貌). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 琛 to 璨.

U+7E17 衰 缞 (Mainland simplified) (F2.80 衰) 齊衰喪服也 (F2.80 縗) 同上 (Page 598 #5: (1)衰(1)縗) The unhemmed, frayed edges of mourning clothes (Kangxi 縗: 喪服也), which are left so; to ravel out; _(2)ch(a/)m (1)ts(')(u/)i_ (zaam2 ceoi1 斬縗), clipped, unhemmed. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 裘 to 喪, and corrected 土 to 上. 【縗】 (tshwoj) (_noun-like_) mourning-clothes, sackcloth

U+86C6 zeoi1 (common) (F1.44 蛆) 蛆虫 (Page 595 #9: (1)蛆) Maggots in putrid flesh (Kangxi: 肉中蟲也); flyblows, eggs of flies (Kangxi: 蠅乳); _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng (1)ts(')(u_ (saang1 ceoi1 生蛆), it has bred worms; _s(ut(8) (1)ts(')(u_ (syut3 ceoi1 雪蛆), worms found in snow in Sz'chuen (四川), a sort of Protococcus. Williams' 生蛆: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1).

zeoi1.text: U+86C6 (Page 595 #9: (1)蛆) Read _(1)ts(u_ (zeoi1), a millipede; _tsik(7) (1)ts(u_ (zik1 zeoi1 蝍蛆), a centipede (Kangxi: 蝍蛆食蛇蜈蚣也).

ceoi1.text: U+8870 (F2.80 衰) 齊衰喪服也 (F2.80 縗) 同上 (Page 598 #5: (1)衰(1)縗) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 裘 to 喪, and corrected 土 to 上.

ci4.text: U+8D8D According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, the explanation 久也 (for the term 趍趙) should read 夊也, to go slowly (supplemented below). Karlgren has "to run" for 趍 on a Stone Drum inscription. Used in 趍趙 (to go slowly) (Kangxi: 趍趙夊也).

ceoi1.text: U+8DA8 趋 趍 (F1.44 趨) 趨向 (F1.44 趋) 同上 (Page 595 #8: (1)趨(1)趋) To hasten to one's place (Kangxi 趨: 疾行曰趨趨赴也赴所至也, 趨今之捷步), to stride off (Kangxi 趨: 行而張足曰趨), as in a superior's presence; to run, to walk quick (Kangxi 趨: 走也, 行也); _(1)ts(')(u (4)sh(i/)_ (ceoi1 si4 趨時), to run after, as a fashion; _(1)ts(')(u p(o\)(6)_ (ceoi1 bou6 趨步) to straddle off, as a courier does; _(1)ts(')(u (4)(i/)m f(u/)(6) shai(3)_ (ceoi1 jim4 fu6 sai3 趨炎附勢) to run to the flame and stick to the strong --- a parasite. 【趨】 (tshju) (_verb-like_) to haste toward
U+9FA1 (F2.55 吹) 風吹又吹噓 (F2.55 龡) 同上 (Page 34* #3: (1)吹(1)龡) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword (with 比-like centre-left instead of ⿲口口口) to 龡.

ceoi2.text: U+53D6 (F1.46 取) 索也獲也收也愛也攬也資也 (Page 595 #11: (2)取) To take, to lay hold on (Kangxi: 捕取也), to use; to exact; to seize on, to take away; to assume, to appropriate (Kangxi: 資也收也); to receive (Kangxi: 受也), to apply to one's use; to get, to induce, to bring upon; taken, applied, selected; _(1)shau (2)ts(')(u_ (sau1 ceoi2 收取), to receive; _(2)ts(')(u (4)'m (5)sh(e/)ung_ (ceoi2 m4 soeng5 取唔上), not needed, unfit; _(2)ts(')(u chung(3)_ (ceoi2 zung3 取中) promoted, chosen, selected; _t(a/)i(6) (5)yau (2)ho (2)ts(')(u_ (daai6 jau5 ho2 ceoi2 大有可取), estimable, one who is liked; _(2)ts(')(u ch(')ut(7)_ (ceoi2 ceot1 取出) taken out; _(2)ts(')(u yap(9)_ (ceoi2 jap6 取入) brought in; _t(')(a/)m(3) (4)nong (2)ts(')(u mat(9)_ (taam3 nong4 ceoi2 mat6 探囊取物) as easy as taking cash out of the purse; _sok(8) (2)ts(')(u_ (sok3 ceoi2 索取), to beg earnestly for, as a loan; _(2)ts(')(u si(u/)(3) (5)k(')(u_ (ceoi2 siu3 keoi5 取笑佢), to get the joke on him; _tsz'(6) (2)ts(')(u wo(6)_ (zi6 ceoi2 wo6 自取禍) to bring down misery on one's self; _tsau(6) t(i/)(6) (2)ts(')(u (4)ts(')oi_ (zau6 dei6 ceoi2 coi4 就地取材), happily I just then turned it up, as something that was wanted; _(4)'m (4)shing kwo(3) (2)ts(')(u_ (m4 sing4 gwo3 ceoi2 唔成過取), I don't want much; _h(i/)p(8) (2)ts(')(u_ (hip3 ceoi2 脅取), to force from, to extort; _(4)p(')ang (4)man (2)ts(')(u luk(9)_ (pang4 man4 ceoi2 luk6 憑文取錄) to select the compositions according to their style; _(4)mung (2)ts(')(u fo(3)_ (mung4 ceoi2 fo3 蒙取貨) obliged to you for taking goods, --- as shopmen say. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱宀⿱宀厼 to 索, and normalised 𫉬 to 獲. 【取】 (tshjuX, tshuwX) (_verb-like_) to take

U+5A36 取 ceoi3 (per 《廣韻》七句切) cou2 (uncommon vernacular) (F1.48 娶 _Ts(')(u(3)_ (ceoi3)) 取婦曰娶 (Page 595 #11: (2)取; here normalised to 娶) to take, as a wife; (Page 596 #1: 娶(3) _Ts(')(u(3)_ (ceoi3); here normalised to _(2)Ts(')(u_ (ceoi2)) To marry a woman with the legal ceremonies (Kangxi: 取婦也); a marriage; _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (1)ts(')ai_ (ceoi2 cai1 娶妻), or _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (5)l(o\) (4)p(')o_ (ceoi2 lou5 po4 娶老婆), to take a wife; _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (1)san (5)f(u/)_ (ceoi2 san1 fu5 娶新婦) or _~~(2)ts(')(o\)~~ (2)ts(')(u ~~(1)sam~~ (1)san (5)p(')(o\)_ (ceoi2 san1 pou5 娶新婦), ~~somebady~~ a son marrying; _(4)wing ~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (4)'m (4)ts(')ang_ (wing4 ceoi2 m4 cang4 榮娶唔曾), have you ~~been married~~ taken a wife yet? _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (ceoi2 cip3 娶妾) or _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (1)p(')(i/)n (4)fong_ (ceoi2 pin1 fong4 娶偏房), to take a concubine home to one. Williams' 娶新婦 (second occurrence): Normalised _(2)ts(')(o\)_ (cou2) to _(2)ts(')(u_ (ceoi2) and corrected _(1)sam_ (sam1) to _(1)san_ (san1). 【娶】 (tshjuH) (_verb-like_) to take a wife

zeoi3.text: U+60F4 ceoi2 (per Fan Wan) cyun2 (common) (F2.56 惴 _(2)Ch(')ui_ (ceoi2)) 恐懼貌 (Page 34* #10: (2)惴 _(2)Ch(')ui_ (ceoi2); here normalised to _Chui(3)_ (zeoi3)) ~~Mournful~~ Anxious, apprehensive (Kangxi: 憂懼也); ~~in straits;~~ _~~(2)ch(')ui (2)ch(')ui~~ chui(3) chui(3)_ (zeoi3 zeoi3 惴惴), ~~mourning, grieving~~; _~~(2)ch(')ui~~ chui(3) k(u(6)_ (zeoi3 geoi6 惴懼) anxious. Anxious, apprehensive (Kangxi: 憂懼也). 【惴】 (tsyweH) (_adjective-like_) apprehensive

ceoi2.text: U+63E3 (F2.56 揣) 吹上聲揣度揣摩 (Page 34* #9: (2)揣)

cyun2.text: U+63E3 ceoi2 (per 《廣韻》初委切) (F2.56 揣 _(2)Ch(')ui_ (ceoi2)) 吹上聲揣度揣摩 (Page 34* #9: (2)揣) Also read _(2)ch(')(un_ (cyun2). To estimate, to calculate, to reckon (Kangxi: 量也, 量度也, 凡稱量忖度皆曰揣); to feel, to try, to rub, in order to ascertain (Kangxi: 一曰捫而察之也); to detect; ~~to~~ _~~(2)ch(')ui~~ (2)ch(')(un tok(9)_ (cyun2 dok6 揣度) to conjecture; _~~(2)ch(')ui~~ (2)ch(')(un (1)mo_ (cyun2 mo1 揣摩), to feel, to learn one's wishes, to seek out the sense; _pat(7) ~~(2)ch(')ui~~ (2)ch(')(un_ (bat1 cyun2 不揣), unable to detect. Williams' "Also read ...": This reading _(2)ch(')(un_ (cyun2) is the canonical reading today. I have normalised _(2)ch(')ui_ (ceoi2) in the examples to it. 【揣】 (tsrhjweX) (_verb-like_) to measure, to reckon

ceoi2.text: U+6F3C (F2.81 漼 _(4)Ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi4)) 情回切水深貌 (Page 598 #7: (4)~~㴶~~漼 _(4)Ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi4); here corrected to _(2)Ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi2)) Deep (Kangxi 漼: 深也), clear water; tears trickling down (Kangxi 漼: 涕垂貌); fresh, new (Kangxi 漼: 鮮明也), clean; spoiling, ruining (Kangxi 漼: 壞貌); name of a stream (Kangxi 漼: 水名). 【漼】 (tshwojX) (_adjective-like_) deep

ceoi4.text: U+6F3C (F2.81 漼) 情回切水深貌 (Page 598 #7: (4)~~㴶~~漼) snow drifted (Kangxi 漼: 漼溰雪霜積聚貌);

ceoi3.text: U+5550 seoi6 (per Fan Wan, common) (F2.24 啐 _Ts(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) 尊入聲嘗入口也又咄啐呼也 (F2.57 啐 _Sui(6)_ (seoi6)) 咄啐呼也驚也又嘗入口也 (Page 609 #7: 啐(8) _Ts(ut(8)_ (zyut3); here corrected to _Ts(')(u/)i(3)_ (ceoi3)) To taste (Kangxi: 嘗也, 嘗入口)~~, to craunch~~; A berating puff (Kangxi: 咄啐嘑也). 【啐】 (tshwojH) (_verb-like_) to sip, to taste

zyut3.text: U+5550 zeot1 (per 《廣韻》子聿切 for onomatopoeic senses) (F2.24 啐) 尊入聲嘗入口也又咄啐呼也 (Page 609 #7: 啐(8)) (...), the noise of sucking (Kangxi: 吮聲)~~, or swallowing with a gusto~~;

ceoi3.text: U+6BF3 (F2.56 毳 _Ch(')ui(3)_) 獸毛褥也 (Page 597 #6: 毳(3)) The down on birds, the fine undergrowth of hair on animals (Kangxi: 獸細毛也); ~~birds molting;~~ furry, downy, soft, fine, delicate; like felt, velvety; _(4)m(i/)n ts(')ui(3)_ (min4 ceoi3 綿毳) cotton staple; _(2)fo ts(')ui(3)_ (fo2 ceoi3 火毳) asbestos cloth; _ts(')ui(3) mok(9)_ (ceoi3 mok6 毳幕) a felt tent. 《廣韻》 gives both 此芮切 _ts(')ui(3)_ (per Williams) and 楚稅切 _ch(')ui(3)_ (per Fan Wan). Williams' "birds molting": Probably a misreading of Kangxi 鳥腹毛曰毳. 【毳】 (tshjwejH, tsrhjwejH) (_noun-like_) fine-hair

U+7FE0 (F2.56 翠) 翡翠鳥羽也赤曰翡靑曰翠 (Page 597 #5: 翠(3)) The female of a kingfisher, whose feathers are used in plumagery (Kangxi: 靑羽雀也, 雄曰翡雌曰翠); _ts(')ui(3) ki(u/)(6)_ (ceoi3 giu6-2 翠轎) a bridal chair covered with feathers; _ts(')ui(3) (4)t(')ing_ (ceoi3 ting4 翠亭), a feathered shrine ~~or car~~; _(2)t(i/)m ts(')ui(3)_ (dim2 ceoi3 點翠) to put on feathers; _ts(')ui(3) (4)m(o\)_ (ceoi3 mou4 翠毛), the kingfisher's feathers; _ts(')ui(3) shik(7)_ (ceoi3 sik1 翠色) a ~~purplish blue~~ jade-like green. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 日 to 曰.
U+8103 May appear with right component as 絶 (assumed here) or 絕, depending on the font. (Page 597 #7: 脃(3)脆(3))

U+8106 脃 ceoi3-2 (rising second in vernacular 脆脆地) (F2.56 脆) 物易斷也又輕薄也 (Page 597 #7: 脃(3)脆(3)) Delicate, easily broken (Kangxi 脃: 小耎易斷也); brittle, crackling; shivery, crumbling; crisp, light (Kangxi 脃: 輕也), as crust; trifling, unsteady in character; _(2)shong ts(')ui(3)_ (song2 ceoi3 爽脆) delicate, as cakes; _(1)kon ts(')ui(3)_ (gon1 ceoi3 乾脆) cracks when dry; _(4)h(a/)m ts(')ui(3) (1)f(a/) (1)shang_ (haam4 ceoi3 faa1 sang1 鹹脆花生), baked salt ground nuts; _(4)t(')i(u/) meng(6) ap(7) ap(7) ts(')ui(3)_ (tiu4 meng6 ap1 ap1 ceoi3 條命洽洽脆) life snaps asunder like crust. Williams' 爽脆: More crunchy than delicate. Williams' 乾脆: Figuratively, clear-cut. 【脆】 (tshjwejH) (_adjective-like_) brittle 【扑扑脆】 (bok1 bok1 ceoi3) Crispy. (Also heard as lok1 lok1 ceoi3, or ngok1 ngok1 ceoi3.) 【脆扑扑】 (ceoi3 bok1 bok1) Crispy. The spelling 扑 for bok1 is arbitrary (but well established).
U+89B0 (F1.48 覻) 竊視曰覻 (Page 596 #3: 覰(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword 覻.

U+89B7 覰 觑 (Mainland simplified) (F1.48 覻) 竊視曰覻 (Page 596 #3: 覰(3); here normalised to 覷) To spy, to look at; to peep, to descry, to reconnoitre (Kangxi 覰: 伺視也); _ts(')(u(3) (1)p(i/)n_ (ceoi3 bin1 覷邊), to look after the frontiers closely. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword 覻.

ceoi4.text: U+53A8 (F1.45 厨) 庖厨 (Page 32* #7: (4)廚(4)厨) Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𢊍 to 厨.

cyu4.text: U+53A8 (F1.45 厨) 庖厨 (Page 32* #7: (4)廚(4)厨) Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𢊍 to 厨.

ceoi4.text: U+210F4 隨 (Cantonese) (Page 597 #3: (4)隨; here normalised to 𡃴) A colloquial word. A smell, a stench; bad breath; _yat(7) pung(6) (4)ts(')ui_ (jat1 bung6 ceoi4 一𩗴𡃴), a stench; _(5)yau tik(7) (4)ts(')ui sik(7)_ (jau5 dik1 ceoi4 sik1 有滴𡃴息) there is some bad smell. 【𡃴】 (ceoi4) A smell or odour. 有𠹻𡃴 (jau5 zam6 ceoi4): "There's an odour." 男人𡃴 (naam4 jan4 ceoi4): "Man smell." 老人𡃴 (lou5 jan4 ceoi4): "Old person smell." The spelling 𡃴 is arbitrary.

U+5EDA 厨 㕑 ceoi4-2 (uncommon vernacular for "chef" sense) cyu4 (alternative) cyu4-2 (vernacular for "chef" sense) (F1.45 厨) 庖厨 (Page 32* #7: (4)廚(4)厨) A kitchen, a cook-room (Kangxi 廚: 庖屋也); a slaughter-house; a ~~quiver~~ box or cabinet (Kangxi 廚: 櫝也); _(4)ch(')(u (4)yan_ (cyu4 jan4 廚人) or _(4)ch(')(u (1)k(u/)n_ (cyu4 gun1 廚官), a cook; _(1)pong (4)ch(')(u (4)yan_ (bong1 cyu4 jan4 幫廚人), a cook's mate, a scullion; _ki(u/)(3) ts(o\)(6) (4)ch(')(u_ (giu3 zou6 cyu4-2 叫做廚), call the cook; _(4)ch(')(u (4)fong_ (cyu4 fong4-2 廚房), a kitchen. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𢊍 to 厨. 【廚】 (drju) (_noun-like_) kitchen

cyu4.text: U+5EDA (F1.45 厨) 庖厨 (Page 32* #7: (4)廚(4)厨) Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𢊍 to 厨.

ceoi4.text: U+5F90 (F1.45 徐) 緩也又姓 (Page 595 #10: (4)徐) Grave, serious, leisurely; tardy, slow (Kangxi: 緩也, 遲也); composed (Kangxi: 安行也), majestic, dignified (Kangxi: 威儀也); to walk carefully and formally; _(4)ts(')(u p(o\)(6)_ (ceoi4 bou6 徐步) to walk gracefully; _(4)ts(')(u (4)ts(')(u_ (ceoi4 ceoi4 徐徐), gravely, tranquilly, as a gait. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰糸⿱刀交 to 緩. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【徐】 (zjo) (_adverb-like_) slowly, gently (_adjective-like_) composed, dignified
U+6376 搥 zeoi2 (per 《廣韻》之累切) (Page 34* #7: (4)搥; here normalised to 捶) To beat (Kangxi 捶: 以杖擊也); to strike, as on a bell; 【捶】 (tsyweX) (_verb-like_) to beat

zeoi1.text: U+690E 㮅 (for tree-type sense) A vertebra (in 脊椎 etc.). A type of tree, like the chestnut but small (Kangxi: 木名似栗而小).

ceoi4.text: U+69CC 搥 捶 (for verb senses) 椎 ceoi4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.56 椎) 木椎 (F2.56 槌) 同上 (Page 34* #6: (4)槌(4)椎) A mallet, a beater, a club, a bludgeon (Kangxi 槌: 棒槌所以擊也); a beetle; to beat, to strike (Kangxi 槌: 擊也); _(4)ch(')ui (2)k(u/)_ (ceoi4 gu2 槌鼓), to drum; _(2)k(u/) (4)ch(')ui_ (gu2 ceoi4 鼓槌), a drumstick; _(2)t(a/) (1)chong (4)ch(')ui_ (daa2 zong1 ceoi4 打樁槌), a pile-hammer; _~~(4)lui~~ (4)l(u/)i (4)ch(')ui_ (leoi4 ceoi4 擂槌), a triturating pestle; _met._ large fingers; _(4)ch(')ui p(u/)i(3)_ (ceoi4 bui3 槌背) to shampoo. (Page 34* #7: (4)搥) Like the last (槌). Williams' 擂槌: Corrected _(4)lui_ to _(4)l(u/)i_.
U+6EC1 cyu4 (uncommon) (F1.45 滁) 水名 (Page 32* #3: (4)滁) A branch of the R. Y(a/)ngtsz' (揚子江) flowing in between Nanking (南京) and (I/)ching (？？); a city in the east of Ng(a/)nhwui (安徽).

U+7BE8 cyu4 (uncommon) (F1.45 篨) 籧篨醜疾也 (Page 32* #4: (4)篨) A mat (Kangxi: 籧篨竹席) rolled up; _(4)k(')(u (4)ch(')(u_ (keoi4 ceoi4 籧篨), a coarse mat; _met._ a bad ailment, repulsive (Kangxi: 醜疾名)~~, hunchbacked~~. Williams' 籧篨: Not hunchbacked, but swollen. Kangxi has 編籧篨爲囷如人之擁腫而不能俯故以名醜疾也, so 籧篨 is the inability to look down (which is somewhat the opposite of being hunchbacked).

cyu4.text: U+7BE8 (F1.45 篨) 籧篨醜疾也 (Page 32* #4: (4)篨)

ceoi4.text: U+870D cyu4 (alternative) syu4 (uncommon) (Page 32* #1: (4)蜍) A toad (Kangxi: 蟾蜍也); _(4)sh(i/)m (4)ch(')(u_ (sim4 ceoi4 蟾蜍), vulgo, _(4)k(')am (4)k(')(u_ (kam4 keoi4 蠄蟝), a toad.

U+8E95 蹰 𨆼 cyu4 (alternative) (F1.45 蹰) 踟蹰 (Page 32* #8: (4)𨆼; here normalised to 躕) Embarrassed, hindered (Kangxi 躕: 踟躕行不進貌); _(4)ch(')(i/) (4)ch(')(u_ (ci4 ceoi4 踟躕), entangled. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿰𧾷⿸广⿰豆寸 to 蹰. Williams' "Embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed". 【躕】 (drju) Used in 踟躕.

U+9318 鎚 (for "hammer" senses) 锤 (Mainland simplified) ceoi4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.56 錘) 鉄錘又秤錘 (Page 34* #8: (4)錘(4)鎚) The weight on a steelyard (Kangxi 錘: 稱錘也); a hammer; to hammer; to beat, to pound; a blow, a knock; _(4)ch(')ui (4)t(')au_ (ceoi4 tau4 錘頭), the fist; _(4)w(a/)ng (4)ch(')ui_ (waang4 ceoi4 橫錘), a side blow; _yat(7) (4)ch(')ui (2)t(a/) (2)t(o\)_ (jat1 ceoi4 daa2 dou2 一錘打倒), felled him with a blow; _(4)ch(')ui l(a/)n(6)_ (ceoi4 laan6 錘爛) hammered to pieces. The first word (錘) also means a weight of 12 taels (Kangxi 錘: 六兩曰鍿倍鍿曰錘〇按此與說文解異). Williams' "12 taels": As noted by Kangxi, this differs from the 《說文》 definition of 八銖, which works out to one third of a tael. Williams' 一錘打倒: Corrected _yat_ (jat) to _yat(7)_ (jat1). 【錘】 (ceoi4) A punch with the fist. 打佢兩錘 (daa2 keoi5 loeng5 ceoi4): "Hit him with two blows." 【錘仔】 (ceoi4 zai2) A hammer.

U+9664 cyu4 (uncommon) (F1.45 除) 消除 (Page 32* #2: (4)除) Steps to a palace (Kangxi: 殿陛也); a vestibule (Kangxi: 除謂門屛之閒); to exclude, to remove (Kangxi: 去也); to deduct, to subtract; to except from; to cure (Kangxi: 病愈者或謂之除); to exchange (Kangxi: 易也); to vacate (Kangxi: 開也); to divide (Kangxi: 算法有乗除); besides, exclusive of; _(4)ch(')(u lat(7)_ (ceoi4 lat1 除甩) throw it away as useless; _(4)ch(')(u (1)f(i/)_ (ceoi4 fei1 除非), if, when, thenceafter, premising, not reckoning; _(4)ch(')(u ch(')ut(7)_ (ceoi4 ceot1 除出) to exclude, to lay by; _(4)ch(')(u fuk(9)_ (ceoi4 fuk6 除服) to lay aside mourning; _(1)kwai (4)ch(')(u_ (gwai1 ceoi4 歸除), to multiply or divide; _(4)ch(')(u (4)p(')(i/) (2)k(i/) (1)to (1)kan_ (ceoi4 pei4 gei2 do1 gan1 除皮幾多斤), how many pounds beside the tare? _(4)ch(')(u ch(')(a/)k(8) (4)m(a/)i shing(6) (1)n(i/) tik(7)_ (ceoi4 caak3 maai4 sing6 ni1 dik1 除拆埋剩呢滴) so much remains after deducting; _(4)ch(')(u (1)k(u/)n_ (ceoi4 gun1 除官), to exchange office; to promote to a post; _(4)ch(')(u (1)hi(u/) (5)n(i/) (4)m(o\) (4)yan ts(o\)(6) tak(7)_ (ceoi4 hiu1 nei5 mou4 jan4 zou6 dak1 除嘵你無人做得) nobody can do it besides you; _(4)ch(')(u h(u(3)_ (ceoi4 heoi3 除去) to push away, to eject. 【除】 (drjo) (_verb-like_) to remove (_verb-like_) to divide 【除】 (ceoi4) To remove clothing, accessories, footwear, etc. 除衫 (ceoi4 saam1): "Take off clothes." 除褲 (ceoi4 fu3): "Take off pants." 除帽 (ceoi4 mou6-2): "Take off a hat." 除鞋 (ceoi4 haai4): "Take off shoes."
U+968B (F2.56 隋) 國名 (Page 597 #4: (4)隋) A dynasty, which ruled from A. D. ~~590~~~581--~~620~~~619, preceding the T(')(a/)ng (唐) dynasty.

U+96A8 随 (Mainland simplified) (F2.56 隨) 從也順也 (Page 597 #3: (4)隨) To follow, to accord with, to yield, to comply obediently (Kangxi: 從也順也); to permit, to let; the way or usage of; an adverb, according to, as, like, wherever; forthwith, presently; a feudal state now _(4)Ts(')ui (1)chau_ (ceoi4 zau1 隨州) in the northeast of H(u/)peh (湖北); _(4)ts(')ui (4)sh(i/) ts(o\)(6)_ (ceoi4 si4 zou6 隨時做) do it as I have time; _(4)ts(')ui p(i/)n(6)_ (ceoi4 bin6-2 隨便) as you please; very well; _(4)ts(')ui (5)ngo (4)lai_ (ceoi4 ngo5 lai4 隨我嚟), come after me; _(4)ts(')ui tsoi(6) (5)ngo_ (ceoi4 zoi6 ngo5 隨在我), the decision is with me; _(4)ts(')ui tak(7) (5)k(')(u_ (ceoi4 dak1 keoi5 隨得佢), let him do as he likes; _(4)ts(')ui yat(7) t(o\)(3) (i/)(6)_ (ceoi4 jat1 dou3 ji6 隨一到二) do the second like (or after) the first; _(4)ts(')ui k(a/)(3) m(u/)i(6)_ (ceoi4 gaa3 mui6-2 隨嫁妹) a waiting-maid given at marriage, like Zilpah; _(4)ts(')ui ch(')(u(3) (2)kong_ (ceoi4 cyu3 gong2 隨處講), talkiing about it everywhere; _(4)ts(')ui (2)shi(u/) (4)loi_ (ceoi4 siu2 loi4 隨少來), bring a little of it, as you can get it; _(4)ts(')ui tsik(7)_ (ceoi4 zik1 隨即) immediately; _(4)ts(')ui ch(')(u(3) (1)k(a/)i (4)(i/)n_ (ceoi4 cyu3 gaai1 jin4 隨處皆然), it is all about, they are everywhere. 【隨】 (zjwe) (_verb-like_) to follow, (_met._) according unto

ceon1.text: U+6625 旾 萅 (F2.52 春) 四季之首 (Page 37* #1: (1)春) Spring (Kangxi: 春爲靑陽 etc.), beginning of the year (Kangxi: 春者何歲之始也); joyous, glad; ~~wanton~~ amorous; _met._ times, period; budding, starting; _(1)ch(')un shik(7)_ (ceon1 sik1 春色) a parade of people with tables meeting the spring; _(1)ch(')un (4)ngau_ (ceon1 ngau4 春牛), a clay ox made in the spring; _(1)ch(')un ~~(4)(i/)~~ (i/)(3)_ (ceon1 ji3 春意), sexual desires; _(1)san (1)ch(')un_ (san1 ceon1 新春), the ~~first month~~ new year. Williams' 春意: Corrected _(4)(i/)_ (ji4) to _(i/)(3)_ (ji3). A year. Vitality, life. A type of alcohol (Kangxi: 酒名). 【春】 (tsyhwin) (_noun-like_) spring, springtime

U+693F (F2.52 椿) 木名父曰椿母曰萱 (Page 37* #2: (1)椿) A longlived tree (Kangxi: 上古有大椿者以八千歲爲春八千歲爲秋), a kind of banian; _(1)ch(')un (4)t(')ong_ (ceon1 tong4 椿堂), ~~a~~ father and mother; _(1)ch(')un (1)h(un_ (ceon1 hyun1 椿萱), father and mother. A colloquial word. A classifier of affairs; an incident, an adventure; _yat(7) (1)ch(')un (4)k(')(i/) sz'(6)_ (jat1 ceon1 kei4 si6 一椿奇事) a singular affair. Williams' 椿堂: Father alone would instead be 椿庭 _(1)ch(')un (4)t(')ing_ (ceon1 ting4).

U+81A5 春 (Cantonese) 𱼚 (Cantonese) (F2.52 膥) 鳥之卵 (Page 37* #3: (1)𱼚; here normalised to 膥) An egg, fish roe, crab's eggs; _(4)lui (1)kung (1)ch(')un_ (leoi4 gung1 ceon1 雷公膥), 'thunder eggs,' truffles? Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𱼚 to 膥, and corrected missing left dot in 卵. 【膥】 (ceon1) Egg or roe. 雞膥 (gai1 ceon1): "Chicken egg." 魚膥 (jyu4 ceon1): "Fish roe." 水蛇膥咁長 (seoi2 se4 ceon1 gam3 coeng4): "Long as water-snake eggs." (_vulgar_) The testicles. 燒膥袋 (siu1 ceon1 doi6): "Have your ball sack burnt" (as a punishment in hell; see ''The Conmen in Vegas''). For the (vulgar) intensifier senses, and also for the hypothesised relation to springtime in Old Chinese, see the Wiktionary entry for 春. 【石膥】 (sek6 ceon1) A pebble. The spelling 膥 is arbitrary (but well established).

ceon2.text: U+60F7 蠢 (F2.53 惷) 亂也 Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 亂. Disorderly (Kangxi: 亂也). Agitated (Kangxi: 惷惷動擾貌). Thick.

U+8822 惷 (F2.53 蠢) 愚也鈍也又虫動曰蠢 (Page 37* #4: ~~(2)舂~~(2)蠢) To crawl, to wriggle, as worms (Kangxi 蠢: 蟲動也); to move, to stir (Kangxi 蠢: 蠢作也, 蠢動作也); foolish, simple. ~~The first also means embarrassed;~~ _(2)ch(')un tun(6)_ (ceon2 deon6 蠢鈍) silly, a simpleton; _(2)ch(')un (4)ts(')oi_ (ceon2 coi4 蠢材), doltish; _(2)ch(')un chik(9)_ (ceon2 zik6 蠢直) unaffected; _chai(3) (2)ch(')un_ (zai3 ceon2 ？蠢), appearing foolish, silly looking. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 鈍, and corrected 虫曰蠢動 to 虫動曰蠢. Williams erroneously has 舂 for an alternative form instead of 惷. Insolent, disrespectful (Kangxi: 蠢不遜也). 【蠢】 (tsyhwinX) (_verb-like_) to wriggle, to stir (_adjective-like_) insolent

U+8E33 cyun2 (per 《集韻》尺兖切) (F2.53 踳) 雜也乖舛也 (Page 37* #5: (2)踳) Blended, mixed, as colors; _(2)ch(')un pok(8)_ (ceon2 bok3 踳駮) variegated, colors dissimilar (Kangxi: 踳駮色雜不同). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰夕生 to 舛. Opposing, going against (Kangxi: 踳駮相乖舛).

ceon4.text: U+5DE1 廵 循 (F2.52 巡) 巡視行也遍也又逡巡退却也 (Page 603 #1: (4)循) to inspect, to go the rounds, to perambulate, to go on the circuit (Kangxi 循: 巡也); (Page 603 #3: (4)廵(4)巡) To cruize (Kangxi 巡: 巡行也); to go on circuit (Kangxi 巡: 徧也, 謂巡繞徧行之), to examine what another is doing (Kangxi 巡: 巡視行貌), to go on a tour of inspection (Kangxi 巡: 巡守也); a ~~course at a feast~~ round of drinks; _(4)ts(')un (2)f(u/)_ (ceon4 fu2 巡撫), the governor of a province; _(4)ts(')un (2)k(i/)m_ (ceon4 gim2 巡檢), the supervisor or judge of a _(1)sz'_ (si1 司) or township; _(4)ts(')un (4)sh(un_ (ceon4 syun4 巡船), revenue cruizers; _(4)ts(')un p(o\)(6)_ (ceon4 bou6 巡捕) special aids of the governor-general and governor; _(4)ts(')un (1)k(a/)ng_ (ceon4 gaang1 巡更), on post, as a watchman; _(4)ts(')un (2)ch(un ch(')(u(3)_ (ceon4 zyun2 cyu3 巡轉處) to go about and examine; _ch(')ut(7) (4)ts(')un_ (ceot1 ceon4 出巡), to start on a circuit; to reconnoitre; _(4)ts(')un (1)ting_ (ceon4 ding1 巡丁), tidewaiters, cruizing officers. Used in 逡巡 (hesitant, retreative) (Kangxi: 逡巡郤退之貌). 【巡】 (zwin) (_verb-like_) to patrol, to inspect Used in 巡守. 【巡守】 (zwin syuwH) (_verb-like_) to make tour of inspection

U+5FAA 揗 (for "comply", "rub", and "console" senses) (F2.52 循) 順也又遵循撫循又循良 (Page 603 #1: (4)循) To follow a leader; to comply with (Kangxi: 自也率循也); to accord (Kangxi: 行順也), to follow or go round with (Kangxi: 依也); to revolve (Kangxi: 循環謂旋繞往來); good (Kangxi: 善也)~~, easy, docile~~; ~~leisurely;~~ to soothe, to console (Kangxi: 撫循慰安也); to explain (Kangxi: 述也); _(4)ts(')un (1)kw(')ai t(o\)(6) (2)k(u_ (ceon4 kwai1 dou6 geoi2 循規蹈矩), to accord with and follow ~~instructions~~ the rules; _(4)ts(')un f(a/)t(8)_ (ceon4 faat3 循法) to obey the laws; _(1)yan (4)ts(')un 'ng(6) sz'(6)_ (jan1 ceon4 ng6 si6 因循誤事) lazily hindering the prosecution of business; _(1)yan (4)ts(')un_ (jan1 ceon4 因循), not interfering with, indifferent to (Kangxi: 無所作爲曰因循); _(4)ts(')un (4)ts(')un sh(i/)n(6) (5)yau_ (ceon4 ceon4 sin6 jau5 循循善誘), gradually and gently lead him on, as to good habits; _(4)ts(')un (4)hang ~~k(o\)(3)~~ kau(6) sz'(6)_ (ceon4 hang4 gau6 si6 循行舊事) act as has been formerly done. Williams' 循行舊事: Corrected _k(o\)(3)_ (gou3) to _kau(6)_ (gau6). Orderly, gradually (Kangxi: 循次序也). To rub (Kangxi: 循摩也). 【循】 (zwin) (_verb-like_) to go along, to comply (_adjective-like_) orderly (_verb-like_) to rub

U+63D7 seon6 (per 《廣韻》食尹切 and 食閏切) (F2.52 揗) 以手相安慰曰揗 (Page 603 #2: (4)揗) To pat, to stroke; to encourage, to soothe (Kangxi: 手相安慰也); to take a sympathizing interest in (Kangxi: 凡以恩相撫以心相恤皆曰揗). To rub (Kangxi: 摩也).

U+65EC (F2.52 旬) 十日曰一旬 (Page 604 #2: (4)旬) A decade of years or days (Kangxi: 徧也十日爲旬); a complete number finished, completed (Kangxi: 徧也); the whole of (Kangxi: 旬均也); in mourning, seven days make a _(4)ts(')un_ (旬)_;_ _(4)ts(')un sui(3)_ (ceon4 seoi3 旬歲) a complete year (Kangxi: 旬滿也旬歲猶言滿歲也); the _sh(e/)ung(6)_ (soeng6 上), _(1)chung_ (zung1 中), and _h(a/)(6) (4)ts(')un_ (haa6 ceon4 下旬), are the first, second, and third decades of a month; _ts(')at(7) (4)ts(')un_ (cat1 ceon4 七旬), the 49 days of mourning; also 70 years; _(2)h(o\) (2)shui (4)ts(')un_ (hou2 seoi2 ceon4 好水旬), the tide will serve you well. 【旬】 (zwin) (_noun-like_) ten-days

U+79E6 (F2.52 秦) 國名又姓 (Page 603 #6: (4)秦) A kind of rice (Kangxi: 一曰秦禾名); a feudal state (Kangxi: 國名) occupying the region of the rivers Wei (渭) and King (涇); the range of mountains in the south of Shens(i/) (陝西); _(4)Ts(')un (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (ceon4 ciu4 秦朝), the Ts(')in (秦) dynasty, B. C. ~~186~~~221--~~120~~~207; _(4)ts(')un ~~(2)Ch(i/)~~ (2)Ch(')(i/) (4)wong tai(3)_ (ceon4 ci2 wong4 dai3 秦始皇帝) the emperor First of this Ts(')in (秦) dynasty, who centralized the Chinese empire. Williams' 秦始皇帝: Corrected _(2)Ch(i/)_ (zi2) to _(2)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci2). A surname (Kangxi: 姓).

U+7D03 𬘓 (Mainland simplified) seon4 (alternative per 《廣韻》食倫切) (F2.52 紃) 組紃 (Page 603 #4: (4)紃) Fine, silken cords or bindings (Kangxi: 圜采也, 絛紃也, etc.); tassels, ornaments; a model, a pattern (Kangxi: 法也); _t(i/)t(8) (4)ts(')un_ (dit3 ceon4), the spindle of a spinning-wheel --- a colloquial term. 【紃】 (zwin, zywin) (_noun-like_) silk-cord

U+8793 (F2.52 螓) 似蟬而小 (Page 604 #1: (4)螓) A small species of cicada (Kangxi: 蟲名似蟬而小 etc.); ~~eggs of the mantis;~~ a breeze or large blue-bottle fly (Kangxi: 大蠅曰胡螓). 【螓】 (dzin) (_noun-like_) small-cicada
