ceot1.text: U+51FA ceoi3 (alternative per 《廣韻》尺類切) cyut1 (uncommon) (F2.55 出) 外也退也生也發也 (Page 42 #1: 出(7)) To go out (Kangxi: 出入也), to issue (Kangxi: 吐也), to proceed forth (Kangxi: 進也), to manifest (Kangxi: 見也), according to the tenor of the following or preceding word; to eject, to put out; an auxiliary verb, implying completion or action; _ch(')ut(7) ~~yap(7)~~ yap(9)_ (ceot1 jap6 出入) to go in and out, back and forth; _(2)s(e/) ch(')ut(7) (4)loi_ (se2 ceot1 loi4 寫出來), ~~will~~ write out; _(4)ch(')(a/) ch(')ut(7) (4)loi_ (caa4 ceot1 loi4 查出來), ~~about to~~ examine; _ch(')ut(7) chung(3)_ (ceot1 zung3 出眾) preeminent, to surpass; _(5)n(i/) (1)p(i/)n ch(')(u(3) ch(')ut(7) shai(3)_ (nei5 bin1 cyu3 ceot1 sai3 你邊處出世) where were you born? _ch(')ut(7) (1)kung_ (ceot1 gung1 出恭), to retire, to ease nature; _ch(')ut(7) k(a/)(3)_ (ceot1 gaa3 出嫁) to marry a husband; _ch(')ut(7) (1)shan_ (ceot1 san1 出身), to hold office; _ch(')ut(7) (4)yau ~~p(o\)(6)~~ (4)p(')(o\) s(a/)t(8)_ (ceot1 jau4 pou4 saat3 出遊菩薩) to carry idols in procession; _ch(')ut(7) ~~(1)k(i/)~~ (4)k(')(i/)_ (ceot1 kei4 出奇), surprising; _ch(')ut(7) p(')i(u/)(3)_ (ceot1 piu3 出票) to issue a warrant, to advertise; _ch(')ut(7) h(i/)(3)_ (ceot1 hei3 出氣) to fume or steam, to avenge another's quarrel; _ch(')ut(7) (4)t(')au_ (ceot1 tau4 出頭), to take the lead; _ch(')ut(7) (2)ch(')au_ (ceot1 cau2 出醜), to ~~be despised~~ make a fool of oneself; _ch(')ut(7) (1)ts(')ai_ (ceot1 cai1 出妻), to divorce; _ch(')ut(7) kai(3)_ (ceot1 gai3 出繼) to be adopted by an uncle; _(4)ts(')ui (5)n(i/) ch(')ut(7) (1)sam_ (ceoi4 nei5 ceot1 sam1 隨你出心), as you like to do it; _hon(3) (4)'m ch(')ut(7) s(e/)ung(3)_ (hon3 m4 ceot1 soeng3 看唔出相) to belie his looks; _(2)s(e/)ung (4)'m ch(')ut(7)_ (soeng2 m4 ceot1 想唔出) can not recall to mind; _ch(')ut(7) (4)ngan_ (ceot1 ngan4-2 出銀), to pay; _pat(7) ch(')ut(7) (2)sho ~~li(u/)(3)~~ li(u/)(6)_ (bat1 ceot1 so2 liu6 不出所料) to guess aright. 《廣韻》 does not explain the departing-tone reading 尺類切 _ch(')ui(3)_ (ceoi3). Kangxi has 《正韻》凡物自出則入聲非自出而出之則去聲然亦有互用者, which prescribes entering tone _ch(')ut(7)_ (ceot1) for the intransitive verb senses and departing tone _ch(')ui(3)_ (ceoi3) for the transitive verb senses (though conceding some degree of interchangeability). In modern usage, this distinction is absolutely obsolete, and _ch(')ut(7)_ (ceot1) is the only reading in all senses. Williams' 出入: Corrected _yap(7)_ (jap1) to _yap(9)_ (jap6). Williams' 出恭: That is, to go to the toilet. Williams' 出遊菩薩: Corrected _p(o\)(6)_ (bou6) to _(4)p(')(o\)_ (pou4). Williams' 出奇: Corrected _(1)k(i/)_ (gei1) to _(4)k(')(i/)_ (kei4). Williams' 不出所料: Corrected _li(u/)(3)_ (liu3) to _li(u/)(6)_ (liu6). To supply, to put forth. To produce. A sister's child (Kangxi: 生也, 男子謂姊妹之子爲出). 【出-departing】 (tsyhwijH) (_verb-like_) to bring out, to send forth (_verb-like_) to supply 【出-entering】 (tsyhwit) (_verb-like_) to go out 【出】 (ceot1) To go out to a place. 出街 (ceot1 gaai1): "Go out." 出城 (ceot1 seng4-2): "Go out to the city." Out. 出便 (ceot1 bin6): "Outside." 褪出啲 (tan3 ceot1 di1): "Shift it out a bit."
U+6035 May appear as either ⿰忄朮 (assumed here) or ⿰忄术, depending on the font.

zyut3.text: U+7D40 绌 (Mainland simplified) fat1 (per 《正韻牋》曲勿切 for "bent/withdrawn" sense) zeot1 (per 《廣韻》竹律切) (F1.86 絀 _Fat(7)_ (fat1)) 嬴絀猶屈伸也 (Page 41 #12: 絀(7) _Chut(7)_ (zeot1); here normalised to _Ch(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) Crimson (Kangxi: 絳也) silk; to sew (Kangxi: 紩也); ~~to baste or sew badly;~~ _(4)ying ~~chut(7)~~ ch(ut(8)_ (jing4 zyut3 嬴絀) to retire and come forth (Kangxi: 猶言屈伸也); unequal; (Page 713 #4: 絀(7) _Chut(7)_ (zeot1); here normalised to _Ch(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) This word also means ~~obstructed,~~ bent; withdrawn~~, as money from circulation~~; _(4)ts(')oi yung(6) (1)ch(i/) ~~chut(7)~~ ch(ut(8)_ (coi4 jung6 zi1 zyut3 財用之絀) ~~obstructions in the way of trade~~ insufficiency of funds. Williams' "to baste or sew badly": This is a misreading of Kangxi ...故作秫絀耳此蓋言其女工箴縷之麤拙也. Here, it is 秫 that supplies the meaning of "poor". The character 絀 simply means "sew" or "stitch". Insufficient.

Here, 黜 refers to dismissal, not a reprimand. To reject. To abolish. To rebuke. 【黜】 (trhwit) (_verb-like_) to expel, to reject, to dismiss, to degrade

ci1.text: U+55E4 (F1.36 嗤) 笑也 (Page 10* #14: (1)嗤) Laughing (Kangxi: 笑貌); to laugh at; _(1)h(o\)m (1)ch(')(i/)_ (ham1 ci1 堪嗤), ridiculous; _si(u/)(3) (1)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(')(i/)_ (siu3 ci1 ci1 笑嗤嗤), to laugh heartily. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𠷣 to 嗤.

U+5AB8 (F1.36 媸) 妍媸 (Page 11* #1: (1)~~？~~媸) Ugly (Kangxi 媸: 醜也); a homely woman; lewd (Kangxi 媸: 淫也), worthless, foolish (Kangxi 媸: 癡也); _(1)ch(')(i/) (4)n(o\)_ (ci1 nou4 媸奴), a harridan; _(4)(i/)n (1)ch(')(i/) tsz'(6) ~~k(i/)n(6)~~ (i/)n(6)_ (jin4 ci1 zi6 jin6 妍媸自見) he knows whether he is handsome or ugly. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𡟎 to 媸. Williams' "homely": In the sense of "unattractive". Williams' 妍媸自見: Corrected _k(i/)n(6)_ (gin6) to _(i/)n(6)_ (jin6).

U+75B5 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. 呰 訾 ci4 (per 《廣韻》疾移切) (F2.34 疵 _(4)Ts(')z'_ (ci4)) 症也吹毛求疵 (F2.35 疵 _Ts(')z'(3)_ (ci3)) 瑕疵 (Page 613 #6: (2)呰 _(2)Tsz'_ (zi2); here corrected to _(4)Ts(')z'_ (ci4) and normalised to 疵 _(1)Ts(')z'_ (ci1)) a defect, a flaw (Kangxi 呰: 瑕也). (Page 615 #4: (4)疵 _(4)Ts(')z'_ (ci4); here normalised to _(1)Ts(')z'_ (ci1)) Malady (Kangxi: 病也), disease, infirmity; an imperfection, as a mole; a failing, a fault; an eccentricity; _(4)h(a/) ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (1)ts(')z'_ (haa4 ci1 瑕疵) a flaw, any fault which renders a thing imperfect; _(2)si(u/) ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (1)ts(')z'_ (siu2 ci1 小疵) a little fault, as in a man's character; _hak(7) ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (1)ts(')z'_ (hak1 ci1 黑疵) a black spot. In its entry for 訾, Kangxi gives the sense 病也 "defect" with the example 《禮檀弓》故子之所刺於禮者亦非禮之訾也《註》病也 under the reading 卽移切 _(1)tsz'_ (zi1). The reading should instead be 疾移切 _(4)ts(')z'_ (ci4), if we read 訾 as an alternative form of 疵 (as I have done here). 【疵】 (dzje) (_noun-like_) defect

U+7661 痴 (F1.36 痴) 痴呆 (F1.36 癡) 同上愚也 (Page 10* #6: (1)癡(1)痴) Foolish, silly (Kangxi 癡: 不慧也); stupid, inapt (Kangxi 癡: 癡者神思不足); idiotic; doting after, lustful, hankering; out of his head, wandering; _(1)ch(')(i/) (4)ngoi_ (ci1 ngoi4 癡呆), foolish stolid; _(1)ch(')(i/) ch(ut(8) ~~k(o\)m(3)~~ (2)k(o\)m (1)ch(')(un l(un(6) ch(')(u(3)_ (ci1 zyut3 gam2 cyun1 lyun6 cyu3 癡拙噉穿亂處) running in and out, making such a rumpus; _(1)ch(')(i/) (4)ts(')ing_ (ci1 cing4 癡情), salacious; _(1)ch(')(i/) (4)ch(')(i/)n_ (ci1 cin4 癡纏) bound up in, loving; _pat(7) (1)ch(')(i/) pat(7) (4)lung_ (bat1 ci1 bat1 lung4 不癡不聾), if I am not foolish and deaf I cannot reign; _(1)sh(u (1)ch(')(i/)_ (syu1 ci1 書癡), doting on books; _(1)ch(')(i/) ~~(4)m(a/)i~~ (4)mai pat(7) (2)sing_ (ci1 mai4 bat1 sing2 癡迷不醒) mad after. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 土 to 上. Williams' 癡拙噉穿亂處: Corrected _k(o\)m(3)_ (gam3) to _(2)k(o\)m_ (gam2). Williams' 癡迷不醒: Corrected _(4)m(a/)i_ (maai4) to _(4)mai_ (mai4).

U+7B1E (F1.36 笞) 捶擊也 (Page 10* #9: (1)笞) To punish with a bamboo, to bastinado; to correct, so as to reform (Kangxi: 笞者所以敎之也); to scourge, to flog, to bamboo (Kangxi: 捶擊也); _(1)ch(')(i/) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (ci1 zoeng6 笞杖) the stick used in a y(a/)mun (衙門) to punish; _(1)ch(')(i/) ch(a/)k(8)_ (ci1 zaak3 笞責) to chastise culprits, vulgo, _(2)t(a/) (2)p(a/)n (2)tsz'_ (daa2 baan2 zi2 打板子).

zi1.text: U+80DD ci1 (per Fan Wan) (F1.36 胝 _(1)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci1)) 皮厚也 (Page 10* #7: (1)胝 _(1)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci1); here normalised to _(1)Ch(i/)_ (zi1)) Thickened skin (Kangxi: 腄也, 腁胝, 皮厚也) on the hand; growing callous; _~~(1)p(')(i/)n~~ (4)p(')(i/)n ~~(1)ch(')(i/)~~ (1)ch(i/)_ (pin4 zi1 胼胝), horny skin. Whilst Kangxi has the reading _(1)ch(')(i/)_ (ci1) per 《集韻》稱脂切, it is explained 鳥胃 "bird's stomach" (same as 胵). Williams' 胼胝: Corrected _(1)p(')(i/)n_ (pin1) to _(4)p(')(i/)n_ (pin4).

ci1.text: U+86A9 (F1.36 蚩) 無知貌 (Page 10* #13: (1)蚩) A worm (Kangxi: 蟲名); ignorant, stupid (Kangxi: 騃也); unpolished, sincere, rustic; to impose on; to treat as if ignorant, to despise; _(1)ch(')(i/) (4)man_ (ci1 man4 蚩民), the uneducated people; _(1)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(')(i/)_ (ci1 ci1 蚩蚩), honest, blunt, rustic. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿱山虫 to 蚩.

ci2.text: U+892B ci1 (per Fan Wan, common) (F1.36 褫 _(1)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci1)) 奪也 (Page 10* #11: (1)褫 _(1)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci1); here normalised to _(2)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci2)) To take away insignia, to degrade; to strip, to take off clothes, to denude (Kangxi: 奪衣也); a fringe (Kangxi: 衣絮偏也); _~~(1)ch(')(i/)~~ (2)ch(')(i/) k(a/)k(8)_ (ci2 gaak3 褫革) to dismiss from office; _~~(1)ch(')(i/)~~ (2)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(i/)n_ (ci2 zin1 褫氈), plush, felt. 【褫】 (drje, drjeX, trhjeX) (_verb-like_) to strip

zi2.text: U+8A3E May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. 呰 (for "slander" sense) 訿 (for "slander" sense) (F2.34 訾 _(1)Ts(')z'_ (ci1)) 詆也誚也 (F2.35 訿 _(2)Ts(')z'_ (ci2)) 相詆也詩翕翕訿訿 (Page 615 #3: (1)訾 _(1)Ts(')z'_ (ci1); here corrected to _(2)Tsz'_ (zi2)) To speak hastily, to utter things unadvisedly (Kangxi: 不思稱意也); to slander, to detract from (Kangxi: 毀也); ~~faulty, licentious (Kangxi: 恣也);~~ ~~impertinent, evil;~~ its meaning varies according to the one joined with it. Williams' "faulty, licentious": This is a reasonable rendering of Kangxi 恣也. But since the associated commentary is 訾讀爲恣, this would make 訾 an alternative form of 恣, and therefore to be read _tsz'(3)_ (zi3) instead of _(2)tsz'_ (zi2). Williams' "impertinent, evil": This is a misreading of Kangxi 惡也. Here, 惡 is departing tone (loathe), not entering tone (evil). To loathe (Kangxi: 惡也). 【訾-rising】 (tsjeX) (_verb-like_) to traduce (_verb-like_) to loathe

Fan Wan entry: Corrected 毌 to 母. 【雌】 (tshje) (_noun-like_) hen, female-bird (_noun-like_) female

ci3.text: U+9AB4 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. 胔 ci1 (per common parsing of 音疵) ci4 (per 《廣韻》疾移切) zi6 (per 《廣韻》疾智切) (F2.35 骴) 殘骨 (Page 617 #3: 骴(3)) An old bone of men or beasts (Kangxi: 鳥獸殘骨曰骴, 謂死人骨也); putrid bones, having some flesh on them (Kangxi: 骨之尚有肉者, 肉腐曰胔, 有骨曰胔亦作骴).

ci1.text: U+9D1F 鵄 鸱 (Mainland simplified) (F1.36 鴟) 鴟鴞惡鳥攫鳥子而食者 (Page 10* #8: (1)鴟) A kind of owl, or a sort of hawk (Kangxi: 䳠也); _kok(8) (1)ch(')(i/)_ (gok3 ci1 角鴟) or _(1)ch(')(i/) (1)hi(u/)_ (ci1 hiu1 鴟鴞), the horned owl; _(1)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (ci1 zoeng1 鴟張), to act unscrupulously, as this bird does. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 欔 to 攫. Short for 鴟夷 (a wineskin) (Kangxi: 鴟夷革囊也, 盛酒者也). 【鴟】 (tsyhij) (_noun-like_) owl Used in 鴟鴞. 【鴟鴞】 (tsyhij hjew) (_noun-like_) owl

U+9ED0 𥼝 (Page 10* #12: (1)𥼝(1)黐) To attach to, to stick on; glutinous, sticky, pasty (Kangxi 黐: 黏也); _(1)ch(')(i/) (1)k(a/)u_ (ci1 gaau1 黐膠), birdlime; _(1)ch(')(i/) k(e/)uk(8)_ (ci1 goek3 黐腳) to sorn, to sponge for meals; _(4)'m (1)ch(')(i/) (4)m(a/)i_ (m4 ci1 maai4 唔黐埋), it don't stick; _(1)ch(')(i/) tak(7) (2)h(o\) shat(9)_ (ci1 dak1 hou2 sat6 黐得好實) sticks very tightly; _(1)ch(')(i/) mak(9) (1)hong_ (ci1 mak6 hong1 黐麥糠), a sponger, a sorner. 【黐】 (ci1) To stick, to be sticky, to cling. 黐住咗 (ci1 zyu6 zo2): "It's stuck onto it." 好黐牙 (hou2 ci1 ngaa4): "Really clingy to the teeth." 黐底 (ci1 dai2): "Stuck to the bottom of the pot." 黐鑊 (ci1 wok6): "Stuck to the wok." 黐𣲷𣲷 (ci1 nap6 nap6): "Sticky and wet." 黐手 (ci1 sau2): "Sticky hands" (a training technique in Wing Ch(')un). To freeload, to impose on another (for food etc.). 黐餐 (ci1 caan1): "Sponge a meal." 黐車坐 (ci1 ce1 co5): "Freeload for a car ride." Short for 黐線. 做到黐咗 (zou6 dou3 ci1 zo2): "Worked so much he's gone crazy." 【黐肺】 (ci1 fai3) To be exhausted. (Literally, "stuck-together lungs".) 熱到黐肺 (jit6 dou3 ci1 fai3): "So hot I'm knackered." 【黐脷根】 (ci1 lei6 gan1) To have a lisp. (Literally, "sticky tongue-root".) 【黐孖筋】 (ci1 maa1 gan1) Crazy, insane. 【黐線】 (ci1 sin3) Crazy, insane. 黐咗線咩 (ci1 zo2 sin3 me1): "Have you gone crazy?" 黐線㗎 (ci1 sin3 ga3): "It's crazy!" Olden attestation for 黐 _(1)ch(')(i/)_ (ci1) meaning "glue", hence "sticky": 《廣韻》吕支切 黐 黏也又丑知切 《廣韻》丑知切 黐 所以粘鳥又吕支切 《康熙字典》黐 《廣韻》丑知切《集韻》《正韻》抽知切𠀤音摛《玉篇》黏也《廣韻》黐膠所以黏鳥 又《廣韻》呂支切《集韻》鄰知切𠀤音離義同

U+9F5D 呞 𪗪 (F1.36 呞) 口張開也 (Page 10* #10: (1)呞(1)𪗪; here normalised to 齝) To ruminate, to chew the cud (Kangxi 齝: 吐而噍也), vulgarly called _(4)ngau t(')(o\)(3) (2)ts(')(o\)_ (ngau4 tou3 cou2 牛吐草). The Fan Wan defines it (呞) to gape (Fan Wan 呞: 口張開也).

U+59CB 乨 (F1.39 始) 初也原也 (Page 11* #11: (2)始) The beginning (Kangxi: 初也); an opening, a start; to begin, to commence; at the beginning of a sentence, it often means then, was, at that time; _(2)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(')o_ (ci2 co1 始初), the commencement, first; _(2)ch(')(i/) (1)chung_ (ci2 zung1 始終), beginning and end; the whole period, the circumstances; _(2)ch(')(i/) ch(')ong(3)_ (ci2 cong3 始創) invention. 【始】 (syiX) (_noun-like_) beginning (_adverb-like_) (_met._) first, just

ci2.text: U+6065 耻 (F1.39 恥) 慚愧 (F1.39 耻) 同上 (Page 12* #2: (2)恥(2)耻) Ashamed (Kangxi 恥: 辱也); to feel shame, disgraced, humbled, chagrined (Kangxi 恥: 慙也); to blush or redden; _(1)sau (2)ch(')(i/)_ (sau1 ci2 羞恥), shame; _(4)mung (2)ch(')(i/)_ (mung4 ci2 蒙恥), covered with disgrace; _(5)n(i/) (4)'m k(i/)n(3) (1)sau (2)ch(')(i/)_ (nei5 m4 gin3 sau1 ci2 你唔見羞恥), are you not mortified? _(4)m(o\) (2)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(i/) (4)t(')(o\)_ (mou4 ci2 zi1 tou4 無恥之徒), a brazenfaced rascal; _(2)ch(')(i/) m(a/)(6)_ (ci2 maa6 恥罵) afraid of a scolding. Fan Wan entry: Corrected duplicate headword 耻 to 恥. 【恥】 (trhiX) (_noun-like_) shame (_verb-like_) to ashame

U+675D 柂 ci5 (per 《廣韻》池爾切) to1 (alternative per Kangxi 叶託何切) (F1.39 柂) 析薪而循其理 (Page 12* #1: (2)杝(2)柂) To split wood with the grain (Kangxi 杝: 析薪也, 杝隨其理也); to fall down (Kangxi 杝: 落也); ~~These are also read _(4)(i/)_ (ji4), _(4)l(i/)_ (lei4), and _(4)t(')o_ (to4), with the same meanings.~~ The reading _(2)ch(')(i/)_ (ci2) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 尺里切, explained 析木觀其理. Williams' "read ... with the same meanings": This is not quite correct. 杝 read _(4)(i/)_ (ji4) is the name of a tree. 杝 read _(4)l(i/)_ (lei4) is used for 離. 杝 read _(4)t(')o_ (to4) is a mistaken parsing of Kangxi 叶託何切音佗 _(1)t(')o_ (to1), which is the only reading having the same meaning of "splitting with the grain". 【杝】 (drjeX) (_verb-like_) to split with the grain
U+67C2 (F1.39 柂) 析薪而循其理 (Page 12* #1: (2)杝(2)柂)

ci5.text: U+67FF 柹 ci4 (per Fan Wan) ci5-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.34 柿 _(4)Ts(')z'_ (ci4)) 乾柿 (Page 616 #5: (4)柿 _(4)Ts(')z'_ (ci4); here normalised to _(5)Ts(')z'_ (ci5)) The persimmon, the Diospyrus or China fig; _(1)kon ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z'_ (gon1 ci5-2 乾柿) or _~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z' (2)peng_ (ci5-2 beng2 柿餅), dried persimmons or figs, prepared for exportation; _(4)ngau (1)sam ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z'_ (ngau4 sam1 ci5-2 牛心柿) the large sort; _(1)kai (1)sam ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z'_ (gai1 sam1 ci5-2 雞心柿) the small sort; _(2)shui tsam(3) ~~(4)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z'_ (seoi2 zam3 ci5-2 水浸柿) the yellow persimmon. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(5)ch(')(i/)_ per 《廣韻》鉏里切 for 𣐈. 【柿】 (dzriX) (_noun-like_) persimmon

ci2.text: U+6B64 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes or 4 strokes (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.35 此) 彼此斯也 (Page 616 #6: (2)此) A pronoun, this (Kangxi: 此者彼之對); here, now; this, the last spoken of; the thing in hand; _(2)p(i/) (2)ts(')z'_ (bei2 ci2 彼此) that, this; you, I; there, here; _(4)(u (2)ts(')z'_ (jyu4 ci2 如此) like this; _(4)'m tsoi(6) (2)ts(')z'_ (m4 zoi6 ci2 唔在此) not here; _(5)(i/) (2)ts(')z'_ (ji5 ci2 以此) by, or on this account; _(2)ts(')z' (1)yan (2)ts(')z' tak(7)_ (ci2 jan1 ci2 dak1 此恩此德) for this very kindness. Thus, then. 【此】 (tshjeX) (_determiner-like_) this

U+77E2 (F1.39 矢) 箭也 (Page 12* #7: (2)矢) An arrow or dart (Kangxi: 弓弩矢也); swift as an arrow; direct, openly; to set forth, to arrange (Kangxi: 陳也); to swear, to vow (Kangxi: 誓也); to display; to resolve, to form a purpose; the 111th radical (U+2F6E ⽮ "arrow"); _yat(7) (2)ch(')(i/) (1)ch(i/) t(i/)(6)_ (jat1 ci2 zi1 dei6 一矢之地) a little distance, a bowshot; _(2)ch(')(i/) chik(9)_ (ci2 zik6 矢直) straight as an arrow; _f(a/)t(8) yat(7) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (faat3 jat1 ci2 發一矢), let fly an arrow; _(2)ch(')(i/) shai(6)_ (ci2 sai6 矢誓) to take an oath; _(2)ch(')(i/) (2)hau pat(7) (4)(i/)_ (ci2 hau2 bat1 ji4 矢口不移), to affirm constantly. Upright (Kangxi: 正也直也). 【矢】 (syijX) (_noun-like_) arrow (_verb-like_) to arrange (_verb-like_) to swear
U+803B (F1.39 恥) 慚愧 (F1.39 耻) 同上 (Page 12* #2: (2)恥(2)耻) Fan Wan entry: Corrected duplicate headword 耻 to 恥.

U+8C55 (F1.39 豕) 猪也 (Page 12* #6: (2)豕) A hog, a pig (Kangxi: 彘也); the ~~153d~~ 152d radical (U+2F97 ⾗ "pig") of characters relating mostly to swine; _(2)ch(')(i/) yuk(9)_ (ci2 juk6 豕肉) pork. 【豕】 (syeX) (_noun-like_) swine

U+9F52 歯 齿 (Mainland simplified) (F1.39 齒) 牙齒又年齒也 (Page 12* #3: (2)齒) The upper front teeth (Kangxi: 口齗骨也, 上曰齒下曰牙); _met._ the mouth, words; age, years ~~(Kangxi: 齒壽也)~~; sort, class (Kangxi: 類也); associates, equals; to commence (Kangxi: 齒始也); to sort, to class by the age (Kangxi: 年也又列也, 論量...歲數); ~~to record, to write in;~~ the 211th radical (U+2FD2 ⿒ "tooth") of characters relating to teeth; _(2)ch(')(i/) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (ci2 zoeng2 齒長), old; _f(u/)(6) (1)ch(i/) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (fu6 zi1 ci2 父之齒) a father's associates; _(4)n(i/)n (2)ch(')(i/) (5)m(u/)i (1)ts(')(u/)i_ (nin4 ci2 mui5 ceoi1 年齒每催), years are hastening one on; _(4)n(i/)n (2)ch(')(i/)_ (nin4 ci2 年齒), age, years; _(4)ling (4)ng(a/) l(i/)(6) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (ling4 ngaa4 lei6 ci2 伶牙俐齒), eloquent; _pok(9) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (bok6 ci2 薄齒), young, without distinction; _(2)ch(')(i/) (4)(i/)n_ (ci2 jin4 齒言), specious. Kangxi 齒壽也: Modern editions have 壽也 corrected to 齯齒壽也 per the original text of 《爾雅釋詁》. Williams' "to record, to write in": This is (I think) a misreading of Kangxi 錄也. Kangxi 錄 has 《增韻》齒也總也, i.e. to command. (Note that 《廣韻》 has 齒録也 for this sense, which is not very helpful.) Williams' 年齒每催: A misspelling of 年矢每催 (from Thousand Character Classic). 【齒】 (tsyhiX) (_noun-like_) front-tooth, tooth, (_met._) age

ci3.text: U+4F7D (F2.35 佽) 便利也又比也助也 (Page 616 #12: 佽(3)) Light, nimble, sprightly (Kangxi: 佽飛...輕疾若飛也); to help, to assist (Kangxi: 助也); ~~to compare;~~ for, instead (Kangxi: 代也遞也); _ts(')z'(3) cho(6)_ (ci3 zo6 佽助) to aid. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 㐸 to 佽. Williams' "to compare": This is a misreading of Kangxi 比也, which explains 《詩小雅》決拾旣佽, with commentary 《註》利也謂相次然後射 and lesser-note 《鄭箋》謂指相次比也. In 次比, we have 比 in departing tone, meaning "put beside" or "pack together" (as in 鱗次櫛比 etc.). 【佽】 (tshijH) (_verb-like_) to help, to convenience

U+523A 朿 (for "thorn" sense) cik3 (alternative for "stab" senses) (F2.35 刺) 刺史又挿也又譏諷 (Page 617 #5: 刺(3)) A thorn (Kangxi: 棘芒也); a sting; to pierce, to prick, to thrust a sharp point into (Kangxi: 針刺也); to embroider (Kangxi: 以針黹物曰刺); to brand, to tattoo; to cut into; a visiting-card (Kangxi: 書姓名於奏白曰刺), because it was once cut in wood; to stab (Kangxi: 刺直傷也) and kill (Kangxi: 刺殺也); to spade up, as plants with a trowel; to reprehend, to blame (Kangxi: 刺責之); to criticise, to lampoon; satire; to examine (Kangxi: 刺訊決也); _ts(')z'(3) (4)ng(a/)_ (ci3 ngaa4 刺牙), to pick the teeth; _(4)hang ts(')z'(3)_ (hang4 ci3 行刺) to stab to death; _tsok(8) (1)sh(i/) ts(')z'(3) (5)k(')(u_ (zok3 si1 ci3 keoi5 作詩刺佢), to pasquinade in verse; _~~(5)ts(a/)m~~ (5)ts(')(a/)m ts(')z'(3)_ (caam5 ci3 鏨刺) to engrave, to prick; _(4)t(')au ts(')z'(3)_ (tau4 ci3 投刺) to send in a card; _sh(ut(8) ts(')z'(3)_ (syut3 ci3 說刺) or _(1)k(i/) ts(')z'(3)_ (gei1 ci3 譏刺) a sarcasm, an inuendo, a taunt; Williams' 行刺: Metaphorically, to assassinate. Williams' 鏨刺: Corrected _(5)ts(a/)m_ (zaam5) to _(5)ts(')(a/)m_ (caam5). 【刺-noun】 (tshjeH) (_noun-like_) thorn 【刺-verb】 (tshjeH, tshjek) (_verb-like_) to pierce, to stab, (_met._) to slay, to assassinate, to castigate, to lampoon

cik3.text: U+523A (Page 571 #3: 刺(8)) To bore through (Kangxi: 穿也傷也); to stab; to embroider (Kangxi: 針黹也); to tattoo, to mark the skin; a prickle, a thorn; _ts(')ik(8) ts(')ik(8) pat(7) (1)yau_ (cik3 cik3 bat1 jau1 刺刺不休), incessant talking (Kangxi: 刺刺多言貌). (Page 617 #5: 刺(3) _Ts(')z'(3)_ (ci3); here corrected to _Ts(')ik(8)_ (cik3)) to pole, as a boat (Kangxi: 撐也); to pry into, to overhear (Kangxi: 偵伺也); _~~ts(')z'(3) ts(')z'(3)~~ ts(')ik(8) ts(')ik(8)_ (cik3 cik3 刺刺) to talk much (Kangxi: 刺刺多言貌).

ci3.text: U+53A0 (F2.35 厠) 囷厠糞也 (Page 617 #7: 廁(3)厠(3)) Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _ch(')(i/)(3)_ per 《廣韻》初吏切 for 廁.

U+557B 翅 (F1.42 啻) 但也止也 (Page 12* #10: 啻(3)) Only; to stop at (Kangxi: 啻猶止也猶言何止); an overplus (Kangxi: 餘也, 過多也); _pat(7) ch(')(i/)(3)_ (bat1 ci3 不啻) not only, more than; _(4)ho ch(')(i/)(3) (1)ts(')(i/)n m(a/)n(6)_ (ho4 ci3 cin1 maan6 何啻千萬) can it stop at ten millions? _pat(7) ch(')(i/)(3) f(u/)(6) (5)m(o\)_ (bat1 ci3 fu6 mou5 不啻父母), more than father and mother. ~~Often read _tai(3)_ (dai3).~~ (Page 12* #11: 翅(3)翄(3)) Used for the last (啻) (Kangxi 翅: 同啻). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 伹 to 但. Williams' "Often read ...": 《集韻》 has the reading 丁計切, explained 高聲一曰諟也, but this does not correspond to the senses given here. 【啻】 (syeH) (_adverb-like_) only, merely, (_met._) less than

U+5E5F 織 帜 (Mainland simplified) si3 (alternative per 《廣韻》式吏切) (F1.42 幟) 旗幟 (Page 12* #9: 幟(3)) The fringe or border on a flag; a flag, a streamer or pennon, long and fringed (Kangxi: 旌旗之屬, 旗幟, 標也, 旛也); to tie or sew on fringes, as a signal (Kangxi: 記也); to signalize. 【幟】 (tsyhiH, syiH) (_noun-like_) flag

U+5EC1 厠 厕 (Mainland simplified) si3 (lazy in 廁所) (F2.35 厠) 囷厠糞也 (Page 617 #7: 廁(3)厠(3)) To cleanse, to wash (Kangxi 廁: 廁淸也); a place which must be kept clean (Kangxi 廁: ...至穢之處宜常修治使潔淸也); a privy, a necessary (Kangxi 廁: 或曰溷, 或曰圊); ~~in order, to put in proper places, as guests~~ to put amongst, to mingle (Kangxi 廁: 閒也次也); a gorge, where a stream forces its way (Kangxi 廁: 高岸夾水曰廁); _ts(')z'(3) (1)h(a/)ng_ (ci3 haang1 廁坑) or _ts(')z'(3) (2)sho_ (ci3 so2 廁所), a privy. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _ch(')(i/)(3)_ per 《廣韻》初吏切. Williams' "privy", "necessary": That is, a toilet. Williams' "... to put in proper places, as guests": This is a misreading of Kangxi's example 《史記樂毅傳》廁之賔客之中. Here, it is not the guests who are being put in place; rather, someone is being placed *amongst* the guests.

zi3.text: U+6063 ci3 (per Fan Wan, common) (F2.35 恣(3) _Ts(')z'(3)_ (ci3)) 縱恣無忌 (Page 617 #1: 恣(3) _Ts(')z'(3)_ (ci3)) Relaxation, dissipation; licentious, gay, loose (Kangxi: 縱也); to follow one's passions, to throw off all restraint (Kangxi: 恣謂狡㹟淫戲不以禮也); _fong(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (fong3 ci3 放恣) profligate, dissipated; to give the rein to one's lusts; _tsung(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (zung3 ci3 縱恣) unrestrained. 【恣】 (tsijH) (_verb-like_) to wanton, to indulge

U+61E5 ci3 (alternative per 《集韻》丑吏切) (F1.42 懥 _Ch(')(i/)(3)_ (ci3)) 忿恨怒也 (Page 12* #12: 懥(3) _Ch(')(i/)(3)_ (ci3); here normalised to _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3)) ~~Vexation, irritated~~ Angry (Kangxi: 怒也); hatred; _(5)fan ~~ch(')(i/)(3)~~ ch(i/)(3)_ (fan5 zi3 忿懥) enraged, in a great anger. 【懥】 (tsyijH, trijH) (_noun-like_) enragement

ci3.text: U+673F (Page 617 #4: 朿(3)) To be distinguished from 束 _ch(')uk(7)_ (cuk1) to bind. A thorn, a prickle, a sliver, a sharp slit (Kangxi: 木芒也).

U+6B21 May appear as either ⿰二欠 (assumed here) or ⿰冫欠, depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 次 as a component. (F2.35 次) 次第 (Page 616 #11: 次(3)) Neither first nor best (Kangxi: 不前不精也); coming after, second in order, inferior, secondary; next, succeeding; to put in order (Kangxi: 位次); a halting-place, an encampment (Kangxi: 師止曰次, 安行旅之處爲旅次); a rest-house, an inn, a shed or stall (Kangxi: 凡舍皆曰次); a mansion (Kangxi: 次舍); a position, as of the stars (Kangxi: 星之躔舍爲次); a time, a place, a stated post; to halt, to reach (Kangxi: 至也); _ts(')z'(3) tai(6)_ (ci3 dai6 次第) in order, regularly; _tsoi(6) (4)k(')(i/) ts(')z'(3)_ (zoi6 kei4 ci3 在其次) in that place; next in order; _(4)t(')au ts(')z'(3)_ (tau4 ci3 頭次) the first time; _(4)ts(')ang (4)ts(')ang ts(')z'(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (cang4 cang4 ci3 ci3 層層次次) rising gradually like a gallery; _ts(')z'(3) yat(9)_ (ci3 jat6 次日) next day; _ts(o\)(6) ts(')z'(3)_ (zou6 ci3 造次) flighty, flurried; _(5)lui ts(')z'(3)_ (leoi5 ci3 屢次) repeatedly; _ts(')z'(3) (4)ngan_ (ci3 ngan4 次銀), inferior silver; _wai(6) ts(')z'(3)_ (wai6 ci3 位次) a seat, a position; _h(a/)k(8) ts(')z'(3)_ (haak3 ci3 客次) a stranger's lodging, travelers' houses. The form ⿰冫欠 is compatibility ideograph U+2F8EF. 【次】 (tshijH) (_adjective-like_) next, second (_verb-like_) to come next (_noun-like_) sequence (_verb-like_) to camp, to lodge Used in 造次.

U+71BE 炽 (Mainland simplified) (F1.42 熾) 火盛 (Page 12* #8: 熾(3)) Flame, blaze; splendor (Kangxi: 熾盛也); the glare of lights; numerous; _(5)(i/) (4)yau kau(3) (2)fo, (u(6) p(')ok(8) (u(6) ch(')(i/)(3)_ (ji5 jau4 gau3 fo2 jyu6 pok3 jyu6 ci3 以油救火愈撲愈熾) as if you should try to put out a fire with oil, the more the fiercer it burns. 【熾】 (tsyhiH) (_adjective-like_) blazing

zik1.text: U+7E54 织 (Mainland simplified) zi3 (per Kangxi 職利切 for "dyed-weaving" sense) (F1.76 織) 扣結布帛之總名 (Page 13* #2: 織(7)) To weave (Kangxi: 作布帛之總名); woven; _chik(7) (4)(u_ (zik1 jyu4 織餘), a thrum left in the web; _ts(')uk(7) chik(7)_ (cuk1 zik1 促織) a cricket; _chik(7) (1)k(i/)_ (zik1 gei1 織機), a loom; _chik(7) (5)n(u_ (zik1 neoi5-2 織女), the star Wega _α_ in Lyra; _chik(7) ~~p(o\)(6)~~ p(o\)(3)_ (zik1 bou3 織布) to weave cloth. Williams' 織布: Corrected _p(o\)(6)_ (bou6) to _p(o\)(3)_ (bou3). Dyed woven cloth (Kangxi: 織染絲織之士衣染繒也). 【織-departing】 (tsyiH) (_noun-like_) dyed-weaving 【織-entering】 (tsyik) (_verb-like_) to weave

ci3.text: U+7FC5 翄 (F1.42 翅) 鳥翼 (Page 12* #11: 翅(3)翄(3)) Wings (Kangxi 翄: 翼也); fins; _ch(')(i/)(3) yik(9)_ (ci3 jik6 翅翼) wings; _(4)(u ch(')(i/)(3)_ (jyu4 ci3 魚翅) fins; the shark's fins; _(2)ch(i/)n ch(')(i/)(3)_ (zin2 ci3 展翅) to ~~flap~~ spread the wings; _ch(')(i/)(3) (4)p(')(a/)i_ (ci3 paai4 翅排), spread out like a comb; _(4)kw(')an ch(')(i/)(3)_ (kwan4 ci3 裙翅) and _(1)t(u/)i ch(')(i/)(3)_ (deoi1 ci3 堆翅) are sorts of shark's fins.
U+86D3 蚝 螆 A type of hairy caterpillar (Kangxi: 毛蟲也).
U+8786 May appear as either ⿰虫兹 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰虫茲 (+10), depending on the font.

zi1.text: U+8786 May appear as either ⿰虫兹 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰虫茲 (+10), depending on the font. 蛓 (Page 610 #8: (1)蛓(1)螆) A colloquial word. A louse, a nit; insects that ~~irritates~~ irritate the skin; an itching, pickling; _l(a/)i(3) (1)tsz'_ (laai3 zi1 癩螆) the itch; _yat(7) (1)shan (1)tsz'_ (jat1 san1 zi1 一身螆) whole person is frowzy; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng (1)tsz' (2)kau_ (saang1 zi1 gau2 生螆狗), a mangy dog; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng (1)tsz' (2)kau (2)k(o\)m (1)sheng_ (saang1 zi1 gau2 gam2 seng1 生螆狗噉聲), a peevish child, always whining for something to eat; _(2)shui (1)tsz'_ (seoi2 zi1 水螆) water spiders; _(4)m(o\) (1)tsz'_ (mou4 zi1 毛螆) hairy worms. Williams' 生螆狗, 生螆狗噉聲: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【螆】 (zi1) A flea, louse, or small insect. 水螆 (seoi2 zi1): "Water flea." 生螆 (saang1 zi1): "Got lice." 蚊螆 (man1 zi1): "Mosquitoey." An itch. The spelling 螆 is arbitrary (but well established).

ci3.text: U+8CDC 赐 (Mainland simplified) si3 (per 《廣韻》斯義切) (F2.35 賜) 與也惠也 (Page 617 #6: 賜(3)) To confer (Kangxi: 予也); bestowed by a superior, usually refers to the emperor; imperial grants; a favor (Kangxi: 賜猶惠也); a benefit; _(2)sh(e/)ung ts(')z'(3)_ (soeng2 ci3 賞賜) to reward; _(1)yam ts(')z'(3)_ (jam1 ci3 欽賜) imperial favors; _shau(6) ts(')z'(3)_ (sau6 ci3 受賜) to receive a benefit; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)k(u/)n ts(')z'(3) fuk(7)_ (tin1 gun1 ci3 fuk1 天官賜福) may heaven send down blessings; _ts(')z'(3) muk(9)_ (ci3 muk6 賜目) to look at; _p(a/)i(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (baai3 ci3 拜賜) to thank; _(4)mung ts(')z'(3) k(u/)(3)_ (mung4 ci3 gu3 蒙賜顧) obliged for your patronage---a phrase on bills; _(u(6) ts(')z'(3) (1)f(a/) (4)ling_ (jyu6 ci3 faa1 ling4 御賜花翎), an imperial gift of a peacock's feather. 【賜】 (sjeH) (_verb-like_) to confer

U+994E May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 糦 (F1.42 饎) 酒食 (F1.42 糦) 黍稷 (Page 12* #13: 饎(3)糦(3)) To cook or dress provisions (Kangxi 饎: 炊黍稷曰饎); wine and food (Kangxi 饎: 饎酒食也), victuals; millet used in sacrifice (Kangxi 糦: 大祭亦稷也); _ch(')(i/)(3) ch(a/)n(6)_ (ci3 zaan6 饎饌) food and drink; _ch(')(i/)(3) (4)(i/)n_ (ci3 jin4 饎筵), a feast. 【饎】 (tsyhiH) (_noun-like_) rice-offering, feast

ci4.text: U+577B (F1.38 坻) 水中高地 (Page 11* #4: (4)坻) An islet (Kangxi: 小渚曰沚小沚曰坻); a ledge of rocks in a stream (Kangxi: 水中高地也); a bank; to bank in; 【坻】 (drij) (_noun-like_) islet

U+5880 (F1.38 墀) 丹墀 (Page 11* #2: (4)墀) A porch, a vestibule or piazza, reached by a few steps (Kangxi: 涂地也, 階上地也); a courtyard; the path or walk somewhat elevated between the gate and palace; _(1)t(a/)n (4)ch(')(i/)_ (daan1 ci4 丹墀), the vermilion avenue, _i. e._ the emperor's palace.

U+6148 May appear as either ⿱兹心 (+9 assumed here) or ⿱茲心 (+10), depending on the font. (F2.34 慈) 慈相心之柔也愛也 (Page 615 #8: (4)慈) Maternal affection (Kangxi: 父母之愛子也); love (Kangxi: 愛也), kindness, mercy, compassion; gentle, soft, tender to (Kangxi: 柔也); a mother; _(1)k(a/) (4)ts(')z'_ (gaa1 ci4 家慈) my mother; _(4)ts(')z' (1)sam_ (ci4 sam1 慈心), kindhearted; _(4)ts(')z' (5)m(o\)_ (ci4 mou5 慈母), kind mothers---often spoil their children; _(4)shing (4)ts(')z' ming(6)_ (sing4 ci4 ming6 承慈命) I received my mother's orders; _(4)ts(')z' (1)p(i/)_ (ci4 bei1 慈悲), compassionate; _(4)ts(')z' (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (ci4 coeng4 慈祥), long-suffering, forbearance; _(4)ts(')z' oi(3)_ (ci4 oi3 慈愛) loving affection. The form ⿱茲心 is compatibility ideograph U+2F8A6. Williams' 承慈命: Used in marriage invitations, indicating that the groom/bride's father has arranged the marriage according to the wishes of the groom/bride's father's mother. 【慈】 (dzi) (_noun-like_) affection, kindness, (_met._) mother

U+6301 (F1.38 持) 執持又扶持 (Page 11* #8: (4)持) To take, to lay hold of, to grasp (Kangxi: 握也, 執也); to observe or maintain; firm, decided; to direct resolutely; _(2)p(a/) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (baa2 ci4 把持), to manage an affair; _(1)ts(')(o\) sh(i/)n(3) (i/)(6) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (cou1 sin3 ji6 ci4 粗扇二持), two common fans; _(4)f(u/) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (fu4 ci4 扶持), to assist; _chap(7) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (zap1 ci4 執持), to hold in the hand; _(1)ts(')(o\) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (cou1 ci4 操持), to do with energy; _(4)ch(')(i/) f(a/)t(8)_ (ci4 faat3 持法) to maintain the law. 【持】 (dri) (_verb-like_) to hold

U+6C60 (F1.38 池) 池沼 (Page 11* #6: (4)池) A tank, a pool, a pond (Kangxi: 治也...停水曰池); a ditch, a fosse (Kangxi: 城塹曰溝池); stagnant water; _~~(4)sheng~~ (4)shing (4)ch(')(i/)_ (sing4 ci4 城池), a moat; _(1)chung (4)ch(')(i/)_ (zung1 ci4 中池), the heart; _(i/)n(6) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (jin6 ci4 硯池), a water-cup for writing; _(2)tsau (4)ch(')(i/) yuk(9) (4)lam_ (zau2 ci4 juk6 lam4 酒池肉林), a wine tank and meat-grove, _i. e._ plenty; _(1)ch(')(a/) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (caa1 ci4 差池), a mirage pool, a take-in, a mistake; _(4)ch(')(i/) (4)t(')ong_ (ci4 tong4 池塘) or _(4)(u (4)ch(')(i/)_ (jyu4 ci4 魚池), a fish-pool. Williams' 城池: Changed _(4)sheng_ (seng4) to literary reading _(4)shing_ (sing4). Williams' 酒池肉林: Originally used to describe the excesses of 紂王. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【池】 (drje) (_noun-like_) pool

U+6CBB (Page 9* #12: 治(6) _Ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6); here corrected to _(4)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci4)) Name of a stream (Kangxi: 水名) in the east of Sh(a/)ntung (山東); In modern usage, the level-tone reading _(4)ch(')(i/)_ (ci4) for the verb senses is considered obsolete. See commentary at 治 zi6.

zi6.text: U+6CBB ci4 (for literary verb senses) (F1.43 治) 理也平也 (Page 9* #12: 治(6)) to govern, to rule well, to manage (Kangxi: 亦理也); to heal; to oversee (Kangxi: 監督也), to care for; to form; to try causes (Kangxi: 聽獄之成辭亦曰治); experienced, talented (Kangxi: 才多亦曰治); prosperity, good government; _ch(i/)(6) (1)song_ (zi6 song1 治喪), to oversee a funeral; _ch(i/)(6) h(a/)(6) (2)ch(e/)_ (zi6 haa6 ze2 治下者), subjects, the governed; _(1)(i/) ch(i/)(6)_ (ji1 zi6 醫治) to cure; _(1)t(')(i/)n h(a/)(6) t(a/)i(6) ch(i/)(6)_ (tin1 haa6 daai6 zi6 天下大治) the empire well governed, firm peace; _(4)m(o\) f(a/)t(8) (2)ho ch(i/)(6)_ (mou4 faat3 ho2 zi6 無法可治) there's no way of managing him; _ch(i/)(6) (1)k(a/)_ (zi6 gaa1 治家), to order a family; _ch(i/)(6) l(un(6)_ (zi6 lyun6 治亂) to suppress rebellion. The level-tone reading _(4)ch(')(i/)_ (ci4) is the classical reading for verb senses of govern (e.g. 治國 "govern the nation"), as opposed to departing-tone _ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6) for adjective senses of govern (e.g. 國治 "the nation governed"). Notwithstanding, the only conclusion that can be drawn from 《廣韻》 is that the proper-noun sense is in level tone: 《廣韻》直之切 治 水名出東萊亦理也 《廣韻》直利切 治 治理也又直之切 《廣韻》直吏切 治 治理也又丈之切 Nevertheless, the distinction in reading between the verb "govern" and the adjective "governed" is not made up. In 《大學章句》, 治其國 is annotated with 治平聲, whilst 國治 is annotated with 治去聲. In modern usage, level-tone _(4)ch(')(i/)_ (ci4) is considered obsolete. 【治-level】 (dri) (_verb-like_) to govern, to administer, to regulate 【治-departing】 (driH) (_adjective-like_) governed, administered, regulated 【三文治】 (saam1 man4 zi6) A sandwich. 【治】 (zi6) Short for 三文治. 腿蛋治 (teoi2 daan6-2 zi6): "Ham and egg sandwich." The spelling 三文治 (and hence 治) is arbitrary (but well established).

ci4.text: U+74F7 甆 磁 (F2.34 磁) 磁器 (Page 615 #9: (4)磁; here normalised to 瓷) porcelain, chinaware (Kangxi 瓷: 瓦器也); _(4)ts(')z' h(i/)(3)_ (ci4 hei3 瓷器) crockeryware; _(4)y(e/)ung (4)ts(')z'_ (joeng4 ci4 洋瓷) foreign chinaware. Williams does not consider 瓷 (porcelain) to be a different word to 磁 (magnet). I have split things up accordingly.

U+78C1 慈 𥔵 礠 (F2.34 磁) 磁器 (Page 615 #9: (4)磁) The loadstone (Kangxi: 本作礠省从兹, 石名可以引鍼); _(4)ts(')z' shek(9)_ (ci4 sek6 磁石) the loadstone; Williams does not consider 瓷 (porcelain) to be a different word to 磁 (magnet). I have split things up accordingly. Williams' "loadstone": An old word for a (natural) magnet. Also spelt "lodestone".

U+7960 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.34 祠) 祖祠 (Page 615 #5: (4)祠) To sacrifice to ancestors in the spring (Kangxi: 祭也, 春曰祠); a family shrine, an ancestral temple; a temple, a shrine (Kangxi: 廟也); to get a blessing (Kangxi: 報賽也, 求福曰禱得求曰祠); _(4)shan (4)ts(')z'_ (san4 ci4 神祠) shrine to the gods, said of the national ones; an ancestral tablet; _(4)ts(')z' (4)t(')ong_ (ci4 tong4-2 祠堂), an ancestral temple; _fuk(7) tak(7) (4)ts(')z'_ (fuk1 dak1 ci4 福德祠) shrine of street gods; _ts(i/)t(8) h(a/)u(3) (4)ts(')z'_ (zit3 haau3 ci4 節孝祠) a temple to virtuous women. 【祠】 (zi) (_noun-like_) spring-sacrifice, sacrifice (_noun-like_) ancestral-shrine

U+7BEA 竾 筂 䶵 (F1.38 篪) 塤篪又樂器 (Page 11* #9: (4)篪) A kind of bamboo flute, with seven holes (Kangxi: 管樂也, 周禮云篪七孔); the sound resembles the wailing of children (Kangxi: 篪啼也...如嬰兒啼聲); _(4)ch(')(i/) (1)h(un_ (ci4 hyun1 篪壎), two instruments which chord; fraternal love. 【篪】 (drje) (_noun-like_) flute
U+7CA2

zi1.text: U+7CA2 秶 齍 (F2.34 粢) 黍稷曰粢 (Page 612 #2: (1)粢) A common name for grains ~~and pulse~~ (Kangxi: 稷也); rice used in sacrifices, which must be of the best; Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱禾氺 to 黍. 【粢】 (tsij) (_noun-like_) millet

ci4.text: U+7CCD May appear as either ⿰米兹 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰米茲 (+10), depending on the font. Commonly used in the term 糯米糍.

U+81CD 齊 脐 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 臍) 肚臍 (Page 616 #2: (4)臍) The navel (Kangxi: 肶臍也); ~~to cut off even;~~ _(4)ts(')z' t(a/)i(3)_ (ci4 daai3-2 臍帶) the umbilical cord; _shai(6) (4)ts(')z' mok(9) k(')ap(9)_ (sai6 ci4 mok6 kap6 噬臍莫及) hard as for one to bite his own navel; _(5)t(')(o\) (4)ts(')z'_ (tou5 ci4 肚臍) the navel; _(5)n(un (4)ts(')z' (1)k(o\)_ (nyun5 ci4 gou1 暖臍膏), a plaster to keep the navel warm. Williams' "to cut off even": This is a misreading of either Kangxi 劑也 (which means "portion") or Kangxi 通作齊 (which indicates that 臍 can be written 齊, not the other way round). 【臍】 (dzej) (_noun-like_) navel

U+8328 (F2.34 茨) 茨菰 (Page 616 #3: (4)茨) To thatch (Kangxi: 以茅蓋屋); grass on a wall; a spinous trailing plant with triangular seed (Kangxi: 蒺藜也); to collect (Kangxi: 積也聚也); _(4)ts(')z' (1)k(u/)_ (ci4 gu1 茨菰), the _Caladium sagittifolium_, a species of Arum. 【茨】 (dzij) (_verb-like_) to thatch (_noun-like_) puncture-vine
U+8332 兹 Used in 龜茲 (Kucha, the name of a kingdom) (Kangxi: 國名).

zi1.text: U+8332 兹 茊 (F2.34 兹) 此也 (Page 610 #6: (1)茲(1)兹) Herbs and shrubs in great abundance (Kangxi 茲: 草木多益也); a mat (Kangxi 茲: 蓐席也); an adjective, this (Kangxi 茲: 此也); an adverb, here; a conjunction, but, still; _(1)tsz' (2)ch(e/)_ (zi1 ze2 茲者), the following---a phrase used at the beginning of a notice; _tsoi(6) (1)tsz'_ (zoi6 zi1 在茲) here; _(1)tsz' (1)kam_ (zi1 gam1 茲今), now; _n(i/)m(6) (1)tsz' tsoi(6) (1)tsz'_ (nim6 zi1 zoi6 zi1 念茲在茲) thinking of a thing without distraction; _(1)(u (1)tsz'_ (jyu1 zi1 於茲) hereupon, now then---an illative phrase. 【茲】 (tsi) (_determiner-like_) this (_adverb-like_) now, at this time

ci4.text: U+86B3 (F1.38 蚳) 姓 (Page 11* #5: (4)蚳) Eggs or larva of ants (Kangxi: 蟻卵也). ~~One says, a bloodsucker.~~ 【蚳】 (drij) (_noun-like_) ant-egg

U+8A5E 䛐 辭 词 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 詞) 言詞 (Page 615 #6: (4)詞) An expression, a phrase, a sentence, a word (Kangxi: 說也, 言也); a particle; a writing (Kangxi: 文也), an accusation; to speak, to tell the thoughts, to say (Kangxi: 意內而言外也)~~,~~; to accuse (Kangxi: 吿也); to request, to ask (Kangxi: 請也); _(4)ts(')z' pat(7) t(a/)t(9) (i/)(3)_ (ci4 bat1 daat6 ji3 詞不達意) the sentence does not fully convey the idea; _(4)ts(')z' (4)lam_ (ci4 lam4 詞林), the H(a/)nlin (翰林) Academy; _(4)man (4)ts(')z'_ (man4 ci4 文詞) writings; _chong(6) (4)ts(')z'_ (zong6 ci4 狀詞) an accusation, a petition. (Page 615 #7: (4)辭(4)辞) Similar to the last (詞); 【詞】 (zi) (_noun-like_) phrase, expression

U+8E1F (F1.38 踟) 踟𨆼 (Page 11* #10: (4)踟) Irresolute (Kangxi: 踟躕行不進也); _(4)ch(')(i/) (4)ch(')(u_ (ci4 cyu4 踟躕), undecided, embarrassed, going on and then returning. Williams' "embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed". 【踟】 (drje) Used in 踟躕. 【踟躕】 (drje drju) (_verb-like_) to walk about hesitatingly
U+8F9E (F2.34 辭) 言辭又不受也 (F2.34 辞) 同上 (Page 615 #7: (4)辭(4)辞)

U+8FAD 辞 辤 (F2.34 辭) 言辭又不受也 (F2.34 辞) 同上 (Page 615 #7: (4)辭(4)辞) an expression, a word, a particle, a part of speech; evidence (Kangxi 辭: 訟辭也), speech, words (Kangxi 辭: 辭說也); to refuse, to decline with thanks (Kangxi 辭: 卻不受也); to resign, to leave, to go, to retire, to depart (Kangxi 辭: 別去也); _(1)t(')(u/)i (4)ts(')z'_ (teoi1 ci4 推辭) to decline, as an office; _(4)ts(')z' h(u(3)_ (ci4 heoi3 辭去) to leave, as one's service; _k(o\)(3) (4)ts(')z'_ (gou3 ci4 告辭) to take leave, to bid good bye; _(1)sam (4)ts(')z'_ (sam1 ci4 心辭) to dislike, averse to; _(1)kung (4)ts(')z' pak(7) (5)sh(e/)ung_ (gung1 ci4 bak1 soeng5 恭辭北上), a respectful adieu on going to Peking (北京); _kok(8) chap(7) yat(7) (4)ts(')z'_ (gok3 zap1 jat1 ci4 各執一辭) each held to his own argument; _(4)ts(')z' ~~t(')(i/)p(9)~~ t(')(i/)p(8)_ (ci4 tip3-2 辭帖) to send a card of invitation back; _(4)ts(')z' (4)hang ~~t(')(i/)p(9)~~ t(')(i/)p(8)_ (ci4 hang4 tip3-2 辭行帖) a card to take leave; _(1)h(u (4)ts(')z'_ (heoi1 ci4 虛辭) a falsehood; _t(')(a/)n(3) (5)(u (4)ts(')z'_ (taan3 jyu5 ci4 嘆語辭) an interjection; _(2)h(o\) (4)ts(')z' k(u(3)_ (hou2 ci4 geoi3 好辭句) a good style. Williams' 辭帖, 辭行帖: Corrected _t(')(i/)p(9)_ (tip6) to _t(')(i/)p(8)_ (tip3). 【辭】 (zi) (_noun-like_) statement (_verb-like_) to decline (_verb-like_) to take leave

U+9072 赿 遅 遟 迟 (Mainland simplified) ci4-2 (rising second in vernacular 遲遲地) (F1.38 遲) 緩也又迎也又陵遲 (Page 11* #3: (4)遲) Slow, dilatory (Kangxi: 徐行也); late, tardy; not urgent (Kangxi: 緩也, 緩而不迫也); to delay, to walk leisurely; to procrastinate; _(4)loi tak(7) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (loi4 dak1 ci4 來得遲), came late; _(4)ch(')(i/) (1)s(a/)m yat(9) tsau(6) (4)loi_ (ci4 saam1 jat6 zau6 loi4 遲三日就來), come in three days; _(4)ch(')(i/) (1)hi(u/)_ (ci4 hiu1 遲嘵), you are late! _(5)t(')o (4)ch(')(i/)_ (to5 ci4 ？遲), to put off continually; _k(o\)m(3) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (gam3 ci4 咁遲), so late! _f(u/)i(3) han(6) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (fui3 han6 ci4 悔恨遲), unavailing repentance; _(4)ch(')(i/) (4)loi pat(7) k(')ap(9)_ (ci4 loi4 bat1 kap6 遲來不及) you will be too late to reach the boat; _(4)ch(')(i/) (5)h(a/) (1)t(')(i/)m_ (ci4 haa5 tim1 遲吓添) wait a little longer; _(4)ch(')(i/) yat(7) chan(6)_ (ci4 jat1 zan6 遲一陣) wait a while; _(4)ch(')(i/) (4)'m (4)ch(')(i/)_ (ci4 m4 ci4 遲唔遲), will it be late? am I late? _(1)ch(')(e/)ung ngoi(6) yat(9) (4)ch(')(i/) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (coeng1 ngoi6 jat6 ci4 ci4 窗外日遲遲), the sun goes down slowly. 【遲-level】 (drij) (_adjective-like_) slow

zi6.text: U+9072 遅 遟 迟 (Mainland simplified) (Page 11* #3: (4)遲 _(4)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci4); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6)) to wait for (Kangxi: 待也); 【遲-departing】 (drijH) (_verb-like_) to await

ci4.text: U+9908 粢 糍 䭣 (F2.34 餈) 飯餅 (Page 612 #2: (1)粢 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1); here corrected to _(4)Ts(')z'_ (ci4) and normalised to 餈) a cake of glutinous rice (Kangxi 粢: 稻餠與餈同). (Page 616 #4: (4)餈) Unleavened cakes; pancakes, or dumplings made of rice flour (Kangxi: 稻餠也); _(4)yau (4)ts(')z'_ (jau4 ci4 油餈) cakes fried in fat; _(4)y(e/) (4)ts(')z'_ (je4 ci4 椰餈) cocoanut flour cakes. The alternative form 糍 is commonly used in the term 糯米糍 (see below). 【糯米糍】 (no6 mai5 ci4) Glutinous rice balls.

U+99B3 䮈 驰 (Mainland simplified) (F1.38 馳) 馳驅又馳騖 (Page 11* #7: (4)馳) To gallop, to ride fast (Kangxi: 走奔也, 馳騖也疾驅也), as a courier; ~~a fleet horse;~~ to go fast; fast; far, spread abroad; _(4)ch(')(i/) t(o\)(6)_ (ci4 dou6 馳道) the middle road for the emperor; _ngoi(6) m(o\)(6) (1)fan (4)ch(')(i/)_ (ngoi6 mou6 fan1 ci4 外騖分馳), harrassed with cares; _(4)ch(')(i/) (5)m(a/)_ (ci4 maa5 馳馬), to gallop a horse; _(4)ch(')(i/) yik(9)_ (ci4 jik6 馳驛) to ride post; _(4)ch(')(i/) (1)k(')(u_ (ci4 keoi1 馳驅), to ride fast. 【馳】 (drje) (_verb-like_) to gallop, to speed

U+9DBF May appear as either ⿱兹鳥 (+9 assumed here) or ⿱茲鳥 (+10), depending on the font. 鷀 鹚 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 鷀) 鸕鷀水鳥 (Page 616 #1: (4)鷀; here normalised to 鶿) The fishing cormorant (Kangxi 鶿: 水鳥), the _Phalacrocorax;_ _(4)l(o\) (4)ts(')z'_ (lou4 ci4 鸕鶿) the cormorant, poetically called _(2)shui (5)l(o\) (1)(a/)_ (seoi2 lou5 aa1 水老鴉), or the old water crow.

ci5.text: U+4F3C 佀 ci5-2 (rising second in vernacular 似似地) (F2.35 似) 如也肖也 (Page 616 #8: (5)似) Like, similar; as, as if, as it were, appearing, resembling (Kangxi: 肖也); to appear, to have the aspect of; _(2)h(o\) (5)ts(')z'_ (hou2 ci5 好似) like; _(5)ts(')z' (4)'m (5)ts(')z'_ (ci5 m4 ci5 似唔似) is it like or not? _(4)'m (1)to (5)ts(')z'_ (m4 do1 ci5 唔多似) not very similar; _(5)ts(')z' tsuk(7) (5)n(i/)_ (ci5 zuk1 nei5 似足你), just like you; _(5)ts(')z' sh(i/)(6) (4)(i/) (1)f(i/)_ (ci5 si6 ji4 fei1 似是而非), somewhat of right, but still wrong; _(5)yau shing(3) (5)ts(')z' (5)ngo tik(7)_ (jau5 sing3 ci5 ngo5 dik1 有勝似我的) there are those superior to me; _(4)yan (5)yau (1)s(e/)ung (5)ts(')z'_ (jan4 jau5 soeng1 ci5 人有相似) they resemble each other. To continue (Kangxi: 嗣也). To present, to give (Kangxi: 况也奉也). 【似】 (ziX) (_verb-like_) to resemble (_conjunction-like_) like Cantonese prefers classical 似 over 像. 【似】 (ci5) To resemble, to be like. 似佢阿媽 (ci5 keoi5 aa3 maa1): "She resembles her mum." 好似得咗 (hou2 ci5 dak1 zo2): "Seems like it worked." 【似樣】 (ci5 joeng6-2) To resemble in appearance. 好似樣 (hou2 ci5 joeng6-2): "They really look alike." To appear acceptable, to look the part. 噉似樣啲 (gam2 ci5 joeng6-2 di1): "It looks more acceptable like this."

U+59D2 㚶 (F2.35 姒) 兄弟之妻相謂曰姒又文王之妃曰太姒 (Page 616 #9: ~~(2)姒~~(5)姒) An elder brother's wife; _~~(2)ts(')z'~~ (5)ts(')z' tai(6)_ (ci5 dai6 姒娣) sisters-in-law; _(5)ts(')z' (5)f(u/)_ (ci5 fu5 姒婦), an old lady---a term used by the young.

U+6C5C 洍 (Page 616 #10: (5)汜) A stream leaving the main branch, and afterwards flowing into it again (Kangxi: 水別復入水也); _(5)ts(')z' (2)shui_ (ci5 seoi2 汜水), a small river in Hon(a/)n (河南) (Kangxi: 水名 etc.), west of K(')(a/)ifung f(u/) (開封府), having a town of the same name. Unflowing water (Kangxi: 一曰汜窮瀆也, 謂困窮不通之水瀆名汜也). 【汜】 (ziX) (_noun-like_) rejoining-water

cik1.text: U+52C5 (F1.74 勅) 天子制書曰勅命 (F1.74 勑) 同上 (F1.74 敕) 同上又戒謹 (Page 14* #9: 勅(7)敕(7))

U+53F1 𠮟 cat1 (per 《廣韻》昌栗切) (F1.74 叱) 呵叱怒罵也 (Page 15* #1: 叱(7)) To scold (Kangxi 𠮟: 訶也), to cry out to; to hoot at; to mention; _ch(')ik(7) m(a/)(6)_ (cik1 maa6 叱罵) to rail at; _ch(')ik(7) (2)kau_ (cik1 gau2 叱狗), to drive out a dog; _ch(')ik(7) (4)ming ch(i/)(3) (i/)(3)_ (cik1 ming4 zi3 ji3 叱名致意) mention my name, and make my respects. 【叱】 (tsyhit) (_verb-like_) to berate, to shout (at)

U+617C May appear as either ⿱戚心 or ⿵戚心 (assumed here), depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 慼 as a component. (F1.75 慼) 憂也 (Page 571 #1: 慼(7)) Grief, sorrow (Kangxi: 憂也); to be afflicted, to be sad; pained, mournful.

U+621A 慼 (for "grief" sense) 鏚 (for "battle-axe" sense) (F1.75 戚) 親戚憂戚又戚戚心動貌 (Page 570 #9: 戚(7)) A sort of pole-ax (Kangxi: 戉類, 戚斧也); to compassionate, to pity; mournful, sorry (Kangxi: 哀也); angry (Kangxi: 憤也), aroused, vexed (Kangxi: 憂也, 惱也); deformed~~, marked in any way~~ (Kangxi: 醜疾人曰戚施); near, related to, dear to (Kangxi: 戚近也); relatives (Kangxi: 親也); _(1)ts(')an ts(')ik(7)_ (can1 cik1 親戚) one's kindred; _(1)yau ts(')ik(7) (1)s(e/)ung (1)kw(a/)n_ (jau1 cik1 soeng1 gwaan1 休戚相關), to feel for other's woes, mutually effected; _ts(')ik(7) ts(')ik(7)_ (cik1 cik1 戚戚) melancholy. (Page 571 #1: 慼(7)) Used for the preceding (戚) (for the "grief" sense) (Kangxi 慼: 又通作戚). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【戚】 (tshek) (_noun-like_) battle-axe (_adjective-like_) grieved, distressed, mournful (_noun-like_) kin

U+6475 戚 (Cantonese) 【摵】 (cik1) To pull up, to lift up. 摵唔起 (cik1 m4 hei2): "Can't lift it up." 摵起衫袖 (cik1 hei2 saam1 zau6): "Pull the sleeve up." To pull or throb painfully. The spelling 摵 is arbitrary.

U+6555 勅 勑 飭 sik1 (common for "order" sense spelt 飭) (F1.74 勅) 天子制書曰勅命 (F1.74 勑) 同上 (F1.74 敕) 同上又戒謹 (Page 14* #9: 勅(7)敕(7)) An order, a prohibition or command from the emperor; an ordinance, a special precept (Kangxi 敕: 誡也); a charter, a commission; _ch(')ik(7) (1)sh(u_ (cik1 syu1 敕書), credentials; letters-patent; _ch(')ik(7) (1)fung_ (cik1 fung1 敕封), a special perferment; _ch(')ik(7) ming(6)_ (cik1 ming6 敕命) an imperial order; _ch(')ik(7) (4)f(u/)_ (cik1 fu4 敕符) to make a charm efficacious by spurting water on it; _ch(')ik(7) shau(6)_ (cik1 sau6 敕受) to receive commands; _ch(')ik(7) tsang(6)_ (cik1 zang6 敕贈) to bestow honors on one's dead parents. (Page 439 #3: 飭(7) _Shik(7)_ (sik1); here normalised to 敕 _Ch(')ik(7)_ (cik1)) To enjoin, to direct, to command~~, as an inferior~~ (Kangxi 飭: 與敕同命令也); _~~shik(7)~~ ch(')ik(7) (1)ch(')(a/)i_ (cik1 caai1 敕差), to dispatch on public service; _(1)shan ~~shik(7)~~ ch(')ik(7)_ (san1 cik1 申敕) to strictly charge, to order; _~~shik(7)~~ ch(')ik(7) (4)fong_ (cik1 fong4 敕房), to direct the proper office or department; _~~shik(7)~~ ch(')ik(7) ling(6)_ (cik1 ling6 敕令) to command, to direct. 【敕】 (trhik) (_verb-like_) to caution (_verb-like_) to command 【得敕】 (dak1 cik1) Smug. The spelling 敕 for cik1 is arbitrary.

U+65A5 㡿 (F1.74 斥) 開拒也又斥逐擯斥又斥候又斥鹵鹹地曰斥鹵 (Page 14* #10: 斥(7)) To exclude, to expel, to send off, to drive off (Kangxi: 逐也遠也); to scold; to pry into, to spy (Kangxi: 斥度也𠋫視也望也); reaching far, extending to, extensive (Kangxi: 斥廣也), plenty (Kangxi: ...言其多); _ch(')ik(7) chuk(9)_ (cik1 zuk6 斥逐) to order away; _m(i/)n(6) ch(')ik(7)_ (min6 cik1 面斥) to reprimand, to speak rudely to; _ch(')ik(7) (5)l(o\)_ (cik1 lou5 斥鹵), to let salt-water into the pans; _(2)ch(i/) ch(')ik(7)_ (zi2 cik1 指斥) to point out faults; _ch(')ik(7) fong(3)_ (cik1 fong3 斥放) to dismiss and banish; _ch(')ik(7) ch(')ut(7)_ (cik1 ceot1 斥出) to remove, to expel; _ch(')ik(7) p(a/)k(9) (5)k(')(u_ (cik1 baak6 keoi5 斥白佢), rate him plainly; _ch(')ik(7) f(a/)t(8)_ (cik1 faat3 斥法) to juggle. Williams' "to juggle": In the (now) archaic sense of performing magical trickery. Salty earth (Kangxi: 斥謂地鹹). To open up (Kangxi: 斥開也). To allocate or spend. 【斥】 (tsyhek) (_verb-like_) to reject (_noun-like_) saline-earth

U+2510E 戚 (Cantonese) 摵 (Cantonese) To make small eye-motions (Kangxi: 目小動也). 【𥄎】 (cik1) To move the eyes or eyebrows, especially subtly. 𥄎眉𥄎眼 (cik1 mei4 cik1 ngaan5): "Moving eyebrows and moving eyes." Olden attestation for 𥄎 _ts(')ik(7)_ (cik1) meaning "small eye-motions": 《廣韻》七役切 𥄎 小動
U+87AB (F1.74 螫) 蟲行毒也詩自求辛螫 (Page 15* #2: 螫(7))
U+93DA (F1.75 鏚) 斧也 (Page 571 #2: 鏚(7)) A sort of pole-ax, a bill (Kangxi: 干鏚斧鉞也, 鏚斧也); an ornamental kind of ax carried in processions. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 釜 to 斧.

U+98ED May appear with left component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 敕 饬 (Mainland simplified) sik1 (per Fan Wan, common) (F1.76 飭 _Shik(7)_ (sik1)) 致堅也又整備也又修飭 (Page 439 #3: 飭(7) _Shik(7)_ (sik1); here normalised to _Ch(')ik(7)_ (cik1)) to strengthen (Kangxi: 致堅也), to repair; to adjust, to prepare and arrange (Kangxi: 修治); ready, prepared (Kangxi: 整備也); compact, firm; reverent, careful, respectful (Kangxi: 謹貌); _(2)ching ~~shik(7)~~ ch(')ik(7) (2)h(o\) (5)k(')(u_ (zing2 cik1 hou2 keoi5 整飭好佢), put it in order, arrange it properly; Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱⿰朿攵正 to 整. 【飭】 (trhik) (_verb-like_) to strengthen (_verb-like_) to prepare, to arrange
U+9D92 鷘 (F1.74 𪅙) 鸂𪅙鳥名 (Page 15* #3: 鷘(7); here normalised to 鶒) A bird with a crest which frequents brooks; a gay colored water-bird (Kangxi 鶒: 鸂鶒水鳥也); a hoopoe? Fan Wan entry: Corrected 雞 to 鸂.
U+9DD8 (F1.74 𪅙) 鸂𪅙鳥名 (Page 15* #3: 鷘(7)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 雞 to 鸂.

cim1.text: U+50C9 佥 (Mainland simplified) (F2.47 僉) 咸也皆也共也 (F2.47 ？) 咸也皆也共也 (Page 571 #7: (1)僉) All, the whole (Kangxi: 皆也咸也); an unanimous voice, the general opinion (Kangxi: 衆共言之也); a flail (Kangxi: 連枷亦曰僉打穀具也); _(1)ts(')(i/)m ~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8)_ (cim1 aat3 僉押) all signed it. Williams' 僉押: Changed _(a/)p(8)_ (aap3) to common reading _(a/)t(8)_ (aat3). 【僉】 (tshjem) (_adjective-like_) all
U+20803 (F2.47 ？) 切也割也 (Page 571 #10: (1)𠠃) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 竊 to 切.

U+3510 𠠃 (F2.47 ？) 切也割也 (Page 571 #10: (1)𠠃; here normalised to 㔐) To cut (Kangxi 𠠃: 切割也); to stick in the throat; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (5)k(')(u (4)hau (4)lung_ (cim1 keoi5 hau4 lung4 㔐佢喉嚨), pierce his weasand; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (1)ch(u_ (cim1 zyu1 㔐豬), to stick a pig; _(1)ts(')(i/)m sh(u(6)_ (cim1 syu6 㔐樹) to ingraft by slips. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 竊 to 切. I have normalised 𠠃 to 㔐 for the better font support. 【㔐】 (cim1) To cut or sever. (_Chinese chess_) To capture a piece on an upper corner of the palace using an advisor. 士㔐 (si6 cim1): "Advisor captures on the upper corner." Olden attestation for 㔐 _(1)ts(')(i/)m_ (cim1) meaning "cut" or "sever": 《廣韻》七廉切 𠠃 𠠃切割也 《康熙字典》𠠃 《五音集韻》七廉切音籤切割也 《康熙字典》㔐 《玉篇》千廉切音僉割也〇按《五音集韻》作𠠃
U+5B45 (Page 572 #5: (1)孅) crafty, subtle (Kangxi: 孅趨巧佞也);

zim1.text: U+5E68 裧 襜 cim1 (per 《廣韻》處占切) cim3 (per 《廣韻》昌豔切 for "lapel" sense) (F2.47 幨) 帖也 (Page 16* #5: (1)幨) Similar to the last (襜). A curtain of a carriage (Kangxi: 車襜); a curtain over an opening (Kangxi: 帷也); an overlap or lapel ~~which hides a seam~~ (Kangxi: 披衣, 襟謂之幨). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𭘖 to 帖. To fray(?), to purse up (Kangxi: 絕也, 幨謂絕起也). 【幨-level】 (tsyhem) (_verb-like_) to fray, to purse up 【幨-departing】 (tsyhemH) (_noun-like_) lapel

cim1.text: U+61B8 (F2.47 憸) 利也 (Page 572 #1: (1)憸) Disputatious, skilled at arguing (Kangxi: 小人而謂之憸者形容其沾沾便捷之狀也); insidious, lying flattery (Kangxi: 憸詖也); _(1)ts(')(i/)m (4)yan_ (cim1 jan4 憸人), a flatterer. 【憸】 (sjem, tshjem) (_adjective-like_) glib-tongued

U+6BB2 瀸 歼 (Mainland simplified) zim1 (per 《廣韻》子廉切) (F2.47 殲) 滅也盡也 (Page 572 #2: (1)瀸; here normalised to 殲) (...) (Kangxi 瀸: 滅也通殲); _(1)ts(')(i/)m m(i/)t(9)_ (cim1 mit6 殲滅) to extirpate. (Page 572 #3: (1)殲) To destroy utterly, to exterminate (Kangxi: 殲盡也), to pierce, to kill; _yat(7) (1)t(o\) (1)ts(')(i/)m (2)sz' (5)k(')(u_ (jat1 dou1 cim1 sei2 keoi5 一刀殲死佢), stabbed him dead at a blow; _(1)ts(')(i/)m k(')(ut(8) (4)k(')(u (1)f(u/)i_ (cim1 kyut3 keoi4 fui1 殲厥渠魁), killed the chief himself. 【殲】 (tsjem) (_verb-like_) to annihilate
U+7038 zim1 (per 《廣韻》子廉切) (F2.47 瀸) 汲也 (Page 572 #2: (1)瀸) To soak, to moisten, to dampen (Kangxi: 漬也洽也); ~~to overflow;~~ a spring appearing and reappearing (Kangxi: 泉一見一否爲瀸 etc.);

U+7C3D 签 (Mainland simplified) (F2.47 簽) 竹簾又簽書 (Page 571 #8: (1)簽) to subscribe, to write one's name (Kangxi: 簽書文字也); a sort of basket (Kangxi: 簽籯籠也); _(1)ts(')(i/)m tsz'(6)_ (cim1 zi6 簽字) a circular, a subscription paper; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (4)meng_ (cim1 meng4-2 簽名), to write one's name; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (4)t(')ai_ (cim1 tai4 簽題), to subscribe to; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (1)kw(a/)n_ (cim1 gwaan1 簽關), to join in engaging a teacher;

U+7C64 簽 签 (Mainland simplified) (F2.47 籖) 神籤騐也又竹籌 (Page 571 #8: (1)簽; here normalised to 籤) Slips of bamboo written on for lots (...); _(1)ts(')(i/)m (5)(u_ (cim1 jyu5 籤語), to draw lots for a response. (Page 571 #9: (1)韱; here corrected to 籤) Similar to the above (簽); a slip, a lot (Kangxi 籤: 驗也, 竹籤用以卜者); a warrant, a permit, a ticket having the officer's name on it; to probe, to bore through (Kangxi 籤: 一曰...貫也); sharp-pointed (Kangxi 籤: 一曰銳也); _chai(3) (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (zai3 cim1 掣籤) or _(1)ch(a/) (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (zaa1 cim1 揸籤), to lot out officers to their stations; _(4)ng(o\) (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (ngou4 cim1 摮籤), to ~~draw~~ cast lots before idols; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (4)t(')ung_ (cim1 tung4 籤筒), a cup to hold the slips; _ch(')ut(7) (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (ceot1 cim1 出籤), to issue a warrant or permit; _(4)k(')au (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (kau4 cim1 求籤), to divine.

U+7E96 摻 (for "delicate" senses) 孅 (for "delicate" senses) 纤 (Mainland simplified) (F2.47 纖) 細微也 (F2.47 摻) 與纖同又音覽 (Page 572 #4: (1)纖(1)摻) Fine silk (Kangxi 纖: 繒帛之細者謂之纖); small, delicate (Kangxi 纖: 細也, 纖小也, 纖細也), like silken fibres; silk woven with a white woof and black warp (Kangxi 纖: 黑經白緯曰纖); niggardly, stingy (Kangxi 纖: 纖儉嗇也); _(1)ts(')(i/)m (4)h(o\)_ (cim1 hou4 纖毫), like a fibre, minute; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (1)ts(')(i/)m yuk(9) (2)shau_ (cim1 cim1 juk6 sau2 纖纖玉手), a delicate hand; _(1)ts(')(i/)m (1)i(u/)_ (cim1 jiu1 纖腰), a slender waist, (Page 572 #5: (1)孅; here normalised to 纖) slender, sharp-pointed, acute (Kangxi 孅: 銳細也與纖通); _(1)ts(')(i/)m y(e/)uk(9)_ (cim1 joek6 纖弱) weak and delicate. 【纖】 (sjem) (_adjective-like_) delicate (_noun-like_) chequered-silk

zim1.text: U+895C 裧 襝 cim1 (per 《廣韻》處占切) (F2.47 襜) 整也 (Page 16* #4: (1)襜) An apron (Kangxi: 衣蔽前謂之襜); a flap, a skirt; a curtain of a car (Kangxi: 帷也, 車上施帷 etc.); to adjust, to put the dress in order (Kangxi: 整貌); _(4)ts(')(i/)n (1)ch(i/)m_ (cin4 zim1 前襜), the front skirt; _(1)ch(i/)m (1)ch(i/)m_ (zim1 zim1 襜襜), nice and trim; flapping, as a curtain. To flap (Kangxi: 搖動貌). 【襜】 (tsyhem) (_noun-like_) apron (_verb-like_) to flap, to adjust

cim2.text: U+8AC2 讇 谄 (Mainland simplified) (F2.49 諂) 諛媚也 (F2.49 讇) 同上 (Page 16* #9: (2)諂(2)~~𨶒~~讇) To flatter (Kangxi 諂: 同讇省諛也), to lie to; to cajole; to give a god or man worship or praise not due to him; to fawn on, to court; gratifying to one's feelings, adulation, sycophancy; _(2)ch(')(i/)m m(i/)(6) (1)ch(i/) (4)yan_ (cim2 mei6 zi1 jan4 諂媚之人), a flatterer; _(2)ch(')(i/)m (u(6)_ (cim2 jyu6 諂譽) to praise extravagantly; _(2)ch(')(i/)m si(u/)(3)_ (cim2 siu3 諂笑) to cajole and laugh with; _(4)p(')an (4)(i/) (4)m(o\) (2)ch(')(i/)m_ (pan4 ji4 mou4 cim2 貧而無諂), poor without being sycophantic. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 謟 to 諂, headword ⿵門謟 to 讇, and headword self-reference to 上. 【諂】 (trhjemX) (_verb-like_) to flatter
U+8B87 (F2.49 諂) 諛媚也 (F2.49 讇) 同上 (Page 16* #9: (2)諂(2)~~𨶒~~讇) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 謟 to 諂, headword ⿵門謟 to 讇, and headword self-reference to 上.

cim3.text: U+50ED cim5 (common) zim3 (per 《廣韻》子念切) (F2.49 僭) 越分也爭也 (Page 572 #8: 僭(3)) To arrogate to one's self, to usurp, to assume (Kangxi: 假也, 儗也); to overstep one's limits or rank; usurped, despotic, assuming; _ts(')(i/)m(3) fan(6)_ (cim3 fan6 僭分) to assume to one's self; _ts(')(i/)m(3) wai(6)_ (cim3 wai6 僭位) to aspire to the throne; to take another's rank; _ts(')(i/)m(3) (1)s(i/)n (2)kong_ (cim3 sin1 gong2 僭先講), to speak before his turn. 【僭】 (tsemH) (_verb-like_) to usurp (_adjective-like_) erroneous 【僭建】 (cim3 gin3, cim5 gin3) Unauthorised addition of a structure to a building.

zam3.text: U+50ED (Page 572 #8: 僭(3) _Ts(')(i/)m(3)_ (cim3); here corrected to _Cham(3)_ (zam3)) dubious, false (Kangxi: 僭始不信之端也 etc.);

cim3.text: U+5879 壍 堑 (Mainland simplified) (F2.49 塹) 坑塹 (F2.49 壍) 同上 (Page 572 #9: 塹(3)壍(3)) The moat around a wall (Kangxi 塹: 遶城水也), a fosse, a ditch (Kangxi 塹: 坑也); a sluice to lead water upon trees; to deepen, to dig out; _~~kwat(7)~~ kwat(9) ts(')(i/)m(3)_ (gwat6 cim3 掘塹) to dig a sluice; _(1)h(a/)ng ts(')(i/)m(3)_ (haang1 cim3 坑塹) a gutter. Williams' 掘塹: Corrected _kwat(7)_ (gwat1) to _kwat(9)_ (gwat6). 【塹】 (tshjemH) (_noun-like_) trench, moat

U+66B9 cim1 (per 《廣韻》息廉切) (F2.49 暹) 日光也升也進也 (Page 572 #11: 暹(3)) The increasing light and splendor of the sun (Kangxi: 日光升也); advancing, rising higher and higher (Fan Wan: 進也); _Ts(')(i/)m(3) (4)lo kwok(8)_ (cim3 lo4 gwok3 暹羅國) Siam, a word probably corrupted from _Sien_ through the Portuguese language. Williams' "corrupted from _Sien_ ...": It is not clear whether the name 暹 for Siam predates the merger of final m into n in (Ming Dynasty?) Mandarin. In any case, Williams' hypothesis of corruption does not hold if the Portuguese got the word via an m-preserving variety of Chinese.

U+69E7 椠 (Mainland simplified) cim5 (alternative per 《廣韻》慈染切) (F2.49 槧) 斬木爲槧 (Page 572 #10: 槧(3)) Boards for cutting books on (Kangxi: 牘樸也); tablets for memoranda, tablets to be written on with a pencil. 《廣韻》 has four readings, among which 慈染切 _(5)ts(')(i/)m_ (cim5) and 七豔切 _ts(')(i/)m(3)_ (cim3) have explanations consistent with the "board" sense. Williams' "pencil": In the (now) dated sense of a brush.

zim1.text: U+4828 cim1 (per 《集韻》處占切) cim3 (per 《廣韻》昌豔切) (F2.47 䠨) 仰視 (Page 16* #7: (1)䠨) A horse traveling at full speed (Kangxi: 馬急行). Fan Wan entry: The explanation 仰視 is erroneous (it explains 瞻 rather than 䠨).

cim4.text: U+648D zaam2 (per 《廣韻》子感切 for "hand-movement" sense) zaam3 (per Kangxi 作紺切 for "take-up" sense) zam1 (per 《廣韻》側吟切 for "speed" sense) (Page 572 #7: (4)撍) To move with the hand (Kangxi: 手動也), to take up (Kangxi: 掇也); to select (Kangxi: 摘也), to pull out, as from a pile; to draw, as lots; quick, rapid, urgent (Kangxi: 疾也, 速也); _(4)ts(')(i/)m (4)'m (2)t(o\)_ (cim4 m4 dou3-2 撍唔到), I drew a blank lot; _(4)ts(')(i/)m ch(')ut(7)_ (cim4 ceot1 撍出) pull it out; _(4)ts(')(i/)m (4)ch(')au_ (cim4 cau4-2 撍籌), to draw a slip. The reading _(4)ts(')(i/)m_ (cim4) is not unattested for the "select" sense; 《集韻》 has the reading 慈鹽切, explained 摘也. 【撍】 (cim4) To select or draw out, especially from a pile. 撍鎖匙 (cim4 so2 si4): "Fishing for the keys." Olden attestation for 撍 _(4)ts(')(i/)m_ (cim4) meaning "select": 《集韻》 慈鹽切 撍 摘也

U+6F5B 潜 zim6 (alternative per 《廣韻》慈豔切 for "hide" sense) (F2.48 潛) 伏也藏也 (Page 572 #6: (4)潛(4)潜) To ford, to wade across, to cross water (Kangxi 潛: 涉水也); to dive (Kangxi 潛: 潛涵沉也又游也), to walk on the bottom (Kangxi 潛: 潛行水中亦曰游); to hide away, to abscond, to secrete one's self (Kangxi 潛: 藏也); an ancient name for the River H(a/)n (漢) (Kangxi 潛: 漢水之別名); carefully, feeling one's way, heedfully; ~~a cess-pool;~~ _(4)ts(')(i/)m p(o\)(6)_ (cim4 bou6 潛步) careful steps; _(4)ts(')(i/)m (4)hang (2)shui (1)chung_ (cim4 hang4 seoi2 zung1 潛行水中), to walk in the water; _(4)ch(')am (4)ts(')(i/)m_ (cam4 cim4 沉潛), reserved, diligent. Williams' "cess-pool": This is not correct. Perhaps "fish-pool", per Kangxi 魚之所息謂之潛, 潛糝也. According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, there are (competing) interpretations of 糝 in 潛糝也: Wood dropped into water, around which fish gather; and Water into which grain is thrown, to feed fish. 【潛-dive】 (dzjem) (_verb-like_) to dive 【潛-hide】 (dzjem, dzjemH) (_verb-like_) to hide

cin1.text: U+4EDF A captain of a thousand men (Kangxi: 千人之長曰仟).

U+5343 仟 (anti-alteration) (F1.19 千) 十百曰千 (Page 574 #6: (1)千) A thousand (Kangxi: 十百也); many, an indefinite number; _(1)ts(')(i/)n m(a/)n(6) i(u/)(3) ts(o\)(6)_ (cin1 maan6 jiu3 zou6 千萬要做) it must by all means be done; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (4)k(')(i/) (1)f(a/)n (4)lai_ (cin1 kei4 faan1 lai4 千祈返嚟), I earnestly beg you to return; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (1)kam_ (cin1 gam1 千金), your daughter; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (5)l(i/) (5)m(a/)_ (cin1 lei5 maa5 千里馬), a racehorse; a courier; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (2)tsung_ (cin1 zung2 千總), a lieutenant; _(5)l(o\) (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (lou5 cin1 老千), an old blackleg; name of a card; _(2)t(a/) (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (daa2 cin1 打千), to bend one knee; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (1)kan_ (cin1 gan1 千斤), a wrench to extract nails; _(1)ts(')(i/)n sui(3)_ (cin1 seoi3 千歲) your Highness, said to princes; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (1)kam kwai(3) (2)t(')ai_ (cin1 gam1 gwai3 tai2 千金貴體), your honorable self, said to any one; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (2)k(u/) (4)k(')(i/) sz'(6)_ (cin1 gu2 kei4 si6 千古奇事) exceedingly strange; _(1)ts(')(i/)n yat(7) pat(7) (2)koi_ (cin1 jat1 bat1 goi2 千一不改), a thousand to one he'll not reform. 【千】 (tshen) (_noun-like_) thousand 【老千】 (lou5 cin1) A swindler, conman, or cheat. 正一老千 (zing3 jat1 lou5 cin1): "He's a right swindler." An act of cheating, especially in gambling games. 咪出老千 (mai5 ceot1 lou5 cin1): "Don't you do any cheats."
U+828A 仟 阡 (F1.19 芊) 草盛貌 (Page 574 #7: (1)芊) Exuberant foliage, flourishing vegetation (Kangxi: 芊芊草盛貌); green, like jade (Kangxi: 碧貌); _(1)ts(')(i/)n (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (cin1 cin1 芊芊), luxuriant.
U+8E9A May appear as either ⿰𧾷⿺辶⿳覀大㔾 (+15 assumed here) or ⿰𧾷⿺辶⿳覀大巳 (+16), depending on the font. (F1.19 躚) 蹁躚 (Page 574 #10: (1)躚)
U+8FC1 (F1.19 遷) 移徙 (F1.19 迁) 同上 (Page 574 #9: (1)遷(1)迁) Note that 《廣韻》 considers 迁 a different word to 遷, with 迁 explained 伺候也進也又迁葬又標記也.

U+9077 May appear as either ⿺辶⿳覀大㔾 (+11 assumed here) or ⿺辶⿳覀大巳 (+12), depending on the font. 拪 迁 (F1.19 遷) 移徙 (F1.19 迁) 同上 (Page 574 #9: (1)遷(1)迁) To move, to remove, to place elsewhere (Kangxi 遷: 移物曰遷); to ascend (Kangxi 遷: 登也, 去下之高也); to be promoted; to change, to transpose (Kangxi 遷: 變易也), to improve (Kangxi 遷: 遷徙也); to banish, to deport, to drive off (Kangxi 遷: 謫也放逐也); _(1)p(u/)n (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (bun1 cin1 搬遷), to move, as one's residence; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (1)k(u_ (cin1 geoi1 遷居), to change one's lodgings; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (aat3 cin1 押遷), to eject, as a tenant; _(2)tso (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (zo2 cin1 左遷), to degrade to a lower place or rank. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 徒 to 徙. Williams' 押遷: Changed _(a/)p(8)_ (aap3) to common reading _(a/)t(8)_ (aat3). 【遷】 (tshjen) (_verb-like_) to shift
U+9621 仟 (F1.19 阡) 田基也南北曰阡東西曰陌 (Page 574 #8: (1)阡) A road going north and south (Kangxi: 路南北爲阡); a cross-way through a field, a path to a grave (Kangxi: 墓道也).

U+97C6 May appear as either ⿰革⿺辶⿳覀大㔾 (+15 assumed here) or ⿰革⿺辶⿳覀大巳 (+16), depending on the font. 千 (F1.19 韆) 鞦韆 (Page 575 #1: (1)韆) To swing to and fro, to play upon the whirligig; _(1)ts(')au (1)ts(')(i/)n_ (cau1 cin1 鞦韆), a swing (Kangxi: 鞦韆繩戲也). In Cantonese, 韆鞦 (cin1 cau1) "thousand autumns" is preferred over 鞦韆 (cau1 cin1) "autumns thousand". See below. 【韆鞦】 (cin1 cau1) A hanging-seat swing. Whilst 鞦韆 (cau1 cin1) "autumns thousand" is the form attested in Middle Chinese, Kangxi has commentary saying that 千秋 (cin1 cau1) "thousand autumns" is the original (being a well-wish for longevity), with 秋千 (cau1 cin1) "autumns thousand" being a verbal corruption that later got spelt 鞦韆: 《康熙字典》韆 ...《廣韻》鞦韆繩戲也《集韻》鞦韆北方戲以習輕趫者《張有復古編》詞人高無際作鞦韆賦漢武帝後庭繩戲本云千秋祝壽詞也語譌轉爲秋千後人譌爲鞦韆

cin2.text: U+4FF4 (F1.22 俴) 淺也詩小戎俴收 (Page 575 #5: (2)俴)

cin5.text: U+4FF4 cin2 (per Fan Wan) (F1.22 俴 _(2)Ts(')(i/)n_ (cin2)) 淺也詩小戎俴收 (Page 575 #5: (2)俴 _(2)Ts(')(i/)n_ (cin2); here normalised to _(5)Ts(')(i/)n_ (cin5)) Shallow, thin, beaten out, as a piece of metal (Kangxi: 淺也 etc.); superficial, ignorant. Unarmoured. 【俴】 (dzjenX) (_adjective-like_) shallow, (_met._) thin-armoured

cin2.text: U+6DFA 浅 (Mainland simplified) (F1.22 淺) 不深也 (Page 575 #4: (2)淺) Shallow, not deep (Kangxi: 水不深也); superficial, not profound; light, as coloring; easy, having few strokes, simple, as characters; short-haired (Kangxi: 凡獸之淺毛者皆曰淺); ~~dripping;~~ _(1)sham (2)ts(')(i/)n_ (sam1 cin2 深淺), deep---shallow; hard---easy; _(2)ts(')(i/)n kan(6) (1)ch(i/) (4)t(')(o\)_ (cin2 gan6 zi1 tou4 淺近之徒), a superficial scholar; _(2)ts(')(i/)n (4)wong_ (cin2 wong4 淺黃), a light yellow; _(2)ts(')(i/)n (2)ts(')(i/)n (2)ho (2)kong_ (cin2 cin2 ho2 gong2 淺淺可講), he can understand a very little; _(2)ts(')(i/)n sut(7)_ (cin2 seot1 淺率) vulgar and superficial, as a scholar; _(2)h(o\) (2)ts(')(i/)n_ (hou2 cin2 好淺), very shallow, very easy; _(5)ng(a/)n (2)ts(')(i/)n_ (ngaan5 cin2 眼淺), impatient, having respect to persons; _hoi(6) (4)yan pat(7) (2)ts(')(i/)n_ (hoi6 jan4 bat1 cin2 害人不淺), to endamage one seriously. Williams' "dripping": This is a misinterpretation of the senses interchangeable with 濺 zin1, 濺 zin3, or 灒 zaan3. 【淺】 (tshjenX) (_adjective-like_) shallow

zin1.text: U+6DFA

cin5.text: U+8E10 践 (Mainland simplified) cin2 (common) zin6 (recast to departing) (Page 574 #5: 踐(6) _Ts(i/)n(6)_ (zin6); often read _(5)Ts(')(i/)n_ (cin5)) To tread upon (Kangxi: 履也), to trample on or over (Kangxi: 踐蹋也, 踐殘也使殘壞也); ~~to walk,~~ to step; ~~to arrange out;~~ _~~ts(i/)n(6)~~ (5)ts(')(i/)n (4)(i/)n_ (cin5 jin4 踐言), to fulfill one's promise; _~~ts(i/)n(6)~~ (5)ts(')(i/)n t(a/)p(9)_ (cin5 daap6 踐踏) to tread down or in; _~~ts(i/)n(6)~~ (5)ts(')(i/)n k(u(3)_ (cin5 geoi3 踐？) to tread down the heels; _~~ts(i/)n(6)~~ (5)ts(')(i/)n wai(6)_ (cin5 wai6 踐位) to ascend the throne; to walk in another's steps. Often read _(5)ts(')(i/)n_ (cin5). Williams' "to walk", "to arrange out": These are misreadings of Kangxi 行也, 列也 (which mean "column" and "row" rather than "walk" and "arrange"). 【踐】 (dzjenX) (_verb-like_) to trample, to tread, (_met._) to realise, to fulfil

zin2.text: U+95E1 閳 阐 (Mainland simplified) cin2 (per 《廣韻》昌善切) (F1.22 闡) 發也開也 (Page 17* #11: (2)闡) To open, to spread out, to enlarge from the original condition (Kangxi: 開也); manifest, clear, plain (Kangxi: 顯也, 明也); _(2)ch(i/)n (1)hoi_ (zin2 hoi1 闡開), to open, to extend; _(2)ch(i/)n (4)ming_ (zin2 ming4 闡明), to state clearly; _(2)ch(i/)n t(a/)t(9)_ (zin2 daat6 闡達) to comprehend. 【闡】 (tsyhenX) (_verb-like_) to open (up), (_met._) to elucidate

cin4.text: U+524D 歬 (F1.21 前) 前後 (Page 575 #2: (4)前) Before, in front of, in presence of (Kangxi: 前後之對); in advance (Kangxi: 進也); previously (Kangxi: 先也, 猶故也); formerly, anciently; the former; to advance, to lead forward (Kangxi: 前猶導也); _(4)ts(')(i/)n hau(6)_ (cin4 hau6 前後) before, after; _(4)ts(')(i/)n yat(9)_ (cin4 jat6 前日) day before yesterday; _t(a/)i(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n yat(9)_ (daai6 cin4 jat6 大前日) three days ago; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (4)t(')au_ (cin4 tau4 前頭), in front; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (ut(9)_ (cin4 jyut6 前月) last month; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (4)yan (2)t(a/) p(')(a/)(3) hau(6) (4)yan_ (cin4 jan4 daa2 paa3 hau6 jan4 前人打怕後人), I am afraid, I have been once deceived; _(5)ng(a/)n (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (ngaan5 cin4 眼前), before one's eyes; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (4)loi_ (cin4 loi4 前來), come here, advance; about coming; _tsoi(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zoi6 cin4 在前), before, then; _(5)sh(e/)ung (4)ts(')(i/)n h(u(3)_ (soeng5 cin4 heoi3 上前去) go ahead, go on; _(2)tsau tung(6) pat(7) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zau2 dung6 bat1 cin4 走動不前), I can't well get on with it; it's a difficult job to manage; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (4)ch(')ing (4)n(a/)n li(u/)(6)_ (cin4 cing4 naan4 liu6 前程難料) it's not easy to guess how it will turn out; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (1)king_ (cin4 ging1 前經), already, before done. 【前】 (dzen) (_adjective-like_) fore, front (_postposition-like_) before (_adjective-like_) former Cantonese (in the vernacular register) makes a distinction between 以前 and 之前. 【以前】 (ji5 cin4) In the relatively distant past. 以前去過 (ji5 cin4 heoi3 gwo3): "I've been there in the past." 【之前】 (zi1 cin4) In the relatively near past. 之前去過 (zi1 cin4 heoi3 gwo3): "I've been there before." Before, when used as a suffix to an event. 瞓覺之前 (fan3 gaau3 zi1 cin4): "Before sleeping." 上機之前 (soeng5 gei1 zi1 cin4): "Before boarding the flight."

U+5EDB (F1.21 廛) 市宅 (Page 17* #13: (4)廛) Ground allotted a serf (Kangxi: 一畝半一家之居 etc.); a shop, a village market, a bazaar (Kangxi: 市邸也); _(4)ts(')un (4)hang (4)ch(')(i/)n sz'(3)_ (ceon4 hang4 cin4 si3 巡行廛肆) to inspect the markets; _(4)ch(')(i/)n (5)sh(i/)_ (cin4 si5 廛市), a market. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword (with 厂 and 黑-like interior) to 廛. 【廛】 (drjen) (_noun-like_) farming-lot (_noun-like_) shop

U+7E8F 缠 (Mainland simplified) zin6 (alternative per 《廣韻》持碾切) (F1.21 纏) 牽纏 (Page 17* #14: (4)纏) To wind around (Kangxi: 繞也), to bind up (Kangxi: 約也, 束也), to wrap, to bandage; to entwine, to cling to; to molest, to implicate; to bother; _(4)ch(')(i/)n k(e/)uk(8)_ (cin4 goek3 纏腳) to bandage the feet; _(4)ch(')(i/)n (4)t(')au_ (cin4 tau4 纏頭), to bind the head with a turban; _(4)ch(')(i/)n (2)shau_ (cin4 sau2 纏手), to prevent doing; _(4)ch(')(i/)n (2)kan_ (cin4 gan2 纏緊), bind it tight; _(4)ch(')(i/)n toi(6)_ (cin4 doi6-2 纏袋) a waist bag for money; _(4)ch(')(i/)n (4)m(i/)n_ (cin4 min4 纏綿), to think of; _(4)ch(')(i/)n ch(u(6)_ (cin4 zyu6 纏住) importunate, to bother; _~~(1)ch(')i~~ (1)ch(')(i/) (4)ch(')(i/)n_ (ci1 cin4 癡纏), troublesome, to annoy. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword (with 厂 and 黑-like interior) to 纏. Williams' 纏綿: More to be entangled or caught up in. Williams' 癡纏: Corrected _(1)ch(')i_ to _(1)ch(')(i/)_. Also to be madly in love with. 【纏】 (drjen) (_verb-like_) to twine

U+8E94 (F1.21 躔) 踐踏也又星辰躔度 (Page 18* #1: (4)躔) To tread (Kangxi: 踐也); to follow in order (Kangxi: 星之躔次星所履行也); to turn in an orbit (Kangxi: 歷行也日運爲躔); a trodden path (Kangxi: 躔徑也), a rut (Kangxi: 行徑轍迹也), a footstep (Kangxi: 脚所踐處); a course, an orbit; _tsik(7) (4)ch(')(i/)n_ (zik1 cin4 跡躔), a footmark, a vestige; _(4)ch(')(i/)n t(o\)(6)_ (cin4 dou6 躔度) an orbit; _(4)ch(')(i/)n t(a/)p(9)_ (cin4 daap6 躔踏) to tread on. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword (with 厂 and 黑-like interior) to 躔.

U+9322 㦮 銭 钱 (Mainland simplified) cin4-2 (vernacular for "money" sense) (F1.21 錢) 十分爲錢 (F1.21 ？) 同上 (Page 575 #3: (4)錢(4)？) Copper coin, cash, coppers (Kangxi 錢: 冶銅爲錢易貨也); coin, a piece of money; cash, wealth, money, property (Kangxi 錢: 財也); a tenth of a tael (両), or mace, which the cash once weighed; _(4)t(')ung (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (tung4 cin4 銅錢), copper cash; _(1)kam (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (gam1 cin4 金錢), gold coins; _(5)yau (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (jau5 cin4-2 有錢), rich, wealthy; _(4)ts(')(i/)n kuk(9)_ (cin4 guk6-2 錢局) a mint; _(2)ch(a/)u (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zaau2 cin4 找錢), to exchange into cash; _(2)k(i/) (4)ts(')(i/)n ~~chung(6)~~ (5)ch(')ung_ (gei2 cin4 cung5 幾錢重) how many mace does it weigh? _fong(3) l(o\)(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (fong3 lou6 cin4 放路錢), to scatter paper money at burials; _t(a/)i(6) (1)kong (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (daai6 gong1 cin4 大？錢), large coins of K(a/)ngh(i/) (康熙); _l(a/)n(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (laan6 cin4 爛錢), bad cash; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (2)p(a/)n k(o\)m(3) ~~hau(6)~~ (5)hau_ (cin4 baan2 gam3 hau5 錢板咁厚) thick as a cash board; _l(i/)(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (lei6 cin4 利錢), interest; _(2)shau (4)ts(')(i/)n (4)n(o\)_ (sau2 cin4 nou4 守錢奴), a miser; _(2)nan (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (nan2 cin4-2 㤻錢), to gamble; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (4)l(e/)ung_ (cin4 loeng4 錢糧), taxes, revenue; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (2)l(e/)ung (2)tsz'_ (cin4 loeng5-2 zi2 錢両子) shot, bullets; _(1)ch(a/)ng (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zaang1 cin4-2 爭錢), disputing about money; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (4)shan (2)p(a/)i p(o\)(3)_ (cin4 san4 baai2 bou3 錢神擺布) money serves for everything; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (2)shui (1)tai_ (cin4 seoi2 dai1 錢水低), the rate of exchange is low. Williams' 幾錢重: Corrected _chung(6)_ (zung6 去聲) to _(5)ch(')ung_ (cung5 上聲). Williams' 錢板咁厚: Normalised _hau(6)_ (hau6) to _(5)hau_ (hau5). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【錢-level】 (dzjen) (_noun-like_) coin 【錢銀】 (cin4-2 ngan4-2) Money. 錢銀嘢 (cin4-2 ngan4-2 je5): "Matters of money."

zin2.text: U+9322 銭 钱 (Mainland simplified) A farming tool (Kangxi: 銚也古田器). 【錢-rising】 (tsjenX) (_noun-like_) adze-hoe

cing1.text: U+6A89 柽 (Mainland simplified) (F1.71 檉 _(2)Ch(')ing_ (cing2)) 河邊柳 (Page 21* #11: (2)檉 _(2)Ch(')ing_ (cing2); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')ing_ (cing1)) A reddish bark willow, growing by water courses (Kangxi: 河柳也), and thought to indicate rain (Kangxi: 天之將雨檉先起氣以應之故一名雨師). 【檉】 (trhjeng) (_noun-like_) tamarisk
U+6DF8 (F1.68 淸) 淸潔淸正淸廉淸白 (Page 577 #6: (1)淸) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 曰 to 白.

U+6E05 淸 (F1.68 淸) 淸潔淸正淸廉淸白 (Page 577 #6: (1)淸; here normalised to 清) Pure, limpid (Kangxi 淸: 朖也), clear (Kangxi 淸: 澂水之貌), unsullied, sharpsighted (Kangxi 淸: 視淸明也); clean (Kangxi 淸: 潔也), incorruptible, right principled; clear, ringing, as a sound; to settle, to become clear; to purify; to settle an account; style of the present Manchu dynasty; Manchu; _(2)shui (1)ts(')ing_ (seoi2 cing1 水清) pure water; _(1)k(a/) shai(3) (1)ts(')ing p(a/)k(9)_ (gaa1 sai3 cing1 baak6 家世清白) a family of unsullied reputation; _(1)ts(')ing (1)k(u/)n_ (cing1 gun1 清官), an honest magistrate; _(2)shau (1)ts(')ing_ (sau2 cing1 守清), a betrothed girl refusing to marry; _~~(1)ning~~ (1)ling (1)ts(')ing_ (ling1 cing1 拎清), taken all away; _(1)ts(')ing (2)k(a/)m_ (cing1 gaam2 清減), sallow, poor; _(1)ts(')ing (2)ch(')o (5)li(u/) l(i/)(6)_ (cing1 co2 liu5 lei6 清楚了利) the whole matter is done; _~~(1)ts(')eng~~ (1)ts(')ing sh(o\)(3)_ (cing1 sou3 清數) to settle an account; _sh(o\)(3) (5)m(i/) (4)'m (1)ts(')ing_ (sou3 mei5 m4 cing1 數尾唔清), some unbalanced accounts; _(1)ts(')ing t(o\)(6) (4)k(')(i/)_ (cing1 dou6 kei4 清道旗), a banner to clear the way; _(1)ts(')ing sau(3)_ (cing1 sau3 清秀) elegant, well formed; _(1)ts(')ing (1)ts(')ing tik(7)_ (cing1 cing1 dik1 清清滴) take a little; _ts(a/)m(6) (1)chung (1)ts(')ing_ (zaam6 zung1 cing1 暫中清), occasionally, when at leisure; _(2)shui (2)sai (4)'m (1)ts(')ing_ (seoi2 sai2 m4 cing1 水洗唔清), it cannot be washed out; _e.g._ a sullied name; _(1)ts(')ing (4)t(')au (2)l(o\)_ (cing1 tau4 lou2 清頭佬), an old bachelor; _(1)ts(')ing (1)sam_ (cing1 sam1 清心), to clear one's character, to purify the heart; _(1)ts(')ing (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (cing1 ciu4 清朝), the Pure or Manchu dynasty; _(1)ts(')ing tsz'(6)_ (cing1 zi6 清字) Manchu words. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 曰 to 白. Williams considers _(1)ts(')eng_ (ceng1) a possible reading variation for 清. Williams' 拎清: Changed _(1)ning_ (ning1) to _(1)ling_ (ling1). Williams' 清數: Changed _(1)ts(')eng_ (ceng1) to _(1)ts(')ing_ (cing1). Quiet. (_phonetics_) Unvoiced. 【清】 (tshjeng) (_adjective-like_) clear, pure (_adjective-like_) (_met._) unvoiced

cing3.text: U+79E4 稱 (F1.73 秤) 所以稱物之輕重也 (Page 21* #13: 稱(3); here normalised to 秤) To weigh, to adjust; a steelyard or dotchin (Kangxi 秤: 正斤兩也); _ch(')ing(3) fo(3)_ (cing3 fo3 秤貨) to weigh goods; _ch(')ing(3) (4)t(')o_ (cing3 to4 秤砣), the yard weight; _ch(')ing(3) (1)kon_ (cing3 gon1 秤桿), the beam; _ch(')ing(3) ~~(1)kau~~ (1)ngau_ (cing3 ngau1 秤鉤), the hook; _(1)sz' (5)m(a/) ch(')ing(3)_ (si1 maa5 cing3 司馬秤) to weigh full weight; _(1)ch(a/) (2)wan ch(')ing(3)_ (zaa1 wan2 cing3 揸穩秤) weight it true; _yat(7) (2)p(a/) ch(')ing(3)_ (jat1 baa2 cing3 一把秤) a steelyards; _yat(7) ch(')ing(3) (1)kung (1)fan_ (jat1 cing3 gung1 fan1 一秤公分), to divide justly; For the character 秤, Fan Wan records level-tone _(1)ch(')ing_ (cing1) for the verb "weigh" and departing-tone _ch(')ing(3)_ (cing3) for the noun "scales". This is consistent with the classical tone distinction for 稱 (level-tone verb and departing-tone noun), notwithstanding 《廣韻》 only records departing-tone for the character 秤. In modern Cantonese usage, the verb "weigh" is nevertheless commonly read in departing tone as _ch(')ing(3)_ (cing3). Williams has also recorded departing-tone 稱 for the verb "weigh" (here normalised to the character 秤); it is unclear whether this is a mistake on his part or a deliberate attestation of (classical-violating) usage in Cantonese. Williams' 秤鉤: Changed _(1)kau_ (gau1) to common reading _(1)ngau_ (ngau1). 【稱-noun】 (tsyhingH) (_noun-like_) steelyard

cing1.text: U+7A31 秤 (for "weigh" sense) 穪 称 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 稱) 稱揚稱舉稱道 (F1.68 称) 同上 (F1.68 秤) 較物輕重 (Page 20* #4: (1)稱) To call, to name, to designate, to style (Kangxi: 名號謂之稱); to say (Kangxi: 言也), to talk about; to simulate; to compliment, to commend (Kangxi: 揚也謂也); to admire; to feign, to plead as an excuse; a designation, an appellation, a name; _tsz'(6) (1)ch(')ing (4)k(')(i/) f(u/)(6) ~~(ut(8)~~ (ut(9) (1)k(a/) f(u/)(6)_ (zi6 cing1 kei4 fu6 jyut6 gaa1 fu6 自稱其父曰家父) one styles his own father _k(a/)-f(u/)_ (gaa fu)_;_ _(1)ch(')ing (1)f(u/)_ (cing1 fu1 稱呼), termed; _(1)ch(')ing ts(a/)n(3)_ (cing1 zaan3 稱讚) to praise; _(1)ch(')ing (4)y(e/)ung_ (cing1 joeng4 稱揚), to speak abroad, to laud; _(1)ch(')ing (4)k(')(i/)_ (cing1 kei4 稱奇), to regard as excellent; _(1)t(')ung (1)ch(')ing_ (tung1 cing1 通稱), a general designation; _(1)ch(')ing peng(6)_ (cing1 beng6 稱病) to malinger, to feign sickness. (Page 20* #5: (1)秤; here normalised to 稱) Same as the last (稱), but usually applied only to weighing; to adjust; to weigh (Kangxi 稱: 知輕重也); _(1)ch(')ing t(o\)(3) (2)chun_ (cing1 dou3 zeon2 稱到準), it is weighed exactly; _(1)ch(')ing (4)ch(')(a/)_ (cing1 caa4 稱茶), to weigh teas. For the character 秤, Fan Wan records level-tone _(1)ch(')ing_ (cing1) for the verb "weigh" and departing-tone _ch(')ing(3)_ (cing3) for the noun "scales". This is consistent with the classical tone distinction for 稱 (level-tone verb and departing-tone noun), notwithstanding 《廣韻》 only records departing-tone for the character 秤. In modern Cantonese usage, the verb "weigh" is nevertheless commonly read in departing tone as _ch(')ing(3)_ (cing3). Williams has also recorded departing-tone 稱 for the verb "weigh"; it is unclear whether this is a mistake on his part or a deliberate attestation of (classical-violating) usage in Cantonese. Williams' 自稱其父曰家父: Corrected _(ut(8)_ (jyut3) to _(ut(9)_ (jyut6). To raise (Kangxi: 舉也). 【稱-verb】 (tsyhing) (_verb-like_) to weigh (_verb-like_) to refer to, to proclaim (_verb-like_) to extol (_verb-like_) to raise

cing3.text: U+7A31 穪 称 (Mainland simplified) (F1.73 稱) 度量也快意曰稱意又均等也 (Page 21* #13: 稱(3)) suitable (Kangxi: 適物之宜也), as one wishes (Kangxi: 愜意); corresponding to (Kangxi: 相等也), satisfied with; _(2)ho (5)(i/) (1)s(e/)ung ch(')ing(3)_ (ho2 ji5 soeng1 cing3 可以相稱) they can pass together; symmetrical; _(1)(i/) pat(7) ch(')ing(3) (1)shan_ (ji1 bat1 cing3 san1 衣不稱身), his dress does not fit him; _(4)'m ch(')ing(3)_ (m4 cing3 唔稱) unfitting; _ch(')ing(3) (i/)(3)_ (cing3 ji3 稱意) as I like. 【稱-adjective】 (tsyhingH) (_adjective-like_) meet, (_met._) competent

zing1.text: U+83C1 May appear as either ⿱艹靑 or ⿱艹青 (assumed here), depending on the font. cing1 (alternative per 《集韻》倉經切 for "luxuriant" sense) (F1.67 菁) 草盛也 (Page 576 #3: (1)菁) Scallion blossoms (Kangxi: 韭華也); a kind of three ribbed rush (Kangxi: 菁茅, 江淮之閒有一茅而三脊 etc.); flowery, ~~elegant,~~ flourishing (Kangxi: 菁菁花盛貌); _(4)m(o\) (1)tsing_ (mou4 zing1 蕪菁) a sort of greens like mustard. Splendid, magnificent (Kangxi: 菁華英也). 【菁】 (tsjeng) (_noun-like_) leek-flower, chive-flower (_noun-like_) spikerush (_adjective-like_) luxuriant

(F1.67 蜻 _(1)Tsing_ (zing1)) 蜻蜓 (Page 576 #4: (1)蜻 _(1)Tsing_ (zing1); here corrected to _(1)Ts(')ing_ (cing1)) A dragon-fly, called _~~(1)tsing (1)t(')ing~~ (1)ts(')ing (4)t(')ing_ (cing1 ting4 蜻蜓), which sips the water (Kangxi: 蜻蜓蟲); _~~(1)tsing~~ (1)ts(')ing (4)ling_ (cing1 ling4 蜻蛉)~~, a kind of locust~~.
