cing1.text: U+87F6 蛏 (Mainland simplified) sing3 (common) (F1.71 蟶 _(2)Ch(')ing_ (cing2)) 蚌屬 (Page 21* #12: (2)蟶 _(2)Ch(')ing_ (cing2); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')ing_ (cing1)) A bivalve (Kangxi: 蚌屬), the razor-sheath or Solen, also called _(1)sh(a/) (4)lo_ (saa1 lo4 沙螺), or sand screw.

U+8D6C 緽 頳 䞓 赪 (Mainland simplified) zing1 (common) (F1.71 頳 _(2)Ch(')ing_ (cing2)) 赤色 (Page 21* #10: (2)赬 _(2)Ch(')ing_ (cing2); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')ing_ (cing1)) A carnation or pink color; cloth dyed twice over (Kangxi: 再染謂之赬), to dye red (Kangxi: 赬染赤); _met._ distressing toil which flushes one. 【赬】 (trhjeng) (_adjective-like_) red

cing2.text: U+62EF 丞 抍 zing2 (per 《廣韻》蒸上聲) (F1.71 拯) 上舉也援也救也助也 (Page 21* #9: (2)拯) To rescue (Kangxi: 救也助也, 援也), to pull out, as from a well; to deliver, to save; to raise up (Kangxi: 舉也); _(2)ch(')ing kau(3)_ (cing2 gau3 拯救) to save from danger; _(2)ch(')ing (4)man (1)(u (2)shui (2)fo (1)ch(i/) (1)chung_ (cing2 man4 jyu1 seoi2 fo2 zi1 zung1 拯民於水火之中), to save the people from danger like fire and water. 【拯】 (tsyingX) (_verb-like_) to lift (up) (_verb-like_) to rescue

U+88CE 《廣韻》 has 丑郢切 _(2)ch(')ing_ (cing2) explained 襌衣. Kangxi erroneously has 《揚子方言》襌衣無袌者謂之裎衣 under the level-tone reading _(4)ch(')ing_ (cing4). It correctly has synonymous (but easily misinterpreted) 深衣也 under the rising-tone reading _(2)ch(')ing_ (cing2). Note that the text of 《揚子方言》 is 襌衣...無袌者謂之裎衣古謂之深衣. An unlined garment (Kangxi: 深衣也).

cing4.text: U+88CE (F1.69 裎) 裸裎露身也 (Page 21* #1: (4)裎) ~~The upper part of the body;~~ naked (Kangxi: 倮也); to disrobe one's self; a girdle (Kangxi: 佩紟謂之裎, 裎佩帶也); _~~(5)lo~~ (2)lo (4)ch(')ing_ (lo2 cing4 裸裎), naked. Williams' 裸裎: Changed _(5)lo_ (lo5) to common reading _(2)lo_ (lo2). 【裎】 (drjeng) (_verb-like_) to nake

cing2.text: U+901E (F1.71 逞) 矜也誇也成也 (Page 21* #7: (2)逞) Froward, presuming, confident of one's power or pretensions (Kangxi: 矜而自逞也); precipitate, hasty (Kangxi: 疾也); to act on an impulse; pleased with (Kangxi: 快也); ~~to pervade;~~ to exhaust (Kangxi: 極也盡也); _pat(7) (2)ch(')ing_ (bat1 cing2 不逞), dissatisfied, careless of; _(2)ch(')ing (1)kung (4)nang_ (cing2 gung1 nang4 逞功能), confident of one's power; _pat(7) (2)ch(')ing (1)ch(i/) ~~(4)t(o\)~~ (4)t(')(o\)_ (bat1 cing2 zi1 tou4 不逞之徒), a reckless rascal; _(2)ch(')ing (2)p(u/)n sz'(6)_ (cing2 bun2 si6 逞本事) to boast of one's abilities; _(2)ch(')ing ok(8) (4)hang k(i/)p(8)_ (cing2 ok3 hang4 gip3 逞惡行劫) to rob without fear; _(1)kw(')(a/) (2)ch(')ing_ (kwaa1 cing2 誇逞), to brag. Williams' 不逞之徒: Corrected _(4)t(o\)_ (dou4) to _(4)t(')(o\)_ (tou4). To resolve (Kangxi: 解也). 【逞】 (trhjengX) (_verb-like_) to let loose, to indulge

cing4.text: U+5448 May appear as either ⿱口𡈼 (assumed here) or ⿱口王, depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 呈 as a component. The two forms are actually separate characters in Kangxi (p.179#2 and p.181#17 respectively). The definitions here pertain to the first (⿱口𡈼). (F1.69 呈) 申也示也露也 (Page 20* #7: (4)呈) A statement, a plea of a case; to present a petition or statement; to offer, to present to; to state to; to show, to ~~discover~~ reveal (Kangxi: 示也見也, 露也); _(4)ch(')ing (5)sh(e/)ung_ (cing4 soeng5 呈上), to inform another; _tsun(3) (4)ch(')ing_ (zeon3 cing4 進呈), to memorialize; _tsik(7) (4)ch(')ing_ (zik1 cing4 即呈), now send this to you; _(4)ch(')ing tai(6)_ (cing4 dai6 呈遞) to present to a superior; _(4)ch(')ing (2)pan_ (cing4 ban2 呈稟), to hand up a petition; _(4)ch(')ing ~~(2)sz'~~ (2)tsz'_ (cing4 zi2 呈子) a petition; _(4)ch(')ing t(i/)n(6)_ (cing4 din6 呈？) stated for your inspection; _(4)hung (4)ch(')ing_ (hung4 cing4 紅呈), a statement from the gentry. Williams' "to discover": This is a misreading of Kangxi 見也. Here, 見 is used for 現, "reveal". Williams' 呈子: Corrected _(2)sz'_ (si2) to _(2)tsz'_ (zi2). 【猜呈沉】 (caai1 cing4 cam4) To play rock-scissors-paper. 【呈沉磨鉸叉燒包】 (cing4-1 cam4-1 mo4 gaau3 caa1 siu1 baau1) Long-form chant for rock-scissors-paper. Of the three items in rock-scissors-paper: The spelling 呈沉 for "rock" is arbitrary. Note that in 猜呈沉 it is read low (cing4 cam4), and in 呈沉磨鉸叉燒包 it is read high (cing1 cam1). Allusion to a heavy weight falling suggests 秤 instead for the first and 沉 for the second. The term 磨鉸 for "scissors" is literally "sharpened scissors". The term 叉燒包 for "paper" is literally "barbecued-pork bun", in which the bun (包) is a wrapper that wraps its filling.

U+57D5 (F1.69 埕) 瓦器 (Page 21* #2: (4)埕) An unauthorized character. An amphora or earthen jar of a pear shape, without handles, for carrying water, oil, or spirits; _(2)shui (4)ch(')ing_ (seoi2 cing4 水埕), a water jar; _yat(7) (4)ch(')ing (4)yau_ (jat1 cing4 jau4 一埕油), a jar of oil; _kwai(3) (4)lam (4)ch(')ing_ (gwai3 lam4 cing4 桂林埕), large jars from Kw(a/)ngs(i/) (廣西).

U+60C5 May appear as either ⿰忄靑 or ⿰忄青 (assumed here), depending on the font. cing4-2 (in 實情) (F1.71 情) 理也心中也性之所發也 (Page 578 #1: (4)情) The passions (Kangxi: 人欲之謂情), reckoned to be seven (Kangxi: 喜怒哀懼愛惡欲); the feelings, the desires; temper, passion, affection; lust, concupiscence; the circumstances, the facts of a case; an affair, a matter; _sing(3) (4)ts(')ing_ (sing3 cing4 性情), temper, disposition; _yung(6) (4)ts(')ing_ (jung6 cing4 用情), to assist one heartily; _(4)m(o\) (4)ts(')ing_ (mou4 cing4 無情) or _pok(9) (4)ts(')ing_ (bok6 cing4 薄情), ungrateful; _(1)to (4)ts(')ing_ (do1 cing4 多情), or _(4)ts(')ing (1)sham_ (cing4 sam1 情深), very grateful; _kwat(9) (4)ts(')ing_ (gwat6 cing4 倔情), thankless; _sz'(6) (4)ts(')ing_ (si6 cing4 事情), an affair, a concern; _shat(9) (4)ts(')ing_ (sat6 cing4 實情), the real facts; _(4)m(o\) (4)ts(')oi (4)ts(')ing_ (mou4 coi4 cing4 無才情), inapt, stolid; _~~(4)ts(')eng~~ (4)ts(')ing (4)yau_ (cing4 jau4 情由), circumstances or causes of a thing; _(1)sz' (4)ts(')ing_ (si1 cing4 私情), illicit, fornicating; _(4)ts(')ing (un(6) ts(o\)(6)_ (cing4 jyun6 zou6 情願做) I'll willingly do it; _(4)ts(')ing sh(e/)ung(6) ok(8) kwo(3)_ (cing4 soeng6 ok3 gwo3 情上惡過) a hard temper; _(4)ts(')ing (5)l(i/)_ (cing4 lei5 情理), common sense, reasonable; _(4)ts(')ing (4)t(')au_ (cing4 tau4 情投), a mutual liking. Williams considers _(4)ts(')eng_ (ceng4) a possible reading variation for 情. Williams' 多情: Also amorous. Williams' 情由: Changed _(4)ts(')eng_ (ceng4) to _(4)ts(')ing_ (cing4). 【情】 (dzjeng) (_noun-like_) sentiment, (_met._) sense, nature (_noun-like_) truth, circumstance

U+61F2 徵 惩 (F1.69 懲) 懲治懲戒懲創 (Page 21* #4: (4)惩(4)懲) To repress, to curb (Kangxi 懲: 㣻也); to warn; to reprove, to reprimand; a warning, a caution, a lesson; _(2)si(u/) (4)ch(')ing_ (siu2 cing4 小懲), an admonitory hint; _(4)ch(')ing ch(i/)(6)_ (cing4 zi6 懲治) to ~~govern strictly~~ punish. Williams' 懲治: To punish, not necessarily in relation to governance. 【懲】 (dring) (_verb-like_) to chastise

U+6674 May appear as either ⿰日靑 or ⿰日青 (assumed here), depending on the font. 夝 甠 暒 (F1.71 晴) 雲收雨止而日出也 (Page 578 #2: (4)晴) The sky clearing up after rain (Kangxi: 雨止也晴明也無雲也), the clear blue sky; the stars coming out (Kangxi: 夝雨而夜除星見也, 今俗作晴非); _(1)t(')(i/)n (4)ts(')ing_ (tin1 cing4 天晴), a clear sky; _(5)(u (4)ts(')ing_ (jyu5 cing4 雨晴), it has stopped raining.

U+6F84 澂 (F1.69 澄) 澄淸 (Page 21* #6: (4)澄) Still water; limpid, clear (Kangxi: 水靜而淸也); _(4)ch(')ing (1)ts(')ing_ (cing4 cing1 澄清), pure, still. Williams' 澄清: In modern usage, usually only used in the verb sense "clarify". 【澄】 (dring) (_adjective-like_) clear

U+77AA (F1.69 瞪) 直視也 (Page 21* #5: (4)瞪) To stare at, to look straight at (Kangxi: 直視也), to fix the eye on; _(4)ch(')ing (5)ng(a/)n mong(6)_ (cing4 ngaan5 mong6 瞪眼望) gazed at with fixed eyes; _(4)ch(')ing sh(i/)(6)_ (cing4 si6 瞪視) gazing, staring.

U+7A0B (F1.69 程) 限期也又程式課程路程 (Page 20* #6: (4)程) ~~The {1/100}th part of a _ts(')(un(3)_ (cyun3 寸) (Kangxi: ...十程爲分十分爲寸)_;_~~ a portion or percentage; a rule, a pattern, a regulation (Kangxi: 式也), to rule; a limit, a period (Kangxi: 期也, 限也); a job or measure; an allowance; a part; a road, a journey; to travel; _(4)ch(')ing sh(o\)(3)_ (cing4 sou3 程數) a percentage on one's accounts; _sung(3) (4)ch(')ing (4)(i/)_ (sung3 cing4 ji4 送程儀), to give one his traveling expenses; _(2)h(i/) (4)ch(')ing_ (hei2 cing4 起程), to start on a journey; _h(a/)n(6) (4)ch(')ing_ (haan6 cing4 限程), a day's journey; _(1)k(i/)m (4)ch(')ing_ (gim1 cing4 兼程), a forced march, a rapid journey; _kok(8) k(u/)(3) (4)ts(')(i/)n (4)ch(')ing_ (gok3 gu3 cin4 cing4 各顧前程), each regards his future preferment; _f(a/)i(3) (4)ch(')ing_ (faai3 cing4 快程), to travel fast; _(4)ch(')ing shik(7)_ (cing4 sik1 程式) a form; _(4)m(o\) (4)ch(')ing shik(7)_ (mou4 cing4 sik1 無程式) nothing to compare it to; _(2)kau (4)ch(')ing (2)kau (1)t(o\) (5)yau_ (gau2 cing4 gau2 dou1 jau5 九程九都有), most probably, ~~ten to one~~ nine times out of nine it will; _yat(7) (4)ch(')ing_ (jat1 cing4 一程), a tenth; _~~tak(9)~~ tak(7) (1)f(a/)n (2)kau (4)ch(')ing p(u/)n(3)_ (dak1 faan1 gau2 cing4 bun3 得返九程半) got back 95 per cent.; _pat(7) (4)ch(')ing (4)k(')(i/) lik(9)_ (bat1 cing4 kei4 lik6 不程其力) I wrongly estimated his strength. Williams' "{1/100}th part ...": According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, 十程爲分 should be 一程爲分. This makes 程 a tenth of a 寸. Williams' 得返九程半: Corrected _tak(9)_ (dak6) to _tak(7)_ (dak1). Measurement (Kangxi: 程者物之準也, 程度量之總名). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【程】 (drjeng) (_noun-like_) measurement, measure (_noun-like_) norm

U+9172 (F1.69 酲) 酒病也 (Page 21* #3: (4)酲) ~~To drink till sick and drunk~~ Sick from drink (Kangxi: 病酒也); half sobered, and ashamed at being drunk (Kangxi: 一曰醉而覺也); feelings after a bout. 【酲】 (drjeng) (_adjective-like_) hungover, drunk-sick

cip3.text: U+59BE (F2.51 妾) 次妻曰妾 (Page 579 #3: 妾(8)) A concubine, a wife taken without the legal ceremonies (Kangxi: 接也得接于君子者也), a secondary wife; term by which ladies call themselves; _ts(')(i/)p(8) sh(i/)(6)_ (cip3 si6 妾侍) or _sh(i/)(6) ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (si6 cip3 侍妾) a concubine; _lap(9) ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (lap6 cip3 立妾) to bring in a concubine; _ts(')(i/)p(8) (1)shan_ (cip3 san1 妾身), I, your handmaid; _(2)si(u/) ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (siu2 cip3 小妾) my concubine; _oi(3) ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (oi3 cip3 愛妾) your concubine; _shi(u/)(3) ts(')(i/)p(8)_ (siu3 cip3 少妾) my young concubine. A woman or girl in servitude. 【妾】 (tshjep) (_noun-like_) slave-woman, slave-girl (_noun-like_) concubine

cit3.text: U+5FB9 May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+11) or 4 strokes (+12 assumed here), depending on the font. 彻 (Mainland simplified) (F1.26 徹) 通明也透也 (Page 23* #4: 徹(8)) Pervious, perspicacious, discerning (Kangxi: 通也); to penetrate, to pass through (Kangxi: 徹達也); to remove, to take away (Kangxi: 去也); ~~a road, a thoroughfare;~~ to skin, to peel off (Kangxi: 剝取也), to destroy (Kangxi: 毀也); to ~~cultivate~~ regulate (Kangxi: 治也); _ch(')(i/)t(8) ch(a/)n(6)_ (cit3 zaan6 徹饌) to remove food; _ch(')(i/)t(8) (2)tai_ (cit3 dai2 徹底), to understand thoroughly; _ch(')(i/)t(8) t(')au(3)_ (cit3 tau3 徹透) fully known. Williams' "a road, a thoroughfare": This is a misreading of Kangxi 道也 (but an understandable one, since no example is supplied). According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, this explanation applies to 天命不徹 (in 《詩經》). There, 徹 is usually interpreted as "follow/comply", although James Legge interprets it as "explain". 【徹】 (trhjet, drjet) (_verb-like_) to pervade (_verb-like_) to remove, to withdraw (_verb-like_) to regulate

U+63A3 (Page 10|n53 #1: 掣(3) _Chai(3)_ (zai3); here corrected to _Ch(')(i/)t(8)_ (cit3)) to take, to choose out, to raise up (Kangxi: 揭也取也); to select; to pull, to draw (Kangxi: 挽也); _~~chai(3)~~ ch(')(i/)t(8) (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (cit3 cim1 掣籤), to draw lots; (Page 23* #8: 掣(8)) To choose, to draw out (Kangxi: 取也); _ch(')(i/)t(8) (1)ts(')(i/)m_ (cit3 cim1 掣籤), to draw lots for official duty.

zai3.text: U+63A3 cai3 (per 《廣韻》尺制切) (F1.32 掣) 掣肘滯隔不進也 (Page 10|n53 #1: 掣(3)) To obstruct, to hinder from ~~entering~~ advancing (Kangxi: 滯隔不進也); _(1)h(i/)n chai(3)_ (hin1 zai3 牽掣) to compel, to force; _ch(a/)(3) chai(3) ch(a/)(3) tsung(3)_ (zaa3 zai3 zaa3 zung3 乍掣乍縱) a twitching, as of children in convulsions; _chai(3) t(i/)n(6)_ (zai3 din6 掣電) like lightning, as an electrical machine acts; _~~h(i/)p(9)~~ h(i/)p(8) chai(3)_ (hip3 zai3 挾掣) to restrain; _chai(3) ~~(2)chau~~ (2)ch(a/)u_ (zai3 zaau2 掣肘), to impede, to embarrass. Williams' 挾掣: Changed _h(i/)p(9)_ (hip6) to common reading _h(i/)p(8)_ (hip3). Williams' 掣肘: Changed _(2)chau_ (zau2) to common reading _(2)ch(a/)u_ (zaau2). Williams' "to embarrass": In the (now) archaic sense of "impede", "obstruct". To hinder by pulling or tugging back (Kangxi: 甹夆掣曳也). 【掣】 (tsyhejH) (_verb-like_) to tug, to drag 【掣】 (zai3) A push-button, switch, pedal, etc. 手掣 (sau2 zai3): "Handbrake." 撳掣 (gam6 zai3): "Press the button." 煞掣 (saat3 zai3): "Slam the brakes." 總掣 (zung2 zai3): "The main switch." 跳掣 (tiu3 zai3): "Trip the breaker." 閂掣 (saan1 zai3): "Turn off the switch." 開掣 (hoi1 zai3): "Turn on the switch." 電掣 (din6 zai3): "An electrical switch."

cit3.text: U+64A4 May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+11) or 4 strokes (+12 assumed here), depending on the font. 勶 (F1.26 撤) 抽除也握也 (Page 23* #5: 撤(8)) To send away, to remove (Kangxi: 除去也); to reject, to recall; to put aside; to take off, to flay (Kangxi: 抽也剝也); _ch(')(i/)t(8) (4)nung_ (cit3 nung4 撤膿), to come to a head, as a boil; _(2)p(i/) (1)fung ch(')(i/)t(8) h(u(3)_ (bei2 fung1 cit3 heoi3 畀風撤去) whisked away by the wind; _ch(')(i/)t(8) h(u(3)_ (cit3 heoi3 撤去) to send or take away; _ch(')(i/)t(8) (1)hoi_ (cit3 hoi1 撤開), to remove; _ch(')(i/)t(8) (4)(u/)i_ (cit3 wui4 撤回), to put back, to recall an officer; _ch(')(i/)t(8) tsik(9) s(a/)n(3) (4)t(')oi_ (cit3 zik6 saan3 toi4 撤席散檯), to clear off and leave the table. 【撤】 (trhjet, drjet) (_verb-like_) to remove, to withdraw

U+6F88 May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+11) or 4 strokes (+12 assumed here), depending on the font. zit6 (per 《廣韻》直列切) (Page 23* #6: 澈(8)) Pure, transparent, pellucid (Kangxi: 水澄也); _(4)ch(')ing ch(')(i/)t(8)_ (cing4 cit3 澄澈) pureminded, clear.

U+8A2D 设 (Mainland simplified) (F1.26 設) 置主也陳設也 (Page 23* #3: 設(8)) To institute, to establish (Kangxi: 立也); to set forth (Kangxi: 施陳也); to spread, as a net; to arrange, to place, to set up (Kangxi: 置也); to suppose (Kangxi: 假借之辭); a band of soldiers, or its officer (Kangxi: 突厥別部典兵者曰設); large, said of a sword (Kangxi: 大也); _(4)'m (2)shai ch(')(i/)t(8) (1)k(u/)n_ (m4 sai2 cit3 gun1 唔使設官), not to care anything for the magistrates, or there's no need of them; _ch(')(i/)t(8) lap(9)_ (cit3 lap6 設立) to establish; _ch(')(i/)t(8) (4)(i/)n_ (cit3 jin4 設筵), to make a feast; _ch(')(i/)t(8) f(a/)t(8)_ (cit3 faat3 設法) to devise means; _ch(')(i/)t(8) kai(3)_ (cit3 gai3 設計) to plot against; _ch(')(i/)t(8) w(a/)k(9)_ (cit3 waak6 設或) or _ch(')(i/)t(8) (2)sz'_ (cit3 si2 設使) suppose that; _(1)p(')(o\) ch(')(i/)t(8)_ (pou1 cit3 鋪設) to set in order, to prepare; _ch(')(i/)t(8) k(a/)u(3)_ (cit3 gaau3 設教) or _ch(')(i/)t(8) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (cit3 zoeng3 設帳) to open a school. A colloquial word. A very little, a bit, not half enough; _(2)t(un ch(')(i/)t(8) k(o\)m(3) (2)t(un_ (dyun2 cit3 gam3 dyun2 短設咁短), not half long enough. 【設】 (syet) (_verb-like_) to set (_verb-like_) to establish (_verb-like_) to suppose

U+8F4D May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+11) or 4 strokes (+12 assumed here), depending on the font. 辙 (Mainland simplified) zit6 (per 《廣韻》直列切) (F1.26 轍) 車輪 (Page 23* #7: 轍(8)) A rut of a wheel (Kangxi: 車輪所碾迹也); _k(')ok(8) ch(')(i/)t(8)_ (kok3 cit3 涸轍) a dry rut; _met._ one in great straits; _(4)ying t(o\)(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n ch(')(i/)t(8)_ (jing4 dou6 cin4 cit3 仍蹈前轍) to go in the old rut, to act badly again. 【轍】 (drjet) (_noun-like_) wheel-rut, rut

ciu1.text: U+5F28 (F2.2 弨) 弛也 (Page 25* #2: (1)弨) To fly back, as a bow (Kangxi: 弓反也); to spring back (Kangxi: 翻起曰弨); a bow unbent (Kangxi: 弓弛貌). 【弨】 (tsyhew) (_adjective-like_) relaxed, undrawn

U+662D 炤 ziu1 (per 《廣韻》止遥切) (F2.2 昭) 明也光也 (Page 25* #1: (1)昭) The brightness of the sun (Kangxi: 日明也); bright, splendid (Kangxi: 明也, 光也); manifest (Kangxi: 昭見也, 著也); luminous, refulgent; _(1)ch(')i(u/) muk(9)_ (ciu1 muk6 昭穆) the order of precedence in the ancestral hall; _(5)(i/) muk(9) (1)ch(')i(u/) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (ji5 muk6 ciu1 zoeng1 耳目昭彰), bright to the eyes and clear to the ears, as a reputation; _(1)ch(')i(u/) (4)(i/)n_ (ciu1 jin4 昭然), intelligible; _(1)ch(')i(u/) ch(')(e/)uk(8) (4)n(i/)n (1)heng_ (ciu1 coek3 nin4 heng1 昭灼年輕), beautiful and young. 【昭】 (tsyew) (_adjective-like_) luminous, illuminate

U+8D85 (F2.2 超) 越也躍而過也 (Page 25* #3: (1)超) To leap over, to trip (Kangxi: 跳也); to hop across, to vault, to step over, to go before, to precede (Kangxi: 出前也); to excel, to surpass (Kangxi: 超卓也); to promote; to raise; _(1)ch(')i(u/) ~~p(a/)t(9)~~ pat(9)_ (ciu1 bat6 超拔) to override an officer; _(1)ch(')i(u/) (1)yau_ (ciu1 jau1 超幽) or _(1)ch(')i(u/) t(o\)(6)_ (ciu1 dou6 超度) to release spirits from suffering; _(1)ch(')i(u/) (2)tang_ (ciu1 dang2 超等), to exceed in the bachelor's examination; _(1)ch(')i(u/) (4)kw(')an_ (ciu1 kwan4 超群), excelling; _(1)ch(')i(u/) (1)shang_ (ciu1 sang1 超生), to restore to health, to save from death, to be reincarnated; _(1)ch(')i(u/) ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (ciu1 coek3 超卓) to surpass. Williams' "to trip": In the (now) dated sense of skipping lightly. Williams' 超拔: Changed _p(a/)t(9)_ (baat6) to modern _pat(9)_ (bat6). 【超】 (trhjew) (_verb-like_) to leap (over) (_verb-like_) to transcend 【超】 (ciu1) To stare or glare. 眼超超 (ngaan5 ciu1 ciu1): "Eyes staring." Sunglasses. 黑超 (hak1 ciu1): "Sunnies." An interjection of dismissal or dissatisfaction. 超、得兩個人 (ciu1, dak1 loeng5 go3 jan4): "Pff, only two people." The spelling 超 is arbitrary.

U+91D7 钊 (Mainland simplified) ziu1 (per 《廣韻》止遥切) (F2.2 釗) 遠也見也勉也又弩牙也 (Page 25* #4: (1)釗) To pare, to lop off (Kangxi: 刓也); to see, to wait on (Kangxi: 見也); distant (Kangxi: 遠也); to encourage (Kangxi: 釗勉也); _(5)m(i/)n (1)ch(')i(u/)_ (min5 ciu1 勉釗), to stimulate one; _yat(7) (1)ch(')i(u/)_ (jat1 ciu1 一釗), one dig, one delve.

U+936C 喿 橾 鍫 鐰 锹 (Mainland simplified) (Page 582 #2: 鍫(3) _Ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (ciu3); here corrected to _(1)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu1) and normalised to 鍬) A spade or pick (Kangxi 鍫: 臿也); an implement for turning up the ground; to dig deep; _~~ts(')i(u/)(3)~~ (1)ts(')i(u/) (4)t(')ong_ (ciu1 tong4 鍬塘), to dig out a fishpond; _t(a/)i(6) tung(6) ~~ts(')i(u/)(3)~~ (1)ts(')i(u/)_ (daai6 dung6 ciu1 大動鍬) a crowbar.

ciu2.text: U+6084 ciu3 (common) (F2.5 悄) 憂也 (Page 581 #14: (2)悄) Sad, downcast, sorrowing (Kangxi: 憂也); _(1)yau (1)sam (2)ts(')i(u/) (2)ts(')i(u/)_ (jau1 sam1 ciu2 ciu2 憂心悄悄), sick at heart, quietly sad, sorrowing in secret. The common reading ciu3 is sung by Danny Chan in 深愛著你 (1985) (containing the line 悄悄看我熟睡). Quietly. 【悄】 (tshjewX) (_adjective-like_) distressed

ciu3.text: U+4FCF (F2.5 俏 _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2)) 密行也又似也像也 (Page 581 #12: (2)俏 _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2); here corrected to _Ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (ciu3)) Like, as if, similar (Kangxi: 似也像也); handsome, pretty, beautiful (Kangxi: 好貌); superior; _~~(2)ts(')i(u/)~~ ts(')i(u/)(3) (4)p(')(i/)_ (ciu3 pei4 俏皮), pretty; _m(a/)i(6) ~~(2)ts(')i(u/)~~ ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (maai6 ciu3 賣俏), to show off one's pretty face, as by standing in the door; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng tak(7) ~~(2)ts(')i(u/)~~ ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (saang1 dak1 ciu3 生得俏), bright, as eyes; _(2)h(o\) ~~(2)ts(')i(u/)~~ ts(')i(u/)(3) t(u/)i(3) (5)ng(a/)n_ (hou2 ciu3 deoi3 ngaan5 好俏對眼), sparkling eyes; _~~(2)ts(')i(u/)~~ ts(')i(u/)(3) ~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng_ (ciu3 saang1 俏生), like life, as puppets or images. (Page 582 #3: 肖(3); here corrected to 俏) _ts(')i(u/)(3) (4)p(')(i/)_ (ciu3 pei4 俏皮), pretty; Williams' 生得俏, 俏生: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1).

U+5CED 陗 (F2.5 峭 _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2)) 陖也險也 (Page 581 #13: (2)峭 _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2); here corrected to _Ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (ciu3)) A steep, abrupt hill (Kangxi: 山峻拔峭絕也); a cliff, which obstructs the way (Kangxi: 嶮也); severe, strict, vehement (Kangxi: 嚴厲也); _~~(2)ts(')i(u/)~~ ts(')i(u/)(3) pik(7) (1)k(o\)_ (ciu3 bik1 gou1 峭壁高), a perpendicular cliff. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 唆 to 陖.

U+8096 May appear with top component as 尙 or 尚 (assumed here), depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 肖 as a component. (F2.7 肖) 似也像也 (Page 582 #3: 肖(3)) To assimilate, to imitate (Kangxi: 肖法也); a likeness or relationship between parent and child (Kangxi: 骨肉相似也), said to be proved by mixing their blood; resembling, like (Kangxi: 似也, 肖類也); small (Kangxi: 小也); ~~a class;~~ alike; _pat(7) ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (bat1 ciu3 不肖) not like it, inferior, degenerate; also used by a son to his father; _ts(')i(u/)(3) (5)n(i/) ko(3) y(e/)ung(6)_ (ciu3 nei5 go3 joeng6-2 肖你個樣) resembles you, as a bust or child; _shap(9) (i/)(6) (1)shang ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (sap6 ji6 sang1 ciu3 十二生肖) the twelve animals which are thought to be like the twelve branches. Williams' "a class": This is a misreading of Kangxi 肖類也. 【不肖】 (pjut sjewH) (_adjective-like_) unbecoming 【肖】 (sjewH) (_verb-like_) to resemble, (_met._) to emulate Used in 不肖.

U+8A9A 譙 诮 (Mainland simplified) ziu6 (per 《廣韻》才笑切) (F2.7 誚) 以言相譏詆曰誚 (Page 581 #9: (4)譙) Often used for _ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (ciu3) 誚, to scold (Kangxi 譙: 譙誚二字古通). to ridicule (Kangxi 譙: 嬈譊也); to bawl out at (Kangxi 譙: 呵也); to reprehend (Kangxi 譙: 責也); (Page 582 #4: 誚(3)) To ridicule; to blame, to reprehend (Kangxi: 讓也, 誚責也); to speak harshly against; _(1)k(i/) ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (gei1 ciu3 譏誚) to satirize. 【誚】 (dzjewH) (_verb-like_) to blame

ciu4.text: U+8B59 樵 谯 (Mainland simplified) (F2.5 譙) 地名又殺也 (Page 581 #8: (4)樵) a lookout terrace, for which the next (譙) is used (Kangxi 樵: 與譙通, ...高樓以望敵也); (Page 581 #9: (4)譙) A lookout tower or loft (Kangxi: 樓之別稱也); _~~(4)tsi(u/)~~ (4)ts(')i(u/) (1)k(u_ (ciu4 geoi1 譙車), a high turret laid on wheels for archers. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱誰灬 to 譙. Williams' 譙車: Corrected _(4)tsi(u/)_ (ziu4) to _(4)ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu4). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【譙】 (dzjew) (_noun-like_) turret Used in 譙譙. 【譙譙】 (dzjew dzjew) (_adjective-like_) worn out

ciu3.text: U+9798 削 韒 (F2.5 鞘 _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2)) 刀劍殿 (Page 582 #1: (2)鞘 _(2)Ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu2); here corrected to _Ts(')i(u/)(3)_ (ciu3)) A scabbard, a sheath (Kangxi: 刀室也) (...).

ciu4.text: U+6194 蕉 醮 䩌 顦 (F2.5 憔) 憔悴？苦貌 (Page 581 #10: (4)憔) Lean (Kangxi: 憔悴瘦也), anxious and starving; _(4)ts(')i(u/) sui(6)_ (ciu4 seoi6 憔悴) distressed from a want of food. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𭵼 to 憔. The incomprehensible character looks like ⿱䒑用. 【憔】 (dzjew) Used in 憔悴. 【憔悴】 (dzjew dzwijH) (_adjective-like_) languishing
U+6641 鼂 (F2.5 鼂) 姓 (F2.5 晁) 同上 Fan Wan entry: Fixed incorrectly crossing strokes in headword 鼂. A surname (Kangxi 鼂: 姓, 或作晁).

U+671D 晁 (F2.5 朝) 朝廷朝覲 (Page 25* #6: (4)朝) A court; the court, the palace; to attend an audience, to go to court, to show fealty (Kangxi: 陪朝也, 臣見君曰朝); to have an audience, to hold a levee (Kangxi: 天子無事與諸侯相見曰朝); an audience; a dynasty; courtly, fashionable; to visit a father or elder; _(4)ch(')i(u/) (4)t(')ing_ (ciu4 ting4 朝廷), the court; his majesty; _(4)ch(')i(u/) k(i/)n(3)_ (ciu4 gin3 朝見) to see his majesty; _(5)sh(e/)ung (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (soeng5 ciu4 上朝), to go up to court; _(2)ching tun(6) (4)ch(')i(u/) (1)kong_ (zing2 deon6 ciu4 gong1 整頓朝綱) to strengthen the government; _(4)ch(')i(u/) (1)f(a/)n_ (ciu4 faan1 朝幡), to salute the banner, a religious practice; _sh(i/)(6) (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (si6 ciu4 侍朝), H. I. M. entering court; _(1)t(')(i/)n (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (tin1 ciu4 天朝), the celestial dynasty; _(4)ch(')i(u/) kung(3)_ (ciu4 gung3 朝貢) to hand up tribute; _(2)ch(un (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (zyun2 ciu4 轉朝), to change the dynasty; _yat(7) (4)ch(')i(u/) (1)t(')(i/)n (2)tsz' yat(7) (4)ch(')i(u/) (4)shan_ (jat1 ciu4 tin1 zi2 jat1 ciu4 san4 一朝天子一朝臣), each monarch has his own set of ministers; _(4)ch(')i(u/) (4)fong_ (ciu4 fong4 朝房), an antechamber of the audience-room; _(4)ch(')i(u/) fuk(9)_ (ciu4 fuk6 朝服) court dress; _(4)ch(')i(u/) (2)h(a/)u_ (ciu4 haau2 朝考), examination for H(a/)nlin (翰林). See 朝 ziu1 for commentary on the reading of 朝 in 朝鮮. 【朝-voiced】 (drjew) (_noun-like_) audience, (imperial) court (_verb-like_) to attend audience, to attend court (_noun-like_) dynasty

ziu1.text: U+671D 晁 鼂 zi1 (lazy elision in 朝頭早) (F2.2 朝) 旦也早也又朝鮮國名 (Page 23* #9: (1)朝(1)晁) Dawn, morning (Kangxi 朝: 旦也, 朝早也); early; _(1)chi(u/) (5)m(a/)n_ (ziu1 maan5 朝晚), morning and evening, early and late; _yat(7) (1)chi(u/)_ (jat1 ziu1 一朝), in a morning, quickly, in a trice; _(1)chi(u/) (4)t(')au (2)ts(o\)_ (ziu1 tau4 zou2 朝頭早), early in morning; _(1)chi(u/) f(a/)n(6)_ (ziu1 faan6 朝飯) breakfast; _(1)chi(u/) (4)shan_ (ziu1 san4 朝晨), morning time; _(1)chi(u/) (1)chi(u/)_ (ziu1 ziu1 朝朝) every morning; _(1)Chi(u/) ~~(1)sin~~ (1)s(i/)n kwok(8)_ (ziu1 sin1 gwok3 朝鮮國) Corea (Kangxi 朝: 朝鮮國名); _yung(6) (1)chi(u/) m(i/)(6)_ (jung6 ziu1 mei6 用朝未) have you breakfasted? _(5)yau (1)chi(u/) (4)m(o\) (5)m(a/)n_ (jau5 ziu1 mou4 maan5 有朝無晚), there is a morning but no evening, the day is very short; _t(a/)i(6) p(u/)n(3) (1)chi(u/) (4)loi_ (daai6 bun3 ziu1 loi4 大半朝來), come before breakfast. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 且 to 旦. Williams' 朝鮮國: Opinion is divided on whether 朝 in 朝鮮 should be read _(1)chi(u/)_ (ziu1) or _(4)ch(')i(u/)_ (ciu4). _(1)chi(u/)_ (ziu1) is recorded in the dictionaries: 《廣韻》陟遥切 朝 早也...又朝鮮國名... 《康熙字典》朝 古文晁《唐韻》《廣韻》《集韻》《類篇》《韻會》𠀤陟遙切音昭...又朝鮮國名... _(4)ch(')i(u/)_ (ciu4) is recorded in 《史記索隱》, specifically as a note under 朝鮮列傳第五十五: 案朝音潮直驕反鮮音仙以有汕水故名也汕一音訕 Corrected _(1)sin_ to _(1)s(i/)n_. Williams' 朝飯, 朝晨, 用朝未: Dated. 【朝-unvoiced】 (trjew) (_noun-like_) morning 【朝頭早】 (ziu1 tau4 zou2) The morning. 朝頭早沖涼 (ziu1 tau4 zou2 cung1 loeng4): "I shower in the morning." 【朝早】 (ziu1 zou2) Morning. 聽朝早 (ting1 ziu1 zou2): "Tomorrow morning." 琴日朝早 (kam4 jat6 ziu1 zou2): "Yesterday morning". 朝早八點 (ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2): "Eight o'clock in the morning."

ciu4.text: U+6A35 蕉 (F2.5 樵) 采薪曰樵 (Page 581 #8: (4)樵) Wood fit for fuel; scattered wood (Kangxi: 散木也); to cut fuel (Kangxi: 采薪曰樵); _~~(4)tsi(u/)~~ (4)ts(')i(u/) (1)f(u/)_ (ciu4 fu1 樵夫), a woodcutter; _(4)ts(')i(u/) (4)lau_ (ciu4 lau4 樵樓), a watchman's tower; _(4)ts(')i(u/) king(3)_ (ciu4 ging3 樵徑) a bridle path, a goat path; _(2)ts(')oi (4)ts(')i(u/)_ (coi2 ciu4 採樵), to cut wood; _(1)Sai (4)Ts(')i(u/)_ (sai1 ciu4 西樵), a hilly district southwest of Canton. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𬋈 to 樵. Williams' 樵夫: Corrected _(4)tsi(u/)_ (ziu4) to _(4)ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu4). 【樵】 (dzjew) (_noun-like_) firewood (_verb-like_) (_met._) to cut firewood, to burn firewood

U+6F6E (F2.5 潮) 海水旋流每日消長朝曰潮夕曰汐 (Page 25* #5: (4)潮) The morning tide (Kangxi: 隨月消長早曰潮晚曰汐); moist, damp; _(2)ch(e/)ung (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (zoeng2 ciu4 長朝), tide rising; _(4)shing (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (sing4 ciu4 乘潮), to go with the tide; _(4)ch(')i(u/) shap(7)_ (ciu4 sap1 潮濕) damp ~~ground~~; _(4)ch(')i(u/) (4)t(')(i/)n_ (ciu4 tin4 潮田), tidal grounds; _(1)f(a/)n (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (faan1 ciu4 返潮), becoming damp again; _(4)Ch(')i(u/) (1)chau (2)f(u/)_ (ciu4 zau1 fu2 潮州府), a prefecture in the east of Kw(a/)ngtung (廣東); _(4)ch(')i(u/) h(i/)(3)_ (ciu4 hei3 潮氣) dull, stupid, owlish. Fan Wan entry: Normalised ⿱一毋 to 每, and corrected 汝 to 汐. Williams' 潮濕: Not necessarily of the ground. 【潮】 (drjew) (_noun-like_) (morning) tide

U+77A7 (Page 581 #11: (4)瞧) To look at, to see; to look at furtively (Kangxi: 偸視貌), to glance at; _(4)ts(')i(u/) yat(7) (4)ts(')i(u/)_ (ciu4 jat1 ciu4 瞧一瞧), I had a look at it. Chiefly used in the court dialect.

ziu1.text: U+8549 (F2.3 蕉) 芭蕉花名 (Page 580 #6: (1)蕉) The banana or plantain (Kangxi: 芭蕉); _(1)h(e/)ung (4)ng(a/) (1)tsi(u/)_ (hoeng1 ngaa4 ziu1 香芽蕉), green plantains; _(1)tsi(u/) (2)tsau_ (ziu1 zau2 蕉酒), spirits with plantains steeped in it; _(2)k(u/) (4)ch(')ui (1)tsi(u/)_ (gu2 ceoi4 ziu1 鼓錘蕉), large plantains; _(5)m(i/) (4)yan (1)tsi(u/)_ (mei5 jan4 ziu1 美人蕉), thin skinned plantains. Raw hemp, which has not yet been treated by soaking. 【蕉】 (tsjew) (_noun-like_) raw-hemp

co1.text: U+509E so1 (alternative per 《廣韻》素何切) (F2.58 傞) 舞不止也 (Page 583 #2: (1)傞) The drunken frolics of a man in liquor (Kangxi: 醉舞貌); _(1)ts(')o (1)ts(')o_ (co1 co1 傞傞), drunken antics. Williams' "frolics": Specifically, dancing. 【傞】 (tsha, sa) Used in 傞傞. 【傞傞】 (tsha tsha, sa sa) (_adverb-like_) (dancing) drunkenly, on and on

U+521D (F2.58 初) 始也先也 (Page 26* #4: (1)初) To cut out garments (Kangxi: 裁衣之始也); to begin, to commence (Kangxi: 始也); the first, the beginning; incipient, at first; _(a/)(3) (1)ch(')o (1)ko_ (aa3 co1 go1 阿初哥), a beginner, raw; _(1)ch(')o (1)k(a/)n_ (co1 gaan1 初間), during the first decade; _(1)ch(')o (1)ch(')o_ (co1 co1 初初), at first; _(1)ch(')o (4)t(')au f(a/)t(8) shai(3)_ (co1 tau4 faat3 sai3 初頭發勢) a great show at starting; _~~(4)ch(')o~~ (1)ch(')o (4)loi p(o\)(6) t(o\)(3)_ (co1 loi4 bou6 dou3 初來步到) unacquainted with things; _(1)ch(')o ts(o\)(6)_ (co1 zou6 初做) to begin; _(1)ch(')o (1)shang_ (co1 sang1 初生), a ~~first-born~~ newborn; _(1)ch(')o (4)ts(')un_ (co1 ceon4 初旬), the first decade; _(1)ch(')o (1)hoi fau(6)_ (co1 hoi1 fau6 初開埠) to found a mart; _(1)ch(')o (2)k(i/)_ (co1 gei2 初幾), which day of the first decade is it? Williams' "To cut out garments": Specifically, the beginning of producing clothes. Williams' 初間, 初旬, 初幾: Here, "decade" means ten days. Williams' 初來步到: Corrected _(4)ch(')o_ (co4) to _(1)ch(')o_ (co1). 【初】 (tsrhjo) (_noun-like_) beginning (_adjective-like_) initial 【初初】 (co1 co1) At first, initially. 【初哥】 (co1 go1) A beginner, a novice.

U+5528 (Page 26* #5: (1)唨) A colloquial, final particle. To stop, to desist; _(5)n(i/) (5)mai h(u(3) tsz'(6) (1)ch(')o_ (nei5 mai5 heoi3 zi6 co1 你咪去？唨), don't you go! _(5)n(i/) (2)tang (5)h(a/) (1)ch(')o_ (nei5 dang2 haa5 co1 你等吓唨), stop a little!

U+5D6F 嵳 co4 (per 《廣韻》昨何切) (F2.58 嵯) 嵯峨 (Page 583 #3: (1)嵯) ~~Uneven hills;~~ ~~_(1)ts(')o (4)ngo_ (co1 ngo4 嵯峨), the inequalities of hills, the undulating outline of mountains.~~ The reading _(1)ts(')o_ (co1) is not unattested; Kangxi has 《集韻》《韻會》《正韻》𠀤倉何切音磋《說文》嵯峨山石貌. Williams' "Uneven hills" etc.: These explanations only apply to the reading 楚宜切 _(1)ch(')(i/)_ (ci1) for use in the phrase 㠁嵯, which is the mountain version of 參差. Used in 嵯峨 (lofty, mountainous).

U+7473 co2 (alternative per 《廣韻》千可切) (F2.58 瑳) 玉鮮白色 (Page 583 #7: (1)瑳) A white, lustrous, stone (Kangxi: 玉色鮮白也); fresh, beautiful (Kangxi: 凡物鮮盛亦曰瑳, 鮮盛貌); to smile, to look fascinating (Kangxi: 笑貌, 瑳巧笑貌). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 解 to 鮮 (notwithstanding the olden dictionaries read 玉色鮮白). Kangxi prescribes the rising-tone reading for the "brilliant" (鮮盛貌) and "smiling" (笑貌) senses. 【瑳】 (tsha, tshaX) (_adjective-like_) brilliant-white

U+78CB 瑳 (F2.58 磋) 切磋所以治骨角 (Page 583 #7: (1)瑳) Used for the next (磋) (Kangxi 瑳: 與磋同). (Page 583 #8: (1)磋) To polish, to work on (Kangxi: 磨治也, 治象曰磋); to cut and polish; to work at, to make good, as composition; _ts(')(i/)t(8) (1)ts(')o_ (cit3 co1 切磋), to cut and polish. 【磋】 (tsha) (_verb-like_) to polish

U+82BB 刍 蒭 (F2.58 芻) 草也 (Page 26* #6: (1)芻) To cut grass (Kangxi: 刈草也); hay, fodder, grass for animals (Kangxi: 芻者飼牛馬之草, 草食曰芻); _yat(7) ch(')uk(7) (1)ch(')o_ (jat1 cuk1 co1 一束芻), a bundle of hay; _(1)ch(')o (4)i(u/)_ (co1 jiu4 芻蕘), grass; _met._ the people. 【芻】 (tsrhju) (_noun-like_) hay, fodder
U+8E49 (F2.58 蹉) 蹉跎不及也 (Page 583 #6: (1)蹉) To slip (Kangxi: 蹉跌也); to err (Kangxi: 蹉過也); _(1)ts(')o (4)t(')o_ (co1 to4 蹉跎), to miss the time, to lose the opportunity (Kangxi: 蹉跎失時也).

U+96DB 雏 鶵 co4 (per 《廣韻》仕于切) (F2.60 雛 _(4)Ch(')o_ (co4)) 鳥子曰雛 (Page 26* #7: (4)雛 _(4)Ch(')o_ (co4); here normalised to _(1)Ch(')o_ (co1)) A chick, a fledgeling (Kangxi: 雞子也); the callow young of birds; _~~(4)ch(')o~~ (1)ch(')o (1)kai_ (co1 gai1 雛雞), a chicken. 【雛】 (dzrju) (_noun-like_) chick

co4.text: U+96DB (F2.60 雛) 鳥子曰雛 (Page 26* #7: (4)雛)

co2.text: U+695A 憷 (for "pain/suffering" senses) 椘 䠂 (F2.60 楚) 國名大也高起也又夏楚荊條也 (Page 26* #9: (2)楚) A coppice, a bramble-bush, a thicket (Kangxi: 叢木也); a clump of trees; spinous (Kangxi: 楚楚茨棘貌); distinct, clear, orderly (Kangxi: 楚楚鮮明貌); well done, properly finished; painful (Kangxi: 辛楚痛也), sharp; a feudal state (Kangxi: 國名) in the Chau (周) dynasty now the chief part of H(u/)n(a/)n (湖南) and H(u/)peh (湖北); _(1)ts(')ing (2)ch(')o_ (cing1 co2 清楚), clear, fresh, completed, well done; _(2)ch(')o (2)ch(')o_ (co2 co2 楚楚), very good, carefully; _(1)king (2)ch(')o_ (ging1 co2 荊楚), a severe castigation; _(2)f(u/) (2)ch(')o_ (fu2 co2 苦楚), distressing, suffering. (Page 26* #10: (2)憷) Interchanged with the last (楚), in the senses of painful, suffering (Kangxi 憷: 通作楚). A rod or cane used to beat offenders (Kangxi: 楚荆也扑撻犯禮者). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【楚】 (tsrhjoX) (_noun-like_) thorn-tree, thorn, (_met._) ferule (_noun-like_) pain, suffering (_adjective-like_) thickset (_adjective-like_) neat, splendid Used in 萇楚.
U+790E 础 (Mainland simplified) (Page 26* #11: (2)~~？~~礎) The stone base of a pillar or column (Kangxi 礎: 柱下石, 礩也); a pedestal; a plinth.

U+811E co3 (per Fan Wan) (F2.61 脞 _Ts(')o(3)_ (co3)) 叢脞又細碎無大畧也 (Page 583 #13: 脞(3) _Ts(')o(3)_ (co3); here normalised to _(2)Ts(')o_ (co2)) To mince up meat (Kangxi: 一曰切肉爲脞); broken to bits, minced; small (Kangxi: 小也); to attend to trifles (Kangxi: 叢脞細碎無大略). 【脞】 (tshwaX) (_noun-like_) mince, (_met._) trifle

co3.text: U+811E (F2.61 脞) 叢脞又細碎無大畧也 (Page 583 #13: 脞(3))
U+5249 (F2.61 剉) 折也 (F2.61 銼) 與剉同 (Page 583 #10: 剉(3)) To cut, to lop off the corners and sharp points, to trim and prune (Kangxi: 折傷也, 斫也, 斬截也); to cut up, to cut to pieces.

U+632B zo3 (per 《廣韻》則臥切) (F2.61 挫) 摧折也打也 (Page 583 #12: 挫(3)) To break, to wound (Kangxi: 摧也, 挫折也); to take off the edge, to humble; to oppress, to treat harshly; ~~to trim, to file off;~~ _ts(')o(3) (4)k(')(i/) yui(6) h(i/)(3)_ (co3 kei4 jeoi6 hei3 挫其銳氣) to bring down his valor; _ts(')o(3) ch(i/)t(8)_ (co3 zit3 挫折) to improve, to polish rude ways; tried by afflictions. 【挫】 (tswaH) (_verb-like_) to break, to defeat, (_met._) to dampen (_verb-like_) to push

U+92BC 剉 锉 (Mainland simplified) co4 (per 《廣韻》昨禾切 for "boiler" sense) zuk6 (per 《廣韻》昨木切 for "boiler" sense) (F2.61 剉) 折也 (F2.61 銼) 與剉同 (Page 583 #10: 剉(3)) Often used for the next (銼). (Page 583 #11: 銼(3)) An iron pan or boiler (Kangxi: 鍑也); a file, a rasp; to rasp, to file, to smooth off the sharp or rough points; to rub down; _yat(7) (2)p(a/) ts(')o(3)_ (jat1 baa2 co3 一把銼) one file; _ts(')o(3) w(a/)t(9)_ (co3 waat6 銼滑) file it smooth; _(1)kai (1)ch(')un ts(')o(3)_ (gai1 ceon1 co3 雞膥銼) to file eggs, or _(1)ch(i/) (4)m(a/) ts(')o(3)_ (zi1 maa4 co3 芝麻銼) to scrape sesamum seeds, both mean a skinflint; _ts(')o(3) kok(8)_ (co3 gok3 銼角) to file off corners. Williams' 雞膥銼, 芝麻銼: More accurately rendered as nouns, i.e. "chicken-egg file" and "sesame file".

U+932F 错 (Mainland simplified) (Page 583 #14: 錯(3)) In disorder, confused; to mistake, to err, to do wrong; to slip; erroneous, mixed, wrong; _(5)m(o\) ts(')o(3)_ (mou5 co3 冇錯) no mistake, right; _ts(')o(3) ~~(5)ng(a/)m~~ (1)ng(a/)m_ (co3 ngaam1 錯啱), a lucky hit, an error which is fortunate; _(4)'m ying(6) ts(')o(3)_ (m4 jing6 co3 唔認錯) will not confess the wrong; _ts(')o(3) k(e/)uk(8) (4)n(a/)n (1)f(a/)n_ (co3 goek3 naan4 faan1 錯腳難翻) a slip may be hard to retrieve; _ts(')o(3) kwo(3) p(i/)t(7) (2)koi_ (co3 gwo3 bit1 goi2 錯過必改), error must be corrected; _(2)s(e/) ts(')o(3)_ (se2 co3 寫錯) written wrong. The classical reading of the "erroneous" and "mixed" senses is entering-tone _ts(')ok(8)_ (cok3). Williams' 錯啱: Corrected _(5)ng(a/)m_ (ngaam5) to _(1)ng(a/)m_ (ngaam1). 【唔錯】 (m4 co3) Not bad (in quality). 唔錯吖 (m4 co3 a1): "Not bad!" 【冇錯】 (mou5 co3) Correct. 冇錯喇 (mou5 co3 la3): "That's correct."

cok3.text: U+932F 剒 (for "cut/work" sense) 厝 (for "whetstone" sense) 逪 (for "cross/diagonal" senses) 䥄 (for "inlay/plate" sense) 错 (Mainland simplified) (F1.102 錯) 舛也乖也誤也亂也 (Page 588 #1: 錯(3) _Ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3); here corrected to _Ts(')ok(8)_ (cok3)) To cut or work stones (Kangxi: 治玉石曰錯); (Page 592 #8: 錯(8)) To ~~wash~~ inlay or plate with gold (Kangxi: 金涂也); the stripes, striae, streaks, &c., in stones or fabrics (Kangxi: 錯衡文衡也); to file or polish (Kangxi: 鑢也, 治玉石曰錯); to tattoo (Kangxi: 錯臂亦文身謂以丹靑錯畫其臂); a stone for grinding gems or glass (Kangxi: 厲石也, 錯石也可以琢玉); mixed, crossed, barred, confused (Kangxi: 雜也, 亂也); _ts(')ok(8) p(i/)(3)_ (cok3 bei3 錯臂) to tattoo the arm. 【錯】 (tshak) (_noun-like_) whetstone (_verb-like_) to inlay, to tattoo (_verb-like_) to cross (diagonally) (_adjective-like_) mixed, erroneous, confused (_adjective-like_) diagonal (_adjective-like_) wary

cou3.text: U+932F 错 (Mainland simplified) (F2.16 錯 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 捨置也又倉入聲礪石也 (Page 588 #1: 錯(3)) Interchanged with the two last (厝, 措). to place (Kangxi: 錯置也); to hide, to store away (Kangxi: 藏也).

co4.text: U+924F (F2.60 鋤) 冲所切田器也 (F2.60 鉏) 同上 (Page 26* #8: ~~(5)鉏(5)鋤~~(4)鉏(4)鋤) Fan Wan entry: The supplied dissection 冲所切 is incorrect.

U+92E4 鉏 锄 (Mainland simplified) (F2.60 鋤) 冲所切田器也 (F2.60 鉏) 同上 (Page 26* #8: ~~(5)鉏(5)鋤~~(4)鉏(4)鋤) A hoe, a mattoc (Kangxi 鉏: 立薅所用也, 助也去穢助苗也); to hoe, to cultivate (Kangxi 鉏: 治田也); _(4)ch(')o (4)t(')(i/)n_ (co4 tin4 鋤田), to dig; _(4)ch(')o (4)t(')au_ (co4 tau4-2 鋤頭), a hoe or mattoc. Fan Wan entry: The supplied dissection 冲所切 is incorrect. 【鋤】 (dzrjo) (_noun-like_) hoe 【鋤大弟】 (co4 daai6 di2) Big two (the card game). To play big two. 【鋤弟】 (co4 di2) Short for 鋤大弟 (to play big two).

zo6.text: U+5750 co5 (verb-like) (F2.62 坐) 止也居也 (Page 582 #7: 坐(6)) To sit (Kangxi: 行之對也); to sit on the heels; sitting, remaining; a session; to maintain, to hold (Kangxi: 猶守也); involved in, implicated; ~~to sit in judgement on, to judge;~~ to place, to set down; to kneel (Kangxi: 古者謂跪爲坐); _(2)ts(')ing ~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o_ (cing2 co5 請坐) please be seated; _tso(6) (1)i(u/)_ (zo6 jiu1 坐腰), to curtsey; _(5)n(i/) ~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o_ (nei5 co5 你坐) or _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o ch(e/)(3)_ (co5 ze3 坐嗻) good bye, said to the host; _tso(6) (5)l(i/)_ (zo6 lei5 坐𢃇), to let down sail; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o ki(u/)(6)_ (co5 giu6-2 坐轎) to ride in a sedan; _tso(6) ts(u/)i(6) (1)(u (5)n(i/)_ (zo6 zeoi6 jyu1 nei5 坐罪於你), to bring the punishment upon you; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (ut(9)_ (co5 jyut6-2 坐月) the month after confinement; _tso(6) wai(6)_ (zo6 wai6-2 坐位) a seat, a station; _tso(6) shat(9)_ (zo6 sat6 坐實) put it in securely; _tso(6) sok(8)_ (zo6 sok3 坐索) to quarter on one to force him to pay; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (4)'m lok(9)_ (co5 m4 lok6 坐唔落) no place to sit in; _tso(6) h(e/)ung(3)_ (zo6 hoeng3 坐向) the prospect, as of a grave; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (5)h(a/) (1)t(')(i/)m_ (co5 haa5 tim1 坐吓添), sit a while longer; _t(')(i/)t(8) tso(6)_ (tit3 zo6 鐵坐) to squat, as a tailor; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (1)k(a/)m_ (co5 gaam1 坐監), in prison; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o ~~sh(e/)ung(6)~~ (5)sh(e/)ung_ (co5 soeng5 坐上) sit up higher; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (4)t(')ong_ (co5 tong4-2 坐堂), in court, on the bench; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (5)l(a/)ng f(a/)n(6) ~~k(o\)m(3)~~ (2)k(o\)m ~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o_ (co5 laang5 faan6 gam2 co5 坐冷飯噉坐) to sit till the rice is cold, _i. e._ to take ~~Freuch~~ French leave; _(2)t(a/) tso(6) (1)ts(')(a/)m ~~(4)sh(i/)n~~ (4)sh(i/)m_ (daa2 zo6 caam1 sim4 打坐參禪), to ~~squat~~ sit in the lotus position and contemplate, as Budhists do. The rising-tone reading _(5)ts(')o_ (co5) is typically only heard in vernacular usage for verb-like occurrences, leading to the perception that it is non-literary. In fact, the distinction in Cantonese between aspirated rising _(5)ts(')o_ (co5) and unaspirated departing _tso(6)_ (zo6) actually preserves the two readings of 坐 in Middle Chinese (also true of 斷, 淡, 近, 重, etc.). Kangxi has an extended note, 按坐有上去二音字韻諸書訓註皆同惟轉注古音坐註引史記高帝紀遂坐上坐正義云前坐字在果反後坐字在臥反 the short version of which is, that the quoted line 遂坐上坐 "Then he sat upon the upper seat" should be read _sui(6) (5)ts(')o sh(e/)ung(6) tso(6)_ (seoi6 co5 soeng6 zo6), with the first 坐 ("sat") rising and the second 坐 ("seat") departing. Williams' _tso(6)_ (zo6 去聲) has been corrected to _(5)ts(')o_ (co5 上聲) when appropriate. Williams' 坐月: Here, "confinement" means childbirth. Confusingly, in more modern English, the act of staying home for a month afterward is also called confinement. Williams' 坐上: Corrected _sh(e/)ung(6)_ (soeng6 去聲) to _(5)sh(e/)ung_ (soeng5 上聲). Williams' 坐冷飯噉坐: Corrected _k(o\)m(3)_ (gam3) to _(2)k(o\)m_ (gam2). Williams' 打坐參禪: Changed _(4)sh(i/)n_ (sin4) to common reading _(4)sh(i/)m_ (sim4). Implicatory collective punishment (Kangxi: 《律》有罪坐). A defence lawyer or cross-examination(?) (Kangxi: 罪人對理曰坐). 【坐-rising】 (dzwaX) (_verb-like_) to sit, to kneel 【坐-departing】 (dzwaH) (_noun-like_) seat (_adjective-like_) seated, (_met._) hunkered (_adjective-like_) implicated, convicted 【坐】 (co5) (_Chinese chess_) Used to describe moves of the general. 坐起 (co5 hei2): "Sit raised" (i.e. move the general up). 坐上 (co5 soeng5): "Sit up" (i.e. move the general up). 坐上山頂 (co5 soeng5 saan1 deng2): "Sit up to the mountain top" (i.e. move the general up to the top row of the palace). 坐落 (co5 lok6): "Sit down" (i.e. move the general down). 坐出 (co5 ceot1): "Sit out" (i.e. move the general out of cover of the centre column). 坐入 (co5 jap6): "Sit in" (i.e. move the general back into cover of the centre column). 坐歪 (co5 me2): "Sit off-centre" (i.e. move the general off the uncovered centre column). 坐正 (co5 zeng3): "Sit right" (i.e. move the general back onto the uncovered centre column). 坐咗佢 (co5 zo2 keoi5): "Sit over it" (i.e. capture with the general). 【坐低】 (co5 dai1) To sit down. 【坐穩機】 (co5 wan2 gei1) A farewell wish for a safe flight.

coek3.text: U+502C zoek3 (per initial of 《廣韻》竹角切) (F1.94 倬) 著也大也詩倬彼雲漢 (Page 33|n76 #2: 倬(8)) Extensive~~, distant~~; large (Kangxi: 大也); to show, to manifest (Kangxi: 著也, 明貌); _(4)ming ch(')(e/)uk(8) (5)(u ts(u/)i(6)_ (ming4 coek3 jyu5 zeoi6 明倬汝罪) to make your crime known. 【倬】 (traewk) (_adjective-like_) grand, illustrious

zoek3.text: U+52FA 杓 (for noun sense) coek3 (common) soek3 (common) soek6 (per 《廣韻》市若切 for noun sense) (F1.94 勺) 挹取也 (Page 32|n75 #3: 勺(8)) A ladle or spoon (Kangxi: 勺所以𣂏酒也); a spoonful; _~~tau(6)~~ lau(6) ch(e/)uk(8)_ (lau6 zoek3 漏勺) a cullender; _yat(7) ch(e/)uk(8) (2)shui (1)ch(i/) (1)to_ (jat1 zoek3 seoi2 zi1 do1 一勺水之多), much as a spoonful of water (Kangxi: 一勺水之多言少也). (Page 32|n75 #6: 杓(8); here normalised to 勺) A ladle (Kangxi 杓: 以爲桮杓之杓所以抒挹也); Williams' 漏勺: Corrected _tau(6)_ (dau6) to _lau(6)_ (lau6). To ladle (Kangxi: 挹取也). 【勺-noun】 (dzyak) (_noun-like_) ladle 【勺-verb】 (tsyak) (_verb-like_) to ladle

coek3.text: U+5353 㔬 桌 zoek3 (per initial of 《廣韻》竹角切) (F1.94 卓) 特立也高也遠也望也 (Page 33|n76 #1: 卓(8)) Firm, stable; lofty (Kangxi: 高也) and profound; distant; to establish; to expect; to surpass (Kangxi: 超卓也); eminent in, raised above others; ~~at, reached, as a time;~~ _(1)ch(')i(u/) ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (ciu1 coek3 超卓) preeminent, superior to common; _ch(')(e/)uk(8) (ut(9) (4)yan (4)kw(')an_ (coek3 jyut6 jan4 kwan4 卓越人群), excelling other men; _ch(')(e/)uk(8) lap(9)_ (coek3 lap6 卓立) to erect, upright; _ch(')(e/)uk(8) (i/)(6)_ (coek3 ji6 卓異) meritorious, said of officers at the quinqennial trial. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【卓】 (traewk) (_adjective-like_) lofty (_adverb-like_) aloft
U+6233 cok3 (alternative for "stamp" sense) (Page 33|n76 #5: 戳(8)) To stab or spear (Kangxi: 槍戳也); a seal used by constables; _k(')oi(3) ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (koi3 coek3 蓋戳) to stamp a document.

U+684C 卓 棹 槕 zoek3 (per initial of 《廣韻》竹角切) (Page 33|n76 #3: 棹(8); here normalised to 桌) A table (Kangxi 桌: 俗呼几案曰桌); a stand; _ch(')(e/)uk(8) (2)tsz'_ (coek3 zi2 桌子) a table; _(2)(i/) ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (ji2 coek3 椅桌) tables and chairs.
U+68F9 zoek6 (per initial of Kangxi 直角切) (Page 33|n76 #3: 棹(8)) a kind of tree (Kangxi: 木名);

zaau6.text: U+68F9 掉 櫂 濯 (F2.42 棹 _Ch(a/)u(3)_ (zaau3)) 進船之器 (F2.43 櫂 _Ch(a/)u(3)_ (zaau3)) 同上 (Page 29|n72 #8: 櫂(3)棹(3)掉(3) _Ch(a/)u(3)_ (zaau3); here corrected to _Ch(a/)u(6)_ (zaau6)) To row (Kangxi 櫂: 言使舟櫂進也); to shoot an arrow; to throw away; a long oar (Kangxi 櫂: 所以進船也, 短曰檝長曰櫂); _~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6) k(e/)uk(8)_ (zaau6 goek3 棹腳) to limp, as the lame do; _~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6) chung(3)_ (zaau6 zung3 棹中) to hit the bull's-eye; _~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6) (2)ts(e/)ung_ (zaau6 zoeng2 棹槳), to pull an oar; _~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6) (4)m(a/)i (4)t(')au_ (zaau6 maai4 tau4 棹埋頭), to pull ashore; _~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6) kwo(3) (2)hoi_ (zaau6 gwo3 hoi2 棹過海), to pull across the river; _ch(')ut(7) lik(9) ~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6)_ (ceot1 lik6 zaau6 出力棹) row harder; _~~ch(a/)u(3)~~ ch(a/)u(6) ch(')ut(7) (1)k(a/)i_ (zaau6 ceot1 gaai1 棹出街), throw it out in the street. The ~~two~~ last of these characters (~~棹,~~ 掉) ~~are~~ is improperly used in Canton for the first (櫂).

coek3.text: U+707C 焯 (for "manifest/clear" sense and Cantonese "blanch" sense) zoek3 (per 《廣韻》之若切) (F1.94 灼 _Ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) 燒也炙也昭也又灼灼華盛貌 (Page 32|n75 #4: 灼(8) _Ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3); here normalised to _Ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3)) To burn (Kangxi: 炙也, 熱也); to singe, to cauterize ~~with moxa~~ (Kangxi: 熱也); alarmed (Kangxi: 灼驚也); clear, distinct (Kangxi: 明也); luxuriant, as flowers (Kangxi: 灼灼花盛貌); _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(')(e/)uk(8) (1)kwai_ (coek3 gwai1 灼龜), to singe a terrapin's shell; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(')(e/)uk(8) l(a/)n(6)_ (coek3 laan6 灼爛) to raise a blister; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(')(e/)uk(8) ng(a/)i(6)_ (coek3 ngaai6 灼艾) to burn the moxa; _~~ch(e/)uk(8) ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(')(e/)uk(8) ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3 coek3 灼灼) splendid, as flowers. 【灼】 (tsyak) (_verb-like_) to burn, to scorch (_adjective-like_) manifest, (_met._) bright 【灼】 (coek3) To cook (briefly) in boiling water, to blanch. 白灼蝦 (baak6 coek3 haa1): "Plain boiled prawns." 灼一灼 (coek3 jat1 coek3): "Give it a blanch."
