coek3.text: U+712F zoek3 (per 《廣韻》之若切) Clear, bright.

U+7DBD 繛 绰 (Mainland simplified) (F1.94 綽) 寬也緩也 (Page 33|n76 #4: 綽(8)) Large, ample (Kangxi: 緩也, 綽綽寬也, 綽猶多也); ~~slow, leisurely;~~ _ch(')(e/)uk(8) y(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3 joek3 綽約) delicate, as a girl; _(1)f(u/)n ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (fun1 coek3 寬綽) broad, liberal; _ch(')(e/)uk(8) ch(')(e/)uk(8) (5)yau (4)(u_ (coek3 coek3 jau5 jyu4 綽綽有餘), an overplus, more than enough. Williams' "slow, leisurely": This is a misreading of Kangxi 緩也. 【綽】 (tsyhak) (_adjective-like_) generous, ample (_adjective-like_) gentle

U+828D 勺 soek6 (per 《廣韻》市若切) zoek3 (per 《廣韻》張略切) (F1.94 芍 _Ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) 芍藥花名 (Page 32|n75 #7: 芍(8) _Ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3); here normalised to _Ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3)) The peony (Kangxi: 芍藥猶綽約也); also the dahlia; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(')(e/)uk(8) y(e/)uk(9)_ (coek3 joek6 芍藥) peony roots, a medicine. 【芍】 (dzyak, trjak) Used in 芍藥. 【芍藥】 (dzyak yak, trjak yak) (_noun-like_) peony
U+8E14 (Page 29|n72 #7: 踔(3)) Read _ch(')(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3)_;_ to leap far and high (Kangxi: 踔高遠也); to walk lamely (Kangxi: 踸踔跛者行也).

zaau3.text: U+8E14 caau3 (per 《廣韻》丑敎切) (Page 29|n72 #7: 踔(3)) To tread on (Kangxi: 踶也); to stretch ahead in running (Kangxi: 踔走也, 踔踰也, 踔猶越也); to jump over.

zoek3.text: U+9D72 舃 舄 鹊 (Mainland simplified) coek3 (per 《廣韻》七雀切) zoek3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.94 鵲 _Ts(')(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3)) 喜鵲 (Page 565 #8: 鵲(8) _Ts(')(e/)uk(8)_ (coek3); here normalised to _Ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) A magpie, a jackdaw (Kangxi: 鳥名喜鵲也); a jay (Kangxi: 練鵲); _(2)h(i/) ~~ts(')(e/)uk(8)~~ ts(e/)uk(8)_ (hei2 zoek3 喜鵲) or _(1)kon ~~ts(')(e/)uk(8)~~ ts(e/)uk(8)_ (gon1 zoek3 乾鵲) a magpie; _(1)sh(a/)n (2)h(i/) ~~ts(')(e/)uk(8)~~ ts(e/)uk(8)_ (saan1 hei2 zoek3 山喜鵲) a magpie with a gradated tail; _(1)(u/) ~~ts(')(e/)uk(8)~~ ts(e/)uk(8)_ (wu1 zoek3 烏鵲) a raven. 【鵲】 (tshjak) (_noun-like_) magpie

coeng1.text: U+5021 (F1.90 倡) 倡導倡率先之也 (Page 36|n79 #2: (1)倡)

coeng3.text: U+5021 coeng1 (per Fan Wan, common) (F1.90 倡 _(1)Ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1)) 倡導倡率先之也 (Page 36|n79 #2: (1)倡 _(1)Ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1); here normalised to _Ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (coeng3)) To lead, to go before (Kangxi: 倡發歌句也), to seduce or induce; a leader; an example, a guide; _~~(1)ch(')(e/)ung~~ ch(')(e/)ung(3) t(o\)(6)_ (coeng3 dou6 倡導) to show the way; _~~(1)ch(')(e/)ung~~ ch(')(e/)ung(3) (4)(i/)n_ (coeng3 jin4 倡言), to speak first; _~~(1)ch(')(e/)ung~~ ch(')(e/)ung(3) sut(7)_ (coeng3 seot1 倡率) to lead on; _~~(1)ch(')(e/)ung~~ ch(')(e/)ung(3) (4)t(')au_ (coeng3 tau4 倡頭), a leader; _~~(1)ch(')(e/)ung~~ ch(')(e/)ung(3) l(un(6)_ (coeng3 lyun6 倡亂) to head a riot. 【倡】 (tsyhangH) (_verb-like_) to lead song

coeng1.text: U+5A3C 倡 (F1.90 娼) 娼妓又娼優女樂 (Page 36|n79 #2: (1)倡) used for the (...) next (娼) (Kangxi 倡: 別作娼); (Page 36|n79 #3: (1)娼) A singing woman (Kangxi 倡: 倡優女樂...別作娼); a courtesan; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)m(u/)n_ (coeng1 mun4 娼門), public women; _(1)wo (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (wo1 coeng1 窩娼), house of assignation; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (5)f(u/)_ (coeng1 fu5 娼婦), a strumpet; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung k(i/)(6)_ (coeng1 gei6 娼妓) a whore; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)li(u/)_ (coeng1 liu4 娼寮), a brothel; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (1)k(a/)_ (coeng1 gaa1 娼家), a bagnio; _(1)yau (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (jau1 coeng1 優娼), public singers; _(1)tong (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (dong1 coeng1 當娼), to be a whore.

U+5C07 将 (Mainland simplified) To request, to ask (Kangxi: 請也幾願辭也). (_onomatopoeia_) The sound of tinkling (Kangxi: 聲也). Stern and proper (Kangxi: 嚴正貌). Collected (Kangxi: 集也). 【將-aspirated】 (tshjang) (_verb-like_) to entreat

zoeng1.text: U+5C07 将 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 將) 事之未必就時也又奉也送也又干將劍名 (Page 565 #9: (1)將) To take, to bring, to hold in the hand; sign of the future, shall, will, about to go (Kangxi: 將甫始之辭); sometimes a form of the accusative; then, soon, presently; to help, to accommodate (Kangxi: 助也); to use, to avail of, to go with, to escort, to accompany (Kangxi: 送也); great (Kangxi: 大也)~~, stout~~; long (Kangxi: 長也)~~, large~~; to receive and act upon, endued with (Kangxi: 承也奉也行也); to act, to perform, to implement (Kangxi: 將行也); to progress, ~~to increase,~~ to approach, to advance (Kangxi: 進也) ~~towards a mark~~; to follow (Kangxi: 從也隨也); going, passing, as time (Kangxi: 去也 etc.); the side (Kangxi: 側也); _(1)ts(e/)ung (4)loi_ (zoeng1 loi4 將來) presently; _(1)ts(e/)ung (2)sz'_ (zoeng1 si2 將死) dying; _(1)ts(e/)ung kan(6) (a/)n(3) chau(3)_ (zoeng1 gan6 aan3 zau3 將近晏晝) it is nearly noon; _(1)ts(e/)ung (2)ho ch(')ut(7)_ (zoeng1 ho2 ceot1 將可出) then he can go; _(1)ts(e/)ung (1)kwan_ (zoeng1 gwan1 將軍), a commander-in-chief, all of whom are Manchus; _met._ the best, the principal; _(1)ts(e/)ung (4)(u (1)ch(i/) (4)ho_ (zoeng1 jyu4 zi1 ho4 將如之何), how shall we then act? _(1)ts(e/)ung (4)loi (1)ch(')ung (1)kung_ (zoeng1 loi4 cung1 gung1 將來充公), to confiscate effects; _(1)ts(e/)ung (1)kam pok(8) (2)p(o\)_ (zoeng1 gam1 bok3 bou2 將金博寶), to value a rarity with gold; _(1)ts(e/)ung (2)p(u/)n (4)k(')au l(i/)(6)_ (zoeng1 bun2 kau4 lei6 將本求利) to make money on a capital; _(1)sh(u (1)ts(e/)ung_ (syu1 zoeng1 輸將), to aid the government; _(1)ts(e/)ung (4)i(u/) (4)(i/)n (4)ch(')(un p(o\)(3)_ (zoeng1 jiu4 jin4 cyun4 bou3 將謠言傳布) to avail of strange words to make it known. Williams' "sometimes a form of the accusative": In the sense that 將 is used before the direct object of a verb so that the verb can be placed after the direct object. Williams' 將軍: In the non-Manchu context, a general; in Chinese chess, to check. Two of Williams' examples (將死, 將可出) are suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.15 (_Particles denoting Time_) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. Or (Kangxi: 抑然之辭). And, also (Kangxi: 且也). To support by holding (Kangxi: 扶持也). To provide for, to support (Kangxi: 養也). Strong, vigorous (Kangxi: 壯也). To recuperate. (_Chinese chess_) Short for 將軍 (to check). 【將-level】 (tsjang) (_verb-like_) to bring (forth), to take (_verb-like_) to escort (_verb-like_) to support (forth), to push (forth) (_verb-like_) to perform (_verb-like_) to advance (_verb-like_) shall, to intend (to) (_adverb-like_) about (to) (_conjunction-like_) and, (_met._) both (_conjunction-like_) or (_adjective-like_) great (_adjective-like_) strong, vigorous (_adjective-like_) long (_verb-like_) to go (_noun-like_) side

zoeng3.text: U+5C07 将 (Mainland simplified) (F1.93 將) 將帥統兵之官也 (Page 566 #7: 將(3)) To take charge of troops, to lead troops into the field, to act as a general (Kangxi: 將之也); a general, a leader (Kangxi: 將帥也); _~~(2)l(o\)~~ (5)l(o\) ts(e/)ung(3)_ (lou5 zoeng3 老將) an old soldier, a veteran. Williams' 老將: Corrected _(2)l(o\)_ (lou2) to _(5)l(o\)_ (lou5). 【將-departing】 (tsjangH) (_verb-like_) to command, to lead (_noun-like_) commander, general

coeng1.text: U+220D1 (F1.90 ⿰巾昌) 披衣不帶曰𢃑 (Page 36|n79 #7: (1)~~帽~~𢃑) Williams misprints 𢃑 as 帽; here corrected. (The character 𢃑 appears correctly on Page 758 in the character index.)

U+65A8 (F1.89 斨) 方銎斧也 (Page 567 #8: (1)斨) A sort of broad-ax (Kangxi: 斨卽斧也); a ~~pole-ax made square, a bill~~ square-eyed axe (Kangxi: 方銎斧也); to hack, to chop (Kangxi: 斨戕也); _(4)Sh(u (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (syu4 coeng1 殳斨), a statesman in the days of Shun (舜). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿺方丶 to 方, ⿱⿰工几金 to 銎, and 釜 to 斧. 【斨】 (tshjang) (_noun-like_) square-eyed-axe

U+660C (F1.90 昌) 盛也顯也善也 (Page 35|n78 #8: (1)昌) Light of the sun (Kangxi: 一曰日光也); fine words (Kangxi: 美言也); elegant, flourishing, prosperous (Kangxi: 盛也, 昌盛壯貌); increasing in wealth or peace; powerful; effulgent; good (Kangxi: 當也, 昌狡好貌); rich, affluent; to increase; ~~to illuminate~~ a thing (Kangxi: 物也); _(1)ch(')(e/)ung shing(6)_ (coeng1 sing6 昌盛) prosperous, well-off; _kat(7) (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gat1 coeng1 吉昌), happy, successful; _shun(6) (1)t(')(i/)n (2)ch(e/) (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (seon6 tin1 ze2 coeng1 順天者昌), he will prosper who obeys heaven; _(1)kwong (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gwong1 coeng1 光昌), splendid, gay. A surname. 【昌】 (tsyhang) (_adjective-like_) splendid (_adjective-like_) flourishing, abundant
U+7255 May appear as either ⿰片⿱囪心 or ⿰片⿱囱心 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.90 窓) 高曰窓低曰牗 (F1.90 牕) 同上 (Page 36|n79 #6: (1)窓(1)窗(1)牕)

U+7316 倡 (F1.90 猖) 猖狂縱橫也 (Page 36|n79 #1: (1)猖) ~~A herd of animals fleeing;~~ _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)kw(')ong_ (coeng1 kwong4 猖狂), ungovernable, unrestrained (Kangxi: 猖狂). (Page 36|n79 #2: (1)倡) used for the last (猖) (Kangxi 倡: 亦作猖) (...); Williams' "A herd of animals fleeing": This is a misreading of Kangxi 狂駭也.

U+7472 玱 (Mainland simplified) (Page 593 #10: (1)瑲 _(1)Ts(')ong_ (cong1); here corrected to _(1)Ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1)) a musical sound (Kangxi: 玉聲也, 一曰樂聲); _~~(1)ts(')ong (1)ts(')ong~~ (1)ts(')(e/)ung (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1 coeng1 瑲瑲), the jingling of stones. 【瑲】 (tshjang) (_onomatopoeia_) ting

cong1.text: U+7472 玱 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 瑲) 玉名 (Page 593 #10: (1)瑲) Color of gems (Kangxi: 玉色);

coeng1.text: U+7A97 May appear as either ⿱穴囪 (assumed here) or ⿱穴囱, depending on the font. 囪 囱 牎 牕 窓 䆫 窻 (F1.90 窓) 高曰窓低曰牗 (F1.90 牕) 同上 (Page 36|n79 #6: (1)窓(1)窗(1)牕) A window, an aperture to admit light (Kangxi 窗: 助戸爲明); a sash; a venetian blind, a shutter; a school; a student; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)m(u/)n_ (coeng1 mun4-2 窗門), a window; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (tin1 coeng1 天窗), a sky-light; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)m(u/)n ~~(5)ch(')(a/)n~~ (5)ch(')(a/)m_ (coeng1 mun4-2 caam5 窗門棖), a window-sill; _(1)sh(u (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (syu1 coeng1 書窗), or _(1)kai (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gai1 coeng1 雞窗), a schoolroom; _t(')ong(3) (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (tong3 coeng1 摥窗), to pull the sash to; _(4)hon (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (hon4 coeng1 寒窗), a poor student; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (a/)t(8)_ (coeng1 aat3 窗壓) a window-bar; _(4)t(')ung (1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (tung4 coeng1 同窗), or _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (5)yau_ (coeng1 jau5 窗友), chums, fellow-students; _(1)ch(')(e/)ung h(a/)(6)_ (coeng1 haa6 窗下) at school, while at his studies. Williams' "sash": In the sense of the sliding panel in a sash window. Williams' 窗門棖: Changed uncommon reading _(5)ch(')(a/)n_ (caan5) to _(5)ch(')(a/)m_ (caam5). 【窗】 (tsrhaewng) (_noun-like_) window
U+7ABB May appear as either ⿱穴⿱囪心 or ⿱穴⿱囱心 (assumed here), depending on the font.

U+83D6 (F1.90 菖) 菖蒲草名 (Page 36|n79 #4: (1)菖) The flag _(Acorus)_ (Kangxi: 菖蒲蒲類之昌盛者)_;_ _(1)ch(')(e/)ung (4)p(')(o\)_ (coeng1 pou4 菖蒲), sweet flag, hung on door lintels to drive away maleficent influences.

U+88EE 𢃑 (F1.90 𢃑) 披衣不帶曰𢃑 (Page 36|n79 #7: (1)~~帽~~𢃑; here normalised to 裮) Loose flowing garments thrown on one without a cincture (Kangxi 裮: 披裮, 披衣不帶也). Williams misprints 𢃑 as 帽; here corrected. (The character 𢃑 appears correctly on Page 758 in the character index.)

U+8E4C 蹡 跄 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 蹌) 動也 (Page 567 #3: (1)蹌) To walk rapidly (Kangxi: 恐動趨步, 蹌巧趨貌); to move ~~towards a superior quickly~~ dignifiedly (Kangxi: 士大夫之威儀也); to gambol, to skip about (Kangxi: 舞貌). (Page 567 #4: (1)蹡) Similar to the preceding (蹌); 【蹌】 (tshjang) (_verb-like_) to move, to fleet, (_met._) dignified

coeng3.text: U+8E61 蹌 (Page 567 #4: (1)蹡 _(1)Ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1); here corrected to _Ts(')(e/)ung(3)_ (coeng3)) to move irregularly, to go across, to walk awry (Kangxi: 同蹌行不正貌).

coeng1.text: U+93D8 鎗 锵 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 鏘) 鏗鏘鐘鼓之聲 (Page 567 #5: (1)鏘) The sound of stones, bells and drums (Kangxi: 玉聲也一曰樂聲); a noise (Kangxi: 鏘聲也); a tinkling; _(1)hang (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (hang1 coeng1 鏗鏘), the ring of metallic things. (Page 567 #6: (1)鎗) Interchanged with the last (鏘); 【鏘】 (tshjang) (_onomatopoeia_) ting

U+95B6 阊 (Mainland simplified) (F1.90 閶) 閶闔天門也 (Page 36|n79 #5: (1)閶) The door of heaven (Kangxi: 天門也); a gate of S(u/)chau (蘇州); _(1)ch(')(e/)ung h(o\)p(9)_ (coeng1 hap6 閶闔) door of paradise, kept by Kw(a/)nt(i/) (關帝) or Mars.

U+9BE7 䱽 鲳 (Mainland simplified) Effectively, 鯧 and 䱽 are the same semantic word "pomfret", but: 鯧 is classical with reading _(1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1); and 䱽 is vernacular with reading _(1)ts(')ong_ (cong1) (see 䱽 cong1). The pomfret (Kangxi: 鯧鯸魚名, 閩人譌爲䱽魚).

U+9DAC 鸧 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 鶬) 鞗革聲之和也又音倉鶬鶊鳥名 Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱𥫗革 to 鞗 and corrected ⿰肛鳥 to 鶊. (_onomatopoeia_) The sound of harmonising tinkling (Kangxi: 聲和也). Adorned with metal (Kangxi: 金飾貌). 【鶬-onomatopoeia】 (tshjang) (_onomatopoeia_) ting

cong1.text: U+9DAC 倉 鸧 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 鶬) 鶬鶊鳥名 (Page 594 #3: (1)鶬) A kind of crane (Kangxi: 今呼鶬鴰, 鶬大如鶴), plumage ashcolored (Kangxi: 靑蒼色亦有灰色者), and cheeks red (Kangxi: 兩頰紅); _(1)ts(')ong ~~k(u/)t(8)~~ k(')(u/)t(8)_ (cong1 kut3 鶬鴰) the black crane, called _(4)t(')(i/)n (1)tam (1)kai_ (tin4 dam1 gai1 田揼雞), or field tank hen. Williams' 鶬鴰: Changed _k(u/)t(8)_ (gut3) to common reading _k(')(u/)t(8)_ (kut3). Used in 鶬鶊 (oriole) (Kangxi: 鶬鶊鳥名本作倉). 【鶬-noun】 (tshang) (_noun-like_) crane Used in 鶬鶊. 【鶬鶊】 (tshang kaeng) (_noun-like_) oriole

coeng3.text: U+5531 (F1.93 唱) 歌唱 (Page 37|n80 #4: 唱(3)) To sing in recitative (Kangxi: 發歌也); to cry out, to give the word; to lead, to conduct, as singing (Kangxi: 導也); to crow; _(1)ts(')ing ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (cing1 coeng3 清唱) singing with a lute; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) (4)h(a/)m_ (coeng3 haam4 唱銜), to call out the titles, as at a levee; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) (1)ko_ (coeng3 go1 唱歌), to sing songs; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) (4)n(a/)m (4)ts(')z'_ (coeng3 naam4 ci4 唱南詞) to sing southern ditties, _ch(')(e/)ung(3) (1)pong (2)tsz' (1)hong_ (coeng3 bong1 zi2 hong1 唱梆子腔), theatrical singing; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) h(i/)(3)_ (coeng3 hei3 唱戲) to recite plays; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) muk(9) (4)(u_ (coeng3 muk6 jyu4-2 唱木魚), to sing in the Canton dialect. 【唱】 (tsyhangH) (_verb-like_) to lead song

zoeng3.text: U+60B5 怅 (Mainland simplified) coeng3 (per 《廣韻》丑亮切) (F1.92 悵) 惆悵 (Page 34|n77 #7: 悵(3)) Disappointment (Kangxi: 望恨也); vexed; _ch(e/)ung(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (zoeng3 zoeng3 悵悵) longed for; _ch(e/)ung(3) mong(6)_ (zoeng3 mong6 悵望) sick at heart from delayed hopes. 【悵】 (trhjangH) (_adjective-like_) disappointed

cong2.text: U+6636 㫤 (F1.98 昶) 日長也明也通也舒也 (Page 29* #3: (2)昶) A long day (Kangxi: 日長也); bright (Kangxi: 明久也), thorough (Kangxi: 通也), extended (Kangxi: 舒也);

coeng3.text: U+66A2 唱 (for Cantonese cash-breaking sense) 昶 㫤 畼 鬯 畅 (Mainland simplified) (F1.93 暢) 遂也通也達也 (Page 37|n80 #5: 暢(3)) ~~The inner qualities developing;~~ penetrating, thorough, spreading (Kangxi: 通暢又達也); to fill (Kangxi: 暢充也); joyous, contented, in good spirits; remote, long (Kangxi: 長也); exhilirating; joy; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) (ut(9)_ (coeng3 jyut6 暢月) the eleventh month; _f(a/)i(3) ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (faai3 coeng3 快暢) happy; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) t(a/)t(9)_ (coeng3 daat6 暢達) to permeate; _ch(')(e/)ung(3) mau(6)_ (coeng3 mau6 暢茂) flourishing. (Page 29* #3: (2)昶 _(2)Ch(')ong_ (cong2); _Ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (coeng3) implied) Interchanged with 暢 (Kangxi 昶: 昶與暢同). filled. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 逹 to 達. Williams' "The inner qualities developing": This is a misreading of Kangxi 《易坤卦》美在其中而暢於四支《疏》有美在中必通暢於外 as a definition, when it is actually an example. 【暢】 (trhjangH) (_verb-like_) to permeate 【暢】 (coeng3) To exchange cash so as to break it up. 暢錢 (coeng3 cin4-2): "Break up cash." 暢散紙 (coeng3 saan2 zi2): "Exchange for smaller denominations." 暢散張廿蚊 (coeng3 saan2 zoeng1 jaa6 man1): "Break up the twenty-buck note." The spelling 暢 is arbitrary.
U+97D4 鬯 (F1.93 韔) 弓囊也 (Page 37|n80 #3: 韔(3)) A bow case (Kangxi: 弓衣也); to put a bow into its case (Kangxi: 韔韜也). 【韔】 (trhjangH) (_noun-like_) bow-case

U+9B2F (F1.93 鬯) 用秬黍爲酒以香草和之爲鬯 (Page 37|n80 #6: 鬯(3)) Sacrificial spirits, made by infusing millet and fragrant herbs (Kangxi: 以秬釀𩰪艸芬芳條暢以降神也, 鬯香酒奉宗廟之盛也); mixed wine; _k(u(6) ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (geoi6 coeng3 秬鬯) odoriferous spirits; _(2)ch(u ch(')(e/)ung(3)_ (zyu2 coeng3 主鬯) a man who prepares the libations. The 192nd radical (U+2FBF ⾿ "sacrificial-wine"). 【鬯】 (trhjangH) (_noun-like_) fragrant-wine

coeng4.text: U+5834 塲 场 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 塲) 祭神之所築塲爲壇除地爲塲又疆場 (Page 37|n80 #1: (4)塲; here normalised to 場) An arena (Kangxi 場: 戰爭之地曰戰場), an area, a lot, a field (Kangxi 場: 收禾圃曰場); an altar, a sacrificial ground (Kangxi 場: 祭神道也); a playhouse; the society of, a company; a classifier of affairs; a fit, a spell; _(2)t(a/) t(a/)i(6) (4)ch(')(e/)ung (5)k(')(u_ (daa2 daai6 coeng4 keoi5 打大場佢), give him a sound drubbing; _ch(i/)n(3) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (zin3 coeng4 戰場) field of battle; _uk(7) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (uk1 coeng4 屋場), a building lot; _(1)k(u/)n (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gun1 coeng4 官場), the fashion of officials; _k(a/)u(3) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gaau3 coeng4 校場), a paradeground; _f(a/)t(8) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (faat3 coeng4 法場), execution-ground; _(4)t(')(a/)n (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (taan4 coeng4 壇場), an altar; _t(')i(u/)(3) ch(')ut(7) ~~(4)sh(i/)~~ sh(i/)(6) (1)f(i/) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (tiu3 ceot1 si6 fei1 coeng4 跳出是非場), I'll have nothing more to do with it; _(1)hoi (1)t(')(a/)n (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (hoi1 taan1 coeng4 開攤場), to open a gambling-house; _yap(9) (1)fo (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (jap6 fo1 coeng4 入科場), to enter the lists for a degree of _k(ujin_ (舉人)_;_ _(1)k(u/)n (5)h(a/) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gun1 haa5 coeng4 觀吓場), made a trial; in the examination; _(4)man (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (man4 coeng4 文場), resorts of students; trials for degrees; _(4)t(')au (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (tau4 coeng4 頭場), the first trial; _lok(9) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (lok6 coeng4 落場), to go to the gambling-table; _yat(7) (4)ch(')(e/)ung (2)h(o\) (1)sam_ (jat1 coeng4 hou2 sam1 一場好心), a good action; _t(a/)i(6) mung(6) yat(7) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (daai6 mung6 jat1 coeng4 大夢一場), a great dream, life. Williams' 跳出是非場: Corrected _(4)sh(i/)_ (si4) to _sh(i/)(6)_ (si6). 【場】 (drjang) (_noun-like_) arena (_noun-like_) field
U+5872 (F1.91 塲) 祭神之所築塲爲壇除地爲塲又疆場 (Page 37|n80 #1: (4)塲)
U+58BB (F1.91 牆) 卑曰垣高曰牆 (F1.91 墻) 同上 (Page 568 #3: (4)牆(4)墻)
U+5B19 嫱 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 嬙) 嬪嬙女官名 (Page 568 #4: (4)嬙) Female officers in the imperial hareem (Kangxi: 嬪嬙婦官名); _pan(3) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (ban3 coeng4 嬪嬙), a lady of the bedchamber.

U+5EA0 (F1.91 庠) 學宮名以養老爲義 (Page 567 #9: (4)庠) An asylum for aged people in ancient times (Kangxi: 禮官養老處也), a village school, a college, a gymnasium, an academy (Kangxi: 上庠右學大學也下庠左學小學也); to teach (Kangxi: 庠者養也); _(4)ts(')(e/)ung (1)shang_ (coeng4 sang1 庠生), a si(u/)ts(')(a/)i (秀才); _tsun(3) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (zeon3 coeng4 進庠), to become a si(u/)ts(')(a/)i (秀才); _yap(7) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (jap1 coeng4 邑庠), the graduates of a district. 【庠】 (zjang) (_noun-like_) academy

U+6215 (F1.91 戕) 傷也害也 (Page 568 #2: (4)戕) ~~A spear, a wooden lance;~~ to kill; ~~to rob,~~ to maltreat (Kangxi: 槍也, 戕者卒暴之名); _(4)ts(')(e/)ung (1)sh(e/)ung_ (coeng4 soeng1 戕傷), to wound; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung ts(')(a/)k(9)_ (coeng4 caak6 戕賊) to kill ~~and rob~~ or injure. Williams' "A spear, a wooden lance": This is a misreading of Kangxi 槍也. According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》 (which has 搶也 originally), the intended meaning is 槍者歫也歫謂相抵爲害 (to do harm by collision), with an annotation of the Classic of Poetry reading 戕殘也 (to harm cruelly). 【戕】 (dzjang) (_verb-like_) to kill, to brutalise

zong1.text: U+6215 (Page 568 #2: (4)戕 _(4)Ts(')(e/)ung_ (coeng4); here corrected to _(1)Tsong_ (zong1)) a post (Kangxi: 戕戙𣏾也);

coeng4.text: U+6AA3 艢 樯 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 檣) 船桅也 (Page 568 #5: (4)檣) A mast, any spar or mast which sustains the sails (Kangxi: 船檣帆柱也); _(4)f(a/)n (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (faan4 coeng4 帆檣), masts and sails.

U+7246 墻 廧 墙 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 牆) 卑曰垣高曰牆 (F1.91 墻) 同上 (Page 568 #3: (4)牆(4)墻) A wall made of stone, brick, or mud (Kangxi 牆: 垣蔽也, 牆謂之墉); a defense or wall (Kangxi 牆: 牆所以防非常); _(1)ch(un (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (zyun1 coeng4 磚牆), a brick wall; _(4)nai (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (nai4 coeng4 泥牆), an adobie wall; _chuk(7) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (zuk1 coeng4 築牆), to build a wall; _tong(6) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (dong6 coeng4 盪牆), to plaster a wall; _m(i/)(6) (2)shui (1)chung (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (mei6 seoi2 zung1 coeng4 寐水舂牆), to crawl under water, and build a wall, _met._ hard labor; _(1)ti(u/) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (diu1 coeng4 雕牆), to adorn and paint a wall; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung pik(7)_ (coeng4 bik1 牆壁) a wall; _yat(7) (4)t(')i(u/) (4)ts(')(e/)ung kwo(3)_ (jat1 tiu4 coeng4 gwo3 一條牆過) a single back wall for several houses. 【牆】 (dzjang) (_noun-like_) wall

U+7965 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. 羊 (F1.91 祥) 祥瑞言祥禍也善也又喪服有大祥小祥謂除凶從吉也 (Page 567 #10: (4)祥) Happiness, felicity, fortune (Kangxi: 福也), goodness (Kangxi: 一云善也); an omen, a sign, a prognostic (Kangxi: 凡吉凶之兆皆曰祥, 祥詳也, 祥者善惡之徵); _(4)ts(')(e/)ung sui(6)_ (coeng4 seoi6 祥瑞) lucky omens; _kat(7) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (gat1 coeng4 吉祥), a happy sign; _(2)si(u/) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (siu2 coeng4 小祥) and _t(a/)i(6) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (daai6 coeng4 大祥), are the sacrifices to ancestors at the end of one and two years, when the mourning is altered (Kangxi: 祭名 etc.); _pat(7) (4)ts(')(e/)ung (1)ch(i/) ~~chi(u/)(6)~~ shi(u/)(6)_ (bat1 coeng4 zi1 siu6 不祥之兆) a most unlucky omen; _(4)ts(')z' (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (ci4 coeng4 慈祥), kind-hearted. Williams' 不祥之兆: Changed _chi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) to common reading _shi(u/)(6)_ (siu6). 【祥】 (zjang) (_adjective-like_) auspicious (_noun-like_) auspice

U+7FD4 (F1.91 翔) 翺翔飛也 (Page 568 #1: (4)翔) To soar, to hover over (Kangxi: 回飛也); to look back (Kangxi: 翔廻顧也); dignified, severe, stern (Kangxi: 莊敬貌); _(4)(u/)i (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (wui4 coeng4 回翔), to look back regretfully. 【翔】 (zjang) (_verb-like_) to fly about, to soar

U+8178 膓 肠 (Mainland simplified) coeng4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.91 腸) 腸臟 (Page 36|n79 #10: (4)腸) The bowels (Kangxi: 大小腸藏府之二名也); the intestines; tripe; _met._ the feelings, the affections; _(4)w(a/)ng (1)(a/) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (waang4 aa1 coeng4-2 橫丫腸), cunning; _(2)h(o\) (4)ch(')(e/)ung (5)t(')(o\)_ (hou2 coeng4 tou5 好腸肚), clever, learned; _si(u/)(3) (1)l(un (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (siu3 lyun1 coeng4-2 笑攣腸), laughed till his side ached; _chik(9) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (zik6 coeng4 直腸), honest, trustworthy; _(4)ngau (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (ngau4 coeng4-2 牛腸), tripe; _t(a/)i(6) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (daai6 coeng4-2 大腸), the colon; _(2)si(u/) (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (siu2 coeng4-2 小腸), lesser intestines; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung tsong(6)_ (coeng4 zong6 腸臟) the intestines, the inwards; _(1)sam (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (sam1 coeng4 心腸), the disposition, feelings; _(4)m(o\) (4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)kung (2)tsz'_ (mou4 coeng4 gung1 zi2 無腸公子) a crab. Williams' "tripe", 牛腸: Only tripe in the sense of entrails (specifically the intestines). 【腸】 (drjang) (_noun-like_) bowel 【腸】 (coeng4-2) Short for 腸粉 (cheung fan). 蝦腸 (haa1 coeng4-2): "Prawn rice-noodle rolls." 齋腸 (zaai1 coeng4-2): "Plain rice-noodle rolls." 【腸粉】 (coeng4-2 fan2) Rice-noodle rolls. 【豬腸粉】 (zyu1 coeng4 fan2) Rice-noodle rolls, especially the tighter-rolled street food variant (smaller radius with no filling).

U+8407 苌 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 萇) 萇楚今羊桃也 (Page 36|n79 #9: (4)萇) A sort of fruit, the carambola _(Averrhoa)_ (Kangxi: 萇楚, 今羊桃也), also called the _(4)y(e/)ung (4)t(')(o\)_ (joeng4 tou4 羊桃), or sheep's peach. 【萇】 (drjang) Used in 萇楚. 【萇楚】 (drjang tsrhjoX) (_noun-like_) carambola
U+8594 蔷 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 薔) 薔薇花名 (Page 568 #6: (4)薔) A rose; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung (4)m(i/) (1)f(a/)_ (coeng4 mei4 faa1 薔薇花), the cinnamon rose.

U+8A73 祥 详 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 詳) 詳備詳悉細密也 (Page 567 #11: (4)詳) To examine carefully, to learn and report upon, to inquire fully into (Kangxi: 審議也); to discourse upon (Kangxi: 論也), to reason upon (Kangxi: 諟也); to state the circumstances, to minutely narrate (Kangxi: 詳言之也, 詳悉也); the detail, the particulars, the facts, the arguments; minutely, fully; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung (5)h(a/)_ (coeng4 haa5 詳吓), examine into it; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung sai(3) (2)kong_ (coeng4 sai3 gong2 詳細講), told every particular; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung (4)man_ (coeng4 man4 詳文), an official report; _(4)'m (1)ch(i/) (4)ts(')(e/)ung sai(3)_ (m4 zi1 coeng4 sai3 唔知詳細) I don't know all the facts; _(4)ts(')(e/)ung sik(7)_ (coeng4 sik1 詳悉) a luminous account of, intelligible. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰亻⿱十用 to 備. 【詳】 (zjang) (_verb-like_) to scrutinise (_adjective-like_) detailed (_verb-like_) to detail, to elaborate

U+9577 仧 兏 镸 长 (Mainland simplified) coeng4-2 (rising second in vernacular 長長地) (F1.91 長) 長久永遠也 (Page 36|n79 #8: (4)長) Long in time (Kangxi: 久也) or distance (Kangxi: 短之對也), far off (Kangxi: 遠也); constantly, regularly (Kangxi: 常也); always, continual; superiors (Kangxi: 長弟猶云先後也); skilled, used to, practiced; direct, straight; the 168th radical (U+2FA7 ⾧ "long"); _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (5)(un_ (coeng4 jyun5 長遠), durable; _kok(8) (5)yau (2)sho (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (gok3 jau5 so2 coeng4 各有所長), in what each excels; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung kwo(3) (4)t(')au_ (coeng4 gwo3 tau4 長過頭), too long; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)shang_ (coeng4 sang1 長生) long life; a coffin; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (4)sh(i/) yung(6)_ (coeng4 si4 jung6 長時用) in constant use; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (2)kau_ (coeng4 gau2 長久), old, a long time; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung h(i/)(3)_ (coeng4 hei3 長氣) longwinded, as a talker; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (4)hung_ (coeng4 hung4 長紅), a hand-bill; _yat(7) (4)m(o\) (2)sho (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (jat1 mou4 so2 coeng4 一無所長), changeful, not persevering; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (2)kau (2)fo k(i/)(3)_ (coeng4 gau2 fo2 gei3 長久伙記) an old comrade; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)shang pat(7) (5)l(o\)_ (coeng4 sang1 bat1 lou5 長生不老), ~~a green old age~~ immortal; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (5)(un shai(3) k(a/)i(3)_ (coeng4 jyun5 sai3 gaai3 長遠世界) long continued, as a family; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (2)t(un_ (coeng4 dyun2 長短), the length of, the traits of character; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)k(')(u_ (coeng4 keoi1 長驅), go directly there. 【長-level】 (drjang) (_adjective-like_) long, (_met._) everlasting 【長氣】 (coeng4 hei3) Long-winded. 咪咁長氣啦 (mai5 gam3 coeng4 hei3 la1): "Don't be so long-winded!"

zoeng2.text: U+9577 仧 兏 镸 长 (Mainland simplified) (F1.91 長) 尊也大也 (Page 34|n77 #6: (2)長) Old, senior, superior, greater (Kangxi: 長雄長之長); to excel, to increase (Kangxi: 進也); to grow (Kangxi: 生長也), to extend, to advance; to prosper; to elevate, to think highly of; an elder (Kangxi: 齒高也), a superior (Kangxi: 位高也); _(2)p(o\) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (bou2 zoeng2 保長), a constable; _(1)k(a/) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (gaa1 zoeng2 家長), a paterfamilias; _(5)ngo (2)kau (2)ch(e/)ung (5)n(i/)_ (ngo5 gau2 zoeng2 nei5 我久長你), I'm somewhat older than you; _kwai(3) (1)kang (1)to (2)ch(e/)ung_ (gwai3 gang1 do1 zoeng2 貴庚多長), how old are you? _(2)fo (2)ch(e/)ung_ (fo2 zoeng2 伙長), mates in a ship; _(2)ch(e/)ung t(a/)i(6)_ (zoeng2 daai6 長大) to grow older; _(2)ch(e/)ung (2)tsz'_ (zoeng2 zi2 長子) or _(2)ch(e/)ung (4)fong_ (zoeng2 fong4 長房), the eldest son and his household; _(2)ch(e/)ung (5)l(o\)_ (zoeng2 lou5 長老), a Budhist priest; _(1)ts(un (2)ch(e/)ung_ (zyun1 zoeng2 尊長) or _(2)ch(e/)ung (2)ch(e/)_ (zoeng2 ze2 長者), an old man; _(4)n(i/)n (2)ch(e/)ung_ (nin4 zoeng2 年長), old, older; _pat(7) (2)ch(e/)ung tsun(3)_ (bat1 zoeng2 zeon3 不長進) ~~untrustworthy~~ unimproving, not progressing. Used in 長孫 (a compound surname). 【長-rising】 (trjangX) (_verb-like_) to grow (_noun-like_) elder, leader (_verb-like_) to lead

zoeng6.text: U+9577 长 (Mainland simplified) Excess or surplus (Kangxi: 餘也, 多也宂也剰也). 【長-departing】 (drjangH) (_adjective-like_) surplus

coi1.text: U+554B (Page 590 #1: (1)啋) A colloquial word. An interjection of contempt, tush! pish! to pish at; _(1)ts(')oi, f(a/)t(8) ng(a/)m(6) w(a/)(6) (1)m(e/)_ (coi1, faat3 ngaam6 waa6-2 me1 啋、發譫話咩), pshaw, what a lie! said by women; _(1)ts(')oi, (1)wan (5)n(i/)_ (coi1 wan1 nei5 啋瘟你), pox take you! 【啋】 (coi1) An interjection of rebuke for mentioning a bad or inauspicious outcome. 啋 (coi1): "Pish!" 啋過你 (coi1 gwo3 nei5): "Pish unto you for saying that!" The spelling 啋 is arbitrary (but well established). It is unclear if Kangxi 倉來切音猜語辭俗也 is a coincidence.

coi2.text: U+5BC0 采 (F2.45 寀) 寮寀 (Page 591 #2: (2)寀) Lands or cities allotted for the revenue of officers (Kangxi: 謂寀地); _(2)ts(')oi t(i/)(6)_ (coi2 dei6 寀地) territory set apart for grandees; _(4)li(u/) (2)ts(')oi_ (liu4 coi2 寮寀), officers exercising jurisdiction over the same circuit (Kangxi: 寀寮官也, 官地爲寀同官爲寮). Strictly speaking, 寀 refers to the fief-*holder*, rather than the fief itself. See commentary at 埰 coi3.

U+5F69 采 (F2.44 彩) 光彩 (Page 591 #3: (2)彩) Variegated, mixed or ornamented with different colors; elegant, gay, colored; beautiful, as the figures in silks or gems (Kangxi: 文章也); lucky, pleased; _(1)kwong (2)ts(')oi_ (gwong1 coi2 光彩), brilliant; smooth, as a shaven head; _(2)h(o\) (2)ts(')oi_ (hou2 coi2 好彩), fortunate, a good chance; _(5)m(o\) (2)ts(')oi_ (mou5 coi2 冇彩), unlucky, unprosperous; _(2)lo (2)ts(')oi_ (lo2 coi2 攞彩), to get eclat, as actors do; _hot(8) (2)ts(')oi_ (hot3 coi2 喝彩), to clap, to encore actors; _(1)kam (1)f(a/) (2)ts(')oi (4)hung_ (gam1 faa1 coi2 hung4 金花彩紅), tinsel and red silk, such as is used on joyful occasions; _(2)h(i/) ~~kwo(3)~~ ko(3) (2)ts(')oi_ (hei2 go3 coi2 起個彩), let us have a rejoicing, as after one is out of prison; _t(ut(9) (2)ts(')oi_ (dyut6 coi2 奪彩), to get to the goal, to win the praise; _(2)ts(')oi (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (coi2 cin4 彩錢), the winner's douceur, the lucky man's present; _(2)ts(')oi (4)k(')(i/)_ (coi2 kei4 彩旗), variegated banners, as those used at weddings; _(5)'ng (2)ts(')oi_ (ng5 coi2 五彩), variegated, colored. Williams' 起個彩: Corrected _kwo(3)_ (gwo3) to _ko(3)_ (go3). 【彩】 (tshojX) (_noun-like_) colour, variegation, brilliance 【彩數】 (coi2 sou3) Luck, fortune. 【好彩】 (hou2 coi2) Lucky, fortunate. 好彩冇落雨 (hou2 coi2 mou5 lok6 jyu5): "Fortunately it didn't rain." 唔好彩 (m4 hou2 coi2): "Unlucky."

U+63A1 采 (F2.44 採) 取也 (Page 591 #1: (2)採) To select, to choose, to pick, to pluck, as leaves (Kangxi: 摘也取也㩜也); to take with the hand; _(2)ts(')oi (1)song_ (coi2 song1 採桑), to pick mulberry leaves; _(2)ts(')oi (5)m(a/)i_ (coi2 maai5 採買), to buy the choicest; _(2)ts(')oi (1)f(a/)_ (coi2 faa1 採花), to gather flowers. 【採】 (tshojX) (_verb-like_) to pick

U+68CC coi3 (per 《廣韻》倉代切) (F2.45 棌) 木名 (Page 591 #5: (2)棌) A sort of tree (Kangxi: 槲也), whose wood is hard and durable, like that of the chestnut or locust. The reading _(2)ts(')oi_ (coi2) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 此宰切, explained 木也 with example 漢書唐虞棌椽.

U+776C 倸 採 (Page 591 #6: (2)睬) To pay attention to, to notice, to greet (Kangxi: 偢睬俗言也); _(4)'m (1)ts(')au (4)'m (2)ts(')oi_ (m4 cau1 m4 coi2 唔瞅唔睬) the cut direct, not to recognize; _(4)'m (2)ts(')oi_ (m4 coi2 唔睬), not to acknowledge.

U+7DB5 彩 (F2.44 綵) 文色也繪也 (Page 591 #4: (2)綵) Interchanged with the last (彩). Variegated, colored silk (Kangxi: 五綵備); particolored; _k(i/)t(8) (2)ts(')oi_ (git3 coi2 結綵), or _kw(a/)(3) (2)ts(')oi (4)ch(')au_ (gwaa3 coi2 cau4 掛綵綢), to hang festoons of silk, as is done at the _(2)t(a/) tsi(u/)(3)_ (daa2 ziu3 打醮)_;_ _(2)ts(')oi (4)k(')au_ (coi2 kau4 綵球), a many colored ball; _(4)ling (2)ts(')oi_ (ling4 coi2 綾綵), colored sarsnet, used for linings. 【綵】 (tshojX) (_noun-like_) colourful-silk

U+91C7 (F2.44 采) 文采又采取 (Page 590 #7: (2)采) To be distinguished from 釆 _p(i/)n(6)_ (bin6) to divide. To pluck, to choose, to take with the hand (Kangxi: 捋取也, 擇也); variegated, adorned with colors (Kangxi: 采色, 物采); cities allotted to officers for revenue (Kangxi: 采地); in these senses the three next (採, 寀, 彩) are used; ~~a business, an employment;~~ _(2)ts(')oi ~~yap(9)~~ yap(7)_ (coi2 jap1 采邑) territory set apart for the support of grandees, an ancient usage; _n(a/)p(9) (2)ts(')oi_ (naap6 coi2 納采), to choose and send the betrothal presents. Williams' 采邑: Corrected _yap(9)_ (jap6) to _yap(7)_ (jap1). See commentary at 埰 coi3 on the reading of 采.

coi3.text: U+57F0 采 coi2 (per 《集韻》此宰切 for "mound" sense and alternative per Kangxi 倉宰切 for "fief" sense spelt 采) Note that "fief" spelt 采 is recorded in Kangxi under *both* rising _(2)ts(')oi_ (coi2) and departing _ts(')oi(3)_ (coi3): 《康熙字典》采 《唐韻》倉宰切《集韻》《韻會》此宰切𠀤音採...又采地《禮禮運》大夫有采以處其子孫《前漢地理志》大夫韓武子食采於韓原...又《韻會》《正韻》𠀤倉代切音菜臣食邑《周禮天官八則註》公卿大夫采邑音菜《孟子元士受地視子男註》所受采地之制音菜《前漢食貨志註》采官也因官食地故曰采地... The confusion stems from the fact that 采 is used for both: Rising-tone 寀 _(2)ts(')oi_ (coi2) "fief-holder" (see 寀 coi2); and Departing-tone 埰 _ts(')oi(3)_ (coi3) "fief". As a result, the term 采地 can be interpreted as either "fief-holder's land" (采 rising) or "fief-land" (采 departing). A fief (Kangxi: 采地也). A mound (Kangxi: 冢或謂之埰).

U+585E (F2.45 塞 _Soi(3)_ (soi3)) 邊界也 (Page 591 #9: 塞(3)) A boundary, a frontier, a limit (Kangxi: 邊界也); _ch(')ut(7) ts(')oi(3)_ (ceot1 coi3 出塞) to travel abroad; _ts(')oi(3) ngoi(6)_ (coi3 ngoi6 塞外) beyond the frontier. 【塞】 (sojH) (_noun-like_) frontier

U+83DC 采 (F2.45 菜) 蔬菜 (Page 591 #7: 菜(3)) Vegetables, edible herbs, greens (Kangxi: 草之可食者, 蔬也); food, viands; _(2)h(o\) ts(')oi(3)_ (hou2 coi3 好菜) good eating; _(1)ts(')eng ts(')oi(3)_ (ceng1 coi3 青菜) greens in general; _sung(3) ts(')oi(3)_ (sung3 coi3 餸菜) dishes on the table, not rice; _ts(')oi(3) shik(7)_ (coi3 sik1 菜色) lank, half starved, like one who has lived on greens (Kangxi: 食菜之饑色); _h(u(3) (5)m(a/)i ts(')oi(3)_ (heoi3 maai5 coi3 去買菜) gone to market; _p(a/)k(9) ts(')oi(3)_ (baak6 coi3 白菜) ~~broccoli,~~ the pehtsai (白菜); _(4)h(a/)m ts(')oi(3)_ (haam4 coi3 鹹菜) sour crout; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng ts(')oi(3)_ (saang1 coi3 生菜) lettuce; _(4)y(e/) ts(')oi(3)_ (je4 coi3 椰菜) cabbage; _t(a/)m(6) ts(')oi(3)_ (daam6 coi3 淡菜) a small kind of oyster; _ts(')oi(3) (4)yau_ (coi3 jau4 菜油), rape-seed oil; _(4)ng(a/) ts(')oi(3)_ (ngaa4 coi3 芽菜) bean sprouts; _ts(')oi(3) (1)f(a/)_ (coi3 faa1 菜花), a kind of rape of which the _ts(')oi(3) (4)yau_ (coi3 jau4 菜油), or herb oil, is pressed; _(2)si(u/) ts(')oi(3)_ (siu2 coi3 小菜) condiments of leaves and greens; _(2)hoi ts(')oi(3)_ (hoi2 coi3 海菜) seaweed; limpets. Williams' 生菜: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【菜】 (tshojH) (_noun-like_) vegetable 【菜】 (coi3) (_derogatory_, _objectification_) Girlfriend. 你條菜呢 (nei5 tiu4 coi3 ne1): "Where's your chick?"

U+8521 saat3 (per 《集韻》桑割切 for "banish" and "kill" senses) (F2.45 菜) 國名又大龜也又姓 (Page 591 #8: 蔡(3)) Grass, herbs, esculent herbs (Kangxi: 草也); ~~a law, a rule~~ punishment by banishment (Kangxi: 蔡法也); name of a feudal state, now J(u/)ning f(u/) (汝寧府) in the southeast of Hon(a/)n (河南). To put down, to kill. A great turtle (Kangxi: 蔡國君之守龜 etc.). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【蔡】 (sat) (_verb-like_) to banish, to put down

U+8CFD 赛 (Mainland simplified) (F2.45 賽 _Soi(3)_ (soi3)) 比併也又報賽 (Page 592 #1: 賽(3)) To recompense, to thank (Kangxi: 報也); to strive to surpass, to contest for, to emulate, to match; excelling, contesting; ~~to announce~~ a thank offering, to make an offering (Kangxi: 今俗報祭曰賽神); a show of; _ts(')oi(3) (1)tang_ (coi3 dang1 賽燈), to show lanterns, on the festival of lanterns, at 15th of 1st moon; _ts(')oi(3) (4)shan_ (coi3 san4 賽神), to get up religious processions; _ts(')oi(3) shik(7)_ (coi3 sik1 賽色) to show figures, to emulate in making a fine display in processions; _(2)t(o\) ts(')oi(3)_ (dou2 coi3 賭賽) to wager. Williams' "to announce": This is a misreading of 報 in Kangxi 今俗報祭曰賽神.

coi4.text: U+624D 材 財 coi4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun in 秀才) (F2.44 才) 能也功也畧也 (Page 590 #2: (4)才) talents, capacity, ability, powers (Kangxi: 一曰能也, 質也力也); endowments, genius, gifts; a person, a graduate; _(4)ts(')oi (2)tsz'_ (coi4 zi2 才子) a genius; _(4)man (4)ts(')oi_ (man4 coi4 文才), literary talents; _(1)s(a/)m (4)ts(')oi_ (saam1 coi4 三才), the three powers---are heaven, earth, man (Kangxi: 天地人爲三才), who rule all things; _yat(7) (2)pi(u/) (4)yan (4)ts(')oi_ (jat1 biu2 jan4 coi4 一表人才), a fine looking man; _(4)n(o\) (4)ts(')oi_ (nou4 coi4 奴才), a slave; _(4)ts(')oi k(u(6)_ (coi4 geoi6 才具) parts, talents; _(4)ts(')oi (4)nang_ (coi4 nang4 才能), ability; _(4)l(e/)ung (4)ts(')oi_ (loeng4 coi4 良才), goodness, rectitude; _(4)ts(')oi ch(i/)(3)_ (coi4 zi3 才智) talents and knowledge; _(2)ch(')un (4)ts(')oi_ (ceon2 coi4 蠢才), you goose! _(4)wai (4)ts(')oi_ (wai4 coi4 遺才), the unsuccessful si(u/)ts(')(a/)i (秀才); _(2)h(o\) (2)hau (4)ts(')oi_ (hou2 hau2 coi4 好口才), eloquent. 【才】 (dzoj) (_noun-like_) talent, capability

U+6750 才 財 (F2.44 材) 人之可用者曰賢材木之可用者曰材料 (Page 590 #2: (4)才) Materials, stuff, or the substance of things, for which the next (材) is used; (Page 590 #3: (4)材) Materials of which things are made (Kangxi: 五材金木水火土也 etc.); nature, qualities; timber, lumber, wood; materiel, stuff; _(4)ts(')oi li(u/)(6)_ (coi4 liu6-2 材料) materials, as wood, stone, &c.; ingredients; _(4)l(e/)ung (4)ts(')oi_ (loeng4 coi4 良材), good stuff; _met._ upright ministers; _(2)h(o\) (1)shan (4)ts(')oi_ (hou2 san1 coi4 好身材), likely, well formed; _(5)'ng (4)ts(')oi_ (ng5 coi4 五材), the five elements. 【材】 (dzoj) (_noun-like_) timber (_noun-like_) material

U+7E94 才 裁 財 (F2.44 纔) 暫也僅也又剛纔方纔 (F2.44 ？) 同上 (Page 590 #6: (4)纔) An adverb of time; near to, at hand, nearly reaching to; in a short time, thereupon, presently, then, just then, just now, scarcely (Kangxi: 僅也); _(1)fong (4)ts(')oi_ (fong1 coi4 方纔), then, a little while ago; _(4)ts(')oi (2)h(o\)_ (coi4 hou2 纔好), then it will do; _(4)ts(')oi h(u(3)_ (coi4 heoi3 纔去) just gone. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 謹 to 僅, and corrected 土 to 上.

U+88C1 才 財 (F2.44 裁) 裁衣又裁度裁製 (Page 590 #5: (4)裁) To make clothes, to cut out garments (Kangxi: 制衣也); to tear, to cut off (Kangxi: 裂也); to moderate, to reduce, to deny, to diminish (Kangxi: 節也); to guess, to plan; to regulate; _(4)ts(')oi (4)fung (2)l(o\)_ (coi4 fung4-2 lou2 裁縫佬), a tailor; _tsz'(6) (4)ts(')oi_ (zi6 coi4 自裁), suicide (Kangxi: 自裁自殺也); _(4)ts(')oi (1)(i/)_ (coi4 ji1 裁衣), to cut out clothes; _(4)ts(')oi (2)ts(i/)n_ (coi4 zin2 裁剪), to cut off with shears; _(2)si(u/) (4)ts(')oi_ (siu2 coi4 小裁) and _t(a/)i(6) (4)ts(')oi_ (daai6 coi4 大裁), a scant pattern, a full pattern. Williams' 自裁: Literally, to "self-resolve". To judge, to adjudicate, to make a ruling (Kangxi: 鑒別也). 【裁】 (dzoj) (_verb-like_) to cut, to tailor (_verb-like_) to rule (on), to resolve

U+8CA1 财 (Mainland simplified) (F2.44 財) 寶也又貨也 (Page 590 #4: (4)財) Wealth, riches, valuables, property, possessions, goods, whatever men can use (Kangxi: 人所寶也, 可入用者也, etc.); ~~profits;~~ ~~bribes;~~ presents (Kangxi: 賂也); _(4)ts(')oi (2)ch(u (2)l(o\)_ (coi4 zyu2 lou2 財主佬), a rich man; _(4)ts(')oi (1)tung_ (coi4 dung1 財東), a capitalist, a moneyed man; _k(')ap(7) (4)ts(')oi_ (kap1 coi4 吸財), quick at money making; _f(a/)t(8) (4)ts(')oi_ (faat3 coi4 發財), to get rich, to make money; _(1)t(')(i/)n (4)ts(')oi_ (tin1 coi4 天財), good luck, as a prize in a lottery; _(4)ts(')oi p(a/)k(9) (1)sing (1)kwan_ (coi4 baak6 sing1 gwan1 財帛星君), or _(4)ts(')oi (4)shan_ (coi4 san4 財神), god of wealth, Plutus, Mammon; _(1)t(')au (1)k(a/) (4)ts(')oi_ (tau1 gaa1 coi4 偷家財), a thief of a cook; _(4)ts(')oi (5)lai_ (coi4 lai5 財禮), presents, complimentary gifts; _p(')o(3) (4)ts(')oi (2)tong (1)tsoi_ (po3 coi4 dong2 zoi1 破財擋災), to lavish money to ward off (or remedy) calamity; _(4)ts(')oi (2)ho ~~(2)(i/)~~ (5)(i/) (1)t(')ung (4)shan_ (coi4 ho2 ji5 tung1 san4 財可以通神), money can move the gods; _(5)n(i/) (4)'m hai(6) (4)ts(')oi (4)shan_ (nei5 m4 hai6 coi4 san4 你唔係財神), you've bought nothing of me, you've given me no custom. Williams' "bribes": This is a misreading of Kangxi 賂也. Williams' 財可以通神: Corrected _(2)(i/)_ (ji2) to _(5)(i/)_ (ji5). 【財】 (dzoj) (_noun-like_) wealth

cok3.text: U+5252 錯 (for Cantonese "choppiness" and "jolt" senses) cok3-2 (rising second in vernacular 剒剒地) (Page 592 #8: 錯(8); here normalised to 剒) A colloquial word. A hacking in the throat, a difficulty or stoppage in the throat; _ts(')ok(8) h(i/)(3)_ (cok3 hei3 剒氣) the heart in the throat; _(1)ch(')au ts(')ok(8)_ (cau1 cok3 抽剒) a retching cough; _ts(')ok(8) ts(')ok(8) ngok(9) ngok(9)_ (cok3 cok3 ngok6 ngok6 剒剒愕愕) amazed, alarmed and amused. To work, to cut, to polish (Kangxi: 治樸之名, 亦作錯). To chop off. 【剒】 (cok3) Choppiness in the airways, unsmoothness in breathing. 剒住條氣 (cok3 zyu6 tiu4 hei3): "Choppiness in the airways." To shake, to jolt. 剒車 (cok3 ce1): "Jerking car." 剒散咗 (cok3 saan2 zo2): "Shaken to pieces." The spelling 剒 is arbitrary.

cou3.text: U+539D (F2.16 措 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 處置也安着也施布也又委置也 (F2.16 厝 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 同上又安頓也 (Page 587 #10: 厝(3)) ~~A large flat stone, fit for a gravestone;~~ to place (Kangxi: 厝置也), to put a body away properly; interchanged with the next (措) (Kangxi: 同措); _(1)on ts(')(o\)(3)_ (on1 cou3 安厝) to put a coffin in the grave or under a lodge; quietly reposing; _ts(')(o\)(3) ch(u(3)_ (cou3 zyu3 厝註) ~~to cut~~ an epitaph. Williams' "large flat stone, fit for a gravestone" and "to cut": Williams has conflated the "whetstone" sense of 厝, which should be read in entering tone _ts(')ok(8)_ (cok3), with the "placement" sense _ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3). Unlike the "placement" sense, the "whetstone" sense has no connotations with burial.

cong1.text: U+5009 仺 蒼 (in 倉皇 spelt 蒼黃) 仓 (Mainland simplified) cong2 (common in 倉卒) (F1.95 倉) 倉廪藏谷之所又倉皇言懼也 (Page 593 #7: (1)倉) A granary (Kangxi: 穀藏也) of the government; a storehouse; a box, a bin, a compartment, a pigeon-hole; _kuk(7) (1)ts(')ong_ (guk1 cong1 穀倉), a rice storehouse; _(1)ts(')ong (1)s(e/)ung_ (cong1 soeng1 倉箱), bins or partitions in a granary; _fo(3) (1)ts(')ong_ (fo3 cong1 貨倉), a pack-house, a go-down; _(1)hoi (1)ts(')ong_ (hoi1 cong1 開倉), to dispense rice from the granaries; _yat(7) (1)ts(')ong (1)ts(')ong_ (jat1 cong1 cong1 一倉倉), ~~one bin or stall~~ individual bins; _(1)ts(')ong ts(')(ut(8)_ (cong1 cyut3 倉卒) ~~flurried, perturbed, alarmed~~ hurried, hasty. (Page 593 #8: (1)蒼; here normalised to 倉) Occurs used for the last (倉), hastily; _(1)ts(')ong (4)wong_ (cong1 wong4 倉皇), hurried, flighty (Kangxi 蒼: 蒼黃急遽貌); 【倉】 (tshang) (_noun-like_) granary

U+5275 刅 刱 剏 剙 戧 创 (Mainland simplified) cong3 (common) (Page 28* #5: (1)創(1)刅) To wound, to cut and injure (Kangxi 創: 傷也); to butt, to gore; a wound, a cut; wounded, gashed; _(1)shan p(i/)(6) (1)to (1)ch(')ong_ (san1 bei6 do1 cong1 身被多創) he received many wounds. Whilst the classical reading for the "wound" sense is level-tone _(1)ch(')ong_ (cong1), the common reading departing-tone _ch(')ong(3)_ (cong3) is not unattested; Kangxi has 又《唐韻》初亮切瘡去聲始也造也...又傷也《前漢匈奴傳》人民創艾戰鬭. 【創-level】 (tsrhjang) (_verb-like_) to wound

cong3.text: U+5275 刱 剏 剙 创 (Mainland simplified) (F1.100 創) 創造創始又懲創儆也 (F1.100 ？) 同上 (Page 29* #6: 創(3)刱(3)) To begin, to invent (Kangxi 創: 始也造也); to create, to found, to lay the foundation of; to take measures for; ~~to reprove;~~ the commencement, first; _ts(o\)(6) ch(')ong(3)_ (zou6 cong3 造創) to invent; _ch(')ong(3) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (cong3 ci2 創始), to begin; _ch(')ong(3) (i/)p(9)_ (cong3 jip6 創業) to found a family or a settlement; _(1)t(')(i/)n t(i/)(6) (1)hoi ch(')ong(3)_ (tin1 dei6 hoi1 cong3 天地開創) the creation; _ch(')ong(3) lap(9) (5)m(a/) (4)t(')au_ (cong3 lap6 maa5 tau4 創立碼頭), to build a ferry or jetty; _(4)ch(')ing ch(')ong(3)_ (cing4 cong3 懲創) to blame. To take heed or warning (Kangxi: 懲也). 【創-departing】 (tsrhjangH) (_verb-like_) to create, to initiate (_verb-like_) to take heed

cong1.text: U+6EC4 沧 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 滄) 滄浪水名又滄海也 (Page 593 #9: (1)滄) Vast like the sea; name of a river and lake (Kangxi: 水名, 河名, 湖名); a superior district in Tientsin f(u/) (天津府); _(1)ts(')ong (2)hoi (1)ch(i/) l(e/)ung(6)_ (cong1 hoi2 zi1 loeng6 滄海之量) to drink like the sea, able to drink much. Cold (Kangxi: 寒也).

U+7621 創 疮 (Mainland simplified) (F1.96 瘡) 瘡疾傷也 (Page 28* #6: (1)瘡) A sore, ulcer, boil, or eruption (Kangxi: 痏也, 瘍也); _(1)ch(')ong (1)n(a/)_ (cong1 naa1 瘡𤶸), a scar; _(1)ch(')ong (1)ch(')(un_ (cong1 cyun1 瘡穿), to open a boil; _(1)ch(')ong lau(6)_ (cong1 lau6 瘡瘻) the piles; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng (1)ch(')ong_ (saang1 cong1 生瘡), to have a sore; _(2)fo ~~(1)ting~~ (1)teng (1)ch(')ong_ (fo2 deng1 cong1 火釘瘡), a boil; _w(a/)t(8) yuk(9) (2)lo (1)ch(')ong ~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng_, (waat3 juk6 lo2 cong1 saang1 挖肉攞瘡生) he scrapes the flesh to make a sore --- he ~~trumps up a cause against me~~ brings unnecessary trouble to himself; _k(i/)(3) (1)ch(')ong_ (gei3 cong1 寄瘡), to give away a boil. Williams' 生瘡, 挖肉攞瘡生: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). Williams' 火釘瘡: Changed _(1)ting_ (ding1) to vernacular reading _(1)teng_ (deng1). 【瘡】 (tsrhjang) (_noun-like_) boil

U+8259 舱 (Mainland simplified) (Page 594 #1: (1)艙) An unauthorized character. The compartments in a ship's hold; a hold; _(4)sh(un (1)ts(')ong_ (syun4 cong1 船艙), the hold of a vessel; _(1)hoi (1)ts(')ong_ (hoi1 cong1 開艙) to begin to unlade; _s(o\)(3) (1)ts(')ong_ (sou3 cong1 掃艙), the last lighter; _(1)ts(')ing (1)ts(')ong_ (cing1 cong1 清艙), cargo all discharged; _(1)fung (1)ts(')ong_ (fung1 cong1 封艙), to forbid trade; _t(a/)i(6) ~~(2)t(')(o\)~~ (5)t(')(o\) (1)ts(')ong_ (daai6 tou5 cong1 大肚艙), the main hold; _(1)ts(')ong wai(6)_ (cong1 wai6-2 艙位) the stowage. Williams' 大肚艙: Corrected _(2)t(')(o\)_ (tou2) to _(5)t(')(o\)_ (tou5).

U+84BC 倉 苍 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 蒼) 靑色又蒼天 (Page 593 #8: (1)蒼) the green tint of plants (Kangxi: 草色也), or the azure of the sky; flourishing, prospering (Kangxi: 茂也); hoary, aged, old in service (Kangxi: 老也); _(1)ts(')ong (4)t(')au_ (cong1 tau4 蒼頭), soldiers, so called from their green caps (Kangxi: 蒼頭, 士卒靑帛巾); an old slave; _(1)ts(')ong (1)ts(')ong (2)ch(e/) (1)t(')(i/)n_ (cong1 cong1 ze2 tin1 蒼蒼者天), the empyrean; _met._ Providence; _(1)ts(')ong (5)l(o\)_ (cong1 lou5 蒼老), old, waning; an old man; _(1)ts(')ong (1)shang_ (cong1 sang1 蒼生) the people, living things; _(1)ts(')ing (1)ts(')ong_ (cing1 cong1 青蒼), a greenish bluish color. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【蒼】 (tshang) (_adjective-like_) azure, verdant
U+468E (Page 27* #6: (1)䚎 _(1)Chong_ (zong1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')ong_ (cong1)) To see indistinctly (Kangxi: 視不明也); to look at fixedly (Kangxi: 一曰直視); ~~to watch, as one does a new hand.~~

zong1.text: U+468E 𥅾 (Cantonese) 𥊙 (Cantonese) (Page 27* #6: (1)䚎) A colloquial word. To peep through a crack; to hide one away; _(1)chong (4)k(')am (1)chong shuk(7)_ (zong1 kam4 zong1 suk1 䚎擒䚎縮) to peep in and out; _(1)chong (5)h(a/) (5)k(')(u (2)t(i/)m_ (zong1 haa5 keoi5 dim2 䚎吓佢點), see how he acts; _(1)chong (5)k(')(u ts(')o(3) ch(')(u(3)_ (zong1 keoi5 co3 cyu3 䚎佢錯處) mark his errors. 【䚎】 (zong1) To look whilst trying not to be seen. 唔准䚎人 (m4 zeon2 zong1 jan4): "No peeping at others!" The spelling 䚎 is arbitrary.

cong1.text: U+4C7D 鯧 䲝 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 䱽) 魚名 (Page 594 #2: (1)鯧(1)䱽) The second character (䱽) is unauthorized. The pomfret; _p(a/)k(9) (1)ts(')ong (4)(u_ (baak6 cong1 jyu4-2 白䱽魚), the silver pomfret _(Stromateus argenteus);_ _hak(7) (1)ts(')ong_ (hak1 cong1 黑䱽), the black pomfret _(Stromateus niger);_ _(4)wong ~~lap(9)~~ l(a/)p(9) (1)ts(')ong_ (wong4 laap6 cong1 黃鱲䱽), the yellow pomfret _(Trachinotus auratus);_ _(1)f(a/) (1)ts(')ong_ (faa1 cong1 花䱽), small pomfret _(Caranx malabaricus);_ _(1)kw(a/) (2)tsz' (1)ts(')ong_ (gwaa1 zi2 cong1 瓜子䱽), long-finned pomfret _(Trachinotus asper)_. Effectively, 鯧 and 䱽 are the same semantic word "pomfret", but: 鯧 is classical with reading _(1)ch(')(e/)ung_ (coeng1) (see 鯧 coeng1); and 䱽 is vernacular with reading _(1)ts(')ong_ (cong1). Williams' 黃鱲䱽: Changed _lap(9)_ (lap6) to longer syllable _l(a/)p(9)_ (laap6).

cong2.text: U+53B0 (F1.98 厰) 屋無壁 (Page 29* #1: (2)厰) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿸厂敝 to 厰.

U+5EE0 厰 厂 (Mainland simplified) (F1.98 厰) 屋無壁 (Page 29* #1: (2)厰; here normalised to 廠) An open shed (Kangxi 廠: 露舍也); a covered place not walled in (Kangxi 廠: 屋無壁也); a place to receive taxes, broad, spacious; a depository; a large workshop; _(4)m(u/)i t(')(a/)n(3) (2)ch(')ong_ (mui4 taan3 cong2 煤炭廠), a coal depot; _(1)si(u/) (2)ch(')ong_ (siu1 cong2 硝廠), a saltpetre gabel; _(4)p(')ung (2)ch(')ong_ (pung4 cong2 篷廠) a mat shed; _~~ko(3)~~ (2)ko ~~(4)k(a/)n~~ (1)k(a/)n uk(7) (2)h(o\) (2)ch(')ong_ (go2 gaan1 uk1 hou2 cong2 嗰間屋好廠), that's a large house; _(2)ch(')ong (1)t(')eng_ (cong2 teng1 廠廳), a summer arbor. In modern usage, "factory". Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿸厂敝 to 厰. Williams' 嗰間屋好廠: Changed _ko(3)_ (go3) to modern _(2)ko_ (go2) and corrected _(4)k(a/)n_ (gaan4) to _(1)k(a/)n_ (gaan1).

U+60DD 㒉 𢠵 戃 tong2 (alternative per 《集韻》坦㓪切) (F1.98 𢠵) 𢠵恍也驚貌 (Page 29* #2: (2)𢠵; here normalised to 惝) Alarmed (Kangxi 𢠵: 𢠵怳驚貌或省作惝); frightened; _(2)ch(')ong (2)fong_, (cong2 fong2 惝怳) apprehensive, disappointed (Kangxi 惝: 惝怳失意不悅貌). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 𢠳 to 𢠵.
U+6134 怆 (Mainland simplified) (F1.98 愴) 悽愴言傷心也 (Page 29* #5: (2)愴) Used in 愴怳 (disappointed) (Kangxi: 愴怳失意貌).

cong3.text: U+6134 怆 (Mainland simplified) cong2 (per Fan Wan) (F1.98 愴 _(2)Ch(')ong_ (cong2)) 悽愴言傷心也 (Page 29* #5: (2)愴 _(2)Ch(')ong_ (cong2); here normalised to _Ch(')ong(3)_ (cong3)) Grief (Kangxi: 傷也); _(1)ts(')ai ~~(2)ch(')ong~~ ch(')ong(3)_ (cai1 cong3 悽愴), sorrow; to pity; _~~(2)ch(')ong~~ ch(')ong(3) ch(')ak(7)_ (cong3 cak1 愴惻) a wounded heart, distressed. 【愴】 (tsrhjangH) (_adjective-like_) grieved

cong2.text: U+22835 (F1.98 𢠵) 𢠵恍也驚貌 (Page 29* #2: (2)𢠵) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 𢠳 to 𢠵.

U+95D6 闯 (Mainland simplified) cam3 (per 《廣韻》丑禁切) cong3 (per 《說文注》俗語轉若刱) (F1.98 闖) 闖進出頭貌又音滲 (Page 29* #4: (2)闖) A horse going out of a door (Kangxi: 馬出門貌); to thrust out the head, to appear (Kangxi: 出頭貌); to bolt out; suddenly, forcibly, abruptly; _(2)ch(')ong wo(6)_ (cong2 wo6 闖禍) to induce calamities; _(2)ch(')ong (1)kw(a/)n_ (cong2 gwaan1 闖關), to slip by the custom-house; _(2)ch(')ong ~~ts(a/)k(9)~~ ts(')(a/)k(9) (4)loi_ (cong2 caak6 loi4 闖賊來), the rover Ch(')ong (闖) is on us! Also read _(1)sham_ (sam1) (Kangxi: 《說文》...讀若郴). Williams' 闖賊來: Corrected _ts(a/)k(9)_ (zaak6) to _ts(')(a/)k(9)_ (caak6). Williams' "Also read ...": Or _(1)ch(')am_ (cam1) per 《廣韻》丑林切 for 郴.

cong4.text: U+5E62 (Page 28* #1: (4)幢 _(4)Chong_ (zong4); here corrected to _(4)Ch(')ong_ (cong4)) Long embroidered scrolls or streamers (Kangxi: 旌旗之屬) in temples, suspended from the roof, and having a tilt at top.
U+5E8A (F1.97 床) 臥榻 (F1.97 牀) 同上 (Page 28* #7: (4)床(4)牀) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 㮼 to 榻.

U+7240 床 爿 (F1.97 床) 臥榻 (F1.97 牀) 同上 (Page 28* #7: (4)床(4)牀) A bed, a couch (Kangxi 牀: 安身之坐者, 人所坐臥曰牀); a settee; a suit of bed clothes; the boards which make a bed; a well-curb; a measure of 8 cubits (Kangxi 牀: 八尺曰牀); _yat(7) (4)ch(')ong (5)p(')(i/) yuk(9)_ (jat1 cong4 pei5 juk6 一牀被褥) mattrass, sheets, all complete; _(1)p(')(o\) (4)ch(')ong_ (pou1 cong4 鋪牀), make the bed; _yat(7) (1)ch(e/)ung (4)ch(')ong_ (jat1 zoeng1 cong4 一張牀), a bed; _t(a/)i(6) (4)ch(')ong_ (daai6 cong4 大牀), a double bedstead; _k(')ong(3) (4)ch(')ong_ (kong3 cong4 匟牀), the couch of honor in a hall; _(4)ch(')ong (1)p(')(o\)_ (cong4 pou1 牀鋪), bedding; _kwai(3) (1)f(i/) (4)ch(')ong_ (gwai3 fei1 cong4 貴妃牀), a couch with rolling ends; _(5)sh(e/)ung (4)ch(')ong_ (soeng5 cong4 上牀), to go to bed. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 㮼 to 榻. 【牀】 (dzrjang) (_noun-like_) bed

zong1.text: U+81E7 匨 (F1.95 臧) 善也厚也又奴婢曰臧獲 (Page 593 #1: (1)臧) Good (Kangxi: 臧善也), generous (Kangxi: 厚也); virtuous, faithful; to scold male slaves (Kangxi: ...罵奴曰臧罵婢曰獲); _(1)tsong ~~wok(8)~~ wok(9)_ (zong1 wok6 臧獲) to berate slaves. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𫉬 to 獲. Williams' 臧獲: Corrected _wok(8)_ (wok3) to _wok(9)_ (wok6). To commend, to praise. A slave. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【臧】 (tsang) (_adjective-like_) good

cong4.text: U+85CF 匨 臧 (F1.97 藏) 匿也隱也蓄也 (Page 594 #4: (4)藏) To store away (Kangxi: 蓄也), to put in safety; to contain; to hide, to conceal (Kangxi: 匿也); to accumulate; to gather knowledge; _(4)ts(')ong (4)m(a/)i_ (cong4 maai4 藏埋), to lay by; _(1)k(a/) (4)ts(')ong_ (gaa1 cong4 家藏), heirlooms laid by, family treasures; _(5)m(o\) (4)ts(')ong (4)t(')au_ (mou5 cong4 tau4-2 冇藏頭), no chance for profit; _(4)ts(')ong (2)p(a/)n_ (cong4 baan2 藏版), to keep the blocks, to publish a book; _(1)p(a/)u (4)ts(')ong_ (baau1 cong4 包藏), to keep from, not to divulge; _(1)shau (4)ts(')ong_ (sau1 cong4 收藏), to receive, as in trust; _(4)'m hai(6) (4)ts(')ong (4)lung (1)ch(i/) (2)sho_ (m4 hai6 cong4 lung4 zi1 so2 唔係藏龍之所), I'm not to be cribbed in this place; _(2)yan (4)ts(')ong_ (jan2 cong4 隱藏), to conceal; _(4)ts(')ong (4)t(')au l(o\)(6) (5)m(i/)_ (cong4 tau4 lou6 mei5 藏頭露尾), to give a partial account of, an inkling. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 慝 to 匿, and corrected malformed 蓄. 【藏-noun】 (dzang) (_verb-like_) to store (away)

zong6.text: U+85CF 臧 (F1.101 藏) 收貨財處曰藏又過貪曰無盡藏 (Page 593 #6: 藏(6)) A store-house, a retreat; a strong-box, a casket; _(4)m(o\) tsun(6) tsong(6)_ (mou4 zeon6 zong6 無盡藏) exceedingly avaricious or greedy; _(1)sai tsong(6)_ (sai1 zong6 西藏) Tibet; _yap(9) tsong(6)_ (jap6 zong6 入藏) to lie torpid; to keep out of sight; _t(i/)(6) tsong(6) (4)wong_ (dei6 zong6 wong4 地藏王), name of a deified Budhist. The viscera (Kangxi: 與臟通). 【藏-departing】 (dzangH) (_noun-like_) store (_noun-like_) (_met._) viscera

cou1.text: U+64CD 撡 (F2.9 操 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 操持 (F2.9 撡 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (Page 586 #1: (1)操) To take, to hold, to grasp (Kangxi: 把持也); to manage; to exercise, to drill; expert, used to; to maintain, to restrain one's self, to moderate one's desires; _(1)ts(')(o\) (2)(i/)n_ (cou1 jin2 操演) or _~~(5)h(a/)~~ h(a/)(6) (1)ts(')(o\)_ (haa6 cou1 下操), to drill troops; _(2)t(')ai (1)ts(')(o\)_ (tai2 cou1 睇操), to see a review; _t(a/)i(6) (1)ts(')(o\)_ (daai6 cou1 大操), the triennial review; _(1)ts(')(o\) (4)ch(')(i/)_ (cou1 ci4 操持), resolute, adhering to right; _(1)ts(')(o\) (1)sam_ (cou1 sam1 操心), anxious, careworn. Williams' 下操: Corrected _(5)h(a/)_ (haa5) to _h(a/)(6)_ (haa6). 【操-level】 (tshaw) (_verb-like_) to hold, to handle

cou3.text: U+64CD 撡 cou1 (common) (Page 586 #1: (1)操 _(1)Ts(')(o\)_ (cou1); here normalised to _Ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3)) a purpose, a design, self-imposed rule (Kangxi: 所守也持念也, 所執持之志行也); consistent, principled; Zither music (Kangxi: 琴曲也). 【操-departing】 (tshawH) (_noun-like_) integrity, moral-character

cou1.text: U+7C97 觕 麁 麄 麤 (F2.9 粗 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 不精也臭惡也 (F2.9 麄 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (F2.9 麤 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (Page 586 #2: (1)粗(1)麤) Coarse (Kangxi 粗: 略也疏也), uncleaned, dirty, as rice just thrashed; large, open, coarse (Kangxi 粗: 大也...物不精也); rude, vulgar, boisterous, unpolished; gross, indecent, dirty; harsh, as a voice; partially, rudely; _(1)ts(')(o\) yau(3)_ (cou1 jau3 粗幼) coarse or fine, as cloth; _(1)ts(')(o\) tsuk(9) (4)yan_ (cou1 zuk6 jan4 粗俗人), a rough vulgar man; _(1)ts(')(o\) (5)l(o\)_ (cou1 lou5 粗魯), rough, unmannerly; _(1)ts(')(o\) (1)ch(i/)_ (cou1 zi1 粗知), partly knew it; _(1)ts(')(o\) w(a/)(6)_ (cou1 waa6-2 粗話) obscene language; _(1)ts(')(o\) shik(9)_ (cou1 sik6 粗食) coarse food; a gross eater; _(1)ts(')(o\) (4)(un_ (cou1 jyun4 粗完), nearly done; _(2)shau (1)ts(')(o\)_ (sau2 cou1 手粗), a large hand; _(1)ts(')(o\) (1)sam (4)fau h(i/)(3)_ (cou1 sam1 fau4 hei3 粗心浮氣) light, inattentive, giddy; _(1)ts(')(o\) (2)shai t(a/)i(6) yung(6)_ (cou1 sai2 daai6 jung6 粗使大用) careless in spending money; ~~_(1)(u/) (1)ts(')(o\)_ (wu1 cou1 污粗), dirty, unwashed.~~ Williams' 污粗: Should instead appear under 糟 as 污糟. Cylindrically thick. 【粗】 (tshu) (_adjective-like_) coarse, thick

U+9EA4 麁 麄 (F2.9 粗 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 不精也臭惡也 (F2.9 麄 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (F2.9 麤 _(1)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (Page 586 #2: (1)粗(1)麤) The second form (麤) also means to take long leaps as a deer (Kangxi 麤: 行超遠也); to take precautions (Kangxi 麤: 警防也).

cou3.text: U+61C6 cou2 (per 《廣韻》采老切 for "distressed" sense) (F2.16 懆 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 憂貌 (Page 587 #7: 懆(3)) Chagrined, thoughtful, sad, vexed (Kangxi: 愁不安也); covetous (Kangxi: 貪也); affected by; _(1)tsi(u/) ts(')(o\)(3)_ (ziu1 cou3 焦懆) discontented and anxious. The reading _ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3) is not unattested for the "distressed" sense; 《集韻》 has the reading 七到切, explained 貪也不安也 (covering both the "greed" and "distressed" senses). 【懆】 (tshawX) (_adjective-like_) distraught

cou2.text: U+8278 艹 (character component on top) (F2.14 草 _(2)Ts(')(u/)_) 草木 (F2.14 艸 _(2)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (Page 587 #2: (2)草(2)艸) the 140th radical (U+2F8B ⾋ "grass") of characters relating to herbs;

U+8349 艸 (F2.14 草 _(2)Ts(')(u/)_) 草木 (F2.14 艸 _(2)Ts(')(u/)_) 同上 (Page 587 #2: (2)草(2)艸) Herbs, grasses, plants with herbaceous stems (Kangxi 草: 百卉也); plants in general; hastily, carelessly (Kangxi 草: 苟簡曰草草); the running hand; a rough copy, original draft; to cut grass, to mow (Kangxi 草: 草艾謂艾取草也); _(2)ts(')(o\) muk(9)_ (cou2 muk6 草木) plants; _(2)t(a/) (2)ts(')(o\) (4)ts(')am (4)sh(e/)_ (daa2 cou2 cam4 se4 打草尋蛇), to beat the grass for snakes, _i. e._ to devise evil; _(2)ts(')(o\) (2)ts(')(o\) (5)li(u/) sz'(6)_ (cou2 cou2 liu5 si6 草草了事) to finish up jobs heedlessly; _(2)ts(')(o\) (1)sh(u_ (cou2 syu1 草書), running hand; _(2)ts(')(o\) (2)ts(')(o\)_ (cou2 cou2 草草), toilsome, troublesome, careless, lenient; _(2)ts(')(o\) (2)k(o\)_ (cou2 gou2 草稿), first proof, a rough copy; _(2)ts(')(o\) (1)p(a/)u_ (cou2 baau1 草包), an irascible man; _(4)wo (2)ts(')(o\)_ (wo4 cou2 禾草), rice straw; _(2)ts(')(o\) (1)kan (1)f(u/)i_ (cou2 gan1 fui1 草根灰), mortar with straw; _(1)f(a/) (2)ts(')(o\)_ (faa1 cou2 花草), flowers, adorned with plants; _(4)'m (2)h(o\) (1)f(a/) (2)ts(')(o\)_ (m4 hou2 faa1 cou2 唔好花草), not well carved; _(2)ts(')(o\) (4)p(')(a/)ng_ (cou2 paang4 草棚), a thatched roof, any thatch; _(2)ts(')(o\) ~~(2)k(u/)n~~ (1)k(a/)n (4)yan meng(6)_ (cou2 gaan1 jan4 meng6 草菅人命) to trifle with people's lives, as charlatans do. Williams' 草菅人命: Corrected _(2)k(u/)n_ (gun2) to _(1)k(a/)n_ (gaan1). Williams has likely misread 菅 as 管. 【草】 (tshawX) (_noun-like_) grass, herbage (_adjective-like_) rough, careless (_adjective-like_) travailed 【草花頭】 (cou2 faa1 tau4-2) The character component 艹. (Literally, "grass flower atop".)

cou3.text: U+566A 喿 (F2.16 噪 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 群鳥鳴聲 (Page 587 #6: 噪(3)) The chirping and singing of many birds (Kangxi 喿: 鳥羣鳴也, 或作噪𠹏); the hum of men; to cry out (Kangxi 噪: 呼噪也).

U+63AA 厝 (for "place", "bury", "conceal" senses) 錯 (for "place", "bury", "conceal" senses) (F2.16 措 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 處置也安着也施布也又委置也 (F2.16 厝 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 同上又安頓也 (Page 587 #11: 措(3)) To cast away, to throw down, to place, to put in its place (Kangxi: 措置也, 投也); to make known, to show abroad (Kangxi: 舉也); to conceal, to set aside; to bury; ~~to take at unawares;~~ to use, to employ (Kangxi: 施布也, 措猶用也); to ~~relinquish~~ abandon (Kangxi: 委置也); arranged, well ordered; a rule; _(4)m(o\) (2)sho ts(')(o\)(3) (2)shau tsuk(7)_ (mou4 so2 cou3 sau2 zuk1 無所措手足) no place for my hands or feet, _i.e._ at a loss, perplexed; _ts(')(o\)(3) (4)ts(')z' t(a/)i(6) (5)ng(a/)_ (cou3 ci4 daai6 ngaa5 措辭大雅), elegant phraseology, words well spoken. 【措】 (tshuH) (_verb-like_) to place, to put, to set (_verb-like_) to apply

zaak3.text: U+63AA (Page 587 #11: 措(3)) Read _~~ch(')(a/)k(8)~~ ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3). To pursue after, to chase, to ferret out (Kangxi: 追捕也).

cou3.text: U+6FA1 zou2 (per 《廣韻》子晧切) (F2.13 澡 _(2)Ts(u/)_ (zou2)) 洗滌 (Page 584 #9: (2)澡 _(2)Ts(o\)_ (zou2); here normalised to _Ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3)) To bathe, to wash the person (Kangxi: 澡洗也); to cleanse the heart, to reform (Kangxi: 借作修潔意); _(2)sai ~~(2)ts(o\)~~ ts(')(o\)(3)_ (sai2 cou3 洗澡), to bathe. To wash the hands (per 《說文》洒手也). 【澡】 (tsawX) (_verb-like_) to wash

U+71E5 cou3-2 (rising second in vernacular 燥燥地) (Page 587 #8: 燥(3)) Dry, scorched, chapped, parched (Kangxi: 乾也); to dry by the fire; _(1)kon ts(')(o\)(3)_ (gon1 cou3 乾燥) parched up, drought; _(1)fung (1)k(o\) ts(')(o\)(3) mat(9)_ (fung1 gou1 cou3 mat6 風高燥物) the north wind dries or splits things; _(1)ts(')au ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cau1 cou3 秋燥) heats of autumn. Williams' 風高燥物: Usually 風高物燥. 【燥】 (sawH, sawX) (_adjective-like_) parched

U+7CD9 May appear as either ⿰米⿺辶吿 or ⿰米⿺辶告 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.16 糙 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 米糙 (Page 587 #5: 糙(3)) Coarse rice (Kangxi: 粗米未舂)~~, paddy which has only been hulled, and not cleaned~~; _ts(')(o\)(3) (5)mai (1)l(a/)n_ (cou3 mai5 laan1 糙米欄), Coarse Rice street, in Canton.

U+8B5F 噪 (Page 728 #3: 譟(3)) The noise of a crowd (Kangxi: 羣呼煩擾也, 聒也, 羣呼曰譟); a clamor, a disturbance (Kangxi: 擾也); _(4)yan (1)to (2)k(u/) ~~ts'(o\)(3)~~ ts(')(o\)(3)_ (jan4 do1 gu2 cou3 人多鼓譟) a great hallooing. Williams' 人多鼓譟: Corrected _ts'(o\)(3)_ (with an apostrophe) to _ts(')(o\)(3)_ (with an aspirate). 【譟】 (sawH) (_verb-like_) to clamour

U+8E81 燥 趮 zou3 (per 《廣韻》則到切) (F2.16 躁 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 浮躁妄動也急進也 (Page 587 #8: 燥(3); here normalised to 躁) fierce, untameable; (Page 587 #9: 躁(3)) Hasty, heedless, precipitate; to go quickly (Kangxi: 疾也); dried up by the heat, and therefore light (Kangxi: 躁燥也物燥乃動而飛揚也); fierce, violent; _ts(')(o\)(3) p(o\)(6)_ (cou3 bou6 躁暴) outrageous, prone to anger; bustling, fussy; _(4)fau ts(')(o\)(3)_ (fau4 cou3 浮躁) light, testy, wavering. To move, to stir. 【躁】 (tsawH) (_adjective-like_) rash (_verb-like_) to move (hastily), to stir

U+9020 May appear as either ⿺辶吿 or ⿺辶告 (assumed here), depending on the font. 艁 (F2.16 造 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 至也詣也進也又造次 (Page 587 #4: 造(3)) To go to, to arrive (Kangxi: 就也, 詣也); to advance, to enter (Kangxi: 進也); to contain (Kangxi: 納也, 造猶內也內與納同); _ts(')(o\)(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (cou3 ci3 造次) hurried (Kangxi: 造次急遽也), thoughtless. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰音旨 to 詣. 【造-departing】 (tshawH) (_verb-like_) to go unto, to attain (_verb-like_) to contain Used in 造次. 【造次】 (tshawH tshijH) (_adjective-like_) abrupt

cou5.text: U+9020 May appear as either ⿺辶吿 or ⿺辶告 (assumed here), depending on the font. 儲 (Cantonese) (Page 587 #3: (5)造) A colloquial word. To collect, to lay up, to heap up; to lay by, to pay instalments, to pay in savings; _yat(7) (4)ts(')(i/)n (5)ts(')(o\) yat(7) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (jat1 cin4 cou5 jat1 cin4 一錢造一錢), for one mace lay up another; _(2)si(u/) (4)ts(')(i/)n (5)ts(')(o\) t(a/)i(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (siu2 cin4 cou5 daai6 cin4 小錢造大錢), a little farthing will grow to a large penny; _(5)ts(')(o\) (4)m(a/)i_ (cou5 maai4 造埋), to lay up. Used in 新造 (the name of a town in Canton). 【造】 (cou5) To collect, to gather, to accumulate. 造錢 (cou5 cin4-2): "Save up money." 造銀仔 (cou5 ngan4-2 zai2): "Collect coins." The spelling 造 is arbitrary. The alternative spelling 儲 is from appropriation of formal 儲 _(5)ch(')(u_ (cyu5).

zou6.text: U+9020 May appear as either ⿺辶吿 or ⿺辶告 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.18 造 _Ts(u/)(6)_) 建也作也爲也始也 (Page 585 #5: 造(6)) To build, to make, to construct (Kangxi: 建也作也爲也); to create; to act; to do (Kangxi: 造爲也); to begin, to commence (Kangxi: 始也); a crop; _k(i/)n(3) ts(o\)(6)_ (gin3 zou6 建造) to build; _ts(o\)(6) f(a/)(3)_ (zou6 faa3 造化) to create; _(2)h(o\) ts(o\)(6) f(a/)(3)_ (hou2 zou6 faa3 好造化) good fortune; _kot(8) (4)wo ts(o\)(6)_ (got3 wo4 zou6 割禾造) to cut the rice harvest; _~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng ts(o\)(6) ch(')ut(7) (4)lai_, (saang1 zou6 ceot1 lai4 生造出嚟) an entire fabrication, made out of whole cloth; _tsoi(3) ts(o\)(6)_ (zoi3 zou6 再造) do it over again; _ts(o\)(6) (2)p(u/)n_ (zou6 bun2 造本), to get some capital; _m(u/)t(9) ts(o\)(6) tong(3) (1)san ch(')ut(7)_ (mut6 zou6 dong3 san1 ceot1 末造當新出) the last of the season is as good as a new crop; _(2)ts(o\) ts(o\)(6) (5)m(a/)n ts(o\)(6)_ (zou2 zou6 maan5 zou6 早造晚造) the early crop, the late crop; _(2)h(a/)u ts(o\)(6)_ (haau2 zou6 巧造) skillful work. Williams' 生造出嚟: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【造-rising】 (dzawX) (_verb-like_) to make, to create (_verb-like_) to do, to take action (_noun-like_) doing, (_met._) accomplishment (_verb-like_) to commence

zok6.text: U+9162 昨 醋 (F1.103 酢) 酧酢 (Page 592 #6: 酢(9)) To pledge a host, to return health (Kangxi: 客酌主人也, 酬酢); to recompense, to return a compliment (Kangxi: 酢報也). 【酢】 (dzak) (_verb-like_) to pledge (in return) (_verb-like_) to recompense

cou3.text: U+918B 酢 (F2.16 醋 _Ts(')(u/)(3)_) 酒醋 (Page 588 #2: 醋(3)) Vinegar (Kangxi 酢: 今人...反以醋爲酢字, 酸也); pickle; pickled; _(2)tsau ts(')(o\)(3)_ (zau2 cou3 酒醋) vinegar of spirits; _p(a/)k(9) ts(')(o\)(3)_ (baak6 cou3 白醋) clear vinegar; _h(a/)p(8) ts(')(o\)(3)_ (haap3 cou3 呷醋) female rivalry, as between two concubines; _lok(9) tik(7) (4)(i/)m ts(')(o\)(3)_ (lok6 dik1 jim4 cou3 落滴鹽醋) be more severe with him, as with a pupil; _ts(o\)(6) ts(')(o\)(3) (4)'m (1)s(un_ (zou6 cou3 m4 syun1 做醋唔酸), your vinegar has no sourness, *you* can do nothing; _y(a/)k(8) (1)k(e/)ung ts(')(o\)(3)_ (jaak3 goeng1 cou3 吃薑醋) to bear a child, because ginger and vinegar are given to the mother; _(4)y(e/)ung ts(')(o\)(3)_ (joeng4 cou3 洋醋) foreign vinegar. 【呷醋】 (haap3 cou3) To be jealous of a romantic rival.

cou4.text: U+5608 cou4-2 (rising second in vernacular 嘈嘈地) (F2.12 嘈 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 喧也又胡酒也 (Page 586 #6: (4)~~？~~嘈) Noise, clamor, hubbub (Kangxi 嘈: 聲也); an outcry (Kangxi 嘈: 喧嘈); to make a din; to vociferate; _(4)ts(')(o\) n(a/)u(6)_ (cou4 naau6 嘈鬧) wrangling, squabbling; _(1)h(u k(o\)m(3) (4)ts(')(o\)_ (heoi1 gam3 cou4 墟咁嘈), noisy as a market; _(4)ts(')(o\) (4)ts(')(o\) pai(3)_ (cou4 cou4 bai3 嘈嘈閉) a brawl; _(5)mai (4)ts(')(o\) (4)yan (5)(i/)_ (mai5 cou4 jan4 ji5 咪嘈人耳), don't deafen people with your noise; _(4)l(o\) (4)ts(')(o\)_ (lou4 cou4 嘮嘈), rude, rough, unmannerly; _shap(9) (1)fan (4)ts(')(o\) h(i/)(3)_ (sap6 fan1 cou4 hei3 十分嘈氣) panting after an angry brawl; _(4)ts(')(o\) (4)ts(')(o\) (2)ch(')(a/)u (2)ch(')(a/)u_ (cou4 cou4 caau2 caau2 嘈嘈吵吵), a tumult, squalling, as tanka women do; _(4)'m (2)h(o\) (4)ts(')(o\)_ (m4 hou2 cou4 唔好嘈), don't make a noise. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰口冋 to 喧.

U+5F82 且 (F2.12 徂 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 往也落也 (Page 586 #3: (4)徂) To go up; to proceed, to travel (Kangxi: 往也); to preserve (Kangxi: 存也), to lay up; _(4)ts(')(o\) ts(e/)(6)_ (cou4 ze6 徂謝) to fade, as flowers. 【徂】 (dzu) (_verb-like_) to go (unto)

U+66F9 𣍘 (F2.12 曹 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 局也衆也軰也又同事曰曹 (Page 586 #5: (4)曹) ~~A sort of revising judge~~; ~~a judge of appeals;~~ a place where officers meet (Kangxi: 曹羣也); a company, a class, a herd (Kangxi: 曹輩也); denotes the plural of persons; _luk(9) (4)ts(')(o\)_ (luk6 cou4 六曹), the six Boards; _(1)t(')(i/)n (4)ts(')(o\)_ (tin1 cou4 天曹) and _(1)yam (4)ts(')(o\)_ (jam1 cou4 陰曹), gods and devils; _(5)(i/) (4)ts(')(o\)_ (ji5 cou4 爾曹), you; _(1)k(u/)n (4)ts(')(o\)_ (gun1 cou4 官曹), officers; _(4)Ts(')(o\) (1)Ts(')(o\)_ (cou4 cou1 曹操), a famous general, who died A.D. ~~250~~~220. Williams' "A sort of revising judge", "a judge of appeals": These are misreadings of Kangxi 獄之兩曹也在廷東从㯥治事者从曰. Here, 獄 means "litigation" rather than "gaol", and 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》 interpret 㒳曹 as referring to the plaintiff and the defendant (㒳曹今俗所謂原吿被吿也). Note that the two characters "从曰" are missing in Kangxi; their presence in 《說文》 implies that 治事者 is just the explanation of the bottom component 曰, rather than the definition of the character as a whole (as Williams has taken it to be). Plaintiff and defendant (Kangxi: 獄之兩曹也 etc.). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【曹】 (dzaw) (_noun-like_) company, herd

U+69FD (F2.12 槽 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 馬槽滿槽 (Page 586 #7: (4)槽) A trough, a log channeled out, a manger (Kangxi: 畜獸之食器); a vat, a tub for spirits (Kangxi: 酒槽酒坊也); a sort of fruit (Kangxi: 枸槽子果名); _(5)m(a/) (4)ts(')(o\)_ (maa5 cou4 馬槽), a manger; _(2)tsau (4)ts(')(o\)_ (zau2 cou4 酒槽), a wine vat; _(4)ts(')(o\) (1)fong_ (cou4 fong1 槽坊), a grogshop; _(2)shui (4)ts(')(o\)_ (seoi2 cou4 水槽), an eaves-trough, a horse-trough. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰冫㒼 to 滿.

U+6B82 徂 (F2.12 殂 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 死也㓕也 (Page 586 #4: (4)殂) To die (Kangxi: 往死也); ~~dead;~~ ~~a path to the grave;~~ _(4)ts(')(o\) lok(9)_ (cou4 lok6 殂落) to pass away, to die. 【殂】 (dzu) (_verb-like_) to go on, (_met._) to pass away

U+6F15 zou6 (alternative per 《廣韻》在到切 for "water-transport" sense) (F2.12 漕 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 衞邑也又以水運糧曰漕運 (Page 586 #8: (4)漕) A mill-race, a sluice through which water runs (Kangxi: 水轉穀也); ~~a gulf, a gorge;~~ a canal; to lead on water, to turn a water course (Kangxi: 水運曰漕); to convey revenue to Peking (北京); ~~occurs used for the next (艚);~~ _(4)ts(')(o\) wan(6)_ (cou4 wan6 漕運) to transport grain, to take it to the army; _(4)ts(')(o\) (4)ho_ (cou4 ho4 漕河), the Grand Canal; _(4)ts(')(o\) wai(6)_ (cou4 wai6 漕衛) a fortified city.

U+825A (F2.12 艚 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 艚船 (Page 586 #9: (4)艚) A junk, a smack (Kangxi: 小船也); _p(a/)k(9) (4)ts(')(o\) (4)sh(un_ (baak6 cou4 syun4 白艚船), sea-going junks; _(4)ts(')(o\) (2)tsai_ (cou4 zai2 艚仔), small junks.

U+87AC (F2.12 螬 _(4)Ts(')(u/)_) 虫名 (Page 587 #1: (4)螬) ~~Maggots~~ Scarabs in ordure (Kangxi: 蟦蠐螬, 在糞土中者); _(4)ts(')ai (4)ts(')(o\)_ (cai4 cou4 蠐螬), grubs found in filth, which curl themselves up. 【螬】 (dzaw) (_noun-like_) grub Used in 蠐螬.
