cyu5.text: U+5132 May appear with 者 dotless (+15 assumed here) or dotted (+16), depending on the font. 储 (Mainland simplified) cyu4 (per 《廣韻》直魚切) (Page 32* #6: (4)儲 _(4)Ch(')(u_ (cyu4); here normalised to _(5)Ch(')(u_ (cyu5)) To collect (Kangxi: 偫也); to provide for need; furnished; to assist, to act as second to (Kangxi: 副也); _~~(4)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u wai(6)_ (cyu5 wai6 儲位) an heir-apparent; _~~(4)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u (1)kwan_ (cyu5 gwan1 儲君), ~~son of~~ a prince. Williams' 儲君: Not a son of a prince, but an heir to a monarch. To await. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【儲】 (drjo) (_verb-like_) to collect

cuk1.text: U+4FC3 趣 (for "urge" sense) (Page 600 #11: 促(7)) To constrain (Kangxi: 局促小貌); near, short, close (Kangxi: 迫也近也密也); urgent, pressed upon (Kangxi: 刺促); small, shortened; hampered; _kuk(9) ts(')uk(7)_ (guk6 cuk1 侷促) a narrow, small space; _ts(')uk(7) sat(7) (4)t(')(a/)m (1)sam_ (cuk1 sat1 taam4 sam1 促膝談心), to draw together and talk, as long absent friends.

U+6149 huk1 (per 《廣韻》許竹切) (F1.64 慉) 亦養也 (Page 36* #3: 慉(7)) To sustain (Kangxi: 慉養也); to encourage (Kangxi: 起也); ~~_ch(')uk(7) (1)ki(u/)_ (cuk1 giu1 慉驕), to excite pride;~~ ~~_ch(')uk(7) n(o\)(6)_ (cuk1 nou6 慉怒) to stir up anger.~~ Broadly, there are two interpretations of this character: To uplift (《說文》起也, defended by 段玉裁's annotations); and To sustain or to cherish (per 《朱傳》, 《箋》, 《正義》 as appears in Kangxi). Williams' 慉驕: This is a misreading of Kangxi 慉驕也, which is an explanation of meaning (to be punctuated 慉、驕也), rather than an example of a two-character phrase. 【慉】 (xjuwk) (_verb-like_) to cherish, to uplift
U+6410 (F1.64 搐) 宰制也 (Page 36* #4: 搐(7)) To drag along, to pull by force, as one drags an ox (Kangxi: 牽制也); to shake rudely (Kangxi: 搐謂動而痛也).

U+675F (F1.64 束) 束縛約束又束脩束帶 (Page 36* #5: 束(7)) To bind or bundle a number of things (Kangxi: 縛也); to tie up in a sheaf; to coerce, to restrain; a bundle, a sheaf; _ch(')uk(7) ~~fok(8)~~ pok(8)_ (cuk1 bok3 束縛) to cord up; _(2)k(u/)n ch(')uk(7)_ (gun2 cuk1 管束) to restrain those under one; _ch(')uk(7) (1)sau_ (cuk1 sau1 束修), a teacher's pay; _ch(')uk(7) (2)shau toi(6) pai(6)_ (cuk1 sau2 doi6 bai6 束手待斃) in the utmost distress, no work. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 朿 to 束. Williams' 束縛: Changed _fok(8)_ (fok3) to common reading _pok(8)_ (bok3). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【束】 (syowk) (_verb-like_) to bundle, to bind

U+6A15 𣙙 (F1.64 𣙙) 樸𣙙小木也 (Page 600 #4: 𣙙(7); here normalised to 樕) A small tree, a shrub, a sapling (Kangxi 樕: 樸樕小木也); _puk(9) ts(')uk(7)_ (buk6 cuk1 樸樕) small trees, suitable for posts. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰木敇 to 𣙙. 【樕】 (suwk) (_noun-like_) oak (_noun-like_) shrub
U+23659 (F1.64 𣙙) 樸𣙙小木也 (Page 600 #4: 𣙙(7)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰木敇 to 𣙙.

U+755C (F1.64 畜) 畜養 (Page 36* #1: 畜(7)) To rear, to feed, to raise (Kangxi: 養也); to domesticate, to herd; to cultivate; to restrain (Kangxi: 畜止也); to bear with (Kangxi: 容也); to obey (Kangxi: 順也); domestic animals (Kangxi: 六畜); _ch(')uk(7) (1)shang_ (cuk1 sang1 畜牲), you brute! _luk(9) ch(')uk(7)_ (luk6 cuk1 六畜) the six domestic animals; _ch(')uk(7) (5)y(e/)ung_ (cuk1 joeng5 畜養), to raise cattle. (Page 36* #2: 蓄(7); here corrected to 畜) to nourish, to rear; _ch(')uk(7) (1)(a/) (4)t(')au_ (cuk1 aa1 tau4 畜丫頭), to bring up slave girls. Much confusion exists in relation to the Middle Chinese readings of this character. 《廣韻》 has two headline readings: 丑救切 _ch(')au(3)_ (cau3) for the "livestock" sense; and 許竹切 _huk(7)_ (huk1) for the "rear" sense. But within these two entries, it also provides alternative readings (又許宥許六丑六三切 and 又丑六許救二切 respectively), and it is unclear whether these are intended as cross-references or as genuine alternatives for the senses given. Kangxi has a hodgepodge: 丑六切 _ch(')uk(7)_ (cuk1) for "rearing-field" (田畜也), "gather" (積也), and "restrain" (止也), among other senses; 許六切 _huk(7)_ (huk1) for "rear" (養也), "accommodate" (容也), "livestock" (六畜) (with a note that 今人𠀤讀作昌六反), and "obey" (順也), among other senses; 許救切 _yau(3)_ (jau3) for "non-working livestock" (養之曰畜用之曰牲); and 丑救切 _ch(')au(3)_ (cau3) for "domesticated animal" (在野曰獸在家曰畜). Modern Cantonese simply merges all readings into _ch(')uk(7)_ (cuk1). 【畜-noun】 (trhjuwH, xjuwk) (_noun-like_) livestock 【畜-verb】 (xjuwk) (_verb-like_) to rear, to nurture (_verb-like_) to accommodate

U+77D7 May appear with components as the right component of 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.64 矗) 聳上也高起也又直也齊也 (Page 36* #6: 矗(7)) High, eminent (Kangxi: 聳上貌, 高起也); equal, even (Kangxi: 齊也), straight (Kangxi: 直也, 長直貌); to raise; luxuriant growth (Kangxi: 草木盛也).

U+7C0C 𫂙 (Page 600 #5: 𫂙(7); here normalised to 簌) To sift, and cause to shower down (Kangxi 簌: 篩也); close, thickset (Kangxi 簌: 茂密貌); showering down, like autumnal leaves blown by the wind. Fan Wan entry: The headword 𫂙 is a misprint of 蔌.
U+2B099 (Page 600 #5: 𫂙(7)) Fan Wan entry: The headword 𫂙 is a misprint of 蔌.

U+84C4 畜 稸 (F1.64 蓄) 積也藏也 (Page 36* #1: 畜(7); here normalised to 蓄) to gather (Kangxi 畜: 積也); (Page 36* #2: 蓄(7)) To collect, to accumulate, to hoard (Kangxi: 積也, 聚也藏也); _ch(')uk(7) tsik(7)_ (cuk1 zik1 蓄積) to collect together; Used in 蓄意 (premeditated, deliberate). 【蓄】 (xjuwk, trhjuwk) (_verb-like_) to hoard

U+850C (F1.64 蔌) 果名 (F1.64 蔌) 窶陋也 (Page 600 #6: 蔌(7)) Vegetables, legumes, kitchen herbs (Kangxi: 菜謂之蔌, 蔌者菜茹之總名); _ts(')oi(3) ts(')uk(7)_ (coi3 cuk1 菜蔌) vegetables; _ts(')uk(7) ts(')uk(7)_ (cuk1 cuk1 蔌蔌) mean (Kangxi: 蔌蔌陋也); _ts(')uk(7) ts(')uk(7) (1)fung (1)wai_ (cuk1 cuk1 fung1 wai1 蔌蔌風威), the stern wind whistling along (Kangxi: 風聲勁疾之貌). Fan Wan entry: The original entry with headword 蔌, explained 果名, is erroneous. Corrected headword 𫂙 to 蔌. 【蔌】 (suwk) (_noun-like_) vegetable (_adjective-like_) base, mean

U+89EB (F1.65 觫) 觳觫恐懼貌 (Page 600 #3: 觫(7)) Horns beginning to start; to start, to tremble; _huk(9) ts(')uk(7)_ (huk6 cuk1 觳觫) frightened, as oxen are in presence of lions; in a terrible fright (Kangxi: 觳觫懼死貌). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰角朿 to 觫.
U+89F8 (F1.64 觸) 突也犯也抵觸惑也 (F1.64 触) 同上 (Page 36* #7: 觸(7))

zuk1.text: U+89F8 触 cuk1 (per 《廣韻》尺玉切) (F1.64 觸 _Ch(')uk(7)_ (cuk1)) 突也犯也抵觸惑也 (F1.64 触 _Ch(')uk(7)_ (cuk1)) 同上 (Page 36* #7: 觸(7) _Ch(')uk(7)_ (cuk1); here normalised to _Chuk(7)_ (zuk1)) To gore, to push as an ox (Kangxi: 牴也); to oppose, to excite; _~~ch(')uk(7)~~ chuk(7) f(a/)n(6)_ (zuk1 faan6 觸犯) to insult; _~~ch(')uk(7)~~ chuk(7) n(o\)(6)_ (zuk1 nou6 觸怒) to irritate; _~~ch(')uk(7)~~ chuk(7) (2)h(i/)_ (zuk1 hei2 觸起), startling, to recollect suddenly; _~~ch(')uk(7)~~ chuk(7) muk(9) (1)sh(e/)ung (1)sam_ (zuk1 muk6 soeng1 sam1 觸目傷心), distressing and affecting; _~~ch(')uk(7)~~ chuk(7) (4)hon_ (zuk1 hon4 觸寒), to take cold; _~~ch(')uk(7)~~ chuk(7) (1)sh(a/)n (1)ch(i/) lik(9)_ (zuk1 saan1 zi1 lik6 觸山之力) extraordinary strength. 【觸】 (tsyhowk) (_verb-like_) to butt, to knock against

cuk1.text: U+8E59 踧 顣 cik1 (per 《集韻》倉厯切 for "contracted" sense) zuk1 (per 《廣韻》子六切) (F1.64 蹙) 頻蹙愁貌又急也廹也 (F1.64 顣) 同上 (Page 600 #8: 蹙(7)) Pressed upon, urged, impelled (Kangxi: 迫也, 近也); cramped, cribbed; ~~embarrassed;~~ to wrinkle, to rumple, to draw in; retractile; disquieted, uneasy, reduced to extremity; _pik(7) ts(')uk(7)_ (bik1 cuk1 迫蹙) to press or urge vehemently; _ts(')uk(7) ts(')uk(7)_ (cuk1 cuk1 蹙蹙) contracted (Kangxi: 蹙蹙縮小貌, 蹙蹙小之貌). (Page 600 #9: 顣(7)) Interchanged with the last (蹙), to frown (Kangxi 顣: 顣頞鼻頤促貌); to wrinkle the forehead; anxious, careworn. 【蹙】 (tsjuwk) (_verb-like_) to compress, to constrain (_verb-like_) to scowl

U+8E74 蹙 蹵 zuk1 (alternative per 《廣韻》子六切) zuk6 (per 《集韻》就六切 for "respectful" sense) (F1.65 蹴) 踐踏也 (Page 600 #10: 蹴(7)) ~~Similar to the last two (蹙, 顣).~~ To tread on, to press with the foot (Kangxi: 躡也); to kick; _ts(')uk(7) (4)(i/)n_ (cuk1 jin4 蹴然), reverential (Kangxi: 蹴然敬貌). 【蹴-voiced】 (dzjuwk) (_adjective-like_) reverential 【蹴-unvoiced】 (tshjuwk, tsjuwk) (_verb-like_) to trample, to kick

U+901F 遬 (F1.64 速) 急也廹也 (Page 600 #1: 速(7)) Hasty, quick, hurried (Kangxi: 疾也); fleet, as a deer; with haste; to call, to invite (Kangxi: 召也); _tsik(7) ts(')uk(7)_ (zik1 cuk1 即速) instantly, presently; _ts(')uk(7) h(u(3)_ (cuk1 heoi3 速去) go quickly; _ts(')uk(7) ts(')uk(7)_ (cuk1 cuk1 速速) no connection with (Kangxi: 速速不相親附之貌); friendless; _(4)'m tsoi(6) k(o\)m(3) (4)mong ts(')uk(7)_ (m4 zoi6 gam3 mong4 cuk1 唔在咁忙速) don't be so precipitate, flurried; _ts(')uk(7) yuk(9)_ (cuk1 juk6 速玉) to hurry the steps of a guest; _(2)fo ts(')uk(7)_ (fo2 cuk1 火速) as quick as possible. 【速】 (suwk) (_verb-like_) to invite (_verb-like_) to impel (_adjective-like_) speedy

U+906C (F1.65 遬) 齊遬 (Page 600 #7: 遬(7)) ~~Similar to the next (蹙).~~ To step smartly to one's place; to dispatch, to hurry through; attentive, respectful (Kangxi: 猶蹙蹙也); alert, speedy (Kangxi: 剽遬疾也). Williams' "smartly": In the sense of "quickly". 【遬】 (suwk) (_adjective-like_) reverent
U+9863 (F1.64 蹙) 頻蹙愁貌又急也廹也 (F1.64 顣) 同上 (Page 600 #9: 顣(7))

U+9917 May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 𫗧 (Mainland simplified) (F1.64 餗) 鼎實也易覆餗 (Page 600 #2: 餗(7)) The prepared contents of a boiler or kettle (Kangxi: 鼎實也); pot-luck, dressed food. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰飠朿 to 餗. 【餗】 (suwk) (_noun-like_) cauldron-stuff

cung1.text: U+5145 May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+3) or 4 strokes (+4 assumed here), depending on the font. The two forms are actually separate characters in Kangxi (p.123#10 and p.124#1 respectively). Kangxi considers the first (𠫓 having 3 strokes) to be orthodox. 𠑽 (F1.58 充) 滿也塞也實也 (Page 40* #5: (1)充(1)𠑽) To fill (Kangxi 充: 實之也), to satiate (Kangxi 充: ...大充...過飽也)~~, to extend~~; to carry out, to continue (Kangxi 充: 行也滿也); to act, to fill an office (Kangxi 充: 充當也); to stop up, to stuff (Kangxi 充: 塞也); sufficient (Kangxi 充: 備也); fine (Kangxi 充: 美也), ~~long~~ grown, high (Kangxi 充: 長也高也); _(1)ch(')ung (2)k(a/) fo(3)_ (cung1 gaa2 fo3 充假貨) to foist in a poor quality of goods; _(1)ch(')ung (5)m(u/)n (4)ch(')(a/) (4)(u/)_ (cung1 mun5 caa4 wu4-2 充滿茶壺), fill up the tea-pot; _(2)hau ngoi(6) (1)ch(')ung (1)kwan_ (hau2 ngoi6 cung1 gwan1 口外充軍), banishment beyond the frontiers; _(1)ch(')ung shat(9)_ (cung1 sat6 充實) stuff it solid; _(1)ch(')ung (u/)i(6)_ (cung1 wui6-2 充會) to contribute to a society. Williams' 充實: Also "fulfilling" or "rich". To feign. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【充】 (tsyhuwng) (_verb-like_) to fill, to stuff, (_met._) to serve as (_adjective-like_) full, stuffed

U+51B2 (F1.58 沖) 和也又相沖 (F1.58 冲) 幼小曰冲年又相冲也 (F1.58 沖) 搖也 (Page 41 #1: (1)冲(1)沖) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 忡 to 沖, and corrected 枂 to 相. Note that a separate entry with headword 沖 also exists, explained 搖也.

U+5306 忩 怱 悤 (F1.58 怱) 怱忙急遽也 (F1.58 匆) 匆匆喜色 (Page 608 #5: (1)悤; here normalised to 匆) Hurried (Kangxi 悤: 悤悤急遽也, 亦作忩俗作匆非), alarmed, agitated; _n(o\)(6) h(i/)(3) (1)ts(')ung (1)ts(')ung_ (nou6 hei3 cung1 cung1 怒氣匆匆), excited to anger, exasperated; _(1)ts(')ung (4)mong_ (cung1 mong4 匆忙), precipitate. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 忽 to 怱, and corrected headword 勿 to 匆.

U+5FE1 (Page 40* #8: (1)忡) Sorrowful, grieved (Kangxi: 憂也); _(1)ch(')ung (1)ch(')ung_ (cung1 cung1 忡忡), distressed in mind. Fan Wan entry: The headword 忡 is a misprint of 沖. 【忡】 (trhjuwng) (_adjective-like_) grieved, distressed
U+6031 (F1.58 怱) 怱忙急遽也 (F1.58 匆) 匆匆喜色 Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 忽 to 怱, and corrected headword 勿 to 匆.
U+391D May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.58 㤝) 心動貌 (Page 40* #6: (1)㤝) The mind ~~much~~ moved (Kangxi: 心動也); perturbed, agitated.
U+60A4 May appear as either ⿱囪心 (assumed here) or ⿱囱心, depending on the font. (Page 608 #5: (1)悤)
U+61A7 偅 (F1.58 憧) 意不定也 (Page 41 #3: (1)憧) Unsettled in mind, disturbed, undecided (Kangxi: 意不定也); irresolute. 【憧】 (tsyhowng) (_adjective-like_) unsettled, undecided

zong6.text: U+61A7 Foolish (Kangxi: 一曰戇憧愚貌).

cung1.text: U+6A05 枞 (Mainland simplified) zung1 (alternative per 《廣韻》即容切) (F1.58 樅 _(1)Tsung_ (zung1)) 植木以懸鐘磬者 (Page 607 #4: (1)樅 _(1)Tsung_ (zung1); here normalised to _(1)Ts(')ung_ (cung1)) A sort of tall thuja or yew (Kangxi: 松葉柏身), which furnishes timber (Kangxi: 今太廟梁材用此); to beat, as a drum (Kangxi: 撞也). Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing and incomplete strokes in 鐘. Having teeth whereupon bells are hung (Kangxi: 言崇牙之貌樅樅然也). 【樅】 (tshjowng, tsjowng) (_noun-like_) fir (_adjective-like_) toothed

zung1.text: U+6A05 枞 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 樅) 植木以懸鐘磬者 (Page 607 #4: (1)樅) Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing and incomplete strokes in 鐘. Used in 樅陽.

cung1.text: U+6C96 冲 翀 (for "soar" sense) cung4 (per 《廣韻》直弓切) (F1.58 沖) 和也又相沖 (F1.58 冲) 幼小曰冲年又相冲也 (F1.58 沖) 搖也 (Page 41 #1: (1)冲(1)沖) Young, delicate (Kangxi 沖: 幼小也, 沖童也); harmonious (Kangxi 沖: 和也); deep (Kangxi 沖: 深也), (...); to rise in the air (Kangxi 沖: 飛也); to agitate, to move; to strike against (as things do in the water) (Kangxi 沖: 涌搖也); to dart against, to rush; to send (as a letter); _(1)ch(')ung ch(')ong(3)_ (cung1 cong3 沖？) to offend, to answer back; _(4)ying (1)ch(')ung h(a/)k(8) hoi(6)_ (jing4 cung1 haak3 hoi6 迎沖客害) inauspicious calculations; _h(i/)(3) (1)ch(')ung (2)tau (4)ngau_ (hei3 cung1 dau2 ngau4 氣沖牛斗), his spirit rises to the skies; _(1)ch(')ung (1)ch(')ung_ (cung1 cung1 沖沖), sound of ornaments or other things tinkling against each other (Kangxi 沖: 聲也). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 忡 to 沖, and corrected 枂 to 相. Note that a separate entry with headword 沖 also exists, explained 搖也. Hanging down (Kangxi 沖: 垂飾貌). To offset, to counterbalance. (_astrology_) Conflicting, incompatible. 【沖】 (drjuwng) (_verb-like_) to soar (_adjective-like_) childly (_adjective-like_) hanging (down) (_onomatopoeia_) crack

U+6D8C (F1.58 涌) 涌𣽸小海者也 (Page 40* #7: (1)涌) A creek, a side stream coming into a river; _(1)ch(')ung k(a/)u(3)_ (cung1 gaau3 涌𣽸) a creek (Fan Wan: 涌𣽸小海者也); _(5)Lau (1)po (1)ch(')ung_ (lau5 bo1 cung1 柳波涌), a creek near Kaml(i/)-fau (金利埠). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰氵⿱㓁舌 to 𣽸.
U+249DA (F1.58 𤧚) 石似玉 (Page 608 #6: (1)𤧚) Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete stroke in headword 𤧚.

U+7481 May appear as either ⿰𤣩⿱囪心 (assumed here) or ⿰𤣩⿱囱心, depending on the font. 𤧚 (F1.58 𤧚) 石似玉 (Page 608 #6: (1)𤧚; here normalised to 璁) A pebble or stone, resembling a precious gem (Kangxi 璁: 石之似玉者). Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete stroke in headword 𤧚.

U+76C5 冲 沖 cung4 (alternative per 《廣韻》直弓切) (Page 39* #7: (1)盅 _(1)Chung_ (zung1); here corrected to _(1)Ch(')ung_ (cung1)) (...) a hollow vessel (Kangxi: 器虛也, 通作沖) (...); (Page 41 #1: (1)冲(1)沖; here normalised to 盅) (...), hollow (Kangxi 沖: 虛也); 【盅】 (drjuwng, trhjuwng) (_adjective-like_) empty

zung1.text: U+76C5 鍾 (F1.57 鍾) 茶鍾酒鍾又聚也又姓 (Page 39* #2: (1)鍾; here normalised to 盅) a cup or goblet; _(2)tsau (1)chung_ (zau2 zung1 酒盅), a wine-cup. (Page 39* #3: (1)鐘; here corrected to 鍾 and normalised to 盅) _kuk(9) (1)chung_ (guk6 zung1 焗盅), a covered cup for tea; _yat(7) (1)chung (4)ch(')(a/)_ (jat1 zung1 caa4 一盅茶), a cup of tea; (Page 39* #7: (1)盅) A cup, (...), generally small and covered; _(4)ngau (4)yau (1)chung_ (ngau4 jau4 zung1 牛油盅), a butter-cup; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)chung_ (caa4 zung1 茶盅), a tea-cup and cover; _kat(7) (4)sh(i/) (1)chung_ (gat1 si4 zung1 吉時盅), a custard-cup. Williams' 吉時盅: Custard is now 吉士 (gat1 si6-2) rather than 吉時 (gat1 si4).

cung1.text: U+7F7F tung4 (alternative per 《廣韻》徒紅切) (F1.58 罿) 掩兔之車 (Page 41 #4: (1)罿) A net to take birds, with a frame (Kangxi: 罬也, 幡車罔); the Fan Wan says, a frame to cover rabbits (Fan Wan: 掩兔之車). Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱罓童 to 罿, and corrected ⿰犭奄 to 掩. 【罿】 (tsyhowng, duwng) (_noun-like_) bird-net

U+7FC0 cung4 (per 《廣韻》直弓切) (F1.58 翀) 直飛上也 (Page 40* #10: (1)翀) To fly up (Kangxi: 直上飛也); to ascend to the clouds; _ch(i/)(3) (2)ho (1)ch(')ung (1)si(u/)_ (zi3 ho2 cung1 siu1 志可翀霄), aspiring talents. The reading _(1)ch(')ung_ (cung1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 敕中切, explained 上飛也.
U+8066 (F1.58 聦) 察也明也耳力也 (F1.58 聰) 同上 (Page 608 #4: (1)聰(1)聦) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 𦖟 to 聦.

U+8070 May appear as either ⿰耳⿱囪心 (assumed here) or ⿰耳⿱囱心, depending on the font. 悤 聡 聦 聪 (F1.58 聦) 察也明也耳力也 (F1.58 聰) 同上 (Page 608 #4: (1)聰(1)聦) Quick at hearing, astute, ready, quickwitted; to perceive clearly (Kangxi 聰: 聞也明也通也聽也); to discriminate intelligently (Kangxi 聰: 察也, 耳之所聞旣順且審故謂之聰); _(1)ts(')ung (4)ming_ (cung1 ming4 聰明), perspicacious, clever; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)ts(')ung_ (tin1 cung1 天聰), natural gifts; _(5)(i/) (1)ts(')ung_ (ji5 cung1 耳聰) quick at hearing; _sing(3) (1)ts(')ung_ (sing3 cung1 性聰) ready at learning. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 𦖟 to 聦. Hearing. 【聰】 (tshuwng) (_adjective-like_) hearing, well-hearing, (_met._) intelligent

U+8525 May appear as either ⿱艹⿱囪心 (assumed here) or ⿱艹⿱囱心, depending on the font. 䓗 葱 (Page 608 #8: (1)葱; here normalised to 蔥) An onion~~, garlic~~; a general name for alliaceous vegetables (Kangxi 葱: 菜也 etc.); a leek or light green (Kangxi 葱: 靑謂之蔥); ~~a vent, a tubular passage, a draft;~~ _(1)ts(')ung (4)t(')au_ (cung1 tau4 蔥頭), onions; _(1)ts(')ung luk(9)_ (cung1 luk6 蔥綠) a pea green; _(4)(u/) (1)ts(')ung_ (wu4 cung1 胡蔥), small onions; _(1)ts(')ung p(a/)k(9)_ (cung1 baak6 蔥白) the onion bulb; _(1)ts(')ung ~~(5)ling~~ (5)leng_ (cung1 leng5 蔥嶺), the ~~Karakorum~~ Pamir Mts (Kangxi 葱: 山名 etc.). Williams' "a vent, a tubular passage, a draft": This is a misreading of either Kangxi 《本草》蔥从悤外直中空有悤通之象也 (which is a description of what is probably the spring-onion) or Kangxi 氣通達也 (which is an adjective sense, not a noun sense). Williams' 蔥頭: The preferred term for "onion" in Cantonese is 洋蔥. Williams' 蔥嶺: Changed _(5)ling_ (ling5) to vernacular reading _(5)leng_ (leng5). Ventilated (Kangxi: 氣通達也). 【蔥】 (tshuwng) (_noun-like_) spring-onion (_adjective-like_) spring-onion-green

U+885D 冲 (Mainland simplified) cung3 (possibly from Mandarin-matching for "toward" and "fierce" senses) (F1.58 衝) 向也水直撞也又衝要通衢也 (Page 41 #2: (1)衝) A path, a crossway (Kangxi: 通道也 etc.); ~~to support;~~ to move, to excite; to rise or rush against (Kangxi: 當也向也突也)~~, to overflow~~; abrupt; towards; a ~~car~~ battering-chariot (Kangxi: 車也 etc.); _(1)ch(')ung i(u/)(3)_ (cung1 jiu3 衝要) a thoroughfare; _(2)shui (1)ch(')ung_ (seoi2 cung1 水衝), a canal in a city; _(1)ch(')ung (2)t(o\)_ (cung1 dou2 衝倒), to overthrow; _(1)ch(')ung (4)f(a/)n_ (cung1 faan4 衝繁), a place of great concourse. Fan Wan entry: The character 水 is likely erroneous. 【衝】 (tsyhowng) (_noun-like_) crossroad, thoroughfare (_verb-like_) to charge 【衝】 (cung1) To run a traffic light. 衝紅燈 (cung1 hung4 dang1): "Running a red light." 衝黃燈 (cung1 wong4 dang1): "Running an amber light."

U+8877 zung1 (per 《廣韻》陟弓切) (F1.58 衷) 心曲也情也 (Page 40* #11: (1)衷) Inner garments (Kangxi: 裏褻衣也); the heart; ~~to adjust;~~ sincerity (Kangxi: 誠也), rectitude (Kangxi: 中也), (...); full knowledge of; _pat(7) (1)ch(')ung_ (bat1 cung1 不衷), insincere; _(1)ch(')ung (4)ch(')(e/)ung_ (cung1 coeng4 衷腸), the feelings. Goodness (Kangxi: 善也). 【衷】 (trjuwng) (_noun-like_) inner-garment (_noun-like_) inner-feeling (_noun-like_) goodness (_adjective-like_) sincere

zung3.text: U+8877 (Page 40* #11: (1)衷 _(1)Ch(')ung_ (cung1); here corrected to _Chung(3)_ (zung3)) (...), equity; just, as a sentence (Kangxi: 不輕不重也通作中); Williams' "equity": As in compromise (Kangxi: 折衷平也).

cung1.text: U+9A18 (F1.58 騘) 鐵色馬 (Page 608 #7: (1)騘) Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete stroke in headword 騘, and corrected malformed 鐵.

U+9A44 May appear as either ⿰馬⿱囪心 (assumed here) or ⿰馬⿱囱心, depending on the font. 騘 骢 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 騘) 鐵色馬 (Page 608 #7: (1)騘; here normalised to 驄) A dapple-gray horse (Kangxi 驄: 馬靑白雜毛也 etc.)~~, a bay horse~~; _(5)'ng (1)f(a/) (1)ts(')ung_ (ng5 faa1 cung1 五花驄), a piebald, fancy horse. Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete stroke in headword 騘, and corrected malformed 鐵.

cung2.text: U+51A2 塚 (for "mound" sense) zung2 (per 《廣韻》知隴切) (F1.61 冢) 大也長子長婦俱曰冢 (Page 41 #7: (2)冡; here corrected to 冢) The peak of a hill (Kangxi 冢: 山頂也); a mound or tumulus (Kangxi 冢: 墓之墳者亦曰冢); great, honorable, first, the eldest (Kangxi 冢: 大也); _(2)ch(')ung (2)tsz'_ (cung2 zi2 冢子) the eldest son; _(2)ch(')ung (5)f(u/)_ (cung2 fu5 冢婦), the wife; _(2)ch(')ung (2)tsoi_ (cung2 zoi2 冢宰), the highest cabinet ministers. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 冡 to 冢. A high mound (Kangxi: 高墳也 etc.). A raised mound for an altar (Kangxi: 封土爲社). 【冢】 (trjowngX) (_noun-like_) mound (_adjective-like_) great, (_met._) prime

U+585A 冢 (Mainland simplified) zung2 (per 《廣韻》知隴切) (F1.61 塚) 墓封曰塚 (Page 41 #8: (2)~~塜~~塚) A grave, a tomb (Kangxi 塚: 冢俗作塚); _(1)fong (2)ch(')ung_ (fong1 cung2 荒塚), a deserted, unlucky grave; _w(a/)t(8) (2)ch(')ung_ (waat3 cung2 挖塚), to rifle a grave; _(2)ch(')ung m(o\)(6)_ (cung2 mou6 塚墓) a grave; _(4)ming (2)ch(')ung_ (ming4 cung2 明塚), a vaulted grave. Williams misprints 塚 as 塜; here corrected. (The character 塚 appears correctly on Page 751 in the character index.) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 塜 to 塚.

U+5BF5 𠖥 龍 宠 (Mainland simplified) (F1.61 寵) 愛也恩也尊榮也寵 (Page 41 #9: (2)𠖥; here normalised to 寵) Grace, kindness, affection (Kangxi 寵: 一曰愛也恩也), regard, friendship; favor of superiors; to esteem (Kangxi 寵: 尊榮也); to indulge to allow; _(2)ch(')ung oi(3)_ (cung2 oi3 寵愛) delight in; _(2)ch(')ung (1)f(i/)_ (cung2 fei1 寵妃), a favorite concubine; _(2)ch(')ung sik(7)_ (cung2 sik1 寵錫) a special favor of the king; _(4)yan (2)ch(')ung_ (jan4 cung2 仁寵), loving-kindness. (Page 713 #2: (2)𠖥(2)寵) The second form (寵) of this character is the most correct. _Ling(6) (2)ch(')ung_ (ling6 cung2 令寵), your concubine; _tak(7) (2)ch(')ung_ (dak1 cung2 得寵), to win a hushand's love. 【寵】 (trhjowngX) (_verb-like_) to favour, to adore

cung3.text: U+39E4 May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 713 #3: 㧤(3)) To leap, to jump (Kangxi: 跳也). A colloquial word. At once, altogether; to push, to hit; _ch(')ung(3) (1)ts(')an_ (cung3 can1 㧤嚫), to run upon, to thump against; _yat(7) ch(')ung(3) (1)s(a/)m (2)tau (4)yau_ (jat1 cung3 saam1 dau2 jau4 一㧤三斗油), I don't know why he is all at once so very angry.

U+9283 May appear with 𠫓 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. 铳 (Mainland simplified) (F1.62 銃) 火炮 (Page 41 #10: 銃(3)) ~~A piece of iron bored~~ The eye of an axe (Kangxi: 銎也, 斧穿也); a blunderbuss, a ginjall, a gun; _ch(')ung(3) p(')(a/)u(3)_ (cung3 paau3 銃炮) fire-arms; _ch(')ung(3) (2)shau_ (cung3 sau2 銃手), musketeers; _(2)shau ch(')ung(3)_ (sau2 cung3 手銃) small guns.

cung4.text: U+53E2 樷 藂 丛 (Mainland simplified) (F1.60 叢) 聚也又林木茂盛也 (F1.60 樷) 古文叢字 (Page 609 #3: (4)叢) A thicket, a bushy place; crowded, as trees; collected, assembled (Kangxi: 聚也) ~~in numbers~~; bushy; _(1)shang (4)ts(')ung k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (sang1 cung4 gam3 do1 生叢咁多), crowded like a grove, jammed, crowded; _(4)ts(')ung (4)lam_ (cung4 lam4 叢林), a wood, a grove, a place of concours; _sz'(3) t(a/)i(6) (4)ts(')ung (4)lam_ (sei3 daai6 cung4 lam4 四大叢林), the four large Budhist temples in Canton; _(4)lam (5)l(o\) yap(9) (1)f(a/) (4)ts(')ung_ (lam4 lou5 jap6 faa1 cung4 臨老入花叢), to become depraved when old. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 占 to 古. 【叢】 (dzuwng) (_verb-like_) to collect (_noun-like_) thicket

U+5F9E 从 従 (F1.60 從) 隨也順也就也 (Page 608 #9: (4)從) To follow, to listen to (Kangxi: 相聽也), to comply with, to agree; to believe in; commencing from, the place of origin; a preposition, from, by, through, in; since, whence (Kangxi: 自也); a way, a manner; compliance; a follower; _(4)ts(')ung (1)sam (2)sho yuk(9)_ (cung4 sam1 so2 juk6 從心所欲) what my heart desires; _(4)'m (4)ts(')ung_ (m4 cung4 唔從), uncompliant, obstinate; _(4)ts(')ung (4)loi_ (cung4 loi4 從來), heretofore; _(4)m(o\) (4)ts(')ung yap(9) (2)shau_ (mou4 cung4 jap6 sau2 無從入手), no way to begin; _yam(6) (4)ts(')ung (5)n(i/)_ (jam6 cung4 nei5 任從你), as you please, do as you like; _(1)(i/) (4)ts(')ung_ (ji1 cung4 依從), according with; _~~huk(7)~~ k(')uk(7) (4)ts(')ung_ (kuk1 cung4 曲從), constrained to obey; _(4)ts(')ung (4)yau_ (cung4 jau4 從遊), to follow about, as a teacher; _(4)ts(')ung (1)kam (5)(i/) hau(6)_ (cung4 gam1 ji5 hau6 從今以後) hereafter; _(4)ts(')ung m(i/)(6)_ (cung4 mei6 從未) never, not at all; _(4)ts(')ung (4)l(e/)ung_ (cung4 loeng4 從良), a reformed prostitute, one who enters a family; _(4)ts(')ung (2)si(u/)_ (cung4 siu2 從小), since childhood; _(1)s(a/)m (4)ts(')ung_ (saam1 cung4 三從), three compliances of a female to her father, husband, and son. Williams' 曲從: Changed _huk(7)_ (huk1) to common reading _k(')uk(7)_ (kuk1). To pursue, to partake in. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【從-follow】 (dzjowng) (_verb-like_) to follow, to pursue (_preposition-like_) from

zung1.text: U+5F9E

cung5.text: U+91CD cung5-2 (rising second in vernacular 重重地) (Page 40* #4: 重(6) _Chung(6)_ (zung6); here corrected to _(5)Ch(')ung_ (cung5)) Heavy, weighty (Kangxi: 毛氏曰凡物不輕而重則上聲); severe, heinous; _(5)yau (2)k(i/) ~~chung(6)~~ (5)ch(')ung_ (jau5 gei2 cung5 有幾重) how heavy is it? _~~chung(6)~~ (5)ch(')ung (2)t(a/)_ (cung5 daa2 重打), to beat severely; Williams (following Fan Wan) does not provide separate entries for rising-tone _(5)ch(')ung_ (cung5) and departing-tone _chung(6)_ (zung6), whose distinction is still well preserved in modern Cantonese. I have split things up accordingly, noting that the "severe, heinous" sense is able to fit both readings (and, in particular, is rising in 重病, 重刑, etc.). Kangxi has commentary claiming that the rising and departing readings were anciently interchangeable, and that maintaining a distinction between them is 拘泥之過 an "error of clinging" on the part of Sung Dynasty scholars: 按說文柱用切厚也卽與輕重義同集韻柱勇切愼也卽與鄭重義同上去雖有二音𠀤無二義古人三聲通用必謂上去異訓不可通押此宋人拘泥之過也 However, both Zhengzhang and Baxter--Sagart reconstruct *three* readings for 重 in Old Chinese, corresponding to Middle Chinese level, rising, and departing. 【重-rising】 (drjowngX) (_adjective-like_) weighty, heavy (_verb-like_) to weigh

zung6.text: U+91CD 仲 (for Cantonese "still" and "and also" senses) (F1.63 重) 厚也又愼重輕重 (Page 40* #4: 重(6)) momentous (Kangxi: 毛氏曰...因其可重而重之與再重鄭重皆去聲); severe, heinous; decorous, grave; to regard, to give importance to (Kangxi: 尊也, 尚也); a sign of the comparative; (...) _chung(6) (2)h(o\)_ (zung6 hou2 重好), still better; _shan(6) chung(6)_ (san6 zung6 慎重) ~~correct, well principled~~ prudent, careful; _tsz'(6) chung(6)_ (zi6 zung6 自重) self-respect; _chung(6) f(u/)(3) (1)h(i/) (4)p(')an_ (zung6 fu3 hei1 pan4 重富欺貧), to court the rich and despise the poor. Williams (following Fan Wan) does not provide separate entries for rising-tone _(5)ch(')ung_ (cung5) and departing-tone _chung(6)_ (zung6), whose distinction is still well preserved in modern Cantonese. I have split things up accordingly, noting that the "severe, heinous" sense is able to fit both readings (and, in particular, is departing in 嚴重). Kangxi has commentary claiming that the rising and departing readings were anciently interchangeable, and that maintaining a distinction between them is 拘泥之過 an "error of clinging" on the part of Sung Dynasty scholars: 按說文柱用切厚也卽與輕重義同集韻柱勇切愼也卽與鄭重義同上去雖有二音𠀤無二義古人三聲通用必謂上去異訓不可通押此宋人拘泥之過也 However, both Zhengzhang and Baxter--Sagart reconstruct *three* readings for 重 in Old Chinese, corresponding to Middle Chinese level, rising, and departing. Further (Kangxi: 更爲也, 重再也). 【重-departing】 (drjowngH) (_adjective-like_) weighty (_verb-like_) to weight, (_met._) to esteem 【重】 (zung6) Even more, still. 重高過我 (zung6 gou1 gwo3 ngo5): "Even taller than me." 噉重危險 (gam2 zung6 ngai4 him2): "This is even more dangerous." 噉重污糟 (gam2 zung6 wu1 zou1): "This is even dirtier." 比佢重平 (bei2 keoi5 zung6 peng4): "Cheaper still, compared to that." Yet, still. 重嚟 (zung6 lai4): "Still coming at me?" 重污糟 (zung6 wu1 zou1): "Still dirty." 重未到 (zung6 mei6 dou3): "Still yet to arrive." 重有飯 (zung6 jau5 faan6): "There's still rice." And also, as well. 重有甜品送 (zung6 jau5 tim4 ban2 sung3): "And also there's dessert given for free." All these senses of 重 are commonly spelt 仲.

cyu2.text: U+8655 処 䖏 处 (Mainland simplified) cyu5 (common in certain usages) (F1.46 處) 止居也又處置 (F1.46 䖏) 同上 (F1.46 処) 同上 (Page 32* #10: (2)處(2)処) To dwell, to reside (Kangxi 處: 居也); to be, to act, to occupy the place of; while in; to distinguish (Kangxi 處: 分別也), to manage, to judge, to decide on, to attend to, to do what is proper; to place; _~~(2)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u (2)tsz'_ (cyu5 zi2 處子) a young lady; _(2)ch(')(u ch(i/)(6) (1)t(')(a/)_ (cyu2 zi6 taa1 處治他), do it for him, settle him, fix him; _(1)s(e/)ung ~~(2)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u_ (soeng1 cyu5 相處), familiar, friendly; _~~(2)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u (1)kwan (4)shan_ (cyu5 gwan1 san4 處君臣), to be an officer; _(4)n(a/)n (2)ch(')(u_ (naan4 cyu2 難處), not easy to judge; _(2)ch(')(u ~~k(ut(8)~~ k(')(ut(8)_ (cyu2 kyut3 處決) execute him; _~~(2)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u (1)f(u/) (5)f(u/)_ (cyu5 fu1 fu5 處夫婦) when married. I have changed _(2)ch(')(u_ (cyu2) to the common reading _(5)ch(')(u_ (cyu5) when it seems appropriate (although I am not aware of any logic that can be used to determine when this is the case). From personal experience: The classical reading _(2)ch(')(u_ (cyu2) seems mandatory in 處決, 處置. The common reading _(5)ch(')(u_ (cyu5) seems preferred in 共處, 判處, 懲處, 獨處, 相處, 處分, 處境, 處女, 處斬, 處方, 處死, 處罰. Either reading seems acceptable in 處世, 處事, 處理. Williams' 處決: Changed _k(ut(8)_ (gyut3) to common reading _k(')(ut(8)_ (kyut3). (_adjective_) Virgin. 【處-rising】 (tsyhoX) (_verb-like_) to reside, to stay, (_met._) virgin (_verb-like_) to place
