To mark (Kangxi: 著標著也). Position, place (Kangxi: 著位次也). 【著-departing】 (trjoH) (_noun-like_) position, place (_verb-like_) to manifest, to make evident (_adjective-like_) manifest, evident, (_met._) notable (_verb-like_) to write

cyu5.text: U+8CAF 宁 贮 (Mainland simplified) zyu2 (per 《廣韻》丁吕切) (F1.47 貯) 積貯 (Page 32* #12: (5)宁; here normalised to 貯) to accumulate (Kangxi 宁: 宁辨積物也). (Page 33* #2: (5)貯) To hoard, to store up, to lay by in safety (Kangxi: 積也, 藏也); a hoard, a treasure; _(5)ch(')(u tsik(7)_ (cyu5 zik1 貯積) to accumulate; _(5)ch(')(u tun(6)_ (cyu5 deon6 貯頓) to store up goods; _(4)ts(')(un (5)ch(')(u_ (cyun4 cyu5 存貯) or _(5)ch(')(u (4)m(a/)i_ (cyu5 maai4 貯埋), to lay by. 【貯】 (trjoX) (_verb-like_) to stockpile

cyun1.text: U+5DDD 巛 (F2.19 川) 山川衆流也又川穿也謂穿地而流也 (Page 38* #2: (1)川) ~~Mountain~~ streams, ~~perennial~~ brooks (Kangxi: 穿也穿地而流也); _(1)ch(')(un (4)lau pat(7) sik(7)_ (cyun1 lau4 bat1 sik1 川流不息) perennial, unceasing; _(1)ch(')(un ~~(4)ngai~~ (4)ng(a/)i_ (cyun1 ngaai4 川崖), a cascade. Williams' 川崖: Corrected _(4)ngai_ (ngai4) to _(4)ng(a/)i_ (ngaai4). Short for 四川. 【川】 (tsyhwen) (_noun-like_) stream

U+6751 邨 (F2.20 村) 鄕落曰村 (F2.20 邨) 同上 (Page 604 #7: (1)村(1)邨) A hamlet, a village (Kangxi 村: 墅也, 聚落也); _(1)h(e/)ung (1)ts(')(un_ (hoeng1 cyun1 鄉村), a village, the country; _(1)ts(')(un tsuk(9)_ (cyun1 zuk6 村俗) rustic, unpolished; _(1)ts(')(un (1)f(u/)_ (cyun1 fu1 村夫), a villager, an uneducated man.

U+7A7F 䆤 䆥 cyun3 (per 《廣韻》尺絹切 for "thorough" sense) (F2.19 穿) 貫也鑿也 (Page 38* #3: (1)穿) To bore through (Kangxi: 委曲入也鑽也鑿也), to perforate (Kangxi: 通也穴也); to clothe, to put on; to string; _(1)ch(')(un tsok(9)_ (cyun1 zok6 穿鑿) to open a hole; _(1)ch(')(un (4)fong (2)shai ~~f(u/)n(3)~~ (u/)n(6)_ (cyun1 fong4 sai2 wun6 穿房使喚) a servant of all work; _(1)ch(')(un (1)sh(a/) (1)p(o\)_ (cyun1 saa1 bou1 穿砂煲), to show the falsity of; _(1)ch(')(un (1)kam t(a/)i(3) (4)ngan_ (cyun1 gam1 daai3 ngan4 穿金戴銀), she wears gold and robes in silver; _(1)ch(')(un (1)ch(u_ (cyun1 zyu1 穿珠), to string beads; _(1)ch(')(un (4)h(a/)i_ (cyun1 haai4 穿鞋), to pull on shoes; _(1)ch(')(un (1)sh(a/)n k(a/)p(8)_ (cyun1 saan1 gaap3 穿山甲) the manis. Note that the (now obsolete) departing-tone reading is cognate with 串 cyun3. Fan Wan entry: Normalised ⿱⿰凿殳金 (with a stroke missing) to 鑿. Williams' 穿房使喚: Changed _f(u/)n(3)_ (fun3) to modern _(u/)n(6)_ (wun6). Williams' 穿砂煲: Now simply 穿煲. Williams' 穿山甲: Here, "manis" means pangolin. Thorough (in understanding) (Kangxi: 貫也). 【穿】 (tsyhwen) (_verb-like_) to bore through 【穿煲】 (cyun1 bou1) To have a secret or embarrassing information exposed. 【穿窿】 (cyun1 lung4-1) To develop a hole.
U+90A8 (F2.20 村) 鄕落曰村 (F2.20 邨) 同上 (Page 604 #7: (1)村(1)邨) Commonly used in housing estate names in Hong Kong (e.g. 彩虹邨).

cyun2.text: U+5598 端 (F2.21 喘) 氣緊 (Page 38* #8: (2)喘) To pant, to gasp (Kangxi: 疾息也, 喘息); the breath, the life; _(4)ts(')(a/)n (2)ch(')(un_ (caan4 cyun2 殘喘), my poor life, ready to perish; _(2)ch(')(un fai(6)_ (cyun2 fai6 喘吠) to wheeze and cough. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱⿰臣⿱𠂉一糸 to 緊. To speak quietly or subtly (Kangxi: 微言). 【喘】 (tsyhwenX) (_verb-like_) to gasp

U+5FD6 (F2.22 忖) 村上聲思也度也 (Page 605 #11: (2)忖) To consider, to reflect on (Kangxi: 思也); to guess, to surmise (Kangxi: 度也); _(2)ts(')(un tok(9)_ (cyun2 dok6 忖度) to conjecture, to calculate. 【忖】 (tshwonX) (_verb-like_) to consider
U+651B (F2.21 攛) 擲也 (Page 38* #7: (2)攛) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword.

cyun3.text: U+651B 竄 (for "tempt" sense) 撺 (Mainland simplified) cyun1 (per Kangxi 七丸切 for "tempt" sense) cyun2 (per Fan Wan) (F2.21 攛 _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2)) 擲也 (Page 38* #6: (2)竄 _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2); here normalised to 攛 _Ts(')(un(3)_ (cyun3)) to seduce, to beguile (Kangxi 竄: 誘人爲惡曰竄俗曰攛掇); (Page 38* #7: (2)攛 _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2); here normalised to _Ts(')(un(3)_ (cyun3)) To fling away (Kangxi: 擲也); to tempt, to seduce to evil (Kangxi: 俗謂誘人爲非曰攛掇); to get one to consent; _~~(2)ch(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3) ch(ut(8)_ (cyun3 zyut3 攛掇) to entice, to inveigle. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword.

cyun2.text: U+7AC4 (F2.21 竄) 也竄驅逐也 (Page 38* #6: (2)竄) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword. The first two characters 也竄 of the explanation are erroneous.

cyun3.text: U+7AC4 窜 (Mainland simplified) cyun2 (per Fan Wan) (F2.21 竄 _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2)) 也竄驅逐也 (Page 38* #6: (2)竄 _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2); here normalised to _Ts(')(un(3)_ (cyun3)) To sneak away, to hide, to skulk (Kangxi: 匿也逃也); ~~to kill~~ to exile, to punish (Kangxi: 放也誅也); to fumigate (Kangxi: 竄以藥薰之也); to secrete (Kangxi: 藏也隱也); ~~petty, weak, pusillanimous;~~ _~~(2)ch(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3) nik(7)_ (cyun3 nik1 竄匿) to hide away; _(4)t(')(o\) ~~(2)ch(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3)_ (tou4 cyun3 逃竄), to run off; _~~(2)ch(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3) s(i/)t(8)_ (cyun3 sit3 竄竊) to pilfer. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword. The first two characters 也竄 of the explanation are erroneous. In secret (Kangxi: 竄微也). To alter (Kangxi: 改易也). To put, to place. 【竄】 (tshwanH) (_verb-like_) to skulk (_verb-like_) to exile

cyun2.text: U+821B 僢 踳 (F2.21 舛) 差謬也錯亂也 (Page 38* #5: (2)舛) Erroneous (Kangxi: 舛錯也, 錯亂也), opposed (Kangxi: 舛偝也 etc.); to contradict; the 136th radical (U+2F87 ⾇ "oppose"); _(2)ch(')(un ts(')ok(8)_ (cyun2 cok3 舛錯) wrong; _(2)ch(')(un mau(6)_ (cyun2 mau6 舛謬) ~~to deceive~~ absurd. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 錯, and corrected malformed 亂. Williams' 舛錯: Now more commonly read _(2)ch(')(un ts(')o(3)_ (cyun2 co3). Difficult (as a situation). 【舛】 (tsyhwenX) (_adjective-like_) contrary

cyun4.text: U+9044 cyun2 (per Williams) (F2.56 遄 _(2)Ch(')ui_ (ceoi2)) 速也 (Page 38* #9: (2)遄 _(2)Ch(')(un_ (cyun2); here normalised to _(4)Ch(')(un_ (cyun4)) To go quickly (Kangxi: 往來數也, 疾也速也); haste, speed; ~~to go and come.~~ ~~Also read _chui(3)_ (zeoi3) with the same meaning.~~ Williams' "to go and come": This is a misreading of Kangxi 往來數也. Here, 數 is to be read in entering tone, _shok(8)_ (sok3), meaning "frequently". Thus, 往來數也 should be rendered "to go and come frequently", and defines the same sense as 疾也速也. 【遄】 (dzywen) (_adverb-like_) quickly

cyun3.text: U+4E32 (F2.23 串) 穿也貫也 (Page 38* #10: 串(3)) To string together (Kangxi: 物相連貫也與穿讀去聲通穿亦作串); to connect; leagued or banded; a string of; _yat(7) ch(')(un(3) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (jat1 cyun3 cin4 一串錢), a string of cash; _yat(7) ch(')(un(3) p(')(a/)u(3)_ (jat1 cyun3 paau3 一串炮) a string of crackers; _ch(')(un(3) kai(3)_ (cyun3 gai3 串計) to intrigue; _ch(')(un(3) (4)t(')au_ (cyun3 tau4 串頭), a plan to swindle; _ch(')(un(3) (4)m(a/)i_ (cyun3 maai4 串埋), to make a party or band. Cognate with the (now obsolete) departing-tone reading of 穿. To play a role, to perform. 【串】 (cyun3) To spell (of words in an alphabetic language). 點串啊 (dim2 cyun3 a3): "How do you spell it?" 唔識串 (m4 sik1 cyun3): "I don't know how to spell it." Arrogant, cocky. The spelling 串 for this word is arbitrary.

U+5BF8 (F2.23 寸) 分寸 (Page 606 #1: 寸(3)) The Chinese inch (Kangxi: 十分也), regarded as long as the middle joint of the finger; the tenth of a foot, and varies according to the _ch(')ek(8)_ (cek3 尺) (Kangxi: 十寸爲一尺)_;_ a very little; the 41st radical (U+2F28 ⼨ "inch"); _ts(')(un(3) (1)sam_ (cyun3 sam1 寸心) or _(1)fong ts(')(un(3)_ (fong1 cyun3 方寸) the heart; _ts(')(un(3) (2)hau_ (cyun3 hau2 寸口), place of the pulse (Kangxi: 人手卻一寸動脈謂之寸口); _sik(7) ts(')(un(3) (1)yam_ (sik1 cyun3 jam1 惜寸陰), improve every moment of time; _y(e/)uk(9) (5)yau ts(')(un(3) tsun(3)_ (joek6 jau5 cyun3 zeon3 若有寸進) have got on a little --- a depreciating phrase; _ts(')(un(3)_ (cyun3 寸), _(1)kw(a/)n_ (gwaan1 關), _ch(')ek(8)_ (cek3 尺) are three locations of the pulse; _~~tak(7)~~ tak(9) (1)sau ts(')(un(3) tsz'(6)_ (dak6 sau1 cyun3 zi6 特修寸字) I have written a little note; _~~(5)lo~~ (2)lo ch(')ek(8) ts(')(un(3)_ (lo2 cek3 cyun3 攞尺寸) get its measure. In accounts, often used as a contraction of _s(un(3)_ (syun3) 算 to reckon. Williams' "improve": In the (now) dated sense of employing to good purpose. Williams' 特修寸字: Corrected _tak(7)_ (dak1) to _tak(9)_ (dak6). Williams' 攞尺寸: Corrected _(5)lo_ (lo5) to _(2)lo_ (lo2). 【寸】 (tshwonH) (_noun-like_) inch

U+7228 May appear with interior of top-middle component as ⿱一丅 (+25 assumed here), ⿱一コ (+25), or ⿱一口 (+26), depending on the font. 熶 㸑 cyun1 (alternative per 《集韻》七丸切 for verb sense) (F2.22 㸑 _(2)Ts(')(un_ (cyun2)) 炊也 (Page 605 #12: (2)㸑 _(2)Ts(')(un_ (cyun2); here corrected to _Ts(')(un(3)_ (cyun3) and normalised to 爨) A furnace or cooking-place (Kangxi 爨: 竈也 etc.); a mess, a table; to cook over a fire (Kangxi 爨: 炊也) ~~gently~~; ~~to steam;~~ _(1)ch(')ui ~~(2)ts(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3)_ (ceoi1 cyun3 炊爨) to cook; _tsz'(6) (2)k(i/) (1)hoi ~~(2)ts(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3)_ (zi6 gei2 hoi1 cyun3 自己開爨), eats by himself; _(1)fan ~~(2)ts(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3)_ (fan1 cyun3 分爨), to eat at separate tables; _(4)t(')ung ~~(2)ts(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3)_ (tung4 cyun3 同爨), at the same table, messmate; _t(a/)p(8) ~~(2)ts(')(un~~ ts(')(un(3)_ (daap3 cyun3 搭爨), a boarder. 【爨】 (tshwanH, tshwan) (_noun-like_) cookstove 【開火爨】 (hoi1 fo2 cyun3) To start a fire stove (and, by extension, to cook).

U+91E7 钏 (Mainland simplified) cyun1 (common) (F2.23 釧) 釵釧手鈪也 (Page 38* #11: 釧(3)) A bracelet or armlet (Kangxi: 臂環也 etc.); ~~an amulet on the arm,~~ also called _(4)t(')i(u/) t(')(ut(8)_ (tiu4 tyut3 條脫) ~~a warder off~~. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing dots in 釵.

cyun4.text: U+50B3 传 (Mainland simplified) (F2.21 傳) 傳授傳布傳遞又續也 (Page 38* #4: (4)傳) To transfer (Kangxi: 轉也), to transmit, to hand down, to perpetuate (Kangxi: 授也續也); to deliver an order; to propagate (Kangxi: 布也); ~~to carry over, as a balance;~~ ~~to narrate, to record;~~ _(4)ch(')(un shau(6)_ (cyun4 sau6 傳授) to deliver to; _(4)ch(')(un k(a/)u(3)_ (cyun4 gaau3 傳教) to instruct in; _(4)ch(')(un (1)san (4)man_ (cyun4 san1 man4 傳新聞), to tell the news; _(4)ch(')(un (4)(i/)n_ (cyun4 jin4 傳言), to send a message; _(4)ch(')(un (1)kung_ (cyun4 gung1 傳供), a local interpreter in a government office; _(4)ch(')(un sh(ut(8)_ (cyun4 syut3 傳說) a rumor. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 授 and 遞. Williams' 傳教: Now to proselytise (especially Christianity). Williams' 傳言: Also a rumour. Williams' 傳說: Also a legend, a tale. To shift (Kangxi: 移也). To summon, to call. 【傳-level】 (drjwen) (_verb-like_) to transmit (_verb-like_) to summon

zyun3.text: U+50B3 传 (Mainland simplified) A relay station (Kangxi: 傳舍 etc.). A relay carriage (Kangxi: 遽也驛遞曰傳 etc.). 【傳-unvoiced】 (trjwenH) (_noun-like_) relay

zyun6.text: U+50B3 传 (Mainland simplified) zyun6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun for "biography/narrative/legend" sense) (F2.23 傳) 執愿切古書曰傳 (Page 38* #1: 傳(6)) Records or precepts of ancient times (Kangxi: 訓也賢人之書曰傳又紀載事迹以傳於世亦曰傳諸史列傳是也, 傳傳也以傳示後人也); _ch(un(6) (4)man_ (zyun6 man4 傳文), a record or story, an account of. Fan Wan entry: The supplied dissection 執愿切 is incorrect, as it results in the 陰去 reading _ch(un(3)_ (zyun3), rather than the intended 陽去 reading _ch(un(6)_ (zyun6). Corrected headword ⿰亻⿳甫一寸 to 傳. The pronunciation of 傳 in the term 傳奇 "legend" is contentious in Cantonese. The choices are: cyun4 kei4, held by a few who assert that 傳奇 means "transmitted oddity" from etymological considerations; and zyun6 kei4, which is defensible as "chronicled oddity", and is by far the accepted common reading in Hong Kong, as attested in the following songs: 似是故人來 (1991) sung by Anita Mui. 早班火車 (1992) sung by Beyond. A chronicle. A commentary. A biography, a narrative, a legend. Successively (Kangxi: 續也). 【傳-departing】 (drjwenH) (_noun-like_) chronicle (_noun-like_) commentary

cyun4.text: U+5168 㒰 (F2.21 全) 完備也 (Page 604 #8: (4)全) Complete, entire, unbroken, perfect (Kangxi: 完也); all, the whole (Kangxi: 具也); to finish, to do all that is required; _(4)ts(')(un (4)nang_ (cyun4 nang4 全能), almighty; plenipotentiary, having full powers; _(4)ts(')(un f(u/)(3) (1)tsing (4)shan_ (cyun4 fu3 zing1 san4 全副精神), with undivided energies; _(4)ts(')(un s(a/)i(3)_ (cyun4 saai3 全嗮) all complete; _(4)ts(')(un (2)h(o\)_ (cyun4 hou2 全好), all right; _(4)ts(')ai (4)ts(')(un_ (cai4 cyun4 齊全), complete throughout; _(4)ts(')(un (1)k(a/) l(i/)(6) sz'(6)_ (cyun4 gaa1 lei6 si6 全家利事) may your whole family prosper; Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 備. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【全】 (dzjwen) (_adjective-like_) complete, whole

U+5B58 (F2.21 存) 留也在也 (Page 605 #9: (4)存) To preserve, to defend from injury; alive, to exist (Kangxi: 存在也); to lay by; to take care of, as of one's life; to inquire after (Kangxi: 恤問也), as one's health; to heedfully look after (Kangxi: 省也); _(4)ts(')(un h(a/)(6)_ (cyun4 haa6 存下) lay this aside; _(4)ts(')(un (1)sam_ (cyun4 sam1 存心), to ~~be of the same~~ keep in the mind; _(4)ts(')(un (1)f(a/)n yat(7) (2)t(i/)m hau(6) yui(6)_ (cyun4 faan1 jat1 dim2 hau6 jeoi6 存返一點後裔) there remains one descendant only; _(4)ts(')(un (4)mong_ (cyun4 mong4 存亡), to preserve and to ruin; to continue and to lose; _(i/)(3) (4)ts(')(un_ (ji3 cyun4 意存), a settled purpose; _~~(5)ts(')(un~~ (4)ts(')(un (4)lau_ (cyun4 lau4 存留), to detain, to keep back; _k(o\)(3) (4)ts(')(un_ (gou3 cyun4 告存), to inform the emperor of one's health, as old or octogenarian officers should. Williams' 存留: Corrected _(5)ts(')(un_ (cyun5) to _(4)ts(')(un_ (cyun4). 【存】 (dzwon) (_verb-like_) to exist, to be (_verb-like_) to preserve
U+62F4 cyun1 (per 《廣韻》此縁切) (F2.20 拴 _(4)S(un_ (syun4)) 揀也 (Page 605 #1: (4)拴) To select from, to pick out from with the hand (Kangxi: 揀也).

U+6522 攅 櫕 欑 攒 (Mainland simplified) zaan2 (possibly from Mandarin-matching in 積攢) zyun6 (per 《廣韻》在玩切 for "gather" sense) (F2.21 攢) 聚也又攢盒 (Page 605 #7: (4)~~？~~攅; here normalised to 攢) ~~Interchanged with 欑;~~ to collect, to come together, to assemble (Kangxi 攢: 族聚也); to lay a coffin under a shed, and not bury it (Kangxi 攢: 不葬而掩其柩曰攢亦作欑); _(4)ts(')(un h(o\)p(9)_ (cyun4 hap6-2 攢盒) a box with partitions, used for sweetmeats. The reading _(4)ts(')(un_ (cyun4) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 徂官切, explained 族聚也 etc. The reading _(2)ts(a/)n_ (zaan2) is used in 積攢 "accumulate/save". Whilst this reading appears in 《集韻》 as 子䍐切, the explanation 折也 is unrelated in meaning. Therefore, I would wager that zaan2 is from analogy with the Mandarin reading zan in 積攢. Williams' "Interchanged with 欑": The character 攢 can be written as 欑, but not the other way round.
U+6B11 櫕 (Page 605 #7: (4)~~？~~攅; here corrected to 欑) ~~Interchanged with 欑;~~ poles and thatch to cover a coffin (Kangxi 欑: 輴盛柩之車欑猶菆也菆木于輴之四面至于棺上以泥塗之); (...). 【欑】 (dzwan) (_noun-like_) pole-heap

U+6CC9 湶 (F2.21 泉) 源泉有源之水也 (Page 605 #8: (4)泉) A fountain, a spring (Kangxi: 濫泉正出正出涌出也 etc.); the headwaters of a river (Kangxi: 水原也); a department in Fuhkien (福建), Ts(')iuen-chau f(u/) (泉州府) or Chinchew (泉州); _~~(2)tsing~~ (2)tseng (4)ts(')(un_ (zeng2 cyun4 井泉), a well; _lap(9) (4)ts(')(un_ (lap6 cyun4 立泉) a cascade (Kangxi: 瀑布曰立泉); _(4)wong (4)ts(')(un_ (wong4 cyun4 黃泉), elysiun; _(2)kau (4)ts(')(un_ (gau2 cyun4 九泉), hades; _fo(3) (4)ts(')(un_ (fo3 cyun4 貨泉), money, cash (Kangxi: 貨泉卽錢也); _(4)ts(')(un l(o\)(6)_ (cyun4 lou6 泉路) ~~the shades~~ the underworld; _(4)lau (4)ts(')(un (5)y(e/)ung (5)l(o\)_ (lau4 cyun4 joeng5 lou5 流泉養老), to cherish one's old age. Williams' 井泉: Changed _(2)tsing_ (zing2) to vernacular reading _(2)tseng_ (zeng2). Williams' 泉路: Not "the shades", which are souls of the dead in Greek mythology, but their abode, i.e. the underworld. 【泉】 (dzjwen) (_noun-like_) spring, springwater

U+75CA 全 (in 痊癒 spelt 全愈) cyun1 (per 《廣韻》此縁切) (F2.20 痊 _(4)S(un_ (syun4)) 病愈曰痊 (Page 604 #8: (4)全; here normalised to 痊) _(4)ts(')(un (u(6)_ (cyun4 jyu6 全愈) entirely well. (Page 605 #2: (4)痊) Cured, healed, convalescent, recovered (Kangxi: 病瘳也, 病除也); _peng(6) (4)ts(')(un_ (beng6 cyun4 病痊), recovered from illness.

U+7B4C cyun1 (per 《廣韻》此縁切) (F2.20 筌 _(4)S(un_ (syun4)) 裝魚之器 (Page 605 #3: (4)筌) A crab-trap; a bamboo trap for fish (Kangxi: 取魚竹器, 捕魚器今之斗回也), having a small entrance; _tak(7) (4)(u (4)mong (4)ts(')(un_ (dak1 jyu4 mong4 cyun4 得魚忘筌) to get the fish and then forget the trap---ungrateful for benefits. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱⿰共士衣 to 裝. 【筌】 (tshjwen) (_noun-like_) fish-trap

U+8A6E 诠 (Mainland simplified) cyun1 (per 《廣韻》此縁切) (F2.20 詮 _(4)S(un_ (syun4)) 懌言也解喻也評論事理也 (Page 605 #4: (4)詮) To explain, to comment on (Kangxi: 解喩也); ~~select sayings;~~ to illustrate, to expound (Kangxi: 具也 etc.) ~~books~~; to discourse upon, to set forth and enforce; _ch(u(3) (4)ts(')(un_ (zyu3 cyun4 註詮), explained by notes. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 解, and corrected 愉 to 喻. Williams' "select sayings": This is a direct rendering Kangxi 擇言也, but does not sit right, given it is part of the "explain" sense.

U+8DE7 zaan1 (per 《廣韻》阻頑切 for "prostrate" sense) zeon1 (per 《廣韻》將倫切 for "stooped/curled" sense) zyun1 (per 《廣韻》莊緣切 for "kick", "stooped/curled", and "crawl" senses) (F2.20 跧 _(4)S(un_ (syun4)) 伏也 (Page 605 #5: (4)跧) Stooping, creeping, bent down (Kangxi: 一曰卑也絭也); to kick (Kangxi: 蹴也); to go along doubled over (Kangxi: 跧莊匍匐也); ~~decrepit.~~ Prostrate (Kangxi: 伏也). To walk crookedly (Kangxi: 行曲).

U+8E72 ceon1 (per 《集韻》七倫切 for "dancing" sense) cyun2 (per 《集韻》粗本切 for "gather" sense) deon1 (possibly from Mandarin-matching) zeon1 (common) (F2.21 蹲) 踞也坐也又舞貌 (Page 605 #10: (4)蹲) To sit cross-legged; to sit cuddled up, to sit on the heels (Kangxi: 踞也); ~~to make antics~~ dancing, moving with regularity (Kangxi: 蹲蹲舞貌, 蹲蹲行有節); to sit haughtily; ~~placed together~~ gathered, as scales of armor (Kangxi: 聚也). 【蹲-squat】 (dzwon) (_verb-like_) to squat 【蹲-dancing】 (tshwin) (_adverb-like_) (dancing) rhythmically

U+9293 铨 (Mainland simplified) cyun1 (per 《廣韻》此縁切) (F2.20 銓 _(4)S(un_ (syun4)) 衡也度也 (Page 605 #6: (4)銓) To weigh, to measure (Kangxi: 衡也, 量也次也度也); to estimate the quantity of things, to value; to choose according to merit or value; a carpenter's plane (Kangxi: 平木器); _(4)ts(')(un (2)s(un_ (cyun4 syun2 銓選), to select, as proper officers. 【銓】 (tshjwen) (_verb-like_) to weigh

cyun5.text: U+9C52 鳟 (Mainland simplified) zyun1 (common) zyun6 (recast to departing) (F2.22 鱒) 赤目魚 (Page 605 #13: (5)鱒) A fish like the roach, with small scales and red eyes (Kangxi: 鱒似鯶魚而鱗細於鯶赤眼). In Japan, this character denotes the salmon. Williams' "In Japan, ... denotes the salmon": I am not knowledgeable enough in either Japanese or biology to say whether this is unreasonable. Note that both 鮭 _sake_ (salmon?) and 鱒 _masu_ (trout?) belong to the Salmonidae family. The trout. 【鱒】 (dzwonX, dzwonH) (_noun-like_) redeye-carp

cyut3.text: U+5352 䘚 (F2.24 卒) 急也速也 (Page 610 #3: 卒(8)) An adverb, hastily, suddenly, abruptly (Kangxi: 急也, 匆遽之貌); urgently; _ts(')(ut(8) kap(7)_ (cyut3 gap1 卒急) in a hurry; _ts(')(ut(8) ts(')(ut(8)_ (cyut3 cyut3 卒卒) expeditiously; _ts(')(ut(8) (4)(i/)n (4)loi t(o\)(3)_ (cyut3 jin4 loi4 dou3 卒然來到) he suddenly came upon one; _ts(')(ut(8) (4)(i/)n (1)k(a/)n_ (cyut3 jin4 gaan1 卒然間), all in a hurry. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𬨮 to 速. 【卒-abruptly】 (tshwot) (_adverb-like_) abruptly

zeot1.text: U+5352 䘚 (F2.54 卒) 終也又兵卒 (Page 609 #5: 卒(7)) Those who execute orders (Kangxi: 隸人給事者); lictors, soldiers, underlings, menials; to conclude, to finish (Kangxi: 盡也, 終盡也); to die, to come to an end (Kangxi: 大夫死曰卒); to the end; _(1)ping tsut(7)_ (bing1 zeot1 兵卒) soldiers; _(2)si(u/) tsut(7)_ (siu2 zeot1 小卒) camp followers; _peng(6) tsut(7)_ (beng6 zeot1 病卒) ~~disease is mortal~~ died of disease; _tsut(7) (4)wai sh(i/)n(6) sz'(6)_ (zeot1 wai4 sin6 si6 卒為善士) to the last he was a good man. 【卒-end】 (tswit) (_verb-like_) to end, to conclude (_adverb-like_) finally, completely 【卒-serviceman】 (tswot) (_noun-like_) serviceman (_noun-like_) troops 【卒之】 (zeot1 zi1) Finally, eventually.

cyut3.text: U+637D zeot1 (per 《正韻牋》卽律切 for "grasp" sense, common for all senses) zyut6 (per 《廣韻》昨没切) (Page 610 #5: 捽(8)) To grasp, to clutch, to seize (Kangxi: 手持也), as by the nape; to butt, to push (Kangxi: 觸也); to pluck out (Kangxi: 拔取也); _ts(')(ut(8) (4)k(')(i/) f(a/)t(8)_ (cyut3 kei4 faat3 捽其髮) to clench his hair; _ts(')(ut(8) (2)keng_ (cyut3 geng2 捽頸), to take by the nape. To conflict, to clash (Kangxi: 交對也). 【捽】 (dzwot) (_verb-like_) to grasp (_verb-like_) to pick (_verb-like_) to clash, to conflict

zeot1.text: U+637D 【捽】 (zeot1) To rub. 捽乾淨 (zeot1 gon1 zeng6): "Rub it clean." 捽瘀血 (zeot1 jyu2 hyut3): "Rub a bruise." 唔好捽眼 (m4 hou2 zeot1 ngaan5): "Don't rub the eyes." The spelling 捽 is arbitrary (but well established).

cyut3.text: U+64AE zyut3 (per 《廣韻》子括切 for "pull" sense) (F2.24 撮) 兩指蹙聚而取曰撮又四圭曰撮 (Page 610 #1: 撮(8)) To take a pinch with two or three fingers (Kangxi: 一曰兩指撮也, 三指取也); a pinch, a pugil; to take up a little; ~~to snatch,~~ to bring together (Kangxi: 撮摠取也); a little, a handfull; a measure of 256 (some say 60) grains of millet (Kangxi: 四圭曰撮三指撮之也六十四黍爲圭); brought together, selected (Kangxi: 蹙聚而捎取之也); _ts(')(ut(8) i(u/)(3)_ (cyut3 jiu3 撮要) a selection of what is important; _yat(7) ts(')(ut(8) k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (jat1 cyut3 gam3 do1 一撮咁多), as much as a pinch, a little; _yat(7) ts(')(ut(8) (2)t(')(o\)_ (jat1 cyut3 tou2 一撮土), a piece of land; _ts(')(ut(8) (4)m(a/)i yat(7) p(o\)(6)_ (cyut3 maai4 jat1 bou6 撮埋一部) make them all into one book; _ts(')(ut(8) (5)sh(e/)ung ~~(5)ki(u/)~~ (2)ki(u/)_ (cyut3 soeng5 giu6-2 撮上轎), to force one into a sedan; _ts(')(ut(8) h(o\)p(9)_ (cyut3 hap6 撮合) to make~~,~~ an affiance, a partnership. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰扌⿳冖一取 to 撮, and fixed missing strokes in 蹙聚. Williams' "(some say 60) grains": Per 《孫子算經》六粟為一圭十圭為一撮. Williams' 撮上轎: Corrected _(5)ki(u/)_ (giu6-5) to _(2)ki(u/)_ (giu6-2). To extract. To pull (Kangxi: 挽也). 【撮】 (tshwat) (_noun-like_) pinch (_noun-like_) small-cap

U+731D 卒 (for "abruptly/hastily" senses) (F2.24 猝) 倉猝暴疾貌 (Page 610 #4: 猝(8)) Similar to the last (卒). A dog rushing from a cover (Kangxi: 犬从艸暴出逐人也); abrupt (Kangxi: 言倉卒...突也); fierce, precipitate (Kangxi: 暴疾也); _(1)ts(')ong ts(')(ut(8)_ (cong1 cyut3 倉猝) impetuous; ~~perplexed driven by many affairs~~.
U+855D May appear as either ⿱艹絕 (assumed here) or ⿱艹絶, depending on the font. (Page 610 #2: ~~？~~蕝(8)蕞(8))

zyut3.text: U+855D May appear as either ⿱艹絕 (assumed here) or ⿱艹絶, depending on the font. 蕞 cyut3 (per Williams) zyut6 (common) (Page 610 #2: ~~？~~蕝(8)蕞(8) _Ts(')(ut(8)_ (cyut3); here normalised to _Ts(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) A bundle or sheaf of coarse sedge used for straining or pouring spirits through (Kangxi 蕝: 蕝謂束茅而立之所以縮酒, 通蕞). Williams' reading of _ts(')(ut(8)_ (cyut3) takes after the Fan Wan reading for 蕞 in the unrelated sense of "small". See 蕞 cyut3. Williams' "used for straining or pouring spirits through": This is a faithful rendering of Kangxi 所以縮酒. However, Kangxi does not give the sense from 《說文》, supplemented below. Bundled thatch used to indicate the place of attendees in a meeting (per 《說文》朝會束茅表位曰蕝).

zeoi3.text: U+855E cyut3 (per Fan Wan) zeoi6 (per 《廣韻》才外切) (F2.24 蕞 _Ts(')(ut(8)_ (cyut3)) 小國曰蕞爾 (Page 610 #2: ~~？~~蕝(8)蕞(8)) The second (蕞) is otherwise read _tsui(3)_ (zeoi3)_;_ small, vile, base, insignificant (Kangxi 蕞: 小貌); ~~_tsui(3) ts(u(6)_ (zeoi3 zeoi6 蕞聚) to collect together.~~

e6.text: U+35A1 【㖡】 (e6) A filler used to express uncertainty or hesitation. 飲㖡香片啦 (jam2 e6... hoeng1 pin3-2 la1): "We'll drink erm... jasmine tea." The spelling 㖡 is arbitrary.

faa1.text: U+82B1 華 (F2.73 花) 草木之葩 (F2.73 華) 華美亦作花 (Page 42 #10: (1)花(1)華) A blossom, a flower (Kangxi 花: 草木之葩也); pleasure, vice; variegated, ornamental, carved; to exaggerate; _yat(7) ~~(1)to~~ (2)to (1)f(a/)_ (jat1 do2 faa1 一朵花), a flower; _yat(7) ~~chat(7)~~ ch(a/)t(8) (1)f(a/)_ (jat1 zaat3 faa1 一紮花), a bouquet; _~~(1)ming~~ (4)ming (1)f(a/)_ (ming4 faa1 名花), ornamental flowers; _(1)f(a/) (1)shang_ (faa1 sang1 花生), the ground-nut; _(1)f(a/) l(o\)(6) (2)shui_ (faa1 lou6 seoi2 花露水), ~~lavendar~~ lavender water; _(2)ang (1)f(a/)_ (ang2 faa1 㾘花), to enchase on metals; _(1)f(a/) k(a/)p(8) (2)tsz'_ (faa1 gaap3 zi2 花甲子) the sexagenary cycle; _(1)f(a/) (2)tsz'_ (faa1 zi2 花子) a beggar; _(1)f(a/) (4)lam_ (faa1 lam4 花林), a brothel; _(1)f(a/) fai(3)_ (faa1 fai3 花費) to squander in dissipation; _(1)f(a/) (5)n(u_ (faa1 neoi5-2 花女), a girl; _(1)f(a/) (2)t(a/)n_ (faa1 daan2 花旦), an actor who personates women; _(1)f(a/) ~~m(i/)n(3)~~ m(i/)n(6)_ (faa1 min6 花面) to paint the face for acting; _(1)f(a/) (1)f(a/) shai(3) k(a/)i(3)_ (faa1 faa1 sai3 gaai3 花花世界) a thoughtless age; _(1)f(a/) (1)f(a/) (1)kung (2)tsz'_ (faa1 faa1 gung1 zi2 花花公子) a profligate rake; _(1)f(a/) ~~(1)wong~~ (4)wong_ (faa1 wong4 花王), the god who protects children, worshiped under the bed; _(1)f(a/) p(o\)(3)_ (faa1 bou3 花布) chintz; _(1)f(a/) (1)k(a/)i_ (faa1 gaai1 花街), an illuminated street; _(1)f(a/) ~~w(a/)(3)~~ w(a/)(6)_ (faa1 waa6 花話) exaggerated talk; _(1)f(a/) (4)meng_ (faa1 meng4-2 花名), a nickname; _(1)F(a/) (4)k(')(i/) kwok(8)_ (faa1 kei4 gwok3 花旗國) the United States; _(1)f(a/) t(i/)(6)_ (faa1 dei6-2 花地) the Flower Gardens near Canton. Williams' 一朵花: Corrected _(1)to_ (do1) to _(2)to_ (do2). Williams' 一紮花: Corrected _chat(7)_ (zat1) to _ch(a/)t(8)_ (zaat3). Williams' 名花: Corrected _(1)ming_ (ming1) to _(4)ming_ (ming4). Williams' 花費: Also simply to expend, without the negative connotation of excess. Williams' 花面: Corrected _m(i/)n(3)_ (min3) to _m(i/)n(6)_ (min6). Williams' 花花公子: Now used as the translation of Playboy. Williams' 花王: Corrected _(1)wong_ (wong1) to _(4)wong_ (wong4). Williams' 花話: Corrected _w(a/)(3)_ (waa3) to _w(a/)(6)_ (waa6). To flower. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【花】 (xwae) (_noun-like_) flower, blossom 【花】 (faa1) Scratched. 揩花咗 (haai1 faa1 zo2): "Scratched from being brushed against." Messy or chaotic (like the shape of Mr Messy). 畫花嗮 (waak6 faa1 saai3): "All messed-up from being drawn over." (_mahjong_) The flower tiles, usually the four flora (梅蘭菊竹) and the four seasons (春夏秋冬). 正花 (zeng3 faa1): "A correct flower." 爛花 (laan6 faa1): "A bad flower." 唔打花 (m4 daa2 faa1): "Not playing with flower-tiles." A flush (card hand). 【花碼】 (faa1 maa5) Suzhou numerals (〇〡〢〣〤〥〦〧〨〩). 【花面貓】 (faa1 min6 maau1) Messy in the face.
U+83EF (F2.73 花) 草木之葩 (F2.73 華) 華美亦作花 (Page 42 #10: (1)花(1)華)

faa3.text: U+5316 (F2.76 化) 變化王化敎化 (Page 43 #1: 化(3)) To change, to influence so as to alter, to transform (Kangxi: 化敎行也 etc.); to melt, to digest; to convert; to pass into metempsychosis; to create; to transmute (Kangxi: 革物曰化); to barter; to exchange (Kangxi: 貨賄貿易曰化); to reform; _k(a/)u(3) f(a/)(3)_ (gaau3 faa3 教化) to improve by instruction; _f(a/)(3) (1)shan_ (faa3 san1 化身), to burn a priest's corpse; _~~ts(')(o\)(3)~~ ts(o\)(6) f(a/)(3)_ (zou6 faa3 造化) fate, nature; _~~h(o\)(3)~~ (2)h(o\) ~~ts(')(o\)(3)~~ ts(o\)(6) f(a/)(3)_ (hou2 zou6 faa3 好造化) good luck; _(4)wong f(a/)(3)_ (wong4 faa3 王化) the influence of law; _f(a/)(3) (1)shang_ (faa3 sang1 化生), produced by metamorphosis, as insects; _f(a/)(3) yat(9)_ (faa3 jat6 化日) peaceful times; _(1)ch(')(a/)u f(a/)(3)_ (caau1 faa3 抄化) to subscribe for a Budhist mass; _(4)'m f(a/)(3)_ (m4 faa3 唔化) did not subscribe; also, indigestible; _sh(i/)n(6) (4)ts(')oi (4)n(a/)n f(a/)(3)_ (sin6 coi4 naan4 faa3 善財難化) avaricious, niggardly. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 敎. Williams' 化身: Also reincarnation. Williams' 造化: Corrected _ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3) to _ts(o\)(6)_ (zou6). Williams' 好造化: Corrected _h(o\)(3)_ (hou3) to _(2)h(o\)_ (hou2), and corrected _ts(')(o\)(3)_ (cou3) to _ts(o\)(6)_ (zou6). Williams' 抄化: More specifically, for a monk to subscribe an alms-giver. To burn (paper offerings). 化元寶 (faa3 jyun4 bou2): "Transform paper-ingots by fire." 【化】 (xwaeH) (_verb-like_) to transform

faai3.text: U+5080 kui2 (per 《廣韻》口猥切) (F2.28 傀) 傀儡鬼戲人也 (Page 44 #11: 傀(3)) _f(a/)i(3) ~~lui(6)~~ (5)lui_ (faai3 leoi5 傀儡) puppets (Kangxi: 今爲木偶戲曰傀儡), vulgarly called _(2)kwai (2)tsai h(i/)(3)_ (gwai2 zai2 hei3 鬼仔戲). Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing component 厶 in 鬼. Williams' 傀儡: Corrected _lui(6)_ (leoi6) to _(5)lui_ (leoi5).

U+5672 哙 (Mainland simplified) (F2.28 快) 稱意也來也喜也又疾速也 (F2.28 噲) 燕王名又咽也又與快同 (Page 44 #12: 噲(3)) To swallow, to drink ~~with avidity~~ (Kangxi: 一曰嚵噲也); ~~voracious;~~ the throat (Kangxi: 咽也) ~~stopped~~; ~~clamor of voices.~~ Name of a king (Kangxi: 人名燕王噲). Williams' "with avidity", "voracious": These are misreadings of Kangxi 一曰嚵噲也. In the source 《說文》 of this explanation, 嚵 means "sip/taste" or "beak". It is *not* used for 饞, gluttonous. Williams' "Name of a king": Kangxi puts this under a separate reading, _kw(a/)i(3)_ (gwaai3), per 《集韻》古邁切 .

U+584A 凷 墤 块 (Mainland simplified) (F2.28 塊) 片也片也 (Page 44 #10: 塊(3)) A clod (Kangxi: 墣也), a lump; a piece of, a fraction; a classifier of ~~small~~ things which are flattish and usually shapeless, as boards, panes, slices, &c.; doltish; _yat(7) f(a/)i(3) yuk(9)_ (jat1 faai3 juk6 一塊肉) a slice of meat; _yat(7) f(a/)i(3) t(i/)(6)_ (jat1 faai3 dei6 一塊地) a piece of land; _h(o\)m(6) f(a/)i(3)_ (ham6 faai3 冚塊) the whole space; _t(a/)i(6) f(a/)i(3)_ (daai6 faai3 大塊) the globe, nature (Kangxi: 造物之名曰大塊); _f(a/)i(3) (4)(i/)n (4)m(o\) (1)ch(i/)_ (faai3 jin4 mou4 zi1 塊然無知), stupid. Used for the pronoun I (Kangxi: 一曰楚人謂我曰塊). Fan Wan entry: The headword 塊 is printed with the top dot missing in the component 鬼. Solitary (Kangxi: 孑也). 【塊】 (khwojH, khweajH) (_noun-like_) clod

U+5FEB 噲 (F2.28 快) 稱意也來也喜也又疾速也 (F2.28 噲) 燕王名又咽也又與快同 (Page 44 #9: 快(3)) Contented (Kangxi: 稱心也可也), glad (Kangxi: 喜也); pleasure, cheerfulness; quick, hasty (Kangxi: 爽快也急疾也); alacrity; prompt; _f(a/)i(3) lok(9)_ (faai3 lok6 快樂) happy; _pat(7) (2)shong f(a/)i(3)_ (bat1 song2 faai3 不爽快) indisposed, out of sorts; _f(a/)i(3) (u/)t(9)_ (faai3 wut6 快活) delighted, good spirits; _f(a/)i(3) f(a/)i(3)_ (faai3 faai3 快快) quick! _f(a/)i(3) (2)tsz' (2)shau_ (faai3 zi2 sau2 快子手), a headsman; _f(a/)i(3) (5)t(')eng_ (faai3 teng5 快艇), a fast-boat; _f(a/)i(3) (5)m(a/) (4)lai_ (faai3 maa5 lai4 快馬嚟), bring it quickly; _f(a/)i(3) (1)p(a/)n_ (faai3 baan1 快班), a lictor in a magistrate's office; _f(a/)i(3) tik(7) (1)f(a/)n (4)loi_ (faai3 dik1 faan1 loi4 快滴返來), come back quick; _f(a/)i(3) (5)m(a/)_ (faai3 maa5 快馬), a courier; _f(a/)i(3) ts(')ui(3)_ (faai3 ceoi3 快脆) speedy. Williams' 快子手: Probably related to 劊子手. Frank, straightforward. Sharp. Soon. 【快】 (khwaejH) (_adjective-like_) pleased 【快脆】 (faai3 ceoi3) Quick. Erroneously spelt 快趣. 咁快脆 (gam3 faai3 ceoi3): "That quick?" 行快脆啲 (haang4 faai3 ceoi3 di1): "Walk quicker."

U+7B77 快 (Page 44 #9: 快(3); here normalised to 筷) _f(a/)i(3) (2)tsz'_ (faai3 zi2 筷子) chopsticks; Used without the suffix 子 in certain compounds, e.g. 公筷 "public chopsticks" and 起筷 "raise chopsticks to start eating".

faak3.text: U+22AE6 𢪎 (Cantonese) (Page 713 #7: _F(a/)k(8)_ (faak3) exemplified; here assigned to 𢫦) A colloquial word. To whip; to beat with a flat board; to beat up, as eggs or jelly; _f(a/)k(8) (1)kon tseng(6)_ (faak3 gon1 zeng6 𢫦乾淨) thrash it clean, as a carpet; _f(a/)k(8) (2)t(')ung_ (faak3 tung2 𢫦桶), the tub into which grain is thrashed. 【𢫦】 (faak3) To whip, to swing abruptly, to flap violently. 𢫦甩啲塵 (faak3 lat1 di1 can4): "Flap off the dust." To whisk. 𢫦蛋 (faak3 daan6-2): "Whisk eggs." The spelling 𢫦 is arbitrary. The alternative spelling 𢪎 has poorer font support.

faan1.text: U+53CD 仮 (for an octave lower in the musical sense) 𢓉 (for an octave higher in the musical sense) faan2 (alternative for phonetics sense) (Page 48 #13: (2)反 _(2)F(a/)n_ (faan2); here normalised to _(1)F(a/)n_ (faan1)) _~~(2)f(a/)n~~ (1)f(a/)n ~~ts(i/)t~~ ts(')(i/)t(8)_ (faan1 cit3 反切), to spell, to combine sounds; Williams' 反切: Corrected _ts(i/)t_ (zit) to _ts(')(i/)t(8)_ (cit3). Used in 反切 (back-dissection) or alone, referring to the method of indicating (Middle) Chinese pronunciation by two characters, marking the initial (consonant) and the final (rime) respectively. 【反-level】 (phjon) (_verb-like_) to flip, to overturn Used in 反切. 【反切】 (phjon tshet) (_noun-like_) back-dissection 【反】 (faan1) (_music_) Rough equivalent of solfege _fa_ half-sharp in 工尺譜 (Gongche notation).

faan2.text: U+53CD 阪 (F2.69 反) 反覆不順也 (Page 48 #13: (2)反) To turn back, to return (Kangxi: 反謂回還也); to be contrary, to rebel; to combine against; opposed to, but, contrary; again; _(2)f(a/)n ~~fuk(9)~~ fuk(7)_ (faan2 fuk1 反覆) repetition, to and fro, to retract; _(1)s(e/)ung (2)f(a/)n_ (soeng1 faan2 相反), discordant; opposite, contrariwise; _tsok(8) (2)f(a/)n_ (zok3 faan2 作反), to rebel; _(2)f(a/)n ~~chi(u/)(6)~~ chi(u/)(3)_ (faan2 ziu3 反照) to reflect light; _(2)f(a/)n m(i/)n(6)_ (faan2 min6-2 反面) to turn a cold shoulder; _(2)f(a/)n kwat(7)_ (faan2 gwat1 反骨) to backbite; _(2)f(a/)n ~~(2)ch(un~~ ch(un(3)_ (faan2 zyun3 反轉), to turn over; _(2)f(a/)n ~~tau(3)~~ (2)tau_ (faan2 dau2 反斗) clamor and play of children; _(2)f(a/)n (2)hau_ (faan2 hau2 反口) to unsay, to recant; _(2)f(a/)n wai(6) ~~(i/)t(9)~~ (i/)t(8) shik(9)_ (faan2 wai6 jit3 sik6 反胃噎食) the stomach rejects food. Williams' 反覆: Corrected _fuk(9)_ (fuk6) to _fuk(7)_ (fuk1). Williams' 反照: Corrected _chi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) to _chi(u/)(3)_ (ziu3). Williams' 反轉: Corrected _(2)ch(un_ (zyun2) to _ch(un(3)_ (zyun3). Williams' 反斗: Corrected _tau(3)_ (dau3) to _(2)tau_ (dau2). Hence 玩具反斗城 for Toys "R" Us (with 反斗 being a pun on the flipped R in English). Williams' 反胃噎食: Corrected _(i/)t(9)_ (jit6) to _(i/)t(8)_ (jit3). To overturn (Kangxi: 覆也). Contrariwise. To reflect. 【反-rising】 (pjonX) (_verb-like_) to turn (over), to turn (back) (_verb-like_) to revolt (_adverb-like_) contrariwise Used in 反覆.

faan6.text: U+53CD faan3 (alternative per 《集韻》方願切) Used in 反反 (solemn, prudent). 【反-voiced】 (baenX) (_adjective-like_) solemn, prudent

faan1.text: U+5E61 (F2.66 幡) 慢也又幡然攺 (Page 47 #10: (1)幡) A banner, or streamer (Kangxi: 一曰幟也) with sentences, hung in temples or carried in processions; a duster or napkin (Kangxi: 幡書兒拭觚布也); ~~to move;~~ _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)f(a/)n yat(7) t(u/)i(3)_ (coeng4 faan1 jat1 deoi3 長幡一對) a pair of streamers; _(1)f(a/)n (4)(i/)n_ (faan1 jin4 幡然), forthwith. (Page 47 #11: (1)旛; here corrected to 幡) (...) _(4)wan (1)f(a/)n_ (wan4 faan1 魂幡), a banner carried at funerals. ~~Used for the preceding (幡).~~ Fan Wan entry: The explanation 慢也 is erroneous. If it is a typo for 幔也, it is still not quite correct (a banner is not a curtain/screen). Williams' "duster or napkin": Specifically for 觚 "wooden writing-slips". According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, 拭 ("wipe", which is not present as a headword) is a vulgar substitute for 飾 ("decorate"), and this sense should instead be understood as "decorative cloth". Williams' "forthwith": Abrupt like an about-face (see supplemented sense below). Williams' "a banner carried at funerals": Appears erroneously as 魂旛 under 旛. A reversal, an about-face (Kangxi: 幡反也). 【幡】 (phjon) (_verb-like_) to flip (_verb-like_) to flap (about)

U+65DB faan4 (alternative per 《廣韻》附袁切) (F2.66 旛) 旗屬 (Page 47 #11: (1)旛) A streamer (Kangxi: 幅胡也, 旛幡也); _(1)ts(')ing (1)f(a/)n_ (cing1 faan1 青旛)~~, or _(4)wan (1)f(a/)n_ (wan4 faan1), a banner carried at funerals~~. ~~Used for the preceding (幡).~~ Williams' 青旛: These are banners used in springtime rites, distinct from 魂幡 used in funerals, which should appear under 幡. Banners or flags in general (Kangxi: 旌旗總名也). 【旛】 (phjon, bjon) (_noun-like_) banner

U+756A 蕃 (for "foreign" sense) (F2.66 番) 夷狄之稱 (Page 47 #9: (1)番) a time, a turn, a repetition of (Kangxi: 數也遞也); ~~to reckon, to change;~~ ~~a tribe on the south, now applied to all~~ foreigners; _(2)k(i/) (1)f(a/)n_ (gei2 faan1 幾番), several times; _(1)f(a/)n w(a/)(6)_ (faan1 waa6-2 番話) foreign talk; _(1)f(a/)n (4)yan_ (faan1 jan4 番人), foreigners; _(5)l(o\) (1)f(a/)n_ (lou5 faan1 老番) a foreigner. (_mahjong_) Points used to score a winning hand. 三番起糊 (saam1 faan1 hei2 wu4-2): "Three points minimum for a win." 【番】 (phjon) (_noun-like_) turn 【番子】 (faan1 zi2) (_mahjong_) The honours tiles (i.e. the unnumbered suit), consisting of the four winds (東南西北), the three duxes (中發白), and (optionally) the flower tiles.

U+7C53 faan4 (per Fan Wan) (F2.67 籓 _(4)F(a/)n_ (faan4)) 大箕也又蔽也 (Page 48 #4: (4)籓 _(4)F(a/)n_ (faan4); here normalised to _(1)F(a/)n_ (faan1)) A dust basket or large sieve (Kangxi: 大箕); to hide, to cover, to shade (Kangxi: 一曰蔽也).

faan4.text: U+7C53 (F2.67 籓) 大箕也又蔽也 (Page 48 #4: (4)籓)

faan1.text: U+7E59 (Page 47 #12: (1)繙) ~~To spread out~~; ~~to agitate, or wave, as the wind does~~ a flag (Kangxi: 𦆯繙風吹旗也); Williams' "To spread out": This is probably a rendering of Kangxi 《說文》寬也, which is a typo for 冕也, which perhaps should be 繙冤也 (neither of which I comprehend). In any case, this sense does not belong here, as the reading is _(4)f(a/)n_ (faan4) per 《廣韻》附袁切. Williams' "to agitate, or wave, as the wind does": This is a misreading of Kangxi 𦆯繙風吹旗也. In, 𦆯繙 (same as 繽繙), 繙 means flag. It is 𦆯 (same as 繽, literally "disorderly") that supplies the meaning of "wave" or "flap".

U+7FFB 反 幡 (for "reverse/flip" senses) 繙 飜 (F2.66 翻) 翩翻羽飛貌 (Page 47 #12: (1)繙; here normalised to 翻) to translate; to explain; _(1)f(a/)n yik(9)_ (faan1 jik6 翻譯) to translate. (Page 47 #13: (1)翻) To fly (Kangxi: 飛也) to and fro; (...), to change (Kangxi: 反覆也通作幡又通作反); to revise a case; _(1)f(a/)n fuk(7)_ (faan1 fuk1 翻覆) changeable; vacillating; _(1)f(a/)n on(3)_ (faan1 on3 翻案) to rejudge a case; _ti(u/)(6) (1)f(a/)n (2)sh(a/)ng_ (diu6 faan1 saang2 調翻省), ~~to~~ to carry a case to the capital; To reverse, to flip, to turn around.

faan4.text: U+8543 (F2.67 蕃) 茂也滋也息也 (Page 48 #6: (4)蕃) Plants growing luxuriantly (Kangxi: 草茂也, 蕃滋也, 蕃息也); flourishing; plenty; many; ~~to settle;~~ 【蕃】 (bjon) (_adjective-like_) luxuriant, flourishing

U+85E9 蕃 faan1 (per 《廣韻》甫煩切) (F2.67 藩) 藩籬藩屏藩垣 (Page 48 #7: (4)藩~~(4)轓~~) A fence (Kangxi 藩: 籬也), hedge, boundary; a frontier; ~~to ward off,~~ to protect, to screen; _(4)f(a/)n (4)l(i/)_ (faan4 lei4 藩籬), a wattle or hurdle; _(4)f(a/)n wik(9)_ (faan4 wik6 藩域) the frontiers; _(4)f(a/)n (4)t(')oi_ (faan4 toi4 藩臺), the treasurer of a province; _(4)f(a/)n (4)(u/)n_ (faan4 wun4 藩垣), a wall inclosing; _(4)f(a/)n (4)p(')ing_ (faan4 ping4 藩屏), a screen; a statesman. A screen (Kangxi 藩: 與蕃通屛也). 【藩】 (pjon) (_noun-like_) fence (_noun-like_) screen

faan1.text: U+8F53 藩 (Page 48 #7: (4)藩(4)轓 _(4)F(a/)n_ (faan4); here corrected to _(1)F(a/)n_ (faan1)) a cover for a chariot (Kangxi 轓: 轓車之蔽也); a covered car; A large storage compartment of a chariot (Kangxi 轓: 車大箱也). 【轓】 (pjon, phjon) (_noun-like_) chariot-cover

U+8FD4 番 (Cantonese) 翻 (Cantonese) (Page 47 #13: (1)翻; here normalised to 返) to return, (...); _(1)f(a/)n ~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng_ (faan1 saang1 返生), resuscitated; _(1)f(a/)n h(u(3) (1)kwai_ (faan1 heoi3 gwai1 返去歸), to go home; _f(a/)i(3) (1)f(a/)n (1)kwai_ (faai3 faan1 gwai1 快返歸) come home soon. Williams' 返生: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【返】 (faan1) To return, to go back. 返去 (faan1 heoi3): "Go back." 返屋企 (faan1 uk1 kei2): "Go home." 唔返 (m4 faan1): "Not going back." To revert to. 返發 (faan1 faat3): "Reoccur." 返生 (faan1 saang1): "Revive." To go to (in recurring attendance). 返工 (faan1 gung1): "Go to work." 返學 (faan1 hok6): "Go to school." 返廠 (faan1 cong2): "Go to the factory." 返寫字樓 (faan1 se2 zi6 lau4): "Go to the office." 冇工返 (mou5 gung1 faan1): "No work to go to." Back, in return (in reciprocation). 打返畀佢 (daa2 faan1 bei2 keoi5): "Call him back." 還返畀佢 (waan4 faan1 bei2 keoi5): "Return it back to him." 踢返畀佢 (tek3 faan1 bei2 keoi5): "Kick it back to him." 可以打返我 (ho2 ji5 daa1 faan1 ngo5): "You can hit me back." 找返兩蚊 (zaau2 faan1 loeng5 man1): "Two bucks' change in return." Back, again (in restoration of a good state). 好返 (hou2 faan1): "Well again" (after being sick). 搵返 (wan2 faan1): "Found it back" (after having lost it). 惜返 (sek3 faan1): "Kiss you back to being OK." 寫返好啲 (se2 faan1 hou2 di1): "Rewrite it better." 企返起身 (kei5 faan1 hei2 san1): "Stand back up." Suffixed after a verb to indicate a fresh instance of that action. 沖返個正涼 (cung1 faan1 go3 zeng3 loeng4): "Have a nice shower." 瞓返個晏覺 (fan3 faan1 go3 aan3 gaau3): "Take an afternoon nap." Suffixed after a verb to indicate a remainder. 留返畀佢食 (lau4 faan1 bei2 keoi5 sik6): "Leave it aside for him to eat." 得返一個 (dak1 faan1 jat1 go3): "Only one left." 【返轉頭】 (faan1 zyun3 tau4) To go back. 返轉頭攞嘢 (faan1 zyun3 tau4 lo2 je5): "Go back to get some stuff." 冇得返轉頭 (mou5 dak1 faan1 zyun3 tau4): "There's no going back." Back, retracing backwards. 行返轉頭 (haang4 faan1 zyun3 tau4): "Walking back." 做返轉頭 (zou6 faan1 zyun3 tau4): "Doing something but going backwards." Back, in return (in reciprocation). 踢返佢轉頭 (tek3 faan1 keoi5 zyun3 tau4): "Kick him back." Note that the reading _(1)f(a/)n_ (faan1) for 返 is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 孚袁切, explained 回行也.

faan2.text: U+8FD4 反 (F2.69 返) 還也 (Page 48 #15: (2)返) To return, to come back (Kangxi: 還也, 復也); to go back; _(2)f(a/)n ~~(4)hi(u/)~~ (1)hi(u/) (1)h(e/)ung ~~(5)h(a/)~~ h(a/)(6)_ (faan2 hiu1 hoeng1 haa6-2 返嘵鄉下), gone to his village; _(2)f(a/)n h(u(3) ~~(4)kwai~~ (1)kwai_ (faan2 heoi3 gwai1 返去歸), gone home; _~~(2)wong~~ (5)wong (2)f(a/)n (2)k(i/) yat(9)_ (wong5 faan2 gei2 jat6 往返幾日) how many days will you be gone? Williams' 返嘵鄉下: Corrected _(4)hi(u/)_ (hiu4) to _(1)hi(u/)_ (hiu1) and changed (very) obsolete _(5)h(a/)_ (haa5) to _h(a/)(6)_ (haa6-2). Williams' 返去歸: Corrected _(4)kwai_ (gwai4) to _(1)kwai_ (gwai1). Williams' 往返幾日: Corrected _(2)wong_ (wong2) to _(5)wong_ (wong5). All three examples read like they belong under 返 faan1 instead. 【返】 (pjonX) (_verb-like_) to turn (back)

U+3906 faan3 (per 《廣韻》芳万切 and 《集韻》孚萬切) (F2.69 㤆) 㤆悔謂事旣成而生背心 (Page 48 #14: (2)㤆) Regret (Kangxi: 悔也); _(2)f(a/)n f(u/)i(3)_ (faan2 fui3 㤆悔) to regret an act; _(2)f(a/)n (2)ch(un m(i/)n(6) (4)p(')(i/)_ (faan2 zyun2 min6 pei4 㤆轉面皮), to change the countenance; _(2)f(a/)n (1)sam_ (faan2 sam1 㤆心), sorry for. The other definitions given in Kangxi (惡心也急性也 and 急也) are not particularly illuminating.

faan3.text: U+6C3E faan6 (common) (F2.70 泛) 廣也泛濫也 (F2.70 汎) 廣也又汎舟 (F2.70 氾) 氾濫水溢也 (Page 49 #2: 氾(3)) To overflow (Kangxi: 水延漫也), to fluctuate; in motion, agitated (Kangxi: 搖動貌); to float; _f(a/)n(3) l(a/)m(6)_ (faan3 laam6 氾濫) wide, as a deluge. Name of a river (Kangxi: 水名) in Hon(a/)n (河南). Unsteady, bobbing (Kangxi: 不定之辭). 【氾】 (phjomH) (_verb-like_) to flood

faan4.text: U+6C3E A place name (Kangxi: 地名). A surname (Kangxi: 姓).

faan3.text: U+6C4E fung4 (alternative per 《廣韻》房戎切) (F2.70 泛) 廣也泛濫也 (F2.70 汎) 廣也又汎舟 (F2.70 氾) 氾濫水溢也 (Page 48 #16: 汎(3)) To float (Kangxi: 浮貌); driven by the wind (Kangxi: 一曰任風波自縱也); name of a river (Kangxi: 水名). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 㲹 to 汎. 【汎】 (phjomH, bjuwng) (_verb-like_) to float (about)

U+6CDB 氾 汎 faan6 (common) (F2.70 泛) 廣也泛濫也 (F2.70 汎) 廣也又汎舟 (F2.70 氾) 氾濫水溢也 (Page 48 #16: 汎(3)) Used for the next character (泛). (Page 49 #1: 泛(3)汎(3)) To float, to flow down (Kangxi 泛: 浮也一曰流也通作汎); to transport; extensive (Kangxi 氾: 普博也, 氾廣也); to spill over; _(4)fau f(a/)n(3)_ (fau4 faan3 浮泛) to float, superficial; _f(a/)n(3) (4)(i/)n_ (faan3 jin4 泛言), vague words; _f(a/)n(3) (1)chau_ (faan3 zau1 泛舟), to sail in a boat; _f(a/)n(3) (4)(i/)n_ (faan3 jin4 泛？), lightminded. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 㲹 to 汎.

U+7548 畚 (for Cantonese "evil supernatural influences" sense) (Page 49 #3: 畚(3); here normalised to 畈) A colloquial word. Ill-luck, evil influences; ill-starred; things to be avoided when commencing anything; _f(a/)n(3) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (faan3 zoek6 畈着) to bring ill luck; _f(a/)n(3) (4)shan_ (faan3 san4 畈神), to exorcise, to expel or induce evil spirits to depart; _(2)h(i/) f(a/)n(3)_ (hei2 faan3 起畈) to adore the spirits of the threshold. The Williams entry should be marked "A colloquial word", as it pertains to vernacular Cantonese. Williams' choice to spell it 畚 is a poor one, as that character is otherwise read _(2)p(u/)n_ (bun2). I have normalised to 畈 for phonetic defensibility. Williams' 畈着: Corrected _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) to _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6). A field (Kangxi: 田畈, 田也, 平疇也).

U+8CA9 贩 (Mainland simplified) faan3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) faan5 (common) faan6 (common) (F2.70 販) 賤買貴賣曰販 (Page 49 #5: 販(3)) To traffic, to deal in; _f(a/)n(3) m(a/)i(6) (4)yan (2)hau_ (faan3 maai6 jan4 hau2 販賣人口), to deal in men; _(2)kw(a/)i f(a/)n(3)_ (gwaai2 faan3 拐販) to get away children to sell; _f(a/)n(3) (2)tsai_ (faan3 zai2 販仔) or _f(a/)n(3) (1)f(u/)_ (faan3 fu1 販夫), a chapman, a peddler; _f(u/)(6) f(a/)n(3)_ (fu6 faan3 負販) to peddle about. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 責 to 貴 and 販曰 to 曰販. Williams' 販賣人口: Now rendered "human trafficking". A seller, a dealer (Kangxi: 買賤賣貴者). 【販】 (pjonH) (_verb-like_) to trade (in) (_noun-like_) trader

faan4.text: U+51E1 凢 (F2.67 凢) 皆也大槩也又庸常也今人鄙人爲凢夫輕賤之稱也 (Page 47 #14: (4)凡(4)凢) All, everybody (Kangxi 凡: 最括也, 非一也, 皆也); common, vulgar (Kangxi 凡: 輕微之稱), usual (Kangxi 凡: 常也); generally, for the most part (Kangxi 凡: 大槪也); _(4)f(a/)n (4)yan_ (faan4 jan4 凡人), men; _(4)f(a/)n (1)k(a/)n_ (faan4 gaan1 凡間), the world; _(1)ch(u (4)f(a/)n_ (zyu1 faan4 諸凡), every one; _(1)f(i/) (4)f(a/)n_ (fei1 faan4 非凡), extraordinary, clever; _t(a/)i(6) (4)f(a/)n (2)sho (5)yau_ (daai6 faan4 so2 jau5 大凡所有), people generally have it; _~~(5)h(a/)~~ h(a/)(6) (4)f(a/)n_ (haa6 faan4 下凡), to enter the world; _(1)sz' (4)f(a/)n_ (si1 faan4 思凡), to think of marrying (said of a bonze). Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 槩 and 鄙. Williams' 凡間: The mortal world, as opposed to the heavenly realm. Williams' 下凡: Corrected _(5)h(a/)_ (haa5) to _h(a/)(6)_ (haa6). Specifically, to descend into the mortal world from the heavenly realm above. To total (Kangxi 凡: 計數也, 凡最計也). Mortal, earthly. 【凡】 (bjom) (_adverb-like_) for all, (_met._) whenever (_determiner-like_) all, every (_preposition-like_) in total (_adjective-like_) common
U+51E2 (F2.67 凢) 皆也大槩也又庸常也今人鄙人爲凢夫輕賤之稱也 (Page 47 #14: (4)凡(4)凢) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 槩 and 鄙.

U+58A6 (F2.67 墦) 墦間塚也 (Page 48 #2: (4)墦) A grave (Kangxi: 墦埌冢也); _(4)f(a/)n (1)k(a/)n_ (faan4 gaan1 墦間), at the graves, a sepulchre. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 間, and corrected 塜 to 塚. 【墦】 (bjon) (_noun-like_) grave

U+5E06 㠶 䑺 颿 faan6 (per 《廣韻》扶泛切 for verb sense) (F2.68 帆) 風帆 (Page 48 #1: (4)帆) A sail of canvas (Kangxi: 舟上幔以帆風); _kw(a/)(3) (4)f(a/)n_ (gwaa3 faan4 掛帆), to hoist sail; _(4)f(a/)n p(o\)(3)_ (faan4 bou3 帆布) canvas. 【帆-level】 (bjom) (_noun-like_) sail 【帆-departing】 (bjomH) (_verb-like_) to sail

U+68B5 faan6 (per 《廣韻》扶泛切) (F2.71 梵 _F(a/)n(6)_ (faan6)) 羗戎吟聲也佛家經聲曰梵音 (Page 49 #9: 梵(6) _F(a/)n(6)_ (faan6); here normalised to _(4)F(a/)n_ (faan4)) Name of a bonze; the country of Magadha, whence Budha came; the language of the Budhists, Pali or Sanscrit; _~~f(a/)n(6)~~ (4)f(a/)n (1)yam_ (faan4 jam1 梵音), to chant prayers (Fan Wan: 佛家經聲曰梵音); _~~f(a/)n(6)~~ (4)f(a/)n (4)(i/)n_ (faan4 jin4 梵言), Pali; _~~f(a/)n(6)~~ (4)f(a/)n ~~ch(')(a/)t(8)~~ sh(a/)t(8)_ (faan4 saat3 梵剎) a monastery. Williams' 梵剎: Normalised _ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (caat3) to _sh(a/)t(8)_ (saat3). Tranquil, quiet (Kangxi: 華言淸淨正言寂靜).

faan6.text: U+68B5 (F2.71 梵) 羗戎吟聲也佛家經聲曰梵音 (Page 49 #9: 梵(6))

faan4.text: U+7169 烦 (Mainland simplified) faan4-2 (rising second in vernacular 煩煩地) (F2.68 煩) 勞也擾也 (Page 48 #8: (4)煩) Troubled, annoyed, perplexed, heated (Kangxi: 熱頭痛也); to trouble, to intrude on (Kangxi: 干煩也, 煩勞也); troublesome, impertinent; grieved, sorry (Kangxi: 悶也); _(1)to (4)f(a/)n (5)n(i/)_ (do1 faan4 nei5 多煩你), I trouble you; _(4)f(a/)n t(a/)i(3)_ (faan4 daai3 煩帶) I trouble you to take this; _(4)f(a/)n (4)l(o\)_ (faan4 lou4 煩勞), to trouble one to do a thing; _(4)f(a/)n m(u/)n(6)_ (faan4 mun6 煩悶) perplexed, grieved; _(4)f(a/)n ~~(5)i(u/)~~ (2)i(u/)_ (faan4 jiu2 煩擾), interrupted, annoyed. (Page 48 #9: (4)繁; here corrected to 煩) _(4)'m noi(6) (4)f(a/)n_ (m4 noi6 faan4 唔耐煩), unwilling to be troubled, can not endure; Williams' 煩擾: Changed _(5)i(u/)_ (jiu5) to common reading _(2)i(u/)_ (jiu2). Complex (Kangxi: 不簡也). 【煩】 (bjon) (_verb-like_) to vex, to bother (_adjective-like_) vexed, bothered (_adjective-like_) vexatious, bothersome

U+71D4 (F2.67 燔) 熱炙也 (Page 48 #3: (4)燔) _(4)f(a/)n ~~chek(9)~~ chek(8)_ (faan4 zek3 燔炙) to roast meat. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𤍠 to 熱. Williams' 燔炙: Corrected _chek(9)_ (zek6) to _chek(8)_ (zek3). To roast, to burn (Kangxi: 爇也, 燒也, 炙也). 【燔】 (bjon) (_verb-like_) to roast, to burn

U+792C 矾 (Mainland simplified) (F2.68 礬) 白礬 (Page 48 #11: (4)礬) Mineral salts proper four painting or dyeing (Kangxi: 礬石); _~~p(a/)k(8)~~ p(a/)k(9) (4)f(a/)n_ (baak6 faan4 白礬), alum; _(1)ts(')ing (4)f(a/)n_ (cing1 faan4 青礬), copperas; _(4)f(a/)n shek(9)_ (faan4 sek6 礬石) alum shale; _(2)t(a/)m (4)f(a/)n_ (daam2 faan4 膽礬), blue vitriol; _~~(1)f(u/)~~ (1)f(u/)i (4)f(a/)n_ (fui1 faan4 灰礬), alum ash. Williams' 白礬: Corrected _p(a/)k(8)_ (baak3) to _p(a/)k(9)_ (baak6). Williams' 灰礬: Corrected _(1)f(u/)_ (fu1) to _(1)f(u/)i_ (fui1).

U+7E41 煩 䋣 蕃 (F2.68 繁) 多也 (Page 48 #6: (4)蕃; here normalised to 繁) _(4)f(a/)n mau(6)_ (faan4 mau6 繁茂), abundant, prosperous; _(4)f(a/)n (2)(i/)n_ (faan4 jin2 繁衍), numerous progeny. (Page 48 #9: (4)繁) Much, numerous (Kangxi: 繁多也); many, confused, multitudinous (Kangxi: 繁雜也); a variety of affairs; _(4)f(a/)n (4)n(a/)n_ (faan4 naan4 繁難), wearisome; _(4)f(a/)n (4)w(a/)_ (faan4 waa4 繁華), pomp, show; _(4)f(a/)n fai(3)_ (faan4 fai3 繁費) expensive. Complex. Abundant, flourishing (Kangxi: 繁猶盛也). 【繁】 (bjon) (_adjective-like_) abundant, manifold

U+81B0 燔 㸋 (F2.67 膰) 祭餘肉也 (Page 48 #3: (4)燔; here normalised to 膰) To roast meat for sacrifices (Kangxi 燔: 與膰通 etc.); (Page 48 #5: (4)膰) Meat roasted for sacrifice (Kangxi: 宗廟火熟肉, 膰祭肉); the remnants of a sacrifice, sent to princes (Kangxi: ...以饋同姓諸侯). 【膰】 (bjon) (_noun-like_) sacrificial-roast

U+8629 (F2.68 蘩) 草名白蒿也 (Page 48 #10: (4)蘩) A kind of southernwood or Artemisia (Kangxi: 白蒿也, 蘩皤蒿), whose decoction is sprinkled on silkworm eggs to hasten their hatching (Kangxi: 蘩所以生蠶, 蠶未出煑蘩以沃之則易出); _(4)f(a/)n (1)h(o\)_ (faan4 hou1 蘩蒿), a plant grown like celery, and pickled in winter. Williams' 蘩蒿: This is dubious. 【蘩】 (bjon) (_noun-like_) hoary-mugwort

U+881C (F2.67 蠜) 虫名 (Page 48 #12: (4)蠜) A kind of cricket or grasshopper (Kangxi: 蛗螽蠜)~~, which goes by night~~. Williams' "which goes by night": This is a dubious reading of Kangxi 《本草》行夜一名氣蠜, which in any case is separate to the main sense.

U+8E6F 番 (Page 47 #9: (1)番 _(1)F(a/)n_ (faan1); here corrected to _(4)F(a/)n_ (faan4) and normalised to 蹯) A beast's foot~~step~~ (Kangxi 番: 獸足謂之番, 或作𨆌蹯); (Page 714 #1: (4)蹯) A paw of a plantigrade animal (Kangxi: 《說文》作番獸足也), as a badger; _(4)hung (4)f(a/)n_ (hung4 faan4 熊蹯), a bear's paw, which is esteemed a delicacy. 【蹯】 (bjon) (_noun-like_) paw

faan6.text: U+72AF faan6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.71 犯) 觸犯干犯侵犯 (Page 49 #6: 犯(6)) To rush against (Kangxi: 抵觸也); to offend (Kangxi: 干也); to transgress (Kangxi: 僭也); to invade (Kangxi: 侵也, 勝也); to violate, to resist, to oppose; a criminal; _f(a/)n(6) ~~tsui(6)~~ ts(u/)i(6)_ (faan6 zeoi6 犯罪) to transgress; _f(a/)n(6) f(a/)t(8)_ (faan6 faat3 犯法) to break the laws; _f(a/)n(6) (4)yan_ (faan6 jan4 犯人), a prisoner, a criminal; _(4)ts(')au f(a/)n(6)_ (cau4 faan6-2 囚犯) ~~to cage a criminal~~ a prisoner; _(1)ts(')am f(a/)n(6)_ (cam1 faan6 侵犯) to encroach on, to usurp; _(5)yau f(a/)n(6) (1)ts(un (4)ng(a/)n_ (jau5 faan6 zyun1 ngaan4 有犯尊顏) I have offended you. Fan Wan entry: The headword 犯 is printed ⿰犭巳. Williams' 犯罪: Corrected _tsui(6)_ to _ts(u/)i(6)_. To face, to brave. 【犯】 (bjomX) (_verb-like_) to offend (against) (_verb-like_) to confront, to face (_verb-like_) to go over

U+7BC4 范 (F2.71 範) 法也式也模也則也隄防也 (Page 49 #7: 范(6)) Used for the following (範). (Page 49 #8: 範(6)) A rule, a guide; a custom, a usage; a mold, a pattern (Kangxi: 法也式也模也 etc.); to imitate; _(4)m(o\) f(a/)n(6)_ (mou4 faan6 模範) a pattern, an exemplar (Kangxi: 範謂模範); _(4)fong f(a/)n(6)_ (fong4 faan6 防範) rule for guarding; _(1)fung f(a/)n(6)_ (fung1 faan6 風範) a popular custom. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing dot in 式. The headword 犯 is printed ⿱𥫗⿰車巳. Williams' 風範: Better rendered "manner" or "air". Bounds. To bound, to guard against. 【範】 (bjomX) (_noun-like_) mould

U+8303 (F2.71 范) 草名又姓 (Page 49 #7: 范(6)) Herbs, grass (Kangxi: 草也); a bee or wasp (Kangxi: 蠭也); a surname (Kangxi: 姓). Williams' "Herbs, grass": More likely a specific *type* of grass. 【范】 (bjomX) (_noun-like_) bee

U+98EF May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 飰 饭 (Mainland simplified) faan5 (per 《廣韻》扶晚切 rising for verb sense) (F2.71 飯) 米飯 (Page 49 #10: 飯(6)) Cooked rice; a meal; _shik(9) f(a/)n(6)_ (sik6 faan6 食飯) to eat; _ts(o\)(6) f(a/)n(6)_ (zou6 faan6 做飯) to cook; _(2)ts(o\) ~~f(a/)n(3)~~ f(a/)n(6)_ (zou2 faan6 早飯) breakfast; _p(i/)n(6) f(a/)n(6)_ (bin6 faan6 便飯) a common meal; _shik(9) f(a/)n(6) (4)'m (4)ts(')ang_ (sik6 faan6 m4 cang4 食飯唔曾), have you eaten, (i. e. how do you do? the ans. is, _(5)yau (1)p(')(i/)n_ (jau5 pin1 有偏), thank you.) _(1)chong f(a/)n(6)_ (zong1 faan6 裝飯) dish up the rice. Williams' 做飯: The preferred term for "cooking" in Cantonese is 煮飯. Williams' 早飯: Corrected _f(a/)n(3)_ (faan3) to _f(a/)n(6)_ (faan6). To eat (Kangxi: 餐飯也), to feed. The base of the thumb (Kangxi: 指本, 飯大擘指本也). 【飯-rising】 (bjonX) (_verb-like_) to eat, to feed 【飯-departing】 (bjonH) (_noun-like_) cooked-rice, rice, meal

faat3.text: U+6CB7 fat1 (alternative per Kangxi 敷勿切) (Page 714 #2: 沷(8)) Cold (Kangxi: 寒也); to open sluices, to let water in over fields, for irrigating them (Kangxi: 一曰渫也通流也, 沷灌也).

U+6CD5 佱 㳒 灋 (F2.72 法) 法度法則又刑法方法 (F2.72 灋) 古法字 (Page 51 #1: 法(8)) A rule, a law, usage (Kangxi: 法常也, 法偪也偪而使有所限也, etc.); regulations, precepts; a punishment (Kangxi: 𠛬法也) or legal infliction; an art; skill, industry; ~~sect;~~ _f(a/)t(8) t(o\)(6)_ (faat3 dou6 法度) rule, regulation; _(4)ying f(a/)t(8)_ (jing4 faat3 刑法) penal laws; _(4)f(u/) f(a/)t(8)_ (fu4 faat3 符法) to lay a spell; _f(a/)t(8) tsak(7)_ (faat3 zak1 法則) a guide; _f(a/)t(8) (4)m(u/)n_ (faat3 mun4 法門), the ~~Budhists~~ Dharmic gateway of Budhism; _ch(')(a/)k(8) f(a/)t(8)_ (caak3 faat3 拆法) mode of concluding or repairing; _(1)t(o\) f(a/)t(8)_ (dou1 faat3 刀法) rules for carving. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword (with 虫 instead of ⿱灬去) to 灋. Williams' 刀法: Also (single-edged) swordsmanship. To emulate (Kangxi: 效法也). A method. Religious, supernatural, or sorcerous practices. A divisor. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【法】 (pjop) (_noun-like_) law (_noun-like_) emulate (_noun-like_) method, fashion (_noun-like_) divisor
U+704B (F2.72 法) 法度法則又刑法方法 (F2.72 灋) 古法字

U+767C 彂 发 (Mainland simplified) (F2.72 發) 起也揚也舒也遣也 (F2.72 彂) 同上 (Page 50 #13: 發(8)) To issue, to appear, to send forth, to germinate; to cause to go, to dispatch (Kangxi: 遣也)~~, throw out~~; to ferment; to show forth (Kangxi: 舒也揚也, 發越也, 宣發也, 見也), to manifest (Kangxi: 明也); ~~the~~ spring and summer (Kangxi: 春夏曰發秋冬曰斂); _f(a/)t(8) (4)ts(')oi_ (faat3 coi4 發財), to make money; _f(a/)t(8) (5)sh(i/)_ (faat3 si5 發市), to have customers; _f(a/)t(8) h(a/)k(8)_ (faat3 haak3 發客) or _f(a/)t(8) m(a/)i(6)_ (faat3 maai6 發賣) for sale; _f(a/)t(8) (1)sam_ (faat3 sam1 發心), to give in charity; _f(a/)t(8) shai(6)_ (faat3 sai6 發誓) to take an oath; _f(a/)t(8) (1)t(i/)n_ (faat3 din1 發癲), crazed, beside himself; _(5)n(i/) f(a/)t(8) (1)wan (1)m(e/)?_ (nei5 faat3 wan1 me1 你發瘟咩) are you crazy? _f(a/)t(8) (2)h(i/) (4)loi_ (faat3 hei2 loi4 發起來), to rise (as dough), to succeed, to get on; _f(a/)t(8) (1)f(a/)n (1)(un tsik(7)_ (faat3 faan1 jyun1 zik1 發？？？) to dismiss home; _f(a/)t(8) (1)t(a/)n_ (faat3 daan1 發單), to issue ~~advertisements~~ an invoice; _f(a/)t(8) (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (faat3 ciu4 發潮), to get damp; _(2)t(a/) f(a/)t(8)_ (daa2 faat3 打發) to send away; _f(a/)t(8) h(i/)(3)_ (faat3 hei3 發氣) angry; _f(a/)t(8) (1)fo_ (faat3 fo1 發科), to become a _k(uyan_ (舉人)_;_ _f(a/)t(8) k(a/)p(8)_ (faat3 gaap3 發甲) to become a _tsunsz'_ (進士); _f(a/)t(8) h(o\)(6)_ (faat3 hou6 發號) to make a signal; _f(a/)t(8) p(')(u/)i(3)_ (faat3 pui3 發配) banished; _f(a/)t(8) (1)fung_ (faat3 fung1 發瘋), leprous; _f(a/)t(8) (1)ting_ (faat3 ding1 發丁), to have descendants; _f(a/)t(8) (2)ch(i/)_ (faat3 zi2 發紙), to wet paper. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 楊 to 揚. Williams' 發客: Very dated. Williams' 發丁: Specifically, male descendants. To shoot (Kangxi: 䠶發也 etc.). To rise (Kangxi: 起也). To open (Kangxi: 開也). To go, to depart (Kangxi: 進也行也, 去也, 謂起屨也). To raise (Kangxi: 舉也, 興也). To till, to hoe (Kangxi: 伐也, 以耜擊伐). 【發】 (pjot) (_verb-like_) to send forth (_verb-like_) to start (up) (_verb-like_) to go forth (_verb-like_) to shew forth (_adjective-like_) fierce

U+9AEE 发 (Mainland simplified) (F2.72 髮) 毛髮 (Page 51 #2: 髮(8)) Hair of the head (Kangxi: 首上毛也); _met._ herbs, trees, moss (Kangxi: 毛草也地理書云山以草木爲髮); _ch(')uk(7) f(a/)t(8)_ (cuk1 faat3 束髮) to bind up the hair; _(1)p(')(i/) (4)t(')au (2)s(a/)n f(a/)t(8)_ (pei1 tau4 saan2 faat3 披頭散髮) disheveled hair; _s(e/)uk(8) f(a/)t(8)_ (soek3 faat3 削髮) to shave the whole head; _k(i/)t(8) f(a/)t(8)_ (git3 faat3 結髮) marriage of virgins; _shek(9) f(a/)t(8)_ (sek6 faat3 石髮) mosses; _f(a/)t(8) ts(')oi(3)_ (faat3 coi3 髮菜) an algae used for food; _f(a/)t(8) (5)mong_ (faat3 mong5 髮網), female's false hair; _(1)f(i/) f(a/)t(8)_ (fei1 faat3 飛髮) to clip the hair with a razor; _(4)lau (4)t(')au pat(7) (4)lau f(a/)t(8)_ (lau4 tau4 bat1 lau4 faat3 留頭不留髮) ~~married~~ to retain your head, do not retain your hair. Williams' 削髮: Especially in preparation for becoming a Buddhist monk or nun. Williams' 髮網: Now "hairnet". Williams' 留頭不留髮: Clearly not "married". Instead, one of the slogans allegedly used during enforcement of the Ts(')ing Dynasty policy for Han Chinese men to adopt Manchurian hairstyle (a shaved forehead plus a queue). The second half is 留髮不留頭, "retain your hair and you will not retain your head". 【髮】 (pjot) (_noun-like_) hair

fai1.text: U+5FBD 幑 (for "banner" sense) 㫎 (for "banner" sense) (F1.27 徽) 美也 (Page 44 #1: (1)徽) A cord of three strands (Kangxi: 三糾繩也); a string; ~~queenly garments;~~ ~~a kind of sash;~~ good, beautiful (Kangxi: 善也, 徽者美善也); a banner (Kangxi: 與幑通幟也 etc.); the stops on a guitar (Kangxi: 琴節曰徽); _(1)Fai mak(9)_ (fai1 mak6 徽墨) ink from Hwuichau (徽州); _(1)fai (1)yam_ (fai1 jam1 徽音), fine sounds; _(1)fai h(o\)(6)_ (fai1 hou6 徽號) a flag. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿲彳⿱山糸攵 to 徽. Williams' "queenly garments": This is dubious. Although Kangxi has 與褘通, the character 褘 has two readings, and Kangxi appears to be referring to the second reading: 許歸切 _(1)fai_ (fai1), for a queen's attire for sacrificial rites (Kangxi 褘: 后祭服也); and 雨非切 _(4)wai_ (wai4), for a woman's bag(?) (囊也) or for a knee-cover (蔽膝也). Williams' "a kind of sash": This is a misreading of Kangxi 衺幅也. Here, 幅 is to be read _pik(7)_ (bik1). Per 赤芾在股邪幅在下 from the Classic of Poetry, this is a type of binding applied to the lower leg (i.e. from the knee downward). Williams' "the stops on a guitar": Note that the Chinese zither (琴) is fretless, so these are not frets, but a set of inlaid markings away from the strings (providing a visual cue but no physical stoppage). Williams' 徽號: Now "emblem" or "badge". 【徽】 (xjw+j) (_noun-like_) three-stranded-cord (_adjective-like_) good, beautiful (_noun-like_) banner

U+63EE 㩣 挥 (Mainland simplified) (F1.27 揮) 指揮發揮又揮霍 (Page 43 #2: (1)揮) To move, to shake (Kangxi: 振也動也); to be agitated (Kangxi: 奮也); to animate; to sprinkle (Kangxi: 灑也, 揮湔也); to scatter~~, to throw away~~; _(1)fai (1)ch(')un_ (fai1 ceon1 揮春), ~~to write~~ new-year's inscriptions; _(1)fai ~~(1)h(o\)~~ (4)h(o\)_ (fai1 hou4 揮毫), to write; _(1)fai (1)kam (4)(u (2)t(')(o\)_ (fai1 gam1 jyu4 tou2 揮金如土), to spend money like dirt; _(1)fai fok(8)_ (fai1 fok3 揮霍) extravagant; _(2)ch(i/) (1)fai_ (zi2 fai1 指揮), a major in a Manchu corps, to point with the hand; _(1)fai (2)sh(a/)_ (fai1 saa2 揮灑), to sprinkle, to spend fast; _(1)fai tsau(6)_ (fai1 zau6 揮袖) written. Also read _(4)wan_ (wan4), in the phrase _(4)wan (4)lun_ (wan4 leon4 揮掄), entire, unbroken (Kangxi: 揮掄全而不破也). Williams' 揮毫: Corrected _(1)h(o\)_ (hou1) to _(4)h(o\)_ (hou4). To direct, to command (Kangxi: 指揮也). To brandish. 【揮】 (xjw+j) (_verb-like_) to shake (_verb-like_) to brandish 【揮春】 (fai1 ceon1) New Year calligraphic banners. 寫揮春 (se2 fai1 ceon1): "Write New Year banners."

U+649D May appear as either ⿰扌為 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰扌爲 (+12), depending on the font. 㧑 (Mainland simplified) (F1.27 撝) 指也又發撝 (Page 43 #8: (1)撝) To rend open, to tear off (Kangxi: 裂也); to point ~~out~~; humble, unassuming; ~~used for the preceding (翬).~~ Williams' "humble, unassuming": Note that Kangxi's example 《易謙爻》撝謙 should *not* be read as defining 撝 as "humility" (even though the "humility" sense is probably derived from this). To signal, to direct, to command (Kangxi: 一曰手指麾也). 【撝】 (xjwe) (_verb-like_) to signal

U+7762 zeoi1 (per Williams) (Page 594 #7: (1)睢 _(1)Ts(u_ (zeoi1); here normalised to _(1)Fai_ (fai1)) To stare at (Kangxi: 大視也) ~~in a fright~~, to gaze up at (Kangxi: 仰目也, 仰目視貌), to look angrily at (Kangxi: 恣睢恣意怒視也, 睢仰目怒貌). Williams' "in a fright": This is a misreading of Kangxi 《前漢五行志》萬眾睢睢驚怪連日 as a definition, when it is actually an example.

fai1.text: U+7FEC 翚 (Mainland simplified) (F1.27 翬) 雉也 (Page 43 #7: (1)翬) To fly (Kangxi: 大飛也) with noise quickly (Kangxi: 翬翬其飛疾羽聲也); a kind of colored pheasant (Kangxi: 一曰伊洛而南雉五采皆備曰翬 etc.); colored, adorned; _(1)fai (1)fai_ (fai1 fai1 翬翬), to fly up and show the plumage. 【翬】 (xjw+j) (_noun-like_) colourful-pheasant (_verb-like_) to fly

U+8F1D 暉 灳 煇 辉 (Mainland simplified) (F1.27 輝) 光輝 (F1.27 煇) 火光也 (F1.27 暉) 日光 (Page 43 #3: (1)輝) Brilliant, refulgent, glorious (Kangxi: 光也火之光也), like the sun; to glisten; _(1)fai (4)(i/)n_ (fai1 jin4 輝然), spruced up, pleased; _(1)fai (i/)n(6)_ (fai1 jin6 輝現) exceedingly glorious. (Page 43 #4: (1)煇; here normalised to 輝) Luminous, splendid (Kangxi 煇: 光也, 燿光也), like fire (Kangxi 煇: 火之光); _(1)fai (1)kwong_ (fai1 gwong1 輝光), lustrous, gorgeous, like many lamps; _(1)fai (4)wong_ (fai1 wong4 輝煌), illuminated. 【輝】 (xjw+j) (_noun-like_) brightness

U+96B3 墮 墯 隓 (F1.27 隳) 敗也 (Page 43 #10: (1)~~？~~隳) To destroy, to overthrow, to break (Kangxi 隓: 俗作隳非, 廢也毀也損也, 亦作墮); to injure; _(1)fai p(a/)i(6)_ (fai1 baai6 隳敗) to destroy ~~and scatter~~. ~~Also read _to(6)_ (do6), and~~ (...). Williams' "Also read ...": The reading _to(6)_ (do6) is for a different sense (alternative form of 墮 "fall"), so the qualifier "Also" is incorrect. Kangxi 又通作墮 indicates that 隳 _(1)fai_ (fai1) can be spelt 墮. It does *not* indicate a reading of _to(6)_ (do6) for 隳 "destroy/collapse". A collapsed wall (Kangxi 隓: 敗城阜曰隓). 【隳】 (xjwie) (_verb-like_) to destroy

U+9EBE May appear as either ⿸⿸广林毛 or ⿸⿸广𣏟毛 (assumed here), depending on the font. 戲 (F1.27 麾) 驅也旌旗所以指揮 (Page 43 #6: (1)麾) A signal or marking flag (Kangxi: 旌旗之屬所以指麾也, 或作戲, 戲大將之旗); to make a signal, to motion to (Kangxi: 與撝同以手指麾也); quick, hasty (Kangxi: 快也); _(1)fai h(a/)(6)_ (fai1 haa6 麾下) your honor! (used by soldiers.) Fan Wan entry: Corrected missing strokes in 驅. 【麾】 (xjwe) (_noun-like_) signal-flag (_verb-like_) to signal (_adjective-like_) quick

fai3.text: U+75BF 痱 fai3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) fai6 (per 《廣韻》扶沸切 for 痱) (Page 713 #6: 疿(3)) Pimples, small boils~~;~~, sores from heat (Kangxi: 熱生小瘡 etc.); _(i/)t(9) fai(3)_ (jit6 fai3-2 熱疿) or _fai(3) (2)tsz'_ (fai3-2 zi2 疿子) prickly heat. The original departing reading fai3 is almost never heard, having been supplanted by vernacular rising fai3-2 in all senses. In modern usage, the spelling 痱 is much more common. However, this appears to be a merger of two apparently distinct (but synonymous) words in Middle Chinese: 疿, read 方味切 _fai(3)_ (fai3), explained 熱生小瘡; and 痱, read 扶沸切 _fai(6)_ (fai6), explained 熱瘡. In Cantonese, the distinction is hidden by the vernacular rising tone. In Mandarin, there is no distinction between 陰去 and 陽去 (both become fei). Of the two characters, 疿 is the older, as attested in 《黃帝素問》汗出見濕乃生痤疿. Whilst it is 痱 that appears in 《說文》, it is for the different sense of "stroke/paralysis", to be read 符非切 _(4)f(i/)_ (fei4). See 痱 fei4. Williams' "small boils": Corrected the following semicolon to a comma. There is only one sense to be defined here (i.e. the pimples and small boils are also from heat, not standalone). 【疿】 (pj+jH) (_noun-like_) heat-rash 【熱痱】 (jit6 fai3-2) Miliaria, heat rash.

fei4.text: U+75F1 Stroke or paralysis (Kangxi: 風病也). 【痱】 (bj+j) (_noun-like_) stroke

fai3.text: U+5EE2 废 (Mainland simplified) fai3-2 (rising second in vernacular 廢廢地) (F1.32 廢) 絶也棄也 (Page 44 #3: 廢(3)) A house in ruins (Kangxi: 屋頓也); to abandon, to throw aside (Kangxi: 廢舍也, 舍放置), to destroy, to lose; to repudiate, to disinherit; to stop (Kangxi: 止也, 止住也), to fail; obsolete, null; spoiled, corrupt; to depose; useless, degraded; _fai(3) h(u(3)_ (fai3 heoi3 廢去) thrown aside, rejected; _fai(3) mat(9)_ (fai3 mat6 廢物) a useless fellow, good for nothing; _p(u/)n(3) (4)t(')(o\) (4)(i/) fai(3)_ (bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3 半途而廢) to ~~reject~~ abandon when half done; _fai(3) tsat(9)_ (fai3 zat6 廢疾) disabled, incurable. To fall (Kangxi: 墮也). 【廢】 (pjojH) (_verb-like_) to cast away, to abandon, to abolish (_verb-like_) to waste (_verb-like_) to fall

U+6CB8 fat1 (per 《集韻》分物切 for "spring-bubbling" sense) (F1.32 沸) 火煮水滚又泉湧出曰沸 (Page 44 #5: 沸(3)) To bubble, as boiling water (Kangxi: 涫也) or a spring (Kangxi: 觱沸泉出貌); _~~shui(3)~~ (2)shui fai(3) (1)ch(')ung (4)ch(')(a/)_ (seoi2 fai3 cung1 caa4 水沸沖茶), the water boils, pour it on the tea. Also read _fat(7)_ (fat1). Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 滚. Williams' 水沸沖茶: Corrected _shui(3)_ (seoi3) to _(2)shui_ (seoi2). Bustling. 【沸-departing】 (pj+jH) (_verb-like_) to bubble 【觱沸】 (pjit pjut) (_verb-like_) to bubble 【沸-entering】 (pjut) Used in 觱沸.

fei6.text: U+72D2 fai3 (common) fai6 (alternative) fat1 (common) (Page 53 #10: 狒(6)) An animal of the monkey tribe, large and monstrous (Kangxi: 狒狒如人被髮迅走食人, 梟羊也 etc.); _f(i/)(6) f(i/)(6)_ (fei6 fei6 狒狒) the orang-outang or chimpanzee. Williams' 狒狒: Now refers to the baboon.

fai3.text: U+80BA (F1.32 肺) 肺肝 (Page 44 #6: 肺(3)) The lungs (Kangxi: 金藏也 etc.); they are connected with metal; _fai(3) (1)k(a/)_ (fai3 gaa1 肺家), the lungs. 【肺】 (phjojH) (_noun-like_) lung

fat1.text: U+82BE 紼 (for "knee-cover" sense) (F1.86 芾) 芾冕諸侯服也 (Page 44 #7: 芾(3)) read _fat(7)_ (fat1) as _fat(7) fat(7)_ (fat1 fat1 芾芾) foliage abundant (Kangxi: 草木翳薈也, 芾芾茂也). (Page 49 #15: 紼(7); here normalised to 芾) a ~~screen~~ covering for the knees (Kangxi 紼: 與芾通, 紼者蔽也行以蔽前天子朱紼諸侯赤紼); Fan Wan entry: Removed extra dot atop 冕, and corrected missing and incomplete strokes in 服. 【芾-entering】 (pjut) (_adjective-like_) flourishing (_noun-like_) knee-cover

U+8300 祓 (for "good-fortune" sense) fuk1 (for "good-fortune" sense) (F1.86 茀) 轎簾也 (Page 49 #14: 茀(7)) Brambles, or luxuriant herbage, concealing the path (Kangxi: 道多草不可行, 茀茀茂也); happiness, luck (Kangxi: 福也); ~~to~~ a screen (Kangxi: 婦人乗車不露見車之前後設障以自蔽隱謂之茀); to clear away, to open (Kangxi: 治也); _fat(7) ~~(2)ts(o\)~~ (2)ts(')(o\)_ (fat1 cou2 茀草), to clear away grass. Williams' 茀草: Corrected _(2)ts(o\)_ (zou2) to _(2)ts(')(o\)_ (cou2). Strong, vigorous (Kangxi: 强盛也). 【茀】 (phjut) (_adjective-like_) flourishing, vigorous (_noun-like_) screen (_verb-like_) to clear (away) (_noun-like_) fortuity

fai3.text: U+8CBB 费 (Mainland simplified) (F1.32 費) 費用又姓 (Page 44 #2: 費(3)) To spend, to use (Kangxi: 散財用也); to exert; to dissipate (Kangxi: 損也耗也); expense, cost, trouble, outlay (Kangxi: 用也); waste, lavishing; squandering; _(2)shai fai(3)_ (sai2 fai3 使費) to spend, to expend; _fai(3) sz'(6)_ (fai3 si6 費事) troublesome, to interrupt; _fai(3) (1)sam_ (fai3 sam1 費心), to remember one; _long(6) fai(3)_ (long6 fai3 浪費) wasteful; _fai(3) (4)sh(i/)_ (fai3 si4 費時), waste one's time; _kwo(3) fai(3)_ (gwo3 fai3 過費) "great outlay," politely said when sitting at a feast; _p(')o(3) fai(3)_ (po3 fai3 破費) 'lost your outlay,' needless expense, politely said by one who gets a present; _chai(3) fai(3)_ (zai3 fai3 ？費) heedless, witless. 【費-unvoiced】 (phj+jH) (_verb-like_) to squander, to spend 【費事】 (fai3 si6) Not to be bothered (to do something). 費事煮 (fai3 si6 zyu2): "Can't be bothered cooking." 費事行 (fai3 si6 haang4): "Can't be bothered walking." Used before a negative consequence to be prevented or avoided. Like English "lest", but informal. 費事遲到 (fai3 si6 ci4 dou3): "So that we won't arrive late." 費事冷嚫 (fai3 si6 laang5 can1): "So that I don't catch a cold."

fai6.text: U+8CBB 费 (Mainland simplified) fei6 (alternative) Broad in application (Kangxi: 費用之廣也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓也). 【費-voiced】 (bj+jH) (_adjective-like_) general-use
U+5420 (F1.34 吠) 犬聲 (Page 44 #8: 吠(6)) The bark of a dog (Kangxi: 犬吠鳴也, 犬聲); _l(un(6) fai(6) (2)kau_ (lyun6 fai6 gau2 亂吠狗), a dog which barks at everybody. 【吠】 (bjojH) (_verb-like_) to bark

fei6.text: U+5C5D 菲 fai6 (alternative) fei2 (per Williams for 菲, common) (Page 53 #8: (2)菲 _(2)F(i/)_ (fei2); here normalised to 屝 _F(i/)(6)_ (fei6)) straw sandals (Kangxi 菲: 與屝通, 菲草履); Or made from hemp, which also is coarser than silk (Kangxi: 屝麤屨也絲作曰履麻作曰屝). 【屝】 (bj+jH) (_noun-like_) straw-sandal

fei1.text: U+83F2 (Page 53 #8: (2)菲 _(2)F(i/)_ (fei2); here corrected to _(1)F(i/)_ (fei1)) fragrant (Kangxi: 菲菲香也), ~~beautiful~~ luxuriant (Kangxi: 草茂貌, 芳菲也); _(1)fong ~~(2)f(i/)~~ (1)f(i/)_ (fong1 fei1 芳菲) grassy. Mixed, assorted (Kangxi: 雜也). 【菲-level】 (phj+j) (_adjective-like_) fragrant (_adjective-like_) luxuriant

fei2.text: U+83F2 棐 (for "scant" sense) fai6 (alternative per 《集韻》父沸切 for vegetable sense) fei6 (alternative per 《集韻》父沸切 for vegetable sense) (F1.39 菲) 薄也 (Page 53 #8: (2)菲) A red marshy plant (Kangxi: 菜名, 芴也, 菲草生下濕地似蕪菁華紫赤色可食); pot-herbs, greens; sparing, frugal (Kangxi: 薄也); uneasy; _(2)f(i/) pok(9)_ (fei2 bok6 菲薄) poor, valueless; _(2)f(i/) (4)(i/)_ (fei2 ji4 菲儀), trifling, little of; _(2)f(i/) mat(9)_ (fei2 mat6 菲物) of no moment---said of presents; _(2)f(i/) ~~nik(7)~~ nik(9)_ (fei2 nik6 菲惄) grieved (Kangxi: 菲惄悵也); Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete strokes in 薄. Williams' 菲惄: Normalised _nik(7)_ (nik1) to _nik(9)_ (nik6). 【菲-rising】 (phj+jX) (_noun-like_) radish (_adjective-like_) scant

fan1.text: U+5206 匪 (F1.80 分) 分别分離 (Page 45 #15: (1)分) To separate, to divide (Kangxi: 別也); to halve (Kangxi: 半也); to distribute (Kangxi: 賦也施也), to divide amongst; to give, to partake with (Kangxi: 與也); a candareen, a tenth in decimal notation. _(4)P(')ing (1)fan_ (ping4 fan1 平分), to divide evenly; _(1)fan (1)hoi_ (fan1 hoi1 分開), to separate; _(1)fan ~~p(i/)t(8)~~ p(i/)t(9)_ (fan1 bit6 分別) to divide, to leave; separately; _(1)fan ~~p(u/)n(3)~~ p(u/)n(6)_ (fan1 bun6 分伴) to dissolve partnership; _(1)fan (4)ch(')ing sh(o\)(3)_ (fan1 cing4 sou3 分程數) to pay in proportion; _(1)fan (1)k(a/)_ (fan1 gaa1 分家), to divide the estate; _(1)fan ~~p(a/)i(3)~~ p(')(a/)i(3)_ (fan1 paai3 分派) to give amongst; _yat(7) (1)fan (4)hong fo(3), yat(7) (1)fan (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (jat1 fan1 hong4 fo3 jat1 fan1 cin4 一分行貨一分錢), each kind of goods has its own price; _(1)fan (1)k(o\)m (4)t(')ung m(i/)(6)_ (fan1 gam1 tung4 mei6 分柑同味) same taste as the carpels of an orange; _(1)fan (4)(un_ (fan1 jyun4 分？), a deputy district magistrate. Williams' "a candareen": That is, a tenth of a mace (錢), or a hundredth of a tael (両). Williams' 分別: Corrected _p(i/)t(8)_ (bit3) to _p(i/)t(9)_ (bit6). Williams' 分伴: Corrected _p(u/)n(3)_ (bun3) to _p(u/)n(6)_ (bun6). Williams' 分派: Corrected _p(a/)i(3)_ (baai3) to _p(')(a/)i(3)_ (paai3). Williams' 分柑同味: So spelt because of his reference to "orange". The more common form is 分甘同味, with "sweetness" replacing "orange". To distinguish (Kangxi: 判也). A minute. A point, a mark (in scoring). A tenth of a Chinese inch (寸). 【分-level】 (pjun) (_verb-like_) to separate, to split, (_met._) to dispute (_verb-like_) to distinguish (_verb-like_) to share (_noun-like_) tenth 【分分鐘】 (fan1 fan1 zung1) Used to indicate the possibility of a negative outcome. (Literally, "could at every minute".) 分分鐘破產 (fan1 fan1 zung1 po3 caan2): "You could go bankrupt."

fan6.text: U+5206 (Page 45 #15: (1)分 read _Fan(3)_ (fan3); here corrected to _Fan(6)_ (fan6)) Read _~~fan(3)~~ fan(6)_ (fan6) a portion (Kangxi: 均也分劑也), a duty, a part (Kangxi: 分位也); _(1)s(a/)m ~~fan(3)~~ fan(6) (1)ch(i/) yat(7)_ (saam1 fan6 zi1 jat1 三分之一) one third. In Cantonese, the fraction-building sense of 分 is a noun, not a verb. The construct 三分之一 to be parsed as "one of three shares (or portions)". As such, 分 is to be read in the departing tone, _fan(6)_ (fan6). It is *not* to be read in the level tone, as in Mandarin. By extension, the "fraction" sense of 分 is also to be read in the departing tone in Cantonese. This distinguishes 分數 fan6 sou3 "fraction" from 分數 fan1 sou3 "score/points". A fraction (of mathematics). 分數 (fan6 sou3): "Fraction." 約分 (joek3 fan6): "Reducing fractions." 【分-departing】 (bjunH) (_noun-like_) share, fraction (_noun-like_) allotted duty

fei2.text: U+532A (F1.39 匪) 非也 (Page 53 #3: (2)匪) not right, illegal; banditti, vagabonds, heretics; _(2)f(i/) lui(6)_ (fei2 leoi6 匪類) or _(2)f(i/) ~~(4)t(o\)~~ (4)t(')(o\)_ (fei2 tou4 匪徒), vagabonds; _(2)f(i/) (2)tong_ (fei2 dong2 匪黨), a band of villains; _(2)f(i/) shik(7)_ (fei2 sik1 匪色) variegated. fan1.text: U+5429 分 (in 吩咐 spelt 分付) (F1.80 吩) 吩咐 (Page 46 #1: (1)吩) To direct; _(1)fan ~~(1)f(u/)~~ f(u/)(3)_ (fan1 fu3 吩咐), to bid to do, to order. Williams' 吩咐: Corrected 吩呼 _(1)fan (1)f(u/)_ (fan1 fu1) to 吩咐 _(1)fan f(u/)(3)_ (fan1 fu3). Note that Williams has no entry for the character 咐.

U+5A5A 㛰 昏 (F1.80 婚) 婚姻 (Page 45 #8: (1)婚) Marriage (Kangxi: 婚姻嫁也); to take a wife; _(1)fan (1)yan_ (fan1 jan1 婚姻), ~~nuptials~~ marriage; _(4)m(a/)i (1)fan_ (maai4 fan1 埋婚), to complete a marriage; _~~(1)l(i/)n~~ (4)l(i/)n (1)fan_ (lin4 fan1 連婚) (Kangxi: 婚嫁之婚親曰連婚), ~~to marry relatives~~ relatives by marriage, _i. e._ in-laws; _(1)fan p(')(u/)i(3)_ (fan1 pui3 婚配) to contract a marriage. Williams' 連婚: Corrected _(1)l(i/)n_ (lin1) to _(4)l(i/)n_ (lin4). 【婚】 (xwon) (_noun-like_) marriage (_noun-like_) in-law
U+5E09 紛 A wiping-cloth (Kangxi: 拭物巾也, 楚謂大巾曰帉, 又通作紛). 【帉】 (phjun) (_noun-like_) wiping-cloth

U+60DB 惽 fan3 (per 《廣韻》呼悶切 for "forgetful" sense) man5 (per 《集韻》弭盡切 for "confused" sense) (F1.80 惛) 心不明也 (Page 45 #9: (1)惛) Stupid (Kangxi: 不憭也, 不明了也, 心不明也), forgetful (Kangxi: 迷忘也); confused ~~recollection~~ (Kangxi: 昏意也). 【惛】 (xwon) (_adjective-like_) muddled, muddle-headed

U+660F 昬 (F1.80 昏) 日暮也暗也昧也 (Page 45 #7: (1)昏) The sun setting (Kangxi: 日冥也); evening twilight; dusk (Kangxi: 昏代也, 代明也, 日入後二刻半爲昏昏來則明往故云代明); obscure, confused, dull (Kangxi: 昏亂也); in disorder; ~~to oblige to do;~~ _(4)wong (1)fan_ (wong4 fan1 黃昏), dusk; _(1)fan (o\)m(3)_ (fan1 am3 昏暗) dark, dull; _(1)fan l(un(6)_ (fan1 lyun6 昏亂) confused; _(1)fan m(u/)i(6)_ (fan1 mui6 昏昧) unintelligible; _(1)fan y(e/)(6)_ (fan1 je6 昏夜) a gloomy night; _(1)fan (1)f(a/)_ (fan1 faa1 昏花), motes in the eye. To endeavour, to make an effort (Kangxi: 昏彊也). Not yet named (Kangxi: 未名曰昏). To lose consciousness. 【昏】 (xwon) (_noun-like_) dusk (_adjective-like_) adusk, (_met._) blind

U+66DB 熏 纁 (for "dusklight" sense) (F1.80 曛) 日没曰曛 (Page 45 #1: (1)熏; here normalised to 曛) evening twilight; _(1)fan tsik(9)_ (fan1 zik6 曛夕) evening twilight; (Page 45 #3: (1)曛) ~~Twilight~~ Evening twilight, dusk (Kangxi: 黃昏時); the light reflected after sunset (Kangxi: 日入餘光); ~~exhilarated;~~ _(1)sh(a/)n (4)h(a/)m (1)fan ~~(2)y(e/)ung~~ (2)ying_ (saan1 haam4 fan1 jing2 山涵曛映), the hills are tinged with the setting sun. fan4.text: U+678C fan1 (per Fan Wan) (F1.80 枌 _(1)Fan_ (fan1)) 枌榆木名 (Page 46 #2: (1)枌 _(1)Fan_ (fan1); here normalised to _(4)Fan_ (fan4)) A tree resembling the elm with white wood (Kangxi: 楡白枌); _~~(1)fan~~ (4)fan (4)(u (5)sh(e/)_ (fan4 jyu4 se5 枌榆社), an agricultural ~~feast~~ altar (Kangxi: 枌楡社名). 【枌】 (bjun) (_noun-like_) white-elm

fan1.text: U+68FB 梤 fan4 (alternative per 《廣韻》符分切) (F1.80 棻) 香木也 (Page 46 #4: (1)棻) A fragrant wood (Kangxi: 香木也) burned for its perfume. Flourishing, luxuriant.

U+68FC fan4 (per Kangxi 符分切) (F1.80 紛) 紛紜雜也衆也紛亂也 (F1.80 棼) 同上 (Page 46 #3: (1)棼) confused, disordered, complicated (Kangxi: 亂也); Kangxi has this sense under the reading 符分切 _(4)fan_ (fan4). In my opinion, this is dubious, as 《廣韻》符分切 is explained 複屋棟也, which is unrelated to confusion/disorder. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 衆 and 亂.

fan4.text: U+68FC 枌 (for "roof-beam" sense) (Page 46 #2: (1)枌 _(1)Fan_ (fan1); here corrected to _(4)Fan_ (fan4) and normalised to 棼) a beam in a house (Kangxi 枌: 通棼複屋棟也); (Page 46 #3: (1)棼 _(1)Fan_ (fan1); here corrected to _(4)Fan_ (fan4)) A beam or ridge-pole of a roof (Kangxi: 複屋棟也, 複屋背重梁); hempen covering (Kangxi: 薠麻謂之棼, 棼麻布也). 【棼】 (bjun) (_noun-like_) roof-beam (_noun-like_) hemp-cloth

fan1.text: U+6C1B 雰 fan4 (alternative per 《廣韻》符分切) (F1.80 氛) 沃氛 (Page 46 #6: (1)氛) Fume, vapor (Kangxi: 氣也); shadowy signs, a will-o'-the-wisp, airy omens (Kangxi: 氛氳祥氣也, 氛祲妖氣也); _(1)fan (1)wan_ (fan1 wan1 氛氳), aerial influences; _(2)i(u/) (1)fan_ (jiu2 fan1 妖氛), noxious influences; _(2)hoi (1)fan_ (hoi2 fan1 海氛), pirates; _kwok(8) (1)fan_ (gwok3 fan1 國氛), ~~demagogues, disturbers~~ disturbings of the peace. 《廣韻》 has 符分切 _(4)fan_ (fan4) for 氛氲祥氣 "auspicious ambience", and 撫文切 _(1)fan_ (fan1) for 氛侵妖氣 "malign ambience". Modern usage prefers the latter reading, and it is debatable whether the distinction was necessary in the first place. 【氛】 (bjun, phjun) (_noun-like_) ambience

fan4.text: U+6C7E fan1 (per Fan Wan) (F1.80 汾 _(1)Fan_ (fan1)) 水名 (Page 46 #5: (1)汾 _(1)Fan_ (fan1); here normalised to _(4)Fan_ (fan4)) A river in Sh(a/)ns(i/) (山西), a branch of the Yellow R (Kangxi: 水名 etc.). _~~(1)Fan~~ (4)Fan (4)y(e/)ung (4)wong_ (fan4 joeng4 wong4 汾陽王), a personage in the T(a/)ng (唐) dynasty, whose name is a synonym for happiness; as _~~(1)Fan~~ (4)Fan (4)y(e/)ung (2)t(i/)m (5)h(o\)m_ (fan4 joeng4 dim2 ham5 汾陽點頷), Fany(e/)ung's king nodding his chin (because he did not know all his descendants). Williams' "A river in Sh(a/)ns(i/)": Note that Kangxi 水出太原晉陽山西南入河 is to be punctuated as "水出太原晉陽山、西南入河". That we know it is in Sh(a/)ns(i/) is due to "太原晉陽山", not "山、西".

fan1.text: U+6DBD 湣 (F1.80 涽) 齊涽王 (Page 45 #10: (1)涽) Unsettled, unstable, like water (Kangxi: 涽涽未定貌); Fan Wan entry: The posthumous-name sense should be read _(5)man_ (man5) and spelt 湣. See 湣 man5 (TODO).

U+7104 (F1.80 焄) 香氣也禮云焄蒿悽愴 (Page 45 #14: ~~(1)蔒~~(1)焄) fumes from cooked vegetables; ~~savory~~ odors (Kangxi 焄: 香臭之氣也); _(1)fan ~~(1)ho~~ (1)h(o\)_ (fan1 hou1 焄蒿), steam from viands; odorous exhalations. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 愴. Williams considers 蔒 and 焄 interchangeable. This is only true in the sense that both are alternative forms of 葷. Williams' "savory odors": This is a misreading of Kangxi 香臭, which refers odours in general (whether good or bad). Williams' 焄蒿: Corrected _(1)ho_ (ho1) to _(1)h(o\)_ (hou1). 【焄】 (xjun) (_noun-like_) fume, odour

U+718F 焄 燻 (for smoke-related senses) 薰 (F1.80 熏) 烟也又熱氣蒸也 (Page 45 #1: (1)熏) Vapor, exhalations, steam (Kangxi: 火氣盛貌); smoke rising (Kangxi: 火煙上出也); to smoke, to fumigate, to heat (Kangxi: 熱也), to parch (Kangxi: 熏灼也); to offend; to becloud; _(1)fan (1)fung_ (fan1 fung1 熏風), warm wind (Kangxi: 東南曰熏風); _(1)fan (2)fo (2)t(')(u/)i_ (fan1 fo2 teoi2 熏火腿), to smoke hams; _(1)fan (1)fan_ (fan1 fan1 熏熏)~~, uneasy, fidgetty~~; _(1)fan (1)kon_ (fan1 gon1 熏乾), to dry at the fire; _(1)fan ~~chek(9)~~ chek(8)_ (fan1 zek3 熏炙) to cauterize (Kangxi 焄: 焄猶熏炙之也). (Page 45 #14: ~~(1)蔒~~(1)焄) Vapor or steam (Kangxi 焄: 火上出也, 亦作熏); Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𤍠 to 熱. Williams' "uneasy, fidgetty": This is a rendering of Kangxi 熏熏坐不安之貌, which is one of the explanations for 《詩大雅》公尸來止熏熏, but not a very good one, in my opinion. The other explanations (熏熏和悅也 and 熏說文作醺醉也) are better, and of these, the second takes 熏 to be an alternative form of 醺. Williams' 熏炙: Corrected _chek(9)_ (zek6) to _chek(8)_ (zek3). Amiable and cheerful (Kangxi: 熏熏和悅也). Warm. 【熏】 (xjun) (_verb-like_) to smoke, to fume, (_met._) to scorch Used in 熏熏. 【熏熏】 (xjun xjun) (_adjective-like_) elated
