U+7E81 𫄸 (Mainland simplified) (F1.80 纁) 淡紅色也 (Page 713 #8: (1)纁) A light red (Kangxi: 淺絳也), produced by a trine immersion in the dye (Kangxi: 三染謂之纁); a scarlet tint. 【纁】 (xjun) (_adjective-like_) light-red, pink

U+82AC (F1.80 芬) 芬芳 (Page 46 #8: (1)芬) Budding and blossoming; fragrance from opening plants (Kangxi: 草初生香分布也); _(1)fan (1)fong_ (fan1 fong1 芬芳), spreading fragrance; _(1)fan (1)fan_ (fan1 fan1 芬芬), odoriferous (Kangxi: 芬芬香也). (...), harmonious (Kangxi: 和也). Kangxi has the "mound-like, bulging" sense (supplemented below) under the main reading 撫文切 _(1)fan_ (fan1). But if this is the same word as 墳 "moundy", then it should be read 符分切 _(4)fan_ (fan4) instead. Mound-like, bulging (Kangxi: 芬然壤起貌). 【芬】 (phjun) (_adjective-like_) sweet-smelling

U+8477 焄 蔒 薰 荤 (Mainland simplified) (F1.80 葷) 臭草又不食齋曰葷 (Page 45 #13: (1)葷) Leeks, onions, and strong flavored vegetables (Kangxi: 蔥薤也, 葷臭菜也 etc.); animal food; _(1)fan s(u/)(3)_ (fan1 sou3 葷素) meats or vegetables; _pat(7) (4)(u (1)fan_ (bat1 jyu4 fan1 不？葷), not to eat meat; _(1)fan (1)seng_ (fan1 seng1 葷腥), ~~savory~~ meaty odors of food. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 齋. 【葷】 (xjun) (_noun-like_) aromatic-vegetable
U+8512 (Page 45 #14: (1)蔒~~(1)焄~~) Williams considers 蔒 and 焄 interchangeable. This is only true in the sense that both are alternative forms of 葷.

U+85B0 蘍 (F1.80 薰) 香草 (Page 45 #5: (1)薰) Fragrant plants (Kangxi: 香草也), fragrance; used ~~in houses~~ to expel demons (Kangxi: 古人祓除以此草薰之故謂之薰); a savory smell. U+91BA 熏 (F1.80 醺) 微醉也 (Page 45 #6: (1)醺) Intoxicated, drunk (Kangxi: 醉也 etc.); smelling of liquor; _tsui(3) (1)fan (1)fan_ (zeoi3 fan1 fan1 醉醺醺), gloriously drunk. 【醺】 (xjun) (_adjective-like_) intoxicated

U+95BD 𨵽 阍 (Mainland simplified) (F1.80 閽) 閽人守門之役 (Page 45 #11: (1)閽) ~~To shut~~ The lowly servant who shuts the door at evening (Kangxi: 常以昏閉門隸也); a lowly porter (Kangxi: 閽者守門之賤者也); _(1)fan (4)yan_ (fan1 jan4 閽人), a doorkeeper, an eunuch who keeps the hareem; _k(')au(3) (1)fan_ (kau3 fan1 叩閽), to visit the palace (Kangxi: 凡吏民冤抑詣闕自愬者曰叩閽). A palace gate. 【閽】 (xwon) (_noun-like_) doorkeeper

U+96F0 (F1.80 雰) 下雲貌 (Page 46 #9: (1)雰) A frosty mist (Kangxi: 霧氣也); hoarfrost (Kangxi: 潤氣著草木遇寒凍色白曰雰); _(5)(u (1)fan (1)fan_ (jyu5 fan1 fan1 雨雰雰), a snowy, sleety, rain. Snowy (Kangxi: 雰雰雪貌). 【雰】 (phjun) (_adjective-like_) snowy
U+9934 May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), and with right component ⿱大卉 (+8 assumed here) or ⿱大𠦄 (+9), depending on the font. (F1.80 餴) 蒸熟米以水沃之乃再蒸也 (Page 45 #12: (1)餴)

U+9959 May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), and with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. 餴 (F1.80 餴) 蒸熟米以水沃之乃再蒸也 (Page 45 #12: (1)餴; here normalised to 饙) Rice steamed thoroughly; to steam rice (Kangxi 饙: ...然則蒸米爲之饙饙必餾而熟之...). Kangxi's treatment is confusing. For the form 餴, it gives a single sense, defined 半蒸飯也與饙同 (half-steamed-rice, same as 饙), along with the commentary 餴蒸米一熟而以水沃之乃再蒸也 (to steam rice till cooked, then add water, then steam again). This is consistent with Williams' "Rice steamed thoroughly". For the form 饙, it splits things up into: The "half-steamed-rice" sense (半蒸飯); and What appears to be the "thoroughly cooked" sense, based on a heap of commentary on 《爾雅釋言》饙餾稔也.

fan6.text: U+4EFD 分 fan6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun for "share/part" senses) (Page 46 #15: (2)份) A portion, a dividend, a share; _(1)fan (2)fan_ (fan1 fan6-2 分份), to divide the profits; _(4)m(a/)i (2)fan_ (maai4 fan6-2 埋份), to put in shares; _(2)fan (2)tsz'_ (fan6-2 zi2 份子) a share. A vulgar character. (Page 713 #10: (2)份) (...) The proper sound in colloquial is _fan(6)_ (fan6), though sometimes read _(2)fan_ (fan6-2). It is the same word as 分(6) (fan6) when used as a noun. Classifier for documents. Classifier for gifts. Classifier for jobs. Suffixed after 年, 月, 省, etc. to indicate an interval (in time) or division (in space). 【份】 (fan6-2) A part, a partaking. 有份出席 (jau5 fan6-2 ceot1 zik6): "Have a part in attending." 冇佢份 (mou5 keoi5 fan6-2): "There's no part for him" (i.e. he is excluded). 【兩份】 (loeng5 fan6-2) Shared between two. 兩份飲 (loeng5 fan6-2 jam2): "Drink it between the two of us."

fan2.text: U+7C89 fan3 (per 《集韻》方問切 for "apply" sense) (F1.83 粉) 米末也又粉飾 (Page 46 #16: (2)粉) Rice broken to pieces (Kangxi: 米粉, 分也硏米使分散也); a flour of any grain (Kangxi: 豆屑也); pigment, to adorn (Kangxi: 傅也飾也); to whitewash or color (Kangxi: 設采潤色謂之粉澤 etc.); _~~(2)mai~~ (5)mai (2)fan_ (mai5 fan2 米粉) rice flour; rice vermicelli; _suk(7) ~~(2)mai~~ (5)mai (2)fan_ (suk1 mai5 fan2 粟米粉), indian-meal; _(2)fan (1)sz'_ (fan2 si1 粉絲) or _(2)fan (2)tsai_ (fan2 zai2 粉仔), vermicelli; _m(i/)n(6) (2)fan_ (min6 fan2 面粉), a cosmetic; _(2)fan (1)ts(e/)ung_ (fan2 zoeng1 粉漿), starch; _(2)fan toi(6)_ (fan2 doi6-2 粉袋) a tailor's chalk-bag; _~~(1)l(e/)ung~~ (4)l(e/)ung (2)fan_ (loeng4 fan2 涼粉), a sort of jelly; _(2)fan ~~sui(6)~~ sui(3)_ (fan2 seoi3 粉碎) smashed to shivers; _(2)fan shik(7) t(')(a/)i(3) (4)p(')ing_ (fan2 sik1 taai3 ping4 粉飾太平), a specious peace; _(2)fan ~~(4)p(a/)i~~ (4)p(')(a/)i_ (fan2 paai4 粉牌) a writing-board; _(2)fan pik(7)_ (fan2 bik1 粉壁) to whitewash a wall; _(4)(un (2)fan_ (jyun4 fan2 鉛粉), white lead. (Page 713 #9: (2)粉) The white pus of sores; _(2)fan (4)lau_ (fan2 lau4-2 粉瘤), the sloughing from tumors. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 未 to 末. Williams' 米粉, 粟米粉: Corrected _(2)mai_ (mai2) to _(5)mai_ (mai5). Williams' 粉絲: Now more commonly known as glass/cellophane noodles. Williams' 面粉: Not to be confused with 麪粉. Williams' 涼粉: Corrected _(1)l(e/)ung_ (loeng1) to _(4)l(e/)ung_ (loeng4). Specifically, grass jelly. Williams' 粉碎: Corrected _sui(6)_ (seoi6) to _sui(3)_ (seoi3). Williams' 粉牌: Corrected _(4)p(a/)i_ (baai4) to _(4)p(')(a/)i_ (paai4). Cosmetics (Kangxi: 傅面者也). Powder (Kangxi: 凡物磑之如屑者皆爲粉粉通稱非獨米也). To powder. Flour- or starch-based foods (especially staples). 【粉】 (pjunX) (_noun-like_) powder (_noun-like_) rice-flour

fan3.text: U+7793 (Page 47 #6: 瞓(3)) To sleep, to rest; _(5)n(i/) fan(3) (1)wan_ (nei5 fan3 wan1 你瞓瘟), you are half asleep; _(5)ng(a/)n fan(3)_ (ngaan5 fan3 眼瞓) sleepy. A colloquial word, for which this character is often made. 【瞓】 (fan3) To sleep. 唔夠瞓 (m4 gau3 fan3): "Not enough sleep." 喺度瞓 (hai2 dou6 fan3): "Sleep here." 打側瞓 (daa2 zak1 fan3): "Sleep sideways." 瞓廳 (fan3 teng1): "Sleep in the living-room." 瞓地 (fan3 dei6): "Sleep on the floor." 瞓街 (fan3 gaai1): "Sleep on the streets" (i.e. be homeless). To lie, to recline. 瞓低 (fan3 dai1): "Lie down." 瞓低嗮 (fan3 dai1 saai3): "All toppled." 【瞓覺】 (fan3 gaau3) To sleep. 瞓緊晏覺 (fan3 gan2 aan3 gaau3): "Taking an afternoon nap." 瞓着覺 (fan3 zoek6 gaau3): "Fallen asleep." 【瞓身】 (fan3 san1) To go all in. 【瞓着】 (fan3 zoek6) To fall asleep. 未瞓着 (mei6 fan3 zoek6): "Not yet asleep." 瞓唔着 (fan3 m4 zoek6): "Can't fall asleep." 瞓着咗 (fan3 zoek6 zo2): "Fallen asleep." 【蚊都瞓】 (man1 dou1 fan3) Way too late. (Literally, "even mosquitoes are going to sleep".) 【蚊瞓】 (man1 fan3) Short for 蚊都瞓. 【眼瞓】 (ngaan5 fan3) Sleepy. The spelling 瞓 is arbitrary (but well established).

U+7CDE 粪 (Mainland simplified) (F1.85 糞) 糞穢又壅也 (Page 47 #8: 糞(3)) Ordure, filth, muck (Kangxi: 穢也), excrement; to manure (Kangxi: 治也培也); _fan(3) (1)h(a/)ng_ (fan3 haang1 糞坑), a privy; _fan(3) (4)m(u/)n_ (fan3 mun4 糞門), the anus; _lok(9) fan(3)_ (lok6 fan3 落糞) to manure; _fan(3) li(u/)(6)_ (fan3 liu6-2 糞料) muck prepared for sale; _fan(3) t(i/)(6)_ (fan3 dei6 糞地) a public necessary. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 穢. To remove, to sweep away (Kangxi: 掃除也, 糞除也). 【糞】 (pjunH) (_noun-like_) manure, muck (_verb-like_) to sweep (away)

U+8A13 训 (Mainland simplified) (F1.85 訓) 敎訓也又誡也 (Page 47 #7: 訓(3)) To instruct (Kangxi: 說敎也, 導也), to teach (Kangxi: 誨也)~~, to exhort~~; to explain (Kangxi: 訓者釋所言之理也); a doctrine, precept (Kangxi: 古言可爲法也); ~~definition;~~ _fan(3) k(a/)u(3)_ (fan3 gaau3 訓教) to instruct; _fan(3) l(i/)n(6)_ (fan3 lin6 訓練) ~~to teach the manual~~ to train; _fan(3) t(o\)(6)_ (fan3 dou6 訓導) the ~~snperintendent~~ superintendent of education in each department; _(2)k(u/) fan(3)_ (gu2 fan3 古訓) tradition. To caution (Kangxi: 誡也). To comply with, to go along with (Kangxi: 順也). To train. 【訓】 (xjunH) (_verb-like_) to instruct (_verb-like_) to explain (_verb-like_) to comply (with)

fan4.text: U+58B3 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. 隫 坟 (Mainland simplified) (F1.81 墳) 墳墓又墳典言書籍也 (Page 46 #11: (4)墳) A grave, a tomb (Kangxi: 墓也), a tumulus (Kangxi: 土之高者曰墳); river banks, an embankment (Kangxi: 水涯曰墳大防也所以扞水); great, vast (Kangxi: 大也); _(4)Fan m(o\)(6)_ (fan4 mou6 墳墓) a tomb; _s(o\)(3) ~~(1)fan~~ (4)fan_ (sou3 fan4 掃墳), to worship at the graves; _(1)fong (4)fan_ (fong1 fan4 荒墳), a deserted grave; _(1)s(a/)m (4)fan_ (saam1 fan4 三墳), the distinction of heaven, earth, man (Kangxi: 三墳分也論三才之分天地人之始也). Williams' 掃墳: Corrected _(1)fan_ (fan1) to _(4)fan_ (fan4). A classical book or tome. 【墳-level】 (bjun) (_noun-like_) mound (_noun-like_) embankment (_adjective-like_) moundy, (_met._) large

fan5.text: U+58B3 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. 坟 (Mainland simplified) bun6 (per 《集韻》部本切 for "raised" sense) (Page 46 #11: (4)墳 read _Fan(3)_ (fan3); here corrected to _(5)Fan_ (fan5)) rich soil (Kangxi: 土膏肥也); read _~~fan(3)~~ (5)fan_ (fan5). Raised (Kangxi: 土沸起也). 【墳-rising】 (bjunX) (_adjective-like_) rich

fan4.text: U+5E69 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. (F1.82 幩) 鑣之飾也 (Page 46 #12: (4)幩) An ornament on the bit of a bridle (Kangxi: 馬纏鑣扇汗也, 幩飾也 etc.). 【幩】 (bjun) (_noun-like_) bridle-ornament

U+6FC6 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. 𣸣 (Mainland simplified) (F1.81 濆) 水涯 (Page 46 #13: (4)濆) A river overflowing and making streamlets; a river bank (Kangxi: 水厓也); a river in Hon(a/)n (Kangxi: 汝水逕奇雒城西北濆水出焉). Williams' "A river overflowing and making streamlets": Kangxi 大水溢出別爲小水之名 is commentary for 《爾雅釋水》汝爲濆, in which a great river (named 汝) makes (爲) a streamlet (named 濆). It perhaps should not be read as a definition. 【濆】 (bjun) (_noun-like_) riverbank, bank

U+711A 炃 㷊 燌 燓 (F1.81 焚) 火燒曰焚 (Page 46 #10: (4)焚) To burn, to light, to set on fire (Kangxi: 燒也, 火灼物也); _(4)fan (1)h(e/)ung_ (fan4 hoeng1 焚香), to light incense sticks; _~~(1)fan~~ (4)fan f(a/)(3)_ (fan4 faa3 焚化) to burn up; to cremate, to incinerate; _(4)fan (1)sau_ (fan4 sau1 焚修), to burn ~~a bonze~~ incense in the pursuit of Budhist cultivation; _(4)fan ~~(4)sh(u~~ (1)sh(u_ (fan4 syu1 焚書), burning of the books by Tsin (秦). Williams' 焚化: Corrected _(1)fan_ (fan1) to _(4)fan_ (fan4). Williams' 焚書: Corrected _(4)sh(u_ (syu4) to _(1)sh(u_ (syu1). 【焚】 (bjun) (_verb-like_) to burn

U+8561 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. (F1.81 蕡) 草木多實曰蕡 (Page 46 #14: (4)蕡) Fruitful (Kangxi: 草木多實也), flourishing plants (Kangxi: 蕡藹), fragrant flowers growing together (Kangxi: 雜香草也); _(4)m(a/) (4)fan_ (maa4 fan4 麻蕡), hemp seed (Kangxi: 蕡麻子也); _(4)fan shat(9)_ (fan4 sat6 蕡實) bearing much seed. 【蕡】 (bjun) (_adjective-like_) fruitful (_noun-like_) hemp-seed

U+8CC1 May appear with 艹 having 3 strokes (+5 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+6), depending on the font. 贲 (Mainland simplified) Great (Kangxi: 宏賁皆大也). A three-legged tortoise (Kangxi: 龜三足賁). 【賁】 (bjun) (_adjective-like_) large

fan5.text: U+8CC1 May appear with 艹 having 3 strokes (+5 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+6), depending on the font. 贲 (Mainland simplified) (Page 352 #10: (1)賁) Also read _(5)Fan_ (fan5), to be filled with rage (Kangxi: 與憤同, 賁讀爲憤憤怒氣充實也); to bubble or effervesce as a spring (Kangxi: 沸也);

fei4.text: U+8CC1 May appear with 艹 having 3 strokes (+5 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+6), depending on the font. 贲 (Mainland simplified) The modern surname is read _(1)pan_ (ban1) (Kangxi: 前書賁赫音肥今姓音奔). See 賁 ban1 (TODO). An olden surname (Kangxi: 姓也 etc.).

fan5.text: U+9F22 蚠 蚡 fan4 (alternative per 《廣韻》符分切) (Page 47 #2: (5)鼢) A mole or field rat (Kangxi: 地行鼠 etc.); called _(4)lai (2)sh(u_ (lai4 syu2 犁鼠) (Kangxi: 所謂犁鼠者卽此也), a plough rat.

U+50E8 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. 焚 賁 偾 (Mainland simplified) fan3 (per 《廣韻》方問切) (F1.83 僨) 覆敗也 (Page 47 #3: (5)僨) ~~Prostrate;~~ to overthrow, to ruin (Kangxi: 覆敗也); to fall on one's back (Kangxi: 僵也, 仰偃也); _yat(7) (4)(i/)n (5)fan sz'(6)_ (jat1 jin4 fan5 si6 一言僨事) a word will ruin an affair; _(5)fan (2)t(o\) t(i/)(6)_ (fan5 dou2 dei6 僨倒地) to tumble to the ground. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 覆. Moved, excited (Kangxi: 僨動也). 【僨】 (pjunH) (_verb-like_) to fall (back), to ruin

U+596E 奋 (Mainland simplified) fan3 (per 《廣韻》方問切) (F1.83 奮) 發動也 (Page 47 #5: (5)奮) To endeavor after, to excite, to rouse (Kangxi: 震動也); to spread abroad (Kangxi: 揚也) or reach to; to ~~brush away~~ shake off; to lift; prompt, impetuous, rapid; _(5)fan ch(i/)(3)_ (fan5 zi3 奮志) to animate one's self; _(5)fan lik(9)_ (fan5 lik6 奮力) to put forth energy; _(5)fan (1)(i/)_ (fan5 ji1 奮衣), to ~~lift up the skirt~~ shake the dust off the clothes. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 奮, which is printed with the second stroke of 大 conjoined with the first stroke of 隹. To spread the wings (Kangxi: 翬也, 鳥張羽奮奞也). To shake off dust (Kangxi: 振去塵也). 【奮】 (pjunH) (_verb-like_) to spread the wings, to spread (_verb-like_) to shake (_verb-like_) to rouse, to start, to exert

U+5FFF fan2 (per 《廣韻》敷粉切) (F1.83 忿) 怒也 (Page 47 #1: (5)忿) Anger, resentment (Kangxi: 悁也, 恨也怒也); _(5)fan n(o\)(6)_ (fan5 nou6 忿怒) angry, vexed; _(5)fan (5)fan pat(7) kik(7)_ (fan5 fan5 bat1 gik1 忿忿不？) perturbed, cross; _(5)fan han(6)_ (fan5 han6 忿恨) hatred, malice. Classically, 忿 is to be distinguished from 憤. Specifically, 忿 is an irrational anger, whereas 憤 is an internal build-up of *either* anger or ardour. In modern usage, 忿 is indistinguishable from 憤 for the "anger" sense. 【忿】 (phjunX, phjunH) (_verb-like_) to anger

fan6.text: U+5FFF 分 fan3 (per Kangxi 芳問切) Generally only used in the negative (e.g. 不忿, 唔忿氣). Accepting (of an adverse result or occurrence), as opposed to discontented (Kangxi: 通作分, 不分者不平之意與忿同). 深深不忿 (sam1 sam1 bat1 fan6): "Deeply discontented." 【忿氣】 (fan6 hei3) Accepting (of an adverse result or occurrence), as opposed to discontented. 唔忿氣輸咗 (m4 fan6 hei3 syu1 zo2): "Discontented at losing."

fan5.text: U+61A4 May appear with 艹 in 賁 having 3 strokes (+12 assumed here) or 4 strokes (+13), depending on the font. 忿 (for "anger" sense) 賁 愤 (Mainland simplified) (F1.83 憤) 心求通而未能也又發憤又怒也 (Page 47 #4: (5)憤) Impatient desire (Kangxi: 懣也), zeal, ardor; anger, violent feeling; _f(a/)t(8) (5)fan_ (faat3 fan5 發憤), excited, zealous after; _(5)fan lik(9)_ (fan5 lik6 憤力) to put forth one's energies; ~~_(5)fan k(i/)t(8)_ (fan5 git3)~~ _(5)fan l(i/)t(9)_ (fan5 lit6 憤烈) wrought up by passion. (Page 713 #11: (5)憤) Under this character, for _(5)fan k(i/)t(8)_ (fan5 git3) read _(5)fan l(i/)t(9)_ (fan5 lit6 憤烈). See commentary at 忿 on the distinction from 憤. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 通. Williams' 發憤, 憤力: These are effectively alternative forms of 發奮, 奮力. 【憤】 (bjunX) (_adjective-like_) disgruntled

fang4.text: U+63C8 fang6 (vernacular alternative) 【揈-hit】 (fang4, fang6) To hit hard. 揈佢兩錘 (fang4 keoi5 loeng5 ceoi4): "Hit him hard with two blows." Olden attestation for 揈 _(4)fang_ (fang4) meaning "hit": 《集韻》 乎萌切 揈 擊也

fing1.text: U+63C8 捹 (Cantonese) (Page 714 #8: _(1)Fing_ (fing1); here assigned to 揈) A colloquial word. Confused, tangled; _(1)fing k(o\)m(3) l(un(6)_ (fing1 gam3 lyun6 揈咁亂) all in disorder, as one moving; touzled, as hair.

fing3.text: U+63C8 捹 (Cantonese) (Page 714 #9: _Fing(3)_ (fing3); here assigned to 揈) A colloquial word. A slap with the hand; _t(a/)i(6) ~~(2)pa~~ (1)p(a/) fing(3)_ (daai6 baa1 fing3 大巴揈) a smart slap. Williams' 大巴揈: Corrected _(2)pa_ (ba2) to _(1)p(a/)_ (baa1).

fing6.text: U+63C8 捹 (Cantonese) fang6 (alternative mostly for "spend recklessly" sense) (Page 53 #13: 捹(6); here normalised to 揈) To swing; to shake in the wind; _~~(4)t(')i(u/) (4)t(')i(u/)~~ (4)ti(u/) (2)ti(u/) fing(6)_ (diu3-4 diu3-2 fing6 吊吊揈) to hang and swing; _fing(6) tik(7) (2)shui ~~(1)lai~~ (4)lai_ (fing6 dik1 seoi2 lai4 揈滴水嚟), sprinkle a little water; _fing(6) lat(7)_ (fing6 lat1 揈甩) shake it off. (Page 714 #10: _Fing(6)_ (fing6); here assigned to 揈) A colloquial word. To vibrate, to swing, to dangle, as the end of a rope; to sprinkle; to snap away; to shake off, as ink out of a pen; _fing(6) kwo(3) (4)lai_ (fing6 gwo3 lai4 揈過嚟), yerk it (as the cue) forward. (Page 714 after #10: _Fing(6)_ (fing6)) The character 捹, has no authority; ~~it is read _pan(3)_ (ban3)_;_~~ ~~the hands rapidly moving.~~ Williams' 吊吊揈: Corrected _(4)t(')i(u/) (4)t(')i(u/)_ (tiu4 tiu4) to _(4)ti(u/) (2)ti(u/)_ (diu3-4 diu3-2). Williams' 揈滴水嚟: Corrected _(1)lai_ (lai1) to _(4)lai_ (lai4). Williams' "read _pan(3)_": This and the subsequent explanation are misreadings of 《集韻》蒲悶切音坌手亂貌 in Kangxi. See 捹 ban(TODO) 【吊吊揈】 (diu3-4 diu3-2 fing6) Hanging and swinging about. 【揈-swing】 (fing6, fang6) To swing, to flap, to shake. 揈身揈勢 (fing6 san1 fing6 sai3): "Swinging the body to and fro" (i.e. not staying still). 揈手揈腳 (fing6 sau2 fing6 goek3): "Flapping about the hands and feet." 揈甩啲塵 (fing6 lat1 di1 can4): "Flap off the dust." 揈乾隻手 (fing6 gon1 zek3 sau2): "Shake the hand dry." To whirl. 揈乾 (fing6 gon1): "Spin dry." To spend recklessly. 揈錢 (fang6 cin4-2): "Flinging money around." 【揈頭丸】 (fing6 tau4 jyun4-2) Ecstasy, the tablet form of MDMA. (Literally, "head-whirling pills".) The spelling 揈 is arbitrary.

fang4.text: U+8A07 【訇】 (fang4) To rebuke, especially sternly. 畀先生訇 (bei2 sin1 saang1 fang4): "Told off by the teacher." 成日訇人 (seng4 jat6 fang4 jan4): "Always telling others off." The spelling 訇 is arbitrary. I am not aware of any better alternatives.

fat1.text: U+4F5B

fat6.text: U+4F5B (F1.88 佛) 仙佛以空虚寂滅爲敎 (F1.88 仸) 同上 (Page 50 #12: 佛(9)) Budha, the enlightened one (Kangxi: 佛佗佛者覺也); _Fat(9) k(a/)u(3)_ (fat6 gaau3 佛教) ~~Budhists~~ Budhism; _Fat(9) (2)ts(o\)_ (fat6 zou2 佛祖), Budha; _~~Fat(7)~~ Fat(9) ~~f(a/)t(9)~~ f(a/)t(8)_ (fat6 faat3 佛法) ~~Budhism~~ Budhist methodologies; _fat(9) (2)shau_ (fat6 sau2 佛手), citron; _Fat(9) (4)t(')ong_ (fat6 tong4 佛堂), Budhist temples; _fat(9) (2)hau (4)sh(e/) (1)sam_ (fat6 hau2 se4 sam1 佛口蛇心), a villainous hypocrite. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱宀⿰未又 to 寂 and corrected 𬇠 to 滅. Williams' 佛法: Corrected _Fat(7)_ (fat1) to _Fat(9)_ (fat6) and corrected _f(a/)t(9)_ (faat6) to _f(a/)t(8)_ (faat3). 【佛】 (bjut) (_noun-like_) buddha

fat1.text: U+553F 【唿】 (fat1) A connected part or portion. 甩錦唿 (lat1 gam2 fat1): "Lost a patch of hair." 邊一唿 (bin1 jat1 fat1): "Which part?" 呢一唿 (ni1 jat1 fat1): "This part." The spelling 唿 is arbitrary.
U+5DFF This character has a single vertical stroke through the centre. Not to be confused with 市, which has a dot at the top.

U+5F17 (F1.86 弗) 不也 (Page 49 #11: 弗(7)) A negative (Kangxi: 不也); not, it should not be, not permissible (Kangxi: 不可也不然也); contrary (Kangxi: 違也), distorted (Kangxi: 不正也); _fat(7) (4)loi_ (fat1 loi4 弗來), he will not come; _fat(7) tsai(3) sz'(6)_ (fat1 zai3 si6 弗濟事) it will not be done. To rid, to remove (Kangxi: 去也). 【弗】 (pjut) (_adverb-like_) not (_adjective-like_) gusty

U+5F7F 佛 拂 髴 (F1.86 彿) 彷彿猶似樣也 (F1.86 髴) 髣髴猶近似也 (Page 49 #12: 彿(7)) Like, as if; used in the phrase _(2)fong fat(7)_ (fong2 fat1 彷彿) resembling (Kangxi: 彷彿也). (Page 50 #5: 髴(7); here normalised to 彿) like, nearly (Kangxi 髴: 若似也, 或作彿), applied to things. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 依 to 似. 【彷彿】 (phjangX phjut) (_verb-like_) to seem (like), to appear like 【彿】 (phjut) Used in 彷彿.

U+5FFD 曶 芴 (F1.86 忽) 倐倐急遽也又滅也輕也忘也 (Page 50 #7: 忽(7)) A single floss of silk (Kangxi: 輕也一蠶爲一忽十忽爲一絲, 忽蜘蛛網也); the smallest fraction in notation, a ~~millionth~~ hundred thousandth; to forget (Kangxi: 忘也忽忽不省事也), to disregard (Kangxi: 慢忽也); to make light of~~,~~; to extinguish, to obliterate (Kangxi: 滅也); neglectful; suddenly, abrupt (Kangxi: 倏忽也), unexpectedly, all at once; _fat(7) (4)(i/)n_ (fat1 jin4 忽然), suddenly; _fat(7) (5)yau (4)yan (4)loi_ (fat1 jau5 jan4 loi4 忽有人來), just then a man came; _~~(1)heng~~ (1)hing fat(7)_ (hing1 fat1 輕忽) to make light of, to neglect; _fat(7) l(e/)uk(9)_ (fat1 loek6 忽略) to forget; _fat(7) (4)sh(i/)_ (fat1 si4 忽時), not punctual; _fat(7) ~~(1)ming~~ (4)ming fat(7) m(i/)t(9)_ (fat1 ming4 fat1 mit6 忽明忽滅) it appeared and disappeared suddenly. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing and incomplete strokes in 遽 and 滅, and normalised ⿱亾心 to 忘. Williams' "millionth": 忽 is a millionth of a 尺, but a hundred thousandth of a 寸. The progression of length units is 忽絲毫釐分寸尺. Since the convention is to identify 分 with a tenth, 釐 with a hundredth, etc., the base should be 寸, not 尺, whence "hundred thousandth" instead of "millionth". Williams' 輕忽: Corrected _(1)heng_ (heng1) to _(1)hing_ (hing1). Williams' 忽明忽滅: Corrected _(1)ming_ (ming1) to _(4)ming_ (ming4). 【忽】 (xwot) (_adjective-like_) sudden (_verb-like_) to neglect (_verb-like_) to obliterate (_noun-like_) floss
U+60DA 忽 曶 (F1.86 惚) 恍惚 (Page 50 #8: 惚(7)) Minute, abstruse (Kangxi: 怳惚微妙不測貌); inexplicable; that which dazzles or flutters the mind. 【惚】 (xwot) (_adjective-like_) confused

U+62C2 (F1.86 拂) 拭也 (F1.86 拂) 拂拭又蠅拂 (F1.88 拂 _Pat(9)_ (bat6)) 去也拭也除也擊也矯也逆也 (Page 49 #13: 拂(7)) To brush, to wipe, to dust (Kangxi: 去也拭也除也, 拂去塵埃也); to push away, (...); to expel, (...); ~~a sort of flail;~~ _fat(7) (4)ch(')an_ (fat1 can4 拂塵), to brush away dust; _fat(7) shik(7)_ (fat1 sik1 拂拭) to brush away; _(4)ying fat(7)_ (jing4 fat1 蠅拂) a fly whip; Fan Wan entry: The headword 拂 appears twice under the reading _fat(7)_ (fat1). To strike obliquely, to glance (Kangxi: 過擊也, 擊而過之也). A duster (Kangxi: 拂塵具). 【拂-unvoiced】 (phjut) (_verb-like_) to glance (_verb-like_) to brush (off), to wipe (off)

fat6.text: U+62C2 佛 bat6 (per Fan Wan) fat1 (per 《正韻牋》敷勿切) (F1.88 拂 _Pat(9)_ (bat6)) 去也拭也除也擊也矯也逆也 (Page 49 #13: 拂(7) _Fat(7)_ (fat1); here normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) (...), to oppose (Kangxi: 與咈通違也戾也); (...), to contradict; perverse, disobedient; _~~fat(7)~~ fat(9) (4)yan sing(3)_ (fat6 jan4 sing3 拂人性) to thwart another's wishes. (Page 50 #12: 佛(9); here normalised to 拂) Contrary, unreasonable (Kangxi 佛: 逆也戾也, 與拂同); to turn aside (Kangxi 佛: 捩也); (Page 360 #3: 拂(9) _Pat(9)_ (bat6)) _pat(9) l(u(6)_ (bat6 leoi6 拂戾) perverse, obstinate; _pat(9) (4)yan (1)ch(i/) sing(3)_ (bat6 jan4 zi1 sing3 拂人之性) to act contrary to other people. Usually read _fat(7)_ (fat1). 【拂-voiced】 (bjut) (_verb-like_) to oppose, to turn aside

fat1.text: U+39FE (Page 50 #9: 㧾(7)) To take up refuse, to clean away; to bale out, to dip up; _fat(7) (2)tau_ (fat1 dau2 㧾斗), a dust-board; _fat(7) (2)shui_ (fat1 seoi2 㧾水), to bale water; _fat(7) ~~lap(9)~~ l(a/)p(9) s(a/)p(8)_ (fat1 laap6 saap3 㧾垃圾) to take up rubbish. Williams' 㧾垃圾: Corrected _lap(9)_ (lap6) to _l(a/)p(9)_ (laap6). To strike, to hit (Kangxi: 擊也, 南楚相推搏曰㧾). To dust (Kangxi: 一曰去塵也).
U+6612 㫚 mat6 (alternative per 《廣韻》文弗切) Morning twilight, dawn (Kangxi: 尚冥也, 旦明也, 謂日尚冥蓋未明之時也).
U+3ADA This character is ⿱勿日 under the sun radical (Kangxi p.492#2). For the visually similar character under the say radical, see 曶 fat1.
U+66F6 This character is ⿱勿曰 under the say radical (Kangxi p.502#8). For the visually similar character under the sun radical, see 㫚 fat1.

U+7953 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. 弗 fai3 (alternative per 《廣韻》方肺切) (F1.86 祓) 除也 (Page 50 #2: 祓(7)) ~~Clean, pure~~ To cleanse, to purify (Kangxi: 潔也); to disperse; to drive off; to wash away; a sacrifice or baptism to obtain good (Kangxi: 除災求福也); _fat(7) (4)ch(')(u_ (fat1 ceoi4 祓除), to ward off. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 袚 to 祓. Williams' "Clean, pure": These should be rendered as verbs instead. To remove (除也, 通作弗, 弗之言祓也). Good fortune (Kangxi: 通作茀, 祓福也). 【祓】 (phjut, pjojH) (_verb-like_) to remove, to purify

U+7A9F gwat6 (uncommon) wat1 (uncommon) (F1.86 窟) 孔穴也 (Page 50 #11: 窟(7)) A hole in the ground (Kangxi: 窟室也孔穴也); a stable or sty dug out of the earth; _~~fat(9)~~ fat(7) ~~(5)lung~~ (1)lung_ (fat1 lung4-1 窟窿), a hole, a grotto; _(2)sh(u ~~fat(9)~~ fat(7)_ (syu2 fat1 鼠窟) a rat-hole; _(2)k(a/)u t(')(o\)(3) (1)s(a/)m ~~fat(9)~~ fat(7)_ (gaau2 tou3 saam1 fat1 狡兔三窟) a cunning rabbit has three holes; _(2)sh(i/) fat(7)_ (si2 fat1 屎窟) buttocks. Williams' 窟窿, 鼠窟, 狡兔三窟: Corrected _fat(9)_ (fat6) to _fat(7)_ (fat1). Williams' 窟窿: Corrected _(5)lung_ (lung5) to _(1)lung_ (lung4-1). 【窟】 (khwot) (_noun-like_) cave (_noun-like_) hole 【屎窟】 (si2 fat1) Arse (mostly the buttocks, sometimes the anus). 屎窟窿 (si2 fat1 lung4-1): "The arsehole." 屎窟痕 (si2 fat1 han4): "His arse must have been itchy" (i.e. he had no good reason to do that). 正屎窟鬼 (zing3 si2 fat1 gwai2): "What a right arsehole." 生仔冇屎窟 (saang1 zai2 mou5 si2 fat1): "Have a kid without an arse" (as a divine punishment for unethical behaviour).

U+7B0F 曶 (F1.86 笏) 簪笏牙簡也 (Page 50 #10: 笏(7)) A tablet of ivory, bamboo, gem, or wood, used at audiences in former times (Kangxi: 公及士所搢也 etc., 笏一名手版品官所執); meant for making memoranda (Kangxi: 笏忽也備忽忘也), and then used as ornaments; they were held before the breast; _chap(7) fat(7) (5)(i/) (4)ch(')i(u/)_ (zap1 fat1 ji5 ciu4 執笏以朝), to take the tablet in court; _ching(3) fat(7)_ (zing3 fat1 正笏) to hold the tablet. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 簪. 【笏】 (xwot) (_noun-like_) tablet

U+7D31 紼 韍 黻 绂 (Mainland simplified) (F1.86 紱) 綬也 (Page 50 #1: 紱(7)) A ribbon to hold a seal (Kangxi: 綬也, 紱或作紼); ~~used for the two preceding (茀, 紼).~~ (Page 50 #4: 韍(7); here normalised to 紱) a string on a seal (Kangxi 韍: 璽之組也). Williams' "used for the two preceding": Not the case for 茀, and the other way round for 紼 (i.e. 紼 is used for 紱). 【紱】 (pjut) (_noun-like_) seal-ribbon

U+7D3C 綍 茀 绋 (Mainland simplified) (F1.86 茀) 繫印組也又引柩索 (Page 49 #15: 紼(7)) Raveled silk (Kangxi: 亂糸也); a trace to drag a bier (Kangxi: 從前引之曰紼紼發也發車使前); _chap(7) fat(7)_ (zap1 fat1 執紼) to accompany a funeral. Williams' "Raveled silk": 《說文》 actually has 亂系也, with 段玉裁's annotations saying this should instead be 亂枲也, "ravelled hemp". A rope (Kangxi: 紼繂也, 紼縳也). A coffin-rope (for burial) (Kangxi: 引棺索也). 【紼】 (pjut) (_noun-like_) rope, coffin-rope

U+7D8D but6 (per Fan Wan) (F2.80 綍 _P(u/)t(9)_ (but6)) 綸綍王言之 (Page 402 #7: 綍(9) _P(u/)t(9)_ (but6); here normalised to _Fat(7)_ (fat1)) Silken cords which are used to carry coffins by (Kangxi: 同紼, 綍舉棺索也); _met._ fine, elegant, applied to the emperor's words; _(4)lun ~~p(u/)t(9)~~ fat(7)_ (leon4 fat1 綸綍) eloquent, persuasive, as imperial sayings. 【綍】 (pjut) (_noun-like_) rope, coffin-rope

U+889A but3 (per 《廣韻》北末切 for "barbarian-clothing" and "knee-cover" senses) fai3 (per 《集韻》方未切 for "knee-cover" sense) (Page 50 #3: 袚(7)) A covering for the knees (Kangxi: 蔽膝也 etc.); ~~a short tunic worn in southern China~~ clothing worn by south-eastern barbarians (Kangxi: 蠻夷服也). The reading _fat(7)_ (fat1) is not unattested for the "barbarian-clothing" sense; 《集韻》 has the reading 敷勿切, explained 蠻夷衣. Fan Wan entry: The headword 袚 is a misprint of 祓. Williams' "short tunic worn in southern China": This is a poor rendering of Kangxi 蠻夷服也. Clothing for small children (Kangxi: 褿袚䙁褯也).

U+97CD 巿 紱 芾 黻 韨 (Mainland simplified) (F1.86 韍) 以韋爲之所以蔽膝 (Page 50 #4: 韍(7)) A knee-pad of leather (Kangxi: 本作巿韠也); a cover or defense for the bosom; Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 蔽 and 膝. 【韍】 (pjut) (_noun-like_) knee-cover
U+9AF4 fai3 (per Kangxi 芳味切 for "dishevelled" sense) (F1.86 髴) 髣髴猶近似也 (Page 50 #5: 髴(7)) Disheveled hair (Kangxi: 髮亂貌); head ornaments (Kangxi: 婦人首飾);

U+9EFB (F1.86 黻) 黼黻 (Page 50 #6: 黻(7)) ~~Variegated,~~ An embroidered symbol in black and azure mixed (Kangxi: 黑與靑相次文, 黼黻彰也, etc.); to embroider in colors; elegant, flowery (as writing); a variegated garment (Kangxi: 黻紩也畫黻紩文綵於衣也 etc.); _fat(7) (5)m(i/)n_ (fat1 min5 黻冕), an embroidered coronet (Kangxi: 黻冕 etc.). Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 黼. The symbol (文, 彰) referred to by Kangxi is like two 弓 back-to-back, or 亞 with the horizontal strokes disconnected. 【黻】 (pjut) (_noun-like_) embroidered-emblem

fat6.text: U+4E4F (F2.73 乏 _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6)) 貧乏窮乏匱也 (Page 51 #7: 乏(9) _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6); here normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) Want~~, failure, defective~~; without (Kangxi: 無也); a vacancy (Kangxi: 匱也); to fail; to spoil (Kangxi: 廢也)~~, to injure~~; empty, poor, fatigued; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) shik(9)_ (fat6 sik6 乏食) in want of food; _(4)p(')an ~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9)_ (pan4 fat6 貧乏) beggared. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱宀躬 to 窮, and corrected ⿷匚責 to 匱. A safety screen used in archery (Kangxi: 射者所蔽). 【乏】 (bjop) (_verb-like_) to lack (_noun-like_) vacancy (_verb-like_) to waste (_noun-like_) safety-screen

U+4F10 (F2.72 伐 _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6)) 征伐殺伐又誇功也 (Page 51 #3: 伐(9) _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6); here normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) To destroy, to strike, to smite (Kangxi: 攻殺擊刺也)~~, to fight~~; to punish, to subdue (Kangxi: 征伐)~~, to desolate~~; to cut down (Kangxi: 斫木也); to brag (Kangxi: 自稱其功曰伐); meritorious deeds (Kangxi: 伐功也); a go-between; _~~shat(7)~~ sh(a/)t(8) ~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) l(i/)(6) hoi(6)_ (saat3 fat6 lei6 hoi6 殺伐利害) famous for prowess, invincible; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) ~~tsui(6)~~ ts(u/)i(6)_ (fat6 zeoi6 伐罪) to punish crime; _tsok(8) ~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9)_ (zok3 fat6 作伐) to act as go-between. Williams' 殺伐利害: Corrected _shat(7)_ (sat1) to _sh(a/)t(8)_ (saat3). Williams' 伐罪: Corrected _tsui(6)_ to _ts(u/)i(6)_. To hit, to strike (Kangxi: 考擊鐘鼓也). 【伐】 (bjot) (_verb-like_) to smite, to strike, to fell (_verb-like_) to boast
U+5488 佛 拂 To oppose, to go against (Kangxi: 違也, 戾也, 通作佛拂). 【咈】 (bjut) (_verb-like_) to oppose, to go against

U+6A43 (Page 51 #4: 筏(9) _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6); here corrected to 橃 and normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) a large ship ~~like a raft for size~~ (Kangxi 橃: 海中大船, 俗作筏非是); an ark. According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, "large ship" is an olden sense of 橃 that is distinct from 筏 "raft". Williams (following Fan Wan and to some extent Kangxi 筏) includes the "large ship" sense under 筏, and does not provide a separate entry for 橃. I have split things up accordingly.
U+7782 伐 A shield (Kangxi: 盾也, 通作伐). 【瞂】 (bjot) (_noun-like_) shield

U+7B4F 橃 (F2.72 筏 _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6)) 海中大船 (Page 51 #4: 筏(9) _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6); here normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) A bamboo raft (Kangxi: 編竹渡水曰筏); According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, "large ship" is an olden sense of 橃 that is distinct from 筏 "raft". Williams (following Fan Wan and to some extent Kangxi 筏) includes the "large ship" sense under 筏, and does not provide a separate entry for 橃. I have split things up accordingly.

U+7F70 罚 (Mainland simplified) (F2.73 罰 _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6)) 責也治也 (Page 51 #6: 罰(9) _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6); here normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) A peccadillo (Kangxi: 辠之小者 etc.), a crime; to punish, to castigate, to flog (Kangxi: 罰謂撻擊之也); to fine (Kangxi: 出金贖罪); a forfeit; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) ~~chak(7)~~ ch(a/)k(8)_ (fat6 zaak3 罰簀) to bamboo; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) (2)tsau_ (fat6 zau2 罰酒), a forfeit of wine; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) (2)fung_ (fat6 fung6-2 罰俸), to mulct an officer's salary; _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) (4)ngan_ (fat6 ngan4 罰銀), to fine, a forfeit. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 責 and 治. Williams' 罰簀: Normalised _chak(7)_ (zak1) to _ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3). 【罰】 (bjot) (_verb-like_) to punish (_verb-like_) to fine

U+95A5 伐 阀 (Mainland simplified) (F2.72 閥 _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6)) 閥閱自序也積其功曰閥明其等曰閱 (Page 51 #5: 閥(9) _F(a/)t(9)_ (faat6); here normalised to _Fat(9)_ (fat6)) A door on the left (Kangxi: 門在左曰閥在右曰閱); meritorious services, to set forth one's merit (Kangxi: 明其等曰閥積日曰閱); _~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9) (ut(9)_ (fat6 jyut6 閥閱) the side doors of a gateway; worthy services, accumulated merit.

fau1.text: U+574F (F1.50 坏) 一坏之土 (Page 51 #10: (1)坏) A hillock of earth.

fau4.text: U+7D11 fau1 (per 《廣韻》匹尤切 and 甫鳩切) fau2 (per 《廣韻》芳否切) fu1 (per 《集韻》芳無切 for "bright-coloured" sense) (F1.52 紑) 衣鮮絜貌 (Page 51 #12: (4)紑) ~~New silken~~ Fresh, clean, as garments (Kangxi: 白鮮衣貌, 紑絜鮮貌); ~~elegant,~~ lustrous, as silk (Kangxi: 繒色鮮). Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 絜. 【紑】 (phjuw, phjuwX, pjuw) (_adjective-like_) fresh, bright

fau2.text: U+5426 (F1.53 否) 不然之詞 (Page 52 #2: (2)否) Not so, ~~ought~~ not (Kangxi: 不也 etc.); used at the end of sentences as a negative interrogation; else, whether, otherwise; _(ut(9) (2)fau_ (jyut6 fau2 ？否), it is not; _(2)ho (2)fau_ (ho2 fau2 可否), will or can it do, or not; _sh(i/)(6) (2)fau_ (si6 fau2 是否), is it so? _(2)fau tsak(7) ~~(4)wai~~ (1)wai (1)ch(i/)_ (fau2 zak1 wai1 zi1 否則威之), if ~~it be bad~~ not, then ~~frown it away~~ awe them. Williams' "a negative interrogation": Specifically, to present an alternative in the negative, i.e. "or not". Williams' 否則威之: Corrected _(4)wai_ (wai4) to _(1)wai_ (wai1). This is Kangxi's example from 《書益稷》. 【否】 (pjuwX) (_adverb-like_) nay (_adverb-like_) not

U+7F36 𦈢 缻 (F1.50 缶 _(1)Fau_ (fau1)) (Page 51 #8: (1)缶 _(1)Fau_ (fau1); here corrected to _(2)Fau_ (fau2)) Earthenware in general (Kangxi: 瓦缶之器); a vessel used to contain wine (Kangxi: 瓦器所以盛酒漿); one on which time was ~~noted~~ beaten (Kangxi: 秦人鼓之以節歌); a jar (Kangxi: 盎謂之缶, 缶卽盎也大腹而斂口); _(5)ng(a/) ~~(1)fau~~ (2)fau_ (ngaa5 fau2 瓦缶), earthenware. The 121st radical (U+2F78 ⽸ "jar"). 【缶】 (pjuwX) (_noun-like_) earthenware

fu1.text: U+67B9 桴 fau4 (per 《廣韻》縛謀切) (F2.8 枹) 擊鼓之杖 (Page 58 #3: (1)桴; here normalised to 枹) a drumstick (Kangxi 桴: 擊鼓杖與枹同); (Page 58 #5: (1)枹) A drumstick (Kangxi: 擊鼓杖也); The reading _(1)f(u/)_ (fu1) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 芳無切 for both 枹 and 桴, with the explanation including the "drumstick" sense in both cases. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 擊. 【枹】 (bjuw) (_noun-like_) drumstick

U+6874 柎 (for "raft" sense) 泭 (for "raft" sense) fau4 (per Kangxi 縛謀切 for all senses except "raft", and alternative per 《廣韻》 for "ridgepole" sense) (F2.8 桴) 編竹木爲筏皆曰桴 (Page 58 #3: (1)桴) A raft (Kangxi: 編竹木代舟也大曰筏小曰桴); a ridge pole in a roof (Kangxi: 棟名, 棟謂之桴, 謂屋脊也); a ~~barrow to carry~~ tool for heaping dirt (Kangxi: 聚土器也 etc.); _(1)f(u/)_ (or _~~(1)fau~~ (4)fau_) _~~t(a/)n(3)~~ t(')(a/)n(3)_ (fu1 taan3 or fau4 taan3 桴炭) light charcoal. (Page 58 #11: (1)柎; here normalised to 桴) a raft (Kangxi 柎: 編木以渡曰泭或作柎通作桴); Fan Wan entry: Corrected 茷 to 筏. Williams' 桴炭: Corrected _(1)fau_ (fau1) to _(4)fau_ (fau4), and corrected _t(a/)n(3)_ (daan3) to _t(')(a/)n(3)_ (taan3). 【桴】 (phju) (_noun-like_) raft

fau4.text: U+6D6E fau4-2 (rising second in vernacular 浮浮地) pou4 (vernacular) (F1.52 浮) 泛也溢也 (Page 51 #13: (4)浮) To float (Kangxi: 氾也), to drift (Kangxi: 順流曰浮); to overflow, to exceed (Kangxi: 溢也過也), to inundate; ~~past time;~~ light, unsteady, fleeting; excessive; _(4)fau f(a/)n(3)_ (fau4 faan3 浮泛) floating; _vulg._ _~~(4)p(o\) (4)p(o\) p(a/)n(3)~~ (4)p(')(o\) (4)p(')(o\) p(')(a/)n(3)_ (pou4 pou4 paan3 浮浮泛)_;_ _(4)fau (4)(i/)n_ (fau4 jin4 浮言), unmeaning words; _(4)fau (4)ts(')oi_ (fau4 coi4 浮財), floating property; _(4)fau (4)yau tsoi(6) ~~shai(6)~~ shai(3)_ (fau4 jau4 zoi6 sai3 浮遊在世) engaged in worldly affairs; _(4)fau shek(9)_ (fau4 sek6 浮石) pumice; _(2)k(o\)m (4)fau_ (gam2 fau4 敢浮), heedless, flagitious; _(4)fau (4)t(')(o\)_ (fau4 tou4 浮屠), a pagoda; _(4)fau (1)shang_ (fau4 sang1 浮生), the living; _(4)fau (4)fau_ (fau4 fau4 浮浮), vain, much. Williams' "past time": This is a misreading of Kangxi 先時曰浮. The example given is 《書盤庚》鮮以不浮于天時. Reading 浮 as the noun "past time" clearly does not make sense. Instead, 浮 should be read as a verb, "preempt". Williams' 浮浮泛: Corrected _(4)p(o\) (4)p(o\) p(a/)n(3)_ (bou4 bou4 baan3) to _(4)p(')(o\) (4)p(')(o\) p(')(a/)n(3)_ (pou4 pou4 paan3). Williams' 浮浮在世: Corrected _shai(6)_ (sai6) to _shai(3)_ (sai3). Flippant, levitous (Kangxi: 輕也). Falling heavily (Kangxi: 雨雪盛貌). To punish with drink as forfeit (Kangxi: 浮罰也謂罰爵也). 【浮】 (bjuw) (_verb-like_) to float (_verb-like_) to penalise (_adjective-like_) (_met._) heavy, strong 【浮面】 (pou4 min6-2) On the surface. 浮面𢳂油 (pou4 min6-2 bat1 jau4): "Skim the oil along the surface." 【浮頭】 (pou4 tau4) To surface.

U+7F58 (F1.50 罘 _(1)Fau_ (fau1)) 罘罳屏風也 (Page 51 #9: (1)罘 _(1)Fau_ (fau1); here corrected to _(4)Fau_ (fau4)) A rabbit net (Kangxi: 兔罟, 罘罝也); a ~~wooden~~ screen before an official residence (Kangxi: 罘罳 etc.). Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱𠔿不 to 罘, and normalised ⿱𠔿思 to 罳. 【罘】 (bjuw) (_noun-like_) rabbit-net

U+82A3 (F1.53 芣 _(2)Fau_ (fau2)) (Page 52 #3: (2)芣 _(2)Fau_ (fau2); here corrected to _(4)Fau_ (fau4)) The plantago or plantain leaf, called _~~(2)fau~~ (4)fau (5)(i/)_ (fau4 ji5 芣苡) (Kangxi: 芣苢馬舄馬舄車前)_;_ _(1)ch(')(e/) (4)ts(')(i/)n (2)ts(')(o\)_ (ce1 cin4 cou2 車前草) is the common name; it is eaten as greens. Williams' 車前草: Inferred incompletely printed letter _t_ in _(4)ts(')(i/)n_. 【芣】 (bjuw) Used in 芣苡. 【芣苡】 (bjuw yiX) (_noun-like_) plantain

U+8709 (F1.52 蜉) 蜉蝣虫名 (Page 52 #1: (4)蜉) A large ant, called _(4)p(')(i/) (4)fau_ (pei4 fau4 蚍蜉) (Kangxi: 蚍蜉大螘); _(4)fau (4)yau_ (fau4 jau4 蜉蝣), an ephemera, produced from muck (Kangxi: 蜉蝣渠略也 etc.). 【蜉】 (bjuw) Used in 蜉蝣. 【蜉蝣】 (bjuw yuw) (_noun-like_) up-wing fly

fau6.text: U+4F0F (Page 52 #6: 覆(6); here corrected to 伏) to brood, as a hen; _(1)kai (2)n(a/) fau(6) (2)tsai_ (gai1 naa2 fau6 zai2 雞乸伏仔), the hen covers her chickens. (Page 64 #4: 伏(9) _Fuk(9)_ (fuk6); here corrected to _Fau(6)_ (fau6)) to brood (Kangxi: 禽覆卵也); 【伏-departing】 (bjuwH) (_verb-like_) to brood, to hatch

fuk6.text: U+4F0F buk6 (vernacular) (F1.66 伏) 偃也匿也潛也伺也 (Page 64 #4: 伏(9)) To lie or fall prostrate; to humble, to subject, to oppress; to hide, to conceal, to abscond (Kangxi: 匿藏也); to acknowledge, to confess; used as an adverb, meaning humbly, in my opinion; _(4)m(a/)i fuk(9)_ (maai4 fuk6 埋伏) an ambush; _(1)s(a/)m fuk(9)_ (saam1 fuk6 三伏) hot weather, midsummer (Kangxi: 三伏 etc.); _fuk(9) mong(6)_ (fuk6 mong6 伏望) I hope; Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete strokes in 潛, and corrected 何 to 伺. To submit (Kangxi: 屈服也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【伏-entering】 (bjuwk) (_verb-like_) to (lie) prostrate (_verb-like_) to lie hidden, to ambush (_verb-like_) to submit (_verb-like_) to subject

fau6.text: U+57E0 bou6 (per Kangxi 同步) (F1.56 埠) 舶船埠頭 (Page 52 #5: ~~？~~埠(6)) A landing where trade is carried on, a mart on the seaside, an unwalled settlement; _fau(6) ~~(5)t(')au~~ (4)t(')au_ (fau6 tau4 埠頭), a port; _kuk(7) fau(6)_ (guk1 fau6 穀埠) a grain market; _(2)tsz' fau(6)_ (zi2 fau6 子埠) a sub salt depot where no duties are levied; _p(a/)n(6) fau(6)_ (baan6 fau6 辦埠) manager of a salt depot; _kwo(3) fau(6)_ (gwo3 fau6 過埠) to go from port to port. Cognate with 埗 bou6 (TODO). Williams' 埠頭: Corrected _(5)t(')au_ (tau5) to _(4)t(')au_ (tau4).
U+86D7 𧌓 䘀 阜 (Page 714 #3: 𧌓(6); here normalised to 蛗) A kind of grasshopper or cricket; _fau(6) (1)chung_ (fau6 zung1 蛗螽), a sort of green locust; _met._ many children. 【蛗】 (bjuwX) Used in 蛗螽.
U+8986 (F1.56 覆) 天覆地載葢也 (Page 52 #6: 覆(6))

fuk1.text: U+8986 復 复 (Mainland simplified for "reply" sense) fau3 (per 《廣韻》敷救切 for "overspread" sense) fau6 (per 《廣韻》扶富切 for "waylay" sense and Fan Wan for "overspread" sense) fu3 (per 《廣韻》敷救切 for "overspread" sense) (F1.56 覆 _Fau(6)_ (fau6)) 天覆地載葢也 (F1.64 覆) 反覆 (Page 52 #6: 覆(6) _Fau(6)_ (fau6); here normalised to _Fuk(7)_ (fuk1)) To cover, to overshadow (Kangxi: 蓋也); to overspread; _(1)t(')(i/)n ~~fau(6)~~ fuk(7) t(i/)(6) tsoi(3)_ (tin1 fuk1 dei6 zoi3 天覆地載) the heaven covers and earth ~~contains~~ carries; (Page 63 #14: 覆(7)) To and fro, to repeat, back and forth (Kangxi: 反覆也); unstable, unsettled; to subvert, to overthrow (Kangxi: 倒也); to defeat (Kangxi: 覆軍敗也); to throw down, to upset~~, to prostrate~~; to judge (Kangxi: 審也, 詳察曰覆); _(1)k(')ing fuk(7)_ (king1 fuk1 傾覆) defeated, tumbled down, ruined; _(1)t(i/)n fuk(7)_ (din1 fuk1 顛覆) reduced to poverty, reprobate; _(5)m(a/) ~~(4)t(')s(i/)n~~ (4)ts(')(i/)n fuk(7) (2)shui_ (maa5 cin4 fuk1 seoi2 馬前覆水), impossible; _fuk(7) p(a/)k(9)_ (fuk1 baak6 覆白) ~~to understand clearly~~. Williams' "to judge": Better rendered "to examine" or "to review". Williams' 顛覆: Or, to subvert, to overthrow. Williams' 馬前覆水: Corrected _(4)t(')s(i/)n_ (aspirate in wrong position) to _(4)ts(')(i/)n_. Less common than 覆水難收. Williams' 覆白: I am not convinced that this means "to understand clearly". 《廣韻》 has four headline readings: 敷救切 _fau(3)_ (fau3) or _f(u/)(3)_ (fu3) for the "overspread" sense; 扶富切 _fau(6)_ (fau6) for the "waylay" sense; 芳福切 _fuk(7)_ (fuk1) for the "overturn" sense; and 匹北切 _p(')ak(7)_ (pak1) without explanation. The explanations for the first and third readings (i.e. _fau(3)_ (fau3) and _fuk(7)_ (fuk1)) refer to each other. It is unclear whether these are intended as mere cross-references or as genuine alternatives for those two senses. Fan Wan _fau(6)_ (fau6) for the "overspread" sense is not strictly correct, and ought to be _fau(3)_ (fau3) if one insists on the departing tone. According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, the "overspread" and "overturn" senses have the same olden reading 芳福切 _fuk(7)_ (fuk1), and distinguishing 敷救切 _fau(3)_ (fau3) or _f(u/)(3)_ (fu3) for the "overspread" sense is a southern reading (南音). The sense of "reply" (see below) appears to be modern. For the classical word meaning "reply", see 復 fuk6. To waylay (Kangxi: 伏兵曰覆). To reply. Conversely. 【覆-voiced】 (bjuwH) (_verb-like_) to waylay 【覆-unvoiced】 (phjuwH) (_verb-like_) to overspread 【覆-entering】 (phjuwk) (_verb-like_) to overturn, to overthrow (_adverb-like_) conversely Used in 反覆. 【反覆】 (pjonX phjuwk) (_adverb-like_) back and over, (_met._) over and over, back and forth

fau6.text: U+961C 峊 阝 (character component on left) 𨸏 (F1.56 阜) 山無石曰阜又曲阜地名又民豐物阜 (Page 52 #4: 阜(6)阝) A great mound or hill of earth (Kangxi 阜: 大陸曰阜, 山無石者); the 170th radical (U+2FA9 ⾩ "mound") of elevations, hills, &c.; great (Kangxi 阜: 大也), large (Kangxi 阜: 肥也), high, abundant (Kangxi 阜: 盛也), numerous (Kangxi 阜: 多也); _mat(9) fau(6)_ (mat6 fau6 物阜) plenty of things; _(1)fung fau(6)_ (fung1 fau6 豐阜) abundant, as a harvest. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 豐. 【阜】 (bjuw) (_noun-like_) great-mound (_adjective-like_) great, large, abundant

fe1.text: U+5561 fei1 (uncommon) 【啡】 (fe1) Short for 咖啡 (coffee). 齋啡 (zaai1 fe1): "Straight coffee." Brown. 【啡色】 (fe1 sik1) Short for 咖啡色. 【咖啡色】 (gaa3 fe1 sik1) Brown. The spelling 啡 is arbitrary (but well established).

fe4.text: U+6DDD 啡 (for Cantonese "diarrhoea" sense) fe4-2 (rising second in 淝淝) fe6 (alternative for "spray" sense) 【淝】 (fe4, fe6) To spray. 淝濕咗 (fe4 sap1 zo2): "Sprayed it wet." 淝緊水 (fe4 gan2 seoi2): "It's spraying water" (i.e. the sprinkler is on). To shoot. 淝中咗 (fe4 zung3 zo2): "Shot and hit." 【淝淝】 (fe4 fe4-2) Diarrhoea. Commonly spelt 啡啡. 屙淝淝 (o1 fe4 fe4-2): "Have diarrhoea." The spelling 淝 is arbitrary.

fei4.text: U+6DDD 肥 (F1.39 淝) 地名又水名 (Page 714 #4: (4)淝) Diverging streams (Kangxi: 所出同所歸異曰肥泉); a river in Ng(a/)nhwui (安徽) running into Lake Ch(')(a/)u (巢湖) by L(u/)chau f(u/) (廬州府) (Kangxi: 水名 etc.). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 各 to 名.

fei1.text: U+5983 (F1.35 妃) 妃嬪 (Page 52 #15: (1)~~？~~妃) Royal concubines (Kangxi 妃: 女與己身儔也古嬪御之貴次于后者曰妃); _~~(1)wong~~ (4)wong (1)f(i/)_ (wong4 fei1 王妃), wife of the heir apparent; _ching(3) (1)f(i/)_ (zing3 fei1 正妃), the empress; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)f(i/)_ (tin1 fei1 天妃), the Amphitrite of the Chinese (Kangxi 妃: 天妃水神); _(1)f(i/) (2)tsz' si(u/)(3)_ (fei1 zi2 siu3 妃子笑) the best sort of laich(i/) (荔枝). Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿰女巳 to 妃. A spouse (Kangxi: 匹也). 【妃】 (phj+j) (_noun-like_) consort
U+6249 (F1.35 扉) 戸也 (Page 52 #8: (1)扉) A wooden ~~door with two leaves~~ door-leaf (Kangxi: 戶扇也, 闔謂之扉, 以木曰扉以葦曰扇); _met._ a rustic house. 【扉】 (pj+j) (_noun-like_) door-leaf

U+7DCB 绯 (Mainland simplified) fei2 (common in 緋聞) (F1.35 緋) 絳色也一曰赤練 (Page 52 #9: (1)緋) Red or crimson silk (Kangxi: 帛赤色, 絳色又赤練); _(1)f(i/) (4)p(')(o\)_ (fei1 pou4 緋袍), carnation robes. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 終 to 絳.
U+871A (F1.35 蜚) 古飛字聲名顯播也 (Page 52 #11: (1)蜚) To fly. The Fan Wan defines it, "~~famous.~~ prominently spreading," as a reputation.

fei2.text: U+871A fai3 (alternative per 《正韻牋》芳未切 for "grasshopper" sense) fai6 (per 《廣韻》扶沸切 for "stinking-insect" and "ominous-animal" senses) (Page 52 #11: (1)蜚 _(1)F(i/)_ (fei1); here corrected to _(2)F(i/)_ (fei2)) A stinking bug which eats clothes and grain (Kangxi: ...然則蜚是臭惡之蟲害人衣物...); a fabulous animal ominous of pestilence (Kangxi: 獸名, ...見則天下大疫). The reading _(2)f(i/)_ (fei2) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 敷尾切, encompassing the "grasshopper" and "animal" senses. 《廣韻》府尾切 _(2)f(i/)_ (fei2) is unhelpfully explained 蟲名咸蜚. The grasshopper (Kangxi: 蟲名負蠜也). 【蜚】 (pj+jX, bj+jH) (_noun-like_) stinking-pest

fei1.text: U+88F6 (F1.35 裶) 曳衣也又衣長貌 (Page 52 #10: (1)裶) ~~To lift up the skirt;~~ long, trailing, as dresses (Kangxi: 衣長貌, 曳衣貌); _(1)f(i/) (1)(i/)_ (fei1 ji1 裶衣), ~~to hold up the~~ a dragging dress. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in headword 裶.
U+970F 䬠 (F1.35 霏) 雨雪之貌 (Page 52 #12: (1)霏) Rain, sleet, or snow driven by the wind, and filling the air (Kangxi: 雨雪貌, 雰也, 霏甚貌). 【霏】 (phj+j) (_adjective-like_) heavy falling

U+975E (F1.35 非) 不是也 (Page 52 #7: (1)非) Not right, not good (Kangxi: 不是也); not so, opposite (Kangxi: 違也); false, bad, wrong; ~~shameless, low (Kangxi: 下也);~~ to slander (Kangxi: 訾也), to reproach (Kangxi: 責也); _(4)'m (1)ch(i/) sh(i/)(6) (1)f(i/)_ (m4 zi1 si6 fei1 唔知是非), I don't know whether it is so or not; _(2)kong sh(i/)(6) (1)f(i/)_ (gong2 si6 fei1 講是非), to asperse, tittle-tattle; _(1)f(i/) ~~(1)heng~~ (1)hing ~~(1)yung~~ (4)yung (i/)(6)_ (fei1 hing1 jung4 ji6 非輕容易) this is not so easy; _(1)f(i/) (5)lai_ (fei1 lai5 非禮), improper, immodest; _(2)h(i/) (1)f(i/)_ (hei2 fei1 豈非), is it not so! i.e. it is true; _(1)f(i/) ~~(1)sh(e/)ung~~ (4)sh(e/)ung_ (fei1 soeng4 非常), uncommon, superior; _(1)f(i/) (5)y(a/)_ (fei1 jaa5 非也), not so. Williams' 非輕容易: Corrected _(1)heng_ (heng1) to _(1)hing_ (hing1), and corrected _(1)yung_ (jung1) to _(4)yung_ (jung4). Williams' 非禮: Now to molest. Williams' 非常: Corrected _(1)sh(e/)ung_ (soeng1) to _(4)sh(e/)ung_ (soeng4). The 175th radical (U+2FAE ⾮ "wrong"). 【非】 (pj+j) (_verb-like_) to be not (_adverb-like_) not (_adjective-like_) wrong (_verb-like_) to repugn

U+98DB 蜚 飞 (Mainland simplified) (F1.35 飛) 飛鳥 (Page 52 #14: (1)飛) To fly (Kangxi: 鳥翥, 飛翔); to flit; flying; to go swiftly; lofty; quick; _(1)f(i/) h(u(3)_ (fei1 heoi3 飛去) to fly away; _(1)f(i/) (5)ni(u/)_ (fei1 niu5 飛鳥), or _(1)f(i/) (4)k(')am_ (fei1 kam4 飛禽), birds; _(1)f(i/) (1)kam_ (fei1 gam1 飛金), to put on gold leaf; _(1)f(i/) ~~(4)(i/)m~~ (4)sh(i/)m (2)tsau pik(8)_ (fei1 sim4 zau2 bik3 飛檐走壁) an expert thief; _(1)f(i/) (2)sh(u_ (fei1 syu2 飛鼠), a bat; _(1)f(i/) p(o\)(3)_ (fei1 bou3 飛報) to haste to tell; _(1)f(i/) (4)t(')ang_ (fei1 tang4 飛騰), to rise rapidly in office; _(1)f(i/) (1)t(')(i/)n (2)p(u/)n sz'(6)_ (fei1 tin1 bun2 si6 飛天本事) incomparably clever; _(1)F(i/)-(4)l(i/)m_ (fei1 lim4 飛廉), Boreas, the god of wind (Kangxi: ...世因以飛廉爲風伯之名...). Williams' 飛檐走壁: Changed _(4)(i/)m_ (jim4) to common reading _(4)sh(i/)m_ (sim4). The 183rd radical (U+2FB6 ⾶ "fly"). (_mahjong_) A winning tile, in the context of a numbered suit. 叫兩飛 (giu3 loeng5 fei1): "Calling for two different winning tiles." 叫幾飛 (giu3 gei2 fei1): "Calling for several different winning tiles." 【飛】 (pj+j) (_verb-like_) to fly 【飛】 (fei1) To cut off hair. 飛髮 (fei1 faat3): "Get a haircut." 飛短啲 (fei1 dyun2 di1): "Cut it shorter." 飛光佢 (fei1 gwong1 keoi5): "Cut it all off" (i.e. go bald). To skip. 巴士飛站 (baa1 si2 fei1 zaam6): "A bus skipping a stop." A ticket. 買飛 (maai5 fei1): "Buy a ticket." 黃牛飛 (wong4 ngau4 fei1): "Scalped tickets." 【飛起】 (fei1 hei2) Used after 到 to indicate an extreme degree. Similar to "to death" in English after a verb. 熱到飛起 (jit6 dou3 fei1 hei2): "It's so hot I could fly." 鬧到飛起 (naau6 dou3 fei1 hei2): "Scolded so badly I could fly."

U+9A11 匪 (for walking-related senses) 𬴂 (Mainland simplified) (F1.35 騑) 馬行不止 (Page 52 #13: (1)騑) The two outside of a team of four horses (Kangxi: 車有一轅四馬中兩馬夾轅名服馬兩邊名騑馬亦名驂馬); _(1)f(i/) (1)f(i/)_ (fei1 fei1 騑騑), the regular march of horses (Kangxi: 騑騑馬行不止貌). (Page 53 #3: (2)匪 _(2)F(i/)_ (fei2); here corrected to _(1)F(i/)_ (fei1) and normalised to 騑) regular march of horses (Kangxi 匪: 同騑騑騑馬行不止貌), beautiful (Kangxi 匪: 行而有文也); 【騑-adjective】 (phj+j) (_adjective-like_) walking (on), trotting (on) 【騑-noun】 (pj+j) (_noun-like_) outside-horse

fei2.text: U+60B1 (F1.39 悱) 口欲言而未能也 (Page 53 #4: (2)悱) Embarrassed, unable to speak out one's ideas (Kangxi: 口欲言而未能之貌). Williams' "Embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed". 【悱】 (phj+jX) (_adjective-like_) eager to express

U+6590 匪 (F1.39 斐) 文貌 (Page 53 #6: (2)斐) Elegant, adorned (Kangxi: 分別文也 etc.), graceful, polished, applied to actions or writings; _(2)f(i/) (5)m(i/)_ (fei2 mei5 斐美), pleasing; _(2)f(i/) (4)(i/)n ~~(1)shing~~ (4)shing (1)ch(e/)ung_ (fei2 jin4 sing4 zoeng1 斐然成章), as splendid as finished composition. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 貌. Williams' "adorned": Especially with small markings (Kangxi: 小文之貌). Williams' 斐然成章: Corrected _(1)shing_ (sing1) to _(4)shing_ (sing4). 【斐】 (phj+jX) (_adjective-like_) decorated, splendid

U+68D0 (F1.39 棐) 篤棐輔也 (Page 53 #5: ~~(2)榧~~(2)~~棑~~棐) a piece of wood tied to a bow at the grasp to ~~strengthen~~ straighten it (Kangxi 棐: 輔也, 輔卽弓檠也故从木); to assist; ~~to lean on;~~ _tuk(7) (2)f(i/)_ (duk1 fei2 篤棐), to help in earnest; Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete strokes in 輔. Williams does not provide separate entries for 榧 and 棐 (which is misprinted as 棑). Note that 棐 can be used for 榧, but not the other way round. I have split things up accordingly. 【棐】 (pj+jX) (_verb-like_) to assist

U+69A7 棐 (Page 53 #5: (2)榧(2)~~棑~~棐) A kind of cabinet wood with lines (Kangxi 榧: 榧似煔而材光文彩如柏古謂文木通作棐), suitable to make furniture (Kangxi 棐: 與榧同木名可爲几); _(2)f(i/) (2)tsz'_ (fei2 zi2 榧子) a long nut resembling the hazel-nut, found in Sh(a/)ntung (山東). Williams does not provide separate entries for 榧 and 棐 (which is misprinted as 棑). Note that 棐 can be used for 榧, but not the other way round. I have split things up accordingly. The nutmeg yew (Kangxi 榧: 木名子可食療白蟲).

U+7BDA 匪 棐 (F1.39 篚) 筐篚箱屬圓曰篚 (Page 53 #3: (2)匪; here normalised to 篚) A ~~square~~ bamboo box-like container (Kangxi 匪: 匪如篋, ~~竹器方曰匪,~~ 器如竹篋今从竹爲筐篚字); (Page 53 #7: (2)篚) A round bamboo basket (Kangxi: 竹器方曰筐圓曰篚, 通作匪, 亦作棐). 【篚】 (pj+jX) (_noun-like_) bamboo-basket

U+7FE1 fai6 (per 《廣韻》扶沸切) fei6 (per 《廣韻》扶沸切) (Page 53 #11: 翡(6) _F(i/)(6)_ (fei6); here normalised to _(2)F(i/)_ (fei2)) A kingfisher, with beautiful plumage (Kangxi: 赤羽雀也出鬱林, 鳥似翠而赤); the cock is called _~~f(i/)(6)~~ (2)f(i/)_ (fei2 翡), the hen _ts(')ui(3)_ (ceoi3 翠) (Kangxi: 翠鳥形如燕赤而雄曰翡靑而雌曰翠); _~~f(i/)(6)~~ (2)f(i/) ts(')ui(3) yuk(9)_ (fei2 ceoi3 juk6 翡翠玉) ~~chrysoprase~~ jadeite.

U+8AB9 非 诽 (Mainland simplified) fai3 (per 《廣韻》方味切) fei1 (per 《廣韻》甫微切) (F1.39 誹) 誹謗 (Page 53 #9: (2)誹) To backbite, to speak against (Kangxi: 謗也, 𧨚也, 或省作非); _(2)f(i/) p(')ong(3)_ (fei2 pong3 誹謗) to slander. The reading _(2)f(i/)_ (fei2) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the readings 妃尾切 and 府尾切, both explained 謗也. 【誹】 (pj+j, pj+jH) (_verb-like_) to slander

fei4.text: U+80A5 fei4-2 (in 阿肥, and rising second in vernacular 肥肥地) (F1.39 肥) 不瘦也潤也 (Page 53 #1: (4)肥) Fat, oily, fleshy (Kangxi: 多肉也), rich (Kangxi: 饒裕也), fertile (Kangxi: 田有肥瘠); _(4)f(i/) chong(3)_ (fei4 zong3 肥壯) robust; _(4)f(i/) t(a/)i(6)_ (fei4 daai6 肥大) corpulent; _(4)f(i/) (2)l(o\)_ (fei4 lou2 肥佬) or _(a/)(3) (4)f(i/)_ (aa3 fei4-2 阿肥), a fat man; _(4)f(i/) yun(6)_ (fei4 jeon6 肥潤) fertile; _(4)f(i/) ~~tun(6) tun(6)~~ tat(7) tat(7)_ (fei4 dat1 dat1 肥腯腯) obese, fat as a pig; _(4)f(i/) (5)m(i/)_ (fei4 mei5 肥美), plump, good looking. (Page 714 #5: (4)肥) As a verb. To fatten; fattened; to advantage one; _chat(7) k(u/)(3) (4)f(i/) (2)k(i/)_ (zat1 gu3 fei4 gei2 只顧肥己), he only thinks of benefiting himself. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿸疒央 to 瘦, and corrected ⿰冫閏 to 潤. Williams' 肥腯腯: Normalised _tun(6)_ (deon6) to _tat(7)_ (dat1). A horse (Kangxi: 馬亦稱肥). Fertiliser. 【肥】 (bj+j) (_adjective-like_) fat (_adjective-like_) fertile Cantonese prefers 肥 over 胖, even when referring to fatness in humans. 【肥腯腯】 (fei4 dat1 dat1) Chubby. 【肥嘟嘟】 (fei4 dyut1 dyut1) Synonym of 肥腯腯. 【肥揗揗】 (fei4 tan4 tan4) Fat, in a somewhat clumsy or bumbling way. Fatty, greasy.

U+8153 (F1.39 腓) 足肚也又？也詩小人所腓又病也百卉具腓又庇也牛羊腓字之 (Page 53 #2: (4)腓) Calf of the leg (Kangxi: 脛腨也, 腳腨腸也, 腓䏿也, 脛後肉腓腸也); sick, diseased (Kangxi: 病也, 變也); to avoid, to flee from (Kangxi: 避也); to conceal or cover, as animals do each other when herding (Fan Wan: 庇也). Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 詩. The incomprehensible character looks like an incomplete 備; context suggests that this should be 避. Williams' "sick, diseased": Especially worsening disease. 【腓】 (bj+j) (_noun-like_) calf (_verb-like_) to deteriorate (_verb-like_) to protect, to cover

fik1.text: U+20C65 May appear as either ⿰口卉 (+5 assumed here) or ⿰口𠦄 (+6), depending on the font. (Page 714 #7: 𠱥(7)) A colloquial word. Seems to be a mispronunciation of _fat(7)_ (fat1)_;_ _(1)f(a/) (1)f(a/) fik(7) fik(7)_ (faa1 faa1 fik1 fik1 花花𠱥𠱥) fickle, inconstant, fitful, never finishing anything.

fik6.text: U+639D fak6 (alternative) (Page 53 #12: _Fik(7)_ (fik1) exemplified; here corrected to _Fik(9)_ (fik6) and assigned to 掝) To brush off (as a fly); _~~fik(7)~~ fik(9) (1)hoi_ (fik6 hoi1 掝開), brush it off! 【掝】 (fik6, fak6) To swing, to flap, especially quickly. 掝甩 (fik6 lat1): "Flap it off." To flick or to brush away quickly. 掝走佢 (fik6 zau2 keoi5): "Flick it away." The spelling 掝 is arbitrary.

fing1.text: U+6379 May appear as either ⿰扌⿱大卉 (+8 assumed here) or ⿰扌⿱大𠦄 (+9), depending on the font.

fing3.text: U+6379 May appear as either ⿰扌⿱大卉 (+8 assumed here) or ⿰扌⿱大𠦄 (+9), depending on the font.

fing6.text: U+6379 May appear as either ⿰扌⿱大卉 (+8 assumed here) or ⿰扌⿱大𠦄 (+9), depending on the font. (Page 53 #13: 捹(6))

fit1.text: U+227B5 (Page 714 #6: _F(i/)t(7)_ (fit1) assumed; here assigned to 𢞵) A colloquial word. To whip, to spank, to punish.

fo1.text: U+79D1 (F2.58 科) 科坎科等又科甲 (Page 53 #14: (1)科) ~~A root, the hollow culm of grain;~~ ~~a vacuum, empty~~ a hollow in a tree (Kangxi: 木中空也); a rule, a regulation, a clause (Kangxi: 條也); practice (in medicine), an area or field of study; a class, series, order, rank, gradation (Kangxi: 等也); classifier of herbs; a literary examination (Kangxi: 取人條格曰科第); _~~luk(7)~~ luk(9) (1)fo_ (luk6 fo1 六科), six departments in official establishments; _(1)fo k(a/)p(8)_ (fo1 gaap3 科甲) a high literary degree; _(1)hoi (1)fo_ (hoi1 fo1 開科), to open the _k(uyan_ (舉人) examination; _(1)fo (1)shau_ (fo1 sau1 科收), to receive taxes; _(1)fo ~~p(a/)i(3)~~ p(')(a/)i(3)_ (fo1 paai3 科派) compulsory ~~service~~ contributions; _(1)fo muk(9)_ (fo1 muk6 科目) an index, series, rank; _(1)fo (4)l(a/)m_ (fo1 laam4-2 科籃), basket carried by candidates into the hall; _ching(3) (1)fo_ (zing3 fo1 正科), the alternate third years when examinations occur; _noi(6) (1)fo_ (noi6 fo1 內科), medical practice; _(1)fo (4)t(')au_ (fo1 tau4 科頭), bareheaded, head unarmed (Kangxi: 謂不著兜鍪入敵). Williams' 六科: Corrected _luk(7)_ (luk1) to _luk(9)_ (luk6). Williams' 科派: Corrected _p(a/)i(3)_ (baai3) to _p(')(a/)i(3)_ (paai3). Williams' 科目: Now a subject or area of study. Williams' 內科: Specifically internal medicine, as opposed to 外科, surgery. A department, a section. Taxation. A pit, a hole (Kangxi: 坎也). To sentence, to punish (Kangxi: 科斷也 etc.). 【科】 (khwa) (_noun-like_) degree, class, rank (_noun-like_) ordinance (_noun-like_) hole, hollow (_verb-like_) to levy

U+7AA0 wo1 (per Fan Wan, common) (F2.59 窠 _(1)Wo_ (wo1)) 鳥在木曰巢在穴曰窠 (Page 30|n73 #2: (4)窠 _(4)Ch(')(a/)u_ (caau4); here corrected to _(1)Fo_ (fo1)) A nest in a cave (Kangxi: 穴中曰窠樹上曰巢). Erroneously read _(1)wo_ (wo1) in the Fan Wan. (Page 714 #11: (1)窠) A hole (Kangxi: 空也); a nest in the ground or a ~~cliff~~ cave; ~~a nest of clay;~~ a burrow; a roost of pheasants (Kangxi: 雞雉所乳謂之窠); _(2)sh(u (5)ni(u/) (4)t(')ung (1)fo_ (syu2 niu5 tung4 fo1 鼠鳥同窠), rats and birds in the same nest, _i. e._ all villains in that place. This is sometimes pronounced _(1)wo_ (wo1). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 窼 to 窠. Williams' "Erroneously": In the sense that it deviates from Middle Chinese 苦禾切.

U+874C 科 (F2.58 蝌) 蝌蚪虫名又字體也 (Page 54 #1: (1)~~蚪~~蝌) The tadpole; _(1)fo (2)tau_ (fo1 dau2 蝌蚪), the tadpole (Kangxi 蝌: 蝌蚪本作科 etc.); also called _~~(4)lui~~ (4)l(u/)i (1)kung (4)(u_ (leoi4 gung1 jyu4-2 雷公魚). Fan Wan entry: Corrected missing/blurred strokes in 體. Williams' 雷公魚: Corrected _(4)lui_ to _(4)l(u/)i_.

fo2.text: U+4F19 夥 (for "companion/company" senses) 火 fo2-1 (in interrogative intensifier 家伙) (F2.60 夥) 夥伴 (F2.60 伙) 家用物件曰家伙 (Page 54 #2: (2)火; here normalised to 伙) _~~(1)tsun~~ tsun(3) (2)fo_ (zeon3 fo2 進伙), to move to a new house; (Page 54 #3: (2)伙) A company of ten in the army (Kangxi 火: 府兵十人爲火 etc.); _(1)k(a/) (2)fo_ (gaa1 fo2 家伙), household furniture; _(2)fo (4)t(')au_ (fo2 tau4-2 伙頭), a cook; _(2)fo (2)tsai_ (fo2 zai2 伙仔), a scullion; _(2)fo (2)ch(e/)ung_ (fo2 zoeng2 伙長), chief mate; _(i/)(6) (2)fo_ (ji6 fo2 二伙) second mate; _(2)h(o\) (1)k(a/) (2)fo_ (hou2 gaa1 fo2 好家伙), well, pleasing, handsome; also used in irony, as detestable, badly, done. (Page 54 #4: (2)夥; here normalised to 伙) A colleague, comrade, accomplice, associate; a company, party, band, society; _(2)fo p(u/)n(6)_ (fo2 bun6 伙伴) a partner; _h(o\)p(9) (2)fo_ (hap6 fo2 合伙), joint partner; _(2)k(i/) (2)fo_ (gei2 fo2 幾伙), how many? as men; _(2)fo k(i/)(3)_ (fo2 gei3 伙記) (or _kai(3)_ (gai3 計)) a fellow; the word _Fokee_ applied to the Chinese by foreigners. Williams' 進伙: Corrected _(1)tsun_ (zeon1) to _tsun(3)_ (zeon3). Note that the preferred term in Cantonese is 入伙. Williams' "A company of ten in the army": This sense should probably be spelt 火 rather than 伙. Meals, especially communal meals. 【弊家伙】 (bai6 gaa1 fo2) An interjectory expression used in response to something going wrong. 【伙記】 (fo2 gei3) An employee who serves customers, especially a waiter. 【家伙】 (gaa1 fo2, gaa1 fo2-1) A mild intensifier for interrogatives. 做乜家伙 (zou6 mat1 gaa1 fo2): "What the crap are you doing?" 咩家伙啊 (me1 gaa1 fo2-1 a3): "What on earth is this?"
U+5801 fo3 (alternative per 《廣韻》苦卧切 for "dust-rising" sense) Dust rising (Kangxi: 塵起貌).
U+5925 㚌 wo6 (per 《廣韻》胡果切) (F2.60 夥) 夥伴 (Page 54 #4: (2)夥) many, numerous (Kangxi: 多也);

U+706B 灬 (character component on bottom) (F2.60 火) 水火五行之一燒炙物也 (Page 54 #2: (2)火) Fire, flame (Kangxi: 火燬也南方之行炎而上); to burn, to consume (Kangxi: 火化也消化物也 etc.); _(2)fo chuk(7)_ (fo2 zuk1 火燭) a conflagration; _(2)fo (1)f(a/)_ (fo2 faa1 火花), a spark; _(2)fo ~~(1)(i/)m~~ (i/)m(6)_ (fo2 jim6 火焰), a flame; _kau(3) (2)fo_ (gau3 fo2 救火), to put out conflagration; _shat(7) (2)fo_ (sat1 fo2 失火), to catch fire; _(2)t(')ai (2)fo shik(7)_ (tai2 fo2 sik1 睇火色) watch how the fire is, see the blaze! _(2)fo (1)ts(')(e/)ung_ (fo2 coeng1 火鎗), fire-arms; _ts(e/)(3) (2)fo_ (ze3 fo2 借火), trouble you for a light; _(5)m(o\) (2)fo (2)chung_ (mou5 fo2 zung2 冇火種), 'no fire-seed,' poor; _(2)fo shek(9) (2)fan_, (fo2 sek6 fan2 火石粉) chalk; _(2)fo (4)sh(un_ (fo2 syun4 火船), a steamer; _(2)fo ~~sik(9)~~ sik(7)_ (fo2 sik1 火熄) the fire is out; _(2)fo p(')i(u/)(3)_ (fo2 piu3 火票) an urgent warrant; _~~(5)m(o\)~~ (4)m(o\) (4)ming (2)fo_ (mou4 ming4 fo2 無名火), causeless anger; _(2)fo (2)keng_ (fo2 geng2 火頸), testy; _(2)fo (2)p(a/)_ (fo2 baa2 火把), a torch; _(2)fo (1)l(o\)_ (fo2 lou1 火撈), soot; _(2)fo (5)yan_ (fo2 jan5 火引), a match; _(2)fo h(i/)(3)_ (fo2 hei3 火氣) fiery, feverish ; _(2)t(a/) (2)fo_ (daa2 fo2 打火), to strike a fire; _(2)fo ~~(2)f(a/)~~ f(a/)(3)_ (fo2 faa3 火化), burned up; _(5)mai ~~(5)shai~~ (2)shai (2)fo h(i/)(3)_ (mai5 sai2 fo2 hei3 咪使火氣) do n't be so hasty; _(2)fo (1)k(u t(o\)(6) sz'(6)_ (fo2 geoi1 dou6 si6-2 火居道士) a sect among the T(a/)uists. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 燒. Williams' 火焰: Corrected _(1)(i/)m_ (jim1) to _(i/)m(6)_ (jim6). Williams' 火船: Dated. Williams' 火熄: Corrected _sik(9)_ (sik6) to _sik(7)_ (sik1). Williams' 無名火: Corrected _(5)m(o\)_ (mou5) to _(4)m(o\)_ (mou4). Williams' 火引: Perhaps better rendered "a kindler". Williams' 火化: Corrected _(2)f(a/)_ (faa2) to _f(a/)(3)_ (faa3). Cremation. Williams' 咪使火氣: Corrected _(5)shai_ (sai5) to _(2)shai_ (sai2). The 86th radical (U+2F55 ⽕ "fire"). Internal "fire" (or "heat") in Chinese medicine. A combustion engine. 熄火 (sik1 fo2): "Turn off the engine." 撻火 (taat1 fo2): "Start the engine." 死咗火 (sei2 zo2 fo2): "Engine's stalled." 【火】 (xwaX) (_noun-like_) fire, (_met._) light 【火】 (fo2) A watt (of power). 幾多火 (gei2 do1 fo2): "How many watts?" 六十火 (luk6 sap6 fo2): "Sixty watts."

U+9846 堁 (for "clod" sense) 颗 (Mainland simplified) (F2.60 顆) 小頭物也一顆猶一個一粒也 (Page 54 #5: (2)顆) A little head (Kangxi: 小頭也) ~~or clod~~; a clod (Kangxi: 與堁同土塊 etc.); classifier of beads, shot, pearls, and round things (Kangxi: 今言物一顆猶一頭也, 凡圜物以顆計又珠琲曰顆); _(2)k(i/) (1)to (2)fo_ (gei2 do1 fo2 幾多顆), how many of them? Williams' "clod": This is a significantly separate sense. It should be separated from "A little head" by a semicolon.

fo3.text: U+8AB2 课 (Mainland simplified) (F2.61 課) 說課又試也第也計也程也 (Page 54 #7: 課(3)) A plan, an example, a task, an exercise; literary pursuits; to essay, to try, to test, to assess (Kangxi: 試也 etc.); to counsel, to deliberate; to exhort; to examine; ~~a poll~~ tax (Kangxi: 稅也); _~~(1)k(o/)~~ (1)k(o\) fo(3) (4)ngan_ (gou1 fo3 ngan4 ？課銀), allowance given students; _fo(3) (4)man_ (fo3 man4 課文), to criticise compositions; _(u/)i(6) fo(3)_ (wui6 fo3 會課) to hold a concourse for writing; _(ut(9) fo(3)_ (jyut6 fo3 月課) monthly trial for composition; _(1)kung fo(3)_ (gung1 fo3 功課) a stint of work; _~~yat(7)~~ yat(9) fo(3)_ (jat6 fo3 日課) a daily task, or lesson. Williams' "to deliberate": This is a dubious rendering of Kangxi 議也 (which is admittedly unhelpful). Williams' 功課: Now "homework". Williams' 日課: Corrected _yat(7)_ (jat1) to _yat(9)_ (jat6). To compute (Kangxi: 計也程也). 【課】 (khwaH) (_verb-like_) to assess (_noun-like_) tax

U+8CA8 货 (Mainland simplified) (F2.61 貨) 貨財凡物可交易皆曰貨 (Page 54 #6: 貨(3)) Goods, merchandise, commodities, things of value or utility (Kangxi: 財也, 貨寶用物, etc.); to trade, to buy, to sell (Kangxi: 貨賣也); to bribe (Kangxi: 賂也); _fo(3) mat(9)_ (fo3 mat6 貨物) goods; _fo(3) (4)ts(')oi_ (fo3 coi4 貨財), property, capital; _~~(a/)p(8)~~ (a/)t(8) fo(3)_ (aat3 fo3 押貨) to go with cargo to a ship; _fo(3) (4)t(')au_ (fo3 tau4 貨頭), prime goods; _fo(3) l(o\)(6)_ (fo3 lou6 貨賂) to bribe; _fo(3) shik(7)_ (fo3 sik1 貨色) quality of goods. Williams' 押貨: Normalised _(a/)p(8)_ (aap3) to _(a/)t(8)_ (aat3). Currency. 【貨】 (xwaH) (_noun-like_) goods, property (_noun-like_) currency

fok3.text: U+6509 (F1.103 攉) 手反覆也搖手曰揮反手曰攉 (Page 55 #5: 攉(8)) To ~~recall one with~~ flip over the hand (Kangxi: 手反覆也); to motion ~~back~~ with the hand (Kangxi: 搖手曰揮反手曰攉); ~~to fan;~~ _h(i/)(3) fok(8)_ (hei3 fok3 戲攉) to make a fool of; _fok(8) (2)shau_ (fok3 sau2 攉手), to shake the hand. Williams' 攉手: More specifically, to shake about the axis of the arm (in the same way that shaking the head is about the axis of the neck).

U+652B gwok3 (per 《廣韻》居縛切) (F1.103 攫) 爪持也撲取也 (Page 54 #11: 攫(8)) To grasp with the talons or claws (Kangxi: 扟也, 撲取也, 以腳取之謂之攫以翼擊之謂之搏, 一曰持也); _fok(8) (2)ts(')(u_ (fok3 ceoi2 攫取), to seize by force, to get anyhow. Fan Wan entry: Corrected incomplete 瓜 to 爪, and fixed missing stroke in 撲. 【攫】 (kjwak) (_verb-like_) to snatch

U+77CD gwok3 (per 《廣韻》居縛切) (F1.103 矍) 矍鑠輕徤貌 (Page 54 #12: 矍(8)) The fluttering of a bird when caught (Kangxi: 隹欲逸走也); looking right and left in fear (Kangxi: 左右驚顧也); to glance the eyes about quickly (Kangxi: 一曰視遽貌, 不專視之容, 目不正也); _fok(8) ~~y(e/)uk(8)~~ sh(e/)uk(8)_ (fok3 soek3 矍鑠) active; said of an old man (Kangxi: 矍鑠輕健貌). Williams' 矍鑠: Corrected _y(e/)uk(8)_ (joek3) to _sh(e/)uk(8)_ (soek3). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【矍】 (kjwak) (_verb-like_) to glance fearfully
U+7E1B (F1.103 縛) 綁縛 (Page 55 #1: 縛(8)) Fan Wan entry: Fixed extra stroke in headword 縛.

U+85FF (F1.103 藿) 藿香草名 (Page 55 #4: 藿(8)) Leaves or young sprouts of pulse (Kangxi: 尗之少也, 藿豆葉), used as food; ~~greens in general;~~ _fok(8) (1)h(e/)ung_ (fok3 hoeng1 藿香), the _Betonica officinalis_ used in colic. 【藿】 (xwak) (_noun-like_) pulse-leaf, pulse-sprout

U+8EA9 gwok3 (per 《廣韻》居縛切) kwok3 (per 《廣韻》丘縛切) (F1.103 躩) 盤辟貌 (Page 54 #10: 躩(8)) A short, quick, stately step, as if ~~going up stairs~~ turning on the spot, deemed respectful to superiors (Kangxi: 足盤辟而爲敬也); _fok(8) ~~p(o/)(6)~~ p(o\)(6)_ (fok3 bou6 躩步) a quick, regular walk (Kangxi: 躩步疾行). Williams' 躩步: Corrected _p(o/)(6)_ to _p(o\)(6)_. To jump (Kangxi: 躩跳也). 【躩】 (khjwak, kjwak) (_verb-like_) to step turning on the spot, to step quickly
U+9481 䦆 (Mainland simplified) gwok3 (per 《廣韻》居縛切) (F1.103 钁) 鋤頭 (Page 55 #2: 钁(8)) A large hoe or mattock (Kangxi: 大鉏也 etc.), made of wood, edged with iron.

U+970D 靃 (F1.103 霍) 姓 (Page 55 #3: 霍(8)) Speed, celerity, agility (揮霍, 揮霍猝遽也, 揮霍疾貌); a surname (Kangxi: 姓); a range of mountains (Kangxi: 山名 etc.) ~~in H(u/)peh (湖北)~~, the Atlas of China (Kangxi: 卽天柱山); _fok(8) l(un(6) ching(3)_ (fok3 lyun6 zing3 霍亂症) the cholera or bilious colic; _fok(8) (4)(i/)n_ (fok3 jin4 霍然), quick, like flying clouds. Williams' "in H(u/)peh": This is dubious. Kangxi has an extended note discussing whether there are multiple mountains called 霍. Of the candidates, 衡山 is in 湖南, while 天柱山 is in 安徽. To dissipate, to disperse (Kangxi: 霍焉猶渙焉也). 【霍】 (xwak) (_adverb-like_) swiftly

fong1.text: U+574A (F1.96 坊) 邑里之名 (Page 55 #8: (1)坊) A neighborhood; a street, a lane, an alley (Kangxi: 邑里之名); a burgh, a country-house, a shop; _(1)k(a/)i (1)fong_ (gaai1 fong1 街坊) a street; _(1)fong (5)sh(e/)_ (fong1 se5 坊社), a neighborhood; _(4)p(')(a/)i (1)fong_ (paai4 fong1 牌坊), an honorary portal; _~~(4)sh(u~~ (1)sh(u (1)fong_ (syu1 fong1 書坊), bookstore; _(1)ch(')un (1)fong_ (ceon1 fong1 春坊), the palace of the heir-apparent (Kangxi: 太子宮曰春坊), an honorary grade in the H(a/)nlin (翰林) academy. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing final stroke in 里. Williams' 街坊: Also the people in one's neighbourhood. Williams' 書坊: Corrected _(4)sh(u_ (syu4) to _(1)sh(u_ (syu1).

U+614C 荒 (F1.96 慌) 驚慌又慌忽也 (Page 56 #2: (1)慌) Fluttered, perturbed, apprehensive, nervous; to scare, to alarm; _(1)fong ~~(4)h(e/)ung~~ (1)ch(e/)ung_ (fong1 zoeng1 慌張), ~~dreading, terrified~~ panicked; _(1)fong tak(7) (5)ngo_ (fong1 dak1 ngo5 慌得我), you alarm me; _(1)fong (4)mong_ (fong1 mong4 慌忙), hurried, uneasy. Williams prints the headword as ⿰忄⿱艹㠩, which is compatibility ideograph U+2F8A7. Williams' 慌張: Corrected _(4)h(e/)ung_ (hoeng4) to _(1)ch(e/)ung_ (zoeng1). 【慌死】 (fong1 sei2) To be very afraid. 慌死蝕底 (fong1 sei2 sit6 dai2): "Sore afraid of losing out." 【唔慌】 (m4 fong1) Used to indicate anti-expectation of something favourable. 唔慌平 (m4 fong1 peng4): "No way it's cheap." 【唔慌唔】 (m4 fong1 m4) Used to indicate expectation of something unfavourable. 唔慌唔執笠 (m4 fong1 m4 zap1 lap1): "No way the business won't go under."

fong2.text: U+614C 荒 (F1.96 慌 _(1)Fong_ (fong1)) 驚慌又慌忽也 (Page 56 #2: (1)慌 _(1)Fong_ (fong1); here corrected to _(2)Fong_ (fong2)) obscure, confused (Kangxi: 昬也); _~~(5)n(i/) (1)fong~~ (2)fong fat(7)_ (fong2 fat1 慌惚) ~~disturbed, harassed~~ confused; Williams and Kangxi print the headword as ⿰忄⿱艹㠩, which is compatibility ideograph U+2F8A7. 【慌】 (xwangX) (_adjective-like_) vague, unclear

fong1.text: U+65B9 枋 (for "boats abreast" and "raft" senses) 舫 (for "boats abreast" and "raft" sense) (F1.96 方) 方正方術方法量也矩也類也且也有也又四方又方圓 (Page 55 #6: (1)方) Square (Kangxi: ...方者中矩); cornered, angular; a place, a region, a side, a direction (Kangxi: 方名如東西也); manner, art, rule, means (Kangxi: 道也, 術也法也); uprightness, correctness (Kangxi: 義之宜也), regularity (Kangxi: 常也); then, thereupon, in that case, in consequence of; ~~towards, to;~~ ~~like;~~ to compare (Kangxi: 比方也), to lay together; to possess (Kangxi: 有之也); a prescription (Kangxi: 醫方); a ~~thin~~ board or tablet (Kangxi: 板也); ~~a written list of vassals or retainers;~~ _sz'(3) (1)fong_ (sei3 fong1 四方), square, the four points, everywhere, all around; _(1)fong ching(3)_ (fong1 zing3 方正) upright, correct; _(1)fong (2)ho_ (fong1 ho2 方可), proper, suitable; _(5)yau (1)fong_ (jau5 fong1 有方), there are rules; _(1)fong p(i/)n(6)_ (fong1 bin6 方便) convenient, all ready, to do good to, to oblige, to bestow charity; _(4)l(e/)ung (1)fong_ (loeng4 fong1 良方), a good prescription; _(1)fong wai(6)_ (fong1 wai6-2 方位) a seat, residence, location; _(1)fong f(a/)t(8)_ (fong1 faat3 方法) means or way of doing; _t(a/)i(6) (1)fong_ (daai6 fong1 大方), liberal, generous in feeling; _(1)fong (4)ts(')oi_ (fong1 coi4 方纔), then, just now; _(1)fong (2)ch(')(e/)_ (fong1 ce2 方且), about to do, just then~~:~~; _(1)fong (1)kam_ (fong1 gam1 方今), now; _(1)fong ts(')(un(3)_ (fong1 cyun3 方寸) the heart; _(1)fong ~~l(e/)uk(8)~~ l(e/)uk(9)_ (fong1 loek6 方略) a stratagem; _(1)hoi (1)fong_ (hoi1 fong1 開方), to commence a new business. (Page 57 #1: (2)舫 _(2)Fong_ (fong2); here corrected to _(1)Fong_ (fong1) and normalised to 方) Two boats alongside of each other (Kangxi 舫: 倂船也); ~~a galley of fifty men;~~ Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing dot in 術, corrected malformed 量, and normalised 𩔖 to 類. Williams' "a written list of vassals or retainers": This is probably a misreading of Kangxi 《儀禮聘禮》不及百名書於方 as a definition, when it is actually an example. Williams' 方略: Corrected _l(e/)uk(8)_ (loek3) to _l(e/)uk(9)_ (loek6). Williams' 開方: Also to take the square root. Williams' "a galley of fifty men": This is a misreading of Kangxi 一舫載五十人 as a definition, when it is actually an example. A raft (Kangxi: 方泭也). Just grown (Kangxi: 穀始生未實也). Just now. Now (Kangxi: 今也). A cube, a power. The 70th radical (U+2F45 ⽅ "square"). 【方】 (pjang) (_noun-like_) square, cube, (_met._) block (_noun-like_) direction, side (_noun-like_) place, (_met._) to occupy (_suffix_) (_noun-like_) regularity, norm, prescription (_adjective-like_) upright (_noun-like_) method (_adverb-like_) abreast, (_met._) to compare, raft (_adverb-like_) just, (just) now, only then, when (_adverb-like_) about to

U+678B (F1.96 枋) 木枋門枋 (Page 55 #9: (1)枋) A wood used by cartwrights (Kangxi: 木可作車), and shipwrights; ~~the white~~ boards used by fishermen to ~~entice~~ wall fish (Kangxi: 蜀人以木偃魚曰枋); _(1)s(u/) (1)fong muk(9)_ (sou1 fong1 muk6 蘇枋木) a kind of logwood or sapanwood; _(4)m(u/)n (1)fong_ (mun4 fong1 門枋), door-posts.
U+794A May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.96 祊) 廟門内也 (Page 55 #10: (1)祊)

U+8093 (F1.96 肓) 膏肓心之上鬲之下也 (Page 56 #4: (1)~~盲~~肓) A part of the thorax ~~above the heart (Kangxi 肓: 心上鬲下也)~~ below the heart and above the diaphragm; the vitals. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 盲 to 肓. Williams' "above the heart": 《說文》心上鬲下也 quoted by Kangxi ("above the heart and below the diaphragm") is clearly erroneous, and should instead be 心下鬲上也. 【肓】 (xwang) (_noun-like_) mediastinal-floor

fong2.text: U+822B 枋 bong3 (per 《廣韻》補曠切) fong3 (per 《廣韻》甫妄切) (F1.99 舫) 船名 (Page 57 #1: (2)舫) ~~a pilot or steersman (Kangxi: 船師也);~~ _w(a/)(6) (2)fong_ (waa6 fong2 畫舫), a flower or other handsome river boat; _(2)fong (1)chung (4)t(')(a/)m (2)yam_ (fong2 zung1 taam4 jam2 舫中談飲), conversing and drinking in a boat. Williams' "a pilot or steersman": This is a faithful rendering of Kangxi 《說文》船師也, but that definition is incorrect. According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, the explanation 船師也 should simply be 船也, with the logic being that in 舫人習水者, we simply have 舫 meaning "boat" and 人 meaning "man" (i.e. it is the compound 舫人 that means "helmsman"). Kangxi gives analysis in the same vein from 《正字通》. A boat. 【舫】 (pjangH, pangH) (_noun-like_) boat

fong1.text: U+82B3 (F1.96 芳) 芬芳香草 (Page 55 #11: (1)芳) Fragrant, odorous (Kangxi: 芬芳香氣貌); beautiful, like flowers; _met._ agreeable, pleasant; virtuous, excellent; _(1)fong (2)ch(i/)_ (fong1 zi2 芳芷), fragrant plants; _(1)fong (1)tsung_ (fong1 zung1 芳蹤), fragrant memory or examples of ancient worthies; _(1)fong (4)ming_ (fong1 ming4 芳名), a reputation for virtue; _(4)n(i/)n (1)fong (2)k(i/) (1)to_ (nin4 fong1 gei2 do1 年芳幾多), how old are you? _(1)fong (2)ts(')(o\)_ (fong1 cou2 芳草), ~~grassy,~~ fresh grass. The fragrance of virtue (Kangxi: 芳德之臭也). 【芳】 (phjang) (_adjective-like_) fragrant

U+8352 𮎰 (F1.96 荒) 荒蕪荒廢大也遠也 (Page 56 #1: (1)𮎰; here normalised to 荒) Waste, wild (Kangxi 荒: 蕪也), barren, deserted, unproductive; distant (Fan Wan 荒: 遠也); jungle, heath (Kangxi 荒: 一曰草掩地也); empty, uncultivated, void (Kangxi 荒: 空也), ~~unripe,~~ blasted; a famine, a dearth (Kangxi 荒: 四穀不升謂之荒, 果不熟爲荒); to overshadow, to overgrow (Kangxi 荒: 掩也); to magnify (Kangxi 荒: 大也); _(1)fong (4)m(o\)_ (fong1 mou4 荒蕪), bushy, overgrown; _(1)fong fai(3)_ (fong1 fai3 荒廢) to disregard, to cease, old, desuetude; _(1)fong (4)t(')ong_ (fong1 tong4 荒唐), incoherent, incredible, unworthy of belief; _(1)fong (4)n(i/)n_ (fong1 nin4 荒年), a year of scarcity; _(1)fong (1)sho_ (fong1 so1 荒疏), disused, neglected, obsolete; _(1)fong (1)k(a/)u_ (fong1 gaau1 荒郊), wilderness, wilds; _(1)fong (4)yam_ (fong1 jam4 荒淫), lustful. Williams' "unripe": Here, Williams has been misled by Kangxi's example 《爾雅釋天》果不熟爲荒. The full passage (with punctuation) is 穀不熟爲饑、蔬不熟爲饉、果不熟爲荒、仍饑爲荐, which gives the names of various types of crop failure: 饑 for grain, 饉 for vegetable, 荒 for fruit, and 荐 for repeated grain failure. It does *not* define 荒 as meaning "fruit not ripe". To neglect (Kangxi: 廢也). Used in 荒唐, 荒謬, etc. (which now mean "absurd"). 【荒】 (xwang) (_adjective-like_) uncultivated, overgrown (_noun-like_) dearth (_adjective-like_) desolate (_adjective-like_) extensive, (_met._) excessive (_verb-like_) to extend (_verb-like_) to neglect

U+8841 (F1.96 慌) 衁也 (Page 56 #3: (1)衁) Blood ~~above the heart~~ (Kangxi: 血也). Williams' "above the heart": Probably erroneously added out of confusion with the neighbouring entry for 肓, which is misprinted as 盲. See 肓 fong1. 【衁】 (xwang) (_noun-like_) blood

U+8B0A 詤 𧧢 谎 (Mainland simplified) fong2 (alternative per 《廣韻》許昉切 and 呼晃切 for 𧧢) (F1.99 謊 _(2)Fong_ (fong2)) 說謊謬言也 (Page 57 #3: (2)謊 _(2)Fong_ (fong2); here normalised to _(1)Fong_ (fong1)) To talk in sleep (Kangxi 詤: 夢言也), incoherent; to lie, lying, raving; _~~(2)fong~~ (1)fong (4)(i/)n_ (fong1 jin4 謊言), lies; _~~(2)fong~~ (1)fong mau(6)_ (fong1 mau6 謊謬) untrue. Williams and Kangxi print the headword as ⿰訁⿱艹㠩. Williams' 謊謬: To be distinguished from 荒謬, "absurd".

fong2.text: U+8B0A (F1.99 謊) 說謊謬言也 (Page 57 #3: (2)謊) Williams and Kangxi print the headword as ⿰訁⿱艹㠩.

U+4EFF 㑂 倣 放 (F1.99 倣) 依也效也 (Page 56 #8: (2)倣; here normalised to 仿) To imitate (Kangxi 倣: 傚也依也通作仿); like; a model, a copy; _(2)fong ~~y(e/)ung(3)~~ y(e/)ung(6)_ (fong2 joeng6 仿樣) or _(2)fong shik(7)_ (fong2 sik1 仿式) follow the pattern; _(1)s(e/)ung (2)fong_ (soeng1 fong2 相仿), much alike. (Page 57 #4: 放(3) _Fong(3)_ (fong3); here corrected to _(2)Fong_ (fong2) and normalised to 仿) accord (Kangxi 放: 放猶依也); Williams' 仿樣: Corrected _y(e/)ung(3)_ (joeng3) to _y(e/)ung(6)_ (joeng6). 【放-rising】 (pjangX) (_verb-like_) to imitate (_verb-like_) to be in accordance with (_preposition-like_) in accordance with

U+5E4C wong5 (per 《廣韻》胡廣切) (Page 714 #13: (2)幌) A curtain (Kangxi: 帷幔也); an ornament for the head (Kangxi: 蔮恢也恢郭覆髮上也齊人曰幌飾形貌也); ~~a gust, a whirl of wind;~~ _(1)sh(u (2)fong_ (syu1 fong2 書幌), a screen to shade a schoolroom. A shop-sign.

U+5F77 仿 㧍 髣 (F1.99 髣) 髣髴近似也 (F1.99 彷) 同上 (F1.99 恍) 同上 (Page 56 #9: (2)彷(2)髣) Like, resembling (Kangxi 彷: 彷彿也), ~~seen indistinctly (Kangxi 彷: 彷彿見不審也)~~; seeming, ~~dreamy~~; _(2)fong fat(7)_ (fong2 fat1 彷彿) somewhat like; Fan Wan entry: The alternative form 恍 is erroneous. 【彷】 (phjangX) Used in 彷彿.

U+6033 恍 況 (F1.99 怳) 惝怳失意也 (Page 714 #12: (2)恍(2)怳) Wild, mad, fluttered (Kangxi 怳: 狂之貌); Williams does not provide separate entries for 恍 and 怳. I have split things up accordingly. Disappointed (Kangxi 怳: 怳然自失也, 怳失意貌). 【怳】 (xjwangX) (_adjective-like_) disappointed

U+604D 怳 慌 (for "vague/unclear" senses) (F1.99 髣) 髣髴近似也 (F1.99 彷) 同上 (F1.99 恍) 同上 (F1.99 怳) 惝怳失意也 (Page 714 #12: (2)恍(2)怳) ~~Interchanged with 慌 _(1)fong_ (fong1).~~ disturbed, unable to collect one's thoughts; _(2)fong fat(7)_ (fong2 fat1 恍惚) ~~half crazy~~ absent-minded. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 倘 to 惝. Williams does not provide separate entries for 恍 and 怳. I have split things up accordingly. Williams' "Interchanged with 慌": This is incorrect. Instead, 慌 is an alternative form of 恍 _(2)fong_ (fong2) for the "vague/unclear" senses. Vague, unclear (Kangxi 恍: 與慌怳𠀤同). Seemingly. 【恍】 (xwangX) (_adjective-like_) vague, unclear

fong3.text: U+653E 方 fong2 (per Kangxi 分兩切 for "reach" sense) (F1.100 放) 放肆放緃放逐去也散也又置之於此曰放 (Page 57 #4: 放(3)) To reject, to let off; to let go (Kangxi: 棄也), to extend, to liberate, to loose; to lay down (Kangxi: 放置也); to indulge (Kangxi: 放縱也), to relax, to dissipate; ~~to scatter;~~ to open out; _fong(3) (1)sung_ (fong3 sung1 放鬆), to loosen; _fong(3) tsung(3)_ (fong3 zung3 放縱) let him go, to spoil by indulgence; _fong(3) sz'(3)_ (fong3 si3 放肆) presumptuous, impudent; _fong(3) (1)sam_ (fong3 sam1 放心), easy about it, unsolicitous; _fong(3) ch(a/)i(3)_ (fong3 zaai3 放債) to invest money; _fong(3) ~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng_ (fong3 saang1 放生), to let loose to live (as the Budhists do); _fong(3) (2)shau_ (fong3 sau2 放手), let go! _fong(3) tong(6)_ (fong3 dong6 放蕩) ~~willful~~ without restraint; _fong(3) (1)h(a/)u_ (fong3 haau1 放？), gone; _fong(3) tsoi(6) ~~ko(3)~~ (2)ko ch(')(u(3)_ (fong3 zoi6 go2 cyu3 放在嗰處) put it there. Fan Wan entry: 此 is very close to being 比. Williams' "to scatter": This is a rendering of Kangxi 散也, which is vague, but seems to be explaining the "presumptuous" sense (Kangxi: 妄也, 散也, 肆也捨也, 廢也). Williams' 放鬆: Or, to relax. Williams' 放債: Or, to lend money (for interest). Williams' 放生: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). Williams' 放在嗰處: Changed _ko(3)_ (go3) to modern _(2)ko_ (go2). Kangxi has the "reach" sense under the rising tone for the specific example 《孟子》放乎四海《趙岐註》放至也. However, 《正韻牋》 has the explanation 至也 under the departing tone. To banish, to exile (Kangxi: 逐也, 放逐). To issue. To reach (Kangxi: 放至也). 【放-departing】 (pjangH) (_verb-like_) to banish (_verb-like_) to let go, to let down, (_met._) to neglect (_verb-like_) to (let) loose (_verb-like_) (_met._) to reach

fong2.text: U+6609 (F1.99 昉) 始也且初明也 (Page 56 #11: (2)昉) The first light of the morning (Fan Wan: 初明也); ~~clear, bright (Kangxi: 明也);~~ to begin (Fan Wan: 始也), the commencement; _(2)fong l(e/)ung(6)_ (fong2 loeng6 昉亮) bright; _(2)fong l(e/)ung(6) p(')(a/)u(3)_ (fong2 loeng6 paau3 昉亮炮) the morning gun. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 眆 to 昉. Williams' "clear, bright": This is a faithful rendering of Kangxi 《說文》明也, but that is a rather poor definition. Just, only then (Kangxi: 適也).

fong3.text: U+6CC1 况 (F1.100 况) 矧也又譬擬又佳况 (Page 57 #5: 况(3)況(3)) More, moreover, further (Kangxi 況: 矧也); ~~now;~~ cold water (Kangxi 況: 寒水也); to come to (Kangxi 況: 臨訪曰來況); to increase (Kangxi 況: 益也), to ~~moisten~~ grow (Kangxi 況: 滋也); _(4)ho fong(3)_ (ho4 fong3 何況) how much more; _fong(3) ~~(2)k(i/)m~~ (1)k(i/)m_ (fong3 gim1 況兼), still more, as well; _fong(3) hai(6)_ (fong3 hai6 況係) it is just that. For the alternative form 况, the variation ⿰二兄 is compatibility ideograph U+2F81B. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 隹 to 佳. Williams' "now": This appears to based on Kangxi 兹也 with the example 《詩小雅》況也永歎《箋》來兹對之長歎而已. Neither the explanation nor the lesser-note make sense to me. Williams' 況兼: Corrected _(2)k(i/)m_ (gim2) to _(1)k(i/)m_ (gim1). A situation. To compare with, to liken (Kangxi: 譬也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【況】 (xjwangH) (_conjunction-like_) furthermore (_conjunction-like_) how much more (_verb-like_) to increase (_verb-like_) to compare (with)

fong2.text: U+7D21 纺 (Mainland simplified) (F1.99 紡) 紡績 (Page 56 #10: (2)紡) To spin, to twist into thread, to twine (Kangxi: 績紡, 謂紡切麻絲之屬爲纑縷也); lines, threads; _(2)fong tsik(7)_ (fong2 zik1 紡績) to spin; _(2)fong (1)sh(a/)_ (fong2 saa1 紡紗), to spin cotton yarn. 【紡】 (phjangX) (_verb-like_) to spin (_noun-like_) spun-silk
