U+8A2A 访 (Mainland simplified) fong3 (per 《廣韻》敷亮切) (F1.99 訪) 訪問謀也謁見也 (Page 56 #12: (2)訪) To inquire extensively, to search out, to inform one's self (Kangxi: 汎謀曰訪 etc., 問也); to ask advice of; to consult, to deliberate (Kangxi: 謀也, 議也); _(2)fong man(6)_ (fong2 man6 訪問) to inquire about; _(2)fong (4)n(a/)_ (fong2 naa4 訪拿), to find out and seize; _(2)fong ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (fong2 caat3 訪察) to examine into a matter officially; _(2)fong (4)k(')au_ (fong2 kau4 訪求), to inquire for carefully, to search. The reading _(2)fong_ (fong2) is not unattested; Kangxi has 又《正字通》𡚱罔切芳上聲義同. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed bottom-right component of 謁. Williams' 訪問: Now "interview". To visit (Kangxi: 及也見也, 謁見也). 【訪】 (phjangH) (_verb-like_) to inquire
U+8CBA (F1.99 貺) 賜也 (Page 57 #2: (2)貺) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed left component of 賜.

fong3.text: U+8CBA 况 況 贶 (Mainland simplified) fong2 (per Fan Wan) (F1.99 貺 _(2)Fong_ (fong2)) 賜也 (Page 57 #2: (2)貺 _(2)Fong_ (fong2); here normalised to _Fong(3)_ (fong3)) To give, to bestow (Kangxi: 賜也, 與也) (said by the recipient); _~~(2)fong~~ fong(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (fong3 ci3 貺賜) conferred; _~~(2)fong~~ fong(3) (4)(i/)_ (fong3 ji4 貺儀), a present given. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed left component of 賜. 【貺】 (xjwangH) (_verb-like_) to bestow (_noun-like_) bestowment

fong2.text: U+9AE3 (F1.99 髣) 髣髴近似也 (F1.99 彷) 同上 (F1.99 恍) 同上 (Page 56 #9: (2)彷(2)髣)

fong3.text: U+51B5 (F1.100 况) 矧也又譬擬又佳况 (Page 57 #5: 况(3)況(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 隹 to 佳.

fong4.text: U+59A8 fong1 (per 《廣韻》敷方切) (F1.96 妨 _(1)Fong_ (fong1)) 害也憚也 (Page 55 #7: (1)妨 _(1)Fong_ (fong1); here normalised to _(4)Fong_ (fong4)) An impediment, an obstacle, a hindrance (Kangxi: 一曰礙也); to injure (Kangxi: 害也); _(2)si(u/) (1)sam ~~(1)fong~~ (4)fong hoi(6)_ (siu2 sam1 fong4 hoi6 小心妨害) be careful about receiving damage, look out for yourself; _~~(1)fong~~ (4)fong ngoi(6)_ (fong4 ngoi6 妨礙) an obstacle, something which is in the way, or is dangerous; _(4)m(o\) ~~(1)fong~~ (4)fong_ (mou4 fong4 無妨), there is nothing to fear, all clear. Williams' 妨礙: Better rendered as a verb, "to obstruct". Williams' 無妨: Better rendered "there is no harm in doing so". 【妨】 (phjang) (_verb-like_) to injure, to harm

U+623F fong4-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun for "room" sense) (F1.98 房) 房屋又宿名 (Page 56 #5: (4)房) A room, a chamber, a dwelling; an office; a department of an office; one living in the same room; a sexual act; a calyx; a quiver (Kangxi: 箭室也); a bee's nest; the constellation Scorpio (Kangxi: 東南宿名); _yat(7) (1)k(a/)n (4)fong_ (jat1 gaan1 fong4-2 一間房), a room; _(4)fong uk(7)_ (fong4 uk1 房屋) a dwelling; _~~(2)sh(e/)ung~~ sh(e/)ung(6) (4)fong_ (soeng6 fong4 上房), female apartments in an office; _(4)m(u/)n (4)fong_ (mun4 fong4 門房), anteroom; _luk(9) (4)fong_ (luk6 fong4 六房), six departments of an office; _~~(1)fong, (4)t(a/)n~~ (1)t(a/)n (4)fong_ (daan1 fong4 單房) permit office at the hoppo's (粵海關); _(4)ngan (4)fong_ (ngan4 fong4 銀房), a treasury; _(5)n(i/) (1)ts(un (4)fong_ (nei5 zyun1 fong4 你尊房), which brother are you? _ts(i/)n(6) (4)fong_ (zin6 fong4 賤房), my wife; _(1)p(')(i/)n (4)fong_ (pin1 fong4 偏房), my concubine; _(4)ying (4)fong_ (jing4 fong4 營房), a camp, a barracks; _tung(6) (4)fong_ (dung6 fong4 洞房), the nuptial act. Williams' 上房: Corrected _(2)sh(e/)ung_ (soeng2) to _sh(e/)ung(6)_ (soeng6). Williams' 單房: Corrected _(1)fong (4)t(a/)n_ (fong1 daan4) to _(1)t(a/)n (4)fong_ (daan1 fong4). but it is unclear what _(4)t(a/)n_ (daan4) should be corrected to. A side-room (Kangxi: 室在旁也). Classifier for relatives, wives, or concubines. A stand for displaying sacrificial food (Kangxi: 俎名, 半體之俎足下有跗如堂房也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【房】 (bjang) (_noun-like_) side-room, room (_noun-like_) food-stand

U+9632 坊 埅 fong1 (per 《集韻》分房切 for "match" sense) (F1.98 防) 提防關防禦也滿也禁也 (Page 55 #8: (1)坊 _(1)Fong_ (fong1); here corrected to _(4)Fong_ (fong4) and normalised to 防) to guard, to impede; (Page 56 #6: (4)防) A bank, a levee, a dyke (Kangxi: 隄也); a defense (Kangxi: 鄣也, 防禦也); a screen (Kangxi: 容謂之防, 形如今牀頭小曲屛風唱射者所以自防隱也); to guard against (Kangxi: 備也), to keep off, to defend, to repress, to prohibit (Kangxi: 禁也); to provide against; _(4)fong p(i/)(6)_ (fong4 bei6 防備) to prepare for, to be ready, to be on one's guard; _(4)fong (1)k(i/)_ (fong4 gei1 防饑), to provide against dearth; _(4)fong kam(3)_ (fong4 gam3 防禁) to stop; _(4)fong (2)shau_ (fong4 sau2 防守), to protect, to defend. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). To withstand, to match (Kangxi: 防比也, 猶當也, 毛音方鄭音房). 【防】 (bjang) (_noun-like_) dyke (_verb-like_) to prevent, to guard against, (_met._) to forfend (_verb-like_) to withstand, (_met._) to match

U+9B74 鰟 鲂 (Mainland simplified) (F1.98 魴) 魚名 (Page 56 #7: (4)魴) A kind of bream, a foot long, common at Canton; the tail is red (Kangxi: 赤尾魚), or is said to turn so from ~~fear~~ toil (Kangxi: 魚勞則尾赤, 魴魚尾本不赤赤故爲勞也). 【魴】 (bjang) (_noun-like_) bream

fu1.text: U+4E4E

fu4.text: U+4E4E 虖 wu4 (per Fan Wan) (F2.11 乎) 語助詞 (Page 631 #12: 乎 _(4)(U/)_ (wu4); here normalised to _(4)F(u/)_ (fu4)) An interrogative adverb (Kangxi: 疑辭); an interjection of doubt, admiration, or inquiry, and placed at the end of sentence; after nouns, sign of the vocative (Kangxi: 呼聲); after verbs, it is a preposition, in, towards, to, with, from, up to; in respect to, as, like; a sign of the accusative; an expletive (Kangxi: 兮語之餘也); _h(a/)u(3) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (2)kwai (4)shan_ (haau3 fu4 gwai2 san4 孝乎鬼神), dutifully regard your ancestors; _(4)m(o\) (2)yan ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (5)(i/)_ (mou4 jan2 fu4 ji5 無隱乎爾), I've concealed nothing from you; _(2)ho ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (ho2 fu4 可乎), can we do it? _(2)h(i/) (2)ho tak(7) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (hei2 ho2 dak1 fu4 豈可得乎), can we possibly get it? _(4)yan (5)(un ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (1)tsoi_ (jan4 jyun5 fu4 zoi1 仁遠乎哉), can benevolence be so far gone! _pat(7) yik(9) lok(9) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (bat1 jik6 lok6 fu4 不亦樂乎), is it not even pleasant? _mok(9) (1)k(o\) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (1)t(')(i/)n_ (mok6 gou1 fu4 tin1 莫高乎天), there's nothing higher than heaven; _(4)(i/) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (2)fau ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (ji4 fu4 fau2 fu4 宜乎否乎), is it right or not? _sh(u(3) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (4)k(')(i/) (2)ho (5)(i/)_ (syu3 fu4 kei4 ho2 ji5 庶乎其可矣), then it is thus allowed; _(1)k(i/) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (gei1 fu4 幾乎), perhaps, nearly, about; _h(o\)p(9) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) ~~(2)tsz'~~ (2)ts(')z'_ (hap6 fu4 ci2 合乎此) agrees with this; _(1)ch(i/) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (2)ch(e/) (5)y(a/)_ (zi1 fu4 ze2 jaa5 之乎者也), eh! ah! oh! ugh! _met._ it ts all moonshine; _wai(6) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) ~~(5)sh(e/)ung~~ sh(e/)ung(6) (2)ch(e/)_ (wai6 fu4 soeng6 ze2 位乎上者), his place is on high; _(2)p(o\) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (4)man_ (bou2 fu4 man4 保乎民), to preserve the people; _(1)(i/) shik(9) (1)(u sh(i/)(6) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) tsuk(7)_ (ji1 sik6 jyu1 si6 fu4 zuk1 衣食於是乎足) food and raiment thereupon were plenty; _(4)y(e/)ung (4)y(e/)ung ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (joeng4 joeng4 fu4 洋洋乎), haw vast! _tsoi(6) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (zoi6 fu4 在乎), consists in; _(1)sh(u pat(7) (4)wan ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (syu1 bat1 wan4 fu4 書不云乎), is it not so written? Williams' "an expletive": In the sense of a filler, rather than an obscenity or an intensifier. Williams' 合乎此: Corrected _(2)tsz'_ (zi2) to _(2)ts(')z'_ (ci2). Williams' 之乎者也: Here, "moonshine" means nonsense. Williams' 位乎上者: Corrected _(5)sh(e/)ung_ (soeng5) to _sh(e/)ung(6)_ (soeng6). Williams' 書不云乎: Better rendered "does the Shu King not say". Eleven of Williams' examples (孝乎鬼神, 無隱乎爾, 可乎, 豈可得乎, 仁遠乎哉, 不亦樂乎, 莫高乎天, 宜乎否乎, 庶乎其可矣, 衣食於是乎足, 洋洋乎) are identical or suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.5 (_Examples of h(u/)_, 乎) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. 【乎】 (hu) (_speech-assist_) (_preposition-like_) in, upon, unto (_preposition-like_) than

fu1.text: U+4FD8 孚 (F2.8 俘) 囚也對敵被擒之人孚穀殼曰俘葢車中所獲者未也 (Page 58 #2: (1)俘) To captivate, to capture (Kangxi: 一說俘取也), to take prisoner in war; a prisoner of war (Kangxi: 囚敵曰俘); spoil taken in battle (Kangxi: 軍所獲也); _(1)f(u/) (4)ts(')au_ (fu1 cau4 俘囚), a captive; _(1)f(u/) (5)l(o\)_ (fu1 lou5 俘虜), to take captive. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 因 to 囚, and normalised 𫉬 to 獲. 【俘】 (phju) (_verb-like_) to capture (_noun-like_) captive, (_met._) spoils

fu6.text: U+5085 fu3 (per 《廣韻》方遇切 for "assistant/tutor" and surname senses) fu6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun in 師傅) (F2.17 傅) 師傅 (Page 62 #2: 傅(6)) To annex (Kangxi: 麗著也)~~, to arrange~~; ~~to receive;~~ to lay on (as paint); to superintend; a tutor; a workman; a function (Kangxi: 師傅官名...); _t(')(a/)i(3) f(u/)(6)_ (taai3 fu6 太傅) a tutor of princes (Kangxi: ...古者天子有太師太傅太保 etc.); _(1)sz' f(u/)(6)_ (si1 fu6-2 師傅) a master, a common appellation for workmen; _(5)n(i/) (2)kong tak(7) k(o\)m(3) (1)sz' f(u/)(6)_ (nei5 gong2 dak1 gam3 si1 fu6-2 你講得咁師傅) you speak very well; _(1)sz' f(u/)(6) kwat(7)_ (si1 fu6-2 gwat1 師傅骨) a very particular person; _f(u/)(6) (4)yau_ (fu6 jau4 傅油), to oil. Williams' "To annex": Better rendered "To attach". Williams' "to arrange": This is a misreading of Kangxi 同敷陳也. Here, 陳 means "to state", and the sense belongs under 敷 fu1. Williams' 師傅: Used for a third-person master of a trade (e.g. 點心師傅). To be distinguished from 師父, for one's own master, or for a religious or kung fu master. To assist, an assistant (Kangxi: 相也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). Close to (Kangxi: 近也). To reach (Kangxi: 至也, 傅猶戾也). 【傅-voiced】 (bjuH) (_verb-like_) to attach (_adjective-like_) close (to) (_verb-like_) to reach 【傅-unvoiced】 (pjuH) (_verb-like_) to assist, to tutor (_noun-like_) assistant, tutor

fu1.text: U+5233 (Page 715 #4: (1)刳) To cut open (Kangxi: 刳剖也); to rip up, to kill (Kangxi: 屠也); to hollow out (Kangxi: 空物腸也), to hew timber, to cut down; _(1)f(u/) (1)sam_ (fu1 sam1 刳心) to make a clean breast. 【刳】 (khu) (_verb-like_) to cut open (_verb-like_) to eviscerate, (_met._) to hollow out

U+547C 乎 (in 嗚呼 spelt 烏乎) 嘑 虖 謼 fu3 (per 《廣韻》荒故切 for "call" and "shout" senses spelt 謼) (F2.8 呼) 呼喚 (F2.8 嘑) 喚也又咄啐之聲 (Page 58 #6: (1)呼) To breathe out, an expiration (Kangxi: 外息也, 出息爲呼入息爲吸); to call, to invoke (Kangxi: 喚也); _(1)f(u/) ~~f(u/)n(3)~~ (u/)n(6)_ (fu1 wun6 呼喚) to bawl, to cry out; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)f(u/) (2)t(un t(')(a/)n(3)_ (coeng4 fu1 dyun2 taan3 長呼短嘆) groans and sighs; _(1)f(u/) k(')ap(7)_ (fu1 kap1 呼吸) breathing; _(1)f(u/) h(a/)m(3)_ (fu1 haam3 呼喊) to cry after; _(1)f(u/) hot(8)_ (fu1 hot3 呼喝) to scold, to order about. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 夂 to 又. Williams' 呼喚: Changed _f(u/)n(3)_ (fun3) to modern _(u/)n(6)_ (wun6). Williams' 長呼短嘆: Likely a mistake. The actual phrase is 長吁短嘆. To shout out. Used in 嗚呼 (Kangxi: 嗚呼歎辭). (_onomatopoeia_) The sound of wind. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). Used in 呼延 (a compound surname) (Kangxi: 複姓, ...姓呼延者是也). 【嗚呼】 ('u xu) (_onomatopoeia_) boo hoo, (_met._) alas 【呼】 (xu, xuH) (_verb-like_) to call (out), to shout (out) Used in 嗚呼.

U+5611 fu3 (alternative per 《集韻》荒故切) (F2.8 呼) 呼喚 (F2.8 嘑) 喚也又咄啐之聲 (Page 58 #7: (1)嘑) Same as the preceding (呼); also to hoot, to roar at (Kangxi: 唬也, 大聲), to menace; _(2)hau (1)f(u/)_ (hau2 fu1 口嘑), to bellow. Kangxi considers the departing-tone reading _f(u/)(3)_ (fu3) mandatory for the "berate" sense (in 《孟子》嘑爾而與之). To berate (Kangxi: 嘑爾咄啐之貌). 【嘑】 (xu) (_verb-like_) to shout (out)

U+592B (F2.8 夫) 男子之稱也 (Page 57 #9: (1)夫) ~~To help, one who can assist;~~ a man (Kangxi: 男子通稱), a scholar, a distinguished man; a husband (Kangxi: 男女旣配曰夫婦); a porter, a workman; a chair-bearer (Kangxi: 執御行役曰僕夫); an exalted lady; _(1)f(u/) (5)f(u/)_ (fu1 fu5 夫婦), or _(1)f(u/) (1)ts(')ai_ (fu1 cai1 夫妻), husband and wife; _(1)f(u/) (2)tsz'_ (fu1 zi2 夫子) a teacher, a compellation of high scholars (Kangxi: 先生長者曰夫子); _(1)f(u/) (4)yan_ (fu1 jan4 夫人), an officer's wife, your wife; _(1)t(a/)m (1)f(u/)_ (daam1 fu1 擔夫), a porter; _(1)f(u/) (1)kwan_ (fu1 gwan1 夫君), my husband; _(1)f(u/) (2)ch(u_ (fu1 zyu2 夫主), my dead husband; _p(')at(7) (1)f(u/)_ (pat1 fu1 匹夫), a useless lout, an unprofessional man; _t(a/)i(6) ch(e/)ung(6) (1)f(u/)_ (daai6 zoeng6 fu1 大丈夫), a great and good man. Williams' "To help, one who can assist": Possibly an attempt to render Kangxi 《詩註》夫有傅相之德而可倚仗謂之丈夫, which suggests that a 丈夫 is so-called because he can be relied upon (仗) and is assistive (傅). This should not be taken as a definition of 夫. Williams' "a distinguished man": Especially when used in the title 大夫 (Kangxi: 官名). Williams' "an exalted lady": Only in the term 夫人. More generally, any important man's wife or concubine (Kangxi: 天子有后有夫人, 妾曰如夫人). Williams' 夫子: Also *the* master, i.e. Confucius. 【夫-unvoiced】 (pju) (_noun-like_) man, -er (_noun-like_) husband Used in 夫子. 【夫佬】 (fu1 lou2) A full house (card hand). 傾夫佬 (king1 fu1 lou2): "King full house." The spelling 夫佬 is arbitrary.

fu4.text: U+592B (F2.11 夫) 發語詞 (Page 58 #16: (4)夫) An initial particle (Kangxi: 語端辭); now therefore, however; _(1)ts(e/) (4)f(u/)_ (ze1 fu4 嗟夫), alas! _(2)ch(')(e/) (4)f(u/)_ (ce2 fu4 且夫), moreover. A final particle (Kangxi: 語已辭). A demonstrative (Kangxi: 有所指之辭). 【夫-voiced】 (bju) (_speech-assist_) (_determiner-like_) this, that

fu1.text: U+5B5A (F2.8 孚) 誠信足以孚契于人 (Page 58 #1: (1)孚) accordant, mutual agreement; belief, trust, confidence (Kangxi: 一曰信也); ~~the calyx of a bud;~~ _(1)f(u/) sun(3)_ (fu1 seon3 孚信) to rely on, veritable; _(1)chung (1)f(u/)_ (zung1 fu1 忠孚), true and honest. Williams' "the calyx of a bud": This would make 孚 an alternative form of 柎. I do not believe this to be the case. 【孚】 (phju) (_noun-like_) confidence, assurance (_noun-like_) sincerity, trust
U+5B75 孚 (Page 58 #1: (1)孚; here normalised to 孵) To brood over, to hatch (Kangxi 孵: 孵化也 etc.); 【孵】 (phju) (_verb-like_) to brood, to hatch
U+6024 (F2.8 怤) 急性也思也悅也 (Page 715 #5: (1)怤) To think upon with pleasure (Kangxi: 思也, 悅也); pleased, gratified with, as a friend.
U+6276 膚 A unit of length equal to four digits (Kangxi: 鋪四指曰扶, 通作膚). Equivalent to the Ancient Egyptian or English palm. 【扶-unvoiced】 (pju) (_noun-like_) palm

fu4.text: U+6276 (F2.11 扶) 扶持引也 (Page 58 #17: (4)扶) ~~To lead a hand,~~ ~~te~~ to aid, to assist (Kangxi: 佐也一曰相也); to uphold, to protect (Kangxi: 護也); _(4)f(u/) cho(6)_ (fu4 zo6 扶助) to assist; _(4)f(u/) ~~ch(')(a/)p(9)~~ h(i/)p(8)_ (fu4 hip3 扶挾) to support one under his arms; _(4)f(u/) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (fu4 zoeng6 扶杖) leaning on a staff; _(4)f(u/) (2)shau (2)p(a/)n_ (fu4 sau2 baan2 扶手板), a board in a sedan to lean on; _(4)f(u/) ch(')an(3)_ (fu4 can3 扶櫬) to return with a coffin. Williams' "To lead a hand": This should be either "to lend a hand" (i.e. the "help" sense) or "to lead by hand" (per Fan Wan's dubious 引也). Williams' 扶挾: Corrected _ch(')(a/)p(9)_ (caap6) to _h(i/)p(8)_ (hip3). To hold onto. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【扶-voiced】 (bju) (_verb-like_) to support, to uphold

fu1.text: U+6577 傅 尃 旉 (F2.8 旉) 布列也 (F2.8 敷) 布也施也 (Page 58 #8: (1)敷) To spread out, to diffuse (Kangxi: 散也), to give; to issue ~~an order~~, to promulgate (Kangxi: 言其外布...), to announce, to show forth; to state to a superior (Kangxi: 敷陳也); _(1)f(u/) (1)sh(i/)_ (fu1 si1 敷施), to spread good instructions; _(1)f(u/) y(e/)uk(9)_ (fu1 joek6 敷藥) to apply a plaster; _~~yat(7)~~ yat(9) k(')ap(7) pat(7) (1)f(u/)_ (jat6 kap1 bat1 fu1 日給不敷), not enough for daily use; _(1)f(u/) yung(6)_ (fu1 jung6 敷用) sufficient. Williams' "to issue an order": This is a misreading of Kangxi 《書大禹謨》文命敷于四海《傳》言其外布文德敎命. In the commentary, 文德敎命 explains 文命, not 敷. Thus, "an order" should be deleted. Williams' 日給不敷: Corrected _yat(7)_ (jat1) to _yat(9)_ (jat6). In modern usage, used in 敷衍 (to do barely enough). Widely (Kangxi: ...廣...). To arrange, to divide. To apply a compress (in medicine). 熱敷 (jit6 fu1): "Hot compress." To suffice. 【敷】 (phju) (_verb-like_) to spread (widely) (_adverb-like_) widely (_verb-like_) to promulgate (_verb-like_) to arrange, to display (_verb-like_) to state
U+65C9 (F2.8 旉) 布列也 (F2.8 敷) 布也施也

U+67AF (F2.8 枯) 枯槁 (Page 58 #12: (1)枯) ~~Rotten~~ Withered wood (Kangxi: 槀木也); decayed~~, rotten, putrid~~; dry bogs (Kangxi: 山澤無水爲枯); _(1)f(u/) (2)k(o\)_ (fu1 gou2 枯槁), decayed, emaciated, cadaverous; _(1)f(u/) kwat(7)_ (fu1 gwat1 枯骨) ~~soft~~ bones of a corpse. Paralysed. Dregs (e.g. of oil, used to make oil-cake). 【枯】 (khu) (_adjective-like_) withered, (_met._) dried up, paralysed

U+67CE 跗 (F2.8 柎) 花木之萼 (Page 58 #11: (1)柎) A stem or petiole; a calyx (Kangxi: 花萼足也凡草木房謂之柎); ~~lower bar~~ the foot of a railing (Kangxi: 闌足也); ~~to wash in lye.~~ Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 萼. Williams' "to wash in lye": This is a misreading of Kangxi 注也《儀禮士冠禮》素積白屨以魁柎之《疏》以魁蛤灰注其上使色白也. In the subcommentary, 魁蛤灰 (which Williams renders "lye") explains the character 魁, not 柎. The explanation of 柎之 is 注其上 (to pour upon). Moreover, Kangxi reads 柎 as 符遇切 _f(u/)(6)_ (fu6), so it is in fact being used for 附 (to apply). The foot of any object.
U+6CED
U+6EF9 泘 (Page 715 #2: (1)滹) A river in the southwest of Chihl(i/) (直隸), the _(1)F(u/) (4)t(')o (4)ho_ (fu1 to4 ho4 滹沱河), flowing into North Lake, and thence to T(')ientsin (天津) (Kangxi: 滹沱水名 etc.).
U+739E (F2.8 砆) 碔砆石之似玉者 (F2.8 玞) 同上 (Page 715 #8: (1)玞)
U+75E1 (F2.8 痡) 病不能行也 (Page 58 #9: (1)痡)

U+7806 玞 (F2.8 砆) 碔砆石之似玉者 (F2.8 玞) 同上 (Page 57 #10: (1)砆) A stone resembling a gem (Kangxi: 同玞, 碔砆石次玉); a false gem. (Page 715 #8: (1)玞) Is the same as 砆 _(1)f(u/)_ (fu1)_;_ it is probably a veined jasper.

U+7A03 粰 (Page 715 #6: (1)粰; here normalised to 稃) (1)稃 is also the capsule or pericarp of a seed (Kangxi 稃: 稃卽米殻, 穀皮也)~~, the calyx of a flower~~. Williams' "the calyx of a flower": This is a dubious interpretation of Kangxi 《徐曰》稃卽米殻草木之華房爲柎麥之皮爲麩音義皆同. This commentary suggests that 稃 "husk", 柎 "calyx", and 麩 "bran" are cognate, but does not indicate that these are interchangeable.

U+819A 肤 (F2.8 膚) 皮也卽肌膚 (Page 58 #10: (1)膚) The skin, the epidermis (Kangxi: 皮也 etc.); the soft flesh; minced meat (Kangxi: 切肉爲膚); pork (Kangxi: 豕肉爲膚); skin-deep, superficial (Kangxi: 膚淺喩在皮膚不深也); beautiful (Kangxi: 美也), ~~large~~ great (Kangxi: 大也); to skin, to flay (Kangxi: 剝也); ~~to receive;~~ _f(a/)t(8) (1)f(u/)_ (faat3 fu1 髮膚), ~~the scalp~~ the hair and the skin; _(1)k(i/) (1)f(u/)_ (gei1 fu1 肌膚), muscle and skin, flesh; _(1)f(u/) (4)man_ (fu1 man4 膚文), superficial writing; _(1)f(u/) (2)t(')ai_ (fu1 tai2 膚體), the body. Fan Wan entry: Corrected right component of 卽 from 阝 to 卩. Williams' "to receive": This is a misreading of Kangxi 膚受, which is "skin-received" or "received at the skin". It does *not* define 膚 as "receive". 【膚】 (pju) (_noun-like_) skin (_noun-like_) cut-meat (_noun-like_) pork (_adjective-like_) comely (_adjective-like_) great
U+82FB

fu4.text: U+82FB (F2.11 苻) 草名又萑苻 (Page 58 #15: (4)苻) A plant, called devil's eye (Kangxi: 苻鬼目 etc.), from the red and round ~~seeds~~ fruit it bears (Kangxi: 莖似葛葉圓而毛子如耳璫赤色叢生江東人呼鬼目草); a species of Hoya? Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 萑. The radical of the headword is printed poorly (as ⿰十𠂉).

fu1.text: U+83A9 孚 苻 (F2.8 莩) 葭也 (Page 58 #4: (1)莩) The pellicle lining the culms of reeds (Kangxi: 莩者其筩中白皮至薄者也); ~~_met._ near to, friendly, sincere.~~ Williams' "_met._ near to, friendly, sincere": This is incorrect. The metaphor 葭莩之親 is for *thinness* of relation (Kangxi: 至薄者也), not closeness. In other words, for the *barely* related, not the closely related. Used in 莩甲 (to sprout).
U+8B3C

U+8DBA (F2.8 趺) 跏趺僧家屈足盤坐之謂 (Page 57 #11: (1)趺) To sit in audience or state, with the legs bent under one, _a la Turque_ (Kangxi: 跏趺大坐也); ~~_(1)f(u/) (1)f(u/) (4)(i/)n_ (fu1 fu1 jin4 趺趺然),~~ a woman bending to the ground in obeisance (Kangxi: 拜于丈夫爲趺). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𧦤 to 跏, and corrected 曾 to 僧. Williams' 趺趺然: This is a misparsing of Kangxi 《釋名》拜于丈夫爲趺趺然屈折下視地也. This should be punctuated as "拜于丈夫爲趺、趺然屈折下視地也。", with a pause separating 爲趺 from 趺然.

U+8DD7 趺 fu6 (per 《廣韻》符遇切 for name sense and 《集韻》符遇切 for "instep" sense) (Page 715 #13: 跗(6) _F(u/)(6)_ (fu6); here normalised to _(1)F(u/)_ (fu1)) The instep of the foot, where sandals are tied (Kangxi: 足上也 etc.); _~~f(u/)(6)~~ (1)f(u/) ch(u(3)_ (fu1 zyu3 跗注) stocking overalls used by soldiers (Kangxi: 跗注戎服若袴而屬于跗與袴連). Used in personal names (Kangxi: 人名). 【跗】 (pju) (_noun-like_) instep
U+90DB (F2.8 郛) 郭也 (Page 715 #3: (1)郛) The outermost wall beyond the citadel (Kangxi: 城外大郭也); the suburbs, the purlieus of a city. 【郛】 (phju) (_noun-like_) outer-wall
U+9207 𫓧 (Mainland simplified) (F2.8 鈇) 斧鉞之屬也 (Page 57 #12: (1)鈇) A grass cutter (Kangxi: 莝斫刀). 【鈇-cutter】 (pju) (_noun-like_) cutter, chopper

fu2.text: U+9207 𫓧 (Mainland simplified) fu1 (per 《廣韻》甫無切) (F2.8 鈇 _(1)F(u/)_ (fu1)) 斧鉞之屬也 (Page 57 #12: (1)鈇 _(1)F(u/)_ (fu1); here normalised to _(2)F(u/)_ (fu2)) A kind of hatchet of small ax (Kangxi: 斧也, 鈇方于反又音斧). 【鈇-axe】 (pju, pjuX) (_noun-like_) axe, hatchet

fu1.text: U+9AB7 (Page 715 #1: (1)骷) The shoulder-blade, the ~~thigh bone~~ knee-cap or lumbar vertebrae (Kangxi: 骷髆䯊也); a skeleton; _(1)f(u/) (4)l(o\) (4)t(')au_ (fu1 lou4 tau4 骷髏頭), the skull of a dead man.
U+9EA9 粰 麸 麬 麱 䴸 (F2.9 麱) 蔴麱 (Page 57 #13: (1)麩) Bran or husk of wheat (Kangxi: 小麥屑皮也一作麱); the refuse of hemp-seed or ground nut, after the oil is expressed. (Page 715 #6: (1)粰) is the same as (1)麩;
U+9EB1 (F2.9 麱) 蔴麱

fu2.text: U+4FDB (F2.13 俯) 俯仰低頭也 (F2.13 頫) 低頭也又音跳 (F2.13 俛) 同上又音免 (Page 715 #11: (2)俛) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 底 to 低.

U+4FEF 俛 府 頫 (F2.13 俯) 俯仰低頭也 (F2.13 頫) 低頭也又音跳 (F2.13 俛) 同上又音免 (Page 59 #10: (2)俯) To stoop the head (Kangxi: 俛也), to bow; to consider, to look down on, to condescend; ~~unequal;~~ _(2)f(u/) fuk(9)_ (fu2 fuk6 俯伏) to fall prostrate; _(2)f(u/) (2)chun (1)sh(i/) (4)hang_ (fu2 zeon2 si1 hang4 俯准施行), condescend to grant this to be done; _(2)f(u/) (5)y(e/)ung_ (fu2 joeng5 俯仰), to look down and up~~, all ranks~~. (Page 715 #11: (2)俛; here normalised to 俯) Interchanged with 頫 ~~_t(')i(u/)(3)_ (tiu3)~~ in the senses of hanging down the head (Kangxi 俛: 同俯頫 etc.); to look down; to condescend, to examine into. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 底 to 低. Williams' 俯仰: Metaphorically, in an instant. Williams' _t(')i(u/)(3)_ (tiu3): This is a misreading of Fan Wan 又音跳 under 頫, which is a cross-reference to a reading with a different meaning, rather than an alternative reading for the sense given. 【俯】 (pjuX) (_verb-like_) to bow the head (_verb-like_) to stoop

U+5E9C (F2.13 府) 府縣官府又藏也聚也藏貨財曰府 (Page 59 #9: (2)府) A store-house, a record office, a library (Kangxi: 文書藏也), a treasury (Kangxi: 府謂寶藏財賄之處也); the officer over them (Kangxi: 掌財幣之官皆曰府); a house; a thesaurus; a department (Kangxi: 府官府公卿牧守道德之所聚也) or prefecture (Kangxi: 唐制爲大州曰府); _(2)f(u/) f(u/)(3)_ (fu2 fu3 府庫) a treasury; _(2)f(u/) (5)wan_ (fu2 wan5 府尹), the mayor of Peking (北京); _kwai(3) (2)f(u/)_ (gwai3 fu2 貴府), or _(2)f(u/) sh(e/)ung(6)_ (fu2 soeng6 府上) or _(1)ts(un (2)f(u/)_ (zyun1 fu2 尊府), your house; _(2)f(u/) (1)ts(un_ (fu2 zyun1 府尊) his honor, the prefect; _(2)f(u/) tai(6)_ (fu2 dai6 府第) a high officer's court; _luk(9) (2)f(u/)_ (luk6 fu2 六府), the six elements (Kangxi: 水火木金土五材兼以穀爲六府). To accumulate (Kangxi: 府聚也). 【府】 (pjuX) (_noun-like_) treasury, depository (_verb-like_) to accumulate (_noun-like_) government-office

U+62CA 撫 (F2.13 撫) 安慰也又擊也 (F2.13 拊) 循也詩拊我畜我防其驚惧拊循之也又拊而勉之又擊也拍也 (Page 59 #11: (2)撫; here normalised to 拊) (...), to pat (Kangxi 撫: 拍也); (Page 59 #12: (2)拊) To pat, (...), to strike, to beat (Kangxi: 擊也拍也, 重擊曰擊輕擊曰拊); ~~to permit;~~ _(2)f(u/) (1)ying_ (fu2 jing1 拊膺), to ~~lay the hand on~~ beat the breast. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 擊 (under 撫), corrected malformed 驚, and fixed missing horizontal stroke in 惧. A handle (Kangxi: 器把曰拊手執處也 etc.). A type of percussion instrument, similar to a drum (Kangxi: 樂器名, 拊形如鼓). 【拊】 (phjuX) (_verb-like_) to beat (gently) (_noun-like_) beating-drum (_noun-like_) handle

U+64AB 拊 抚 (Mainland simplified) (F2.13 撫) 安慰也又擊也 (F2.13 拊) 循也詩拊我畜我防其驚惧拊循之也又拊而勉之又擊也拍也 (Page 59 #11: (2)撫) To keep down with the hand~~, to fold the hands~~; to stroke, (...); to soothe, to tranquillize (Kangxi: 安也, 慰勉也); to manage; to cherish, to bear; to cheer up; to play a lute; _(2)f(u/) k(i/)m(3)_ (fu2 gim3 撫劍) to seize a sword; _(2)f(u/) (4)t(')oi_ (fu2 toi4 撫臺), or _(2)f(u/) (un(6)_ (fu2 jyun6 撫院) the governor of a province; _(2)f(u/) (5)y(e/)ung_ (fu2 joeng5 撫養), to rear a child, to supply wants. (Page 59 #12: (2)拊) (...), to put the hand on, (...); to quiet; Used for the preceding (撫) (Kangxi 拊: 揗也, 通作撫). Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 擊 (under 撫), corrected malformed 驚, and fixed missing horizontal stroke in 惧. Williams' 撫臺, 撫院: Synonymous with 巡撫. Williams' 撫養: Especially to foster. To hold (Kangxi: 持也). To press or hold still (Kangxi: 以手按止之也). To conform (Kangxi: 一曰循也). 【撫】 (phjuX) (_verb-like_) to lay hand upon, to hold (_verb-like_) to soothe, to comfort, to pacify, (_met._) to stabilise (_verb-like_) to conform

U+65A7 鈇 (F2.13 斧) 斧鉞 (Page 59 #7: (2)斧) An ax, a hatchet (Kangxi: 斫也 etc.); to cut, to hack, to fell (Kangxi: 凡以斧斫物亦曰斧); _(2)f(u/) (4)t(')au_ (fu2 tau4-2 斧頭), an ax; _(2)t(a/) (2)f(u/) (4)t(')au_ (daa2 fu2 tau4 打斧頭), to deceive in buying for one; _(2)f(u/) s(e/)uk(8)_ (fu2 soek3 斧削) to pare off, to correct a theme; _(2)f(u/) (ut(9)_ (fu2 jyut6 斧鉞) hatchets and halberds, carried in processions. Fan Wan entry: Corrected illegible character to 鉞. Williams' 斧鉞: Inferred incompletely printed letter _t_ in _(ut(9)_. 【斧】 (pjuX) (_noun-like_) axe, hatchet 【打斧頭】 (daa2 fu2 tau4) To pocket a portion of money deceitfully when transacting on behalf of another. 【斧頭邊】 (fu2 tau4-2 bin1) The character component 阝, especially on the left. (Literally, "axe beside".)
U+7236 Used in 田父 etc. (for old men in outdoor(?) occupations) (Kangxi: 野老通稱). 【父-unvoiced】 (pjuX) (_suffix_) (_noun-like_) old-man

fu6.text: U+7236 fu6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun in 師父, 舅父) (F2.17 父) 父母 (Page 61 #1: 父(6)) A father (Kangxi: 矩也家長率敎者 etc.); a senior, an ancestor, an old man (Kangxi: 老叟之稱); a title applied to peasants and aged people; to rule, to act as a father; _f(u/)(6) (1)ts(')an_ (fu6 can1 父親), a father; _f(u/)(6) (5)l(o\)_ (fu6 lou5 父老), a village or neighborhood elder; _(1)shang f(u/)(6)_ (sang1 fu6 生父) own father; _f(u/)(6) (5)m(o\) (1)k(u/)n_ (fu6 mou5 gun1 父母官), the local or district magistrate; _f(u/)(6) (1)hing (1)ch(i/) p(u/)i(3)_ (fu6 hing1 zi1 bui3 父兄之輩) superiors generally; _(1)k(a/) f(u/)(6)_ (gaa1 fu6 家父) my father; _f(u/)(6) (5)m(o\)_ (fu6 mou5 父母), parents; _(1)s(i/)n f(u/)(6)_ (sin1 fu6 先父) my late father; _f(u/)(6) (4)wong_ (fu6 wong4 父皇), my imperial father. Williams' 生父: A biological father, as opposed to e.g. an adoptive father. Elder noblemen or officials of the same surname (Kangxi: 天子謂同姓諸侯諸侯謂同姓大夫皆曰諸父). The 88th radical (U+2F57 ⽗ "father"). 【父-voiced】 (bjuX) (_noun-like_) father

fu2.text: U+7425 虎 (F2.13 琥) 琥珀 (Page 60 #2: (2)琥) A signet, made of veined stone ~~like a tiger's skin~~ depicting a tiger (Kangxi: 發兵瑞玉爲虎文); _(2)f(u/) (4)f(u/)_ (fu2 fu4 琥符), warrant or seal, ~~sent when soldiers were levied~~ for sending forth soldiers; _(2)f(u/) ~~p(a/)k(9)~~ p(')(a/)k(8)_ (fu2 paak3 琥珀) amber (Kangxi: 琥珀松脂入地所化). Williams' 琥珀: Corrected _p(a/)k(9)_ (baak6) to _p(')(a/)k(8)_ (paak3). A jade item in the shape of a tiger (Kangxi: 玉器). 【琥】 (xuX) (_noun-like_) tiger-jewel

U+752B 父 (for honorific suffix sense) pou2 (common) (F2.13 甫) 大也始也我也衆也美也又男子美稱也 (Page 59 #3: (2)甫) Large; beautiful, good; numerous (Kangxi: 衆也, 甫甫衆也); great (Kangxi: 甫大也), eminent; to begin (Kangxi: 始也); I, myself (Kangxi: 甫我也); a term of respect when addressing one (Kangxi: 男子美稱也); _(4)t(')oi (2)f(u/) (4)ho ~~(4)meng~~ (4)ming_ (toi4 fu2 ho4 ming4 臺甫何名), what is your name, Sir? Williams' "a term of respect": Explicitly, a suffix attached to a name or style. Williams' 臺甫何名: Corrected _(4)meng_ (meng4-2) to _(4)ming_ (ming4). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). Used in 皇甫 (a compound surname) (Kangxi: 皇甫複姓). 【甫】 (pjuX) (_suffix_) (_adjective-like_) great (_verb-like_) to begin

U+7C20 fu1 (per 《廣韻》甫無切) fu3 (per 《廣韻》芳遇切) (F2.13 簠) 簠簋宗廟盛黍稷之器 (Page 59 #4: (2)簠) A sort of basket, square outside and round within, used to contain grain (Kangxi: 外方內圓曰簠用貯稻粱容一斗二升) when worshiping ancestors, called _(2)f(u/) (2)kwai_ (fu2 gwai2 簠簋) (Kangxi: 簠簋祭器, 周曰簠簋宗廟盛黍稷之器). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword from ⿱𥫗⿳一田血 to 簠. 【簠】 (pju, pjuX, phjuH) (_noun-like_) square-vessel

U+812F pou2 (vernacular) (F2.13 脯) 腊肉也 (Page 59 #5: (2)脯) Preserved or dried meat (Kangxi: 肉乾也, 脯腊也, 乾脯, 乾肉爲脯); ~~flesh;~~ _~~(2)sau~~ (1)sau (2)f(u/)_ (sau1 fu2 脩脯), slices of dried meat formerly sent to a teacher, teacher's wages. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 蒲 to 脯. Williams' 脩脯: Corrected _(2)sau_ (sau2) to _(1)sau_ (sau1). Candied fruit. 【脯】 (pjuX) (_noun-like_) dried-meat

U+8151 府 (F2.13 腑) 腑肺 (Page 59 #13: (2)腑) The inferior viscera (Kangxi: 臟腑, 本作府); _luk(9) (2)f(u/)_ (luk6 fu2 六腑), the stomach, gall, bladder, larger and smaller intestines, and secreting passages (Kangxi: ...膽胃大小腸膀胱三焦六府皆爲陽 etc.); _fai(3) (2)f(u/)_ (fai3 fu2 肺腑), the lungs and viscera. ~~A retired place.~~ Williams' 肺腑: Metaphorically, a confidant. Williams' "A retired place": This is perhaps an attempt at capturing the metaphorical sense of 肺腑 similar to "bottom of one's heart". 【腑】 (pjuX) (_noun-like_) secreting-organ

U+82E6 fu3 (per Kangxi 苦故切 in 苦船, 苦車) (F2.13 苦) 辛苦 (Page 59 #14: (2)苦) A marshy plant, which becomes sweet when frozen (Kangxi: 苦苦菜也陸璣云生田及山澤中得霜甜脃而美); bitter (Kangxi: 味也), unpleasant; troublesome, painful, painstaking; urgent, pressing (Kangxi: 急也), afflicted, ~~distressing~~ distressed (Kangxi: 患也); to dislike, distasteful, to mortify; _(2)h(o\) (2)f(u/)_ (hou2 fu2 好苦), very bitter; _(4)ho (2)f(u/)_ (ho4 fu2 何苦), how troublesome! _(2)f(u/) l(a/)t(9)_ (fu2 laat6 苦辣) bitter and acrid; _(2)f(u/) meng(6)_ (fu2 meng6 苦命) a hard lot; _(2)f(u/) ch(i/)(3)_ (fu2 zi3 苦志) decided, in earnest; _(2)f(u/) (4)sh(un_ (fu2 syun4 苦船), to dislike sailing; _(2)f(u/) (2)hau (4)l(e/)ung y(e/)uk(9)_ (fu2 hau2 loeng4 joek6 苦口良藥) bitter to the taste but wholesome physic, ungracious advice; _(2)f(u/) (1)kw(a/)_ (fu2 gwaa1 苦瓜), ~~egg-plant~~ bitter-melon; _(2)f(u/) (2)ch(')o_ (fu2 co2 苦楚), extreme grief; _(2)f(u/) l(a/)t(9) ts(')oi(3)_ (fu2 laat6 coi3 苦辣菜) a species of Eruca. Williams' 何苦: In the sense of "why trouble oneself to do that". Williams' 苦船: Or, to be seasick. To make endure (Kangxi: 勤也). 【苦】 (khuX) (_noun-like_) bitter-plant (_adjective-like_) bitter (_noun-like_) bitterness, suffering (_verb-like_) to (make) suffer

U+864E 乕 (F2.13 虎) 虎狼猛獸也 (Page 60 #1: (2)虎) A tiger, the king of beasts (Kangxi: 惡獸也, 山獸之君); brave, fierce; awful, violent; _(5)l(o\) (2)f(u/)_ (lou5 fu2 老虎), a tiger; _(2)f(u/) ts(e/)ung(3)_ (fu2 zoeng3 虎將) a valiant soldier; _(2)f(u/) ching(3)_ (fu2 zing3 虎政) a cruel sway; _~~p(a/)t(9)~~ pat(9) (2)f(u/) (1)s(o\)_ (bat6 fu2 sou1 拔虎鬚), 'to seize the tiger's whiskers,' courageous; _(2)F(u/) (4)m(u/)n_ (fu2 mun4 虎門), the Bogue; _(2)f(u/) (4)ying_ (fu2 jing4 虎型), ferocious; _(2)f(u/) k(a/)m(3)_ (fu2 gaam3 虎監) a graduate who lords it over people; _(2)f(u/) sh(i/)(6)_ (fu2 si6 虎視) to glare at, fierce. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 狼 and 獸. Williams' 拔虎鬚: Changed _p(a/)t(9)_ (baat6) to modern _pat(9)_ (bat6). Also 捋虎鬚, to *stroke* the tiger's whiskers. Williams' 虎門: The _Bocca Tigris_, from the Portuguese _Boca do Tigre_. Williams' 虎視: As in 虎視眈眈. 【虎】 (xuX) (_noun-like_) tiger

U+91DC 釡 鬴 fu6 (per 《廣韻》扶雨切) (F2.13 釜) 鑊也又斗屬 (Page 59 #8: (2)釜) A boiler or caldron without feet (Kangxi: 鬴或作𨥏俗省作釜, 有足曰錡無足曰釜); _(2)f(u/) tsang(3)_ (fu2 zang3 釜甑) a boiler and vat; an old measure about equal to a kilderkin (Kangxi: 量名, 豆區釜鍾四升爲豆各自其四以登于釜釜十則鍾, 釜六斗四升鍾六斛四斗). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𳆢 to 鑊. Williams' "kilderkin": This is about 80 litres, which is consistent with 釜六斗四升 in the order of 64 litres. 【釜】 (bjuX) (_noun-like_) boiler

U+9EFC (F2.13 黼) 黼黻黼白黑相次之紋 (Page 59 #6: (2)黼) Black and white, diversified, in embroidery (Kangxi: 白與黑相次文 etc.); embroidered, elegant dress; _(2)f(u/) fat(7)_ (fu2 fat1 黼黻) dresses anciently used an sacrifices, with black and white lines or embroidery resembling axes (Kangxi: 斧謂之黼); fine composition. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 黻, fixed missing character 白, corrected 茨 to 次, and corrected 𮈄 to 紋. Williams' "axes": This the plural of "axe" (not "axis"). 【黼】 (pjuX) (_noun-like_) embroidered-axe

fu6.text: U+4ED8 仅 fu3 (per 《廣韻》方遇切) (F2.17 付) 畀也授也又分付 (Page 62 #3: 付(6)) To give, to deliver, to hand over (Kangxi: 𢌿也授也); _f(u/)(6) k(i/)(3)_ (fu6 gei3 付寄) to send by one; _f(u/)(6) (4)loi_ (fu6 loi4 付來), to send back to; _f(u/)(6) t(')ok(8)_ (fu6 tok3 付託) to charge one with; _f(u/)(6) (1)k(a/)u_ (fu6 gaau1 付交), to deliver to. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𢌿 to 畀. Williams' 付託: Better rendered "to entrust one with". To pay. 【付】 (pjuH) (_verb-like_) to give

fu3.text: U+526F 褔 (for classifier(?) sense) (F2.16 副) 佐也貳也稱也又后夫人祭服之首飾 (Page 60 #5: 副(3)) To assist, to aid, to second; ~~to investigate (Kangxi: 審也);~~ an assistant (Kangxi: 貳也, 佐也), a substitute, a lieutenant, a vice, a deputy (Kangxi: 副者次長之稱); a classifier of suits of clothes, or sets of things, as beads, tools, plates, &c.; an ancient head-dress (Kangxi: 后夫人首飾, 首飾也編髮爲之); _f(u/)(3) (1)sz'_ (fu3 si1 副司) second commissioner; _f(u/)(3) ts(e/)ung(3)_ (fu3 zoeng3 副將) a colonel; _f(u/)(3) (4)y(e/)_ (fu3 je4 副爺), a compellation of low military officers; _yat(7) f(u/)(3) (1)sam (1)k(i/)_ (jat1 fu3 sam1 gei1 一副心機), disposition, temperament; _yat(7) f(u/)(3) (1)t(')(i/)n (1)ts(')ung_ (jat1 fu3 tin1 cung1 一副天聰) naturally clever; _(4)ts(')(un f(u/)(3) chap(7) sz'(6)_ (cyun4 fu3 zap1 si6 全副執事) a complete procession; _f(u/)(3) (2)pong_ (fu3 bong2 副榜), an under _(k(ujin)_ (舉人) graduate. Fan Wan entry: Fixed position of dot in 貳. The same irregular dot placement in 貳 is found in Kangxi. Williams' "to investigate": This is a faithful rendering of Kangxi 審也, but that sense is perhaps more reasonable under the entering tone. The commentary (副者次長之稱審猶察也) is of little help here. To match. 【副-departing】 (phjuwH) (_adjective-like_) subsidiary, (_met._) matched (_noun-like_) headdress
U+5490 付 fu6 (per Fan Wan for 付) (F2.17 付 _F(u/)(6)_ (fu6)) 畀也授也又分付 Used in 吩咐, 囑咐 (to bid, to direct, to give instructions).

U+5BCC 冨 (F2.16 富) 豐於財也 (Page 60 #4: 富(3)) Rich, affluent (Kangxi: 備也一曰厚也, 豐於財也), abundant (Kangxi: 凡充裕皆曰富); to provide, to enrich; the rich; wealth (Kangxi: 貨賄也); _f(u/)(3) kwai(3)_ (fu3 gwai3 富貴) rich, noble; _f(u/)(3) ~~hau(6)~~ (5)hau_ (fu3 hau5 富厚) rich; _f(u/)(3) (1)yung_ (fu3 jung1 富翁), a rich old fellow; _(4)n(i/)n f(u/)(3)_ (nin4 fu3 年富) young, lusty (Kangxi: 年富謂年幼後來齒歷方久也); _hok(9) f(u/)(3) ~~(1)ch(e/)~~ (5)'ng (1)k(u_ (hok6 fu3 ng5 geoi1 學富五車) universally learned; _f(u/)(3) tsuk(7)_ (fu3 zuk1 富足) rich enough. (Page 715 #12: 富(3)) The phrase _hok(9) f(u/)(3) (1)ch(e/)_ (hok6 fu3 ze1) should be _hok(9) f(u/)(3) (5)'ng ~~(1)ch(')(e/)~~ (1)k(u_ (hok6 fu3 ng5 geoi1 學富五車). Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 豐. Williams' 富厚: Normalised _hau(6)_ (hau6) to _(5)hau_ (hau5). Williams' 學富: Removed extraneous _(1)ch(e/)_ (ze1). Williams' 學富五車 (Page 715): Corrected _(1)ch(')(e/)_ (ce1) to _(1)k(u_ (geoi1). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【富】 (pjuwH) (_adjective-like_) wealthy (_verb-like_) to wealthen

U+5EAB 库 (Mainland simplified) (F2.16 庫) 貯財之府 (Page 60 #7: 庫(3)) A carriage-house; an armory, an arsenal (Kangxi: 兵車藏也); a storehouse (Kangxi: 庫舍也物所在之舍也故齊魯謂庫曰舍); a treasury, a magazine; a lexicon; _(4)ngan f(u/)(3)_ (ngan4 fu3 銀庫) a treasury; _(2)t(')(o\) f(u/)(3)_ (tou2 fu3 土庫) a go-down; _f(u/)(3) hong(6)_ (fu3 hong6 庫？) treasury stores. 【庫】 (khuH) (_noun-like_) arsenal, (_met._) storehouse

U+623D fu2 (alternative per 《廣韻》呼古切 for noun sense) wu6 (per 《廣韻》侯古切 for verb sense) (F2.16 戽) 戽水之斗 (Page 60 #9: 戽(3)) To bale out water (Kangxi: 抒也); a baling vessel (Kangxi: 戽斗舟中渫水器也); _f(u/)(3) (2)shui_ (fu3 seoi2 戽水), to bale water; _f(u/)(3) (2)tau_ (fu3 dau2 戽斗), a water ladle; _f(u/)(3) (4)(u_ (fu3 jyu4-2 戽魚), to take fish by baling the water.

U+8932 絝 袴 裤 (Mainland simplified) (F2.16 褲) 下衣 (Page 60 #8: 褲(3)袴(3)) A covering for the legs, trowsers (Kangxi 袴: 脛衣也); _(4)ngau (4)t(')au ~~fu(3)~~ f(u/)(3)_ (ngau4 tau4 fu3 牛頭褲) breeches; _t(')(o\)(3) f(u/)(3)_ (tou3 fu3 套褲) overalls, leggings; _noi(6) f(u/)(3)_ (noi6 fu3 內褲) drawers; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung f(u/)(3)_ (coeng4 fu3 長褲) pantaloons; _yat(7) (4)t(')i(u/) f(u/)(3)_ (jat1 tiu4 fu3 一條褲) a pair of trowsers. Williams' 內褲: The preferred term for "underpants" in Cantonese is 底褲. 【袴】 (khuH) (_noun-like_) trousers

U+8CE6 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+7) or 4 strokes (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. 䝾 赋 (Mainland simplified) (F2.16 賦) 稅也役也又詞賦 (Page 60 #6: 賦(3)) To exact, to levy, to collect, to require (Kangxi: 責取也, 斂也); taxes of money ~~or~~ for the military ~~arms~~; ~~tribute from fiefs;~~ to express clearly (Kangxi: 鋪陳也, 賦之言鋪直鋪陳今之政敎善惡); to give (Kangxi: 給與也); to receive (Kangxi: 稟受也); to place in order; ~~a metre of 4 and 6 feet in the lines~~ rhyming prose; _f(u/)(3) shui(3)_ (fu3 seoi3 賦稅) imposts; _f(u/)(3) (5)l(i/)m_ (fu3 lim5 賦斂), to levy taxes; _f(u/)(3) yik(9)_ (fu3 jik6 賦役) to levy troops; _f(u/)(3) n(a/)p(9)_ (fu3 naap6 賦納) ~~_t_o~~ to send up taxes. Williams' "tribute from fiefs": This is a misreading of Kangxi 貢士曰賦. Here, 貢士 is a scholar sent (as a tribute of sorts) from a vassal-state. The example is 《前漢鼂錯傳》廼以臣錯充賦, and the commentary indicates that 賦 is being used in a self-deprecating sense, metaphorically comparing one's appointment to the fulfilment of a tax shortfall, "Ye have only taken me the Minister Ts(')ok to fill the required amount." To spread, to distribute (Kangxi: 布也). 【賦】 (pjuH) (_verb-like_) to tax (_verb-like_) to give, to spread, to distribute (_noun-like_) rhyming-prose

fu4.text: U+7B26 (F2.11 符) 合也劵也又符節 (Page 58 #14: (4)符) A tally made of two slips (Kangxi: 符信也...分而相合, 符符節也分爲兩邊各持一以爲信); a seal on two pieces; to correspond to, to testify, to verify (Kangxi: 驗也), to agree with (Kangxi: 合也), to evidence (Kangxi: 證也); a spell or charm written for preventing evil, for a cure, &c.; _(4)f(u/) h(o\)p(9)_ (fu4 hap6 符合) agreeing; _(4)t(')(o\) (4)f(u/)_ (tou4 fu4 桃符), a peach-leaf charm; _(4)f(u/) luk(9)_ (fu4 luk6 符籙) a written charm (Kangxi: 符籙); _(4)f(u/) ts(i/)t(8)_ (fu4 zit3 符節) a warrant or commission given to an officer (Kangxi: 符節者如今諸官詔符也); _(4)f(u/) sui(6)_ (fu4 seoi6 符瑞) favorable, genial influences. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱𠆢口 to 合. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). A symbol. 【符】 (bju) (_noun-like_) corroborative-tally (_adjective-like_) corroborative (_noun-like_) talisman

U+8299 (Page 715 #9: (4)芙) A flower; _(4)f(u/) (4)yung (1)f(a/)_ (fu4 jung4 faa1 芙蓉花), the _Hibiscus mutabilis;_ _(1)o (4)f(u/) (4)yung_ (o1 fu4 jung4 阿芙蓉), the poppy. Williams' 阿芙蓉: Or, opium. The lotus (Kangxi: 芙蓉也, 荷芙蕖). 芙蓉蛋 (fu4 jung4 daan6-2): "Egg foo yung" (the omelette dish). 【芙】 (bju) Used in 芙蓉. 【芙蓉】 (bju yowng) (_noun-like_) lotus

U+86A8 (F2.11 蚨) 靑蚨蟲名 (Page 59 #1: (4)蚨) A species of cicada or dytiscus, called _(1)ts(')ing (4)f(u/)_ (cing1 fu4 青蚨), supposed to be able to recover its stolen young, and cause cash rubbed with its eggs to return to their owner (Kangxi: 靑蚨水蟲可還錢 etc.).
U+98AB (F2.11 颫) 大風也 (Page 715 #10: (4)颫) A gust of wind; the wind blowing downwards (Kangxi: 風自上下謂之颫颻); _(4)f(u/) (1)fung_ (fu4 fung1 颫風) a storm (Kangxi: 颫風大風).

U+9CE7 鳬 凫 (Mainland simplified) (F2.11 鳬) 鴨也 (Page 59 #2: (4)鳬; here normalised to 鳧) A sheldrake or mallard (Kangxi 鳧: 野曰鳧家曰鴨); a wild duck with a crest; a small but abundant species near the Y(a/)ngtsz' R. (揚子江) (Kangxi 鳧: 江東有小鳧其多無數) is called ~~_(1)k(u/)n (4)f(u/)_ (gun1 fu4 冠鳧), the crowned duck (Kangxi 鳧: 俗謂之冠鳧)~~ _k(')au(3) (4)f(u/)_ (kau3 fu4 寇鳧). Williams' "the crowned duck": Here, Williams has been misled by Kangxi's quote of 《揚子方言郭註》, in which 冠鳧 is a typo for 寇鳧. The original text of 《揚子方言》 (to which the commentary applies) is 凡物盛多謂之寇, and the original commentary has 寇 instead of 冠. 【鳧】 (bju) (_noun-like_) mallard

fu5.text: U+5A66 媍 妇 (Mainland simplified) pou5 (vernacular in 新婦, 姪婦) (F2.15 婦) 女人之稱又妻也 (F2.15 媍) 同上 (Page 60 #3: (5)婦) A wife, a married woman, a female under subjection (Kangxi: 服也, ...又女子已嫁曰婦婦之言服也服事於夫也); a lady; ~~fcmale~~ female (Kangxi: 物類之隂者亦曰婦); beautiful (Kangxi: 好貌); _(5)f(u/) (4)yan_ (fu5 jan4 婦人), a woman; _~~ts(')(u(3)~~ (2)ts(')(u (1)san (5)f(u/)_ (ceoi2 san1 fu5 娶新婦), to take a ~~wife~~ daughter-in-law; _(5)f(u/) (5)n(u_ (fu5 neoi5 婦女), women; _(2)ch(')au (5)f(u/)_ (cau2 fu5 醜婦), a hag; _(5)f(u/) t(o\)(6) (1)ch(i/) (1)k(a/)_ (fu5 dou6 zi1 gaa1 婦道之家), a woman's place, female propriety; _~~meng(6)~~ ming(6) (5)f(u/)_ (ming6 fu5 命婦), an officer's lady. Williams' "under subjection": Or "in servitude". Williams' 娶新婦: Changed _ts(')(u(3)_ (ceoi3) to common reading _(2)ts(')(u_ (ceoi2). Williams' 命婦: Corrected _meng(6)_ (meng6) to _ming(6)_ (ming6). A daughter-in-law (Kangxi: 子之妻爲婦...). 【婦】 (bjuwX) (_noun-like_) woman Used in 婦人. 【婦人】 (bjuwX nyin) (_noun-like_) woman 【新婦】 (san1 pou5) A daughter-in-law. 娶新婦未 (ceoi2 san1 pou5 mei6): "Have you taken a daughter-in-law yet?" (i.e. has your son taken a wife yet?). Also see 姪婦.

fu6.text: U+4EC6 baak6 (per 《廣韻》蒲北切) fau3 (per 《廣韻》敷救切) fu3 (per 《廣韻》芳遇切 and 敷救切) pau3 (per 《廣韻》匹候切) puk1 (per 《集韻》普木切) (F2.17 仆) 偃也僵也臥也 (Page 61 #8: 仆(6)) To fall down prostrate (Kangxi: 偃也僵也); to fall to the earth; ~~overthrown;~~ _~~(5)t(o\)~~ (2)t(o\) f(u/)(6)_ (dou2 fu6 倒仆) fallen down. Williams' 倒仆: Corrected _(5)t(o\)_ (dou5) to _(2)t(o\)_ (dou2). See 仆 puk1 for the reading that is perceived to be vernacular. 【仆】 (phjuH, phjuwH, phuwH, bok) (_verb-like_) to fall prostrate

puk1.text: U+4EC6 pok3 (per Williams) (Page 726 #7: 仆(8) _P(')ok(8)_ (pok3); here normalised to _P(')uk(7)_ (puk1)) This is more often pronounced _~~p(')ok(8)~~ p(')uk(7)_ (puk1) than _f(u/)(6)_ (fu6), as given on page 61; _(1)t(i/)n ~~p(')ok(8)~~ p(')uk(7)~~_ (din1 puk1 顛仆) slipped down; _(1)k(e/)ung ~~p(')ok(8)~~ p(')uk(7)_ (goeng1 puk1 僵仆) fell down stiff, as if dead. The reading _p(')uk(7)_ (puk1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 普木切, explained 僵也, as an alternative reading of the classical word 仆, to fall prostrate (for which see 仆 fu6). Williams' reading _p(')ok(8)_ (pok3) is now obsolete, but is interesting to note, as it is an alternative expected reading from 《集韻》普木切. The use of 仆 _p(')uk(7)_ (puk1) in 仆街 (see below) leads to the perception that the reading is vernacular, even vulgar. To fall prostrate. 仆咗喺度 (puk1 zo2 hai2 dou6): "He's fallen forwards." 【仆街】 (puk1 gaai1) To fall prostrate in the street. Informally spelt PK. 仆你個街 (puk1 nei5 go3 gaai1): "May you fall forward in the street." Can be used as an optative, an interjection, an adjective, and a noun, varying in meaning from the literal "fall prostrate" to the metaphorical "keel over" or "die" (or one who deserves to do so). For these, see the Wiktionary entry for 仆街. 【仆直】 (puk1 zik6) To fall flat on one's face, i.e. to fail utterly.

fu6.text: U+670D A carriage-box (Kangxi: 牝服謂車箱服讀曰負). A type of crossbar (Kangxi: 牝服長八尺謂較也). 【服-rising】 (bjuwX) (_noun-like_) carriage-box

fuk6.text: U+670D 伏 (for "submit" sense) 𠬝 (F1.66 服) 衣服又悅服 (Page 64 #2: 服(9)) To use (Kangxi: 用也) (as a boat); to wait on, to serve; to submit, yield to, accord with; to cause to submit (Kangxi: 懾服也), to convince; accustomed to, acclimated, habituated (Kangxi: 習也); to think (Kangxi: 思也); to dress; to fold; garments (Kangxi: 衣服), mourning apparel; a carriage cloth; a quiver (Kangxi: 盛矢器也); an affair; _(1)(i/) fuk(9)_ (ji1 fuk6 衣服) clothes; _ch(e/)uk(8) fuk(9)_ (zoek3 fuk6 着服) to go in mourning; _(5)'ng fuk(9)_ (ng5 fuk6 五服) five grades of mourning; _(1)yam fuk(9)_ (jam1 fuk6 欽服) complete submission; _~~t(')(ut(9)~~ t(')(ut(8) fuk(9)_ (tyut3 fuk6 脫服) to lay off mourning; _fuk(9) y(e/)uk(9)_ (fuk6 joek6 服藥) to take medicine; _(1)kung fuk(9)_ (gung1 fuk6 公服) ceremonial dress; _fuk(9) sz'(6)_ (fuk6 si6 服事) to attend, to serve; _(4)'m fuk(9) k(a/)u(3)_ (m4 fuk6 gaau3 唔服教) intractable; _fuk(9) (2)shui (2)t(')(o\)_ (fuk6 seoi2 tou2 服水土), acclimated; _(4)(un fuk(9)_ (jyun4 fuk6 元服) an official cap. (Page 64 #4: 伏(9); here normalised to 服) _(1)sh(u fuk(9)_ (syu1 fuk6 舒服) in good spirits; _(1)sam fuk(9)_ (sam1 fuk6 心服) to respect or acknowledge another's talents. Williams' "to convince": As in 說服. Williams' 脫服: Corrected _t(')(ut(9)_ (tyut6) to _t(')(ut(8)_ (tyut3). Williams' 服水土: Used in the negative for traveller's diarrhoea (水土不服). An inside-horse (Kangxi: 兩服中央夾轅者). To apply (Kangxi: 行也). Service (Kangxi: 職也, 事也). Classifier for medicinal dosage. 【服-entering】 (bjuwk) (_verb-like_) to submit (_verb-like_) to subjugate, to yoke (_verb-like_) (_met._) to harness, to apply (_noun-like_) yoke-horse, inside-horse (_noun-like_) service (_verb-like_) to serve (_verb-like_) to muse (upon) (_noun-like_) raiment (_verb-like_) to don (_noun-like_) quiver (_verb-like_) to take

fu6.text: U+7954 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. 付 附 (F2.17 祔) 合食先祖曰祔食又合葬曰祔 (Page 61 #4: 祔(6)) To sacrifice to the newly dead alongside ancestors in the hall (Kangxi: 後死者合食於先祖); to inter in the same tomb (Kangxi: 合葬亦曰祔); _f(u/)(6) ~~shik(9)~~ tsz'(6)_ (fu6 zi6 祔食) to sacrifice to the dead and his ancestors; _f(u/)(6) tsong(3)_ (fu6 zong3 祔葬) to bury together. Williams' 祔食: Corrected _shik(9)_ (sik6) to _tsz'(6)_ (zi6). 【祔】 (bjuH) (_verb-like_) to adjoin in sacrifice (_verb-like_) to bury jointly

U+8150 (F2.17 腐) 腐爛又腐腐 (Page 61 #6: 腐(6)) Corrupted, carious, rotten (Kangxi: 爛也, 朽也敗也); ~~crushed to powder;~~ castrated as punishment (Kangxi: 宮𠛬曰腐 etc.); _f(u/)(6) l(a/)n(6)_ (fu6 laan6 腐爛) putrid, rotten; _tau(6) f(u/)(6)_ (dau6 fu6 豆腐) bean curd; _f(u/)(6) (5)(u_ (fu6 jyu5 腐乳) soured curd; _f(u/)(6) (4)ying_ (fu6 jing4 腐刑), punishment of castration; _f(u/)(6) (4)(u_ (fu6 jyu4 腐儒) a foolish pedant (Kangxi: 腐者敗爛言無所堪任). Fan Wan entry: 腐腐 should probably be 豆腐 or 腐乳. Williams' 腐儒: Especially one who is stale or antiquated. 【腐】 (bjuX) (_adjective-like_) rotting, putrid (_noun-like_) (_met._) castration

U+8A03 赴 讣 (Mainland simplified) fu3 (per 《廣韻》芳遇切) (F2.17 訃) 訃音報喪曰訃 (Page 61 #10: 訃(6)) To announce the death (Kangxi: 吿喪也) of a parent or relative by the nearest mourner on the 7th day; to go to (Kangxi: 至也); _f(u/)(6) (1)yam_ (fu6 jam1 訃音), a letter announcing the death of a parent. 【訃】 (phjuH) (_verb-like_) to announce death

U+8CA0 May appear as either ⿱⺈貝 (assumed here) or ⿱刀貝, depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 負 as a component. 负 (Mainland simplified) (F2.17 負) 背負又孤負 (Page 61 #11: 負(6)) To carry on the back, to bear (Kangxi: 負背也置項背也, 擔也, 荷也); to take a duty; to rely on, to depend on (Kangxi: 恃也); to turn the back on (Kangxi: 背也), to disregard, to refuse; defeated, to fail (Kangxi: 敗也); to owe (Kangxi: 一曰受貸不償); to slight, to be ungrateful (Kangxi: 背恩忘德曰負); a burden; _(1)k(u/) f(u/)(6)_ (gu1 fu6 辜負) unmindful of kindness, disappointed; _f(u/)(6) (1)sam_ (fu6 sam1 負心), ungrateful; _f(u/)(6) lui(6)_ (fu6 leoi6 負累) to involve an indorser; _f(u/)(6) t(')ok(8)_ (fu6 tok3 負託) to slight a request; _f(u/)(6) wat(7)_ (fu6 wat1 負屈) injured, grieved; _f(u/)(6) ~~ho(3)~~ ho(6)_ (fu6 ho6 負荷) a responsibility. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 背. Williams' 負心: Or, heartless. Williams' 負託: That is, to let down by failing to perform an entrusted task. Williams' 負屈: Better rendered "wronged". Williams' 負荷: Corrected _ho(3)_ (ho3) to _ho(6)_ (ho6). Better rendered "burden". To keep near to (Kangxi: 依也). To betray, to let down. Negative. 【負】 (bjuwX) (_verb-like_) to carry on the back, (_met._) to bear, to support (_verb-like_) to turn the back (upon), (_met._) to betray, to let down (_verb-like_) to lean upon, (_met._) to keep near to (_noun-like_) loss

U+8CFB 赙 (Mainland simplified) (F2.17 賻) 以貨財助喪事曰賻 (Page 62 #1: 賻(6)) To contribute to bury one (Kangxi: 助也, 以財助喪也); to assist an interment by giving articles. 【賻】 (bjuH) (_verb-like_) to contribute to funeral expense (_noun-like_) contributed funeral expense

U+8D74 fu3 (per 《廣韻》芳遇切) (F2.17 赴) 奔也至也趨也就也 (Page 61 #9: 赴(6)) To go to, to repair to, to hasten (Kangxi: 赴至也, 趨而至也, 趨也); to arrive at, to come; _f(u/)(6) tsik(9)_ (fu6 zik6 赴席) to go to a feast; _(1)pan f(u/)(6)_ (ban1 fu6 奔赴) to go speedily; _f(u/)(6) ming(6)_ (fu6 ming6 赴命) to obey a call; _f(u/)(6) (4)p(')ung (4)loi_ (fu6 pung4 loi4 赴蓬萊), gone to elysium; _f(u/)(6) k(o\)(3)_ (fu6 gou3 赴告) to present a petition; _f(u/)(6) y(e/)uk(8)_ (fu6 joek3 赴約) to engage to meet. Williams' 赴約: Or, to make an appointment. 【赴】 (phjuH) (_verb-like_) to hasten (unto), to go unto, (_met._) to throw oneself

U+8F14 䩉 (for jawbone/cheek senses) 辅 (Mainland simplified) (F2.17 輔) 扶助也又輔弼官也又四輔星名又車輔兩旁夾車木也 (Page 61 #7: 輔(6)) The rack or cheeks of a cart (Kangxi: 車輔兩旁夾車木也 etc.); end of the jaw bones (Kangxi: 人頰骨也, 輔上頷也); to flank, to help, to second (Kangxi: 毗輔相助也弼也, 扶也); _f(u/)(6) tso(3)_ (fu6 zo3 輔佐) to succor; _f(u/)(6) pat(9)_ (fu6 bat6 輔弼) ministers; _sz'(3) f(u/)(6)_ (si3 fu6 四輔) four stars near the North-pole (Kangxi: 四輔星名所以輔佐北極); ~~a~~ the four counsellors (Kangxi: 四輔官名, 謂師保疑丞也). 【輔】 (bjuX) (_noun-like_) carriage-support, (_met._) upper-jawbone (_verb-like_) to support, to assist

U+9644 傅 (for "attach" and "close" senses) 坿 (for "add to" sense) 柎 (F2.17 附) 附寄附麗附託附近附益又衣附 (Page 61 #5: 附(6)) Near, about, ~~approaching~~ attached (Kangxi: 依也近也著也); to lean on, to follow; annexed, attached to, tributary, dependent; to join; a supplement, appendix, inclosure; _f(u/)(3) k(i/)(3)_ (fu3 gei3 附寄) to send with; _f(u/)(6) wo(6)_ (fu6 wo6 附和) to follow one in explaining; _f(u/)(6) (u/)i(6)_ (fu6 wui6 附會) to echo or assent to another's words; _f(u/)(6) kan(6)_ (fu6 gan6 附近) near, adjacent; _f(u/)(6) (1)t(a/)n_ (fu6 daan1 附單), to inclose an account; _f(u/)(6) t(')ok(8)_ (fu6 tok3 附託) to charge one with, to request; _f(u/)(6) (4)loi_ (fu6 loi4 附來), to come or bring with one; _f(u/)(6) yik(7)_ (fu6 jik1 附益) to add to, to benefit; _f(u/)(6) (2)tsz'_ (fu6 zi2 附子) a stimulating medicine (a Rhamnus?); _f(u/)(6) ts(i/)n(3)_ (fu6 zin3 附薦) to send one's tablets to a _t(a/)-tsi(u/)_ (daa ziu 打醮). Williams' 附和: Or, to echo or second, either sycophantically or without applying one's own critical thinking. To add to (Kangxi: 附益也). Used in 附會 (to make strained interpretation/analogy) (Kangxi 傅: 同附曲意黨同曰傅會). 【附】 (bjuH) (_verb-like_) to attach, to adjoin, to annex, (_met._) to add (to)

U+99D9 驸 (Mainland simplified) (F2.17 駙) 駙馬王親也 (Page 61 #2: 駙(6)) Near (Kangxi: 一曰近也); quick (Kangxi: 一曰疾也); ~~to help~~ a subsidiary horse (Kangxi: 副馬也); _f(u/)(6) (5)m(a/)_ (fu6 maa5 駙馬), a son-in-law of the emperor (Kangxi: 皇女爲公主其夫必拜駙馬都尉故謂之駙馬).

U+9B92 鲋 (Mainland simplified) (F2.17 鮒) 魚名 (Page 61 #3: 鮒(6)) A small freshwater fish resembling the perch (Kangxi: 魚名, 鮒鰿也今作鯽, 鮒魚魚之小者), said to go in pairs or shoals (Kangxi: 以相附謂之鮒), and be faithful to each other (Kangxi: 義取夫婦相依附者也); _f(u/)(6) (4)hang_ (fu6 hang4 鮒行), to ~~go in shoals~~ walk in pairs. 【鮒】 (bjuH) (_noun-like_) small-carp

fui1.text: U+6062 (F2.80 恢) 大也又恢復 (Page 62 #6: (1)恢) Great (Kangxi: 大也); liberal; extensive; to enlarge (Kangxi: 大之也); _(1)f(u/)i fuk(9)_ (fui1 fuk6 恢復) to regain possession of. Complete. 【恢】 (khwoj) (_verb-like_) to extend, to vasten (_adjective-like_) extensive, vast (_adjective-like_) complete
U+609D (F2.80 悝) 病憂也悲也大也又人名衞孔悝 (Page 62 #8: (1)悝) Used in personal names (Kangxi: 人名).

U+7070 May appear as either ⿸𠂇火 (assumed here) or ⿸厂火, depending on the font. (F2.80 灰) 火灰石灰 (Page 62 #5: (1)灰) Ashes (Kangxi: 死火餘㶳也, 火之滅者爲灰), ashy; lime; dust; to plaster; _(2)fo (1)f(u/)i_ (fo2 fui1 火灰), wood-ashes; _t(')(a/)n(3) (1)f(u/)i_ (taan3 fui1 炭灰), coal-ash; _shek(9) (1)f(u/)i_ (sek6 fui1 石灰), stone lime; _(1)pan (4)long (1)f(u/)i_ (ban1 long4 fui1 檳榔灰), betel lime; _(1)f(u/)i (2)tsun_ (fui1 zeon2 灰燼), embers; _(4)ng(a/) (1)f(u/)i_ (ngaa4 fui1 牙灰), tooth-powder; _(1)f(u/)i (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (fui1 coeng4 灰牆), to plaster a wall. (Page 715 #14: (1)灰) As a verb, to turn pale, to faint, to sink from amazement; _(1)sam (1)f(u/)i_ (sam1 fui1 心灰), the heart turned to ashes, disheartened. Williams prints the headword as ⿸厂火, which is compatibility ideograph U+2F835. Charcoal. Grey. 【灰】 (xwoj) (_noun-like_) ash (_noun-like_) charcoal
U+867A (F2.80 虺) 虺隤馬罷病不能升高之病又音委 (Page 62 #9: (1)虺) _(1)f(u/)i (4)t(')(u/)i_ (fui1 teoi4 虺隤), a jaded, sick horse (Kangxi: 虺隤病也). 【虺-level】 (xwoj, xweaj) (_adjective-like_) jaded

U+8A7C 悝 诙 (Mainland simplified) (F2.80 詼) 詼諧調戲也 (Page 62 #7: (1)詼) To play with, to laugh at (Kangxi: 調戲也, 譏戲也, 謔也嘲也); _(1)f(u/)i ~~(2)si(u/)~~ si(u/)(3)_ (fui1 siu3 詼笑), to ridicule; _(1)f(u/)i k(')ek(9)_ (fui1 kek6 詼劇) to gambol with; _(1)f(u/)i (4)h(a/)i_ (fui1 haai4 詼諧), to dally and jeer with.

U+9B41 (F2.80 魁) 凡爲首者皆曰魁 (Page 62 #4: (1)魁) A star (Kangxi: 星名); the head, chief (Kangxi: 魁帥也, 魁猶首也); the highest or first of a class; ~~monstrous~~ great (Kangxi: 大也); _(4)(un (1)f(u/)i_ (jyun4 fui1 元魁), the chief; _(1)f(u/)i (2)shau_ (fui1 sau2 魁首), the first _k(ujin_ (舉人) graduate; _(a/)(3) (1)f(u/)i_ (aa3 fui1 亞魁), the second; _(1)f(u/)i (1)sing_ (fui1 sing1 魁星), the north star, the attendant of the god of Literature; _(4)man (1)f(u/)i_ (man4 fui1 文魁), the sign over the door of a _k(ujin_ (舉人) graduate. Williams' "A star": Specifically, the first (or first four) of the Big Dipper (Kangxi: 魁北斗第一星也, 春秋緯曰瑤光第一至第四爲魁). A (small) mound (Kangxi: 小阜). A large ladle or dipper. A type of mollusc (Kangxi: 蜃蛤也). 【魁】 (khwoj) (_noun-like_) dipper, dipper-mollusc (_noun-like_) mound (_adjective-like_) chief (_adjective-like_) great

fui2.text: U+6D27 (F2.81 洧) 溱洧二水名 (Page 62 #12: (2)洧)
U+8CC4 (F2.81 賄) 財賂也 (Page 62 #10: (2)賄) Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing and incomplete strokes in 財 and 賂.

fui3.text: U+6094 May appear as either ⿰忄每 (+7 assumed here) or ⿰忄毎 (+6), depending on the font. 𠧩 fui2 (per 《廣韻》呼罪切 for "regret" sense) (F2.82 悔) 心恨也又反悔 (Page 63 #3: 悔(3)) To repent, to change (Kangxi: 悔恨也, 改也恨也); to regret (Kangxi: 悔吝也), vexed with one's self; ~~to explain the diagrams;~~ _f(u/)i(3) han(6)_ (fui3 han6 悔恨) remorse, contrition; _f(u/)i(3) ts(u/)i(6)_ (fui3 zeoi6 悔罪) to repent of sin; _f(u/)i(3) (2)koi_ (fui3 goi2 悔改), to reform; _(4)m(o\) f(u/)i(3)_ (mou4 fui3 無悔) stubborn; _f(u/)i(3) (1)sam_ (fui3 sam1 悔心), compunction. The form ⿰忄毎 is compatibility ideograph U+2F8A3. Williams' "to explain the diagrams": This is a misreading of Kangxi 外卦曰𠧩 under 𠧩. Here, 外 means "outer", not "explain". Williams' 無悔: Or "without regret". The outer (i.e. upper) trigram of a hexagram (Kangxi 𠧩: 外卦曰𠧩內卦曰貞). 【悔-rising】 (xwojX) (_verb-like_) to regret 【悔-departing】 (xwojH) (_verb-like_) to repent (_noun-like_) outer-trigram

U+6666 (F2.82 晦) 不明也又月盡謂之晦 (Page 63 #4: 晦(3)) Obscure (Kangxi: 晦昧也), dark (Kangxi: 晦昏也); night (Kangxi: 晦夜也), the close of light (Kangxi: 晦晏也); the last day of the month (Kangxi: 月盡也 etc.); misty (Kangxi: 霧謂之晦), dim (Kangxi: 晦者何冥也); _f(u/)i(3) h(i/)(3)_ (fui3 hei3 晦氣) lugubrious; _f(u/)i(3) h(i/)(3) (1)tau_ (fui3 hei3 dau1 晦氣兜), how unlucky! Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing stroke in 盡. 【晦】 (xwojH) (_noun-like_) month's-end (_adjective-like_) dark, obscure

U+8AA8 诲 (Mainland simplified) (F2.82 誨) 敎訓也 (Page 63 #5: 誨(3)) To teach, to reiterate instruction (Kangxi: 曉敎也 etc.); to admonish, to give line upon line; to induce, to lead to; inviting; _k(a/)u(3) f(u/)i(3)_ (gaau3 fui3 教誨) to teach diligently. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 敎. 【誨】 (xwojH) (_verb-like_) to instruct, (_met._) to induce
U+9767 (Page 715 #17: 靧(3)) To wash the face (Kangxi: 洗面也). 【靧】 (xwojH) (_verb-like_) to wash the face

fuk1.text: U+5E45 䋹 (F1.64 幅) 布之一片曰一幅又邊幅 (Page 63 #7: 幅(7)) ~~A wide strip~~ The width of cloth (Kangxi: 布帛廣也 etc.); a roll of paper or cloth; a selvedge or hem; a border, a frontier; a classifier of maps, pictures, rolls, flags, walls, and cloth; _(1)p(i/)n fuk(7)_ (bin1 fuk1 邊幅) a frontier; a hem; _sz'(3) fuk(7) (4)t(')au_ (sei3 fuk1 tau4-2 四幅頭), a set of four scrolls hung in halls. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 邊. Williams' 邊幅: Metaphorically, one's appearance. In modern usage, used in the sense of "extent" or "amplitude", as in 大幅, 升幅, 振幅, etc. 【幅-width】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) cloth-width, width (_noun-like_) hem (_verb-like_) (_met._) to limit

fuk6.text: U+5FA9 复 fau6 (per 《廣韻》扶富切 for "again" sense) (F1.66 復) 返也報答也重叠也 (Page 64 #3: 復(9)) Again, reiterated, to do the second time (Kangxi: 又也, 再也); to return (Kangxi: 返也, 復還也), to reply (Kangxi: 答也); to revenge, to restore (Kangxi: 興復), to repay; to report to (Kangxi: 反命也, 復報也反也), to answer; to recall the spirit of one who died from home (Kangxi: 招魂曰復); _fuk(9) (1)yam_ (fuk6 jam1 復音), an answer; _fuk(9) ~~san(3)~~ sun(3)_ (fuk6 seon3 復信) reply a to a letter; _fuk(9) ming(6)_ (fuk6 ming6 復命) to report on a commission; _fuk(9) (4)(un_ (fuk6 jyun4 復原), restored to health; _fuk(9) ~~(4)ch(')au~~ (4)shau_ (fuk6 sau4 復仇), to revenge a wrong. Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete strokes in 返, 答, and 重. Williams' 復信: Corrected _san(3)_ (san3) to _sun(3)_ (seon3). Williams' 復仇: Normalised _(4)ch(')au_ (cau4) to _(4)shau_ (sau4). For the modern word meaning "reply", see 覆 fuk1. 【復-departing】 (bjuwH) (_adverb-like_) re-, again (_verb-like_) to repeat 【復-entering】 (bjuwk) (_verb-like_) to return (_verb-like_) to reply (_verb-like_) to report (_verb-like_) to repay (_verb-like_) to restore, (_met._) to fulfil

fuk1.text: U+6945 (F1.64 楅) 以橫木施之牛角使其不抵觸 (Page 63 #9: 楅(7))

U+798F May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. fau3 (per 《集韻》敷救切 for "store" sense) fu3 (per 《集韻》敷救切 for "store" sense) (F1.64 福) 祐也德也休也善也祥也百善之名也 (Page 63 #8: 福(7)) Happiness, good fortune, lucky, felicity (Kangxi: 祐也休也善也祥也); to bless; a blessing, divine prosperity; good; provided with all things (Kangxi: 福者備也); sacrificial meats (Kangxi: 祭祀胙肉曰福); to store up (Kangxi: 藏也); ~~with;~~ _n(a/)p(9) fuk(7)_ (naap6 fuk1 納福) are you well? _(5)'ng fuk(7)_ (ng5 fuk1 五福) the five blessings (longevity, riches, ~~wealth, virtuous~~ honor, posterity, and a natural death); _fuk(7) sh(i/)n(6)_ (fuk1 sin6 福善) ~~blessed,~~ to bless the good; _fuk(7) (4)t(')(i/)n_ (fuk1 tin4 福田), ancestors' fortune; _fuk(7) t(i/)(6)_ (fuk1 dei6 福地) a lucky ~~grave-~~spot; _fuk(7) (4)shan_ (fuk1 san4 福神), lares rustici, street gods; _m(a/)n(6) fuk(7)_ (maan6 fuk1 萬福) your Honor (used by women); _fuk(7) h(i/)(3)_ (fuk1 hei3 福氣) fleshy; _f(a/)t(8) fuk(7)_ (faat3 fuk1 發福) to get fat; _(1)t(')(i/)m fuk(7) (1)t(')(i/)m shau(6)_ (tim1 fuk1 tim1 sau6 添福添壽) may you be blessed and long-lived; _yat(7) l(o\)(6) fuk(7) (1)sing_ (jat1 lou6 fuk1 sing1 一路福星), let a lucky star light your journey. (Page 715 #18: 福(7)) For "wealth, virtuous" in the list of five blessings, read "honor, posterity;" there is some discrepancy respecting the particular blessings included in the five. Williams' 福地: Not specific to graves. Better rendered "blessed land", e.g. in 心田先祖種、福地後人耕. Williams' 萬福: Specifically, said by women when performing the Chinese equivalent of a curtsey. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【福】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) blessing, happiness

U+8179 (F1.64 腹) 腹心 (Page 63 #13: 腹(7)) That which embraces; the belly, abdomen, bowels (Kangxi: 肚也 etc.); the seat of the mind; the affections; rich, thick (Kangxi: 厚也); intimate, dear; the earth (Kangxi: 坤爲腹, 坤能包藏含容故爲腹也); _fuk(7) (1)sam_ (fuk1 sam1 腹心), beloved, dear; _fuk(7) ~~(1)f(i/)~~ (2)f(i/)_ (fuk1 fei2 腹誹)~~, refusing to tell~~; _fuk(7) t(a/)i(6)_ (fuk1 daai6 腹大) ambitious, talented; _(2)k(u/) fuk(7)_ (gu2 fuk1 鼓腹) pot-bellied; _(4)wai fuk(7)_ (wai4 fuk1 遺腹) a posthumous child; _~~(2)t(a/)n~~ (2)t(')(a/)n fuk(7)_ (taan2 fuk1 坦腹) a son-in-law. Williams' 腹誹: Normalised _(1)f(i/)_ (fei1) to _(2)f(i/)_ (fei2). Not refusing to tell, but disagreeing silently. Williams' 坦腹: Corrected _(2)t(a/)n_ (daan2) to _(2)t(')(a/)n_ (taan2). To embrace (Kangxi: 腹懷抱也). 【腹】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) belly (_verb-like_) to embrace
U+844D (F1.64 葍) 惡菜 (Page 63 #10: 葍(7)) An edible vegetable with white roots, size of the finger (Kangxi: 大葉白華根如指正白可啖), found in Sh(a/)ntung (山東). 【葍】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) whiteroot
U+8760 (F1.64 蝠) 蝙蝠卽蝠飛鼠 (Page 63 #11: 蝠(7)) A bat (Kangxi: 蝙蝠服翼); Fan Wan entry: Normalised ⿱白⿵𠘨⿻二丨 to 鼠.

U+876E 蝠 (Page 63 #11: 蝠(7); here normalised to 蝮) _fuk(7) (4)sh(e/)_ (fuk1 se4 蝮蛇), a venemous serpent; _met._ a malignant heart. (Page 63 #12: 蝮(7)) An adder, cobra, or venemous serpent, called in Canton _~~f(a/)n(3)~~ f(a/)n(6) ~~(4)sh(i/)~~ (4)ch(')(i/) (4)t(')au_ (faan6 ci4 tau4 飯匙頭), or 'rice-spoon head;' a locust before it flies (Kangxi: 蝝蝮蜪, 蝗子未有翅者); _fuk(7) (2)wai_ (fuk1 wai2 蝮虺), a huge serpent (Kangxi: 蝮虺博三寸首大如擘 etc.). Williams' 飯匙頭: Corrected _f(a/)n(3)_ (faan3) to _f(a/)n(6)_ (faan6), and changed _(4)sh(i/)_ (si4) to common reading _(4)ch(')(i/)_ (ci4). Williams' "a locust before it flies": Note that Kangxi 蝝蝮蜪 is to be punctuated 蝝、蝮蜪. 【蝮】 (phjuwk) (_noun-like_) viper

U+8907 復 复 (Mainland simplified) fau6 (per 《廣韻》扶富切 for "repeat" sense) (Page 715 #19: 複(7)) A wadded or lined garment (Kangxi: 重衣也); doubled; the second; _(4)ch(')ung fuk(7)_ (cung4 fuk1 重複) again, repeated. Repeated, layered (Kangxi: 重也). To repeat. Complex, complicated. Compound. 複姓 (fuk1 sing3): "Compound surname." 【複】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) lined-garment

U+8F39 輻 fuk6 (per 《廣韻》房六切 for "axle-housing" sense) (F1.64 輹) 車之承輻者 Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 輻. 《廣韻》 distinguishes between: 方六切 _fuk(7)_ (fuk1) for the "axle-tie" sense; and 房六切 _fuk(9)_ (fuk6) for the "axle-housing" (or "prostrate-rabbit") sense. Kangxi does not distinguish the two senses, putting both under the first reading. An axle-tie (Kangxi: 車下縛也, 車軸縛也). An axle-housing (Kangxi: 車伏兔也). 【輹-voiced】 (bjuwk) (_noun-like_) axle-housing 【輹-unvoiced】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) axle-tie

U+8F3B 辐 (Mainland simplified) (F1.64 輻) 輻輳 (Page 63 #6: 輻(7)) The spokes of a wheel (Kangxi: 輪轑也, 輻謂輪中木之直指者); _fuk(7) ts(')au(3)_ (fuk1 cau3 輻輳) to collect (as at a metropolis), running together. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed headword 輻. In modern usage, used in 輻射 (radiation). 【輻】 (pjuwk) (_noun-like_) spoke

U+99A5 䫝 bik6 (per 《廣韻》符逼切 for "fragrance" sense and Kangxi 符逼切 for onomatopoeic sense) fuk6 (per 《廣韻》房六切) (F1.64 馥) 香氣 (Page 64 #1: 馥(7)) Fragrance, odors diffused around (Kangxi: 香氣芬馥); _~~(1)fau~~ (1)fan fuk(7)_ (fan1 fuk1 芬馥) a pleasant fragrance; a man's name. Williams' 芬馥: Corrected _(1)fau_ (fau1) to _(1)fan_ (fan1). Williams' "a man's name": This is applicable not to the term 芬馥, but to the character 馥 alone (Kangxi: 人名). (_onomatopoeia_) The sound of an arrowhead striking (Kangxi: 馥中鏃聲也).

fuk6.text: U+5310 伏 服 baak6 (alternative per 《廣韻》蒲北切) (F2.89 匐 _P(a/)k(9)_ (baak6)) 匍匐手足並行之貌 (Page 64 #4: 伏(9); here normalised to 匐) _(4)p(')(o\) fuk(9)_ (pou4 fuk6 匍匐) to go on the hands and knees, humbly; (Page 351 #3: 匐(9) _P(a/)k(9)_ (baak6)) To fall prostrate (Kangxi: 伏地也); _(4)p(')(o\) p(a/)k(9)_ (pou4 baak6 匍匐) to crawl, as children (Kangxi: 兒以手行也), or when making prostration to the emperor; to hasten to a friend in case of need---so as to relieve him (Kangxi: 盡力奔趨往也). Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 匍. 【匐】 (bjuwk, bok) Used in 匍匐. 【匍匐】 (bu bjuwk, bu bok) (_verb-like_) to crawl

U+832F (F1.66 茯) 茯苓藥名 (Page 64 #6: 茯(9)) China-root _(Smilax ~~China~~ glabra)_ called _fuk(9) (4)ling_ (fuk6 ling4 茯苓)_;_ _(2)t(')(o\) fuk(9) (4)ling_ (tou2 fuk6 ling4 土茯苓), Canton China-root; _p(a/)k(9) fuk(9)_ (baak6 fuk6 白茯) the Sz'chuen (四川) root; _fuk(9) (4)ling (1)k(o\)_ (fuk6 ling4 gou1 茯苓膏), a jelly made from this root. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱艹⿱𠆢口 to 苓, and fixed missing strokes in 藥.

U+88B1 (F1.66 袱) 包袱 (Page 64 #5: 袱(9)) A square cloth wrapper, called _(1)p(a/)u fuk(9)_ (baau1 fuk6 包袱); _(2)shau fuk(9)_ (sau2 fuk6 手袱) a handkerchief. As in 執包袱走 zap1 baau1 fuk6 zau2, equivalent to "pack your bags and leave".

fun1.text: U+5BDB (F2.77 寛) 寛大寛裕 (Page 64 #7: (1)寛) Fan Wan entry: Fixed incompletely printed character 裕.

U+5BEC 寛 宽 (Mainland simplified) (F2.77 寛) 寛大寛裕 (Page 64 #7: (1)寛; here normalised to 寬) Large, spacious (Kangxi 寬: 屋寬大也), wide, ample (Kangxi 寬: 裕也), broad; forgiving (Kangxi 寬: 宥也), easy (Kangxi 寬: 舒也), benignant, clement (Kangxi 寬: 不猛也)~~.~~, kind, indulgent; slow; to widen, to enlarge, to relax (Kangxi 寬: 緩也); to forbear; to unrobe; _(1)f(u/)n f(u/)t(8)_ (fun1 fut3 寬闊) wide, ample; _(1)f(u/)n t(a/)i(6)_ (fun1 daai6 寬大) ~~liberal, indulgent~~ magnanimous; _(1)f(u/)n ~~(1)yung~~ (4)yung_ (fun1 jung4 寬容), pleasant, a jolly countenance; _(1)f(u/)n ~~(4)(u~~ (u(6)_ (fun1 jyu6 寬裕), an abundance, overplus; _(1)f(u/)n h(a/)n(6)_ (fun1 haan6 寬限) to allow a longer time; _(1)f(u/)n sh(u(3)_ (fun1 syu3 寬恕) to forgive; _(1)f(u/)n (u/)t(9)_ (fun1 wut6 寬活) in easy circumstances; _sz'(6) (1)f(u/)n_ (si6 fun1 事寬), not urgent; _(1)f(u/)n tsung(3)_ (fun1 zung3 寬縱) over-indulgent, heedless of. Fan Wan entry: Fixed incompletely printed character 裕. Williams' 寬大: Better rendered "magnanimous". This is a positive trait. Williams' 寬容: Corrected _(1)yung_ (jung1) to _(4)yung_ (jung4). Better rendered "lenient" or "permissive". Williams' 寬裕: Corrected _(4)(u_ (jyu4) to _(u(6)_ (jyu6). 【寬】 (khwan) (_adjective-like_) wide, spacious (_adjective-like_) magnanimous (_adjective-like_) clement, lenient (_verb-like_) to clemence, (_met._) to pardon
U+61FD (F2.77 歡) 喜歡悅也 (F2.77 懽) 同上 (F2.77 驩) 同上 (Page 715 #20: (1)懽)

U+6B61 懽 欢 讙 驩 (F2.77 歡) 喜歡悅也 (F2.77 懽) 同上 (F2.77 驩) 同上 (Page 64 #8: (1)歡) Joyous, jocund, glad, frolicsome, gleeful, merry (Kangxi: 喜樂也); to rejoice (Kangxi: 喜動聲氣故从欠); _(1)f(u/)n (2)h(i/)_ (fun1 hei2 歡喜), pleased, to like, agreeable; _(1)f(u/)n (1)sam_ (fun1 sam1 歡心), to gladden one; _(1)f(u/)n lok(9)_ (fun1 lok6 歡樂) highly delighted. (Page 715 #20: (1)懽) Interchanged with 歡 _(1)f(u/)n_ (fun1). To delight in, to like. Friendly, amicable. 【歡】 (xwan) (_verb-like_) to rejoice, to delight (in) (_adjective-like_) (_met._) friendly
U+8B99 hyun1 (alternative per 《廣韻》況袁切) To clamour (Kangxi: 譁也, 鳴也, 諠也). 【讙】 (xwan, xjwon) (_verb-like_) to clamour

U+8C9B 犿 獾 䝔 (Page 65 #1: (1)貛) A wild boar (Kangxi: 野豕也); _(2)kau (1)f(u/)n_ (gau2 fun1 狗貛), a species of jackal (Kangxi: 狗貛蜀人呼天狗 etc.); _(2)hoi (1)f(u/)n_ (hoi2 fun1 海貛), a sort of musk rat in Li(a/)utung (遼東) (Kangxi: 遼東有海貛皮可爲裘領); _(1)f(u/)n (2)tsz' (4)p(')(i/)_ (fun1 zi2 pei4 貛子皮), a beaver skin. A badger. A male wolf (Kangxi: 狼牡貛牝狼).

fun2.text: U+6B35 (F2.78 欵) 衷曲也至也留也又條件也 (Page 65 #2: (2)欵) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 留.

U+6B3E 欵 歀 㱁 (F2.78 欵) 衷曲也至也留也又條件也 (Page 65 #2: (2)欵; here normalised to 款) ~~Something desired~~ Desiring (Kangxi 款: 意有所欲也 etc.); sincere, single-hearted; true (Kangxi 款: 誠也, 款款忠誠也), to love (Kangxi 款: 愛也), to venerate, to respect; to treat well; to knock at (Kangxi 款: 叩也求通也); to reach (Kangxi 款: 至也); ~~to repay;~~ ~~a memorandum of~~ an inscription (Kangxi 款: 誌也, 師古曰款刻也識記也, etc.); ~~to enumerate;~~ a classifier of articles of different sorts, classes, affairs; _(2)f(u/)n toi(6)_ (fun2 doi6 款待) to treat politely; _(2)f(u/)n (4)t(')au t(a/)i(6)_ (fun2 tau4 daai6 款頭大) haughty, difficult of access; _n(a/)u(6) (2)f(u/)n_ (naau6 fun2 鬧款), pompous; _(4)t(')ai (2)f(u/)n_ (tai4 fun2 題款), to write an autograph; _(2)f(u/)n shik(7)_ (fun2 sik1 款式) a sort; _kok(8) (2)f(u/)n_ (gok3 fun2 各款), every kind; _(1)kwai (2)f(u/)n_ (gwai1 fun2 歸款) to repay a loan; _yat(7) (2)f(u/)n sz'(6)_ (jat1 fun2 si6 一款事) an affair; _(2)f(u/)n (4)lau_ (fun2 lau4 款留), to detain as a guest. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 留. Williams' "Something desired": This is a misreading of Kangxi 意有所欲也. This sense is an adjective ("desiring", as a hole unfilled), not a noun. Void, hollow (Kangxi 款: 空也). A clause (Kangxi 款: 科也今章疏言列款謂科條列之), a provision. Funds. To detain, to keep (Kangxi 款: 留也). Slowly, tardily (Kangxi 款: 緩也). 【款】 (khwanX) (_adjective-like_) void, hollow (_adjective-like_) true, staunch (_verb-like_) to knock
U+76E5 (F2.78 盥) 以盤水洗手曰盥 (Page 65 #4: (2)盥)

U+7ABE 款 窽 (F2.78 窽) 空也莊子導太平 (Page 65 #3: (2)窾) ~~An~~ empty ~~place~~ (Kangxi: 空也); hollow, like an empty vessel; uninformed, ignorant; _(2)f(u/)n ~~k(')i(u/)(3)~~ hi(u/)(3)_ (fun2 hiu3 窾竅) an empty hole. Williams' 窾竅: Normalised _k(')i(u/)(3)_ (kiu3) to _hi(u/)(3)_ (hiu3). 【窾】 (khwanX) (_noun-like_) hollow

fung1.text: U+4E30 May appear with first stroke ㇒ (assumed here) or ㇐, depending on the font. fung4 (alternative per 《集韻》符風切) (F1.58 丰) 丰采又面丰滿也 (Page 66 #8: (1)丰) Luxuriant (Kangxi: 丰茸草盛貌); plump, good-looking (Kangxi: 容色美好貌); easy, melodious; a round face; Kangxi considers the form with first stroke ㇐ (horizontal) to be standard. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 滿. 【丰】 (phjowng) (_adjective-like_) luxuriant, lush

U+5C01 (F1.58 封) 緘也培也又封贈 (Page 65 #9: (1)封) The domain granted to princes (Kangxi: 爵諸侯之土也); to heap up earth (Kangxi: 聚土曰封); great (Kangxi: 大也), affluent (Kangxi: 富厚也); to enrich; to invest nobles with rule, to appoint to office, to confer investiture (Kangxi: 凡專利自私曰封); to give a title of nobility; to seal up, to close a letter (Kangxi: 緘也); an envelop of a letter, classifier of letters; 20 taels (両); _(1)fung k(o\)(3)_ (fung1 gou3 封誥) to ennoble an officer's parents; _(1)fung (4)n(a/)m ts(e/)uk(8)_ (fung1 naam4 zoek3 封男爵) to confer the title of ~~viscount~~ baron; _(1)fung (2)so_ (fung1 so2 封鎖), to seal up; _(1)fung p(')(o\)(3)_ (fung1 pou3 封舖) to shut up a shop; _(1)fung (4)sh(un_ (fung1 syun4 封船), to taboo a boat for government use; _yat(7) (1)fung sun(3)_ (jat1 fung1 seon3 一封信) a letter; _yat(7) (1)fung (4)ngan_ (jat1 fung1 ngan4 一封銀), 20 taels (両) of silver; _(1)fung (4)p(')(i/)_ (fung1 pei4 封皮), an envelop for dispatches; _(1)teng (1)fung_ (deng1 fung1 釘封), a rescript inclosed in boards containing a death-warrant; _(1)fung (1)k(e/)ung t(a/)i(6) (4)shan_ (fung1 goeng1 daai6 san4 封疆大臣), the high provincial officers; _(1)fung (4)shan_ (fung1 san4 封神), to confer a title on an idol. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 絾 to 緘. Williams' 封神: Better rendered "to deify". In modern usage, used in 封面 (cover of a book or publication). To earth up, to cultivate (Kangxi: 培也, 壅本曰封). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【封】 (pjowng) (_noun-like_) raised-mound, raised-boundary (_verb-like_) to raise mound, to earth up (_verb-like_) to seal up (_noun-like_) feoff (_verb-like_) to enfeoff, to appoint (_adjective-like_) great
U+5CEF (F1.58 峯) 山之尖頂 (Page 66 #4: (1)峯)

U+5CF0 峯 (F1.58 峯) 山之尖頂 (Page 66 #4: (1)峯; here normalised to 峰) The peak of a mountain (Kangxi 峯: 山耑也); a camel's hump; _(1)fung (4)l(un_ (fung1 lyun4 峰巒), ridges and peaks. 【峰】 (phjowng) (_noun-like_) peak, summit

U+6953 枫 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 楓) 木名 (Page 65 #7: (1)楓) The maple (Kangxi: 木也 etc.); also applied to the sycamore; _(1)fung (4)shan_ (fung1 san4 楓宸), the palace, the emperor (Kangxi: 楓木漢宮殿中多植之故稱楓宸).
U+6E22 (F1.58 渢) 水名 Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete and missing strokes in 名.

fung4.text: U+6E22 沨 (Mainland simplified) faan3 (per 《集韻》孚梵切 for "neutral/even-sounding" sense) faan4 (per 《集韻》符咸切 for "neutral/even-sounding" sense and Kangxi for "floating" sense) fung1 (per Fan Wan, common) (F1.58 渢 _(1)Fung_ (fung1)) 水名 (Page 715 #22: (4)渢) The noise or roaring of water or waves (Kangxi: 水聲一曰弘大聲); floating (Kangxi: 一曰浮貌). Read _f(a/)n(3)_ (faan3), in the phrase _f(a/)n(3) f(a/)n(3)_ (faan3 faan3 渢渢) an easy, even sound (Kangxi: 渢渢中庸之聲也). Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete and missing strokes in 名.

fung1.text: U+70FD 㶻 㷭 (F1.58 烽) 烽火置薪火於高處賊至則焚之以相吿曰烽火 (Page 66 #7: (1)烽) A fire-place erected on hills, in which fires are lighted; _(1)fung (1)(i/)n_ (fung1 jin1 烽煙), a beacon-fire. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing strokes in 賊. Williams' "A fire-place ...": Specifically, for the purposes of signalling or warning (Kangxi 㷭: 同烽, 燧表𠋫也邊有警則舉火). 【烽】 (phjowng) (_noun-like_) beacon

U+760B 風 疯 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 瘋) 大疾 (Page 65 #8: (1)瘋) The leprosy, scrofula, and kindred diseases; insane, insensate; _f(a/)t(8) (1)fung_ (faat3 fung1 發瘋), leprous; _(1)fung (un(6)_ (fung1 jyun6-2 瘋院) a lazaretto; _(1)fung (1)t(i/)n_ (fung1 din1 瘋癲), mad, crazed; _(1)fung (2)kau_ (fung1 gau2 瘋狗), a mad dog; _(4)t(')au (1)fung_ (tau4 fung1 頭瘋), headache (Kangxi: 頭瘋病).

U+8451 (F1.58 葑) 葑菲菜名 (Page 66 #1: (1)葑) ~~Vegetables~~ A vegetable resembling mustard, chives (Kangxi: 菜名 etc.); _(1)fung (2)f(i/)_ (fung1 fei2 葑菲), cheap greens; _met._ poor, trifling, worthless. Possibly turnip (Kangxi: 葑蔓菁也). 【葑】 (pjowng) (_noun-like_) turnip

fung3.text: U+8451 Wild rice root (Kangxi: 菰根也).

fung1.text: U+8702 蚌 䗬 蠭 鋒 (for "swarming" sense) (F1.58 蜂) 蜜蜂 (F1.58 蠭) 同蜂字 (Page 66 #5: (1)蜂(1)蠭) Bees, wasps, hornets (Kangxi 蠭: 飛蟲螫人者 etc.); _mat(9) (1)fung_ (mat6 fung1 蜜蜂), a honey bee; _(1)fung ~~tau(6)~~ tau(3)_ (fung1 dau3 蜂竇) a bee's-nest; _(4)wong (1)fung ~~tau(6)~~ tau(3)_ (wong4 fung1 dau3 黃蜂竇) a hornet's nest, a villain; _(1)fung (4)ch(')(a/)u_ (fung1 caau4 蜂巢), a bee-hive; _(5)m(a/) (1)fung_ (maa5 fung1 馬蜂), a ~~horse-fly, a breeze~~ wasp or hornet; _(1)fung (1)cham_ (fung1 zam1 蜂針), a sting. Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 蜜, and normalised headword 𧔧 to 蠭. Williams' 蜂竇, 黃蜂竇: Corrected _tau(6)_ (dau6) to _tau(3)_ (dau3). Swarming. 【蜂】 (phjowng) (_noun-like_) bee, wasp, hornet (_adjective-like_) (_met._) swarming
U+882D (F1.58 蜂) 蜜蜂 (F1.58 蠭) 同蜂字 (Page 66 #5: (1)蜂(1)蠭) Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed 蜜, and normalised headword 𧔧 to 蠭.
U+8C4A (F1.58 豐) 大也盛也又豐熟 (F1.58 豊) 同上 (Page 66 #2: (1)豊) Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing dot in 盛, and corrected 土 to 上.

U+8C50 豊 丰 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 豐) 大也盛也又豐熟 (F1.58 豊) 同上 (Page 66 #2: (1)豊; here normalised to 豐) ~~A full goblet;~~ abundant, affluent, copious, exuberant (Kangxi 豐: 茂也盛也); rich, fertile, prolific; talented; _(1)fung (4)n(i/)n_ (fung1 nin4 豐年), a plenteous year; _(1)fung shing(6)_ (fung1 sing6 豐盛) flourishing, prosperous; _(1)fung shuk(9)_ (fung1 suk6 豐熟) ripe, fully grown; _(1)fung ~~hau(6)~~ (5)hau_ (fung1 hau5 豐厚) generous (as a feast); _(1)fung (1)tang_ (fung1 dang1 豐登), large supplies (of corn). (Page 715 #21: (1)豐) Is the full form of 豊; the latter (豊) is the least used. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing dot in 盛, and corrected 土 to 上. Williams' "A full goblet": This is a misreading of Kangxi 豆之豐滿者也. Here, 豐滿者 means "the full-sized", while 豆 is a ritual vessel much flatter than a typical goblet. Williams' 豐厚: Normalised _hau(6)_ (hau6) to _(5)hau_ (hau5). A type of ritual vessel (Kangxi: 一曰器名, 似豆而卑). Great (Kangxi: 大也). Ample (Kangxi: 多也, 猶厚也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【豐】 (phjuwng) (_noun-like_) flat-goblet (_adjective-like_) plenteous, ample (_adjective-like_) exuberant

U+9146 鄷 (F1.58 鄷) 鄷都山又地名 (Page 66 #3: (1)酆) The capital of Wan w(a/)ng (文王) (Kangxi: 周文王所都), now H(u/) hien (鄠縣) in S(i/)-ng(a/)n f(u/) (西安府) in Shens(i/) (陝西); _(1)fung (1)t(o\)_ (fung1 dou1 酆都), a district in Chung chau (中州) in Sz'chuen (四川), where the fire-wells occur, hence used as a name for hell, or Tophet, from the popular belief. Williams' 酆都: Now 豐都. A surname (Kangxi: 姓).

U+92D2 蜂 蠭 鏠 锋 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 鋒) 刀劍之芒 (Page 66 #6: (1)鋒) The point of a weapon, a sharp pont (Kangxi: 兵耑也 etc.); the vanguard (Kangxi: 軍之前列); bristling; turbulent; ~~to rise up (as spears appear);~~ _(1)k(a/)u (1)fung_ (gaau1 fung1 交鋒), to ~~attack~~ engage in battle; _(1)s(i/)n (1)fung_ (sin1 fung1 先鋒), the van. Williams' "to rise up (as spears appear)": This is a reasonable rendering of Kangxi 《註》如鋒刃齊起而難犯, but that commentary applies to examples with the phrase 鋒起 rather than to 鋒 by itself. Williams' 先鋒: Here, "van" is short for "vanguard". The cutting edge of a weapon. A meteorological front. Pointed, sharp. 【鋒】 (phjowng) (_noun-like_) weapon-point, (_met._) vanguard, momentum (_adjective-like_) pointed

U+98A8 丰 (for "manner/demeanour" senses) 凬 风 (Mainland simplified) (F1.58 風) 風雨又風化 (Page 65 #6: (1)風) Breath, spirit, passion; air-gusts, gale, wind (Kangxi: 風以動萬物也 etc.); haste, fleetness; manners, deportment, etiquette; administration, policy; fame, example, fashion (Kangxi: 風俗); instruction, reformation (Kangxi: 敎也, 風是諸侯政敎也); institutes, influence; disposition, temper; to affect by example; heat in animals (Kangxi: 佚也, ...風放也牝牡相誘謂之風...); _t(a/)i(6) (1)fung_ (daai6 fung1 大風), a gale, a tyfoon; _(1)fung (5)m(a/)ng_ (fung1 maang5 風猛), the wind is violent; _shun(6) (1)fung_ (seon6 fung1 順風), a fair wind; _(2)sh(i/)m (1)sh(a/)n (1)fung_ (sim2 saan1 fung1 閃山風), a gust; _ng(a/)k(9) (1)fung_ (ngaak6 fung1 額風), a head wind; _(4)w(a/)ng (1)fung_ (waang4 fung1 橫風), a side wind; _(1)fung (1)sheng_ (fung1 seng1 風聲), or _(4)lau (1)fung_ (lau4 fung1 流風), a rumor; _(1)fung tsuk(9)_ (fung1 zuk6 風俗) usage; _(1)fung f(a/)(3)_ (fung1 faa3 風化) influence of example; _(4)man (1)fung_ (man4 fung1 民風), character of a people; _(1)fung (ut(9)_ (fung1 jyut6 風月) dissipation; _(1)fung (4)lau_ (fung1 lau4 風流), gaiety, pleasure; _(4)man (1)fung_ (man4 fung1 文風), a literary spirit; _(1)fung (2)shui_ (fung1 seoi2 風水), geomancy; _(1)fung (1)s(e/)ung_ (fung1 soeng1 風箱), a bellows; _(2)kwai (4)t(')au (1)fung_ (gwai2 tau4 fung1 鬼頭風), an adverse wind; _(4)man (1)fung chuk(7) (2)ying_ (man4 fung1 zuk1 jing2 聞風捉影), a newsmonger, an idle talebearer; _(1)k(o\)m p(a/)i(3) ~~h(a/)(3)~~ h(a/)(6) (1)fung_ (gam1 baai3 haa6 fung1 甘拜下風), I willingly acknowledge your superiority; _(1)fung (4)ts(')ing_ (fung1 cing4 風情) lascivious looks. (Page 66 #8: (1)丰) _(2)s(e/)ung mong(6) (1)fung (4)(i/)_ (soeng2 mong6 fung1 ji4 想望丰儀), I wish to see your pleasant demeanour and face; _(1)fung (2)ts(')oi_ (fung1 coi2 丰采), a graceful carriage. Williams' 大風: In modern usage, it is 颱風 that is a typhoon. Williams' 甘拜下風: Corrected _h(a/)(3)_ (haa3) to _h(a/)(6)_ (haa6). News. Scenery. 放風 (fong3 fung1): "Release the news." 收到風 (sau1 dou3-2 fung1): "Received news." "Wind" in Chinese medicine. 傷風 (soeng1 fung1): "A cold." 中風 (zung3 fung1): "Stroke." The 182nd radical (U+2FB5 ⾵ "wind"). 【風-level】 (pjuwng) (_noun-like_) wind (_noun-like_) style, manner (_noun-like_) (_met._) air (_noun-like_) (_met._) in heat

fung3.text: U+98A8 凬 风 (Mainland simplified) (F1.61 諷 _(2)Fung_ (fung2)) 譏諷又諷諫 (F1.61 風 _(2)Fung_ (fung2)) 同上 To blow. To criticise tactfully or allusively (Kangxi: 風化風刺皆謂譬諭不直言也). 【風-departing】 (pjuwngH) (_verb-like_) to blow (_verb-like_) to criticise tactfully

fung2.text: U+4FF8 (F1.61 俸) 俸祿 (Page 66 #12: (2)俸) Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete strokes in 祿.

fung6.text: U+4FF8 奉 fung6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.61 俸 _(2)Fung_ (fung2)) 俸祿 (Page 66 #12: (2)俸 _(2)Fung_ (fung2)) Salary, emoluments (Kangxi: 秩祿也, 亦作奉); wages, stipend, pay, rations, allowance; _(2)fung luk(9)_ (fung6-2 luk6 俸祿) an officer's salary; _(2)fung (1)sau_ (fung6-2 sau1 俸修), government allowances; _t(a/)i(3) (2)fung (1)kwai (4)t(')(i/)n_ (daai3 fung6-2 gwai1 tin4 帶俸歸田), to retire from an office on its salary; _(2)fung (5)mai_ (fung6-2 mai5 俸米), soldiers' rations. Fan Wan entry: Fixed incomplete strokes in 祿. Williams' 帶俸歸田: Inferred incompletely printed letters _i_ in _t(a/)i(3)_, "o" in "from", and "c" in "office". Williams' 俸米: Also the grain allowance for non-military officials. 【俸】 (bjowngH) (_noun-like_) emolument

fung2.text: U+8982 泛 (for "overturn/overthrow" sense) (Page 67 #4: (2)泛; here normalised to 覂) To overthrow (Kangxi 覂: 反覆也, 泛本作覂後通用耳), to throw a rider, to "spill" him; _(2)fung k(a/)(3) (1)ch(i/) (5)m(a/)_ (fung2 gaa3 zi1 maa5 覂駕之馬), a vicious horse, _met._ a stubborn boy. Lacking (Kangxi 覂: 乏也). 【覂】 (pjowngX) (_verb-like_) to overturn, to overthrow

fung3.text: U+8AF7 風 讽 (Mainland simplified) (F1.61 諷 _(2)Fung_ (fung2)) 譏諷又諷諫 (F1.61 風 _(2)Fung_ (fung2)) 同上 (Page 67 #1: (2)諷 _(2)Fung_ (fung2); here corrected to _Fung(3)_ (fung3)) To recite (Kangxi: 誦也) ~~or rehearse in a musical tone~~; ~~recitative;~~ to ridicule, to satirize~~,~~; to reprove by irony~~;~~, metaphor, or allusion (Kangxi: 敎也, 譬喩也, 諫刺也); _~~(2)fung~~ fung(3) k(a/)n(3)_ (fung3 gaan3 諷諫) ~~satire,~~ to censure; _~~(2)fung~~ fung(3) ts(')z'(3)_ (fung3 ci3 諷刺) pointed irony; _~~(2)fung~~ fung(3) sz'(6)_ (fung3 si6 諷？) satirical ballads; _~~(2)fung~~ fung(3) tsung(6)_ (fung3 zung6 諷誦) to chant (as priests do). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 幾 to 譏. Williams' "or rehearse in a musical tone", "recitative": Kangxi gives the commentary 《註》倍文曰諷以聲節之曰誦, which prescribes 誦, *not* 諷, as being the rhythmic (or musical) type of recitation. Williams' 諷諫: Not satire, but tactful or allusive remonstrance. This is, in a way, the *opposite* of the (non-classical) "satire" sense. 【諷】 (pjuwngH) (_verb-like_) to recite (_verb-like_) to criticise tactfully
