The spelling 之嘛 is arbitrary (but well established). Modern Cantonese dictionaries indicate a reading of zi1 maa3 for 之嘛. I disagree with this reading for three reasons: I have only heard za1 maa3. I believe that 之嘛 (za1 maa3) is a contraction of 啫 (ze1) + 吖嘛 (a1 maa3), in the same way that 𠺢嘛 (ga1 maa3) is shortened from 嘅 (ge3) + 吖嘛 (a1 maa3). I believe that any insistence on the reading of zi1 maa3 is a case of incorrectly letting the spelling dictate the pronunciation. It would be more helpful if za1 maa3 were written 𠾵嘛 instead, but unfortunately the spelling 之嘛 is already well established.

zi1.text: U+4E4B 㞢 (F1.35 之) 於也往也又語助詞 (Page 38|n81 #2: (1)之) A sign of the genitive; when placed between ~~two nouns or verbs~~ a noun and a verb, answers to who, which, that; an object pronoun, ~~he~~ him, ~~she~~ her, it, them; often used in the abstract, after a noun, or as a relative particle, in apposition; ~~to progress;~~ to go to (Kangxi: 往也); _~~t(')eng(3)~~ t(')ing(3) (1)ch(i/) (1)ch(i/) (4)yan_ (ting3 zi1 zi1 jan4 聽之之人), the person who hears him; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)ch(i/) (4)ming ming(6)_ (tin1 zi1 ming4 ming6 天之明命) heaven's plain decree; _(4)(u (1)ch(i/) noi(6) (4)ho_ (jyu4 zi1 noi6 ho4 如之奈何) if so, how then? _m(i/)(6) (1)ch(i/) (5)yau (5)y(a/)_ (mei6 zi1 jau5 jaa5 未之有也), there is no such thing; _(1)ts(e/)ung (4)ho (1)ch(i/)_ (zoeng1 ho4 zi1 將何之), where are you going? _(2)k(u/) (1)ch(i/)_ (gu2 zi1 古之), the ancients; _(1)t(')(i/)n ming(6) (1)ch(i/)_ (tin1 ming6 zi1 天命之), heaven orders it; _(4)m(o\) (1)ch(i/)_ (mou4 zi1 無之), impossible; _(4)hang (4)(i/) pat(7) ch(i/)(3) (2)ch(e/) (5)yau (1)ch(i/)_ (hang4 ji4 bat1 zi3 ze2 jau5 zi1 行而不至者有之), to go and not arrive is common; _(2)ch(u (1)ch(i/) (2)ch(e/) (1)ch(i/) wai(6) tai(3)_ (zyu2 zi1 ze2 zi1 wai6 dai3 主之者之謂帝) that which rules is called supreme. Many of the senses given in Kangxi are too unsatisfactory to be mapped to Williams' definitions above. For example, where Kangxi has 語助辭 "speech-assist word" (i.e. particle), the examples given are actually for the objective pronoun sense. Williams' 聽之之人: Corrected _t(')eng(3)_ (teng3) to _t(')ing(3)_ (ting3). Six of Williams' examples (天之明命, 未之有也, 古之, 無之, 行而不至者有之, 主之者之謂帝) are identical or suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.1 (_Examples of ch(i/)_, 之) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. This (Kangxi: 此也). Till, until (Kangxi: 至也). 【之】 (tsyi) (_verb-like_) to go (_preposition-like_) till (_determiner-like_) this, such (_pronoun-like_) him, it, (_met._) a thing (_postposition-like_) of (_speech-assist_) that

zaa1.text: U+54B1 (Page 547 #10: (1)咱) A colloquial word in the north; I, myself (Kangxi: 俗稱自己爲咱); _(1)ts(a/) (1)k(a/)_ (zaa1 gaa1 咱家), I, me; _(1)ts(a/) (4)m(u/)n_ (zaa1 mun4 咱們), we. Williams' 咱們: Specifically, the inclusive "we".

U+20FB5 (Page 7 #11: (1)𠾵) A colloquial particle implying a short time; _(2)tang (5)h(a/) (1)ch(a/)!_ (dang2 haa5 zaa1 等吓𠾵) wait a moment; _(2)yam (4)ch(')(a/) (1)ch(a/)_ (jam2 caa4 zaa1 飲茶𠾵), only just to take a cup of tea.

U+63F8 (Page 7 #9: (1)㪥; here corrected to 揸) _(1)ch(a/) (5)y(e/)_ (zaa1 je5 揸嘢), to handle. (Page 7 #10: (1)揸) A unauthorized character. To grasp, to grab, to clutch; to hold or take firmly; to work, as a bellows; to use; a handful; _(1)ch(a/) (1)fung (1)s(e/)ung_ (zaa1 fung1 soeng1 揸風箱), to work a bellows; _(1)ch(a/) yat(7) t(a/)i(6) (1)ch(a/)_ (zaa1 jat1 daai6 zaa1 揸一大揸), grab a big handful; _(1)ch(a/) (2)kan_ (zaa1 gan2 揸緊), hold it fast; _(1)ch(a/) (1)t(')(a/)n_ (zaa1 taan1 揸攤), to keep a gambling-table; _(1)ch(a/) tak(7) (2)wan_ (zaa1 dak1 wan2 揸得穩), I hold it safely; _(1)ch(a/) (2)shui (1)ch(u yuk(9)_ (zaa1 seoi2 zyu1 juk6 揸水豬肉) water-sogged pork; _(1)ch(a/) (2)fo (4)t(')ung_ (zaa1 fo2 tung4 揸火筒), to be a scullion; _(5)yau (1)ch(a/) (2)shau_ (jau5 zaa1 sau2 有揸手) I have security; _(5)m(o\) (1)ch(a/) (4)n(a/)_ (mou5 zaa1 naa4 冇揸拿), nothing to hold on by; a Budhist priest is so nicknamed; _(1)ch(a/) (4)k(')(un (4)t(')au_ (zaa1 kyun4 tau4 揸拳頭), to double up the fist; _(1)ch(a/) ch(u(6) kai(3) (2)tsai_ (zaa1 zyu6 gai3 zai2 揸住髻仔), to grab him by the tail; _(1)ch(a/) l(a/)n(6)_ (zaa1 laan6 揸爛) to crush in the hand. 【揸】 (zaa1) To hold, to grasp, to control. 揸兜 (zaa1 dau1): "Hold a shallow-bowl" (i.e. be a beggar). 揸拿 (zaa1 naa4): "A grasp of the situation." 揸筷子 (zaa1 faai3 zi2): "Control chopsticks." To drive a vehicle. 揸棍波 (zaa1 gwan3 bo1): "Drive stick." 揸車 (zaa1 ce1): "Drive a car." The spelling 揸 is arbitrary (but well established).
U+64BE 挝 (Mainland simplified) (F2.74 撾) 擊鼓曰撾 (Page 7 #12: (1)撾) To beat a drum or a bell with a stick (Kangxi: 擊也, 擊鼓也).
U+3AA5 (F2.74 㪥) 以手按物 (Page 7 #9: (1)㪥) To put the hand upon, to feel, to press down (Kangxi: 以指按也), to take (Kangxi: 取也);
U+6A1D (Page 7 #6: (1)樝) A sour red berry as large as a cherry (Kangxi: 似棃而酢), called _(1)sh(a/)n (1)ch(a/)_ (saan1 zaa1 山樝), used for its acid.

U+6E23 (F2.74 渣) 乍平聲渣滓 (Page 7 #5: (1)渣) Name of a river (Kangxi: 水名); dregs, grounds, residuum (Kangxi: 俗以此爲渣滓字); sediment, settlings, refuse after expressing juice; _(2)tsz' (2)kang (1)ch(a/)_ (zi2 gang2 zaa1 紫梗渣), shell lac; _(5)m(o\) (1)ch(a/)_ (mou5 zaa1 冇渣), there's no refuse left. ~~Often used for the two next (樝, 皻).~~ 【渣】 (zaa1) The residual after moisture is removed; the unswallowable remains after chewing untender meat or stringy vegetables. 渣都冇 (zaa1 dou1 mou5): "Even the scraps are gone." 𦧲渣 (loe1 zaa1): "Spit out the scraps."
U+76BB (Page 7 #7: (1)皻) Pimples on the nose (Kangxi: 鼻上皰), wine blotches (Kangxi: 紅暈似瘡浮起著面鼻者曰酒皻); pimples on the skin; _(2)tsau (1)ch(a/)_ (zau2 zaa1 酒皻), wine blossoms.
U+8E45 (F2.74 蹅) 足踏也 (Page 7 #8: (1)蹅) To tread upon; to put the foot on; _(1)ch(a/) t(a/)p(9)_ (zaa1 daap6 蹅踏) to stamp. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰目杳 to 踏.

zaa2.text: U+9B93 鮺 䱹 鲊 (Mainland simplified) (F2.75 鮓) 魚鮓肉鮓 (Page 7 #13: (2)鮓) A rank condiment of fish or flesh and salted hashed fine, with red rice and oil (Kangxi: 藏魚也 etc.); _~~l(a/)(6)~~ (5)l(a/) (2)ch(a/)_ (laa5 zaa2 揦鮓), rank, dirty, foul. Williams' 揦鮓: Corrected _l(a/)(6)_ (laa6) to _(5)l(a/)_ (laa5). 【揦鮓】 (laa5 zaa2) Dirty. 𨋢掣揦鮓 (lip1 zai3 laa5 zaa2): "The lift button is dirty." 【鮓】 (zaa2) Low quality or crappy. 咁鮓 (gam3 zaa2): "How is it so crappy?" 鮓嘢 (zaa2 je5): "A crappy thing." The spellings 揦鮓 and 鮓 are arbitrary.

zaa6.text: U+9B93 蚱 鲊 (Mainland simplified) (Page 7 #13: (2)鮓 _(2)Ch(a/)_ (zaa2); here corrected to _Ch(a/)(6)_ (zaa6)) _~~(2)ch(a/)~~ ch(a/)(6) (4)(u_ (zaa6 jyu4 鮓魚), a sort of Medusa or sea-blubber (Kangxi: 海魚名 etc.);

zaa3.text: U+4E4D 咋 詐 zaa6 (per 《廣韻》鋤駕切) (F2.76 乍) 初也忽也猝也甫然也暫也 (Page 8 #6: 乍(3)) At first (Kangxi: 初也), suddenly, hastily (Kangxi: 猝也); for a moment (Kangxi: 暫也); inadvertently, unexpectedly (Kangxi: 忽也); _ch(a/)(3) (5)yau ch(a/)(3) (4)m(o\)_ (zaa3 jau5 zaa3 mou4 乍有乍無), all at once there is some and then we have none; _ch(a/)(3) (4)(i/)n_ (zaa3 jin4 乍然), abruptly, at once; _ch(a/)(3) k(i/)n(3)_ (zaa3 gin3 乍見) happened to see. 【乍】 (dzraeH) (_adverb-like_) suddenly, unexpectedly

U+548B za3 (shorter syllable for vernacular sense) (Page 8 #8: 咋(3)) A colloquial particle implying doubt, perhaps; also a final sound, implying it is so; I understand it: _(2)k(o\)m y(e/)ung(6) ch(a/)(3)_ (gam2 joeng6-2 zaa3 噉樣咋) so will do, eh! 【咋】 (za3, zaa3) A final particle of limitation. 三個人咋 (saam1 go3 jan4-2 za3): "Only three people." The spelling 咋 is arbitrary.

zaak3.text: U+548B zaak6 (per 《正韻牋》士革切 for "bite" sense) (Page 8 #8: 咋(3) _Ch(a/)(3)_ (zaa3); here corrected to _Ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3)) A loud sound, a rude noise (Kangxi: 大聲). To eat (Kangxi: 啖也), to bite (Kangxi: 嚙也).

zaa3.text: U+643E (F2.76 榨) 壓油之器又糖榨 (F2.76 搾) 以手壓物 (Page 8 #7: 搾(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected 千 to 手.

U+69A8 搾 醡 (F2.76 榨) 壓油之器又糖榨 (F2.76 搾) 以手壓物 (Page 8 #4: 醡(3)) used for the next (榨) (Kangxi 醡: 打油具). (Page 8 #5: 榨(3)) An oil-press (Kangxi: 打油具也); a sugar press; to press or extract juices; _lok(9) ch(a/)(3) (4)ch(')ong_ (lok6 zaa3 cong4 落榨床), to violently extort money; _(4)yau ch(a/)(3)_ (jau4 zaa3 油榨) an oil press; _ch(a/)(3) (4)li(u/)_ (zaa3 liu4 榨寮), a sugar-press shed. (Page 8 #7: 搾(3)) An unauthorized character. To press down, to squeeze between the hand; _(5)l(o\) (1)hong (1)t(o\) ch(a/)(3) ch(')ut(7) (4)yau_ (lou5 hong1 dou1 zaa3 ceot1 jau4 老糠都搾出油), he even squeezes oil from rice chaff. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 千 to 手.
U+70B8 To blow up, to explode, to make explode. To deep-fry.

U+86B1 zaak3 (per 《廣韻》側伯切) (Page 8 #3: 蚱(3)) A large ~~locust~~ grasshopper, called _(5)m(a/) ch(a/)(3)_ (maa5 zaa3 螞蚱) or _ch(a/)(3) ~~(5)mang~~ (5)m(a/)ng_ (zaa3 maang5 蚱蜢)_;_ _ch(a/)(3) ~~(4)sh(i/)n~~ (4)sh(i/)m_ (zaa3 sim4 蚱蟬), a small species of cicada. The reading _ch(a/)(3)_ (zaa3) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 側駕切, explained 蟬屬. Williams' 蚱蜢: Changed _(5)mang_ (mang5) to common reading _(5)m(a/)ng_ (maang5). The spelling 諦 for dai3 is arbitrary (but well established).
U+91A1 (F2.76 醡) 壓酒具 (Page 8 #4: 醡(3)) A wine press (Kangxi: 壓酒具也); to press or separate spirits;

zaai1.text: U+658B (F2.25 齊) 竹佳切莊也恭也潔也洗心曰齊 (F2.25 齋) 齋成又燕居之室曰齋 (F2.25 斋) 同上 (Page 10|n53 #3: (1)齋(1)~~？~~斋)

U+9F4B 亝 斋 㪰 䬩 齊 (F2.25 齊) 竹佳切莊也恭也潔也洗心曰齊 (F2.25 齋) 齋成又燕居之室曰齋 (F2.25 斋) 同上 (Page 10|n53 #3: (1)齋(1)~~？~~斋) To respect, to reverence (Kangxi 齋: 恭也, 齋敬也); to abstain from (Kangxi 齋: 潔也, 洗心曰齋); pure, reverential, serious (Kangxi 齋: 莊也); a retiring room, a closet (Kangxi 齋: 燕居之室曰齋); _(2)t(a/) (1)ch(a/)i_ (daa2 zaai1 打齋), to get a soul out of tartarus; _(2)t(a/) (1)ch(a/)i hok(9)_ (daa2 zaai1 hok6-2 打齋鶴) storks for the soul to ride to heaven; _met._ a pander; _t(a/)i(6) sz'(6) (1)ch(a/)i_ (daai6 si6 zaai1 大士齋), offerings before the purveyor of hungry spirits; _(4)h(a/)n (1)ch(a/)i_ (haan4 zaai1 閒齋), a closet; _(1)sh(u (1)ch(a/)i_ (syu1 zaai1 書齋), a library; _(1)ts(')ing (1)ch(a/)i_ (cing1 zaai1 清齋), an entire fast; _(2)lo (1)ch(a/)i_ (lo2 zaai1 攞齋), to beg vegetables; _(1)ch(a/)i k(a/)i(3)_ (zaai1 gaai3 齋戒) to fast from animal food; _(1)ch(a/)i ~~tsi(u/)(6)~~ tsi(u/)(3)_ (zaai1 ziu3 齋醮) to fast at All-souls; _shik(9) (1)ch(a/)i_ (sik6 zaai1 食齋), to fast on vegetables; _(4)lo hon(3) (1)ch(a/)i_ (lo4 hon3 zaai1 羅漢齋), all sorts of vegetables; _(1)ch(a/)i (1)k(u_ (zaai1 geoi1 齋居), to live at ease; _(1)ch(a/)i (1)chong_ (zaai1 zong1 齋莊), respectful, reverential. A colloquial word. A final particle denoting that it was said, that it is so; _mat(7) (4)yan w(a/)(6) (1)ch(a/)i_ (mat1 jan4 waa6 zaai1 乜人話齋), somebody has said; _(2)h(o\) (5)ts(')z' (5)k(')(u w(a/)(6) (1)ch(a/)i_ (hou2 ci5 keoi5 waa6 zaai1 好似佢話齋), just as he said. (Page 10|n53 #4: (1)齊) Interchanged with the last (齋) (Kangxi 齊: 與齋同). To respect; decorous; the heart pure, to chasten the desires. Williams' 齋戒: Properly, to abstain from all pleasures (meat, alcohol, sex). Williams' 齋醮: Corrected _tsi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) to _tsi(u/)(3)_ (ziu3). Williams' 羅漢齋: The name of a dish, commonly called Buddha's Delight. 【齋】 (tsreaj) (_verb-like_) to purify by abstinence 【話齋】 (waa6 zaai1) Emphatic form of "as he said". The spelling 齋 for zaai1 is arbitrary. 好似佢話齋 (hou2 ci5 keoi5 waa6 zaai1): "As he said." 【齋】 (zaai1) Vegetarian food. 初一十五食齋 (co1 jat1 sap6 ng5 sik6 zaai1): "Eating vegetarian on the first and fifteenth of the lunar month." 齋口唔齋心 (zaai1 hau2 m4 zaai1 sam1): "Vegetarian in mouth but not vegetarian at heart" (said of vegetarians that eat imitation meat). Plain, pure, etc. 齋啡 (zaai1 fe1): "Straight coffee." 齋腸 (zaai1 coeng4-2): "Plain rice-noodle rolls." 齋噏 (zaai1 ngap1): "Purely blabbering."

zaak3.text: U+77FA 砸 (Cantonese) 磧 (Cantonese) 責 (Cantonese) zaak6 (alternative) (Page 12|n55 #8: 責(8); here normalised to 矺) to lay a weight on; to squeeze smooth, to press; _ch(a/)k(8) ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u_ (zaak3 zyu6 keoi5 矺住佢), keep it down; _ch(a/)k(8) (2)sz'_ (zaak3 sei2 矺死) crushed to death; _ch(a/)k(8) tsoi(6)_ (zaak3 zoi6 矺儎) to ballast a ship; _ch(a/)k(8) l(a/)n(6)_ (zaak3 laan6 矺爛) crushed in pieces. This character (in the vernacular "weight/crush" senses) is commonly written 砸 (from appropriation of formal 砸 zaap3). In my opinion, 矺 is a better character to use than 砸 because: 矺 is attested in Middle Chinese with both reasonable sound and reasonable meaning (zaak3 per 《廣韻》陟革切, explained 磓也, to stone downward); and 砸 is otherwise read zaap3. This character (in the vernacular "weight/crush" senses) is sometimes written 笮. In my opinion, 笮 is a poor character to use because it is *not* specific to pressure being applied *vertically*. Indeed for 笮, Kangxi has 又《增韻》壓也通作措《史記梁世家》李太后與爭門措指《註》晉灼曰措字借以爲笮師古曰爲門扇所笮, and in this example I think it more likely for the dowager's finger to have been crushed *horizontally* by the door, rather than vertically. 【矺】 (zaak3, zaak6) To weigh down with a heavy object. 矺住張紙 (zaak6 zyu6 zoeng1 zi2): "Weigh down the piece of paper." To crush (vertically) with a heavy object. 矺扁咗 (zaak3 bin2 zo2): "Squashed flat." Olden attestation for 矺 _ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3) meaning "weight/crush": 《廣韻》陟革切 矺 磓也 《康熙字典》矺 《廣韻》《集韻》𠀤陟格切音舴同磔省詳磔字註 又《廣韻》磓也... Here, 磓 is either to stone downwards or to gather stones (in a heap): 《廣韻》都回切 磓 落也亦作塠 《康熙字典》磓 《廣韻》《集韻》《韻會》《正韻》𠀤都回切音堆聚石也又以石投下也亦作塠...

(Page 569 #6: 嘖(7)賾(7) _Tsik(7)_ (zik1); here corrected to _Ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3)) distant, retired, hidden (Kangxi 嘖: 與賾通); Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𧷤 to 賾. 【賾】 (dzreak) (_adjective-like_) abstruse

zaak6.text: U+5B85 㡯 zaak6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.89 宅) 家宅居也堂也 (Page 13|n56 #8: 宅(9)) A dwelling, a mansion, a residence (Kangxi: 居也, 謂居處也); a grave; to dwell, to fix, to settle (Kangxi: 定也); ~~to conform to;~~ an office, a station (Kangxi: 所居之位亦曰宅); _(4)y(e/)ung ch(a/)k(9)_ (joeng4 zaak6 陽宅) houses, residences; _t(a/)i(6) ch(a/)k(9) (i/)(6) ch(a/)k(9)_ (daai6 zaak6-2 ji6 zaak6-2 大宅二宅) eldest son and second son's dwellings; _(1)yam ch(a/)k(9)_ (jam1 zaak6 陰宅) a grave; ancestral halls or shrines; _ch(a/)k(9) ~~chi(u/)(6)~~ shi(u/)(6)_ (zaak6 siu6 宅兆) to divine for a grave. Williams' 宅兆: Changed _chi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) to common reading _shi(u/)(6)_ (siu6). 【宅】 (draek) (_noun-like_) dwelling, settlement (_verb-like_) to dwell, to settle

U+6458 tik1 (per 《廣韻》他歷切 for "pick", "point", and "start" senses) zaak3 (per 《廣韻》陟革切 for "take" sense) (F2.89 摘) 以手折花曰擇 (Page 13|n56 #5: 摘(9)) To pluck, to cull; to pull, to pick (Kangxi: 拓果樹實也); to lay hold of (Kangxi: 手取也); to move on, to start (Kangxi: 發也動也); to point out (Kangxi: 一曰指近之也); _ch(a/)k(9) yan(3)_ (zaak6 jan3 摘印) to take away an officer's seal; _ch(a/)k(9) (2)t(u\) ~~tok(9)~~ lok(9) (4)lai_ (zaak6 doe2 lok6 lai4 摘朵落嚟), pull a flower down; _yat(7) ch(a/)k(9)_ (jat1 zaak6 一摘) one picking; _ch(a/)k(9) (2)kwo_ (zaak6 gwo2 摘果), to pick fruit; _ch(a/)k(9) ~~(1)teng~~ (2)teng_ (zaak6 deng2 摘頂), to take away an officer's button. (Page 13|n56 #6: 翟(9)) ~~This and the~~ The last (摘) ~~are~~ is also read _t(')ik(7)_ (tik1) ~~with the same meanings~~. Williams' 摘朵落嚟: Corrected _tok(9)_ (dok6) to _lok(9)_ (lok6). Williams' 摘頂: Corrected _(1)teng_ (deng1) to _(2)teng_ (deng2). 【摘】 (treak) (_verb-like_) to pluck

U+64C7 睪 择 (Mainland simplified) (F2.89 擇) 揀擇選擇 (Page 13|n56 #3: 擇(9)) To select, to pick out, to choose, to prefer (Kangxi: 揀選也); _ch(a/)k(9) yat(9)_ (zaak6 jat6-2 擇日) to choose a lucky day; _(5)n(i/) k(o\)m(3) (2)k(a/)n ch(a/)k(9)_ (nei5 gam3 gaan2 zaak6 你咁揀擇) you are so hard to suit; _yam(6) (5)n(i/) (2)k(a/)n ch(a/)k(9)_ (jam6 nei5 gaan2 zaak6 任你揀擇) just as you like; _ch(a/)k(9) (1)k(a/)u_ (zaak6 gaau1 擇交), to take associates. 【擇】 (draek) (_verb-like_) to select
U+64E2 (F2.89 擢) 拔抽也取用也 (Page 13|n56 #7: 擢(9))

zok6.text: U+64E2 zaak6 (per Fan Wan) (F2.89 擢 _Ch(a/)k(9)_ (zaak6)) 拔抽也取用也 (Page 13|n56 #7: 擢(9) _Ch(a/)k(9)_ (zaak6); here normalised to _Chok(9)_ (zok6)) To pull up (Kangxi: 引也); to take out, to select, to raise, to promote (Kangxi: 拔也, 抽也出也); to employ in office; ~~to reject, to extinguish, as good resolutions~~ to remove (Kangxi: 去也徹也); _~~ch(a/)k(9)~~ chok(9) f(a/)t(8) (4)n(a/)n (2)sh(o\)_ (zok6 faat3 naan4 sou2 擢髮難數), the hairs can not be counted by pulling them out---his crimes are ~~unmberless~~ numberless. 【擢】 (draewk) (_verb-like_) to pull out, to select, (_met._) to remove

zaak6.text: U+64F2 擿 掷 (Mainland simplified) (F2.89 擲) 棄擲 (Page 13|n56 #4: 擲(9)) To throw down, to throw at (Kangxi: 投也); to throw away, to reject (Kangxi: 拋也掉也與擿同); to waste, as one's time; _ch(a/)k(9) (4)(u/)i_ (zaak6 wui4 擲回), to refuse, to give back; _ch(a/)k(9) chung(3)_ (zaak6 zung3 擲中) to hit; _ch(a/)k(9) (4)t(')au_ (zaak6 tau4 擲骰) or _ch(a/)k(9) shik(7)_ (zaak6 sik1 擲色) to throw dice; _ch(a/)k(9) (2)kau (2)tsai_ (zaak6 gau2 zai2 擲九仔), to throw nines, _i.e._ to gamble; _h(i/)(3) ch(a/)k(9)_ (hei3 zaak6 棄擲) to discard.

U+6FA4 睪 泽 (Mainland simplified) (F2.89 澤) 恩澤惠澤潤澤雨澤 (Page 13|n56 #2: 澤(9)) A marsh, a fen, a pool (Kangxi: 澤水之鐘也, 水草交厝名之爲澤); to fertilize, to soften, to enrich (Kangxi: 澤者言其潤澤萬物以阜民用也); to anoint, to make to shine (Kangxi: 光潤也); to benefit, to favor; humid, slippery, smooth; to show kindness to (Kangxi: 德澤); to wash (Kangxi: 洗濯曰澤), to moisten; to make to grow; fertile; redolent of, as fragrance (Kangxi: 香澤); favor, kindness; _(2)shau ch(a/)k(9)_ (sau2 zaak6 手澤) to brighten by handling; _yun(6) ch(a/)k(9)_ (jeon6 zaak6 潤澤) fresh, moist; _w(a/)t(9) ch(a/)k(9)_ (waat6 zaak6 滑澤) glossy; _(5)(u ch(a/)k(9)_ (jyu5 zaak6 雨澤) wet with rain; _(1)yan ch(a/)k(9)_ (jan1 zaak6 恩澤) to confer favors. Williams' 手澤: Metaphorically, brilliant works by the hand of one now deceased. Undergarments (Kangxi: 褻衣曰澤). 【澤】 (draek) (_noun-like_) pool, marsh (_noun-like_) lustre (_verb-like_) to moisten, to enrich (_verb-like_) to wash (_noun-like_) undergarment

U+7FDF (F2.89 翟) 姓也又音狄 (Page 13|n56 #6: 翟(9)) A surname (Kangxi: 亦姓). ~~This~~ (...) ~~also read _t(')ik(7)_ (tik1) with the same meanings.~~ Fan Wan entry: Corrected 伙 to 狄, and removed extraneous trailing 翟.
U+274F8 (Page 13|n56 #9: 𧓸(9)) A large green caterpillar, called _ch(a/)k(9) chuk(9)_ (zaak6 zuk6 𧓸蠋) which feeds on bean leaves (Kangxi: 𧓸蠋蟲名).

U+8B2B 讁 適 谪 (Mainland simplified) zaak3 (alternative(?) per 《廣韻》陟革切) (F2.89 讁) 責也貶也 (F2.89 適) 同上 (Page 13|n56 #11: 謫(9)讁(9)) To blame, to reprehend (Kangxi 謫: 責也, 咎也); to ~~disgracc~~ disgrace officers, to punish (Kangxi 謫: 罰也) by disgracing; to scold, to be angry at (Kangxi 謫: 怒也), to find fault with; flaw, error (Kangxi 謫: 罪也過也); a change of appearance (Kangxi 謫: 變氣也); _ch(a/)k(9) (1)k(a/)n_ (zaak6 gaan1 謫奸), to disgrace an officer. Whilst 《廣韻》 has the headline reading 陟革切 _ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3), it also has the in-entry alternative 又丈厄切 _ch(a/)k(9)_ (zaak6). It is unclear whether this is intended as a cross-reference or as a genuine alternative for the "blame" sense. 【謫】 (treak) (_verb-like_) to blame (_verb-like_) to punish, to disgrace
U+8E62 (F2.89 躑) 躑躅蟲名人之奔走追逐也 (F2.89 蹢) 同上

U+8E91 蹢 踯 (Mainland simplified) zik6 (per 《廣韻》直炙切) (F2.89 躑) 躑躅蟲名人之奔走追逐也 (F2.89 蹢) 同上 (Page 13|n56 #10: 躑(9)) Going back and forth (Kangxi: 躑躅猶踟躕也); embarrassed, undecided (Kangxi: 躑躅行不進也); _ch(a/)k(9) chuk(9)_ (zaak6 zuk6 躑躅) irresolute. Williams' "embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed". 【躑】 (drjek) Used in 躑躅. 【躑躅】 (drjek drjowk) (_verb-like_) to pace back and forth (_verb-like_) to stamp feet

zaam1.text: U+7C2A 兂 篸 (F2.63 簪) 首飾也又聚也 (Page 553 #1: (1)簪) A hairpin, clasp, or bodkin, used to confine the hair or fasten the coiffure (Kangxi: 首筓也); to insert in the hair, to stick on the head; quick, brisk, ~~to collect~~ speedily (Kangxi: 疾也); _(1)ts(a/)m (5)p(')(a/)ng_ (zaam1 paang5 簪棒), a hairpin; _(1)ts(a/)m (1)f(a/)_ (zaam1 faa1 簪花), to stick flowers in the hair; _(5)ni(u/) (1)ts(a/)m_ (niu5 zaam1 裊簪), a gay headstall; _yuk(9) (1)ts(a/)m (1)f(a/)_ (juk6 zaam1 faa1 玉簪花), the tuberose; _(1)kai (1)ts(a/)m (5)mai_ (gai1 zaam1 mai5 雞簪米), the fowl pecks the rice---a colloquial phrase. (Page 554 #9: (2)篸 _(2)Ts(')(a/)m_ (caam2); here corrected to _(1)Ts(a/)m_ (zaam1) and normalised to 簪) a hair-pin (Kangxi 篸: 同簪); 【簪】 (tsrim, tsom) (_noun-like_) hairpin (_adjective-like_) swift

zaan2.text: U+5BC1 zaam2 (per 《廣韻》子感切) zip6 (per 《廣韻》疾葉切) (F2.69 寁) 速也 (Page 555 #3: (2)寁) Promptly, quickly (Kangxi: 居之速也); with haste; to hasten, to accelerate. 【寁】 (tsomX, dzjep) (_adverb-like_) hastily

zaam2.text: U+65AC 斩 (Mainland simplified) (F2.64 斬) 截也斷也 (Page 15|n58 #9: (2)斬) To sunder, to cut in two (Kangxi: 截也, 裁也); to cut off (Kangxi: 斬...卽斷也); to execute, to decapitate; capital; to root up; to break off, as ~~intercousre~~ intercourse; ~~faded, forgotten, vanished;~~ _(2)ch(a/)m ~~(1)shui~~ (1)ts(')(u/)i_ (zaam2 ceoi1 斬衰), mourning for parents; _(2)ch(a/)m (5)t(')(un_ (zaam2 tyun5 斬斷), to cut in two, to break off, as a business; _(2)ch(a/)m (4)t(')au_ (zaam2 tau4-2 斬頭), to decollate; _(1)i(u/) (2)ch(a/)m_ (jiu1 zaam2 腰斬), to divide a criminal in the middle; _(2)ch(a/)m (1)teng ts(i/)t(9) t(')(i/)t(8)_ (zaam2 deng1 zit6 tit3 斬釘截鐵) to cut an iron nail---decided, sincere; _(1)k(a/)m (2)ch(a/)m_ (gaam1 zaam2 監斬), to superintend an execution; _(2)ch(a/)m (1)hoi_ (zaam2 hoi1 斬開), to cut open; _(2)ch(a/)m ~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9)_ (zaam2 fat6 斬伐) to subjugate; to prune. Williams' 斬衰: Corrected _(1)shui_ (seoi1) to _(1)ts(')(u/)i_ (ceoi1). Williams' 腰斬: Now used figuratively for midway cancellation or termination. Williams' 斬伐: Changed _f(a/)t(9)_ (faat6) to modern _fat(9)_ (fat6). 【斬】 (tsreamX) (_verb-like_) to chop (off), to sever

U+406A 眨 (Cantonese) 【䁪】 (zaam2) To blink. 䁪吓眼 (zaam2 haa5 ngaan5): "In the blink of an eye." To flash. 眼燈䁪緊 (ngaan5-2 dang1 zaam2 gan2): "The light's flashing." The spelling 䁪 is arbitrary. The alternative spelling 眨 is from appropriation of formal 眨 _ch(a/)p(8)_ (zaap3).

zaam3.text: U+8638 May appear as either ⿱艹醮 or ⿱艹⿱醀灬 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.65 蘸) 以物淬水中 (Page 16|n59 #2: 蘸(3)) To dip (Kangxi: 以物投水也), as a pencil in ink, or sop a morsel in gravy; used by some for baptize. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱艹⿰酉隹 (missing 灬) to 蘸, and corrected 禾 to 水. Williams' "pencil": In the (now) dated sense of a brush.

zaam6.text: U+66AB 蹔 暂 (Mainland simplified) (F2.65 暫) 卽淡切暫時間言不久也 (Page 553 #3: 暫(6)) ~~A part of a day;~~ for the time being, briefly, shortly, for a short time, in the interim, meanwhile (Kangxi: 不久也, 須臾也); suddenly (Kangxi: 暫猶卒也); _ts(a/)m(6) (4)sh(i/)_ (zaam6 si4 暫時), a litte while; _ts(a/)m(6) (2)yan_ (zaam6 jan2 暫忍), be patient; _ts(a/)m(6) (u(6)_ (zaam6 jyu6 暫遇) suddenly met him; _ts(a/)m(6) ch(u(6)_ (zaam6 zyu6 暫住) a temporary lodging; _(2)ho ts(a/)m(6) pat(7) (2)ho (4)sh(e/)ung_ (ho2 zaam6 bat1 ho2 soeng4 可暫不可常), it will do for a temporary arrangement. 【暫】 (dzamH) (_adverb-like_) momentarily (_adverb-like_) suddenly

U+7AD9 zaam3 (per 《廣韻》陟陷切) (F2.71 站 _Ch(a/)n(6)_ (zaan6)) 站立也又音賺 (Page 16|n59 #4: 站(6)) A stage, a journey; _~~yik(7)~~ yik(9) ch(a/)m(6)_ (jik6 zaam6 驛站) a stage; _ch(a/)m(6) (4)t(')au_ (zaam6 tau4 站頭), end of a journey; _yat(7) ch(a/)m(6) l(o\)(6)_ (jat1 zaam6 lou6 一站路) a stage, usually reckoned to be a league. (Page 19|n62 #10: 站(6) _Ch(a/)n(6)_ (zaan6); here corrected to _Ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6)) To stand (Kangxi: 久立也); to stand erect; to stop; a stoppage; _~~ch(a/)n(6)~~ ch(a/)m(6) (2)h(i/) (4)loi_ (zaam6 hei2 loi4 站起來), stand up! _~~ch(a/)n(6)~~ ch(a/)m(6) (1)p(a/)n_ (zaam6 baan1 站班), to file off in rank, and salute an officer. Fan Wan entry: Note that Fan Wan considers _ch(a/)n(6)_ (zaan6) to be the canonical reading of 站, with 賺 to be read _ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6). Williams' 驛站: Corrected _yik(7)_ (jik1) to _yik(9)_ (jik6). Stage meaning a relay station for horses.

U+8CFA 赚 (Mainland simplified) (F2.65 賺) 中淡切猶眈誤也阻之也生意獲利亦曰賺 (Page 16|n59 #3: 賺(6)) To impede, to hinder (Fan Wan: 阻之也); to sell (Kangxi: 賣也), (...); to gain unfairly, to palm off poor goods (Kangxi: 一曰市物失實); _(2)cho ch(a/)m(6)_ (zo2 zaam6 阻賺) to deceive; to hinder. Fan Wan entry: The supplied dissection 中淡切 is incorrect, as it results in the 陰去 reading _ch(a/)m(3)_ (zaam3), rather than the intended 陽去 reading _ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6). Normalised 𫉬 to 獲.

zaan6.text: U+8CFA 贃 赚 (Mainland simplified) zaam6 (per 《集韻》直陷切) (F2.65 賺 _Ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6)) 中淡切猶眈誤也阻之也生意獲利亦曰賺 (Page 16|n59 #3: 賺(6) _Ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6); here normalised to _Ch(a/)n(6)_ (zaan6)) (...) to profit; (Page 20|n63 #1: 贃(6); here normalised to 賺) An unauthorized word. To profit, to make gain in trade; _ch(a/)n(6) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zaan6 cin4-2 賺錢), to make money; _(1)to ch(a/)n(6)_ (do1 zaan6 多賺) profitable; _(5)m(o\) tak(7) ch(a/)n(6)_ (mou5 dak1 zaan6 冇得賺) no profit; _ch(a/)n(6) tak(7) (1)l(o\)_ (zaan6 dak1 lou1 賺得撈), got my outlay back; _ch(a/)n(6) wan(6)_ (zaan6 wan6 賺混) nothing but a trouble. Fan Wan entry: The supplied dissection 中淡切 is incorrect, as it results in the 陰去 reading _ch(a/)m(3)_ (zaam3), rather than the intended 陽去 reading _ch(a/)m(6)_ (zaam6). Normalised 𫉬 to 獲.

zaan2.text: U+5139 儧 (F2.69 儹) 積儹聚也 (Page 555 #1: (2)儧; here normalised to 儹) To accumulate, to collect together, to hoard up, to store (Kangxi 儧: 聚而計事也).

U+373A 𡣶 zaan3 (per 《廣韻》則旰切) zaan6 (per 《廣韻》徂賛切) Arguably, _(2)ts(a/)n_ (zaan2) is a vernacular rising-tone reading of _ts(a/)n(6)_ (zaan6) (per 《廣韻》徂賛切), meaning "pretty" (美好皃); see below. 【㜺】 (zaan2) Wonderful, pretty. 【㜺鬼】 (zaan2 gwai2) Intriguing, pretty, neat. Olden attestation for 㜺 _ts(a/)n(6)_ (zaan6) meaning "pretty": 《廣韻》徂賛切 㜺 不謹也一曰美好皃

U+661D May appear as either ⿱⿺夂人日 (assumed here) or ⿱⿺夂卜日, depending on the font. zaam2 (per 《廣韻》子感切) (F2.69 昝) 姓 (Page 555 #4: (2)昝) Sometimes used for _(1)ts(a/)_ (zaa1) 咱 I, me, in the north. A surname (Kangxi: 姓也).

zaan6.text: U+68E7 桟 栈 (Mainland simplified) zaan2 (per Kangxi 阻限切 for "small-bridge" sense) zaan6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.71 棧) 閣木爲棚曰棧四川有棧道 (Page 19|n62 #11: 棧(6)) ~~A covered loft;~~ palisades; a scaffold (Kangxi: 棚也); a covered, planked road cut out of the side of hills (Kangxi: 閣也, 木棧道也); a hearse (Kangxi: 柩車亦謂之棧), a workshop; a warehouse; a storehouse, a stable (Kangxi: 馬棧亦編木爲之), a pen, a sheepcote; a wooden bridge (Kangxi: 小橋曰棧) or pathway (Kangxi: 編木曰棧); _ch(a/)n(6) (4)fong_ (zaan6-2 fong4 棧房), a warehouse, a packhouse; _ch(a/)n(6) (1)ts(o\)_ (zaan6-2 zou1 棧租), storage charges; _~~(4)mi(u/)~~ (1)m(a/)u ch(a/)n(6)_ (maau1 zaan6-2 貓棧) a kennel for cats. Williams' 貓棧: Changed _(4)mi(u/)_ (miu4) to common reading _(1)m(a/)u_ (maau1). An inn or guesthouse. 【棧】 (dzreanX, dzrjenX, dzraenH) (_noun-like_) plank (_adjective-like_) planked, (_met._) hearse (_noun-like_) cote

zaan2.text: U+7416 盞 (F2.69 醆) 爵也夏曰醆殷曰斝周曰爵皆酒器也 (F2.69 琖) 同上 (Page 19|n62 #5: (2)琖) A wine-cup, made ~~deeper than the preceding (盞),~~ of jade, or other valuable stone (Kangxi: 玉爵也, 玉琖小杯). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 牽 (but with top similar to 立) to 斝. 【琖】 (tsreanX) (_noun-like_) jade-cup

U+76DE 盏 (Mainland simplified) (F2.69 盞) 酒盞 (Page 19|n62 #4: (2)盞) A shallow cup ~~for oil~~ (Kangxi: 杯也, 酒盞最小杯也); a wine saucer; the classifier of lamps; _(1)tang (2)ch(a/)n_ (dang1 zaan2 燈盞), a saucer for a night lamp; _yat(7) (2)ch(a/)n (1)tang_ (jat1 zaan2 dang1 一盞燈), a lamp. 【盞】 (tsreanX) (_noun-like_) cup 【盞】 (zaan2) Classifier for lamps or lights. 盞燈壞咗 (zaan2 dang1 waai6 zo2): "The light's broken." Only, just (for emphasising that a negative outcome is highly likely). The spelling 盞 for this word is arbitrary. 盞嘥氣 (zaan2 saai1 hei3): "Talking to him will just be a waste of breath." 行得慢咪盞遲到 (haang4 dak1 maan6 mai6 zaan2 ci4 dou3): "If we walk slow then we'll only arrive late, won't we?"

U+8DB2 䟎 趱 (Mainland simplified) zaan3 (per 《廣韻》則旰切 for "scatter" sense and 《集韻》則旰切 for "hasten" sense) zaan6 (per 《廣韻》藏旱切 for "scatter" sense) zou1 (per 《集韻》宗蘇切 for "run" sense) (F2.69 趲) 催也促也 (Page 555 #2: (2)䟎; here normalised to 趲) To ~~walk~~ run, to get on (Kangxi 趲: 走也); to flee, to run away, to scatter, to put to flight (Kangxi 趲: 散走也); to hasten, to urge, to quicken, to press (Kangxi 趲: 逼使走也); _(2)ts(a/)n p(o\)(6)_ (zaan2 bou6 趲步) to walk quicker; _(1)ts(')(u/)i (2)ts(a/)n_ (ceoi1 zaan2 催趲), to urge on; _~~yat(7)~~ yat(9) yat(9) (4)loi (2)ts(a/)n_ (jat6 jat6 loi4 zaan2 日日來趲), he comes urging me daily; _(2)ts(a/)n (5)k(')(u (2)h(i/) (1)shan_ (zaan2 keoi5 hei2 san1 趲佢起身), urge him to get out of bed. The reading _(2)ts(a/)n_ (zaan2) is not unattested; Kangxi has 《集韻》...又子罕切 for the "run" sense. However, note that 《集韻》 actually has 子䍐切 for the "hasten" sense, explained 逼使赱也. Williams' 日日來趲: Corrected _yat(7)_ (jat1) to _yat(9)_ (jat6). 【走趲】 (zau2 zaan2) Wiggle room or leeway. 冇得走趲 (mou5 dak1 zau2 zaan2): "There's no wiggle room." 有得走趲 (jau5 dak1 zau2 zaan2): "There's wiggle room."

U+9186 (F2.69 醆) 爵也夏曰醆殷曰斝周曰爵皆酒器也 (F2.69 琖) 同上 (Page 19|n62 #6: (2)醆) Muddy, unsettled spirits (Kangxi: 酒濁而微淸也); liquor beginning to clear; a cup, a goblet (Kangxi: 爵也). 【醆】 (tsreanX) (_noun-like_) wine-cup (_noun-like_) slightly-clarified-wine

zaan6.text: U+64B0 篹 (for "write" and "compile" senses) 譔 (for "write" and "compile" senses) zaan3 (common) (F2.71 撰) 造也脩也述也具也翰林又修撰 (Page 19|n62 #8: 撰(6)) ~~To regulate, to correct, to dispose in order;~~ to grasp (Kangxi: 持也); to compose, to record (Kangxi: 撰述也屬辭記事曰撰); a rule, a statute (Kangxi: 則也); a received maxim; a business, an act; to edit, to revise books, to publish; _(1)sau ch(a/)n(6)_ (sau1 zaan6 修撰) the first H(a/)nlin (翰林) academician; _ch(a/)n(6) shut(9)_ (zaan6 seot6 撰述) to narrate. (Page 19|n62 #9: 譔(6)) Same as the above (撰). _ch(a/)n(6) (4)man_ (zaan6 man4 譔文), to write essays; _p(a/)i(3) ch(a/)n(6)_ (baai3 zaan6 拜譔) to prepare a eulogistic paper. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 㫦 to 脩. An aspiration, an inclination, a bent. 【撰】 (dzrwaenX, dzrjwenX) (_noun-like_) law of nature (_verb-like_) to take hold (_verb-like_) to prepare, to make (_verb-like_) to compose, to compile

zin1.text: U+6FFA 淺 溅 (Mainland simplified) (Page 574 #3: 濺(3) _Ts(i/)n(3)_ (zin3); here corrected to _(1)Ts(i/)n_ (zin1)) A swift current (Kangxi: 濺濺水疾流貌); a raceway;

zin3.text: U+6FFA 湔 溅 (Mainland simplified) (F1.23 濺) 水激酒也 (Page 574 #3: 濺(3)) to spatter up, to dash against; to squirt out, to spurt (Kangxi: 水激也通作湔), as blood. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿰冫賤 to 濺. 【濺】 (tsjenH) (_verb-like_) to spatter

zaan3.text: U+7052 濺 濽 (F2.70 灒) 汚洒也 (Page 555 #7: 濺(3)灒(3)) To ~~stir up~~ spatter muddy water (Kangxi 灒: 汙灑也); ~~turbid water;~~ to spatter; to rebound, to recoil; resilient; _ts(a/)n(3) (2)nan (1)shan_ (zaan3 nan2 san1 灒㤻身), dirtied and splashed; _ts(a/)n(3) (2)h(i/)_ (zaan3 hei2 灒起), to bound back; _ts(a/)n(3) lok(9) t(i/)(6)_ (zaan3 lok6 dei6 灒落地) bounded back on the ground; _ts(a/)n(3) shap(7) (1)shan_ (zaan3 sap1 san1 灒濕身), spattered against me. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 酒 to 洒.

U+74DA 瓉 瓒 (Mainland simplified) zaan6 (per 《廣韻》藏旱切) (F2.70 瓚) 玉瓚祭器也受五升 (Page 555 #8: 瓚(3)) A sort of stone ~~sceptre made with a~~ cup, used in pouring out libations (Kangxi: 瓚亦圭也...以進于神也, 一曰祼器, 瓚者器名 etc.); a kind of bottle used in worship. The reading _ts(a/)n(3)_ (zaan3) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 則旰切, explained 圭也, which can arguably be interpreted in the "cup" sense rather than the "tablet" sense. Impure jade (Kangxi: 三玉二石也). 【瓚】 (dzanX) (_noun-like_) libation-cup (_noun-like_) impure-jade

U+8B9A 讃 贊 赞 (Mainland simplified) (F2.70 讚) 稱美也 (Page 555 #5: 贊(3)) to praise, to commend, in which sense it is interchanged with the next (讚); (Page 555 #6: 讚(3)) To praise, to commend, to laud (Kangxi: 稱人之美曰讚); to sing praises to; to record the praises of (Kangxi: 又錄也); to explain (Kangxi: 解也); _tak(7) (4)yan ts(a/)n(3)_ (dak1 jan4 zaan3 得人讚) to be praised, praiseworthy; _ts(a/)n(3) (5)m(i/)_ (zaan3 mei5 讚美), to praise; _ts(a/)n(3) s(i/)n(6)_ (zaan3 sin6 讚羨) to commend; _tsung(6) ts(a/)n(3)_ (zung6 zaan3 頌讚) to extol, to sing praises to; _ts(a/)n(3) tak(7) kwo(3)_ (zaan3 dak1 gwo3 頌得過) laudable. 【讚】 (tsanH) (_verb-like_) to praise

U+8D0A 讚 賛 赞 (Mainland simplified) (F2.70 贊) 助也佐也又贊頌 (Page 555 #5: 贊(3)) To visit a superior, to come before a god (Kangxi: 見也); to second (Kangxi: 贊佐也), to assist in bringing forward (Kangxi: 出也助也), to introduce, to bring a present to one; to make clear, to bring to light (Kangxi: 贊明也); ~~to go out;~~ to give evidence; _ts(a/)n(3) cho(6)_ (zaan3 zo6 贊助) to aid in, to further; _ts(a/)n(3) (4)t(')ong_ (zaan3 tong4 贊堂), to still a court, as the crier does; _ts(a/)n(3) (4)shing_ (zaan3 sing4 贊成), to assist in bringing about; _ts(a/)n(3) k(i/)n(3)_ (zaan3 gin3 贊見) to visit. (Page 555 #6: 讚(3)) to assist (Kangxi 讚: 佐也); Williams' 贊助: Now has the connotation of *financial* aid, i.e. sponsorship. 【贊】 (tsanH) (_verb-like_) to assist (in), to advance

zaan6.text: U+7DBB 袒 (for "rent" sense) 绽 (Mainland simplified) (F2.71 綻) 衣縫裂也事不完全曰破綻 (Page 19|n62 #14: 綻(6)) A rent seam (Kangxi: 衣縫); to rip, to tear, to rend (Kangxi: 綻猶解也); a hint, inkling; _p(')o(3) ch(a/)n(6)_ (po3 zaan6 破綻) the affair is known, to hint a matter; _(2)t(a/) tak(7) (4)p(')(i/) (1)hoi yuk(9) ch(a/)n(6)_ (daa2 dak1 pei4 hoi1 juk6 zaan6 打得皮開肉綻) beaten till the flesh was laid bare; _ch(a/)n(6) l(i/)t(9)_ (zaan6 lit6 綻裂) rip the seams. To blossom. 綻放 (zaan6 fong3): "To blossom." 【綻】 (dreanH) (_adjective-like_) rent

U+8665 虦 (F2.71 虥) 虎淺毛 (Page 19|n62 #13: 虥(6)) A tiger cat (Kangxi: 貓也); _ch(a/)n(6) ~~(4)m(a/)i~~ (4)mi(u/)_ (zaan6 miu4 虥苗), a tiger ~~shedding its~~ with light-colored hair (Kangxi: 虎竊毛謂之虦貓). Williams' 虥苗: Corrected _(4)m(a/)i_ (maai4) to _(4)mi(u/)_ (miu4). Note that 虥苗 is also spelt 虥貓, as the Middle Chinese reading of 貓 is homophonous with 苗 _(4)mi(u/)_ (miu4).

U+8B54 cyun1 (alternative per 《廣韻》此縁切) zaan3 (common) (F2.71 譔) 脩也作也作文曰譔文 (Page 19|n62 #9: 譔(6)) ~~To exhort by precepts~~ To teach focusedly (Kangxi: 專敎也); To panegyrise (Kangxi: 善言也). 【譔】 (tshjwen, dzrjwenX, dzrjwenH) (_verb-like_) to panegyrise

U+8F1A 轏 (F2.71 輚) 臥車 (Page 19|n62 #12: 輚(6)) A tumbril ~~for carrying the wounded~~; ~~a hearse;~~ _ch(a/)n(6) l(o\)(6)_ (zaan6 lou6 輚輅) a ~~military~~ carriage for sleeping in (Kangxi: 輚輅臥車). Williams' "military carriage": This is a separate sense for 輚 itself (Kangxi: 兵車也).

U+994C May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 籑 䉵 馔 (Mainland simplified) (F2.71 饌) 具食 (Page 19|n62 #7: 饌(6)) To eat, to drink; to feed persons; to provide for (Kangxi: 具食也, 謂饌陳具設之也); dressed food (Kangxi: 飯食也)~~:~~; _ch(')(i/)t(8) ch(a/)n(6)_ (cit3 zaan6 設饌) to set out a dinner; _shing(6) ch(a/)n(6)_ (sing6 zaan6 盛饌) a banquet; _ts(')oi(3) ch(a/)n(6)_ (coi3 zaan6 菜饌) food; _(5)yau mat(7) (4)ng(a/)u ch(a/)n(6)_ (jau5 mat1 ngaau4 zaan6 有乜餚饌) what delicacy did you have for a relish? 【饌】 (dzrjwenH) (_verb-like_) to consume (_verb-like_) to serve (viands) (_noun-like_) viand

zang1.text: U+5D22 峥 崝 caang4 (per 《廣韻》助庚切 and 士耕切) zaang1 (longer syllable) (F2.29 崢) 山峻貌又頭角崢嶸 (Page 21|n64 #2: (1)崢 _(1)Ch(a/)ng_ (zaang1); here normalised to _(1)Chang_ (zang1)) To rise above; conspicuous, eminent, like a lofty mountain (Kangxi: 崝嶸也); _(4)t(')au kok(8) ~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang ~~(4)ying~~ (4)wing_ (tau4 gok3 zang1 wing4 頭角崢嶸) a noble appearance, dignified. Williams' 頭角崢嶸: Corrected _(4)ying_ (jing4) to _(4)wing_ (wing4).

zaang1.text: U+68E6 May appear as either ⿰木争 (+6) or ⿰木爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font.

zang1.text: U+68E6 May appear as either ⿰木争 (+6) or ⿰木爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. caang1 (per 《廣韻》楚耕切) zaang1 (longer syllable) (F2.29 棦) 木節 (Page 20|n63 #9: (1)棦) A bundle of sticks, a number of sticks tied up into a faggot (Kangxi: 木束也).

U+722D 争 諍 zaang1 (longer syllable) (F2.29 爭) 爭競爭闘 (Page 20|n63 #13: (1)爭 _(1)Ch(a/)ng_ (zaang1); here normalised to _(1)Chang_ (zang1) when appropriate) To wrangle, to strive for precedence (Kangxi: 引也, 競也); to contest, to litigate (Kangxi: 訟也); ~~A colloquial word;~~ ~~just, only, nearly, a little;~~ _~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang noi(6)_ (zang1 noi6 爭奈) but still, howbeit, nevertheless; _(1)ch(a/)ng t(a/)m(6) h(i/)(3)_ (zaang1 daam6 hei3 爭啖氣) unforgiving, choleric; _(1)ch(a/)ng (4)l(i/) (4)h(o\)_ (zaang1 lei4 hou4 爭釐毫), to quarrel upon trifles; _(1)ch(a/)ng mat(7) (5)y(e/)_ (zaang1 mat1 je5 爭乜嘢), what are you quarreling about? _(1)ch(a/)ng tik(7) (5)sh(e/)ung tong(3)_ (zaang1 dik1 soeng5 dong3 爭滴上當) I came near being gulled; _~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang tau(3)_ (zang1 dau3 爭鬥) to fight, to fall to blows; _~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang tsung(6)_ (zang1 zung6 爭訟) to go to law; _(1)ch(a/)ng (1)kung_ (zaang1 gung1 爭功), to ~~emulate~~ claim merit; _~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang ~~t(ut(8)~~ t(ut(9)_ (zang1 dyut6 爭奪) to take by force; _~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang chap(7)_ (zang1 zap1 爭執) obstinate; _(1)ch(a/)ng (5)yau h(a/)n(6)_ (zaang1 jau5 haan6 爭有限) differs a little; _(1)ch(a/)ng tik(7) chuk(7) (2)t(o\) (5)k(')(u_ (zaang1 dik1 zuk1 dou3-2 keoi5 爭滴捉到佢), all but caught him; _~~(1)ch(a/)ng~~ (1)chang (a/)u(3)_ (zang1 aau3 爭詏) to dispute; _(1)ch(a/)ng tak(7) ~~(1)t(o\)~~ (1)to_ (zaang1 dak1 do1 爭得多), very different; not enough; _(1)ch(a/)ng kau(3)_ (zaang1 gau3 爭夠) I'm tired of striving, I'll contend no more. Fan Wan places 爭 under the short syllable _(1)chang_ (zang1); Williams places it under the longer _(1)ch(a/)ng_ (zaang1). The longer syllable _(1)ch(a/)ng_ (zaang1) is preferred in the vernacular register, so normalisation to the shorter _(1)chang_ (zang1) is only appropriate in some instances. Williams' "A colloquial word" etc.: Yes it is a vernacular word, but the meaning is to differ or to lack (see below), not "just", "only", etc. Williams' 爭奪: Corrected _t(ut(8)_ (dyut3) to _t(ut(9)_ (dyut6). Williams' 爭得多: Corrected _(1)t(o\)_ (dou1) to _(1)to_ (do1). 【爭】 (tsreang) (_verb-like_) to strive, to dispute 【爭】 (zaang1) To differ by. 爭好遠 (zaang1 hou2 jyun5): "Off by very far" 爭少少 (zaang1 siu2 siu2): "Off by a little." 爭啲 (zaang1 di1): "Off by a bit." To lack, to be missing, to be short. 爭對筷子 (zaang1 deoi3 faai3 zi2): "Short a pair of chopsticks." 爭一毫 (zaang1 jat1 hou4): "Ten cents short." To owe. 爭住先 (zaang1 zyu6 sin1): "I owe you for now" (i.e. I'll pay you back later). 爭佢錢 (zaang1 keoi5 cin4-2): "I owe him money." 【爭在】 (zaang1 zoi6) To matter. Especially used in contrast to something that does not matter (or in contrast to something that does matter when used in the negative, 唔爭在). 輸就輸硬、爭在輸幾多 (syu1 zau6 syu1 ngaang6, zaang1 zoi6 syu1 gei2 do1): "Yes they've lost for sure, but what matters now is how much they lose by." 唔爭在遲多兩分鐘 (m4 zaang1 zoi6 ci4 do1 loeng5 fan1 zung1): "It won't matter that we're two more minutes late on top of how late we are now." To be lacking in, or to fall short in. 平就平、爭在唔夠飽 (peng4 zau6 peng4, zaang1 zoi6 m4 gau3 baau2): "Yes it's cheap, but it falls short in that it's not adequately filling."

zaang1.text: U+7424 May appear as either ⿰𤣩争 (+6) or ⿰𤣩爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font.

zang1.text: U+7424 May appear as either ⿰𤣩争 (+6) or ⿰𤣩爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. caang1 (per 《廣韻》楚庚切 and 楚耕切) zaang1 (longer syllable) (F2.29 琤) 玉聲 (Page 20|n63 #10: (1)琤) The tinkling sound of gems when they are struck or rung together (Kangxi: 玉聲).

U+7B8F 筝 zaang1 (longer syllable) (F2.29 筝) 樂器十二絃 (Page 20|n63 #7: (1)箏) A kind of harpsichord with 12 copper strings (Kangxi: 鼓絃竹身樂也, 箏瑟類本十二絃今則十三); _(1)fung (1)chang_ (fung1 zang1 風箏), glasses hung to jingle in the wind; _(2)l(a/) (1)chang_ (laa2 zang1 揦箏), to thrum the guitar; _fong(3) (1)fung (1)chang_ (fong3 fung1 zang1 放風箏), to fly a singing kite.

zaang1.text: U+3B39 May appear with right component 争 (+6) or 爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. 踭 zang1 (per Fan Wan) (F2.29 踭 _(1)Chang_ (zang1)) 足跟筋也 (Page 21|n64 #1: (1)㬹) The tendon Achilles (Kangxi: 足跟筋也); the heel; the elbow; _yat(7) (1)ch(a/)ng (2)t(a/) kwo(3) h(u(3)_ (jat1 zaang1 daa2 gwo3 heoi3 一㬹打過去) elbowed him off; _(2)cham (1)ch(a/)ng_ (zam2 zaang1 枕㬹), to lean on the elbow; _t(')(a/)t(8) (1)ch(a/)ng (4)h(a/)i_ (taat3 zaang1 haai4 撻㬹鞋), slipshod; _(4)h(a/)i (1)ch(a/)ng_ (haai4 zaang1 鞋㬹), heel of the shoe; _(2)shau (1)ch(a/)ng_ (sau2 zaang1 手㬹), the elbow. 【㬹】 (zaang1) The heel. 腳㬹 (goek3 zaang1): "Heel of the foot." 鞋㬹 (haai4 zaang1): "Heel of a shoe." The elbow. 手㬹 (sau2 zaang1): "The elbow."
U+8E2D May appear as either ⿰𧾷争 (+6) or ⿰𧾷爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.29 踭 _(1)Chang_ (zang1)) 足跟筋也
U+931A May appear as either ⿰釒争 (+6) or ⿰釒爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font.

zang1.text: U+931A May appear as either ⿰釒争 (+6) or ⿰釒爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. 鏳 铮 (Mainland simplified) caang1 (per 《廣韻》楚耕切) zaang1 (longer syllable) (F2.29 錚) 金聲 (Page 20|n63 #11: (1)錚) A small cymbal, a small sized gong (Kangxi: 鉦也); the ringing sound of metals (Kangxi: 金聲也). The reading _(1)chang_ (zang1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 甾莖切, explained 說文金聲也.

zaang3.text: U+8ACD May appear as either ⿰訁争 (+6) or ⿰訁爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font.

zang1.text: U+8ACD May appear as either ⿰訁争 (+6) or ⿰訁爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font.

zang3.text: U+8ACD May appear as either ⿰訁争 (+6) or ⿰訁爭 (+8 assumed here), depending on the font. 争 爭 诤 (Mainland simplified) zaang3 (longer syllable) (F2.29 諍 _Chang(6)_ (zang6)) 諫諍救正之也 (Page 20|n63 #12: 諍(3)) To remonstrate with; to stop a wrong (Kangxi: 止也, 謂止其失也, 諫諍救正也); _k(a/)n(3) chang(3)_ (gaan3 zang3 諫諍) to reprove one's sovereign; to reprehend. (Page 20|n63 #13: (1)爭 _(1)Ch(a/)ng_ (zaang1); _Chang(3)_ (zang3) implied) to reprove, to remonstrate, in which senses it is used for the last (諍) (Kangxi 爭: 本作諍諫諍也止也). Fan Wan entry: 諍 is spuriously placed under the final _ang(6)_ (ang6).

zaap3.text: U+5284 剳 箚 (F2.66 劄) 帋劄又以針刺也又柬疏謂之劄子 (Page 22|n65 #4: 劄(8)) To prick, to puncture (Kangxi 箚: 以鍼刺也); to embroider; a document, a paper (Kangxi 箚: 牋劄用以奏事非表非狀者謂之劄子); a particular sort of paper; ~~a diploma;~~ a contract; to write out, as a list of prices; a reply from a higher officer; ~~a remonstrance to the emperor;~~ _(2)ch(i/) ch(a/)p(8)_ (zi2 zaap3 紙劄) stationery; _ch(a/)p(8) (2)tsz'_ (zaap3 zi2 劄子) ~~a remonstrance~~; _k(a/)m(3) ch(a/)p(8)_ (gaam3 zaap3 監劄) a diploma bought by a _kiensang_ (監生)_;_ _ch(a/)p(8) k(a/)(3) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zaap3 gaa3 cin4 劄價錢), write the prices; _ch(a/)p(8) lok(9) p(o\)(6)_ (zaap3 lok6 bou6-2 劄落簿) put it to account; _ch(a/)p(8) (1)t(a/)n_ (zaap3 daan1 劄單), a contract for a purchase. The word _chop_, used in Canton is derived from this. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 剌 to 刺. Kangxi has 箚 (⿱𥫗㓣) for the headword, but 劄 (⿰答刂) in the explanations.

U+531D 帀 迊 saap3 (per Williams) (F2.66 匝) 作荅切適也遍也 (Page 408 #5: 匝(8) _S(a/)p(8)_ (saap3); here normalised to _Ts(a/)p(8)_ (zaap3)) To make a circuit, to go the rounds, like a watchman; pervading; a revolution; a side, a row; _(1)chau ~~s(a/)p(8)~~ ts(a/)p(8)_ (zau1 zaap3 周匝) to go about everywhere; _(1)s(a/)m ~~s(a/)p(8)~~ ts(a/)p(8)_ (saam1 zaap3 三匝) on three sides; _yat(7) ~~s(a/)p(8)~~ ts(a/)p(8)_ (jat1 zaap3 一匝) a row. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing and incomplete strokes in 切適. 【匝】 (tsop) (_noun-like_) circuit, turn

U+8936 zip3 (per 襵) (Page 22* #5: 褶(8) _Ch(i/)p(8)_ (zip3)) Used for the last (襵), but always read _ch(a/)p(8)_ or _ts(a/)p(8)_ (both zaap3). _(4)kw(')an ch(a/)p(8)_ (kwan4 zaap3 裙褶) the plaits on a petticoat; _(2)t(a/) ~~ch(i/)p(8)~~ ch(a/)p(8)_ (daa2 zaap3 打褶) to tighten the girdle. For the literary word, see 襵 zip3. Williams' 打褶: Changed _ch(i/)p(8)_ (zip3) to common reading _ch(a/)p(8)_ (zaap3).

zaap6.text: U+8936 (Page 22* #5: 褶(8) _Ch(i/)p(8)_ (zip3); here corrected to _Ts(a/)p(9)_ (zaap6)) a lined riding jacket (Kangxi: 袴褶騎服); _f(u/)(3) ~~ch(a/)p(8)~~ ts(a/)p(9)_ (fu3 zaap6 袴褶) overalls for horseback;
U+6781 (Page 22|n65 #7: 极(9)) A colloquial word. A camp chair; _(5)m(a/) ch(a/)p(9)_ (maa5 zaap6 馬极) a camp-stool; _ch(a/)p(9) chak(7) fan(3)_ (zaap6 zak1 fan3 极側瞓) to sleep on the side.

U+69E2 (F2.39 槢 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 堅木 (Page 559 #1: 槢(9)) Firm, hard wood (Kangxi: 堅木); durable timber; _ts(a/)p(9) muk(9)_ (zaap6 muk6 槢木) any kind of hard wood. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰米習 to 槢. A connector-peg (Kangxi: 械楔).

U+7FD2 习 (Mainland simplified) (F2.39 習 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 學慣熟也狎也練也 (Page 558 #6: 習(9)) ~~A continued flight~~ Flight by repetition (Kangxi: 數飛也); to repeat the same act, to practice, to get accustomed to, to become skilled in; practice, use, custom, habit, exercise, repetition (Kangxi: 習重也); _hok(9) ts(a/)p(9)_ (hok6 zaap6 學習) apprenticed to; to learn about; _ts(a/)p(9) kw(a/)n(3) (4)shing tsz'(6) (4)(i/)n_ (zaap6 gwaan3 sing4 zi6 jin4 習慣成自然), practice makes it natural; _ts(a/)p(9) shuk(9)_ (zaap6 suk6 習熟) well versed in, habituated to; _ts(a/)p(9) l(i/)n(6)_ (zaap6 lin6 習練) practice; _ts(a/)p(9) (2)hau (1)yam_ (zaap6 hau2 jam1 習口音), to practice speaking; _ts(a/)p(9) (4)(i/) pat(7) ch(')(a/)t(8)_ (zaap6 ji4 bat1 caat3 習而不察) to take without examination, careless practice; _ts(a/)p(9) (4)'m t(o\)(3)_ (zaap6 m4 dou3-2 習唔到) cannot learn the use of it; _ts(a/)p(9) tsuk(9) ~~(5)sh(i/)~~ (2)sz' (4)(i/)n_ (zaap6 zuk6 si2 jin4 習俗使然), I've learned the usages. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 綀 to 練. Williams' "A continued flight": Better rendered "Flight by repetition". In Kangxi 數飛也, note that 數 is to be read in entering tone, _shok(8)_ (sok3). Williams' 習俗使然: Corrected _(5)sh(i/)_ (si5) to _(2)sz'_ (si2). An acquaintance, a familiar. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【習】 (zip) (_verb-like_) to practise (_adjective-like_) gentle
U+894D (F2.40 雜 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 參錯也亂也 (F2.40 襍 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 同上 (F2.66 雜) 叅錯也五綵相合也 (F2.66 襍) 同上 (Page 558 #3: 雜(9)襍(9))

U+8972 㦻 袭 (Mainland simplified) zap6 (shorter syllable) (F2.39 襲 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 重衣也因也又潛師揜取曰襲 (Page 558 #5: 襲(9)) Double garments (Kangxi: 重衣也)~~, lined robes, a court dress~~; a suit; a robe fastened on the left side (Kangxi: 左袵袍也); ~~collected~~ to match (Kangxi: 合也); repeated (Kangxi: 重也); to make a foray, to invade, to steal into (Kangxi: 掩其不備也); to receive, to inherit (Kangxi: 受也); hereditary, descending in a family; _shai(3) ts(a/)p(9)_ (sai3 zaap6 世襲) hereditary; _ts(a/)p(9) yam(3)_ (zaap6 jam3 襲蔭) hereditary protection and pension --- for the merit of ancestors; _yat(7) ts(a/)p(9) (1)(i/)_ (jat1 zaap6 ji1 一襲衣), a suit of clothes; _shai(3) ts(a/)p(9) (2)tsz' ts(e/)uk(8)_ (sai3 zaap6 zi2 zoek3 世襲子爵) a hereditary baron. Williams' "Double garments": Seen classically in the verb sense, i.e. to put on a second layer of clothing. Williams' "a court dress": This is a misreading of Kangxi 襲朝服 as a definition, when it is actually an example for the verb sense 服也, to wear. Williams' "collected": This is a misreading of Kangxi 合也. Here, 合 means "match". To wear (Kangxi: 服也). 【襲】 (zip) (_verb-like_) to layer (up), to shroud (_verb-like_) to repeat (_verb-like_) to herit (_verb-like_) to raid

U+9212 钑 (Mainland simplified) zaap6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (Page 22|n65 #6: 鈒(9)) A colloquial word. One bladed shears working on a pivot; to slice or pare with shears; _ch(a/)p(9) (1)hoi_ (zaap6 hoi1 鈒開), cut it open; _(1)pan (4)long ch(a/)p(9)_ (ban1 long4 zaap6-2 檳榔鈒) betel-nut shears; _ch(a/)p(9) y(e/)uk(9) (4)ts(')oi_ (zaap6 joek6 coi4 鈒藥材), to slice medicine; _ch(a/)p(9) sui(3)_ (zaap6 seoi3 鈒碎) slice it fine. 【鈒-noun】 (zaap6, zaap6-2) Shears. 【鈒-verb】 (zaap6) To cut or slice, especially with shears. The spelling 鈒 is arbitrary.

U+9598 闸 (Mainland simplified) aap3 (per 《廣韻》烏甲切 for "barrier" sense) gap3 (per 《廣韻》古盍切 for "shut" sense) (F2.66 閘) 閘門 (Page 22|n65 #5: 閘(9)) A guarded gate, a barrier, a barricade (Kangxi: 開閉門也); dam; a barrier like a turnstile or a stockade; a lock, a flood-gate; to shut a gate (Kangxi: 閉門也); _ch(a/)p(9) ts(a/)p(9)_ (zaap6 zaap6 閘？) a guard-house at a gate; _(1)kw(a/)n ch(a/)p(9)_ (gwaan1 zaap6 關閘) to shut the gate; the Barrier at Macao; _(2)shui ch(a/)p(9)_ (seoi2 zaap6 水閘) a waste-weir, a mill-race or sluice with gates; _ch(a/)p(9) (1)f(u/)_ (zaap6 fu1 閘夫) a gatekeeper; _(1)hon ch(a/)p(9)_ (hon1 zaap6 看閘) to guard the gate; _ch(a/)p(9) (4)m(u/)n_ (zaap6 mun4 閘門), a street gate; _(5)sh(e/)ung ch(a/)p(9)_ (soeng5 zaap6 上閘) put in the bars.

U+96B0 (F2.39 隰 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 下溼曰隰 (Page 559 #2: 隰(9)) Low, marshy land (Kangxi: 下濕曰隰); a pool, a morass, wet meadows at the base of hills (Kangxi: 阪下濕也); _ts(a/)p(9) (4)t(')(i/)n_ (zaap6 tin4 隰田), low wet fields, marshes. Newly cleared or developed land (Kangxi: 隰謂新發田也). The waterside or riverside (Kangxi: ...水邊也). 【隰】 (zip) (_noun-like_) marshland

U+96C6 (F2.40 集 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 聚集會集 (Page 558 #4: 集(9)) To flock together on a tree (Kangxi: 本作雧羣鳥在木上也); to gather, as clouds; to assemble, to come together, to congregate, to collect (Kangxi: 合也, 聚也會也); to bring together (Kangxi: 同也, 集齊也); ~~to go directly to the mark;~~ to mix properly, to blend; to make a collection, to compile (Kangxi: 雜也); a miscellany, ana; a place where people collect, as a market; ~~often interchanged with the last (雜);~~ _(4)ts(')ai ts(a/)p(9)_ (cai4 zaap6 齊集) came together, a full concourse; _(4)man ts(a/)p(9)_ (man4 zaap6 文集) a miscellany; _yat(7) ts(a/)p(9)_ (jat1 zaap6 一集) one division of a book, what is collected under one head; _ts(a/)p(9) (u/)i(6) h(i/)(3)_ (zaap6 wui6 hei3 集會戲) a varied bill, as at a theatre; _(1)chung yat(9) h(a/)p(9) ts(a/)p(9)_ (zung1 jat6 haap6 zaap6 終日狎集) friends here the whole day; _(1)t(')(i/)n h(a/)(6) (4)wan ts(a/)p(9)_ (tin1 haa6 wan4 zaap6 天下雲集) crowded together from all quarters; _ts(u(6) ts(a/)p(9)_ (zeoi6 zaap6 聚集) to assemble, to collect. Williams' "to go directly to the mark": Perhaps intended for Kangxi 就也成也, but that is better rendered "accomplished" or "completed". 【集】 (dzip) (_verb-like_) to perch (together) (_verb-like_) to collect

U+96DC 什 襍 雑 杂 (Mainland simplified) zaap6-2 (in 打雜, and rising second in vernacular 雜雜地) (F2.40 雜 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 參錯也亂也 (F2.40 襍 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 同上 (F2.66 雜) 叅錯也五綵相合也 (F2.66 襍) 同上 (Page 558 #3: 雜(9)襍(9)) A mixture of different colors (Kangxi 雜: 五彩相合也) or ingredients; particolored, streaked; mixed, unassorted, blended, mingled, confused; various, all sorts, miscellaneous, heterogenous, fragmentary (Kangxi 雜: 碎也); to mix, to confuse; ~~to repeat;~~ to revolve (Kangxi 雜: 帀也); to bore through (Kangxi 雜: 穿也); _ts(a/)p(9) fo(3)_ (zaap6 fo3 雜貨) miscellaneous goods; _ts(a/)p(9) fo(3) p(')(o\)(3)_ (zaap6 fo3 pou3 雜貨舖) a variety store; _ts(a/)p(9) shik(7)_ (zaap6 sik1 雜色) variegated; _(1)sam ts(a/)p(9)_ (sam1 zaap6 心雜) distracted, not keeping long at a purpose; _ts(a/)p(9) (2)chung (2)tsai_ (zaap6 zung2 zai2 雜種仔), a bastard; _ts(a/)p(9) (4)t(')ong (2)kwo_ (zaap6 tong4 gwo2 雜糖果), chowchow sweetmeats; _(5)'ng (1)fong ts(a/)p(9) ~~(2)ch(')(u~~ (5)ch(')(u_ (ng5 fong1 zaap6 cyu5 五方雜處), a place where all sorts of people live; _ts(a/)p(9) l(un(6)_ (zaap6 lyun6 雜亂) confused, put in disorder; _(4)h(a/)n ts(a/)p(9) (4)yan (2)tang_ (haan4 zaap6 jan4 dang2 閒雜人等) loafers, idlers; _(2)t(a/) ts(a/)p(9)_ (daa2 zaap6-2 打雜) man of all work; _shik(9) ts(a/)p(9)_ (sik6 zaap6 食雜) to eat anything, not to fast; _l(a/)p(9) ts(a/)p(9)_ (laap6 zaap6 垃雜) miscellaneous, a medley. Williams' "unassorted": Meaning "unsorted" or "miscellaneous". Williams' 五方雜處: Changed _(2)ch(')(u_ (cyu2) to common reading _(5)ch(')(u_ (cyu5). 【雜】 (dzop) (_adjective-like_) mingled 【垃雜】 (laap6 zaap6) Disorganised or cluttered. Commonly spelt 立雜 (see discussion below). 【雜】 (zaap6) Used to describe a place as dodgy, due to the presence of miscellaneous unsavoury characters. 城好雜 (seng4-2 hou2 zaap6): "The city is very dodgy." Offal. 牛雜 (ngau4 zaap6): "Beef assortment of offal." (In Hong Kong noodle shops, the typical parts are tripe (肚 tou5), lung (肺 fai3), intestine (腸 coeng4-2), and spleen (膀 bong2).) 【雜崩冷】 (zaap6 ba1 lang1, zaap6 baa1 laang1, zaap6 bang1 lang1) Miscellaneous. The spelling 崩冷 for the suffix is arbitrary. There is an argument that 垃雜 _l(a/)p(9) ts(a/)p(9)_ (laap6 zaap6) should be spelt 擸𢶍. Indeed 擸𢶍 has an expected reading of _lap(9) tsap(9)_ (lap6 zap6), and is explained "broken" or "cluttered": 《廣韻》盧盍切 擸 折也又擸𢶍破壞也 《廣韻》才盍切 𢶍 擸𢶍和雜 《康熙字典》𢶍 《唐韻》才盍切《集韻》疾盍切𠀤音䪞讀若慙入聲擸𢶍和雜也... However, since 擸𢶍 is also considered the original spelling of 垃圾 laap6 saap3 "rubbish", it would be confusing to use it for laap6 zaap6 also. As a compromise that acknowledges the possible common ancestry, I have opted to spell laap6 zaap6 as 垃雜, even though the common spelling is 立雜.

U+972B (F2.40 霫 _Tsap(9)_ (zap6)) 大雨 (Page 559 #3: 霫(9)) A great shower (Kangxi: 雴霫大雨也), (...); an ancient tribe of northerners ~~near Corea or Manchuria~~, spoken of during the T(')(a/)ng (唐) dynasty (Kangxi: 白霫北狄國). Williams' "near Corea or Manchuria": This is an erroneous merging of two distinct proper-noun (barbarian group) senses: 霫 _sap(7)_ (sap1) as in 奚霫 from the north-east (see 霫 sap1); and 霫 _ts(a/)p(9)_ (zaap6) as in 白霫 from the north. The second of these is the one where Kangxi has an example from 《唐書回鶻傳》.

zaat3.text: U+624E (F2.72 扎) 拔也作也 (Page 24|n67 #7: 扎(8)) To pluck up (Kangxi: 拔也); To pierce, to jab, to push through. To spread, to extend. Used in 掙扎 (to struggle, to break free). 【扎醒】 (zaat3 seng2) To wake with a start. 【扎扎跳】 (zaat3 zaat3 tiu3) To jump up and down rapidly. The spelling 扎 in these terms is arbitrary (but well established).

U+672D 扎 (F2.72 札) 柬也又書札 (Page 24|n67 #8: 札(8)) A tablet for writing (Kangxi: 牒也, 牒亦木牘也); a letter, a document, writings; untimely death (Kangxi: 夭死爲札); a thin slip of wood (Kangxi: 札木簡之薄小者也); fold of armor (Kangxi: 甲葉也); a paddle (Kangxi: 撥水之櫂曰札形似札也); _ng(a/)n(6) ch(a/)t(8)_ (ngaan6 zaat3 雁札) an epistle; _(2)k(a/)n ch(a/)t(8)_ (gaan2 zaat3 柬札) or _(1)sh(u ch(a/)t(8)_ (syu1 zaat3 書札) a letter. 【札】 (tsreat) (_noun-like_) slip (_noun-like_) pestilence

U+7D2E 扎 紥 (F2.72 扎) 拔也作也 (Page 24|n67 #7: 扎(8); here normalised to 紮) to bind, to bind around, to bundle up (Kangxi 紮: 纏束也); a bundle; to make or cut out paper images; _ch(a/)t(8) yat(7) ch(a/)t(8)_ (zaat3 jat1 zaat3 紮一紮) bind it into a bundle; _ch(a/)t(8) k(e/)uk(8)_ (zaat3 goek3 紮腳) to bind the feet of girls; _ch(a/)t(8) (2)kan_ (zaat3 gan2 紮緊), bind it tight; _(2)ch(i/) ch(a/)t(8)_ (zi2 zaat3 紙紮) paper houses, &c., to burn to the dead; also paper strings; _ch(a/)t(8) (4)m(a/)i (5)k(')(u_ (zaat3 maai4 keoi5 紮埋佢), tie it up in a roll; _yat(7) ch(a/)t(8) (1)f(a/)_ (jat1 zaat3 faa1 一紮花), a nosegay; _ch(a/)t(8) tak(7) (1)shang_ (zaat3 dak1 sang1 紮得生), cut out to the life. To station. 紮營 (zaat3 jing4): "Set up camp." 【紮馬】 (zaat3 maa5) To do the horse stance.

zyut3.text: U+8301 zaat3 (alternative per 《廣韻》鄒滑切) (F2.72 茁 _Ch(a/)t(8)_ (zaat3)) 肥壯貌 (Page 24|n67 #10: 茁(8) _Ch(a/)t(8)_ (zaat3); here normalised to _Ch(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) Grass or plants starting out of the ground (Kangxi: 草初生貌); fat, hearty, vigorous (Fan Wan: 肥壯貌), grown (Kangxi: 茁生長貌), said of cattle; _(2)ts(')(o\) ~~ch(a/)t(8)~~ ch(ut(8) (4)k(')(i/) (4)ng(a/)_ (cou2 zyut3 kei4 ngaa4 草茁其芽), the grass is sprouting. 【茁】 (tsrjwet, tsrweat) (_adjective-like_) sprouting, (_met._) thriving

zaat3.text: U+8ECB 轧 (Mainland simplified) aat3 (per 《廣韻》烏黠切) (Page 24|n67 #9: 軋(8)) ~~Creaking~~ To crush with the roll of a wheel (Kangxi: 車輾也); a creaking, grating, sound; punishment of the ~~rack or~~ wheel (Kangxi: 𠛬名); _(1)s(e/)ung (4)mo ch(a/)t(8)_ (soeng1 mo4 zaat3 相磨軋) to harass or impede each other; _ch(a/)t(8) ch(a/)t(8)_ (zaat3 zaat3 軋軋) creaking, jingling. Williams' "Creaking": This is a misreading of Kangxi 車載重蹍軋有聲也 as a definition, when it is actually an example. 【軋】 ('eat) (_verb-like_) to crush

zaat6.text: U+66F1 (Page 560 #2: 曱(9) _Ts(')(a/)t(9)_ (caat6); here corrected to _Ts(a/)t(9)_ (zaat6)) Williams erroneously places this under _ts(')(a/)t(9)_ (caat6), notwithstanding the reading within the entry is correctly _ts(a/)t(9)_ (zaat6).

U+7534 曱 (in 曱甴 spelt 甴曱) zaat6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (Page 560 #2: 曱(9) _Ts(')(a/)t(9)_ (caat6); here corrected to _Ts(a/)t(9)_ (zaat6) and normalised to 甴) A colloquial word. _~~(1)K(a/)~~ K(a/)t(9) ts(a/)t(9)_ (gaat6 zaat6 曱甴) a cockroach. Williams' 曱甴: Changed _(1)K(a/)_ (gaa1) to _K(a/)t(9)_ (gaat6). The second character is correctly _ts(a/)t(9)_ (zaat6) despite the entry being erroneously placed under _ts(')(a/)t(9)_ (caat6). 【曱甴】 (gaat6 zaat6, gaat6 zaat6-2) A cockroach. It is disputed whether gaat6 zaat6 is written 曱甴 or 甴曱 (neither character appears in the Middle Chinese rime books). The form 曱甴 is commonly used, but the form 甴曱 is considered standard by HK Education Bureau's Lexical Items and by 《商務新字典》 (ISBN: 9620701402). A blog post by 陳凱文 has investigated this dispute. To paraphrase, his concluding points include that: Based on the readings recorded in 《四聲篇海》, 《篇海類編》, and 《字彙補》, neither 曱甴 nor 甴曱 have an expected reading of exactly gaat6 zaat6, but 甴曱 is the reading with the greater discrepancy. It is possible that the form 甴曱 arose from a mistake by Eitel in parsing 反切 readings when looking up older Chinese sources, with modern dictionary editors following Eitel's form. The HK Education Bureau should not insist on the form 甴曱. I concur with points 1 and 3 above. I disagree with point 2 above, because Eitel's work is based off of Williams', which had already used the form 甴曱 in 1856 (notwithstanding Williams' reading is _(1)k(a/) ts(a/)t(9)_ (gaa1 zaat6)). Moreover, I am obliged to point out some inaccuracies in 陳凱文's post: Whilst 陳凱文's text refers to the 1877 edition of Eitel's ''A Chinese Dictionary in the Cantonese Dialect'' (wherein 甴 is found under _K(a/)t(9)_ (gaat6) on Page 228), 陳凱文's screenshot is actually of the *1910* edition of Eitel's dictionary *revised and enlarged by Immanuel Gottlieb Genahr* (wherein 甴 is found under _K(a/)t(9)_ (gaat6) on Page 330). In my copy of 《商務新字典》, whose colophon has 9th print, August 1996 as the latest entry in the list of editions, the native reading for 甴 (on Page 438, under Radical ⽥) is "〔駕壓切低入〕", not just "【駕壓切】" as written by 陳凱文. It is possible that this discrepancy is down to edition (but I note that the year 1992 referenced by 陳凱文 does not appear in the list of editions in the colophon of my edition). In any case, I do not believe that modern dictionary editors have "虛構出一個【駕壓切】" as claimed by 陳凱文. Instead, "〔駕壓切低入〕" in 《商務新字典》 is just a modern (i.e. *not* Middle Chinese) and native (i.e. *not* romanisation) but clumsy way of representing the reading gaat6.

zaau1.text: U+5541 (F2.41 啁) 啁嘐聲 (Page 28|n71 #10: (1)啁) Chirping, bickering of birds (Kangxi: 啁哳鳥鳴也); _(1)ch(a/)u (1)ch(a/)u (1)sheng_ (zaau1 zaau1 seng1 啁啁聲), chirping of birds. This reading is used in 啁哳, 啁嘐.

zau1.text: U+5541 Used in 啁噍 (sound of birds) (Kangxi: 啁噍鳥聲). 【啁】 (trjuw) Used in 啁噍.

zaau1.text: U+5632 啁 謿 (F2.41 嘲) 以言相譏笑也 (Page 28|n71 #9: (1)嘲) To deride, to jeer at (Kangxi: 謔也); to ridicule; ~~raillery;~~ _p(a/)k(9) (1)ch(a/)u_ (baak6 zaau1 白嘲), a pasquinade; _(1)ch(a/)u si(u/)(3)_ (zaau1 siu3 嘲笑) to laugh at; _(1)ch(a/)u m(a/)(6)_ (zaau1 maa6 嘲罵) to jeer and rail at. (Page 28|n71 #10: (1)啁) Interchanged with the last (嘲) (Kangxi 啁: 與嘲謿通). Williams' "raillery": To my knowledge, 嘲 is used for malicious or spiteful ridicule, not for good-natured banter. To recite (especially metrical poetry).

zaau2.text: U+5E1A 菷 箒 zau2 (per 《廣韻》之九切) (F1.53 帚 _(2)Chau_ (zau2)) 帚彗掃也 (Page 25|n68 #12: (2)帚(2)箒 _(2)Chau_ (zau2); here normalised to _(2)Ch(a/)u_ (zaau2)) A besom (Kangxi 箒: 箕箒也); a broom; to sweep up dirt (Kangxi 帚: 糞也, 掃除糞穢也), for which the first (帚) is most proper; _chap(7) (1)k(i/) ~~(2)chau~~ (2)ch(a/)u_ (zap1 gei1 zaau2 執箕帚), term for a wife or concubine. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing character 帚. 【帚】 (tsyuwX) (_noun-like_) besom

zau2.text: U+5E1A (F1.53 帚) 帚彗掃也 (Page 25|n68 #12: (2)帚(2)箒) Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing character 帚.

zaau2.text: U+627E (F2.42 找) 找尋找換 (Page 29|n72 #3: (2)找) To seek; to make up the deficiency, to supply what is wanted (Kangxi: 俗音爪補不足曰找); to barter, to swap, to exchange; _(2)ch(a/)u (5)n(i/) f(u/)i(3) h(i/)(3)_ (zaau2 nei5 fui3 hei3 找你晦氣) he's looking for you to scold you; _(2)ch(a/)u (4)t(')au l(o\)(6)_ (zaau2 tau4 lou6 找頭路) to look for work; _(2)ch(a/)u sh(o\)(3) (5)m(i/)_ (zaau2 sou3 mei5 找數尾), let us settle up that account; _(2)ch(a/)u (4)ts(')am_ (zaau2 cam4 找尋), to look for; _(2)ch(a/)u (u/)n(6)_ (zaau2 wun6 找換) to change money or for money; _(2)ch(a/)u (4)ts(')(i/)n p(')(o\)(3)_ (zaau2 cin4 pou3 找錢舖) a money-changer's shop. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰扌弋 to 找. 【有找】 (jau5 zaau2) Suffixed after a monetary amount to indicate that the price is strictly lower. (Literally, "and there's change".) 廿蚊有找 (jaa6 man1 jau5 zaau2): "It's twenty bucks and there's change." 【找數】 (zaau2 sou3) To settle a bill or account.

U+6293 爪 (Page 29|n72 #1: (2)爪; here normalised to 抓) to scratch, to claw; to take up with the fingers; _(2)ch(a/)u l(a/)n(6)_ (zaau2 laan6 抓爛) to tear with the claws; _(2)ch(a/)u shat(9)_ (zaau2 sat6 抓實) to gripe firmly with the claws; _(2)ch(a/)u (2)w(a/)_ (zaau2 waa2 抓搲), to scratch; (Page 29|n72 #2: (2)抓) Interchanged with the last (爪). To scratch, to titillate (Kangxi: 搔也); to tear with the claws; to cajole. Williams' "gripe": In the (now) archaic sense of "seize" or "grasp". To seize, to grasp.

U+722A 㕚 爫 (character component on top) 蚤 (F2.42 爪) 手足甲也 (Page 29|n72 #1: (2)爪) Claws, talons, nails (Kangxi: 覆手曰爪, 手足甲也); an agent, a minion; the 87th radical (U+2F56 ⽖ "claw"); _(2)ch(a/)u (4)ng(a/)_ (zaau2 ngaa4 爪牙), claws and teeth; emissaries, assistants; _(5)m(a/)i p(a/)n(6) (2)ch(a/)u_ (maai5 baan6 zaau2 買辦爪), a comprador's market-man. 【爪】 (tsraewX) (_noun-like_) claw, nail 【狗爪邊】 (gau2 zaau2 bin1) The character component 犭. (Literally, "dog's paw beside".) 【狗爪頭】 (gau2 zaau2 tau4) The character component 爫. (Literally, "dog's paw atop".)

U+8098 zau2 (per 《廣韻》陟柳切) (F1.53 肘 _(2)Chau_ (zau2)) 臂節也又制肘 (Page 25|n68 #11: (2)肘 _(2)Chau_ (zau2); here normalised to _(2)Ch(a/)u_ (zaau2)) ~~The fore-arm;~~ the elbow (Kangxi: 臂節也)~~, the wrist~~; to take by ~~the wrist~~ (Kangxi: 爲人捉其肘而留之亦曰肘); a quarter of an animal; _(2)shau ~~(2)chau~~ (2)ch(a/)u_ (sau2 zaau2 手肘), the elbow; _~~(2)chau~~ (2)ch(a/)u yat(9)_ (zaau2 jat6 肘腋) ~~arms and sides~~ elbows and armpits, _met._ near relatives; _(4)ts(')(i/)n (1)ch(u ~~(2)chau~~ (2)ch(a/)u_ (cin4 zyu1 zaau2 前豬肘), a shoulder of pork. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 刖 to 肘. Williams' "the wrist": This is a misreading of Kangxi 《徐曰》寸口手腕動脈處也, which is a very unilluminating attempt to explain 寸手寸口也 from 《說文》. 【肘】 (tsraewX) (_noun-like_) elbow

zau2.text: U+8098 (F1.53 肘) 臂節也又制肘 (Page 25|n68 #11: (2)肘) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 刖 to 肘.

zaau2.text: U+86A4 May appear as either ⿱叉虫 (+3) or ⿱㕚虫 (+4 assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 584 #5: (2)蚤 _(2)Ts(o\)_ (zou2); here corrected to _(2)Ch(a/)u_ (zaau2)) ~~the rut or trace of a wheel.~~ Williams' "the rut or trace of a wheel": This is a misreading of Kangxi 謂幅入牙中者也, which is the commentary for the example 《周禮冬官考工記》眡其綆欲其蚤之正也. Admittedly, this example is an incredibly difficult passage to parse, and I too would have failed were it not for 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, specifically on the character 箄: ...按考工記注鄭司農云綆讀爲關東言餠之餠謂輪箄也玄謂輪雖箄爪牙必正也...箄謂偏僻... The passage (眡其綆欲其蚤之正也) therefore reads, "Viewing its deviation, he wisheth that it be clawed correct". The probable meaning is that a crooked wheel should still have spokes going into (or "clawing") the hub perpendicularly. The nails (or to trim them) (Kangxi: 蚤讀爲爪, 謂除手足爪也). To install spokes of a wheel perpendicularly into the hub (Kangxi: 蚤當爲爪謂幅入牙中者也).

zou2.text: U+86A4 May appear as either ⿱叉虫 (+3) or ⿱㕚虫 (+4 assumed here), depending on the font. 䖣 䗢 (F2.13 早 _(2)Ts(u/)_) 早晨又先也 (F2.13 蚤 _(2)Ts(u/)_) 同上 (Page 584 #5: (2)蚤) A flea (Kangxi: 嚙人跳蟲也); sand fleas, or those produced in sandy ground (Kangxi: 土乾則生蚤); 【蚤】 (tsawX) (_noun-like_) flea

zaau3.text: U+3DF9 𦻐 zaau6 (per 《廣韻》直敎切) (Page 29|n72 #6: 𦻐(3); here normalised to 㷹) Blazing fire (Kangxi 㷹: 火急煎貌); to fry; to boil in fat; _(4)yau ch(a/)u(3)_ (jau4 zaau3 油㷹) boiled in fat; _ch(a/)u(3) ~~(2)t(o\)~~ t(o\)(3) ts(')ui(3)_ (zaau3 dou3 ceoi3 㷹到脆) fried crisp. The "deep-fry" sense is very dated; 炸 zaa3 is now preferred. Williams' 㷹到脆: Corrected _(2)t(o\)_ (dou2) to _t(o\)(3)_ (dou3).

U+7B0A zaau2 (alternative per 《廣韻》側絞切 for "strainer" sense) (F2.42 笊) 笊籬 (Page 29|n72 #5: 笊(3)) A skimmer made of bamboo or iron wire (Kangxi: 笊篱竹器); nests in caves (Kangxi: 鳥居穴曰笊居樹曰巢); _ch(a/)u(3) (4)l(i/)_ (zaau3 lei4-1 笊籬), a wire ladle.

U+7F69 箌 䈇 𦋇 (F2.42 罩) 嘲去聲取魚器也 (F2.42 䈇) 同上 (Page 29|n72 #4: 𦋇(3); here normalised to 罩) A net, or basket to catch mud fish by covering them (Kangxi 罩: 捕魚器也); to catch or cover over; to shade; a shade, a cover, a protection from wind or dust; _(1)tang ch(a/)u(3)_ (dang1 zaau3 燈罩) a lamp-globe; _(1)k(u/)n ch(a/)u(3)_ (gun1 zaau3 棺罩) a network pall; _ch(a/)u(3) (4)(u_ (zaau3 jyu4-2 罩魚), to catch fish; _(1)kai ch(a/)u(3)_ (gai1 zaau3 雞罩) a hen basket; _~~(5)ki(u/)~~ (2)ki(u/) ch(a/)u(3)_ (giu6-2 zaau3 轎罩) a rain cover on a sedan. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword 𦋇 to 罩. Williams' 轎罩: Corrected _(5)ki(u/)_ (giu6-5) to _(2)ki(u/)_ (giu6-2). 【罩】 (traewH) (_noun-like_) covering-trap

zaau6.text: U+9A5F May appear as either ⿰馬⿱取乑 or ⿰馬⿱取⿸⿹亻人人 (assumed here), depending on the font. 騶 骤 (Mainland simplified) zau6 (per 《廣韻》鋤祐切) (F1.55 驟 _Chau(6)_ (zau6)) 馳驟又疾速也 (Page 562 #4: 驟(6) _Tsau(6)_ (zau6); here normalised to _Ch(a/)u(6)_ (zaau6)) A fleet horse (Kangxi: 馬疾步也); to run (Kangxi: 奔也); quick, fleet; pressing, urgent; frequently, repeatedly (Kangxi: 數也); _~~tsau(6)~~ ch(a/)u(6) (4)(i/)n (4)(i/) (4)loi_ (zaau6 jin4 ji4 loi4 驟然而來), arrived very quickly; _pat(7) (2)ho ~~tsau(6)~~ ch(a/)u(6) tak(7)_ (bat1 ho2 zaau6 dak1 不可驟得) it can not be dune in an instant. 【驟】 (dzrjuwH) (_adjective-like_) speedy

zau6.text: U+9A5F May appear as either ⿰馬⿱取乑 or ⿰馬⿱取⿸⿹亻人人 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.55 驟 _Chau(6)_ (zau6)) 馳驟又疾速也 (Page 562 #4: 驟(6)) Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _chau(6)_ per 《廣韻》鋤祐切.

zai1.text: U+5291 剤 剂 (Mainland simplified) zai6 (per 《廣韻》在詣切 for verb(?) senses) (F1.28 劑) 調劑又劑量 (Page 548 #1: (1)劑) To pare, to cut even, to trim (Kangxi: 劑翦齊也, 齊截也); to equalize, to portion, to adjust (Kangxi: 分劑); to compound, as pills; a dose, a recipe (Kangxi: 藥劑); _yat(7) (1)tsai y(e/)uk(9)_ (jat1 zai1 joek6 一劑藥) a dose of medicine; _(4)t(')i(u/) (1)tsai_ (tiu4 zai1 調劑), to arrange amicably; _chat(7) (1)tsai_ (zat1 zai1 質劑), a check, a bond, made so as to cut in twain for evidence (Kangxi: 質劑謂兩書一札而別之也 etc.). It is not clear how to distribute the senses between level and departing tone. Kangxi has "pare even" and "bisected-contract" under the level tone, and the medicine-related(?) senses under the departing tone. 《廣韻》 has 券也 (for the "bisected-contract" sense) under the level tone, and 分劑 (a very ambiguous "portion(?)") under the departing tone. 【劑-departing】 (dzejH) (_verb-like_) to pare (even) 【劑-level】 (tsjwe) (_noun-like_) bisected-contract

U+64E0 㨈 挤 (Mainland simplified) zai3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子計切) (F1.28 擠) 排也推也 (Page 9|n52 #9: (1)擠 _(1)Chai_ (zai1)) A colloquial word. To place, to put down, to put by; _(1)chai (4)m(a/)i_ (zai1 maai4 擠埋), put it aside; _(1)chai (1)p(i/)n ch(')(u(3)_ (zai1 bin1 cyu3 擠邊處) where shall I put it? _(1)chai (1)p(i/)n ch(')(u(3) (1)t(o\) (2)h(o\)_ (zai1 bin1 cyu3 dou1 hou2 擠邊處都好), put ~~in~~ it down anywhere. (Page 548 #2: (1)擠 _(1)Tsai_ (zai1)) To push (Kangxi: 排也一曰推也), to push over, to upset (Kangxi: 擠墜也); to press upon, to crowd; _(1)tsai (2)yung_ (zai1 jung2 擠擁), to crowd and press upon. 【擠】 (tsej, tsejH) (_verb-like_) to push 【擠】 (zai1) To put, or put down. The spelling 擠 for this word is arbitrary (but well established). 擠喺度 (zai1 hai2 dou6): "Put it over here." 【擠迫】 (zai1 bik1) Crowded. 人多擠迫 (jan4 do1 zai1 bik1): "Lots of people and crowded."
U+7A67 (F1.28 穧) 刈禾把數也束也 (Page 548 #3: (1)穧)

zai6.text: U+7A67 zai1 (per Fan Wan) zai3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子計切 and 子例切) (F1.28 穧 _(1)Tsai_ (zai1)) 刈禾把數也束也 (Page 548 #3: (1)穧 _(1)Tsai_ (zai1); here normalised to _Tsai(6)_ (zai6)) To reap grain (Kangxi: 穫刈也); a handful of rice (Kangxi: 一曰撮也), as it is cut; to put it together ~~to bind~~ in preparation for binding into sheaves (Kangxi: 刈禾把數, 穧禾之鋪而未束者). Williams' "as it is cut": It is unclear whether 撮也 "pinch" applies to the grain (after harvesting) or to the crop (during harvest). 【穧】 (dzejH, tsejH, tsjejH) (_verb-like_) to reap

zai1.text: U+8CEB (F1.28 齎) 送也行道所用也 (F1.28 賫) 持送曰賫詔是也 (Page 548 #5: (1)賷(1)賫)
U+8CF7 (F1.28 齎) 送也行道所用也 (F1.28 賫) 持送曰賫詔是也 (Page 548 #5: (1)賷(1)賫)

U+8E8B 䠁 跻 (Mainland simplified) zai3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子計切) (F1.28 躋) 登也升也 (F1.28 隮) 惡氣上升也 (Page 548 #4: (1)躋(1)隮) To ascend, to go up, as stairs, to mount a steep hill (Kangxi 躋: 登也, 躋升也, 亦作隮); to reach; Williams does not provide separate entries for 躋 and 隮. Kangxi only has them interchangeable for the "ascend" sense. I have split things up accordingly, with duplication where appropriate. 【躋】 (tsej, tsejH) (_verb-like_) to ascend

U+96AE 䠁 躋 (for "ascend" sense) 𬯀 (Mainland simplified) zai3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子計切) (F1.28 躋) 登也升也 (F1.28 隮) 惡氣上升也 (Page 548 #4: (1)躋(1)隮) To ascend, to go up, as stairs, to mount a steep hill (Kangxi 隮: 登也); to rise, as vapor (Kangxi 隮: 氣也升也); a rainbow (Kangxi 隮: 隮虹也). Williams does not provide separate entries for 躋 and 隮. Kangxi only has them interchangeable for the "ascend" sense. I have split things up accordingly, with duplication where appropriate. To fall (Kangxi: 隮墜). 【隮-ascend】 (tsej, tsejH) (_verb-like_) to ascend (_noun-like_) rainbow

zai3.text: U+96AE 𬯀 (Mainland simplified) To fall (Kangxi: 隮墜). 【隮-fall】 (tsejH) (_verb-like_) to fall

zai1.text: U+9F4E 賫 賷 赍 (Mainland simplified) zi1 (alternative per 《廣韻》即夷切) (F1.28 齎) 送也行道所用也 (F1.28 賫) 持送曰賫詔是也 (Page 548 #5: (1)賷(1)賫; here normalised to 齎) To take or send a present; to present to, to offer; to dispatch, as documents; to send up to; _(1)ts(')an (1)tsai_ (can1 zai1 親齎), to give to personally; _(1)tsai sung(3)_ (zai1 sung3 齎送) to send, as a present. (Page 548 #6: (1)齎) Interchanged with the preceding (賷, 賫) (Kangxi 賷: 齎或作賷). To take in both hands (Kangxi: 持也), to offer (Kangxi: 持遺人也); to give to (Kangxi: 付也, 送也); ~~to prepare~~ necessaries for a journey (Kangxi: 行道所用也); to supply, to ~~leave and~~ store up (Kangxi: 裝也); a sigh (Kangxi: 歎聲); _(1)tsai tsau(3) (1)k(u/)n_ (zai1 zau3 gun1 齎奏官), a courier, a bearer of dispatches; _(1)tsz' (1)tsai_ (zi1 zai1 ？齎), to confer on; _(2)fung (1)tsai_ (fung2 zai1 捧齎), to hand up to. Williams' "leave": This is a misreading of Kangxi 遺也. 【齎】 (tsej, tsij) (_verb-like_) to gift (_interjection_) sigh

zi1.text: U+9F4E

zai1.text: U+9F4F 虀 䪡 䪢 齑 (Mainland simplified) (F1.28 虀) 薑蒜爲之又碎也和也 (Page 548 #7: (1)齏) A sort of leek (Kangxi: 𩐌也); to prepare and compound, to blend, to mix (Kangxi: 膾酢也 etc.), as tastes; to make dishes of vegetables as the poor have compounded, mixed; to compare, as opinions; _(4)wo (1)tsai_ (wo4 zai1 和齏), to blend, as when mixing the tastes of spices.

zai2.text: U+4ED4 zai2-4 (low first in reduplication 仔仔) (F1.31 仔) 皃子也又仔肩 (Page 548 #8: (2)仔) A colloquial word. A child, a son; a diminutive; a little thing, the smaller of two; _(2)tsai (5)n(u_ (zai2 neoi5-2 仔女), sons and daughters, children; _(1)kw(a/)i (2)tsai_ (gwaai1 zai2 乖仔), a good boy; _(2)tsai t(a/)i(6) (2)tsai shai(3) k(a/)i(3)_ (zai2 daai6 zai2 sai3 gaai3 仔大仔世界) when a son is old he must take care of himself; _sai(3) (1)man (2)tsai_ (sai3 man1 zai2 細蚊仔), children, lads; _(1)ch(u (2)tsai_ (zyu1 zai2 豬仔), a pig; _(2)kau (2)tsai_ (gau2 zai2 狗仔), a puppy; _(1)kung (2)tsai_ (gung1 zai2 公仔), images, pictures, playthings; _sz'(6) (2)tsai_ (si6 zai2 事仔), a servant boy; _ts(')au(3) (2)tsai (5)m(a/)_ (cau3 zai2 maa5-2 湊仔媽), a nurse. Williams' 豬仔: One sold into slave labour, as in 賣豬仔. 【仔】 (zai2) A kid. 生仔 (saang1 zai2): "Have kids." A son. 生仔 (saang1 zai2): "Have a son." 仔女 (zai2 neoi5-2): "Sons and daughters." 兩仔乸 (loeng5 zai2 naa2): "The two of them, son and mother." 兩仔爺 (loeng5 zai2 je4): "The two of them, son and father." 大個仔 (daai6 go3 zai2): "A big boy now." A guy, lad, etc. 佢條仔 (keoi5 tiu4 zai2): "Her guy" (i.e. boyfriend). 後生仔 (hau6 saang1 zai2): "Young lad." A diminutive suffix. 狗仔 (gau2 zai2): "Puppy." 矮仔 (ai2 zai2): "Shorty." 耳仔 (ji5 zai2): "Ears." 華仔 (waa4 zai2): "Wahsy." 雀仔 (zoek3 zai2): "Birdie."

zi2.text: U+4ED4 zi1 (alternative per 《廣韻》子之切 for "bear" sense) (F2.35 仔) 仔肩任也 (Page 612 #8: (2)仔) To bear, to carry (Kangxi: 克也任也); to undertake, as an officer; _(2)tsz' sai(3)_ (zi2 sai3 仔細) careful; discriminating; _(2)tsz' (1)k(i/)n chung(6) yam(6)_ (zi2 gin1 zung6 jam6 仔肩重任) able to sustain important offices. 【仔】 (tsi, tsiX) (_verb-like_) to bear

zai2.text: U+6FDF 済 㴉 济 (Mainland simplified) (Page 549 #1: 濟(3) _Tsai(3)_ (zai3); here corrected to _(2)Tsai_ (zai2)) Name of a river (Kangxi: 水名); _~~tsai(3) tsai(3)~~ (2)tsai (2)tsai_ (zai2 zai2 濟濟) abundant; a concourse (Kangxi: 濟濟衆盛之貌). Stately (Kangxi: 一曰多威儀也). 【濟-rising】 (tsejX) (_adjective-like_) abundant (_adjective-like_) stately

zai3.text: U+6FDF 済 㴉 济 (Mainland simplified) (F1.32 濟) 周濟又通也 (Page 549 #1: 濟(3)) to assist, to succor, to benefit (Kangxi: 益也); to furnish gratuitous aid (Kangxi: 賙救也); to relieve; to cross a stream (Kangxi: 渡也); to make successful, to further, to bring about, to complete (Kangxi: 成也); able, apt, clever (Fan Wan: 通也); _kau(3) tsai(3)_ (gau3 zai3 救濟) to save and relieve; _(4)'m tsai(3) sz'(6)_ (m4 zai3 si6 唔濟事) he will not do, he is inefficient; _tsai(3) mat(7) sham(6) sz'(6)_ (zai3 mat1 sam6 si6 濟乜甚事) what is he good for? _(4)t(')ung (1)chau kung(6) tsai(3)_ (tung4 zau1 gung6 zai3 同舟共濟) to cross a river in the same boat; _tsai(3) (1)k(i/)_ (zai3 gei1 濟饑), to feed the hungry; _t(o\)(6) tsai(3) (1)t(')(i/)n h(a/)(6)_ (dou6 zai3 tin1 haa6 道濟天下) to reform the world; _(1)chau tsai(3)_ (zau1 zai3 周濟) to supply another's wants; 【濟-departing】 (tsejH) (_verb-like_) to cross (_verb-like_) to rescue, to relieve (_verb-like_) to aid, to benefit

U+5236 (F1.32 制) 節也禁也 (Page 9|n52 #11: 制(3)) To adjust, to cut, to form (Kangxi: 裁也); to govern, to regulate, to rule (Kangxi: 正也御也檢也); to limit, to hinder, to prevent (Kangxi: 禁制也); a law, a rule, a regulation (Kangxi: 成法曰制); _tsoi(6) chai(3)_ (zoi6 zai3 在制) or _(2)shau chai(3)_ (sau2 zai3 守制) to wear mourning for parents; _(5)yau ts(i/)t(8) chai(3)_ (jau5 zit3 zai3 有節制) I can do so much; _chai(3) (4)t(')oi_ (zai3 toi4 制臺), a governor-general; _(1)k(a/)m chai(3)_ (gaam1 zai3 監制) to restrain, to set limits; _chai(3) (2)kan k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (zai3 gan2 gam3 do1 制緊咁多), to limit one; _chai(3) (2)t(o\)_ (zai3 dou2 制倒), to tame, to subdue; _tsz'(6) chai(3)_ (zi6 zai3 自制) self-restraint; _chai(3) (1)sh(u_ (zai3 syu1 制書), an imperial dispatch (Kangxi: 天子之言曰制書); _chai(3) t(o\)(6)_ (zai3 dou6 制度) a pattern, laws; _kam(3) chai(3)_ (gam3 zai3 禁制) a prohibition; _chai(3) t(i/)(6)_ (zai3 dei6 制地) the court; _sui(3) chai(3)_ (seoi3 zai3 歲制) a sexagenary; _chai(3) fok(8)_ (zai3 fok3 制縛) a close surveillance. 【制】 (tsyejH) (_verb-like_) to cut out, (_met._) to form (_noun-like_) institution, system (_verb-like_) to control, to regulate 【制】 (zai3) Willing (to do), accepting (of an outcome). 制唔制 (zai3 m4 zai3): "Are you willing or not?" 我唔制 (ngo5 m4 zai3): "I don't accept this!" The spelling 制 is arbitrary.

U+6662 晣 㫼 (F1.32 晣) 小星明也又音若 (Page 9|n52 #10: 晣(3); here normalised to 晢) Brightness of stars (Kangxi 晢: 星光也); _(4)ming (1)sing chai(3) chai(3)_ (ming4 sing1 zai3 zai3 明星晢晢) the twinkling lustre of the stars. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 䀿 to 晣. The alternative reading (又音若) does not make sense; possibly 折 _ch(i/)t(8)_ (zit3) was intended. 【晢-departing】 (tsyejH) (_adjective-like_) bright

zit3.text: U+6662 晣 㫼 Bright (Kangxi: 昭晢明也). 【晢-entering】 (tsyet) (_adjective-like_) bright

zai3.text: U+6663 (F1.32 晣) 小星明也又音若 (Page 9|n52 #10: 晣(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 䀿 to 晣. The alternative reading (又音若) does not make sense; possibly 折 _ch(i/)t(8)_ (zit3) was intended.

U+796D (F1.32 祭) 祀也薦也 (Page 548 #9: 祭(3)) To sacrifice, to offer slaughtered victims before the gods or penates, which are also usually cooked (Kangxi: 祭祀也); to bring an oblation, to approach before the gods (Kangxi: 人事至於神也); the time of worship; a sacrifice, an offering; _tsai(3) shing(3)_ (zai3 sing3 祭聖) to worship the sages; _tsai(3) tsz'(6)_ (zai3 zi6 祭祀) to present sacrifices; _tsai(3) (4)man_ (zai3 man4 祭文), a prayer; an elegy hung up during the 49 days of mourning; _(2)p(a/)i l(o\)(6) tsai(3)_ (baai2 lou6 zai3 擺路祭) to scatter or lay out offerings along the road --- as at the funerals of worthy men; _tsai(3) (1)yau_ (zai3 jau1 祭幽), to appease ghosts by oblations. 【祭】 (tsjejH) (_noun-like_) sacrifice

U+7A44 (F1.32 穄) 谷也似黍而小 (Page 548 #10: 穄(3)) A sort of panicled millet which is not glutinous, and resembles wheat (Kangxi: 𪎭也, 穄似麥而不黏); it grows in Shens(i/) (陝西). 【穄】 (tsjejH) (_noun-like_) panicled-millet

U+88FD 制 (F1.32 製) 造也作也 (Page 9|n52 #11: 制(3); here normalised to 製) to invent, to make; (Page 9|n52 #12: 製(3)) Interchanged with the last (制). To invent, to make (Kangxi: 造也); to cut out clothes (Kangxi: 裁也); a fashion, a mode (Kangxi: 式也); to compound, as medicines; a pattern; a fur cloak (Kangxi: 裘也); _(5)m(i/) chai(3)_ (mei5 zai3 美製) well made; _(u(6) chai(3)_ (jyu6 zai3 御製) done by his Majesty; _(2)h(o\) chai(3) f(a/)t(8)_ (hou2 zai3 faat3 好製法) well compounded; _f(a/)t(8) chai(3) (5)y(e/)_ (faat3 zai3 je5 法製嘢), useless things; _chai(3) ts(o\)(6)_ (zai3 zou6 製造) to invent; _chai(3) (1)(i/) (4)sh(e/)ung_ (zai3 ji1 soeng4 製衣裳), to cut out clothes; _(2)h(a/)u chai(3)_ (haau2 zai3 巧製) skillfully made. Williams' 製造: Now more "create" than "invent". 【製】 (tsyejH) (_verb-like_) to cut out, to make

U+969B 际 (Mainland simplified) (F1.32 際) 交會也又邊畔也 (Page 548 #11: 際(3)) A limit, a border, a ~~region~~ perimeter (Kangxi: 方也, 邊也畔也), the line of junction of two ~~things~~ walls (Kangxi: 壁會也); the time or place where another begins (Kangxi: 際接也); to join (Kangxi: 合也, 會也)~~, to begin~~; the time of occurring, now, since; _(2)sz' (1)shang (1)ch(i/) tsai(3)_ (si2 sang1 zi1 zai3 死生之際) between life and death; _tsai(3) ts(i/)p(8)_ (zai3 zip3 際接) to receive, to blend, to meet; _(2)h(o\) tsai(3) (u(6)_ (hou2 zai3 jyu6 好際遇) a good opportunity, a favorable juncture; _(2)ts(')z' tsai(3)_ (ci2 zai3 此際) this time; _(1)fung (4)wan tsai(3) (u/)i(6)_ (fung1 wan4 zai3 wui6 風雲際會) the winds and clouds have met; _met._ to receive a favor. 【際】 (tsjejH) (_noun-like_) juncture, connection, (_met._) time

U+973D 濟 霁 (Mainland simplified) zai6 (alternative per 《集韻》才詣切) (F1.32 霽) 雨止而日光也 (Page 549 #1: 濟(3)) used for the next (霽) (Kangxi 濟: 與霽通亦止也); (Page 549 #2: 霽(3)) The rain stopping (Kangxi: 雨止也), the clouds clearing away and the blue sky appearing (Kangxi: 晴也, 雨晴曰霽); _(4)ts(')ing tsai(3)_ (cing4 zai3 晴霽) a fair sky. To cease, to stop (Kangxi: 霽止也). 【霽】 (tsejH) (_verb-like_) to cease (raining)

zai6.text: U+6EEF 滞 (Mainland simplified) zai6-2 (rising second in vernacular 滯滯地) (F1.34 滯) 阻滯不通也 (Page 10|n53 #2: 滯(6)) Water impeded; condensed, congealed (Kangxi: 凝也); to obstruct, to stop; indigestible, disagreeing, piled up; _shik(9) chai(6)_ (sik6 zai6 食滯) indigestible; _chai(6) ch(u(6)_ (zai6 zyu6 滯住) to restrain; impeded; an obstruction, stoppage; _ai(3) chai(6)_ (ai3 zai6 翳滯) fullness in the stomach; hindering; slow progress; _f(u/)i(3) chai(6)_ (fui3 zai6 晦滯) stupid looking; _(2)p(a/)n chai(6)_ (baan2 zai6 板滯) an old fogy; adhering to the old way; _(2)cho chai(6)_ (zo2 zai6 阻滯) hindered, let, detained; _chai(6) h(i/)(3)_ (zai6 hei3 滯氣) a stoppage of secretions. Left-behind (Kangxi: 漏也). 【滯】 (drjejH) (_verb-like_) to congeal (_verb-like_) to stagnate (_adjective-like_) stagnant, (_met._) left-behind 【滯】 (zai6) Stagnated in the stomach, usually from eating too much. 滯住個胃 (zai6 zyu6 go3 wai6): "Feeling stagnant in the stomach." 食滯咗 (sik6 zai6 zo2): "Stuffed myself from eating." 飽飽滯滯 (baau2 baau2 zai6 zai6): "Full and stagnated."

zak1.text: U+4EC4 (F2.32 仄) 平仄傾仄 (Page 12|n55 #1: 仄(7)) Inclined, slanting, leaning, oblique (Kangxi: 人處厂下有慮傾側之象); the name of the three deflected tones (上聲, 去聲, 入聲) (Kangxi: 平仄字聲也); _(1)k(')ing chak(7)_ (king1 zak1 傾仄) tipped over, upset; _chak(7) ~~(1)sheng~~ (1)shing_ (zak1 sing1 仄聲) the oblique tones; _chak(7) lau(6)_ (zak1 lau6 仄陋) vile, erring. Williams' 仄聲: Corrected _(1)sheng_ (seng1) to _(1)shing_ (sing1). 【仄】 (tsrik) (_adjective-like_) oblique, slanting
