U+5074 仄 侧 (Mainland simplified) zap1 (lazy elision in 側邊) (F2.32 側 _Ch(')ak(7)_ (cak1)) 傍邊曰側 (Page 12|n55 #5: 側(7)) Side, the side (Kangxi: 旁也); on the side; to incline (Kangxi: 傾也), to bow down, to bend; lateral; perverted; mean, low (Kangxi: 卑隘也); rebellious, seditious (Kangxi: 叛黨曰反側); _chak(7) shat(7)_ (zak1 sat1 側室) a coucubine; _(4)m(o\) ch(a/)p(9) chak(7)_ (mou4 zaap6 zak1 毋极側) don't turn it over; _chak(7) (1)p(i/)n_ (zak1 bin1 側邊), the side; _chak(7) chak(7) t(i/)(6)_ (zak1 zak1 dei6-2 側側地) a little one sided; _(2)f(a/)n chak(7)_ (faan2 zak1 反側) the rear, the back side; a rebellious cabal; _chak(7) (5)(i/)_ (zak1 ji5 側耳), apply the ear; _yat(9) chak(7)_ (jat6 zak1 日側) afternoon; _sh(i/)(6) (5)ngo chak(7)_ (si6 ngo5 zak1 侍我側) stand at my side. 【側】 (tsrik) (_noun-like_) side (_adjective-like_) oblique, slanting, (_met._) one-sided (_adjective-like_) lowly

U+5247 则 (Mainland simplified) (F2.33 則) 法也準也卽也 (Page 550 #10: 則(7)) A rule, a precept, a law, a regulation (Kangxi: 法也, 則常也); a principle (Kangxi: 天理不差曰則); a pattern (Kangxi: 則等畫物也), an example; a standard, a measure by which to test an act (Kangxi: 凡制度品式皆曰則); to conform to rule, to imitate, to walk by (Kangxi: 法其可法者曰則); an illative particle, denoting a result, a reason for, a cause for; wherefore, immediately, then; a conditional particle, after that, in that case (Kangxi: 助辭又然後之辭); therefore, next, consequently; _f(a/)t(8) tsak(7)_ (faat3 zak1 法則) a rule, a pattern; _(2)chun tsak(7)_ (zeon2 zak1 準則) the pattern, at the time, like the rule, as a carpenter's line is; _(4)ho tsak(7)_ (ho4 zak1 何則) how then? _tsak(7) ko(3)_ (zak1 go3 則個) in the court dialect is like _p(a/)(6) lok(8)_ (baa6 lok3 罷咯) well, then; _e. g._ _sh(u(3) ~~tsui(6)~~ ts(u/)i(6) tsak(7) ko(3)_ (syu3 zeoi6 zak1 go3 恕罪則個) well, then I'll pardon the fault; _(5)yau mat(9) (5)yau tsak(7)_ (jau5 mat6 jau5 zak1 有物有則) both the substance and the immaterial principle; _(4)(i/)n tsak(7)_ (jin4 zak1 然則) if so, then; _yat(7) tsak(7) (5)(i/) (2)h(i/), yat(7) tsak(7) (5)(i/) k(u(6)_ (jat1 zak1 ji5 hei2 jat1 zak1 ji5 geoi6 一則以喜一則以懼) to excite both our joy and fear; _tsak(7) yat(7) (5)y(a/)_ (zak1 jat1 jaa5 則一也), then they are alike; _(1)sui tsak(7) (2)k(o\)m_ (seoi1 zak1 gam2 雖則敢), then I shall venture. Williams' 恕罪則個: Corrected _tsui(6)_ to _ts(u/)i(6)_. Two of Williams' examples (然則, 一則以喜一則以懼) are suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.11.1 (_Examples of tseh_, 則) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. 【則】 (tsok) (_noun-like_) statute (_noun-like_) exemplar (_verb-like_) to emulate (_conjunction-like_) then, thus (_speech-assist_)

zik1.text: U+5247 则 (Mainland simplified) This usage appears to be local to Hong Kong. 【則】 (zik1) An architectural drawing. 則師 (zik1 si1): "Architect." 入則 (jap6 zik1): "Submit the drawings for approval."

zak1.text: U+6603 稷 (F2.32 昃) 日斜也 (Page 12|n55 #2: 昃(7)) The sun declining to the west (Kangxi: 日昃昳中也); the afternoon (Kangxi: 日中則昃); ~~to wane, as the moon;~~ _yat(9) chak(7)_ (jat6 zak1 日昃) day is declining. (Page 569 #11: 稷(7) _Tsik(7)_ (zik1); here corrected to _Chak(7)_ (zak1)) _h(a/)(6) ~~tsik(7)~~ chak(7)_ (haa6 zak1 下稷) afternoon (Kangxi 稷: 與昃通, 稷昃也下稷謂晡時). 【昃】 (tsrik) (_adjective-like_) slanting west

zik1.text: U+7A37 (F1.74 稷) 黍稷社稷又舜臣名 (Page 569 #11: 稷(7)) Panicled millet _(Milium)_, one of the five grains (Kangxi: 𪗉也五穀之長); quick, rapid (Kangxi: 疾也); the god of ~~agriculture~~ grains (Kangxi: 神名 etc.); _(5)sh(e/) tsik(7)_ (se5 zik1 社稷) the Ceres of the Chinese; its altars have no roofs; _hau(6) tsik(7)_ (hau6 zik1 后稷) ~~a god of harvests~~; Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱⿻一火氺 to 黍. Williams' 社稷: Strictly two gods, one of soil (社) and one of grains (稷). Williams' 后稷: Not quite a god, though a legendary figure. Used in the titles of agricultural officials (Kangxi: 農官名曰后稷), after the legendary 后稷. 【稷】 (tsik) (_noun-like_) millet (_adjective-like_) prompt

zam1.text: U+659F (F2.36 斟) 斟酌 (Page 14|n57 #9: (1)斟) To pour from or into (Kangxi: 斟益也, 言斟酌而益之); to lade out, to lighten; to deliberate, to adjust (Kangxi: 斟取也, 計也); a ladle, a spoon (Kangxi: 勺也); _(1)cham (5)t(')o ~~lok(9)~~ lok(8)_ (zam1 to5 lok3 斟妥咯) all well settled; _(4)t(')ung (5)n(i/) (1)cham (1)cham_ (tung4 nei5 zam1 zam1 同你斟斟), let us talk it over; _(1)cham (4)ch(')(a/)_ (zam1 caa4 斟茶), to pour out tea; _~~sai(6)~~ sai(3) (1)cham_ (sai3 zam1 細斟), to whisper; _(1)cham ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zam1 zoek3 斟酌) to consult about. Williams' 斟妥咯: Corrected _lok(9)_ (lok6) to _lok(8)_ (lok3). Williams' 細斟: Corrected _sai(6)_ (sai6) to _sai(3)_ (sai3). 【斟】 (tsyim) (_verb-like_) to pour (_verb-like_) to deliberate 【斟茶遞水】 (zam1 caa4 dai6 seoi2) Menial work. (Literally, "pour tea and pass the water".)

U+6939 (Page 14|n57 #10: (1)椹) ~~An ax or bill;~~ ~~a staff.~~ Williams' "An ax or bill": This is a misreading of Kangxi 鐵椹斫木櫍也. Here, 鐵椹 is the anvil or block that is supporting the wood being chopped, not the axe that is chopping the wood.

U+7827 椹 碪 (F2.36 砧) 擣衣石 (F2.36 碪) 與砧同 (Page 14|n57 #8: (1)砧(1)碪) A stone to beat clothes on (Kangxi 砧: 擣衣石也); an anvil (Kangxi 椹: 鐵椹斫木櫍也); a block for lifting by athletes; _muk(9) (1)cham_ (muk6 zam1 木砧), a horse block; _(1)ch(u (2)p(i/) (1)cham_ (zyu1 bei2 zam1 豬髀砧), a fillet of pork; _(1)cham (2)p(a/)n_ (zam1 baan2 砧板), a cutting board, used by butchers. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰衣鳥 to 擣. Williams' 砧板: Now chopping boards in general (not necessarily a butcher's). 【砧板】 (zam1 baan2) A chopping board.
U+78AA (F2.36 砧) 擣衣石 (F2.36 碪) 與砧同 (Page 14|n57 #8: (1)砧(1)碪) Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰衣鳥 to 擣.

U+7BB4 (F2.36 箴) 箴規箴誠有訓敕而救其失者曰箴 (Page 14|n57 #7: (1)箴) a caution, a check (Kangxi: 規戒也); pointed, urgent; to exhort, to rebuke, to urge to reform (Kangxi: 箴者諫誨之辭); _(1)cham (1)kw(')ai_ (zam1 kwai1 箴規) admonition, rebukes; _(1)cham ~~(4)ming~~ (5)ming_ (zam1 ming5 箴銘), cautionary maxims. Williams' 箴銘: Changed _(4)ming_ (ming4) to common reading _(5)ming_ (ming5). 【箴】 (tsyim) (_noun-like_) needle, (_met._) admonition

U+91DD 箴 鍼 针 (Mainland simplified) (F2.36 針) 所以縫衣服也 (F2.36 鍼) 同上 (Page 14|n57 #6: (1)針(1)鍼) A needle (Kangxi 鍼: 所以縫布帛之錐也, 或作箴亦作針); a cauterizing probe; to prick (Kangxi 鍼: 刺也); to use needles in acupuncture (Kangxi 針: 針灸法); leaves of the pine; _(1)ch(')(un (1)cham_ (cyun1 zam1 穿針), to thread a needle; _~~(1)k(u/)~~ (2)k(u/) (4)ch(')ui (1)cham_ (gu2 ceoi4 zam1 鼓錘針), a pin; _(1)cham p(i/)(6) ~~s(e/)uk(9)~~ s(e/)uk(8) ~~t(')(i/)t(9)~~ t(')(i/)t(8)_ (zam1 bei6 soek3 tit3 針鼻削鐵) mean, stingy; _(1)cham (2)ch(i/)_ (zam1 zi2 針黹), to embroider; _(4)hon (2)sh(u (1)cham_ (hon4 syu2 zam1 寒暑針) a thermometer; _(5)ng(a/)n (1)cham_ (ngaan5 zam1 眼針), a needle; _(1)man (1)cham_ (man1 zam1 蚊針), a musquito's sting. (Page 14|n57 #7: (1)箴) Used for the last (針). A probe, a surgeon's needle (Kangxi 箴: 古者以石爲箴所以刺病); to probe; . Williams' 鼓錘針: Corrected _(1)k(u/)_ (gu1) to _(2)k(u/)_ (gu2). Williams' 針鼻削鐵: Corrected _s(e/)uk(9)_ (soek6) to _s(e/)uk(8)_ (soek3) and corrected _t(')(i/)t(9)_ (tit6) to _t(')(i/)t(8)_ (tit3).

zam2.text: U+600E (F2.37 怎 _(2)Cham_) 怎麽猶何也語詞也 (Page 15|n58 #1: (2)怎 _(2)Cham_) An interrogative word; what, how? _(2)cham y(e/)ung(6)_ (zam2 joeng6 怎樣) in what manner; _(2)cham tik(7)_ (zam2 dik1 怎的) what? _(2)cham (1)shang (2)t(a/) p(a/)n(6)_ (zam2 sang1 daa2 baan6 怎生打扮) how would he look? _(2)cham (2)k(o\)m pat(7) (1)tai (4)t(')au_ (zam2 gam2 bat1 dai1 tau4 怎敢不低頭), how could I decline assent? (Page 551 #4: (2)怎 _(2)Tsam_) What? _(2)tsam (1)mo_ (zam2 mo1 怎麼), what? _(2)tsam (2)kong_ (zam2 gong2 怎講), what does he say? used in the court dialect. ~~This is usually read _(2)sham_ (sam2).~~

U+6795 (F2.37 枕) 臥以薦首者 (Page 14|n57 #11: (2)枕) A pillow (Kangxi: 臥薦首者); ~~a stake;~~ a crossbar in a carriage (Kangxi: 車後橫木也); _(2)cham (1)p(i/)n_ (zam2 bin1 枕邊), in bed, in private; _(2)cham p(u/)n(6)_ (zam2 bun6 枕伴) a bedfellow; _(2)cham tsik(9) (4)n(a/)n (1)on_ (zam2 zik6 naan4 on1 枕席難安), cares disturb his pillow, harassed; _(5)(i/) (2)cham_ (ji5 zam2 耳枕), a support for the ear; _(2)cham (4)t(')au_ (zam2 tau4 枕頭), a pillow; _(2)cham kwat(7)_ (zam2 gwat1 枕骨) the occiput; _(1)on (2)cham (4)m(o\) (1)yau_ (on1 zam2 mou4 jau1 安枕無憂), to sleep quietly. Kangxi has the "crossbar" and "bone" senses under departing-tone 之賃切 _cham(3)_ (zam3). I believe that, as nouns, they should appear here, under rising-tone 章荏切 _(2)cham_ (zam2). A certain bone within the head of a fish (Kangxi: 魚腦中骨曰枕 etc.). 【枕-rising】 (tsyimX) (_noun-like_) pillow 【後尾枕】 (hau6 mei5 zam2) The occiput (back of the head/skull). 【枕住】 (zam2 zyu6) Persistently, continually. 枕住咳 (zam2 zyu6 kat1): "Persistently coughing."

zam3.text: U+6795 (Page 14|n57 #11: (2)枕 _(2)Cham_ (zam2); _Cham(3)_ (zam3) optional, here enforced) to pillow on, to lie near to; contiguous, adjacent, lying on; _(2)sz' (2)ch(e/) (1)s(e/)ung ~~(2)cham~~ cham(3) tsik(9)_ (si2 ze2 soeng1 zam3 zik6 死者相枕藉) the dead lay pillowed on each other; _~~huk(7)~~ k(')uk(7) (1)kwang (4)(i/) ~~(2)cham~~ cham(3)_ (kuk1 gwang1 ji4 zam3 曲肱而枕), pillowed on his arm; As a verb, ~~also~~ read _cham(3)_ (zam3). Williams' 曲肱而枕: Changed _huk(7)_ (huk1) to common reading _k(')uk(7)_ (kuk1). 【枕-departing】 (tsyimH) (_verb-like_) to pillow upon
U+6C81 (F2.38 沁) 水名又以物探水爲沁 (Page 551 #6: 沁(3))

zam6.text: U+20E7B 朕 (Cantonese) (Page 15|n58 #3: 朕(6); here normalised to 𠹻) A colloquial word. A puff, as of smoke; _yat(7) cham(6) (1)(i/)n_ (jat1 zam6 jin1 一𠹻煙), a puff of smoke; _yat(7) cham(6) (2)fo (2)fan_ (jat1 zam6 fo2 fan2 一𠹻火粉), an explosion of incense. 【𠹻】 (zam6) Classifier for smells and odours. 有𠹻味 (jau5 zam6 mei6): "There's a smell." The spelling 𠹻 is arbitrary.

U+6715 (F2.38 朕) 天子自稱曰朕幽暗之文也又朕兆 (Page 15|n58 #3: 朕(6)) Anciently used for I (Kangxi: 我也, 古者貴賤皆自稱朕); now the royal We, Ourself (Kangxi: 秦始皇...定爲至尊之稱 etc.); _cham(6) ~~chi(u/)(6)~~ shi(u/)(6)_ (zam6 siu6 朕兆) subtile, recondite. Williams' 朕兆: Changed _chi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) to common reading _shi(u/)(6)_ (siu6). Whilst it can mean "subtle", it usually means "omen". An omen. 【朕】 (drimX) (_pronoun-like_) I

zan1.text: U+632F Generous (Kangxi: 仁厚也), honourable (Kangxi: 信厚也). Flourishing (Kangxi: 盛貌). 【振-level】 (tsyin) (_adjective-like_) generous, honourable (_adjective-like_) flourishing

zan3.text: U+632F zan3-2 (rising second in vernacular 振振地) (F1.84 振) 振奮振動振作止也收也藏也 (Page 17|n60 #1: 振(3)) To shake, to move (Kangxi: 裂也又動也); to stir up, to agitate (Kangxi: 一曰奮也); to excite, to stimulate; to repair, to restore, to put in order (Kangxi: 整也); to rescue, to save (Kangxi: 舉救也, 拯也); to joggle; to flap, as wings in a flock (Kangxi: 鳥羣飛貌); to terrify; to uphold, to stop (Kangxi: 止也); to receive, to contain (Kangxi: 收也); _chan(3) tung(6)_ (zan3 dung6 振動) to shake, to set about, up and doing; _chan(3) tsok(8)_ (zan3 zok3 振作) diligent; to encourage; _t(a/)i(6) chan(3) (1)k(a/) (1)shing_ (daai6 zan3 gaa1 sing1 大振家聲), made his family famous; _chan(3) (4)m(a/)i yat(7) (4)t(')(un_ (zan3 maai4 jat1 tyun4 振埋一團), cuddled up in a heap, as a shivering child; _chan(3) (1)(i/)_ (zan3 ji1 振衣), to shake the dress. 【振-departing】 (tsyinH) (_verb-like_) to shake, (_met._) to flap (_verb-like_) to uplift, to rouse (_verb-like_) to open up (_verb-like_) to succour (_verb-like_) to organise (_verb-like_) to halt (_verb-like_) to contain, to consolidate (_adjective-like_) flocking (_preposition-like_) since

zan1.text: U+73CD 珎 鉁 錱 (F1.79 珍) 寶也重也貴也又珍珠 (F1.79 ？) 同上 (F1.79 珎) 同上 (Page 16|n59 #10: (1)珍) Valuable, precious (Kangxi: 寶也, 貴也), excellent (Kangxi: 美也); important (Kangxi: 重也), rare (Kangxi: 奇也), noble; to prize; a delicacy (Kangxi: 食之美者亦曰珍); a rarity, a treasure; _(1)chan (1)ch(u_ (zan1 zyu1 珍珠), pearls; _(1)chan (2)p(o\)_ (zan1 bou2 珍寶), precious; _(1)chan chung(6)_ (zan1 zung6 珍重) to take care of, as the health; to esteem; _(1)chan m(i/)(6)_ (zan1 mei6 珍味) delicious; _(1)chan (1)ch(u (2)fan_ (zan1 zyu1 fan2 珍珠粉), pearl sago; _(2)ch(e/)ung sh(e/)ung(6) (1)chan_ (zoeng2 soeng6 zan1 掌上珍), a pearl in the hand---a daughter. 【珍】 (trin) (_noun-like_) precious-thing (_adjective-like_) precious
U+771E (F1.79 眞) 實也正也精也純也 (Page 16|n59 #9: (1)眞(1)真)

U+771F 眞 (F1.79 眞) 實也正也精也純也 (Page 16|n59 #9: (1)眞(1)真) True, sincere, unfeigned, genuine, pure (Kangxi 眞: 不虛假也, 實也僞之反也); in fact, truly, indeed, no mistake; a likeness; actual, not secondary (Kangxi 眞: 正也); spiritual, subtle, pure, unmixed (Kangxi 眞: 神也淳也精也); _(1)chan (4)yan_ (zan1 jan4 真人), a sprite, a phantom of a man~~,~~; _(1)chan ko(3) (5)ts(')z'_ (zan1 go3 ci5 真個似) in fact, it was like; _(2)s(e/) (1)chan_ (se2 zan1 寫真), to draw portraits (Kangxi 眞: 畫像曰寫眞); _(1)chan hai(6)_ (zan1 hai6 真係) it is so; _(1)chan (1)tsong ching(3) ~~fan(6)~~ f(a/)n(6)_ (zan1 zong1 zing3 faan6-2 真贓正犯) this thing proves him a thief; _(4)'m (1)ch(i/) (1)chan (2)k(a/)_ (m4 zi1 zan1 gaa2 唔知真假), I don't know whether it is so or not; _(1)chan (1)sam_ (zan1 sam1 真心), true-hearted; _(1)chan f(u/)i(3) h(i/)(3)_ (zan1 fui3 hei3 真晦氣) low-spirited; _(1)chan ching(3)_ (zan1 zing3 真正) truly, indeed; _(1)chan (2)kong_ (zan1 gong2 真講), it ts really so. Williams' 真人: Kangxi has 《說文》仙人變形而登天也 under 眞, i.e. "The immortal man changing form and ascending to Heaven". In modern non-Taoist usage this sense is now obsolete, and 真人 now simply means "real person". Williams' 真贓正犯: Corrected _fan(6)_ (fan6) to _f(a/)n(6)_ (faan6). 【真】 (tsyin) (_adjective-like_) true 【認真】 (jing6-2 zan1) (_degree_) Really, truly. 認真傻 (jing6-2 zan1 so4): "That's truly dumb." 【嚟真】 (lai4-2 zan1) To do for real (as opposed to a practice, test, or fake run). 今次嚟真㗎喇 (gam1 ci3 lai4-2 zan1 ga3 la3): "This time it's for real!"

zan2.text: U+8CD1 赈 (Mainland simplified) (Page 17|n60 #3: 賑(3)) Read _(2)chan_ (zan2)_;_ rich, affluent, wealthy (Kangxi: 富也). 【賑-rising】 (tsyinX) (_adjective-like_) rich

zan3.text: U+8CD1 振 赈 (Mainland simplified) (F1.84 賑) 賙濟也 (Page 17|n60 #3: 賑(3)) A largess, a bounty; to give, to relieve, to supply (Kangxi: 贍也給也); _chan(3) tsai(3)_ (zan3 zai3 賑濟) to give to the poor; _chan(3) (1)k(i/)_ (zan3 gei1 賑饑), to feed the hungry. Williams' "bounty": In the sense of an act of generosity. *Not* an abundance of wealth, which belongs under the rising-tone reading _(2)chan_ (zan2). 【賑-departing】 (tsyinH) (_verb-like_) to succour

U+4FB2 zan1 (per 《廣韻》職鄰切 for "horsekeeper" sense) (Page 17|n60 #5: 侲(3)) A boy (Kangxi: 童子也) ~~of ten or twelve years~~; _chan(3) (4)t(')ung_ (zan3 tung4 侲童), boys who play at funerals (Kangxi: 挽歌亦用侲童). Kangxi has both the "boy" sense and the "horsekeeper" sense under departing-tone 之刃切 _chan(3)_ (zan3), followed by the permissive level-tone variation 之人切音眞 _(1)chan_ (zan1) for (presumably) the latter sense. In contrast, 《廣韻》 distinguishes the "horsekeeper" sense under departing-tone 章刃切 _chan(3)_ (zan3) from the "boy ghost-expeller" sense under level-tone 職鄰切 _(1)chan_ (zan1). Williams' "of ten or twelve years": This appears in Kangxi's example, 《後漢禮儀志》...選中黃門子弟十歲以上十二以下, but is not part of the definition. A groom, a horsekeeper (Kangxi: 燕齊閒謂養馬者爲侲).

U+5733 cau4 (per Kangxi 市流切 for "field-drainage" sense) zeon3 (per Fan Wan) (F2.54 圳 _Chun(3)_ (zeon3)) 諄去聲水劣也 (Page 36* #16: 圳(3) _Chun(3)_ (zeon3); here normalised to _Chan(3)_ (zan3)) A rapid in a stream; _~~chun(3)~~ chan(3) (2)hau_ (zan3 hau2 圳口), a place where the water runs swiftly. Drainage in a field (Kangxi: 江楚閒田畔水溝謂之圳). Used in 深圳 (Shenzhen).

U+5E2A zan1 (per 《廣韻》職鄰切) (Page 17|n60 #6: 帪(3)) A bag to tie on a horse's head, in which his fodder is placed (Kangxi: 囊也馬兜也, 帪飤馬橐). The reading _chan(3)_ (zan3) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 之刃切, explained 方言飤馬槖.
U+7471 May appear as either ⿰𤣩眞 or ⿰𤣩真 (assumed here), depending on the font. The two forms are actually separate characters in Kangxi (p.740#2 and p.740#3 respectively). A type of jade (Kangxi: 玉名).
U+93AD (F1.84 鎭) 鎭守鎭壓鎭靜凡藩鎭山鎭皆取安重鎭壓之義 (Page 17|n60 #4: 鎭(3))

U+93AE 瑱 鎭 镇 (Mainland simplified) (F1.84 鎭) 鎭守鎭壓鎭靜凡藩鎭山鎭皆取安重鎭壓之義 (Page 17|n60 #4: 鎭(3); here normalised to 鎮) To press down (Kangxi 鎭: 博壓也, 重也壓也); to repress, to keep in subjection; to pacify, to protect (Kangxi 鎭: 安也); to overrule evil influences, as hills or pagodas do; to guard, to keep quiet; a mart, a trading-place; _chan(3) fuk(9)_ (zan3 fuk6 鎮服) to sway, to be lord paramount; _chan(3) (1)king_ (zan3 ging1 鎮驚), to quell one's fears; _chan(3) (4)t(')oi_ (zan3 toi4 鎮臺), a protector; a brigadier; _chan(3) (2)shau (1)p(i/)n (1)kw(a/)n_ (zan3 sau2 bin1 gwaan1 鎮守邊關), to guard the frontier; _chan(3) (a/)t(8)_ (zan3 aat3 鎮壓) to repress disturbance; _t(a/)i(6) chan(3) (4)t(')au_ (daai6 zan3 tau4 大鎮頭), an entrepot or great trading-mart. Williams' 大鎮頭: Here "entrepot" is Williams' spelling. I know not enough about French to determine if it should instead be spelt "entrepot". 【鎮】 (trinH) (_verb-like_) to suppress, to subdue

U+9707 振 zan3-2 (rising second in vernacular 震震地) (F1.84 震) 卦名動也起也懼也威也 (Page 17|n60 #2: 震(3)) Interchanged with the last (振). To quiver (Kangxi: 震動也); to shiver; the 51st diagram, belongs to thunder (Kangxi: 卦名); ~~to shake, as by~~ a crack of thunder (Kangxi: 劈歷振物者, 震雷也); to awe, to impress (Kangxi: 威也); thundering, terrible, as a sound; dire, awful; to intimidate (Kangxi: 震懼也); to ~~raise~~ start (Kangxi: 起也); to alarm; _t(i/)(6) chan(3)_ (dei6 zan3 地震) an earthquake; _chan(3) n(o\)(6)_ (zan3 nou6 震怒) incensed; _(1)wai chan(3)_ (wai1 zan3 威震) to exhibit the majesty of China; _chan(3) ~~(1)keng~~ (1)king_ (zan3 ging1 震驚), terrified; _chan(3) tung(6)_ (zan3 dung6 震動) disturbed. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰亻瞿 to 懼. Williams' 震驚: Corrected _(1)keng_ (geng1) to _(1)king_ (ging1). 【震】 (tsyinH) (_noun-like_) thunder-crack (_verb-like_) to shake, to quake 【打冷震】 (daa2 laang5 zan3) To shiver. (_slang_) To have an orgasm.

zan6.text: U+9663 敶 陳 阵 (Mainland simplified) zan6-2 (for Cantonese "time", "later", and subjunctive marker senses) (F1.85 陣) 軍師行伍之列 (F1.85 陳) 同上 (Page 17|n60 #7: 陣(6)陳(6)) A rank, a file of soldiers, a battalion (Kangxi 陣: 旅也, 列也); an army; to arrange, to place in ranks; a little while, passing, transitory; a battle; to drill; a mode of marshaling; _chan(6) sh(e/)ung(6)_ (zan6 soeng6 陣上) in the fight; _yat(7) chan(6) chan(6) ~~(5)lang~~ (5)l(a/)ng_ (jat1 zan6 zan6 laang5 一陣陣冷), growing colder; _(2)shai (5)n(u (4)yan chan(6)_ (sai2 neoi5 jan4-2 zan6 使女人陣) to send a woman to get it; _(4)mai (4)wan chan(6)_ (mai4 wan4 zan6 迷魂陣) besotted in; silly; _(2)p(a/)i chan(6)_ (baai2 zan6 擺陣) to ~~post troops~~ set up a formation; _(2)k(i/) (4)t(')i(u/) muk(9) chan(6)_ (gei2 tiu4 muk6 zan6 幾條木陣) several wooden sleepers (or supports); _chan(6) shai(3)_ (zan6 sai3 陣勢) the ranks; courageous; _yat(7) chan(6) (5)(u_ (jat1 zan6 jyu5 一陣雨), a shower; _yat(7) chan(6) (1)fung (5)(u_ (jat1 zan6 fung1 jyu5 一陣風雨), a squall; _yat(7) chan(6) (4)ming, yat(7) chan(6) (4)'m (4)ming_ (jat1 zan6 ming4 jat1 zan6 m4 ming4 一陣明一陣唔明), now you know, and then you do not know; _p(a/)i(6) chan(6)_ (baai6 zan6 敗陣) defeated the troops. Williams' 一陣陣冷: Changed _(5)lang_ (lang5) to common reading _(5)l(a/)ng_ (laang5). Williams' 使女人陣: Literally, "employ the women's formation". Williams' 陣勢: Figuratively, the situation of the battle. 【陣】 (drinH) (_noun-like_) battle-array, (_met._) battlefield 【一陣-moment】 (jat1 zan6) A moment or short while. 等一陣啊 (dang2 jat1 zan6 a3): "Hold on a bit." 瞓咗一陣 (fan3 zo2 jat1 zan6): "Slept for a bit." 【一陣-later】 (jat1 zan6, jat1 zan6-2) Later, especially a short while later. 一陣先吖 (jat1 zan6 sin1 a1): "I'll see to it later" 一陣出去 (jat1 zan6-2 ceot1 heoi3): "I'll go out later." Marks the subjunctive mood ("what if" for an hypothetical future). 一陣遲到咪弊 (jat1 zan6-2 ci4 dou3 mai6 bai6): "If we arrive late, won't we be stuffed?" 【一陣間】 (jat1 zan6 gaan1) Synonym of 一陣 (both in the "moment" sense and in the "later" and subjunctive marker senses). 【有陣時】 (jau5 zan6 si4, jau5 zan6 si4-2) Sometimes. 【陣-moment】 (zan6) Short for 一陣 in the "moment" sense. 等陣啊 (dang2 zan6 a3): "Hold on a bit." 瞓咗陣 (fan3 zo2 zan6): "Slept for a bit." 【陣-time】 (zan6, zan6-2) A time, or period of time, or era. 嗰陣 (go2 zan6-2): "At that time." 家陣 (gaa1 zan6-2): "Nowadays." 【陣間】 (zan6 gaan1) Short for 一陣間.

zang1.text: U+51C8 净 caang1 (per 《廣韻》楚耕切) zaang1 (longer syllable) (Page 20|n63 #8: (1)净; here normalised to 凈) Cold, shivering (Kangxi 凈: 冷貌).

U+589E 増 曾 (F2.29 增) 益也加也 (Page 556 #5: (1)曾; here normalised to 增) (...), to add (Kangxi 曾: 與增同); (Page 556 #6: (1)增) To add, to double, to increase (Kangxi: 益也); repeated, doubled (Kangxi: 一曰重也); _(1)k(a/) (1)tsang_ (gaa1 zang1 加增), to augment; _(1)tsang k(a/)(3)_ (zang1 gaa3 增價) to raise the price; _(1)tsang (4)m(a/)i_ (zang1 maai4 增埋), to give a higher price, to throw in the difference. Multitudinous (Kangxi: 衆也). 【增】 (tsong) (_verb-like_) to increase (_adjective-like_) multitudinous

U+618E (F2.29 憎) 惡也 (Page 556 #7: (1)憎) To hate, to dislike, to abominate (Kangxi: 惡也); _(2)ho (1)tsang_ (ho2 zang1 可憎), hateful; _tak(7) (4)yan (1)tsang_ (dak1 jan4 zang1 得人憎), to be hated; _hat(7) (4)yan (1)tsang_ (hat1 jan4 zang1 乞人憎), to act so as to be hated; _(5)ngo (2)h(o\) (1)tsang (5)k(')(u_ (ngo5 hou2 zang1 keoi5 我好憎佢), I perfectly detest him; _(1)tsang h(o\)(3) pat(7) (4)t(')ung_ (zang1 hou3 bat1 tung4 憎好不同), capricious, now hating and then loving. 【憎】 (tsong) (_verb-like_) to hate 【乞人憎】 (hat1 jan4 zang1) Despicable. (Literally, "begging others to hate".) 真係乞人憎 (zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1): "That really is despicable."
U+775C 睁 To open the eyes, especially suddenly.

U+7E52 缯 (Mainland simplified) cang4 (per 《廣韻》疾陵切) (F2.29 繒) 魚網 (F2.29 罾) 同上 (Page 556 #9: (1)繒) A general name for common silken fabrics, as pongee, sarsnet, lutestring (Kangxi: 帛也). The reading _(1)tsang_ (zang1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 咨騰切, explained 帛也. Fan Wan erroneously has 繒 explained 魚網 (綱 corrected to 網), and a strange character (like 曾, but with 丅 conjoined to the middle component between 八 above and 曰 below) explained 同上, here normalised to 罾. 【繒】 (dzing) (_noun-like_) silk

U+7F7E (F2.29 繒) 魚網 (F2.29 罾) 同上 (Page 556 #8: (1)罾) A lifting net, suspended by the corners (Kangxi: 罾魚網也形似仰繖蓋四維而舉之); _kw(a/)(3) (1)tsang_ (gwaa3 zang1 掛罾), to let down the net; _(1)h(a/) (1)tsang_ (haa1 zang1 蝦罾), a crab-net made of cloth; _~~(2)au~~ (2)(a/)u (1)tsang_ (aau2 zang1 拗罾), to raise the net; _~~(2)au~~ (2)(a/)u (1)tsang (4)'m k(i/)(3) tak(7) t(')ong(3) (1)lo (4)sh(i/)_ (aau2 zang1 m4 gei3 dak1 tong3 lo4-1 si4 拗罾唔記得熨籮時), he don't like to remember when he dragged for shrimps. Fan Wan erroneously has 繒 explained 魚網 (綱 corrected to 網), and a strange character (like 曾, but with 丅 conjoined to the middle component between 八 above and 曰 below) explained 同上, here normalised to 罾. Williams' 拗罾 etc.: Corrected _(2)au_ (au2) to _(2)(a/)u_ (aau2).

zang3.text: U+7511 䰝 zang6 (common) (F2.31 甑) 炊飯之器又酒甑 (Page 556 #10: 甑(3)) A boiler for distilling (Fan Wan: 酒甑), an alembic, a still made of pewter; a boiler for steaming (Kangxi: 甗也) rice; to steam, to distil; _lok(9) tsang(3) (1)ching_ (lok6 zang3 zing1 落甑蒸), put it in the still and steam it. 【甑】 (tsingH) (_noun-like_) boiler

zang6.text: U+8D08 赠 (Mainland simplified) (F2.32 贈) 送也 (Page 557 #1: 贈(6)) To present, to give to, to bestow on (Kangxi: 贈送也); to confer, as by the crown; to add to (Kangxi: 贈增也); _tsang(6) sung(3)_ (zang6 sung3 贈送) to give a present to; _k(o\)(3) tsang(6)_ (gou3 zang6 誥贈) to honor an officer's parents for his merits; _tsang(6) (1)k(u/)n h(i/)(3) shik(7)_ (zang6 gun1 hei3 sik1 贈觀氣色) to give a look at one's complexion---a sign of physiognomists; _ch(i/)t(8) (5)lau tsang(6) (4)hang (4)yan_ (zit3 lau5 zang6 hang4 jan4 折柳贈行人), to give a willow-twig at parting; _toi(6) tsang(6)_ (doi6 zang6 待贈) waiting for promotion, as expectant graduates do, at sixty. 【贈】 (dzongH) (_verb-like_) to gift

zap1.text: U+57F7 执 (Mainland simplified) (F2.39 執) 持守也拘也捕也 (Page 22|n65 #1: 執(7)) To take in the hand, to pick up, to lay hold of, to grasp; to apprehend, to catch (Kangxi: 捕也); to maintain, to retain (Kangxi: 守也持也); to stop up (Kangxi: 塞也); a handfull; _chap(7) (5)yau_ (zap1 jau5 執友), a father's old friend (Kangxi: 父之友曰執友); _(1)shau chap(7)_ (sau1 zap1 收執) to receive and keep as evidence; _chap(7) tsz'(6)_ (zap1 zi6 執字) to set types; _chap(7) (4)ch(')au_ (zap1 cau4-2 執籌), to draw lots; _chap(7) (1)chung_ (zap1 zung1 執中), to keep a due medium; _chap(7) (a/)u(3)_ (zap1 aau3 執拗) a pertinacious dispute; _k(u/)(3) chap(7)_ (gu3 zap1 固執) obstinate, set in his way; _kok(8) chap(7) yat(7) ngai(6)_ (gok3 zap1 jat1 ngai6 各執一藝) each follows his trade; _p(o\)(6) chap(7)_ (bou6 zap1 捕執) to arrest; _chap(7) sz'(6)_ (zap1 si6 執事) to manage business; an officer's retinue; _chap(7) (2)shau_ (zap1 sau2 執手), take by the hand. To manage, to judge (Kangxi: 處也). To carry out, to execute. 【執】 (tsyip) (_verb-like_) to take hold, to hold, (_met._) to carry out (_verb-like_) to seize (_noun-like_) close-held friend 【執】 (zap1) To pick up. 執返佢 (zap1 faan1 keoi5): "Pick it back up." 執垃圾 (zap1 laap6 saap3): "Pick up rubbish." 執狗屎 (zap1 gau2 si2): "Pick up dog shit." To tidy up, or make neater. 執房 (zap1 fong4-2): "Tidy up the room." 執正啲 (zap zeng1 di1): "Make it a bit neater." To pack. 執包袱 (zap1 baau1 fuk6): "Pack my bags". 執行李 (zap1 hang4 lei5): "Pack luggage." Short for 執笠. 【執錯字粒】 (zap1 co3 zi6 nap1) To make a typo. (Literally, "Pick up the wrong character block.") 【執骨】 (zap1 gwat1) To take up the bones from a grave (for a reburial). 【執笠】 (zap1 lap1) To shut up shop, especially after going bankrupt. 執咗笠 (zap1 zo2 lap1): "They've shut up shop." 就快執笠 (zau6 faai3 zap1 lap1): "About to go under." 【執媽】 (zap1 maa1) A midwife (strictly female). 【執碼-verb】 (zap1 maa5) To gather ingredients for a chef to cook. 【執碼-noun】 (zap1 maa5-2) The kitchen assistant who gather ingredients for the chefs to cook. 【執生】 (zap1 saang1) To improvise, or figure something out on the spot. 【執輸】 (zap1 syu1) To miss out. 【執仔】 (zap1 zai2) To midwive. 【執仔婆】 (zap1 zai2 po4-2) A midwife (strictly female).

U+6C41 (F2.39 汁) 液也 (Page 22|n65 #3: 汁(7)) Gravy, juice (Kangxi: 液也); thickened liquor; slosh; the juices or essence of a thing got by expressing; sleety rain, wet snow (Kangxi: 雨雪雜下曰汁); _(1)pan (4)long chap(7)_ (ban1 long4 zap1 檳榔汁) betel juice; _ts(')oi(3) chap(7)_ (coi3 zap1 菜汁) liquor left after cooking vegetables; _chap(7) (4)'m tak(7) t(a/)m(6) h(a/)p(8)_ (zap1 m4 dak1 daam6 haap3 汁唔得啖呷) not had a mouthful of gravy to suck---I've had no benefit from it. Williams' "thickened liquor": From Kangxi's example 汁獻涗於醆酒, with commentary noting that 汁獻 is also spelt 汁莎. 【汁】 (tsyip) (_noun-like_) juice, (_met._) sleet

U+7E36 馽 絷 (Mainland simplified) (F2.39 縶) 羈係也絆馬足曰縶 (F2.39 ？) 同上 (Page 22|n65 #2: 縶(7)) To fetter a horse (Kangxi: 縶絆也) or cow with rope; ~~fetters, shackles;~~ to bind, to secure (Kangxi: 相縶也連也); a cord (Kangxi: 縷也). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 紏 to 絆. The variant entry is 馬 with 山 replacing 灬. 【縶】 (trip) (_verb-like_) to tether

U+84FB 𠽃 (Cantonese) 執 (Cantonese) (Page 557 #4: 𠽃(7); here normalised to 蓻) A colloquial word. A heap, a handful, a pile; a group, a knot; _ch(u(6) (4)m(a/)i yat(7) tsap(7)_ (zyu6 maai4 jat1 zap1 住埋一蓻) living in a single community; _~~tso(6)~~ (5)ts(')o (4)m(a/)i yat(7) tsap(7)_ (co5 maai4 jat1 zap1 坐埋一蓻) sitting together in a group; _s(o\)(3) (4)m(a/)i yat(7) tsap(7)_ (sou3 maai4 jat1 zap1 掃埋一蓻) sweep it up into a pile; _ap(7) tsap(7)_ (ap1 zap1 洽蓻) stingy, craven, slovenly; _yat(7) tsap(7) (5)mai_ (jat1 zap1 mai5 一蓻米), as much rice as the fingers can grasp; _(1)t(')au tsap(7)_ (tau1 zap1 偷蓻) to make a little money. Williams' 坐埋一蓻: Corrected _tso(6)_ (zo6 去聲) to _(5)ts(')o_ (co5 上聲). 【蓻】 (zap1) A pinch or tuft. 一蓻鹽 (jat1 zap1 jim4): "One pinch of salt." 一蓻頭髮 (jat zap1 tau4 faat3): "One tuft of hair." It is debatable whether this is the same word as 執 _chap(7)_ (zap1). In any case, Williams records the reading as _tsap(7)_ (zap1), and Eitel (1877) prefers the character 蓻, which matches _tsap(7)_ (zap1) in pronunciation: 《廣韻》子入切 蓻 草生多皃 《康熙字典》蓻 《唐韻》子入切音𥠋草生多貌 又《玉篇》茅芽也...

zat1.text: U+53EA (F1.86 只) 專也又語詞 (Page 23|n66 #7: 只(7))

zi2.text: U+53EA 止 (for "only" senses) 祇 (for "only" senses) 祗 (for "only" senses) 衹 (for "only" senses) 軹 (for particle sense) zat1 (per 《五音集韻》之日切) (F1.39 止) 息也定也但也 (F1.39 祗) 敬也但也又音其 (F1.39 只) 樂只君子 (F1.86 只 _Chat(7)_ (zat1)) 專也又語詞 (Page 23|n66 #7: 只(7) _Chat(7)_ (zat1)) Only, merely; but, however, yet; _chat(7) (2)h(o\) (2)k(o\)m ~~(2)ch(e/)~~ ch(e/)(3)_ (zat1 hou2 gam2 ze3 只好噉嗻), this way alone; _chat(7) tak(7)_ (zat1 dak1 只得) no otherwise, only could. Also read _(2)ch(i/)_ (zi2), in the same senses; and only _(2)ch(i/)_ (zi2), when it is used as a final particle (Kangxi: 語已詞也). (Page 39|n82 #2: (2)止; here normalised to 只) only, but, however; _(2)ch(i/) sh(i/)(6)_ (zi2 si6 只是) only is; _(4)'m (2)ch(i/) k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (m4 zi2 gam3 do1 唔只咁多), not so few; _(2)ch(i/) tak(7) k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (zi2 dak1 gam3 do1 只得咁多), only so many; (Page 40|n83 #1: (2)祗; here normalised to 只) only, but merely, however, yet; _(2)ch(i/) (2)ts(')z'_ (zi2 ci2 只此) only this; _(2)ch(i/) (5)yau yat(7) y(e/)ung(6)_ (zi2 jau5 jat1 joeng6 只有一樣) only one sort; (Page 152 #7: (4)祇; here normalised to 只 via 祗) Often confounded with and used for _(2)ch(i/)_ (zi2) 祗. The sense in the example 樂只君子 given by Fan Wan for 只 is classical speech-assist. Williams' 只好噉啫: Corrected _(2)ch(e/)_ (ze2) to _ch(e/)(3)_ (ze3). In classical terms, the reading _chat(7)_ (zat1) for 只 is vulgar. 《五音集韻》 has the reading 之日切, with the note 本之爾切本無質音今讀若質俗所音増. In modern terms, the reading _chat(7)_ (zat1) is obsolete. 【只】 (tsyeX) (_speech-assist_)

zat1.text: U+67B3 zeot1 (alternative for noun sense) (Page 23|n66 #8: 枳(7)) A colloquial word. A cork, a plug, a stopple; to cork, to fasten a stopper; _(2)tsau chat(7)_ (zau2 zat1 酒枳) a bottle cork; _chat(7) shat(9) (5)k(')(u_ (zat1 sat6 keoi5 枳實佢), cork it tightly. 【枳】 (zat1) A cork or plug. To block or stop using a cork or plug. The spelling 枳 is arbitrary (but well established).

zi2.text: U+67B3 gei2 (per 《集韻》舉綺切 in 枳椇) (F1.39 枳) 枳棘又枳殼藥名 (Page 40|n83 #3: (2)枳) A hedge thorn, a spinous tree (Kangxi: 木高多刺); a fruit like a pumelo, with a thick skin (Kangxi: 木似橘); hurtful (Kangxi: 枳害也)~~, like thorns~~; _(2)ch(i/) kik(7)_ (zi2 gik1 枳棘) hedged up; thorny; _(2)ch(i/) ~~k(u(6)~~ (2)k(u_ (zi2 geoi2 枳椇) the _Hovenia dulcis;_ _(2)ch(i/) hok(8)_ (zi2 hok3 枳殼) ~~its seeds~~ the skin of the Chinese bitter orange, used for medicine. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𣗥 to 棘. Williams' "hurtful": In the sense of "harmful". Williams' 枳椇: Corrected _k(u(6)_ (geoi6) to _(2)k(u_ (geoi2).

zat1.text: U+8CEA 貭 质 (Mainland simplified) (F1.86 質) 樸也又文質 (F1.86 貭) 同質 (Page 23|n66 #4: 質(7)) Substance, essence, nature, the material of (Kangxi: 質猶性也); plain, unadorned (Kangxi: 樸也, 質猶本也); sincere, honest (Kangxi: 實也, 質誠也); to cross-examine, to confront (Kangxi: 問也定也); to establish, to substantiate (Kangxi: 質體也); opposite to, to appear in presence of (Kangxi: 質猶對也); firm, as a texture; a disposition, a habit; a target (Kangxi: 的質也); _h(i/)(3) chat(7)_ (hei3 zat1 氣質) the complexion; the elements of; _chat(7) sun(3)_ (zat1 seon3 質訊) to confront the accused and witnesses; _chat(7) p(')ok(8)_ (zat1 pok3 質樸) plain; _chat(7) t(i/)(6)_ (zat1 dei6-2 質地) temperament, constitution, talents; _(2)pan chat(7)_ (ban2 zat1 品質) the disposition. 【質-entering】 (tsyit) (_noun-like_) substance (_adjective-like_) simple (_verb-like_) to complete (_verb-like_) to affirm, to verify (_verb-like_) to front (_verb-like_) to interrogate (_noun-like_) target (_adverb-like_) directly 【質】 (zat1) To stuff or pack tightly. 質飽佢 (zat1 baau2 keoi5): "Stuff him full with food." 質到爆 (zat1 dou3 baau3): "Packed till bursting." To query or interrogate in an adversarial manner. 畀律師質 (bei2 leot6 si1 zat1): "Interrogated by a lawyer."

zi3.text: U+8CEA 貭 质 (Mainland simplified) (F1.41 質) 留人爲當以要信也 (Page 9* #7: 質(3)) A pledge, a hostage; to pledge, to guaranty (Kangxi: 以物相贅); to pawn; _on(3) ch(i/)(3)_ (on3 zi3 按質) to give a pledge or guaranty; _ch(i/)(3) f(u/)(3)_ (zi3 fu3 質庫) a pawnbroker's; _(1)k(a/)u ch(i/)(3)_ (gaau1 zi3 交質) to exchange hostages. 【質-departing】 (trijH) (_verb-like_) to pledge, to give hostage (_noun-like_) pledge, hostage

zat6.text: U+90C5 zat1 (per 《廣韻》之日切) (F1.41 郅 _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3)) 世之隆也又極也 (Page 23|n66 #3: 郅(7) _Chat(7)_ (zat1); here normalised to _Chat(9)_ (zat6)) To ascend, to go up (Kangxi: 登也), as a hill; flourishing, as an age; very, exceedingly (Kangxi: 至也); name of a city (Kangxi: 郁郅古縣名); _~~chat(7)~~ chat(9) (4)lung_ (zat6 lung4 郅隆), very grand; _yuk(7) ~~chat(7)~~ chat(9)_ (juk1 zat6 郁郅) an ancient name of Ng(a/)nhw(a/) hien (安化縣) in K(a/)nsuh (甘肅).

zat1.text: U+9455 锧 (Mainland simplified) (Page 23|n66 #5: 鑕(7)) An ax, a hatchet (Kangxi: 斧也); an anvil or iron block (Kangxi: 鐵鑕砧, 斧鑕椹也), used by smiths and others.
U+96B2 (F1.86 隲) 陰隲品隲又定也成也陞也生也 (Page 23|n66 #6: 𨽥(7)隲(7))

U+9A2D 隲 𨽥 骘 (Mainland simplified) (F1.86 隲) 陰隲品隲又定也成也陞也生也 (Page 23|n66 #6: 𨽥(7)隲(7); here normalised to 騭) A stallion (Kangxi 騭: 牡馬也, 牡曰騭); to mount; to ascend (Kangxi 騭: 乗馬登山也); to raise, to promote (Kangxi 騭: 騭陞也); to fix, to determine (Kangxi 騭: 定也); _(1)yam chat(7)_ (jam1 zat1 陰騭) to think upon kindly, a secret benevolence; _tsik(7) (1)yam chat(7)_ (zik1 jam1 zat1 積陰騭) to perform many good deeds. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 降 to 陞. 【騭】 (tsyit) (_verb-like_) to secure (_verb-like_) to raise

zat6.text: U+54A5 (F1.87 咥) 易履虎尾不咥人亨詩又音棄 (Page 24|n67 #3: 咥(9)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿱𠫓耒 to 棄.

U+59EA 侄 妷 dit6 (alternative per 《廣韻》徒結切) zat6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.87 姪) 兄弟之子曰姪 (Page 24|n67 #1: 姪(9)) A brother's children (Kangxi: 兄弟之女也, 兄弟之子); _chat(9) (2)tsz'_ (zat6 zi2 姪子) a nephew; _chat(9) (5)n(u_ (zat6 neoi5-2 姪女), a ~~neice~~ niece; _ngoi(6) chat(9)_ (ngoi6 zat6-2 外姪) a wife's nephews; _(4)n(i/)n chat(9)_ (nin4 zat6-2 年姪) sons of alumni of the same year; _k(un(3) chat(9)_ (gyun3 zat6 眷姪) young relatives. 【姪】 (det, drit) (_noun-like_) nephew, niece 【姪婦】 (zat6 pou5) A brother's son's wife. 【姪仔】 (zat6 zai2) A brother's son.

U+5AC9 㑵 愱 疾 zi6 (alternative per 《廣韻》疾二切) (F1.87 嫉) 妬忌也 (Page 559 #4: 疾(9)) used for the next (嫉); (Page 559 #5: 嫉(9)) Envy, jealousy (Kangxi: 妎也); to envy, to dislike, as a competitor; _tsat(9) (4)(i/)n_ (zat6 jin4 嫉賢), to hate the worthy; _tsat(9) t(o\)(3)_ (zat6 dou3 嫉妒) jealousy. 【嫉】 (dzit, dzijH) (_verb-like_) to be jealous (_noun-like_) jealousy

U+6303 zat1 (per 《廣韻》陟栗切) (F1.87 挃) 刈禾聲也詩獲之挃挃 (Page 24|n67 #5: 挃(9)) ~~To cut~~ The sound of cutting down grain (Kangxi: 穫禾聲, 挃挃穫也); to beat, to knock with the fist (Kangxi: 撞挃也). 【挃】 (trit) (_onomatopoeia_) slash

U+684E zat1 (per 《廣韻》之日切) (F1.87 桎) 桎梏刑械也又疑也 (Page 24|n67 #4: 桎(9)) Fetters, gyves, stocks of wood or iron (Kangxi: 足械也); to manacle; to pierce (Kangxi: 桎刺也); a thing to clog wheels (Kangxi: 桎鎋所以制車者); _chat(9) kuk(7)_ (zat6 guk1 桎梏) fetters; _chat(9) hat(9)_ (zat6 hat6 桎鎋) a linchpin; _met._ a censor of manners, a guide of affairs; _wat(7) wat(7) chat(9) chat(9)_ (wat1 wat1 zat6 zat6 屈屈桎桎) cramped, cribbed, the room is scanty;---a colloquial phrase. 【桎】 (tsyit) (_noun-like_) fetter

U+75BE (F1.87 疾) 病也患也惡也急也 (Page 559 #4: 疾(9)) Sickness, a disease which comes suddenly on one (Kangxi: 病也一曰急也 etc.); ~~calamities,~~ afflictions (Kangxi: 患也); urgent, pressing, prompt, hasty (Kangxi: 速也, 急也); unlucky, infelicitous (Kangxi: 惡也); to hate, to dislike, to envy (Kangxi: 怨也); _tsat(9) peng(6)_ (zat6 beng6 疾病) disease, ailments; _man(6) tsat(9)_ (man6 zat6 問疾) to inquire after a sick person; _tsat(9) (4)mong_ (zat6 mong4 疾忙), testy, hasty, quick; _tsat(9) sh(i/)(6)_ (zat6 si6 疾視) to scowl at; _ping(6) (4)m(o\) tsat(9) (4)(i/)n_ (bing6 mou4 zat6 jin4 並無疾言), still he never spoke boisterously; _tsat(9) (4)l(u/)i_ (zat6 leoi4 疾雷), a crashing clap of thunder; _tsat(9) (4)yan_ (zat6 jan4 疾人), a leper; _tsat(9) ~~tsuk(7)~~ ts(')uk(7)_ (zat6 cuk1 疾速) impetuous, in haste; _(4)ts(')(a/)n tsat(9) (1)ch(i/) (4)yan_ (caan4 zat6 zi1 jan4 殘疾之人), thoroughly diseased. Williams' 疾速: Corrected _tsuk(7)_ (zuk1) to _ts(')uk(7)_ (cuk1). 【疾】 (dzit) (_noun-like_) sickness, malady (_adverb-like_) hastily (_verb-like_) to detest

U+7A92 zat1 (per 《廣韻》陟栗切) zat6-2 (rising second in vernacular 窒窒地) (F1.87 窒) 窒塞不通也 (Page 23|n66 #9: 窒(9)) To close (Kangxi: 塞也), to stop up the mouth of; to hamper~~,~~; the moon in opposition (Kangxi: 月在庚曰窒); _chat(9) (2)shau chat(9) k(e/)uk(8)_ (zat6 sau2 zat6 goek3 窒手窒腳) impeded, things not to one's liking; _chat(9) ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u_ (zat6 zyu6 keoi5 窒住佢), stop it up tight; _chat(9) ngoi(6)_ (zat6 ngoi6 窒礙) difficulties. 【窒】 (trit, tet) (_verb-like_) to stop up 【窒】 (zat6) To interrupt, especially by making an adversarial counterpoint or challenge. 咪窒住嗮啦 (mai5 zat6 zyu6 saai3 laa1): "Stop interrupting!" 窒到口啞啞 (zat6 dou3 hau2 aa2 aa2): "Challenged till speechless." To chide, especially as an interruption. 窒我錯咗 (zat6 ngo5 co3 zo2): "Chided me for getting it wrong." To be intermittent and non-smooth in action or motion (stuttered speech, audio/video buffering, etc.). 口窒窒 (hau2 zat6 zat6): "Stammering." 影片窒吓窒吓 (jing2 pin3-2 zat6 haa5 zat6 haa5): "The video playback is stop-start."

U+84BA (F1.87 蒺) 蒺藜有三角 (Page 559 #6: 蒺(9)) Gorse, furze (Kangxi: 蒺䔧藥草); a thorny shrub (Kangxi: 其刺傷人甚疾而利也), whose seeds are biting and spicy; _tsat(9) (4)lai_ (zat6 lai4 蒺藜), a very spinous plant, the seeds are used in diseases of the eye. 【蒺】 (dzit) Used in 蒺藜. 【蒺藜】 (dzit lej) caltrop

U+86ED zat1 (per 《廣韻》之日切) (F1.87 蛭) 虫名 (Page 24|n67 #6: 蛭(9)) A leech (Kangxi: 水蛭 etc.); _(2)shui chat(9)_ (seoi2 zat6 水蛭) a blood-sucker, of which there are several kinds (Kangxi: ...有數種...得齧人腹中有血者...).

U+87C4 蛰 (Mainland simplified) zaap6 (per 《廣韻》直立切) zik6 (common) zit3 (common) (F1.87 蟄) 蟄虫藏也又驚蟄節 (Page 24|n67 #2: 蟄(9)) Retired into silence (Kangxi: 藏也, 蟄靜也); to burrow; insects burrowing, or becoming torpid in holes (Kangxi: 藏伏靜處也); _(1)king chat(9)_ (ging1 zat6 驚蟄) "excited insects," is the name of the fifth of the 24 terms; March 5th to 20th. To cluster (Kangxi: 和集也). 【蟄】 (drip) (_noun-like_) hibernation (_verb-like_) to cluster

zau1.text: U+4F9C (F1.49 侜) 載也 (Page 25|n68 #5: (1)侜) To conceal, to shade, to hide (Kangxi: 有廱蔽也); ~~something stretched for a shade.~~ Williams' "stretched": This is a misreading of Kangxi 侜張...誑也, to deceive. To deceive. 【侜】 (trjuw) (_verb-like_) to cover up, (_met._) to deceive

U+5468 May appear with central vertical stroke not poking through (assumed here) or poking through and touching the component 口. This extends to all characters containing 周 as a component. 週 (F1.49 周) 周密周濟周備周遍又姓 (Page 25|n68 #1: (1)周) Universal, complete, entire (Kangxi: 備也); plenty, enough; to make a circuit, to environ (Kangxi: 周帀也); a famous dynasty, B. C. 1122--255 (Kangxi: 周代名); secret, fine, subtle; close together, fine (Kangxi: 密也); a curve, a bend (Kangxi: 曲也); to extend everywhere (Kangxi: 徧也); honest, trustworthy (Kangxi: 忠信也); to the end (Kangxi: 終也), entirely; _(2)h(o\) (1)chau t(o\)(3)_ (hou2 zau1 dou3 好周到) all things prepared; _(1)chau (1)ch(i/)_ (zau1 zi1 周知), ~~let~~ all know; _h(u(3) k(i/)n(3) (1)chau (1)kung_ (heoi3 gin3 zau1 gung1 去見周公), he's gone to see Duke Chau---asleep; _(1)chau mat(9)_ (zau1 mat6 周密) numerous, close together; _(1)chau p(i/)(6)_ (zau1 bei6 周備) everything ready; _(1)chau (4)wai_ (zau1 wai4 周圍), everywhere, all around; _(1)chau (4)s(un_ (zau1 syun4 周旋) to circulate, to treat friends well; _(1)chau (4)ts(')(un_ (zau1 cyun4 周全), to bring a thing about, to remove ill feeling, to explain; _(2)h(o\) (1)chau ~~(1)ch(i/)~~ ch(i/)(3)_ (hou2 zau1 zi3 好周置), it is excellent. (Page 25|n68 #2: (1)週) Often used for the last (周). _(1)chau (4)sh(i/) (1)t(o\) hai(6) (2)k(o\)m_ (zau1 si4 dou1 hai6 gam2 周時都係噉), he is ever the same. Williams' 好周置: Corrected _(1)ch(i/)_ (zi1) to _ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【周】 (tsyuw) (_noun-like_) cycle, circumference, (_met._) round-part (_verb-like_) to encompass (_adjective-like_) all-encompassing, all-round, (_met._) comprehensive, ultimate, utmost 【周身刀冇張利】 (zau1 san1 dou1 mou5 zoeng1 lei6) Jack of all trades, master of none. (Literally, "Knives all-about the person, but not one sharp".) 【周時】 (zau1 si4) All the time.

U+557E 噍 (for "chirp" sense) (F1.50 啾) 啾喞小聲也 (Page 560 #8: (1)啾) The wail of infants (Kangxi: 小兒聲也); the hum of insects; _(1)tsau tsik(7)_ (zau1 zik1 啾唧) the cry of small children; _(1)tsau (1)tsau_ (zau1 zau1 啾啾), the chattering of birds (Kangxi: 啾啾鳴聲), squeaking of rats.

U+564D ziu1 (per 《廣韻》即消切) (Page 580 #9: (1)噍 _(1)Tsi(u/)_ (ziu1); here normalised to _(1)Tsau_ (zau1)) the chattering of birds (Kangxi: 燕雀聲, 噍子流反, 通作啾); The reading _(1)tsau_ (zau1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 將由切, explained 燕雀聲禮啁噍之頃通作啾. In fact, this reading is probably *more* reliable than 《廣韻》即消切 _(1)tsi(u/)_ (ziu1), as 《集韻》 explicitly has the example 啁噍之頃 from the Record of Rites, for which Kangxi gives 《釋文》噍子流反 in corroboration. Moreover, this gives 啁噍 an internal rhyme, which makes sense for a term that is onomatopoeic. 【啁噍】 (trjuw tsjuw) (_onomatopoeia_) chirp chirp 【噍-onomatopoeia】 (tsjuw) Used in 啁噍.

ziu1.text: U+564D (F2.3 噍) 無噍類言絶也 (Page 580 #9: (1)噍) A ~~husky,~~ suppressed (Kangxi: 噍𠴫也) or urgent (Kangxi: 噍子遙反謂急也) voice; ~~harsh, dissonant cry.~~ 【噍-adjective】 (tsjew) (_adjective-like_) urgent, quiet

ziu6.text: U+564D 𡁻 (Cantonese) 嚼 zeu6 (vernacular) (Page 24* #8: 齸(6) _Chi(u/)(6)_; here corrected to 噍 _Tsi(u/)(6)_) ~~A colloquial word.~~ ~~To chew the cud, to ruminate;~~ to bite hard on, to craunch; to chew, as tobacco. (Page 581 #7: 噍(6)) To bite, to chew, to gnaw (Kangxi: 齧也, 嚼也); _(4)ngau tsi(u/)(6) ~~(5)mau~~ (5)m(a/)u (1)t(a/)n_ (ngau4 ziu6 maau5 daan1 牛噍牡丹), the ox eats the peony, (not knowing it from grass); _tsi(u/)(6) l(a/)n(6)_ (ziu6 laan6 噍爛) to chew fine. Williams' 牛噍牡丹: Changed _(5)mau_ (mau5) to common reading _(5)m(a/)u_ (maau5). 【噍-departing】 (dzjewH) (_verb-like_) to chew 【噍】 (zeu6, ziu6) To chew. 噍爛啲 (zeu6 laan6 di1): "Chew it up finer." 噍香口膠 (ziu6 hoeng1 hau2 gaau1): "Chew chewing gum." 牛噍牡丹 (ngau4 ziu6 maau5 daan1): "As an ox chewing the peony." Olden attestation for 噍 _tsi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) meaning "chew": 《廣韻》才\笑\切 噍 嚼也

zau1.text: U+5DDE (F1.49 州) 九州 (Page 25|n68 #8: (1)州) A district, less than a prefecture; (...), a great division; _(1)ch(i/) (1)chau_ (zi1 zau1 知州), the magistrate over a _chau_ (zau 州) district; _(1)chau (4)t(')ung_ (zau1 tung4 州同), his deputy; _(2)kau (1)chau_ (gau2 zau1 九州), the empire; the whole world; _tuk(9) k(e/)uk(8) (1)chau_ (duk6 goek3 zau1 獨腳州), a district without subdivisions. 【州】 (tsyuw) (_noun-like_) province, district
U+68F7 (Page 560 #10: (1)棷) A kind of wood suitable for fuel (Kangxi: 木薪也); ~~a surname.~~

zau2.text: U+68F7 (Page 560 #10: (1)棷 _(1)Tsau_ (zau1); here corrected to _(2)Chau_ (zau2)) ~~it is used for making~~ watchmen's alarms (Kangxi: 夜戒守有所擊也);

zau1.text: U+6D32 州 (F1.49 洲) 水中可居之也 (Page 25|n68 #8: (1)州) a continent, (...); an island (Kangxi 州: 水中可居曰州); (Page 25|n68 #9: (1)洲) A spot encircled by streams, or in the water, as an islet (Kangxi: 水渚也, 水中可居曰洲); a place where men collect, a village (Kangxi: 聚也人及鳥物所聚息之處也); _(4)ng(o\) (4)(u (1)chau_ (ngou4 jyu4 zau1 鰲魚洲), Whampoa I.; _(4)ch(')(e/)ung (1)chau_ (coeng4 zau1 長洲), Bamboo town; _(2)kau (1)chau_ (gau2 zau1 九洲), the Nine Is. near Macao; _(1)ts(')ing (1)chau_ (cing1 zau1 青洲), Green I. off Macao; _(1)sh(a/) (1)chau_ (saa1 zau1 沙洲), sands, a sand-bank. In modern usage, 州 is used exclusively in the "administrative-division" sense, and never for the "island/continent" sense, which is always spelt 洲. 【洲】 (tsyuw) (_noun-like_) islet

U+7DC5 zeoi3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子句切) (F1.50 緅) 靑赤色 (Page 560 #11: (1)緅) Silk first dyed red thrice, and then twice dipped in black (Kangxi: 五入爲緅, 染纁者三入而成又再染以黑則爲緅); a dark red-like puce (Kangxi: 帛靑赤色也). 【緅】 (tsuw, tsrjuw, tsjuH) (_adjective-like_) puce

U+821F (F1.49 舟) 船也 (Page 25|n68 #6: (1)舟) A boat, a vessel, a craft of any sort (Kangxi: 船也); to go in a boat; to transport, to carry in a vessel (Kangxi: 載也); the 137th radical (U+2F88 ⾈ "boat") of characters relating to ships; _(1)p(')(i/)n (1)chau_ (pin1 zau1 扁舟), a punt; _(1)chau ts(')z'(3)_ (zau1 ci3 舟次) on board ship. 【舟】 (tsyuw) (_noun-like_) boat

U+8ACF 诹 (Mainland simplified) (F1.50 諏) 咨事曰諏 (Page 560 #12: (1)諏) To consult with (Kangxi: 聚謀也), to take advice, to inquire into matters of government publicly (Kangxi: 問政事也); to choose; _(1)tsau kat(7)_ (zau1 gat1 諏吉) to select a lucky day; _kung(6) (1)tsau (4)k(')(i/) ching(3)_ (gung6 zau1 kei4 zing3 共諏其正) to jointly discuss the right of the matter; _(1)tsz' (1)tsau_ (zi1 zau1 咨諏), to take counsel. 【諏】 (tsju) (_verb-like_) to inquire, to consult

U+8B05 诌 (Mainland simplified) cau1 (per 《廣韻》楚鳩切) (Page 560 #3: (1)謅) To whisper (Kangxi: 小言私授謂之謅), to speak into one's ear; to speak in a low tone. The reading zau1 is not unattested, though strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chau_; 《集韻》 has the reading 甾尤切, explained 小言私授謂之謅. To make up, to fabricate.

U+8B78 侜 诪 (Mainland simplified) (F1.49 譸) 書經譸張爲幻 (Page 25|n68 #10: (1)譸) ~~Hurried, bustling,~~ to impose upon, to deceive (Kangxi: 譸張誑也); _(1)chau (1)ch(e/)ung ~~(1)wai~~ (4)wai w(a/)n(6)_ (zau1 zoeng1 wai4 waan6 譸張為幻) to delude with false appearances. Williams' 譸張為幻: Corrected _(1)wai_ (wai1) to _(4)wai_ (wai4). 【譸】 (trjuw) (_verb-like_) to deceive

U+8CD9 周 赒 (Mainland simplified) (F1.49 賙) 賑恤也 (Page 25|n68 #1: (1)周; here normalised to 賙) to supply, to provide, to assist; (Page 25|n68 #3: (1)賙) To bestow charity (Kangxi: 給也贍也); _(1)chau tsai(3)_ (zau1 zai3 賙濟) to relieve the indigent, as a society or government; _(1)chau sut(7)_ (zau1 seot1 賙恤) beneficent. 【賙】 (tsyuw) (_verb-like_) to assist

U+8F08 辀 (Mainland simplified) (F1.49 輈) 車轅 (Page 25|n68 #7: (1)輈) A ~~frame in front~~ pole or shaft of a carriage (Kangxi: 車轅也 etc.) ~~near which the driver sits~~; ~~a sort of dashboard.~~ 【輈】 (trjuw) (_noun-like_) carriage-pole
U+8F16 (F1.49 輖) 匣也 (Page 25|n68 #4: (1)輖) A heavily laden cart, which is low in front (Kangxi: 低也一曰車前重也); a heavy load (Kangxi: 重載也); heavy (Kangxi: 重也).

U+9031 周 (Mainland simplified) (F1.49 週) 回也也 (Page 25|n68 #2: (1)週) To revolve, to circulate (Kangxi: 迴也); ~~to inform people;~~ a year; _(1)chau (4)n(i/)n wong(6) s(e/)ung(3)_ (zau1 nin4 wong6 soeng3 週年旺相) may the whole year be lucky; _t(u/)i(3) (1)chau_ (deoi3 zau1 對週), a return of the year; _yat(7) (1)chau_ (jat1 zau1 一週), a circuit, a year;

U+90F0 鄹 陬 (F1.50 鄹) 孔子故鄕 (Page 560 #6: (1)鄹; here normalised to 郰) The district in L(u/) (魯) where Confucius was born (Kangxi 郰: 魯下邑孔子之鄕, 又通作鄹, 又通作陬), now in Yenchau f(u/) (兗州府) in Sh(a/)ntung (山東); it is not far from the preceding (鄒). (Page 560 #7: (1)陬; here normalised to 郰) _(1)tsau yap(7)_ (zau1 jap1 郰邑) the residence of Confucius, and interchanged with the preceding (鄹). Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chau_ per 《廣韻》側鳩切.

U+9112 邹 鄹 (F1.50 鄒) 國名又姓 (Page 560 #5: (1)鄒) A district in the southwest of Sh(a/)ntung (山東) on the Yellow River; an ancient city in L(u/) (魯) (Kangxi: 魯縣 etc.), where Mencius was born. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chau_ per 《廣韻》側鳩切. A surname (Kangxi: 姓).
U+9139 May appear as either ⿰⿱取乑阝 or ⿰⿱取⿸⿹亻人人阝 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.50 鄹) 孔子故鄕 (Page 560 #6: (1)鄹) Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chau_ per 《廣韻》側鳩切.

U+966C (F1.50 陬) 遐陬 (Page 560 #7: (1)陬) An angle or corner (Kangxi: 阪隅也) ~~of a city wall~~, where it is retired; ~~a bastion;~~ a nook, a corner; to live together (Kangxi: 聚居也); abashed, ashamed (Kangxi: 卑陬愧恧貌); _~~mang(6)~~ m(a/)ng(6) (1)tsau_ (maang6 zau1 孟陬), the first month (Kangxi: 正月爲孟陬); _(o\)m(3) (1)tsau_ (am3 zau1 暗陬), a dark corner; _(4)shing (1)tsau_ (sing4 zau1 城陬), the corner of a wall; Williams' 孟陬: Changed _mang(6)_ (mang6) to common reading _m(a/)ng(6)_ (maang6).

U+9A36 驺 (Mainland simplified) (F1.50 騶) 騶虞仁獸 (Page 560 #4: (1)騶) A fabulous ~~feline~~ beast, called _(1)tsau (4)(u_ (zau1 jyu4 騶虞), emblematic of kindness to animals and gentleness (Kangxi: 騶虞義獸至德所感則見馬之屬 etc.); a ~~royal~~ groom or hostler (Kangxi: 廐御也). Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chau_ per 《廣韻》側鳩切. Williams' "royal groom or hostler": Not necessarily royal, but often so. 【騶】 (tsrjuw) (_noun-like_) horse-keeper

U+9BEB 鲰 (Mainland simplified) cau2 (per 《集韻》此苟切 for "little (man)" sense) cau4 (per 《廣韻》徂鉤切) zau6 (per 《廣韻》仕垢切) (F1.50 魚名又鯫生小人也) (Page 560 #13: (1)鯫) Minnows, white fish (Kangxi: 白魚也, 一曰小魚) which skip over the water; _met._ a simpleton (Kangxi: 小人貌也); _(1)tsau (1)shang_ (zau1 sang1 鯫生), a foolish fellow. The reading _(1)tsau_ (zau1) is not unattested, at least for the "small-fish" sense; 《集韻》 has the reading 將侯切, explained 小魚也.

zau2.text: U+8D70 㞫 赱 zau3 (alternative per 《廣韻》則候切) (F1.53 走) 奔走趨也 (Page 561 #1: (2)走) To go (Kangxi: 走猶去也); to sail; to travel; to run, to hasten, to quicken one's steps (Kangxi: 趨也); to flee, to run off, to clear out; the 156th radical (U+2F9B ⾛ "run") of characters relating to going; _(2)tsau kwo(3) (2)k(i/) (2)sh(a/)ng_ (zau2 gwo3 gei2 saang2 走過幾省), he has been over several provinces; _(2)tsau (4)'m lat(7)_ (zau2 m4 lat1 走唔甩) could not get away; _(2)tsau p(a/)k(9) t(i/)(6)_ (zau2 baak6 dei6 走白地) all cleared out; _(2)tsau tak(7) m(a/)n(6)_ (zau2 dak1 maan6 走得慢) she sails slowly; _(2)tsau h(u(3)_ (zau2 heoi3 走去) to run off; _(2)tsau (2)shai_ (zau2 sai2 走使), a servant; _tau(3) (1)kai (2)tsau (2)kau_ (dau3 gai1 zau2 gau2 鬥雞走狗), to fight cocks and race dogs; _(2)tsau (1)sz'_ (zau2 si1 走私) to smuggle; _(2)tsau lau(6)_ (zau2 lau6 走漏) to disclose, to let out, as a secret; _(2)tsau (2)shui_ (zau2 seoi2 走水), to voyage; _(2)tsau lok(8)_ (zau2 lok3 走咯) I'm going; _(2)tsau (1)lo_ (zau2 lo1 走囉), clear out! _(2)tsau tak(7) f(a/)i(3) ts(')ui(3)_ (zau2 dak1 faai3 ceoi3 走得快脆) he runs very fast. Kangxi follows 《廣韻》 in putting the 《釋名》 definition under the departing tone. Williams' 走漏: In the vernacular register, 走漏 means to omit by mistake. 【走】 (tsuwX) (_verb-like_) to run, to run away (_verb-like_) to go, to leave Cantonese retains the classical distinction between 走 "run" and 行 "walk". 【走】 (zau2) To run. 周圍走 (zau1 wai4 zau2): "Running all over the place." 未學行先學走 (mei6 hok6 haang4 sin1 hok6 zau2): "Having not yet learnt to walk, first learning to run." To flee. 走啊 (zau2 aa3): "Run for your lives!" 咪走 (mai5 zau2): "Don't you run off." To leave. 我哋走 (ngo5 dei6 zau2): "We shall leave." 臨走 (lam4 zau2): "Just before leaving." 走啦 (zau2 laa1): "Leave!" To miss (fail to utilise). 走咗班車 (zau2 zo2 baan1 ce1): "Missed the train." 走咗隻東 (zau2 zo2 zek3 dung1): "Missed the east wind tile." To leave out or omit from food, as a preference. 走蔥 (zau2 cung1): "Without spring-onion." 走青 (zau2 ceng1): "Without any green garnishes." 走色 (zau2 sik1): "Without colour" (i.e. without adding beef stock to noodle soup). 菜心全走 (coi3 sam1 cyun4 zau2): "Choy sum all without" (i.e. without adding oyster sauce or brisket juice). 【走雞】 (zau2 gai1) To miss an opportunity (especially a tile in mahjong). 走咗雞 (zau2 zo2 gai1): "I missed it." 【走去】 (zau2 heoi3) To proceed to. 走去偷嘢 (zau2 heoi3 tau1 je5): "He's gone and stolen stuff." 走去吸毒 (zau2 heoi3 kap1 duk6): "He's gone and taken drugs." 【走油】 (zau2 jau4-2) To wok-fry briefly in a moderate amount of oil (so as to give sheen to meat or seafood). 【走甩】 (zau2 lat1) To get away, to successfully escape. 走唔甩 (zau2 m4 lat1): "Couldn't get away." 走甩咗 (zau2 lat1 zo2): "He got away." 【走路】 (zau2 lou6-2) To run away, to flee.

U+9152 (F1.53 酒) 儀狄所造 (Page 561 #2: (2)酒) Spirits (Kangxi: 就也所以就人性之善惡); distilled liquor made from rice (Kangxi: 酒酉也釀之米麴酉澤久而味美也); it is applied also to beer, wine, and other liquors; given to drink; to redden; _(1)shi(u/) (2)tsau_ (siu1 zau2 燒酒), whiskey, samshoo; _(2)tsau tsik(9)_ (zau2 zik6 酒席) a banquet; _(4)wong (2)tsau_ (wong4 zau2 黃酒), sweet spirits; _(4)m(o\) (2)tsau l(e/)ung(6)_ (mou4 zau2 loeng6 無酒量) I have no ability to drink; _f(a/)t(8) (2)tsau (1)fung_ (faat3 zau2 fung1 發酒瘋), irascible from drink; _(2)tsau (1)fung k(e/)uk(8)_ (zau2 fung1 goek3 酒瘋腳) gouty; _(2)tsau (4)fong_ (zau2 fong4 酒房), a groggery, a wine room or cellar; _(4)hung (2)tsau_ (hung4 zau2 紅酒), claret; _p(a/)k(9) (2)tsau_ (baak6 zau2 白酒), sherry; _~~(2)p(')(e/)~~ (1)p(e/) (2)tsau_ (be1 zau2 啤酒), beer; _(2)shui (2)tsau_ (seoi2 zau2 水酒), weak spirits; _(1)t(')(i/)n (2)tsau_ (tin1 zau2 天酒), genial dews; _shik(7) (2)tsau_ (sik1 zau2 色酒), mulled spirits; _tsui(3) (2)tsau (2)l(o\)_ (zeoi3 zau2 lou2 醉酒佬), a drunkard; _(2)tsau (4)shan kong(3)_ (zau2 san4 gong3 酒神降) to like the flavor of wine; _tsam(3) (2)tsau_ (zam3 zau2 浸酒), to steep things in spirits; _(1)k(o\) (4)l(e/)ung (2)tsau_ (gou1 loeng4 zau2 高粱酒), spirits from millet, a pungent sort; _(5)m(i/) (2)tsau_ (mei5 zau2 美酒), good spirits; _(2)tsau (1)p(u/)i_ (zau2 bui1 酒杯), a wine-glass. Williams' 啤酒: Corrected _(2)p(')(e/)_ (pe2) to _(1)p(e/)_ (be1). 【酒】 (tsjuwX) (_noun-like_) wine

zau3.text: U+50FD zau6 (per 《廣韻》鋤祐切) (Page 560 #14: (1)僽 _(1)Tsau_ (zau1); here corrected to _Tsau(3)_ (zau3)) To scold, to rail at (Kangxi: 僝僽惡言詈也); abusive, scurrilous language; _(4)sh(a/)n ~~(1)tsau~~ tsau(3)_ (saan4 zau3 僝僽), to say outrageous things, to irritate.
U+546A (F1.55 咒) 符咒又咒咀 (F1.55 呪) 同上 (Page 26|n69 #2: 咒(3)呪(3)) Fan Wan entry: Corrected duplicate headword 咒 to 呪.

U+5492 呪 祝 詋 (F1.55 咒) 符咒又咒咀 (F1.55 呪) 同上 (Page 26|n69 #2: 咒(3)呪(3)) To imprecate, to rail at, to curse (Kangxi 呪: 呪詛也); to pray or recite spells; an incantation, an imprecation, a charm, a spell; ~~a prayer;~~ _n(i/)m(6) chau(3)_ (nim6 zau3 念咒) to recite ~~prayers~~ an incantation; _~~(2)t(o\)~~ (2)t(')(o\) chau(3)_ (tou2 zau3 禱咒) to curse; _(4)f(u/) chau(3)_ (fu4 zau3 符咒) to prepare and bless charms; _chau(3) cho(3)_ (zau3 zo3 咒詛) or _chau(3) m(a/)(6)_ (zau3 maa6 咒罵) to curse. Fan Wan entry: Corrected duplicate headword 咒 to 呪. Williams' 禱咒: Changed _(2)t(o\)_ (dou2) to common reading _(2)t(')(o\)_ (tou2). 【祝-departing】 (tsyuwH) (_verb-like_) to curse

U+54AE 噣 注 dau3 (alternative per 《廣韻》都豆切 for 噣) (F1.55 咮) 鳥噌曰咮 (Page 26|n69 #3: 咮(3)) The bill of birds (Kangxi: 鳥口也, 與噣同, 咮喙也, 通作注); to peck with the bill~~, the twittering of birds~~. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 味 to 咮. 【咮】 (trjuwH, tuwH) (_noun-like_) beak

zyu1.text: U+54AE (F1.43 咮) 多言貌 (Page 26|n69 #3: 咮(3)) Also read _(1)ch(u_ (zyu1). Loquacious, chattering (Kangxi: 讋咮多言貌), as birds; ~~_(1)ch(u (4)(u_ (zyu1 jyu4 咮？), talkative.~~ Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 㹸 to 貌.

zau3.text: U+594F (F1.55 奏) 奏本 (F1.55 𩱛) 與奏同 (Page 561 #3: 奏(3)) To report to the throne, to memorialize the emperor, to tell the sovereign, to cause him to hear or know (Kangxi: 人臣言事章疏曰奏); songs or tunes (Kangxi: 樂一更端曰奏); to play music; _tsau(3) (2)p(u/)n_ (zau3 bun2 奏本), a memorial; _tsau(3) (5)sh(e/)ung_ (zau3 soeng5 奏上) to send up a report; _p(')(i/)n(3) tsau(3)_ (pin3 zau3 片奏) a slip handed up; _tsau(3) (4)lau_ (zau3 lau4 奏留), to report than an officer is detained; _tsau(3) ngok(9)_ (zau3 ngok6 奏樂) to play music, to strike up the band; _ts(i/)t(8) tsau(3)_ (zit3 zau3 節奏) to mark the time; _m(i/)n(6) tsau(3)_ (min6 zau3 面奏) to state to the emperor; _(2)chun tsau(3)_ (zeon2 zau3 准奏) to assent to a memorial. Fan Wan entry: The alternative form 𩱛 (i.e. 糭 but with 鬲 in place of 米) is probably based on 《中庸》 having 詩曰奏假無言 when the original is 鬷假無言. To put forward, to offer (Kangxi: 進也薦也). 【奏】 (tsuwH) (_verb-like_) to put forward (_verb-like_) to perform music (_verb-like_) to report

U+665D 昼 (F1.55 晝) 日中曰晝 (Page 26|n69 #1: 晝(3)) A day, daytime, daylight (Kangxi: 日之出入與夜爲界); _chau(3) y(e/)(6) pat(7) h(i/)t(8)_ (zau3 je6 bat1 hit3 晝夜不歇) going incessantly, never resting; _p(a/)k(9) chau(3)_ (baak6 zau3 白晝) broad daylight, openly; _sh(e/)ung(6) chau(3)_ (soeng6 zau3 上晝) forenoon; _h(a/)(6) chau(3)_ (haa6 zau3 下晝) afternoon. 【晝】 (trjuwH) (_noun-like_) daytime

U+7503 (F1.50 甃 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1)) 井甓又結砌也 (Page 563 #2: (1)甃 _(1)Ts(')au_ (cau1); here corrected to _Chau(3)_ (zau3)) The brick lining of a well (Kangxi: 井甓也); to lay, as bricks (Kangxi: 結砌也); to pile up (Kangxi: 以塼壘井修井之壞謂之甃); to finish off a well. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 并 to 井. To adorn, to decorate (Kangxi: 甃猶飾也). 【甃】 (tsrjuwH) (_noun-like_) brickwork

U+76BA 皱 縐 (F1.55 皺) 面皮蹙也 (Page 561 #4: 縐(3)) used for the next (皺); (Page 561 #5: 皺(3)) The skin wrinkled (Kangxi: 面皺也) from age; frowning (Kangxi: 眉攢也); _tsau(3) (4)m(i/) (4)t(')au_ (zau3 mei4 tau4 皺眉頭), to scowl; _m(i/)n(6) (4)p(')(i/) tsau(3)_ (min6 pei4 zau3 面皮皺) a wrinkled face. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _chau(3)_ per 《廣韻》側救切. 【皺】 (tsrjuwH) (_noun-like_) wrinkle
U+795D May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font.

zuk1.text: U+795D May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.63 祝) 禱祝又祝壽又祝融火神也 (Page 35* #4: 祝(7)) To pray, to supplicate; to recite prayers; _chuk(7) (2)t(')(o\)_ (zuk1 tou2 祝禱), to pray; _chuk(7) (4)man_ (zuk1 man4 祝文), a prayer; _chuk(7) fuk(7)_ (zuk1 fuk1 祝福) to bless; _chuk(7) k(o\)(3)_ (zuk1 gou3 祝告) to implore; _tuk(9) chuk(7) (1)k(u/)n_ (duk6 zuk1 gun1 讀祝官), one who reads the prayers; _chuk(7) shau(6)_ (zuk1 sau6 祝壽) to congratulate on one's birthday; _mi(u/)(6) chuk(7)_ (miu6 zuk1 廟祝) an acolyth in the temples. A person that makes offerings/sacrifices to tablets/deities (Kangxi: 贊主人饗神者, 祝祭主贊詞者, etc.). To wish (well). To attach (Kangxi: 屬也, 屬著也). To cut off (Kangxi: 斷也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【祝-entering】 (tsyuwk) (_noun-like_) priest (_verb-like_) to pray (_verb-like_) to attach (_verb-like_) to cut off

zyu3.text: U+795D May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. To apply medicine topically (Kangxi: 祝讀如注病之注謂附著藥也).

zau3.text: U+7E10 䋓 绉 (Mainland simplified) (F1.55 縐) 縮而不光曰縐 (Page 561 #4: 縐(3)) Crape (Kangxi: 絺之細者); rumpled, crenulated, crinkled, crisp, frizzled; to corrugate, to wrinkle; _tsau(3) (1)sh(a/)_ (zau3 saa1 縐紗), crape; _s(i/)n(3) tsau(3)_ (sin3 zau3 線縐) camlet; _tsau(3) (4)m(a/)i_ (zau3 maai4 縐埋), puckered, shriveled up, wrinkled; _tsau(3) (4)ch(')au_ (zau3 cau4 縐綢), wrinkled silk; _tsau(3) (1)sh(a/) (5)t(')(o\)_ (zau3 saa1 tou5 縐紗肚), a capacious paunch; _(4)(u/) tsau(3)_ (wu4 zau3 湖縐) Nanking crape; _tsau(3) (4)man_ (zau3 man4 縐紋), marks of wrinkles. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _chau(3)_ per 《廣韻》側救切. 【縐】 (tsrjuwH) (_noun-like_) wrinkled-cloth, fine-cloth

zau6.text: U+5191 䩜 (F1.55 胄) 后裔也又甲胄 (Page 26|n69 #6: 冑(6)) Often confounded with the last (胄). A helmet, a morion (Kangxi: 兜鍪); _k(a/)p(8) chau(6)_ (gaap3 zau6 甲冑) helmets and cuirasses. For the visually similar character meaning "posterity", see 胄 zau6. Fan Wan entry: No distinction is made between 冑 (under ⼌) and 胄 (under ⾁). 【冑】 (drjuwH) (_noun-like_) helm

U+5B99 (F1.55 宙) 宇宙古往今來曰宙 (Page 26|n69 #4: 宙(6)) ~~To contain, as the earth does;~~ including all ages, from ancient times till now (Kangxi: 往古來今謂之宙). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 行 to 往. 【宙】 (drjuwH) (_noun-like_) time

U+5C31 (F1.56 就) 卽也迎也從也 (Page 561 #6: 就(6)) The place to which things tend or culminate at (Kangxi: 就高也从京从尤, 尤異也尤高人所就之處); to go towards, to approach, to draw near; to accompany, accommodated to, to follow (Kangxi: 從也); to complete (Kangxi: 成也), to make a circuit (Kangxi: 帀也), to meet (Kangxi: 迎也); completed, finished (Kangxi: 終也); to come near in point of time; an adverb, then, immediately, just, just now, presently, forthwith; a conjunction, then, if, as if; able to do (Kangxi: 能也)~~, willing~~; _tsau(6) ching(3) (4)loi_ (zau6 zing3 loi4 就正來), he has just come; _tsau(6) ching(3) (4)loi kwo(3)_ (zau6 zing3 loi4 gwo3 就正來過) he's just come and gone; _tsau(6) (2)k(o\)m lok(8)_ (zau6 gam2 lok3 就噉咯) let it go, that'll do; _(2)k(o\)m tsau(6) (2)h(o\)_ (gam2 zau6 hou2 噉就好), this is right; _tsau(6) (1)k(a/) h(u(3)_ (zau6 gaa1 heoi3 就家去) then I'll go; he's about going; _tsau(6) (1)s(i/)n_ (zau6 sin1 就先), just a little while ago, just now; _tsau(6) ch(i/)(3) h(u(3)_ (zau6 zi3 heoi3 就至去) he's just gone; _tsau(6) (2)shau_ (zau6 sau2 就手), came to one's hands, as profits; _tsau(6) ~~(4)loi~~ (4)lai_ (zau6 lai4 就嚟), presently, in a little; coming forthwith; _(1)tung (4)shing (1)sai tsau(6)_ (dung1 sing4 sai1 zau6 東成西就) the east is done and the west finished, everything is correctly done; _tsau(6) hai(6) ko(3) tik(7)_ (zau6 hai6 go3 dik1 就係個滴) it is just that; _tsau(6) t(i/)(6) (2)ts(')(u (4)ts(')oi_ (zau6 dei6 ceoi2 coi4 就地取材), this will serve the purpose; he will do for the occasion; _tsau(6) (4)m(a/)i (5)n(i/)_ (zau6 maai4 nei5 就埋你), to bear with, to humor one; _tsau(6) (2)k(o\)m y(e/)ung(6) l(e/)(3)_ (zau6 gam2 joeng6-2 le3 就噉樣唎) well, let it pass; _(5)yan (2)keng tsau(6) (4)ying_ (jan5 geng2 zau6 jing4 引頸就刑), to offer his neck to the axe. Williams' 就正, 就家, 就先: All dated. Williams' 就嚟: Corrected _(4)loi_ (loi4) to _(4)lai_ (lai4). 【就】 (dzjuwH) (_verb-like_) to go unto, to proceed (unto) (_verb-like_) to nigh (_verb-like_) to assume (_verb-like_) to accomplish (_noun-like_) coil 【就】 (zau6) Almost, soon. 就得 (zau6 dak1): "Almost done." 就到 (zau6 dou3): "Almost there." To accommodate, to adjust for another's convenience. 就佢夜放 (zau6 keoi5 je6 fong3): "Adjust the time to accommodate his late clock-off." 唔使就我 (m4 sai2 zau6 ngo5): "No need to adjust for me." 【就快】 (zau6 faai3) Soon. 【就嚟】 (zau6 lai4) Soon.
U+5CAB jau4 (alternative per 《集韻》夷周切) (F1.55 岫) 山有石穴曰岫 (Page 562 #3: 岫(6)) A den, a cave among the hills (Kangxi: 山穴也); a glen, a ravine, gorge, or defile. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 油 to 岫.

U+7C40 籒 (Page 26|n69 #8: 籒(6); here normalised to 籀) The framer of the seal character, _Chau(6) ~~t(')(a/)i(6)~~ t(')(a/)i(3) (2)sz'_ (zau6 taai3 si2 籀太史) (Kangxi 籒: 史籒周宣王太史名造大篆)_;_ _chau(6) (4)man_ (zau6 man4 籀文), the seal character (Kangxi 籒: 籒文者史籒所作也 etc.). Williams' 籀太史: Corrected _t(')(a/)i(6)_ (taai6) to _t(')(a/)i(3)_ (taai3). To read (Kangxi: 讀書也).

U+7D02 纣 (Mainland simplified) (F1.55 紂) 商王之號 (Page 26|n69 #7: 紂(6)) A crupper (Kangxi: 馬緧也); a silk trace; _Chau(6) (4)wong_ (zau6 wong4 紂王), the infamous king who ended the Sh(a/)ng (商) dynasty (Kangxi: 帝辛天下謂之紂). Williams' "ended": Not the best wording. He was the final king of that dynasty; he did not bring that dynasty to an end (unless you count his committing suicide, which would be semantics). 【紂】 (drjuwX) (_noun-like_) crupper

U+80C4 (F1.55 胄) 后裔也又甲胄 (Page 26|n69 #5: 胄(6)) Descendants, posterity (Kangxi: 後也); _chau(6) (2)tsz'_ (zau6 zi2 胄子) the eldest son (Kangxi: 長也 etc.); _~~hau(3)~~ chau(6) yui(6)_ (zau6 jeoi6 胄裔) posterity; _shai(3) chau(6)_ (sai3 zau6 世胄) generations. For the visually similar character meaning "helmet", see 冑 zau6. Fan Wan entry: No distinction is made between 冑 (under ⼌) and 胄 (under ⾁). Williams' 胄裔: Corrected _hau(3)_ (hau3) to _chau(6)_ (zau6). 【胄】 (drjuwH) (_adjective-like_) eldest (_noun-like_) posterity

U+8896 褎 褏 (F1.56 袖) 衫袖 (Page 562 #2: 袖(6)) The sleeve (Kangxi: 袂也, 袖由也手所由出入也); to put into the sleeve, to receive in the hand (Kangxi: 亦言受也以受手也); _tsau(6) (2)hau_ (zau6 hau2 袖口), a cuff; _tsau(6) (2)shau_ (zau6 sau2 袖手), to hide the hands in the cuffs; _tsau(6) (4)t(')au_ (zau6 tau4 袖頭), official cuffs shaped like a horsehoof; _(5)ling tsau(6)_ (ling5 zau6 領袖) a chief, one born to command; _t(')(o\)(3) tsau(6)_ (tou3 zau6 套袖) sleeve-covers; _tsau(6) (2)shau (4)p(')ong (1)k(u/)n_ (zau6 sau2 pong4 gun1 袖手旁觀), to fold the hands and look on. 【袖】 (zjuwH) (_noun-like_) sleeve

U+914E (F1.55 酎) 新熱之酒 (Page 26|n69 #9: 酎(6)) ~~New, ripe spirits;~~ pure strong spirits, thrice distilled (Kangxi: 三重醇酒也); _~~to(6)~~ chau(6) (1)kam_ (~~do6~~ zau6 gam1 ~~？~~酎金), wine money paid the heir apparent---an old usage. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𤍠 to 熱. Williams' "New, ripe spirits": This is a misreading of Kangxi 酒之新熟重者爲酎. Here, 酒之新熟 is merely contextual. Williams' ？酎金: _to(6)_ (do6) is probably a typo for what was intended to be _tso(6)_ (zo6), which is the result of misreading Kangxi's example 《史記平準書》列侯坐酎金. Here, 坐酎金 is not a term; 坐 means "convicted", so that 列侯坐酎金 means "The feudal-lords were convicted in the wine money case". 【酎】 (drjuwH) (_noun-like_) strong-drink
U+9DF2 鹫 (Mainland simplified) (Page 562 #1: 鷲(6)) A large accipitrine bird; perhaps a harpy eagle, or a whitish headed condor (Kangxi: 鷲悍多力...卽白鵰也).

ze1.text: U+556B May appear with 者 dotless (+8 assumed here) or dotted (+9), depending on the font. zoe1 (alternative in 啫啫) 【啫】 (ze1) A final particle of limitation, especially used defensively. 少少啫 (siu2 siu2 ze1): "It's just a little!" 講笑啫 (gong2 siu3 ze1): "Just kidding!" 【啫喱】 (ze1 lei2) Jelly. 【啫啫】 (ze1 ze1, zoe1 zoe1) (_onomatopoeia_) The sizzling of a hot claypot. 啫啫雞煲 (ze1 ze1 gai1 bou1): "Sizzling chicken claypot." 啫啫聲 (ze1 ze1 seng1): "Sizzling claypot sounds" (also heard as ze4 ze2 seng1). The spellings 啫, 啫喱, and 啫啫 are arbitrary (but well established).

ze3.text: U+556B May appear with 者 dotless (+8 assumed here) or dotted (+9), depending on the font. (Page 31|n74 #2: 啫(3))

ze1.text: U+55DF (F2.83 嗟) 嘆詞又痛惜也 (F2.83 𭋦) 同上 (Page 563 #11: (1)嗟) To sigh, to lament (Kangxi: 嗟歎也); painful regrets (Kangxi: 一曰痛惜也); an interjection of admiration (Kangxi: 咨也); ah! alas! (Kangxi: 嗟佐也言不足以盡意故發此聲以自佐也) _(1)ts(e/) t(')(a/)n(3)_ (ze1 taan3 嗟嘆) to sigh; _(1)ts(e/) (4)loi (1)ch(i/) shik(9)_ (ze1 loi4 zi1 sik6 嗟來之食) ~~to groan and beg one's bread~~ food given in contempt. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰亻肯 to 惜. Williams' 嗟來之食: Not to beg for food, but food given in contempt. Per 《禮檀弓》, the phrase 嗟來食 "alas come eat" was the utterance of the wealthy man 黔敖 as he handed out food and drink to the famished. 【嗟】 (tsjae) (_interjection_) alas

ze2.text: U+59D0 媎 (for "mother" sense) ze2-1 (vernacular, and high second in reduplication 姐姐) ze2-4 (low suffix for endearment, and low first in reduplication 姐姐) (F2.84 姐) 姊也 (Page 563 #13: (2)姐) An elder sister (Kangxi: 今俗弟呼女兄曰姐); a miss; formerly applied to one's mother (Kangxi: 蜀人呼母曰姐); proud, saucy (Kangxi: 一曰慢也); _(2)ts(e/) m(u/)i(6)_ (ze2 mui6-2 姐妹) sisters; _t(a/)i(6) (2)ts(e/)_ (daai6 ze2-1 大姐), my elder sister; also, a marriageable maidservant; _(2)si(u/) (2)ts(e/)_ (siu2 ze2 小姐), a young miss; _ling(6) (2)ts(e/)_ (ling6 ze2 令姐), your sister; _(2)ts(e/) (1)f(u/)_ (ze2 fu1 姐夫), a sister's husband; _(a/)(3) (2)ts(e/)_ (aa3 ze2 阿姐), sister; also a term for a father's concubine. Williams' 姐妹: The preferred term for "sisters" in Cantonese is 姊妹. Williams' 阿姐: This is the meaning when 姐 is read in the original rising tone. 【阿姐】 (aa3 ze2-1) Generic address for an adult woman when the speaker is not a child. (Can be respectful, neutral, or impolite depending on the context.) 【家姐】 (gaa1 ze2-1) Older sister (or older female paternal cousin). 【細姐】 (sai3 ze2) Father's concubine (presumed to be younger than his wife).

ze1.text: U+7F5D (F2.83 罝) 取兔網 (Page 563 #12: (1)罝) A net with which hares are caught (Kangxi: 兔罔也); a net for beasts (Kangxi: 獸罟曰罝); to stop the way, as a net does. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱罓且 to 罝. 【罝】 (tsjae) (_noun-like_) rabbit-net

U+906E (F2.83 遮) 掩也 (Page 30|n73 #7: (1)遮) To cover, to screen, to vail, to conceal (Kangxi: 蔽也); to shade; to intercept (Kangxi: 斷也, 攔也); a parasol, a shade; _(1)ch(e/) (2)(i/)m_ (ze1 jim2 遮掩), to secrete, to screen; _(1)ch(e/) k(')oi(3)_ (ze1 koi3 遮蓋) to cloak, to cover; _(1)ch(e/) (1)sau_ (ze1 sau1 遮羞), to conceal the face (as females); _(5)(u (1)ch(e/)_ (jyu5 ze1 雨遮), an umbrella; _(4)'m (1)ch(e/) tak(7) ch(u(6)_ (m4 ze1 dak1 zyu6 唔遮得住) it won't cover us, it can not be concealed; _(1)ch(e/) shik(7)_ (ze1 sik1 遮飾) to disguise, to dupe, throw dust in his eyes; _(1)ch(e/) (4)l(a/)n_ (ze1 laan4 遮攔), to fend off, to ward off; _(1)ch(e/) yat(9) (4)t(')au_ (ze1 jat6 tau4-2 遮日頭), keep the sun off; _(1)ch(e/) (4)m(u/)n_ (ze1 mun4 遮瞞), to hide from. 【遮】 (tsyae) (_verb-like_) to block (_verb-like_) to cover 【遮】 (ze1) An umbrella. 開遮 (hoi1 ze1): "Open an umbrella." 擔遮 (daam1 ze1): "Hold up an umbrella." 收遮 (sau1 ze1): "Close up an umbrella." 縮骨遮 (suk1 gwat1 ze1): "Retractable-frame umbrella" (i.e. a pocket or foldable umbrella).

ze2.text: U+8005 May appear dotless (assumed here) or dotted, depending on the font. (F2.84 者) 語助詞指人指物之稱 (Page 30|n73 #8: (2)者) A ~~relative or~~ demonstrative pronoun (Kangxi: 此也...今俗多用這字); ~~it, this,~~ that, he, who, what; following verbs, it forms a noun, as _(4)hang (2)ch(e/)_ (hang4 ze2 行者), a walker, he who is walking; after ~~nouns~~ adjectives, indicates a class, as _(4)(u (2)ch(e/)_ (jyu4 ze2 愚者), the foolish; _~~sz'(3)~~ (2)sz' (2)ch(e/)_ (si2 ze2 死者), the dead; _(4)m(o\) (4)ts(')ing (2)ch(e/)_ (mou4 cing4 ze2 無情者), people who are without affection; or as put in the abstract, as _sing(3) (2)ch(e/)_ (sing3 ze2 性者), nature; _(4)shing (2)ch(e/)_ (sing4 ze2 誠者), truth; placed between two nouns or clauses, it puts them in apposition, as _tak(7) (2)ch(e/), (2)p(u/)n (5)y(a/)_ (dak1 ze2 bun2 jaa5 德者本也), virtue, that is the root; _(4)yan (2)ch(e/) ng(a/)u(6) (1)sh(a/)n_ (jan4 ze2 ngaau6 saan1 仁者樂山) the humane man delights in hills; it is often a mere pause to arrest the attention; _(4)ho (4)wai (2)ch(e/)_ (ho4 wai4 ze2 何為者), what are you doing? _(1)chung (5)y(a/) (2)ch(e/) (1)t(')(i/)n ~~(5)h(a/)~~ h(a/)(6) (1)ch(i/) t(a/)i(6) (2)p(u/)n (5)y(a/)_ (zung1 jaa5 ze2 tin1 haa6 zi1 daai6 bun2 jaa5 中也者天下之大本也), the medium is everywhere the chief point; _sik(7) (2)ch(e/)_ (sik1 ze2 昔者), formerly; _w(a/)k(9) (2)ch(e/)_ (waak6 ze2 或者), perhaps. The dotted form is compatibility ideograph U+FA5B. Williams' 死者: Corrected _sz'(3)_ (si3) to _(2)sz'_ (si2). Williams' 仁者樂山: This example should appear under the "indicates a class" sense. Williams' 中也者天下之大本也: Changed (very) obsolete _(5)h(a/)_ (haa5) to modern _h(a/)(6)_ (haa6). This example should appear under the "puts them in apposition" sense. Eight of Williams' examples (愚者, 死者, 無情者, 性者, 誠者, 德者本也, 仁者樂山, 中也者天下之大本也) are identical or suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.2 (_Examples of ch(e/)_, 者) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. 【者】 (tsyaeX) (_pronoun-like_) he that, that which, one, -er (_speech-assist_)

U+8D6D May appear with 者 dotless (+8 assumed here) or dotted (+9), depending on the font. (F2.84 赭) 赤色 (Page 31|n74 #1: (2)赭) Ochre color (Kangxi: 赤土也); a carnation or reddish brown (Kangxi: 赤也); _(2)ch(e/) shek(9)_ (ze2 sek6 赭石) ochre; _(2)ch(e/) (1)(i/)_ (ze2 ji1 赭衣), reddish garments worn by felons (Kangxi: 赭衣罪人服). Williams' "carnation": In the (now) archaic sense of reddish skin colour. 【赭】 (tsyaeX) (_noun-like_) red-ochre

U+9019 这 (Mainland simplified) ze3 (per Fan Wan) ze5 (common) (F2.84 這 _Ch(e/)(3)_ (ze3)) 是也此也這裏言此處也這事言此事也 (Page 31|n74 #6: 這(3) _Ch(e/)(3)_ (ze3); here normalised to _(2)Ch(e/)_ (ze2)) A demonstrative pronoun, this, that; _~~ch(e/)(3)~~ (2)ch(e/) ~~(5)l(i/)~~ (5)l(u_ (ze2 leoi5 這裡), here; _~~ch(e/)(3)~~ (2)ch(e/) y(e/)ung(6)_ (ze2 joeng6 這樣) thus, so; _~~ch(e/)(3)~~ (2)ch(e/) (2)tang_ (ze2 dang2 這等), such, this sort; _~~ch(e/)(3)~~ (2)ch(e/) (4)sh(i/)_ (ze2 si4 這時), now. Williams' 這裡: Changed _(5)l(i/)_ (lei5) to common reading _(5)l(u_ (leoi5). The character 這 is only attested in the Middle Chinese rime books under the reading 魚變切 _(i/)n(6)_ (jin6), explained 迎也. Kangxi has 毛晃曰凡稱此箇爲者箇俗多改用這字這乃迎也, which proposes that 這 is a vulgar substitute for 者 when used as a demonstrative "this".

ze3.text: U+9019 (F2.84 這) 是也此也這裏言此處也這事言此事也 (Page 31|n74 #6: 這(3))

U+501F 徣 zek3 (alternative per 《廣韻》資昔切) (F2.84 借) 假借借貸又推獎也 (Page 564 #1: 借(3)) To assist (Kangxi: 助也); to lend, to borrow (Kangxi: 假也貸也); to ask for, to beg of; to make a pretext of; to pretend, to assume, to suppose; if, for example, supposing, assuming (Kangxi: 設辭); to use for illustration; to praise (Kangxi: 推獎也); _ts(e/)(3) (4)loi_ (ze3 loi4 借來), to borrow; _ts(e/)(3) h(u(3)_ (ze3 heoi3 借去) to lend; _ts(e/)(3) (4)ngan_ (ze3 ngan4-2 借銀), to ask for money; _ts(e/)(3) (1)t(a/)n_ (ze3 daan1 借單), a borrower's note; _ts(e/)(3) (1)sh(a/)m_ (ze3 saam1 借衫), to borrow a jacket; _(1)s(e/)ung ts(e/)(3)_ (soeng1 ze3 相借) to borrow of; _ts(e/)(3) (4)(u_ (ze3 jyu4 借如), supposing that; _ts(e/)(3) shai(3) (4)wai ok(8)_ (ze3 sai3 wai4 ok3 借勢為惡) to avail of power to do wickedly; _ts(e/)(3) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (5)ngo sz'(6)_ (ze3 zoek6 ngo5 si6 借着我事) he's got my business, he's stole my thunder; _ts(e/)(3) ko(3) (1)kwong_ (ze3 go3 gwong1 借個光), to use another's name, _e. g._ to get a letter of introduction; _ts(e/)(3) (2)m(e/) tik(7)_ (ze3 me2 dik1 借歪滴) please step aside a little; _ts(e/)(3) l(o\)(6) ~~(4)hang~~ (4)h(a/)ng_ (ze3 lou6 haang4 借路行), to beg a way through; _ts(e/)(3) (i/)(3)_ (ze3 ji3 借意) metaphorically; _ts(e/)(3) (4)lai (2)kong_ (ze3 lai4 gong2 借嚟講), said it for illustration, meant nothing by it; _ts(e/)(3) k(')(i/)t(8)_ (ze3 kit3 借揭) to get a loan on interest. Williams' 借着我事: Corrected _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) to _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6). Williams' 借路行: Changed _(4)hang_ (hang4) to vernacular reading _(4)h(a/)ng_ (haang4). 【借】 (tsjaeH, tsjek) (_verb-like_) to borrow, to lend

U+55FB 啫 (Page 31|n74 #2: 啫(3); here normalised to 嗻) A colloquial particle. Just now; a short time, for the nonce, shortly; a form of the subjunctive; _(2)tang (5)h(a/) ch(e/)(3)_ (dang2 haa5 ze3 等吓嗻) stop a little; _(1)f(a/)n (4)lai ch(e/)(3)_ (faan1 lai4 ze3 返嚟嗻) when I come back; _(2)k(o\)m y(e/)ung(6) ch(e/)(3)_ (gam2 joeng6-2 ze3 噉樣嗻) will this do? _(2)t(a/) kwo(3) ch(e/)(3)_ (daa2 gwo3 ze3 打過嗻) let me whip you; _(2)tang (5)ngo h(u(3) ts(o\)(6) mat(7) (5)y(e/) ch(e/)(3)_ (dang2 ngo5 heoi3 zou6 mat1 je5 ze3 等我去做乜嘢嗻) let me do that first. Now dated. Modern Cantonese instead uses 啫 ze1.
U+67D8 樜 (F2.84 柘) 桑柘木名 (Page 31|n74 #4: 柘(3)) a tree whose leaves are fed to silk worms (Kangxi: 桑屬, 柘葉飼蠶爲絲). 【柘】 (tsyaeH) (_noun-like_) melonberry-tree, melonberry

U+8517 柘 樜 (F2.84 蔗) 甘蔗 (F2.84 樜) 同上 (Page 31|n74 #3: 蔗(3)樜(3)) The sugar cane (Kangxi 蔗: 甘蔗也); _(i/)t(9) ch(e/)(3)_ (jit6 ze3 熱蔗) boiled sugar-cane; _t(')(i/)t(8) ch(e/)(3)_ (tit3 ze3 鐵蔗) dark cane; _p(a/)k(9) ch(e/)(3)_ (baak6 ze3 白蔗) white cane; _chuk(7) ch(e/)(3)_ (zuk1 ze3 竹蔗) or _(5)long ch(e/)(3)_ (long5 ze3 ？蔗) small cane; _ch(e/)(3) (1)kai_ (ze3 gai1 蔗雞), suckers of the cane; _ch(e/)(3) (4)li(u/)_ (ze3 liu4 蔗寮), sugaring sheds; _ch(a/)(3) ch(e/)(3)_ (zaa3 ze3 搾蔗) to express cane juice; _~~(2)t(o\)~~ t(o\)(3) t(a/)m(6) ch(e/)(3)_ (dou3 daam6 ze3 倒啖蔗) he eats his cane backwards, he has the best still coming. (Page 31|n74 #4: 柘(3)) Sometimes used for the above (蔗) (Kangxi 柘: 諸柘一曰甘蔗); Williams' 倒啖蔗: Corrected _(2)t(o\)_ (dou2) to _t(o\)(3)_ (dou3). 【蔗】 (tsyaeH) (_noun-like_) sugarcane
U+9DD3 鹧 (Mainland simplified) (F2.84 鷓) 鷓鴣鳥名 (Page 31|n74 #5: 鷓(3)) The partridge (Kangxi: 鳥名鷓鴣越雉也); it also includes francolins and grouse; _ch(e/)(3) (1)k(u/)_ (ze3 gu1 鷓鴣), the common partridge.

ze6.text: U+69AD 謝 (F2.85 榭) 臺榭有屋曰臺無屋曰榭 (Page 564 #3: 榭(6)) A terrace having ~~trees around~~ a timber structure on it (Kangxi: 臺有屋也, 土高曰臺有木曰榭)~~, an arbor~~; a place for storing musical instruments (Kangxi: 榭者所以藏樂器); a high lookout, a keep, a turret; a military school (Kangxi: 講武之屋曰榭); a fencing-room; _(ut(9) ts(e/)(6)_ (jyut6 ze6 月榭) ~~an open arbor~~. Williams' "having trees", "an arbor": This is a misreading of Kangxi 有木曰榭. Here, 木 means "timber" in the sense of construction, rather than "tree". 【榭】 (zjaeH) (_noun-like_) raised-pavilion
U+707A (F2.85 灺) (Page 564 #4: 灺(6)) The snuff of a candle (Kangxi: 燭㶳); the expiring wick of a lamp. Fan Wan entry: No definition is given; only the headword is present.

U+8B1D 谢 (Mainland simplified) ze4 (vernacular alternative for "withered" and Cantonese "exhausted" senses) (F2.85 謝) 辭也絶也又退也彫落也居官致仕曰謝政感德相酧曰謝恩 (Page 564 #2: 謝(6)) To decline, to withdraw from, to refuse (Kangxi: 辭去也), to go away (Kangxi: 去也); to resign, to throw up; to stop intercourse with (Kangxi: 絕也); declining, fading (Kangxi: 退也衰也彫落也), as flowers; to express, to inform (Kangxi: 吿也); to thank, to express gratitude (Kangxi: 拜賜曰謝); to acknowledge, to confess (Kangxi: 自以爲過曰謝); to excuse one's self; _(1)to ts(e/)(6)_ (do1 ze6 多謝) many thanks; _(5)ling ts(e/)(6)_ (ling5 ze6 領謝) to receive with thanks; _ts(e/)(6) sz'(6)_ (ze6 si6 謝事) to retire from office; _ts(e/)(6) t(')(i/)p(8)_ (ze6 tip3-2 謝帖) a reward offered; _pik(7) ts(e/)(6)_ (bik1 ze6 璧謝) to decline a present; _(1)f(a/) ts(e/)(6)_ (faa1 ze6 花謝) fading flowers; _ts(e/)(6) ti(u/)(3)_ (ze6 diu3 謝弔) to decline mourners; _ts(e/)(6) p(o\)(6)_ (ze6 bou6 謝步) a doctor's fees; _ts(e/)(6) h(a/)k(8)_ (ze6 haak3 謝客) to excuse one's self to visitors; _ts(o\)(6) ts(e/)(6) (2)tsau_ (zou6 ze6 zau2 做謝酒), to give one a dinner; _ts(e/)(6) (2)tsau_ (ze6 zau2 謝酒), to take wine with; _ts(e/)(6) shai(3)_ (ze6 sai3 謝世) to die; _(2)k(o\)m ts(e/)(6)_ (gam2 ze6 感謝) feeling grateful for; _t(a/)p(8) ts(e/)(6)_ (daap3 ze6 答謝) to return thanks, to make a present in return; _(4)ch(')au ts(e/)(6)_ (cau4 ze6 酬謝) to requite in kind. To ask. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【謝】 (zjaeH) (_verb-like_) to decline, to renounce, (_met._) to apologise, to wilt Cantonese prefers 多謝 over 謝謝. Note that 多謝 should only be used to express gratitude for gifts or patronage. To express gratitude for small/menial favours, or for goods/services that the speaker is paying for, 唔該 (TODO) should instead be used. 【謝】 (ze6, ze4) Exhausted, fatigued, spent. 做到謝咗 (zou6 dou3 ze4 zo2): "Burnt out from working." 個人謝嗮 (go3 jan4 ze6 saai3): "He's completely spent."

zek1.text: U+5527 喞 【唧】 (zek1) A final particle of emphasis, emotion, pressing, or urging. 得未唧 (dak1 mei6 zek1): "Are you ready or not?" 做咩唧 (zou6 me1 zek1): "What is it now?" 你想點唧 (nei5 soeng2 dim2 zek1): "What do you want now?" The spelling 唧 is arbitrary.

zik1.text: U+5527 喞 (F1.74 喞) 啾喞衆聲又虫鳴 (Page 568 #9: 喞(7); here normalised to 唧) The noise of a crowd (Kangxi 喞: 啾喞也, 啾喞衆聲); the hum of insects; _(1)tsau tsik(7)_ (zau1 zik1 啾唧) a hubbub. (_onomatopoeia_) A clicking (or perhaps chirping) sound (Kangxi 喞: 喞聲也). 【唧】 (zik1) A jack (for raising heavy objects, especially vehicles). 攞個唧嚟 (lo2 go3 zik1 lai4): "Bring me the jack." To raise with a jack. 唧起架車 (zik1 hei2 gaa3 ce1): "Jack up the car." A jack (playing card). 葵扇唧 (kwai4 sin3 zik1): "Jack of spades." 唧夫佬 (zik1 fu1 lou2): "Jack full house." The spelling 唧 is arbitrary.
U+559E (F1.74 喞) 啾喞衆聲又虫鳴 (Page 568 #9: 喞(7))

zek3.text: U+62D3 (F1.78 拓) 拾也又充拓又托推也斥開也拓落不偶也 (Page 14* #3: 摭(9)拓(9) _Chik(9)_ (zik6); here corrected to _Chik(8)_ (zik3) and normalised to _Chek(8)_ (zek3)) Williams has been misled by Fan Wan's placement of the series 跖蹠拓隻炙 (_chik_) *after* 劇屐 (_k(')ik(9)_) and 溺 (_nik(9)_), which are 陽入 (see F1.78). Based on this ordering, Williams has inferred that the character 拓 is read 陽入 _chik(9)_ (zik6). However, since Fan Wan has a separate series for 直値殖植稙湜埴 (_chik(9)_), it appears that its authors have attempted to distinguish the vernacular rime _-ek_ from the literary rime _-ik_, notwithstanding all series appear under 第七英影應益. I have corrected Williams by placing 拓 under _chek(8)_ (zek3) here.

U+646D 拓 zik3 (uncommon) (F1.78 拓) 拾也又充拓又托推也斥開也拓落不偶也 (Page 14* #3: 摭(9)拓(9) _Chik(9)_ (zik6); here corrected to _Chik(8)_ (zik3) and normalised to _Chek(8)_ (zek3)) To take up (Kangxi 摭: 拓或从庶, 取也, 猶拾取也); to collect, to gather; _~~chik(9)~~ chek(8) chap(7)_ (zek3 zap1 摭執) to take or adopt. Williams has been misled by Fan Wan's placement of the series 跖蹠拓隻炙 (_chik_) *after* 劇屐 (_k(')ik(9)_) and 溺 (_nik(9)_), which are 陽入 (see F1.78). Based on this ordering, Williams has inferred that the character 拓 (and hence 摭) is read 陽入 _chik(9)_ (zik6). However, since Fan Wan has a separate series for 直値殖植稙湜埴 (_chik(9)_), it appears that its authors have attempted to distinguish the vernacular rime _-ek_ from the literary rime _-ik_, notwithstanding all series appear under 第七英影應益. I have corrected Williams by placing 摭 under _chek(8)_ (zek3) here. 【摭】 (tsyek) (_verb-like_) to pick up, to pick

U+7099 ze3 (alternative per 《廣韻》之夜切) zik3 (alternative) (F1.78 炙) 燔炙 (Page 14* before #5: 隻(9)) (The three next characters (隻, 蹠跖, 炙) are usually pronounced _chek_ (zek).)
