(Page 14* #7: 炙(9) _Chik(9)_ (zik6); _Chek(9)_ (zek6) implied by variational note; here corrected to _Chek(8)_ (zek3)) To roast (Kangxi: 炮肉也, 炕火曰炙); to broil; to dry or toast before the fire; to heat; near (Kangxi: 親近也); to approach, to approximate; to fry in honey, as some physic is; _~~(2)k(u/)i~~ (2)k(')(u/)i ~~chek(9)~~ chek(8) (4)yan (2)hau_ (kui2 zek3 jan4 hau2 膾炙人口), tastes well in people's mouths --- said of fine poetry; _~~chek(9)~~ chek(8) (2)ts(')(o\)_ (zek3 cou2 炙草), dried liquorice; _~~chek(9)~~ chek(8) (2)shau_ (zek3 sau2 炙手), to warm the hand; _(4)f(a/)n ~~chek(9)~~ chek(8)_ (faan4 zek3 燔炙) to roast or broil; _~~chek(9)~~ chek(8) (1)kon_ (zek3 gon1 炙乾), dried thoroughly. Williams has been misled by Fan Wan's placement of the series 跖蹠拓隻炙 (_chik_) *after* 劇屐 (_k(')ik(9)_) and 溺 (_nik(9)_), which are 陽入 (see F1.78). Based on this ordering, Williams has inferred that the character 炙 is read 陽入 _chik(9)_ (zik6). However, since Fan Wan has a separate series for 直値殖植稙湜埴 (_chik(9)_), it appears that its authors have attempted to distinguish the vernacular rime _-ek_ from the literary rime _-ik_, notwithstanding all series appear under 第七英影應益. I have corrected Williams by placing 炙 under _chek(8)_ (zek3) here. Williams' 膾炙人口: Corrected _(2)k(u/)i_ (gui2) to _(2)k(')(u/)i_ (kui2). Williams' "near": Specifically, to come under the (positive) influence of another. 【炙】 (tsyek, tsyaeH) (_verb-like_) to broil

U+8DD6 蹠 zik3 (alternative) (F1.78 跖) 盗跖秦之大盗 (F1.78 蹠) 同上又脚掌也又踐履也 (Page 14* before #5: 隻(9)) (The three next characters (隻, 蹠跖, 炙) are usually pronounced _chek_ (zek).) (Page 14* #6: 蹠(9)跖(9) _Chik(9)_ (zik6); _Chek(9)_ (zek6) implied by variational note; here corrected to _Chek(8)_ (zek3)) the sole of the foot (Kangxi 跖: 足下); metatarsus of birds; _t(o\)(6) ~~chek(9)~~ chek(8)_ (dou6 zek3 盜跖) a tyrannical leader of thieves~~, a certain Robin Hood~~ in the ~~days of Ts(')in (秦)~~ Spring and Autumn. Williams has been misled by Fan Wan's placement of the series 跖蹠拓隻炙 (_chik_) *after* 劇屐 (_k(')ik(9)_) and 溺 (_nik(9)_), which are 陽入 (see F1.78). zing1.text: U+7CBE May appear as either ⿰米靑 or ⿰米青 (assumed here), depending on the font. zeng1 (vernacular for "clever" sense) (F1.67 精) 妙也細也純也靈也壯也熟也 (Page 576 before #5: (1)精) (The three next (精, 井, 淨) are often pronounced _tseng_ (zeng)) (Page 576 #5: (1)精) Cleaned rice (Kangxi: 鑿也); selected (Kangxi: 擇也), ripe, mature (Kangxi: 熟也); fine, subtle, delicate (Kangxi: 細也); the best, the finest; unmixed, devoted to (Kangxi: 專一也), accustomed to, expert at; skillful, as in strategy (Kangxi: 巧也); the pure parts of anything (Kangxi: 凡物之純至者皆曰精), etherial, subtle; the essence of things (Kangxi: 靈也眞氣也); it is prefixed to other adjectives to show a high degree of; the animal spirits; the semen, the germinating principle of nature; an apparition, form taken by spirits; _(2)h(o\) (1)tsing (4)shan_ (hou2 zing1 san4 好精神), in good spirits, smart; _(1)tsing (1)ping_ (zing1 bing1 精兵), flower of the troops, picked men; _(4)lung (5)m(a/) (1)tsing (4)shan_ (lung4 maa5 zing1 san4 龍馬精神), bright as a steed or dragon; _(1)tseng ~~kong(3)~~ (2)kong t(a/)i(6) w(a/)(6)_ (zeng1 gong2 daai6 waa6 精講大話) very clever at lying; _(5)k(')(u hai(6) (1)tseng_ (keoi5 hai6 zeng1 佢係精) he's smart enough; _(1)tsing yuk(9)_ (zing1 juk6 精肉) lean meat; _(1)tsing h(i/)(3)_ (zing1 hei3 精氣) ether, the essence of; influence, pure, the quintessence; _(1)tsing ch(i/)(3)_ (zing1 zi3 精緻) beautiful, handsome; _~~(1)tsing~~ (1)tseng (1)kw(a/)i_ (zeng1 gwaai1 精乖), very clever at; _(1)tsing kw(a/)i(3)_ (zing1 gwaai3 精怪) an elf; spirit rappings, prodigies; _(4)wai (1)tsing_ (wai4 zing1 遺精), involuntary emissions; _(5)n(i/) (1)tseng (5)ngo (4)'m (4)ngoi_ (nei5 zeng1 ngo5 m4 ngoi4 你精我唔呆), if you are cute, I'm not a fool; _(1)tseng ~~lut(7)~~ lat(7) (1)p(i/)n_ (zeng1 lat1 bin1 精甩辮), smart as a steel-trap; _(1)tseng (2)tsai_ (zeng1 zai2 精仔), a shrewd fellow; _(1)tseng tau(3) (1)tseng_ (zeng1 dau3 zeng1 精鬥精), met his match. Williams' 精講大話: Corrected _kong(3)_ (gong3) to _(2)kong_ (gong2). Williams' 精乖: Changed _(1)tsing_ (zing1) to vernacular reading _(1)tseng_ (zeng1). Williams' 你精我唔呆: Here, "cute" means "clever". Williams' 精甩辮: Corrected _lut(7)_ (leot1) to _lat(7)_ (lat1). 【精】 (tsjeng) (_noun-like_) fine-rice (_adjective-like_) fine (_noun-like_) essence

zing2.text: U+4E95 丼 zeng2 (alternative) (F1.72 井) 穴地出泉曰井 (Page 576 before #5: (1)精) (The three next (精, 井, 淨) are often pronounced _tseng_ (zeng)) (Page 576 #6: (2)井) A well (Kangxi: 穴地出水曰井); a deep pit; a field laid out regularly (Kangxi: 田九百畝曰井象九區之形); to draw water; arranged, laid out regularly (Kangxi: 井井經畫端整貌); _(2)tseng (2)shui_ (zeng2 seoi2 井水), well water; _(5)sh(i/) (2)tseng_ (si5 zeng2 市井), a public market; _(5)sh(i/) (2)tseng (1)ch(i/) (4)t(')(o\)_ (si5 zeng2 zi1 tou4 市井之徒), a worthless loafer; _(1)t(')(i/)n (2)tseng_ (tin1 zeng2 天井), an open court; _tso(6) (2)tseng (1)k(u/)n (1)t(')(i/)n_ (zo6 zeng2 gun1 tin1 坐井觀天), to look at the sky from a well---inexperienced; _(2)tseng (4)l(a/)n_ (zeng2 laan4 井欄), a well-curb; _(2)tseng (2)tseng (5)yau (4)t(')i(u/)_ (zeng2 zeng2 jau5 tiu4 井井有條), all in order, do it methodically; _(1)hoi (2)tseng_ (hoi1 zeng2 開井), to dig a well; _yat(7) (2)tseng t(i/)(6)_ (jat1 zeng2 dei6 一井地) a square rood of land; _(4)t(')(o\) (2)k(u/) (2)tseng_ (tou4 gu2 zeng2 淘古井), to rinse the old well, _i. e._ to marry a rich widow. Williams' "a field laid out regularly": Not wrong, but misses the definition as nine hundred _mau_ (畝) of land area. Williams' 坐井觀天: More ignorant than inexperienced. Continuously (Kangxi: 往來連屬貌). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【井】 (tsjengX) (_noun-like_) well, (_met._) square (_noun-like_) field-grid (_adverb-like_) (_met._) continuously

Williams' 正唔正: Changed _ching(3)_ (zing3) to vernacular reading _cheng(3)_ (zeng3). Williams' 正當: Corrected _(1)tong_ (dong1) to _tong(3)_ (dong3). If 當 is in level tone, then it means "just when" instead of "proper". Williams' 正啱: Changed _ching(3)_ (zing3) to vernacular reading _cheng(3)_ (zeng3). zeng6.text: U+6DE8 (Page 576 #7: 淨(6) _Tsing(6)_ (zing6); _Tseng(6)_ (zeng6) implied by variational note)

zing6.text: U+6DE8 净 凈 浄 瀞 zeng6 (vernacular adjective "clean") (F1.73 淨) 潔淨不汚也 (Page 20|n63 #8: (1)净) Incorrectly but commonly used for 淨 _tsing(6)_ (zing6) clean. (Page 576 before #5: (1)精) (The three next (精, 井, 淨) are often pronounced _tseng_ (zeng)) (Page 576 #7: 淨(6)) Clean, pure, spotless, undefiled (Kangxi: 無垢也潔也); upright, guileless; to wash clean, to cleanse; only; all; a rapids in the R. H(a/)n (漢) (Kangxi: 灘名, 漢水東爲淨灘); _(1)kon tseng(6)_ (gon1 zeng6 乾淨) clean, pure; _k(i/)t(8) tseng(6)_ (git3 zeng6 潔淨) clean, to purify one's heart; _tsing(6) ~~chung(6)~~ (5)ch(')ung_ (zing6 cung5 淨重) the nett weight; _tseng(6) (2)shui (4)f(u/)_ (zeng6 seoi2 fu4), a cleansing charm, used in houses; _yat(7) ko(3) (1)t(o\) h(u(3) (1)kon tseng(6)_ (jat1 go3 dou1 heoi3 gon1 zeng6 一個都去乾淨) every one has gone. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𠎧 to 潔. Williams' 淨重: Corrected _chung(6)_ (zung6 去聲) to _(5)ch(')ung_ (cung5 上聲). 【淨】 (dzjengH) (_adjective-like_) clean (_verb-like_) to cleanse 【淨】 (zing6) Purely, only. 淨麵 (zing6 min6): "Only noodles." 淨魚蛋 (zing6 jyu4 daan6-2): "Only fish-balls" (i.e. without noodles). 淨食餸 (zing6 sik6 sung3): "Only eating dishes" (i.e. without rice). 淨係佢去 (zing6 hai6 keoi5 heoi3): "Only he is going."

zeng6.text: U+912D 郑 (Mainland simplified) zing6 (uncommon) (F1.74 鄭) 國名又鄭重 (Page 21* #14: 鄭(6) _Ch(')ing(6)_ (cing6); here corrected to _Ching(6)_ (zing6) and normalised to _Cheng(6)_ (zeng6)) A feudal state (Kangxi: 國名) in the Chau (周) dynasty, now the prefecture of K(a/)ifung (開封) in Hon(a/)n (河南); it was first placed where the capital of Shens(i/) (陝西) lies; _~~ch(')ing(6)~~ cheng(6) chung(6)_ (zeng6 zung6 鄭重) prudent (Kangxi: 鄭重殷勤之意)~~, inflexible~~. Fan Wan entry: Removed extra character 又 at the end. Williams erroneously puts 鄭 under aspirated _ch(')ing(6)_ (cing6). Williams' 鄭重: In modern usage, only "solemn". A surname (Kangxi: 姓).

zing6.text: U+912D (F1.74 鄭) 國名又鄭重 (Page 21* #14: 鄭(6) _Ch(')ing(6)_ (cing6); here corrected to _Ching(6)_ (zing6)) Fan Wan entry: Removed extra character 又 at the end. Williams erroneously puts 鄭 under aspirated _ch(')ing(6)_ (cing6).

U+9631 汬 穽 zeng6 (vernacular) (F1.73 阱) 地坑坎也 (F1.73 穽) 同上 (Page 577 #4: 穽(6)阱(6)) A pit, a pitfall, a hole to catch beasts in (Kangxi 阱: 坑也, 陷也); ~~to fall into a pit;~~ _~~h(a/)m(6)~~ ham(6) tsing(6)_ (ham6 zing6 陷阱) ~~to tumble into a hole~~ a trap. Williams' "to fall into a pit": This is a misreading of Kangxi 陷也, which is intended as a noun, not a verb. Williams' 陷阱: Changed _h(a/)m(6)_ (haam6) to common reading _ham(6)_ (ham6). 【阱】 (dzjengX) (_noun-like_) pitfall

zeoi1.text: U+6CAE ceoi1 (per 《廣韻》七余切) (F1.44 沮) 水名 (Page 594 #11: (1)沮) The name of an affluent of the Y(a/)ngtsz' ki(a/)ng (揚子江) (Kangxi: 水名, 水出漢中房陵東入江) west of ~~K'ingchau~~ Kingchau f(u/) (荊州府) in H(u/)peh (湖北); an ancient district now the extreme southwest of Shens(i/) (陝西). The reading _(1)ts(u_ (zeoi1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 子余切, explained 水名說文出漢中房陵東入江. Williams considers rising-tone _(2)ts(u_ (zeoi2) an acceptable alternative reading for the name sense. This is incorrect.

zeoi2.text: U+6CAE ceoi1 (alternative per 《廣韻》七余切 for "stop" sense) zeoi6 (per 《廣韻》慈吕切) (F1.46 沮) 沮邱 (Page 594 #12: (2)沮) To stop, to prohibit (Kangxi: 止也); ~~to pass over;~~ to divulge, to leak (Kangxi: 沮泄謂泄漏也); to destroy (Kangxi: 壞也); to discomfit (Kangxi: 敗也); to scare (Kangxi: 沮謂恐怖之也); _(2)ts(u (2)ch(i/)_ (zeoi2 zi2 沮止), to quash, to stop; to intrigue against; _(2)ts(u tsok(9)_ (zeoi2 zok6 沮怍) ashamed, awkward, as a rustic; _(2)ts(u s(i/)t(8)_ (zeoi2 sit3 沮泄) to let out, to blab; to issue, as malaria; The reading _(2)ts(u_ (zeoi2) is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 再呂切, explained 止之也遏也鬲也抑也. Williams' "to pass over": Kangxi has 過也, but it is unclear whether this means "pass" or "excessive". Williams' "discomfit": In the (now) archaic sense of "defeat". Dejected, despondent. 沮喪 (zeoi2 song3): "Dejected." 【沮-rising】 (dzjoX) (_verb-like_) to stop (_verb-like_) to scare (_verb-like_) to leak

zeoi3.text: U+6CAE (Page 594 #12: (2)沮 _(2)Ts(u_ (zeoi2); here corrected to _Ts(u(3)_ (zeoi3)) _shap(7) ~~(2)ts(u~~ ts(u(3)_ (sap1 zeoi3 濕沮), damp, dank. 【沮-departing】 (tsjoH) (_adjective-like_) dank

zeoi1.text: U+75BD ceoi1 (per 《廣韻》七余切) (F1.44 疽) 癰疽 (Page 594 #6: (1)疽) A deep-seated ulcer (Kangxi: 久癰也); a carbuncle or anthrax; _(1)yung (1)ts(u_ (jung1 zeoi1 癰疽), an old ulcer; _(5)sh(un (1)ts(u_ (syun5 zeoi1 吮疽), to suck out an ulcer. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿸疒⿰⿱丿邑隹 to 癰. 【疽】 (tshjo) (_noun-like_) ulcer
U+7820 岨 ceoi1 (per 《廣韻》七余切) The reading _(1)ts(u_ (zeoi1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 子余切, explained 爾雅土戴石為砠. A rocky hill (Kangxi: 土戴石爲砠).

U+8127 啫 (Cantonese vernacular) 䘒 zoe1 (vernacular) zoe1-4 (low first in reduplication 脧脧) For the visually similar character under the moon radical, see 朘 syun(TODO) In the entry for the moon-radical character, Kangxi carefully notes that the left component is *not* meat (不从肉). In the entry for the meat-radical character, Kangxi erroneously includes senses for the moon-radical character. A boy's genitals (Kangxi: 赤子隂也). 【脧】 (zoe1) The penis. 脧 (zoe1): "Peen." 脧脧 (zoe1-4 zoe1): "Willy."

U+83F9 ze1 (per 《集韻》咨邪切 for "marsh" sense) zeoi3 (per 《集韻》將豫切 for "marsh" sense) (F1.44 菹) 淹菜 (Page 594 #9: (1)菹) Pickled fruits, like melons (Kangxi: 酢菜也 etc.); salted vegetables; ~~a marshy plant or sedge;~~ a marsh (Kangxi: 澤生草曰菹). Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(u_ per 《廣韻》側魚切. Nevertheless, the reading _(1)ts(u_ is not unattested; 《正韻牋》 has the reading 子余切, covering both the "pickle" sense and the "marsh" sense. 【菹】 (tsrjo) (_noun-like_) pickle (_noun-like_) marsh

U+89DC May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 612 #4: (1)觜) Read _(1)tsui_ (zeoi1)_;_ the horns of an owl (Kangxi: 鴟舊頭上角觜也); the curved corners of a roof, or ridgepole; to raise the egret on the head;

zeoi2.text: U+89DC May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 612 #4: (1)觜 read _(1)Tsui_ (zeoi1); here corrected to _(2)Tsui_ (zeoi2)) ~~Read _(1)tsui_ (zeoi1)_;_~~ ~~to bristle up, to look incensed, to pout~~ the lips ~~in anger~~ (Kangxi: 喙也). Williams' "to bristle up" etc.: This is a misreading of Kangxi's examples (武人厲其觜吻 and 列膆破觜). There is no inherent connotation of anger in 觜, which simply means "beak" or "lips".

zi1.text: U+89DC May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.34 觜) 宿名 (Page 612 #4: (1)觜) The 21st zodiacal constellation (Kangxi: 星名觜觿西方宿也), consisting of λ and 2π in Orion's head.

zeoi1.text: U+8D84 ceoi1 (per 《廣韻》七余切) (F1.44 趄) 趦趄行不進也 (Page 594 #10: (1)趄) To walk slowly, impeded in going (Kangxi: 趑趄也); _(1)tsz' (1)ts(u_ (zi1 zeoi1 趑趄), hobbling, walking step by step.

U+8FFD (F2.55 追) 追述追隨又追也 (Page 33* #9: (1)追) To pursue (Kangxi: 逐也), to follow after (Kangxi: 隨也); to come up with (Kangxi: 送也), to overtake, to catch (Kangxi: 逮也); to sue; to seek out, to trace back (Kangxi: 凡上遡已往曰追); to reflect on, to look back on, retrospective; ~~to expel;~~ _(1)chui (2)kon_ (zeoi1 gon2 追趕), to chase; _(1)chui t(o\)(3)_ (zeoi1 dou3-2 追到) to catch, to reach; _(1)chui f(u/)i(3)_ (zeoi1 fui3 追悔) to feel remorse; ~~_(1)chui h(u(3)_ (zeoi1 heoi3 追去) to drive out;~~ _(1)chui kau(3)_ (zeoi1 gau3 追究) to investigate thoroughly; _(4)ngan pat(7) (1)chui (4)(u/)i_ (ngan4 bat1 zeoi1 wui4 銀不追回), the money cannot be refunded; _(1)chui (5)k(')(u (1)f(a/)n (4)lai_ (zeoi1 keoi5 faan1 lai4 追佢返嚟), hurry him back here; _(1)chui (4)'m (5)sh(e/)ung lok(8)_ (zeoi1 m4 soeng5 lok3 追唔上佢) could not catch him; _(1)chui (2)t(')(o\)_ (zeoi1 tou2 追討), to dun; _(1)chui (1)fung_ (zeoi1 fung1 追封), posthumous honors; _(1)chui n(i/)m(6)_ (zeoi1 nim6 追念) to recollect. Fan Wan entry: 追也 is self-referential. Williams' "to sue": In the sense of seeking by request. Williams' "to expel": This is a misreading of Kangxi 逐也. 【追】 (trwij) (_verb-like_) to chase (after), (_met._) to reminisce, to send off

U+9310 锥 (Mainland simplified) (F2.55 錐) 鎗劍之屬 (Page 33* #10: (1)錐) An awl, a borer; a sharp pointed tool (Kangxi: 銳器也); the apex, the point; to bore; trifling; _(1)chui (1)t(o\) m(u/)t(9)_ (zeoi1 dou1 mut6 錐刀末) a small matter (Kangxi: 錐刀末喩小事); _(4)m(o\) (1)chui_ (mou4 zeoi1 毛錐), a pencil (Kangxi: 毛錐筆也); _(1)chui (1)lung_ (zeoi1 lung4-1 錐窿), to bore a hole; _(4)p(')an (4)m(o\) lap(9) (1)chui (1)ch(i/) t(i/)(6)_ (pan4 mou4 lap6 zeoi1 zi1 dei6 貧無立錐之地) miserably poor, not a place to stick an awl. Williams' "pencil": In the (now) dated sense of a brush. 【錐】 (tsywij) (_noun-like_) awl
U+96B9 Short-tailed birds in general (Kangxi: 鳥之短尾總名也). The 172nd radical (U+2FAB ⾫ "short-tailed-bird").
U+96CE ceoi1 (per 《廣韻》七余切) (F1.44 雎) 水鳥詩關關雎鳩 This character is easily confused with 睢 (see 睢 zeoi1). A type of waterbird. 【雎】 (tshjo) Used in 雎鳩. 【雎鳩】 (tshjo kjuw) (_noun-like_) water bird

U+9A05 骓 (Mainland simplified) (F2.55 騅) 馬之蒼黑者 (Page 33* #11: (1)騅) A black horse with white spots (Kangxi: 蒼白雜毛騅); _(1)(u/) (1)chui (5)m(a/)_ (wu1 zeoi1 maa5 烏騅馬), the charger of H(a/)ng Y(u/) (項羽) of Tso (楚). 【騅】 (tsywij) (_noun-like_) piebald

zeoi2.text: U+5480 (F1.46 咀) 咀嚼 (Page 595 #1: (2)咀) To taste (Kangxi: 含味也); to chew, to bite in order to taste (Kangxi: 咀嚼); _(2)ts(u ~~ts(e/)uk(9)~~ ts(e/)uk(8) (5)h(a/)_ (zeoi2 zoek3 haa5 咀嚼吓), take a bite of it; _(4)h(o\)m (1)ying (2)ts(u ~~(1)w(a/)~~ (4)w(a/)_ (ham4 jing1 zeoi2 waa4 含英咀華), to learn and relish the beauties of a style. Williams' 咀嚼吓: Changed _ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6) to common reading _ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3). Williams' 含英咀華: Corrected _(1)w(a/)_ (waa1) to _(4)w(a/)_ (waa4).

U+5634 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+12) or 4 strokes (+13 assumed here), depending on the font. 咀 (Cantonese) 𠲿 觜 (F2.56 嘴) 口唇也 (Page 596 #5: (2)嘴) The lips; a beak, a bill of a bird (Kangxi 𠲿: 鳥喙也, 與觜同 etc.); a spout, a nozzle, an aperture, an adit; to wrangle, to chatter, to talk much and impudently, to give lip; _m(u/)t(8) (5)h(a/) (4)t(')i(u/) (2)tsui_ (mut3 haa5 tiu4 zeoi2 抹吓條嘴), wipe your lips; _(1)ts(')an (2)tsui_ (can1 zeoi2 親嘴), to kiss; _ts(e/)uk(8) (2)tsui_ (zoek3 zeoi2 雀嘴), a bird's bill; _(1)(i/)n (4)t(')ung (2)tsui_ (jin1 tung4-1 zeoi2 煙筒嘴), mouthpiece of a pipe; _(2)h(o\) (2)tsui (5)m(a/)_ (hou2 zeoi2 maa5 好嘴馬), or _(4)yau (2)tsui_ (jau4 zeoi2 油嘴), glib at talking, garrulous; _(4)m(o\) t(a/)p(8) (2)tsui_ (mou4 daap3 zeoi2 毋答嘴), don't interfere, as in a dispute; _(2)t(a/) (2)tsui (1)p(a/)_ (daa2 zeoi2 baa1 打嘴巴), to beat the lips; _sung(3) (2)si(u/) (2)tsui_ (sung3 siu2 zeoi2 送小嘴), to tell tales, to stir up ill feeling; _(1)pong (2)tsui_ (bong1 zeoi2 幫嘴), to take the part of; _(4)ch(')(a/) (4)(u/) (2)tsui_ (caa4 wu4-2 zeoi2 茶壺嘴), a teapot spout; _h(o\)(3) shik(9) (2)tsui (4)t(')au_ (hou3 sik6 zeoi2 tau4 好食嘴頭), loving to eat this and that; _(5)n(i/) (5)m(o\) ~~(4)to~~ (1)to (2)tsui_ (nei5 mou5 do1 zeoi2 你冇多嘴), don't you talk so much; _(2)tsui (2)kong ~~(i/)(3)~~ (i/)(6)_ (zeoi2 gong2 ji6 嘴講易) it's all very easy to talk; _(2)tsui (2)h(o\) ng(a/)ng(6)_ (zeoi2 hou2 ngaang6 嘴好硬) he won't confess at all. It is only in modern Cantonese that 咀 _(2)ts(u_ and 嘴 _(2)tsui_ are homophonous (both zeoi2), and that 咀 is an alternative form of 嘴. Williams' 你冇多嘴: Corrected _(4)to_ (do4) to _(1)to_ (do1). Williams' 嘴講易: Corrected _(i/)(3)_ (ji3) to _(i/)(6)_ (ji6).

zo3.text: U+8A5B 作 (for "curse" sense) 謯 诅 (Mainland simplified) zeoi2 (common) (F2.61 詛) 竹過切咒詛 (F2.61 咀) 同上 (Page 26* before #2: 詛(3)) This character (詛) is often called ~~_ch(u\)_ (zoe) or~~ _ch(u_ (zyu). (Page 26* #2: 詛(3)) To curse, to imprecate (Kangxi: 詶也, 呪詛); bad language, curses; _chau(3) cho(3)_ (zau3 zo3 咒詛) to curse. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword self-reference to 上. Williams records _ch(u\)_ (zoe) and _ch(u_ (zyu) as alternative readings without specifying the tone. The former I cannot justify. The latter rhymes with 《集韻》遵遇切 _ts(u(3)_, explained 詶也, and also with 咀 _(2)ts(u_, but in both cases the pre-merger initial is inconsistent. The common reading zeoi2 is perhaps from identifying 詛咒 with 咀咒, noting that Fan Wan considers 咀 an alternative form of 詛 _cho(3)_ (zo3). To swear an oath. 【詛】 (tsrjoH) (_verb-like_) to imprecate, (_met._) to oath

zeoi2.text: U+9F5F 龃 (Mainland simplified) zeoi6 (per 《廣韻》牀吕切) (F1.46 齟) 齟齬不相合也 (Page 595 #2: (2)齟) Irregular teeth, which do not interlock easily (Kangxi: 齒不相値曰齟齬); discordant, as opinions, incongruous; to bite, to chew (Kangxi: 齧也, 嚼也). Fan Wan entry: Corrected malformed radical in headword 齟 and in 齬.

zeoi3.text: U+6700 冣 (F2.57 最) 殿最前曰最後曰殿 (Page 597 #2: 最(3)) To come together, to assemble (Kangxi: 聚也); an adjective denoting the most important, the highest degree of (Kangxi: 極也, 最爲第一); ~~very, extremely, exceedingly~~ most; altogether (Kangxi: 最都凡也); _tsui(3) sh(i/)n(6)_ (zeoi3 sin6 最善) very ~~good~~ best; _tsui(3) (4)n(a/)n_ (zeoi3 naan4 最難), ~~very difficult~~ hardest; _tsui(3) (2)kan i(u/)(3)_ (zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 最緊要) ~~highly~~ most important; _tsui(3) (1)s(i/)n_ (zeoi3 sin1 最先), first, in the first place; _tsui(3) p(i/)n(6) tong(3)_ (zeoi3 bin6 dong3 最便當) the most convenient, very handy. 【最】 (tswajH) (_verb-like_) to collect (_determiner-like_) -est, -most

U+7DB4 缀 (Mainland simplified) zeoi6 (per Fan Wan, common) zyut3 (per 《廣韻》陟劣切 for "stitch/connect" senses and common in 點綴) zyut6 (common in 點綴) (F2.24 綴 _Ch(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) 聯也又舞列也又止也禮記綴兆舒疾樂之文也 (F2.57 綴 _Chui(6)_ (zeoi6)) 冠系又聯也 (Page 34* #2: 綴(6) _Chui(6)_ (zeoi6); here normalised to _Chui(3)_ (zeoi3)) Connected (Kangxi: 連也, 緝也); to carry on (Kangxi: 綴言不絕也); to sew together (Kangxi: 綴猶結也); mixed, variegated (Kangxi: 綴雜彩有文之具); to oversee royal robes (Kangxi: 掌衣服 etc.). (Page 42 #7: 綴(8) _Ch(ut(8)_ (zyut3); here normalised to _Chui(3)_ (zeoi3)) To connect, to join; ~~a band of posture-makers.~~ Williams' "a band of posture-makers": This is perhaps a rendering of Fan Wan 舞列也, or of Kangxi 綴表也所以表行列也, the latter of which is (not particularly helpful) commentary for 《禮樂記》行其綴兆. Undeviating (Kangxi: 不乖離之貌). 【綴】 (trjwet, trjwejH) (_verb-like_) to stitch (together), to connect

zeoi6.text: U+7DB4 (F2.24 綴 _Ch(ut(8)_ (zyut3)) 聯也又舞列也又止也禮記綴兆舒疾樂之文也 (F2.57 綴) 冠系又聯也 (Page 34* #2: 綴(6))

zyut3.text: U+7DB4 缀 (Mainland simplified) (F2.24 綴) 聯也又舞列也又止也禮記綴兆舒疾樂之文也 (F2.57 綴 _Chui(6)_ (zeoi6)) 冠系又聯也 (Page 42 #7: 綴(8)) to stop (Kangxi: 綴猶止也); To bind (Kangxi: 綴猶拘也).

zeoi3.text: U+8DB3 (F1.48 足 _Ts(u(6)_ (zeoi6)) 足恭恭之過也 (Page 598 #8: 足(7) read _Ts(u(6)_ (zeoi6); here corrected to _Ts(u(3)_ (zeoi3)) Read _~~ts(u(6)~~ ts(u(3)_ (zeoi3)_;_ ~~to act respectfully in order to flatter one~~ excessive (Kangxi: 過也); ~~careful of one's words;~~ to increase (Kangxi: 添物也, 益也); _~~ts(u(6)~~ ts(u(3) (1)kung (1)(u (4)yan_ (zeoi3 gung1 jyu1 jan4 足恭於人), ~~to humor and flatter people~~ excessively deferential unto others. 【足-departing】 (tsjuH) (_verb-like_) to plenish, to heap (_adjective-like_) excessive

zuk1.text: U+8DB3 𧾷 (character component on left) (F1.65 足) 脚也備足足完足 (Page 598 #8: 足(7)) The leg (Kangxi: 人之足也); the foot; enough, sufficient (Kangxi: 滿也止也); full, satiated, no deficiency; entirely, in full, wholly; to satisfy, to please; to satisfy the wants of; pure, as silver; actions, conduct; the ~~137th~~ 157th radical (U+2F9C ⾜ "foot") of characters relating to going; _shap(9) tsuk(7)_ (sap6 zuk1 十足) complete in all respects; _(2)shau tsuk(7)_ (sau2 zuk1 手足) hands and feet, brothers; _tsuk(7) (5)ling_ (zuk1 ling5 足領), enough! no more, I beg of you! _tsz'(6) tsuk(7)_ (zi6 zuk1 自足) self-sufficient, conceited; _tsuk(7) tsuk(7) (2)wan (5)n(i/) p(u/)n(3) yat(9)_ (zuk1 zuk1 wan2 nei5 bun3 jat6 足足搵你一日) I've annoyed you half a day; _shat(7) tsuk(7)_ (sat1 zuk1 失足) to slip and fall; to make a blunder, a faux-pas; _tsuk(7) h(a/)(6)_ (zuk1 haa6 足下) your presence, said to a friend; _(4)'m (1)ch(i/) tsuk(7)_ (m4 zi1 zuk1 唔知足) discontented, never satisfied; _pat(7) tsuk(7) t(o\)(6)_ (bat1 zuk1 dou6 不足道) ~~beyond description, can not be spoken of~~ not worth speaking of; _tsuk(7) sh(o\)(3) (4)'m tsuk(7)_ (zuk1 sou3 m4 zuk1 足數唔足) is the number just right? _(1)fung tsuk(7)_ (fung1 zuk1 豐足) prosperous, to the heart's content; _(4)yan (1)sam (5)m(o\) (i/)m(3) tsuk(7)_ (jan4 sam1 mou5 jim3 zuk1 人心冇饜足) the heart is never satisfied; _(4)(un tong(3) tsuk(7) (2)tsz'_ (jyun4 dong3 zuk1 zi2 圓當足子) whole dollars alone are reckoned to be full coin. Williams' 足數唔足: This is dated syntax. In modern Cantonese, it would be 足唔足數, with only the adjective hugging the negative. 【足-entering】 (tsjowk) (_noun-like_) foot (_adjective-like_) sufficient

zeoi3.text: U+9189 zeoi3-2 (rising second in vernacular 醉醉地) (F2.57 醉) 酒醉 (Page 597 #1: 醉(3)) Exhilirated with drink (Kangxi: 爲酒所酣曰醉); intoxicated, fuddled, drunken; a debauch; fascinated, enchanted, devoted to, stupefied with; completely engrossed with; _(2)yam tsui(3)_ (jam2 zeoi3 飲醉) drunken; _(4)'m (1)ch(i/) tsui(3)_ (m4 zi1 zeoi3 唔知醉) not affected by liquor; _tsui(3) (2)tsau (2)l(o\)_ (zeoi3 zau2 lou2 醉酒佬) a drunkard; _(4)m(o\) (2)tsau (1)s(a/)m (1)fan tsui(3)_ (mou4 zau2 saam1 fan1 zeoi3 無酒三分醉) he is ~~half~~ three-tenths drunk, and has had no wine, _i. e._ he is very stupid, he does not know what he's about; _tsui(3) (1)h(e/)ung_ (zeoi3 hoeng1 醉鄉), a drunken sot; _tsui(3) (4)(u (4)nai_ (zeoi3 jyu4 nai4 醉如泥), drunk as a clod; _t(a/)i(6) tsui(3)_ (daai6 zeoi3 大醉) dead drunk. 【醉】 (tswijH) (_adjective-like_) drunk

zeoi6.text: U+589C 䃍 隊 坠 (Mainland simplified) (F2.57 墜) 落也 (F2.57 隊) 同上 (Page 33* #12: 墜(6)隊(6)) To fall, to tumble over (Kangxi 墜: 陊也, 落也); to slide; to fall down; to pull on; _chui(6) (1)tai_ (zeoi6 dai1 墜低), pull it down; _lui(6) chui(6)_ (leoi6 zeoi6 累墜) troublesome, requiring constant oversight; _chui(6) lok(9)_ (zeoi6 lok6 墜落) to fall in ruins, to throw over; _chui(6) lok(9) (1)t(')oi_ (zeoi6 lok6 toi1 墜落胎), a falling womb, an abortion. Williams' "to pull on": Specifically, to tug downward by hung weight. 【墜】 (drwijH) (_verb-like_) to fall 【墜手】 (zeoi6 sau2) Weighty, as felt by the hands.

U+5E8F 叙 (for "order" and "preface" senses) 敍 (for "order" and "preface" senses) 敘 (for "order" and "preface" senses) (F1.48 序) 次也又學名 (Page 595 #3: 序(6)) Eastern and western walls ~~or rooms~~ (Kangxi 序: 東西牆謂之序); a college, a school (Kangxi 序: 學也); an asylum for old men; a preface, an introduction, an exordium (Kangxi 敍: 凡書策舉其綱要列卷首爲敍或作序); order, precedence, series (Kangxi 序: 次也); to follow in order; _ts(')z'(3) ts(u(6)_ (ci3 zeoi6 次序) in order, seriatim, regularly; _tsok(8) yat(7) (1)p(')(i/)n ts(u(6)_ (zok3 jat1 pin1 zeoi6 作一篇序) to write a preface; _ts(u(6) (2)ch(')(i/)_ (zeoi6 ci2 序齒), to go by ages; _ts(u(6) (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (zeoi6 coeng4 序庠), a district college; _ts(u(6) sz'(6) (5)t(')o, tong(3)_ (zeoi6 si6 to5 dong3 序事妥當) everything in its order. (Page 595 #4: 敍(6)叙(6)) Similar to the preceding (序); to arrange, to order, to set in their proper places; order, series, rank (Kangxi 敍: 次第也, 敍謂次敍); _(1)t(')(i/)n ts(u(6)_ (tin1 zeoi6 天序) the five social relations. 【序】 (zjoX) (_noun-like_) side-wall (_noun-like_) learning-hall (_noun-like_) order (_noun-like_) preface

U+6558 叙 敍 (F1.48 敘) 會也又陳述也又天敘五倫也 (Page 595 #4: 敍(6)叙(6); here normalised to 敘) to meet, to converse; to discourse or argue upon; _(1)s(e/)ung ts(u(6)_ (soeng1 zeoi6 相敘) or _ts(u(6) (4)t(')(a/)m_ (zeoi6 taam4 敘談), to converse; _(5)(i/) ts(u(6)_ (ji5 zeoi6 議敘) to deliberate upon the proper rewards; The character U+6558 敘 (⿰余攵) is known to appear incorrectly in at least one serif font; check the Font test page.

U+7E0B 缒 (Mainland simplified) (F2.57 縋) 以繩懸物而垂下曰縋 (Page 33* #13: 縋(6)) A rope (Kangxi: 縋繩索也); to let down by a cord (Kangxi: 以繩有所懸也); _chui(6) lok(9)_ (zeoi6 lok6 縋落) to let down, as into a well, or over a wall; _chui(6) (4)(un_ (zeoi6 jyun4 縋鉛), lead put in sycee. 【縋】 (drjweH) (_noun-like_) (hung) cord (_verb-like_) to hang cord

U+7F6A 辠 (F1.48 罪) 罰也 (F1.48 辠) 同上 (Page 598 #1: 罪(6)辠(6)) A bamboo net for fish (Kangxi 罪: 捕魚竹罔); to become entangled in the net of the law; trespass, crime, sin, fault; a violation of the rules of the land or decorum (Kangxi 辠: 辠犯法也...秦以辠似皇字改爲罪); to criminate, to regard as a criminal; punishment, retribution; _tak(7) ts(u/)i(6) (1)(u (1)t(')(i/)n_ (dak1 zeoi6 jyu1 tin1 得罪於天), to sin against Heaven; _ts(u/)i(6) kwo(3)_ (zeoi6 gwo3 罪過) a fault, a crime; _~~(4)(un~~ ts(u/)i(6) (5)yau (2)ho (4)(un_ (~~jyun4~~ zeoi6 jau5 ho2 jyun4 ~~？~~罪有可原), the crime can be exculpated; _f(a/)t(8) ts(u/)i(6)_ (faat3 zeoi6 法罪) to punish crime; _sh(e/)(3) ts(u/)i(6)_ (se3 zeoi6 赦罪) to forgive sins; _(1)kwan ts(u/)i(6)_ (gwan1 zeoi6 軍罪) exile to (I/)l(i/) (？？); _sh(u(3) ts(u/)i(6)_ (syu3 zeoi6 恕罪) excuse me; _f(a/)n(6) ts(u/)i(6)_ (faan6 zeoi6 犯罪) to offend the laws; _shuk(9) ts(u/)i(6)_ (suk6 zeoi6 贖罪) to redeem or ransom criminals; _f(u/)(6) (1)king (2)ts(')ing ts(u/)i(6)_ (fu6 ging1 cing2 zeoi6 負荊請罪) to take a rod and request punishment --- an affected phrase of officers; _f(u/)i(3) ts(u/)i(6)_ (fui3 zeoi6 悔罪) to repent of sins; _ts(u/)i(6) (2)sho (1)ying tak(7)_ (zeoi6 so2 jing1 dak1 罪所應得) a punishment well deserved. Williams' 罪過: Also a polite (interjectional) apology. 【罪】 (dzwojX) (_noun-like_) crime, offence

U+805A May appear as either ⿱取乑 or ⿱取⿸⿹亻人人 (assumed here), depending on the font. 冣 (F1.48 聚) 會也又積聚 (Page 595 #5: 聚(6)) To assemble, to congregate (Kangxi: 會也), to gather (Kangxi: 斂也); to meet; to tend to, to concur; to incline towards, popular (Kangxi: 聚謂衆所宜); to collect, to dwell together; a dwelling-place, a village (Kangxi: 居也邑落也, 聚謂村落也); a conjunction, a meeting; a place of meeting; _ts(u(6) (2)shau_ (zeoi6 sau2 聚首), a concourse, a gathering of friends; _(4)'m ts(u(6) (4)ts(')oi_ (m4 zeoi6 coi4 唔聚財) not a lucky place; not a moneymaking man; _ts(u(6) (2)p(o\) (4)t(')ong_ (zeoi6 bou2 tong4 聚寶堂), the shrine of Plutus at the door; _ts(u(6) (u/)i(6)_ (zeoi6 wui6 聚會) to call a meeting 【聚】 (dzjuX, dzjuH) (_verb-like_) to gather
U+85C7 (F1.48 藇) 美也 (Page 595 #6: 藇(6)) Good, agreeable, pleasant (Kangxi: 美貌), as liquor. 【藇】 (zjoX) (_adjective-like_) pleasant, fine

U+8D05 赘 (Mainland simplified) zeoi3 (per 《廣韻》之芮切) (F2.57 贅) 謂以物質錢也又男附女家謂之贅壻 (Page 34* #1: 贅(6)) To pledge, to pawn (Kangxi: 以物質錢); connected with, hanging to (Kangxi: 贅屬也, 贅猶綴也謂繫綴而屬之), an excrescence (Kangxi: 贅屬也橫生一肉屬著體也), a useless appendage; a blemish; unsuitable; tautology, verbiage (Kangxi: 言煩也); a postscript; _yap(9) chui(6)_ (jap6 zeoi6 入贅) to live in a wife's family; _chui(6) lui(6)_ (zeoi6 leoi6 贅累) reiterated, verbose; _chui(6) (4)(i/)n_ (zeoi6 jin4 贅言), to repeat; _chui(6) k(')ap(9)_ (zeoi6 kap6 贅及) a postscript. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𢪱 to 物. 【贅】 (tsywejH) (_verb-like_) to pledge (_verb-like_) to annex (_noun-like_) excrescence, (_met._) superfluous
U+9C6E 魣 (F1.48 鱮) 魴鱮魚名 (Page 595 #7: 鱮(6)) The tench or roach; a large, coarse species of carp found in the rivers of Ki(a/)ngs(u/) (江蘇). The silver carp. 【鱮】 (zjoX) (_noun-like_) tench

zeon1.text: U+554D (F2.52 啍) 啍啍重語貌 (Page 36* #8: (1)啍)
U+5C0A (F2.51 樽) 酒樽 (F2.51 鐏) 同上 (F2.51 罇) 同上 (F2.51 尊) 同上 (Page 600 #13: (1)樽(1)罇(1)尊) Fan Wan entry: Normalised ⿰𦈢尊 to 罇.

zyun1.text: U+5C0A (F2.19 尊) 尊長崇也重也貴也敬也 (Page 604 #3: (1)尊) Honorable, eminent, respected, noble (Kangxi: 高稱也, 重也貴也 etc.); a term of respect, your; to honor, to respect, to dignify, to venerate (Kangxi: 敬也); _ling(6) (1)ts(un_ (ling6 zyun1 令尊) your father; _(1)ts(un k(a/)(3)_ (zyun1 gaa3 尊駕) your honor; you, Sir; _(1)ts(un sing(3)_ (zyun1 sing3 尊姓) your surname; _(1)ts(un (2)f(u/)_ (zyun1 fu2 尊府), your house; _(1)ts(un (1)f(u/) (4)yan_ (zyun1 fu1 jan4 尊夫人), your wife; _(4)wai (5)l(o\) pat(7) (1)ts(un_ (wai4 lou5 bat1 zyun1 為老不尊), old but without self-respect; _(1)ts(un king(3)_ (zyun1 ging3 尊敬) to venerate; _ch(i/)(3) (1)ts(un_ (zi3 zyun1 至尊), the emperor; _(1)ts(un (2)ch(e/)ung_ (zyun1 zoeng2 尊長), respected, elderly persons; _yat(7) (1)ts(un fat(9) (2)k(o\)m y(e/)ung(6)_ (jat1 zyun1 fat6 gam2 joeng6-2 一尊佛噉樣) stupid as a statue of Budha. Classifier for objects that are heavy or not readily movable. 【尊】 (tswon) (_verb-like_) to honour

zeon1.text: U+5C6F May appear with first stroke ㇐ (assumed here) or ㇒, depending on the font. This extends to all characters containing 屯 as a component. 迍 (for "difficult" sense) (F2.52 屯) 高屯難也屈也 (Page 36* #13: (1)屯) ~~Budding plants;~~ difficulty (Kangxi: 難也); difficult to proceed (Kangxi: 屯邅難行不進貌); avaricious (Kangxi: 吝也); pressed down; the 3d of the diagrams. Fan Wan entry: Fixed missing bottom-left in 高. Williams' "Budding plants": This is a misreading of Kangxi 象艸木之初生 as a definition, when it is simply the 《說文》 glyph explanation. 【屯-unvoiced】 (trwin) (_adjective-like_) difficult

U+699B 樼 (F2.52 榛) 榛檜木名 (Page 601 #2: (1)榛) A fruit like the hazel or filbert, smaller than the chestnut (Kangxi: 果實如小栗); ~~wood, brushwood~~ a type of tree (Kangxi: 木也); thorny bushes, as in thickset hedges (Kangxi: 一曰蕪也). Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chun_ per 《廣韻》側詵切. Fan Wan entry: Changed 橧 to 檜. 【榛】 (tsrin) (_noun-like_) hazel

U+6A3D 尊 罇 (F2.51 樽) 酒樽 (F2.51 鐏) 同上 (F2.51 罇) 同上 (F2.51 尊) 同上 (Page 600 #13: (1)樽(1)罇(1)尊) A vase for libations; a vase for wine (Kangxi 樽: 酒器也); a bottle, a decanter; a vase, a jar; full, flourishing foliage (Kangxi 樽: ...樽乃林木茂盛之字); to stop (Kangxi 樽: 止也); _yat(7) (1)tsun (2)tsau_ (jat1 zeon1 zau2 一樽酒), a bottle of spirits; _(1)f(a/) (1)tsun_ (faa1 zeon1 花樽), a flower-vase; _(1)hoi (1)tsun_ (hoi1 zeon1 開樽), open the bottle. Fan Wan entry: Normalised ⿰𦈢尊 to 罇. 【樽】 (tswon) (_noun-like_) wine-vase 【樽】 (zeon1) A bottle. 樽豉油 (zeon1 si6 jau4): "The bottle of soy sauce." 樽水 (zeon1 seoi2): "The bottle of water." 樽裝水 (zeon1 zong1 seoi2): "Bottled water." 水樽 (seoi2 zeon1): "Water bottle." 膠樽 (gaau1 zeon1): "Plastic bottle." 酒樽 (zau2 zeon1): "Wine bottle." 玻璃樽 (bo1 lei4-1 zeon1): "Glass bottle." A vase. 花樽 (faa1 zeon1): "A flower vase."

U+6D25 (F2.51 津) 濟渡處又津液 (Page 600 #12: (1)津) A ford (Kangxi: 渡也, 津是渡處), a ferry; a landing-place, a ghaut; to ford, to cross a stream; to imbue, to moisten (Kangxi: 潤也), to soften by soaking; ~~to split wood by the hands;~~ spittle; _(1)tsun (4)l(e/)ung_ (zeon1 loeng4 津梁), ends of a bridge; _(1)tsun yat(9)_ (zeon1 jat6 津溢) saliva; _(1)tsun (2)hau_ (zeon1 hau2 津口), a ferry; _(1)kw(a/)n (1)tsun_ (gwaan1 zeon1 關津), excise stations, guard-houses; _man(6) (1)tsun_ (man6 zeon1 問津), to ask the way; _(1)shang (1)tsun_ (sang1 zeon1 生津), to produce saliva; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)tsun_ (tin1 zeon1 天津), the constellation Cygnus; the port of Peking (北京); _(1)tsun (1)tsun (5)yau m(i/)(6)_ (zeon1 zeon1 jau5 mei6 津津有味) I relish it more and more. 【津】 (tsin) (_noun-like_) ford (_verb-like_) to moisten

U+6EB1 (F2.69 溱) 水名 (Page 601 #3: (1)溱) A small stream in Hon(a/)n (河南) (Kangxi: 水名在河南), one of the headwaters of the R. ~~Hw(a/)i~~ Hwui (Kangxi: 入~~淮~~匯); _(1)tsun (1)tsun_ (zeon1 zeon1 溱溱), numerous, abundant (Kangxi: 溱溱衆也, 溱溱盛貌); at ease, loose (Kangxi: 舒也). Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chun_ per 《廣韻》側詵切. 【溱】 (tsrin) (_adjective-like_) multitudinous, abundant
U+7A80 (Page 36* #11: (1)窀) To inter (Kangxi: 窀穸下棺也); _(1)chun tsik(9)_ (zeon1 zik6 窀穸) the grave; to put away in a vault or grave.
U+7F47 (F2.51 樽) 酒樽 (F2.51 鐏) 同上 (F2.51 罇) 同上 (F2.51 尊) 同上 (Page 600 #13: (1)樽(1)罇(1)尊) Fan Wan entry: Normalised ⿰𦈢尊 to 罇.

U+80AB (F2.52 肫) 懇至貌 (Page 36* #10: (1)肫) Bones of the face (Kangxi: 面頯也); earnest, sincere (Kangxi: 懇誠貌); _(1)chun (1)chun_ (zeon1 zeon1 肫肫), ~~decided, firm~~ earnest, sincere. Bird gizzard. 【肫】 (tsywin) (_adjective-like_) earnest

U+81FB 溱 (F2.69 臻) 至也 (Page 601 #3: (1)溱) to reach to (Kangxi 溱: 至也與臻同); (Page 601 #4: (1)臻) To arrive or extend to (Kangxi: 至也, 及也); the utmost, the highest degree; many, a multitude (Kangxi: 衆也); to collect, to congregate (Kangxi: 聚也); _p(a/)k(8) fuk(7) (4)p(')ing (1)tsun_ (baak3 fuk1 ping4 zeon1 百福駢臻), may all happiness come here. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chun_ per 《廣韻》側詵切. 【臻】 (tsrin) (_verb-like_) to arrive

U+84C1 榛 ceon4 (per 《集韻》鋤臻切 for "tree-thicket" sense) (F2.69 蓁) 美盛貌 (Page 601 #5: (1)蓁) Abundant, exuberant herbage (Kangxi: 草盛貌); bushy trees (Kangxi: 與榛通木叢生也); collected, an accumulation of (Kangxi: 積聚之貌); _(4)k(')(i/) (i/)p(9) (1)tsun (1)tsun_ (kei4 jip6 zeon1 zeon1 其葉蓁蓁), how abundant is the foliage. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)chun_ per 《廣韻》側詵切. 【蓁】 (tsrin) (_adjective-like_) abundant, luxuriant

U+8AC4 啍 谆 (Mainland simplified) zeon3 (per Kangxi 之閏切 for "assist" sense) (F2.52 諄) 詳語貌又懇誠也 (Page 36* #8: (1)啍) Garrulous (Kangxi 啍: 同諄); _(1)chun (1)chun_ (zeon1 zeon1 啍啍), to reiterate, to say over and over (Kangxi 啍: 啍啍多言者也). (Page 36* #9: (1)諄) To inculcate, to tell repeatedly (Kangxi: 吿曉之熟也, 誨言重複也); _(1)chun (1)chun (4)(i/)n (1)ch(i/)_ (zeon1 zeon1 jin4 zi1 諄諄言之), to make plain, to impress on one. Sincere, earnest (Kangxi: 誠懇貌). To assist (Kangxi: 佐也). 【諄】 (tsywin, tsywinH) (_adverb-like_) earnestly, repeatedly (_verb-like_) to assist
U+8FCD (F2.52 迍) 迍邅 (Page 36* #12: (1)迍) A vain effort to progress (Kangxi: 迍邅也); _(1)chun (1)ch(i/)n_ (zeon1 zin1 迍邅), making no advance, unsuccessful.

U+9075 zyun1 (uncommon vernacular) (F2.51 遵) 循也率也 (Page 601 #1: (1)遵) To follow (Kangxi: 循也) a superior; to comply with, to obey, to conform to, to act as required, to yield; to induce to follow, to influence to obey (Kangxi: 率也 etc.); obedience, acquiescence; _(1)tsun (2)ch(i/)_ (zeon1 zi2 遵旨), to obey the ~~emperior's~~ emperor's behests; _(1)yam (2)ts(')z' (1)yam (1)tsun_ (jam1 ci2 jam1 zeon1 欽此欽遵), ~~to stand in awe and obey~~ a phrase that concludes imperial edicts; _(1)tsun f(a/)t(8)_ (zeon1 faat3 遵法) to obey the laws; _(1)tsun (1)(i/)_ (zeon1 ji1 遵依), to cordially receive. Williams' 欽此欽遵: Better rendered "the revered edict is thus, the revered edict is to be obeyed!" 【遵】 (tswin) (_verb-like_) to go along, to adhere

zeon2.text: U+5118 侭 尽 盡 zeon6 (common) (F2.53 儘) 皆也 (Page 601 #6: (2)儘) ~~Same as _tsun(6)_ (zeon6) 盡 to finish;~~ ~~empty;~~ all (Kangxi 盡: 皆也); the utmost degree (Kangxi 盡: 極也, 盡之也); _(2)tsun (2)ho (5)(i/)_ (zeon2 ho2 ji5 儘可以), it can be done; _(2)tsun k(i/)n(3)_ (zeon2 gin3 儘見) seen it through, seen the whole. The common reading zeon6 is reinforced by modern use of 盡快, 盡力, 盡量, etc. instead of 儘快, 儘力, 儘量, etc. Williams' "Same as ...": This is a misreading of Kangxi 同盡, which is only intended for the reading _(2)tsun_ (zeon2). To allow, to let (Kangxi 盡: 任也, 縱令也, 俗作儘). 【盡-unvoiced】 (tsinX) (_adverb-like_) completely

U+51C6 (F2.53 准) 信也實也 (Page 36* #14: (2)准) To permit, to approve; to allow, to decide; to receive; on, upon, as a day; _(2)chun chong(6)_ (zeon2 zong6 准狀) grant the petition; _(2)chun (4)hang_ (zeon2 hang4 准行), allowed to be done; _(2)chun sun(3)_ (zeon2 seon3 准信) to believe; _(2)chun (5)(i/) shap(9) yat(9)_ (zeon2 ji5 sap6 jat6 准以十日) permission for ten days; _(2)chun shat(9) k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (zeon2 sat6 gam3 do1 准實咁多), worth just that.
U+51D6 (F2.53 凖) 凖則平也擬也 (Page 36* #15: (2)凖)

U+6E96 准 凖 (F2.53 凖) 凖則平也擬也 (Page 36* #14: (2)准; here normalised to 準) _(2)chun p(i/)(6)_ (zeon2 bei6 準備) to prepare for; Used for the following (凖). (Page 36* #15: (2)凖; here normalised to 準) To equalize, to fix, to adjust (Kangxi 準: 謂準擊平正之也); to level, to measure; a rule, a ~~guage~~ gauge, a plumb, a line (Kangxi 準: 平也); even, exact, just (Kangxi 準: 均也); to run true, as a watch; _(5)yau (2)chun (4)t(')au_ (jau5 zeon2 tau4 有準頭), he has the right ~~guage~~ gauge, skilled in; _(2)chun ch(i/)t(8)_ (zeon2 zit3 準折) to barter; _(2)chun (4)shing_ (zeon2 sing4 準繩), a marking-line; _(2)chun tsak(7)_ (zeon2 zak1 準則) a custom, a rule; _(2)chun (4)'m (2)chun_ (zeon2 m4 zeon2 準唔準), is it exact? To imitate, to emulate (Kangxi: 則也倣也). 【準】 (tsywinX) (_noun-like_) water-level (_adjective-like_) level, even, (_met._) standard

U+71FC 烬 㶳 藎 (for "remainder" sense) zeon6 (per 《廣韻》徐刃切) (F2.53 燼) 火燭之灰也燒後曰燼 (Page 601 #7: (2)燼) The ashes (Kangxi 㶳: 火餘也), embers (Kangxi 㶳: 火餘木), snuff (Kangxi 㶳: 灺也, 燭餘也), or residue after combustion; a quenched brand; the residuum; the relics, what is left, as of a conquered people (Kangxi 燼: 燼遺民); _f(a/)(3) (4)wai (1)f(u/)i (2)tsun_ (faa3 wai4 fui1 zeon2 化為灰燼), all turned to ashes; _(4)(u (2)tsun_ (jyu4 zeon2 餘燼), the remains, as of embers. (Page 601 #8: (2)藎) Similar to the last (燼); a residue (Kangxi 藎: 藎餘也); 【燼】 (zinH) (_noun-like_) cinder, embers

zeon6.text: U+76E1 尽 䀆 (F2.54 盡) 空也竭也終也悉也 (F2.54 尽) 同上 (Page 602 #16: 盡(6)尽(6)) An empty vessel (Kangxi 盡: 器中空也); to exhaust, to use all (Kangxi 盡: 竭也); ~~to indulge, as one's grief;~~ a quantity used up, a work brought to an end; made an end of (Kangxi 盡: 止也, 終也), as life; finished, achieved, empty, exhausted; all, entirely, fully, wholly (Kangxi 盡: 悉也); to do to the utmost, with the whole of; a superlative, the uttermost, extreme; _tsun(6) (5)ngo (1)sam_ (zeon6 ngo5 sam1 盡我心), obeying with my whole heart; _tsun(6) t(i/)(6) k(o\)m(3) (1)to_ (zeon6 dei6-2 gam3 do1 盡地咁多), there's only so much; _tsun(6) t(i/)(6) ts(o\)(6)_ (zeon6 dei6-2 zou6 盡地做) ~~use it all up then~~ do to the extent possible; _yung(6) tsun(6) (1)sam (1)k(i/)_ (jung6 zeon6 sam1 gei1 用盡心機), employing all my abilities; _(1)k(a/) (4)ts(')oi s(a/)n(3) tsun(6)_ (gaa1 coi4 saan3 zeon6 家財散盡) the whole estate is dissipated; _sh(a/)t(8) ko(3) tsun(6) ts(ut(9)_ (saat3 go3 zeon6 zyut6 殺個盡絕) slew them all; _tsun(6) (ut(9)_ (zeon6 jyut6 盡月) the twelfth month; _tsun(6) (ut(9) (2)p(i/) (5)n(i/)_ (zeon6 jyut6 bei2 nei5 盡月畀你), I'll pay you at the ~~at the~~ month's end; _(2)k(o\)m ts(e/)(6) pat(7) tsun(6)_ (gam2 ze6 bat1 zeon6 感謝不盡) I cannot express all my thanks; _tsun(6) chik(7)_ (zeon6 zik1 盡職) to perform one's official duties fully; _~~(4)hang~~ (4)h(a/)ng tsun(6)_ (haang4 zeon6 行盡) gone through the whole, gone all over; _tsun(6) (1)n(i/) (1)p(o\)_ (zeon6 ni1 bou1 盡呢煲), try this one chance; one chance left; _tsun(6) hai(6) (2)shui tsik(7)_ (zeon6 hai6 seoi2 zik1 盡係水漬) all are water-soaked; _tsz'(6) tsun(6)_ (zi6 zeon6 自盡) put an end to himself; _tsun(6) (4)t(')au_ (zeon6 tau4 盡頭), gone to the end, at the extreme; _(4)m(o\) (4)k(')ung tsun(6)_ (mou4 kung4 zeon6 無窮盡) inexhaustible; _tsun(6) ts(i/)t(8)_ (zeon6 zit3 盡節) died a martyr to chastity. Williams' 行盡: Changed _(4)hang_ (hang4) to vernacular reading _(4)h(a/)ng_ (haang4). 【盡-voiced】 (dzinX) (_verb-like_) to exhaust, to complete 【盡地】 (zeon6 dei6-2) Fully, to the extent possible, all in.

zeon2.text: U+85CE 荩 zeon6 (per 《廣韻》徐刃切) (F2.53 藎) 忠愛曰藎臣 (Page 601 #8: (2)藎) a plant whose roots afford a yellow dye (Kangxi: 藎草一名黃草一名盭草可染黃); ~~to advance constantly~~ advanced, promoted (Kangxi: 藎進也); sincere, as in attachment to (Kangxi: 藎忠愛之篤進進無已也); _(2)tsun (4)shan_ (zeon2 san4 藎臣), or _(1)chung (2)tsun_ (zung1 zeon2 忠藎), a loyal minister. 【藎】 (zinH) (_adjective-like_) promoted, faithful

U+8D10 䝲 賮 赆 (Mainland simplified) zeon6 (per 《廣韻》徐刃切) (F2.53 贐) 送行之禮曰贐 (Page 601 #9: (2)贐) Precious things (Kangxi 賮: 財貨也); presents given to friends going on a journey (Kangxi 賮: 送行財幣也); _(2)tsun (4)(i/)_ (zeon2 ji4 贐儀), parting gifts of ceremony. 【贐】 (zinH) (_noun-like_) travelling-gift

zeon3.text: U+4FCA 㑺 儁 雋 駿 (F2.53 儁) 知過千人 (F2.53 俊) 才過千人 (Page 602 #1: 雋(3) read _Tsui(3)_ (zeoi3); here corrected to _Tsun(3)_ (zeon3) and normalised to 俊) Also ~~read _tsui(3)_ (zeoi3)~~ a hero (Kangxi 雋: 與儁通). (Page 602 #2: 儁(3); here normalised to 俊) Valiant, brave; superior, excelling others in skill or wisdom (Kangxi 儁: 卓特也); to overcome (Kangxi 儁: 得儁曰克, 勝也); unusual, strange (Kangxi 儁: 異也). (Page 602 #3: 俊(3)) Similar to the last (儁) (Kangxi 俊: 與儁...通); superior, remarkable, one of a thousand (Kangxi 俊: 材過千人也 etc.); eminent; _(1)ying tsun(3)_ (jing1 zeon3 英俊) a brave man, a young hero; _(4)kw(')an kwai(3) tsun(3) sau(3)_ (kwan4 gwai3 zeon3 sau3 群季俊秀) all distinguished for accomplishments and beauty. (Page 602 #9: 駿(3); here normalised to 俊) excelling (Kangxi 駿: 與俊同英儁也); Fan Wan entry: The bottom-right component of the headword 儁 is printed with the central horizontal stroke wide and joining onto the two vertical strokes on the sides. Williams' "read _tsui(3)_": This is a mistaken interpretation of Kangxi 將遂切音醉 as being applicable to the "hero" sense (與儁通). It is only applicable to the earlier "pestle" sense (本作檇). 【俊】 (zinH) (_noun-like_) eminent-man (_adjective-like_) eminent

U+5101 (F2.53 儁) 知過千人 (Page 602 #2: 儁(3)) Fan Wan entry: The bottom-right component of the headword 儁 is printed with the central horizontal stroke wide and joining onto the two vertical strokes on the sides.

U+5CFB 駿 (Page 602 #4: 峻(3)) High, lofty, steep, as mountains (Kangxi: 高也, 險也, 大也); impetuous, hasty, stern, severe (Kangxi: 峭也速也嚴急也), as one's temper; _tsun(3) (1)tsai_ (zeon3 zai1 峻劑), a powerful medicine. Fan Wan entry: The headword 峻 is a misprint of 竣. 【峻】 (swinH) (_adjective-like_) lofty

U+6422 May appear as either ⿰扌晉 (assumed here) or ⿰扌晋, depending on the font. 晉 縉 (in 搢紳 spelt 縉紳) 薦 (F2.54 縉) 居官曰縉紳插笏于大帶之間曰縉 (F2.54 搢) 同上 (Page 602 #12: 晉(3)晋(3); here normalised to 搢) to stick (Kangxi 晉: 晉插也), as into a case or about the person; (Page 602 #13: 搢(3)) To stick into, to insert, to tuck (Kangxi: 插也); to put in, as into a socket; to shake (Kangxi: 振也). ~~Used for the next (縉).~~ (Page 602 #14: 縉(3); here normalised to 搢) ~~to wrap around;~~ ~~to gird, as with a sash;~~ _tsun(3) (1)shan_ (zeon3 san1 搢紳), the "~~red~~ tucking sashes" are the gentry or literati; _tsun(3) (1)shan (4)ts(')(un (1)sh(u_ (zeon3 san1 cyun4 syu1 搢紳全書), the red book; _tsun(3) (1)shan (1)s(i/)n ~~(1)shang~~ (1)sh(a/)ng_ (zeon3 san1 sin1 saang1 搢紳先生), a literary gentleman. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 千 to 于. Williams' "Used for the next": It is the other way round (縉 is used for 搢). Williams' "to wrap around", "to gird": These are incorrect. Here, 縉 is used for 搢, meaning "insert" or "tuck" (Kangxi 縉: 扱也). Williams' 搢紳先生: Changed _(1)shang_ (sang1) to vernacular reading _(1)sh(a/)ng_ (saang1). 【搢】 (tsinH) (_verb-like_) to tuck (in)

U+6649 晋 㬜 (F2.54 晉) 進也又國名又卦名 (F2.54 晋) 同上 (Page 602 #12: 晉(3)晋(3)) To increase, to flourish, to grow, as the sun makes all things (Kangxi 晉: 進也日出萬物進也, 晉進也, 以今釋古古之晉字卽以進長爲義); to curb in a horse (Kangxi 晉: 晉猶抑也); name of a dynasty, divided into the Western and Eastern Tsin, A. D. 265--419; a feudal state (Kangxi 晉: 國名), now the southern part of Sh(a/)ns(i/) (山西). To rise, to promote. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【晉】 (tsinH) (_verb-like_) to advance

U+6D5A 濬 (for "deep", "dig", and proper-name senses) (F2.54 浚) 深也 (F2.54 濬) 同上 (Page 602 #5: 浚(3)濬(3)) Deep, profound (Kangxi 浚: 深也), as water; to dig a channel, to deepen a water-course; deep, serious, as reverence (Kangxi 浚: 稟浚敬也); abstruse; well read; to use part of, to employ (Kangxi 浚: 抒也, 抒取出之也); a district in Hon(a/)n (河南); _tsun(3) (2)tseng_ (zeon3 zeng2 浚井), to deepen a well. Some modern Cantonese dictionaries prescribe the reading seon3 for the proper-name sense of 浚, presumably per 《廣韻》私閏切. To me, it does not make sense for *only* the proper-name sense to get this treatment, when 《廣韻》 also has 私閏切 for 濬, explained 深也. 【浚】 (swinH) (_verb-like_) to scoop (_adjective-like_) deep

U+7468 May appear as either ⿰𤣩晉 (assumed here) or ⿰𤣩晋, depending on the font. (F2.54 瑨) 美石也 (Page 602 #15: 瑨(3)) A pebble or secondary gem (Kangxi: 次玉); a stone which may be considered precious (Kangxi: 美石).
U+756F (F2.54 畯) 田畯治農之官 (Page 602 #7: 畯(3)) An officer who superintended the fields (Kangxi: 農夫也一曰典田官, 田畯田大夫也); a land-office; a husbandman, a peasant. 【畯】 (tswinH) (_noun-like_) farm-overseer

U+7743 zyun1 (per 《集韻》遵全切 for name sense) (F2.54 睃) 明也 (Page 602 #6: 睃(3)) To see (Kangxi: 視也); a man's name (Kangxi: 人名); ~~_Tsun(3) Tsun(3) ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zeon3 zeon3 zoek3 睃晉灼) a hero who lived in the H(a/)n (漢) dynasty.~~ Williams' 睃晉灼: This is a misreading of Kangxi's example, 《前漢諸侯王表》魯文王睃晉灼讀. This example should be punctuated as "魯文王睃。晉灼讀。", with 晉灼讀 indicating that the reading _(1)ts(un_ (zyun1) is the pronunciation of 睃 according to the scholar 晉灼.

U+7AE3 ceon1 (per 《廣韻》七倫切) (F2.53 竣) 退也完也 (Page 602 #8: 竣(3)) To stop work, to finish, to complete a task (Kangxi: 止也); completed, done (Kangxi: 事畢也); to stand still, to wait aside, to retire (Kangxi: 退立也); ~~proud;~~ _k(o\)(3) tsun(3)_ (gou3 zeon3 告竣) to make known the completion; _tsun(3) (1)kung_ (zeon3 gung1 竣工), to finish the work; _sz'(6) tsun(3)_ (si6 zeon3 事竣) the affair is completed. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 峻 to 竣. Williams' "proud": This is a misreading of Kangxi 倨也. Here, 倨 is used for 踞. According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, 倨也 as seen in 《廣韻》 is evidence that the explanation of 竣 should be 居也. 【竣】 (tshwin) (_verb-like_) to stand down, to cease

U+7E09 May appear as either ⿰糹晉 (assumed here) or ⿰糹晋, depending on the font. 缙 (Mainland simplified) (F2.54 縉) 居官曰縉紳插笏于大帶之間曰縉 (F2.54 搢) 同上 (Page 602 #14: 縉(3)) Carnation colored silk (Kangxi: 帛赤色), a light red (Kangxi: 縉淺赤色也);

U+9032 进 (Mainland simplified) (F2.53 進) 登也升也向前去也 (Page 601 #10: 進(3)) To advance, to enter, to go up or on, to get on (Kangxi: 登也, 升也, 前也); to present, to bring forward, to introduce, to promote, to recommend (Kangxi: 薦也); to make progress in (Kangxi: 效也); to come near (Kangxi: 近也); a promotion, an advance; a division of a hong (行); _tsun(3) kung(3)_ (zeon3 gung3 進貢) to bring in tribute; _(1)ch(')o tsun(3) p(o\)(6)_ (co1 zeon3 bou6 初進步) the first step ahead --- to be a si(u/)ts(')(a/)i (秀才); _tsun(3) hok(9)_ (zeon3 hok6 進學) to enter school; _(2)k(i/) tsun(3) (1)sham_ (gei2 zeon3 sam1 幾進深), of how many divistons deep? _tsun(3) t(')(u/)i(3) (5)l(e/)ung (4)n(a/)n_ (zeon3 teoi3 loeng5 naan4 進退兩難), hard to advance or retreat, embarrassed; _tsun(3) (1)shan (1)ch(i/) kai(3)_ (zeon3 san1 zi1 gai3 進身之計) a contrivance to advance one's self; _(1)k(o\) tsun(3)_ (gou1 zeon3 高進) high attainments, as in degrees; _chung(3) tsun(3) sz'(6)_ (zung3 zeon3 si6 中進士) to reach the third literary degree; _tsun(3) (2)fo t(a/)i(3) kat(7)_ (zeon3 fo2 daai3 gat1 進伙帶吉) let prosperity come on the new house --- said when moving into another dwelling; _(5)yan tsun(3)_ (jan5 zeon3 引進) to bring forward; _(5)m(o\) (2)ch(e/)ung tsun(3)_ (mou5 zoeng2 zeon3 冇長進) he makes no headway, he does not improve; _~~(1)ts(i/)n~~ (4)ts(')(i/)n ~~tsun(6)~~ tsun(3)_ (cin4 zeon3 前進) to make progress. Williams' 前進: Corrected _(1)ts(i/)n_ (zin1) to _(4)ts(')(i/)n_ (cin4), and corrected _tsun(6)_ (zeon6) to _tsun(3)_ (zeon3). 【進】 (tsinH) (_verb-like_) to advance, to put forth

U+942B 鎸 镌 (Mainland simplified) zyun1 (per 《廣韻》子泉切) (F2.53 鐫) 雕刻也 (Page 601 #11: 鐫(3)) To engrave, to carve (Kangxi: 一曰琢石也); to cut, to chissel; to censure or degrade an officer (Kangxi: 謫也 etc.); _(1)san tsun(3)_ (san1 zeon3 新鐫) a new edition, as of blocks; _tsun(3) k(')ap(7)_ (zeon3 kap1 鐫級) to reduce an officer in rank; _tsun(3) shek(9)_ (zeon3 sek6 鐫石) to cut in stone, as an epitaph. Fan Wan entry: The bottom-right component of the headword 鐫 is printed with the central horizontal stroke wide and joining onto the two vertical strokes on the sides.

U+96CB (F2.53 雋) 永也味之長也 (Page 602 #1: 雋(3)) Fan Wan entry: The bottom component of the headword 雋 is printed with the central horizontal stroke wide and joining onto the two vertical strokes on the sides.

U+9915 May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 馂 (Mainland simplified) (F2.54 餕) 食餘物也 (Page 602 #11: 餕(3)) Hot food (Kangxi: 熟食也); to eat the remnants of an offering (Kangxi: 祭畢食神之餘) or a meal (Kangxi: 凡食人之餘及日晚食饌之餘皆云餕); the leavings on the table (Kangxi: 食之餘也). 【餕】 (tswinH) (_noun-like_) leftover

U+99FF 骏 (Mainland simplified) (F2.54 駿) 良馬 (Page 602 #9: 駿(3)) A steed, a stately, fine horse (Kangxi: 馬之美稱); dignified, majestic; large (Kangxi: 大也); rapid (Kangxi: 速也, 駿者猶迅也, 駿疾也); _tsun(3) f(a/)t(8)_ (zeon3 faat3 駿發) quick, as in getting rich. 【駿】 (tswinH) (_noun-like_) steed (_adverb-like_) rapidly (_adjective-like_) grand, lofty

zeon6.text: U+5C3D (F2.54 盡) 空也竭也終也悉也 (F2.54 尽) 同上 (Page 602 #16: 盡(6)尽(6))

zi1.text: U+5431 (Page 38|n81 #5: (1)吱) A colloquial final, like 咯 _lok(8)_ (lok3) expressing certainty; or that an act was immaterial; _(2)k(o\)m tsau(6) (2)h(o\) (1)ch(i/)_ (gam2 zau6 hou2 zi1 噉就好吱), then he would be well off; _(1)ch(i/) (1)ch(i/) hai(6)_ (zi1 zi1 hai6 吱吱係) certainly so.

U+54A8 諮 (for "consultation" senses) 谘 (Mainland simplified for "consultation" senses) (F2.34 諮) 詢也 (F2.34 咨) 咨嗟咨謀 (Page 611 #12: (1)咨) To deliberate, to plan, to consult (Kangxi: 謀事曰咨, 咨謀也); to state or ask in writing; a document, a dispatch between equals in rank; an interjection, ah, oh! (Kangxi: 嗟咨𨲠也, 咨嗟也) to sigh; _(1)tsz' (4)man_ (zi1 man4 咨文), an official paper; _(4)ho (4)wai (1)tsz' (1)ts(e/)_ (ho4 wai4 zi1 ze1 何為咨嗟), why do you lament so? _(4)(i/) (1)tsz'_ (ji4 zi1 移咨) to send a dispatch. (Page 611 #13: (1)諮) Used for the last (咨) (Kangxi 諮: 與咨同). To deliberate, to consult, to devise a way (Kangxi 諮: 謀也); to ask about (Kangxi 諮: 問也). 【咨】 (tsij) (_verb-like_) to consult (_interjection_) sigh

U+59FF (F2.34 姿) 姿稟形態也 (Page 612 #1: (1)姿) Manner, gait, form, carriage, air (Kangxi: 態也); beautiful, graceful; agreeable parts; natural endowments; _(1)fung (1)tsz'_ (fung1 zi1 丰姿) a fine figure, shapely; _(1)tsz' shik(7)_ (zi1 sik1 姿色) a beauty; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)tsz' kwok(8) shik(7)_ (tin1 zi1 gwok3 sik1 天姿國色) a beauty who can overthrow a state, like Y(a/)ng Kwei-fei (楊貴妃) of the T(')(a/)ng (唐) dynasty.

U+5B5C 孳 孶 (F2.34 孜) 汲也勤也勉也 (Page 611 #1: (1)孶) unwearied, repeated, diligent, in which it is the same as the next (孜) (Kangxi 孳: 與孜同); (Page 611 #2: (1)孜) Unceasing, unwearied effort, untiring diligence (Kangxi: 一曰力篤愛也勤也); self-denying attachment; _(1)tsz' (1)tsz' (4)wai sh(i/)n(6)_ (zi1 zi1 wai4 sin6 孜孜為善) ever striving to be good. 【孜】 (tsi) (_adjective-like_) industrious

U+5B73 孶 (F2.34 孳) 生息也亦作孜 (Page 611 #1: (1)孶; here normalised to 孳) To bear, to produce (Kangxi 孳: 孳息也); to suckle, to nourish, said of animals; to grow, to increase (Kangxi 孳: 汲汲生也); ardent, affectionate, loving; strong love, like a mother's; _(1)tsz' sik(7)_ (zi1 sik1 孳息) to bear young; _m(a/)n(6) mat(9) (1)tsz' (1)shang_ (maan6 mat6 zi1 sang1 萬物孳生), all things gradually multiply. 【孳-level】 (tsi) (_verb-like_) to breed, to multiply

zi6.text: U+5B73 孶 Transformation(?) of the breast (during pregnancy?) (Kangxi: 乳化也). 【孳-departing】 (dziH) (_verb-like_) to mammarise

zi1.text: U+5B76 (F2.34 孳) 生息也亦作孜 (Page 611 #1: (1)孶)

U+5DF5 卮 (F1.36 巵) 酒杯 (Page 38|n81 #9: (1)巵) A goblet (Kangxi: 圜器也); a cup holding four gills (Kangxi: 巵酒器也受四升); ~~a syphon;~~ ~~a vessel for serving rations;~~ _(2)tsau (1)ch(i/)_ (zau2 zi1 酒巵)~~, a wine syphon~~. Williams' "a vessel for serving rations": This is a misreading of Kangxi 所以節飮食. Here, 節飮食 is the moderation of consumption for self-cultivation, rather than the rationing of food/drink due to limited resources. 【巵】 (tsye) (_noun-like_) goblet

U+652F (F1.36 支) 持也分也又支离又支干又宗支 (Page 38|n81 #4: (1)支) To branch, to diverge; ~~to hold;~~ to give, to pay; to prop, to succor (Kangxi: 持也, 支拄也); a branch; posterity, descendants; a sept or tribe; to attend to; to bear up, to stand firm; diverging, parting (Kangxi: 一曰分也); the twelve horary characters (Kangxi: 十二支辰名); ~~to measure;~~ the 65th radical (U+2F40 ⽀ "branch"); _(1)p(a/)u (1)ch(i/)_ (baau1 zi1 包支), responsible for; _(1)ch(i/) ~~(1)kang~~ (1)k(a/)ng_ (zi1 gaang1 支更), a watchman; _yat(9) (1)chung (1)ch(i/) yung(6)_ (jat6 zung1 zi1 jung6 日中支用) daily outlays and expenses; _(1)ch(i/) k(')ap(7)_ (zi1 kap1 支給) to give out; _(1)ch(i/) (1)kung (4)ngan_ (zi1 gung1 ngan4 支工銀), to pay wages; _(1)ch(i/) (4)l(i/)_ (zi1 lei4 支離), irrelevant, not to the point, a liar; _(1)ch(i/) (1)si(u/)_ (zi1 siu1 支消), to expend, use for expenses; _(1)ch(i/) p(')(a/)i(3)_ (zi1 paai3 支派) descendants, a tribe; _(4)w(a/)ng (1)ch(i/)_ (waang4 zi1 橫支), a side branch, a concubine's child. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 千 to 干. Williams' 支更: Corrected _(1)kang_ (gang1) to _(1)k(a/)ng_ (gaang1). To reckon (Kangxi: 支猶計也). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【支】 (tsye) (_noun-like_) branch, limb (_verb-like_) to support (_verb-like_) to pay (for) (_verb-like_) to reckon

U+679D (F1.36 枝) 枝幹 (Page 38|n81 #6: (1)枝) A branch (Kangxi: 木別生條也), a twig; a slender post; to scatter, to branch off (Kangxi: 散也); a tributary of a river (Kangxi: 水別于他水入于大水及海者命曰枝水); a classifier of slender things, as pencils, flowers, pens, &c.; _(1)ch(i/) kon(3)_ (zi1 gon3 枝幹) trunk and branches; _yat(7) (1)ch(i/) (1)f(a/)_ (jat1 zi1 faa1 一枝花), a flower, a pretty girl; _yat(7) (1)ch(i/) (1)kwan_ (jat1 zi1 gwan1 一枝軍), a detachment of troops; _pok(8) (1)ch(i/)_ (bok3 zi1 駁枝), to graft; _(1)ch(i/) (i/)p(9)_ (zi1 jip6 枝葉) branches and leaves; _(1)s(un (1)ch(i/)_ (syun1 zi1 酸枝), Chinese ebony; _(1)sh(a/)n (1)ch(i/)_ (saan1 zi1 山枝), wild _(1)s(un-(1)ch(i/)_ (酸枝) wood, a hard timber. Williams' "pencils": In the (now) dated sense of a brush. 【枝】 (tsye) (_noun-like_) branch (_classifier_)

U+6894 栀 (F1.36 梔) 梔子核可染物 (Page 39|n82 #1: (1)梔) A tree used to dye yellow, a species of Gardenia (Kangxi: 黃木可染); _(4)wong (1)ch(i/)_ (wong4 zi1 黃梔), the becho nut, used in dyeing, and as a medicine in fevers. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𣑱 to 染.

U+6DC4 湽 甾 (F2.34 淄) 黑色水名又臨淄齊地也 (Page 611 #4: (1)淄) A river in the northeast of Sh(a/)ntung (山東) (Kangxi: 水名) flowing into the sea; _(1)Tsz' (1)ch(')(un_ (zi1 cyun1 淄川), a district in Sh(a/)ntung (山東); a dark color (Kangxi: 黑色曰淄). Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》側持切.

U+6ECB May appear as either ⿰氵兹 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰氵茲 (+10), depending on the font. 兹 茲 (F2.34 滋) 潤也益也 (Page 610 #7: (1)滋) ~~Occurs used for the last (茲);~~ sweet, pleasant, rich (Kangxi: 滋味也); humid, soft; to increase, to grow (Kangxi: 蒔也長也益也); to enrich, to moisten, to fertilize; to rise, to overflow; moisture, juices, sap (Kangxi: 液也); numerous, many (Kangxi: 多也蕃也); muddy (Kangxi: 濁也); _(1)tsz' sz'(6)_ (zi1 si6 滋事) to get up a row, to make trouble, to embroil; _(1)tsz' m(a/)n(6)_ (zi1 maan6 滋蔓) a sprouting tendril; something left, as of a seditious band; _(2)h(o\) (1)tsz' m(i/)(6)_ (hou2 zi1 mei6 好滋味) a fine flavor; _(1)tsz' yun(6)_ (zi1 jeon6 滋潤) to mollify, to increase the juices; _(1)tsz' (2)p(o\)_ (zi1 bou2 滋補), to strengthen, as a tonic; _(1)tsz' (2)i(u/)_ (zi1 jiu2 滋擾), to make trouble, to provoke. Williams' "used for the last": This is a misreading of Kangxi 通作兹, (which indicates that 兹 can be written 滋, not the other way round). 【滋】 (tsi) (_verb-like_) to grow (_verb-like_) to breed, to multiply (_adjective-like_) numerous, abundant (_noun-like_) fine-flavour
U+753E (Page 611 #6: (1)甾(1)菑) Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》側持切.

U+77E5 (F1.35 知) 覺也識也明也 (Page 37|n80 #7: (1)知) To know, to perceive, to apprehend (Kangxi: 識也覺也, 喩也); to be acquainted with (Kangxi: 相交曰知); to tell, to inform; a fellow, a friend (Kangxi: 匹也); knowledge, (...); to remember (Kangxi: 猶記憶也); _(1)ch(i/) kwo(3) p(i/)t(7) (2)koi_ (zi1 gwo3 bit1 goi2 知過必改), reform when you know your wrong; _(4)man (1)ch(i/)_ (man4 zi1 聞知), I heard so; _(4)shui (1)ch(i/)_ (seoi4 zi1 誰知), unexpected, who would have thought it? _k(u/)(3) (1)ch(i/)_ (gu3 zi1 故知), an old friend; _(1)ch(i/) (1)t(i/)_ (zi1 di1 知啲), I know a little; _(1)ch(i/) (2)k(i/) (4)p(')ang (5)yau_ (zi1 gei2 pang4 jau5 知己朋友), an intimate friend; _(1)s(i/)n (1)ch(i/)_ (sin1 zi1 先知), a prophet; _(1)ch(i/) t(o\)(6)_ (zi1 dou6-3 知道) I know it; the thing is known; _(1)ch(i/) (2)hi(u/)_ (zi1 hiu2 知曉), to understand; _(1)ch(i/) kok(8)_ (zi1 gok3 知覺) to notice; _(1)ch(i/) t(o\)(6) hai(6) (2)k(o\)m_ (zi1 dou6-3 hai6 gam2 知道係噉), I know it is so; _(4)(i/)m (1)ch(i/) sz'(6)_ (jim4 zi1 si6 鹽知事) a salt commissioner; _(1)ch(i/) (2)f(u/)_ (zi1 fu2 知府), a prefect; _(1)ch(i/) (1)fung_ (zi1 fung1 知風), aware of; _(1)ch(i/) tsuk(7)_ (zi1 zuk1 知足) contented; _pat(7) (1)ch(i/) (2)tai sai(3)_ (bat1 zi1 dai2 sai3 不知底細) I do not know its history. Williams' 知覺: Now "consciousness". 【知】 (trje) (_verb-like_) to know

U+7957 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. zi2 (per Fan Wan) (F1.39 祗 _(2)Ch(i/)_ (zi2)) 敬也但也又音其 (Page 40|n83 #1: (2)祗 _(2)Ch(i/)_ (zi2); here normalised to _(1)Ch(i/)_ (zi1)) To respect, to invocate; respect, awe, reverence (Kangxi: 敬也); _~~(2)ch(i/)~~ (1)ch(i/) king(3)_ (zi1 ging3 祗敬) to venerate. 【祗】 (tsyij) (_verb-like_) to reverence

zi2.text: U+7957 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.39 祗) 敬也但也又音其 (Page 40|n83 #1: (2)祗) This character is easily confused with 祇 (see 祇 zi2).

zi1.text: U+7DC7 𱹼 缁 (Mainland simplified) (Page 611 #5: (1)緇) Dark colored silk (Kangxi: 帛黑色, 緇謂之皁), dyed many times (Kangxi: 七入爲緇, 緅又復再染以黑乃成緇矣); the dark color of a sediment (Kangxi: 緇滓也泥緇黑色者曰滓此色然也); black (Kangxi: 緇黑色); _(1)tsz' (1)(i/)_ (zi1 ji1 緇衣), black garments. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》側持切. Fan Wan entry: The headword 緇 is a misprint of 輜. 【緇】 (tsri) (_noun-like_) black-silk (_adjective-like_) black

U+80A2 胑 (F1.36 肢) 四肢 (Page 38|n81 #7: (1)肢) The limbs (Kangxi: 體四胑也); _sz'(3) (1)ch(i/)_ (sei3 zi1 四肢), the four limbs; _(1)ch(i/) (2)t(')ai_ (zi1 tai2 肢體), the whole body; _(1)ch(i/) (2)k(a/)i_ (zi1 gaai2 肢解), to quarter. 【肢】 (tsye) (_noun-like_) limb
U+80FE (F2.34 胾) 切肉曰胾 (Page 611 #3: (1)胾)

zi3.text: U+80FE zi1 (per Fan Wan) (F2.34 胾 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1)) 切肉曰胾 (Page 611 #3: (1)胾 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1); here normalised to _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3)) To cut up meat into steaks or morsels for eating (Kangxi: 大臠也, 切肉曰胾); slices, steaks, bits of meat. 【胾】 (tsriH) (_noun-like_) chunked-meat

zi1.text: U+8102 (F1.36 脂) 膏也又胭脂 (Page 38|n81 #8: (1)脂) Grease, suet, lard, fat (Kangxi: 戴角者脂無角者膏); hard gums of trees; _met._ honors, glory (Kangxi: 以喩榮祿也); to grease (Kangxi: 用以利物曰脂); fat animals; _(1)(i/)n (1)ch(i/)_ (jin1 zi1 胭脂), rouge (Kangxi: 燕脂以紅藍花汁凝脂爲之 etc.); _(4)man (1)ch(i/)_ (man4 zi1 民脂), the fat of the people, _i. e._ their money; _(1)ch(i/) (1)k(o\)_ (zi1 gou1 脂膏), greasy, unctuous; _(4)y(e/)ung (1)ch(i/)_ (joeng4 zi1 羊脂), mutton tallow; _(1)ch(i/) (2)fan_ (zi1 fan2 脂粉), cosmetics. 【脂】 (tsyij) (_noun-like_) grease, fat

U+829D (F1.35 芝) 芝蔴又芝蘭 (Page 38|n81 #3: (1)芝) A sort of boletus or branched mushroom, regarded as felicitous (Kangxi: 神草也) from its durability; _(1)ch(i/) (4)m(a/)_ (zi1 maa4 芝麻), sesamum; _(1)ch(i/) (4)l(a/)n_ (zi1 laan4 芝蘭), a sort of fragrant epidendrum; _(1)ch(i/) (4)ng(a/)n_ (zi1 ngaan4 芝顏), your fine face; _(1)ch(i/) (4)l(a/)n (1)ch(i/) shat(7)_ (zi1 laan4 zi1 sat1 芝蘭之室) an elegant house, as of the genii; _met._ intimate with good men. 【芝士】 (zi1 si6-2) Cheese. The spelling 芝士 is arbitrary (but well established).

U+83D1 甾 䎩 葘 (F2.34 菑) 田一歲曰菑始反草也 (Page 611 #6: (1)甾(1)菑) ~~Waste, untilled land, overgrown, jungly (Kangxi 菑: 不耕田也);~~ to clear new or waste land; ground under cultivation one year (Kangxi 菑: 田一歲曰葘); to open a road; Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》側持切. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 革 to 草. 【菑-level】 (tsri) (_noun-like_) new-tillage (_verb-like_) to till newly

zi3.text: U+83D1 葘 (Page 611 #6: ~~(1)甾~~(1)菑 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(3)_ and _Tsz'(3)_ (zi3)) to cut, to rend (Kangxi 菑: 剖也裂也); a dead tree still standing (Kangxi 菑: 木立死曰葘). In terms of pre-merger readings: The "dead-tree" sense is _ch(i/)(3)_ per Kangxi 側吏切; and The "cut/rend" sense is _tsz'(3)_ per Kangxi 資四切. 【菑-departing】 (tsriH) (_noun-like_) standing-dead-tree

zoi1.text: U+83D1 (F2.43 災) 災禍災害 (F2.43 灾) 同上 (F2.43 烖) 同上 (F2.43 菑) 古灾字又音兹

zi1.text: U+8718 鼅 䵹 (F1.35 蜘) 蜘蛛 (Page 38|n81 #1: (1)蜘) A spider (Kangxi: 蜘蛛); _(1)ch(i/) (1)ch(u_ (zi1 zyu1 蜘蛛), a spider, a general name for all kinds of aranea. 【蜘】 (trje) Used in 蜘蛛. 【蜘蛛】 (trje trju) (_noun-like_) spider
U+8AEE (F2.34 諮) 詢也 (F2.34 咨) 咨嗟咨謀 (Page 611 #13: (1)諮)

U+8CB2 May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. 訾 赀 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 貲) 財也貨也 (Page 611 #9: (1)貲) A fine paid to redeem one's self (Kangxi: 小罰以財自贖也); riches, goods, wealth (Kangxi: 財也貨也); _(1)tsz' (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zi1 cin4 貲錢), money; _(1)tsz' (4)ts(')oi_ (zi1 coi4 貲財), property; _(1)k(a/) (1)tsz'_ (gaa1 zi1 家貲) family possessions. To estimate, to measure (Kangxi: 與訾同).

U+8CC7 貲 齎 资 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 資) 資財資藉 (Page 611 #9: (1)貲) Used for the next (資). (Page 611 #10: (1)資) Property, riches, things of value (Kangxi: 貨也); necessaries, articles wanted; a fee, a douceur, a treat, a present; to take or to utilise (Kangxi: 資取也); to depend on another; what belongs to one, what is natural, as disposition; what was had at the first; _(2)tsau (1)tsz'_ (zau2 zi1 酒資) or _(1)pan (1)tsz'_ (ban1 zi1 檳資) postage; _(1)h(e/)ung (1)tsz'_ (hoeng1 zi1 香資) a subscription to a festival or to build a temple; _(1)tsz' (2)p(u/)n_ (zi1 bun2 資本), capital; _(1)tsz' (2)f(u/)_ (zi1 fu2 資斧), necessary things, as for a journey; _(1)tsz' k(a/)k(8)_ (zi1 gaak3 資格) talents, capabilities, said of officers; _(1)tsz' chat(7)_ (zi1 zat1 資質) natural disposition; a habit; _(4)m(o\) tik(7) (1)tsz' tsik(9)_ (mou4 dik1 zi1 zik6 無滴資藉) without any sources or dependence. ~~Occurs used for the next (漬).~~ Williams' 酒資, 檳資: Very dated. Williams' 資格: Now "eligibility". To accumulate. To supply, to aid. 資敵 (zi1 dik6): "Supply the enemy." 資助 (zi1 zo6): "Subsidise." 【資】 (tsij) (_noun-like_) means, capital, (_met._) capability (_noun-like_) expense (_verb-like_) to utilise (_verb-like_) to depend (upon) (_verb-like_) to accumulate (_verb-like_) to supply
U+8D91 趦 (F2.34 趦) 趦趄行不進也 (Page 612 #3: (1)趑) Unable to advance (Kangxi: 趑趄行不進也, 趑趄難行也), either from fear or disability; to go awry; _(1)tsz' (1)ts(u_ (zi1 zeoi1 趑趄), impeded.
U+8DA6 (F2.34 趦) 趦趄行不進也

U+8F1C 輺 辎 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 輜) 車屬 (Page 611 #7: (1)輜) ~~treasure wagons, or such as carry arms and spoil;~~ large wagons with places for sleeping and carrying stores (Kangxi: 輜車載輜重臥息其中之車也); ~~manure carts;~~ _(1)tsz' chung(6)_ (zi1 zung6 輜重) baggage wagons of an army. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》側持切. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 緇 to 輜. Williams' "manure carts": This is a misreading of Kangxi 厠也. Here, 厠 means "mingled", not "toilet".

zi3.text: U+8F1C 菑 葘 輺 辎 (Mainland simplified) (Page 611 #6: ~~(1)甾~~(1)菑 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3)) Occurs used for the next (輜). (Page 611 #7: (1)輜 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3)) ~~End of the axle within~~ Spokes going into the nave (Kangxi: 車輻入牙曰輜, 與葘通, 葘謂輻入轂中者也);

zi1.text: U+9319 鍿 锱 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 錙) 耕田之器又錙銖 (Page 611 #8: (1)錙) A weight equal to six _(1)ch(u_ (zyu1) 銖 (Kangxi: 六銖也) or the fourth part of a tael (両), not now in use; _(1)tsz' (1)ch(u_ (zi1 zyu1 錙銖), a little trifle, a mere penny, a mite. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(1)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》側持切. 【錙】 (tsri) (_noun-like_) ounce

U+93A1 May appear as either ⿰釒兹 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰釒茲 (+10), depending on the font. 镃 (Mainland simplified) (F2.34 鎡) 鋤頭之屬 (Page 610 #9: (1)鎡) A hoe ~~for removing weeds~~, called _(1)tsz' (1)k(i/)_ (zi1 gei1 鎡基) (Kangxi: 鎡錤鉏也), having a long narrow blade. 【鎡】 (tsi) Used in 鎡基. 【鎡基】 (tsi ki) (_noun-like_) hoe

U+9AED May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. 頾 頿 (F2.34 髭) 鬚也在下曰鬚在上曰髭 (Page 612 #5: (1)髭) The mustaches (Kangxi: 口上須也), which the Chinese wear long; ~~beautiful, good-looking;~~ _(1)tsz' (1)s(o\)_ (zi1 sou1 髭鬚), the mustaches. Williams' "beautiful, good-looking": This is misreading Kangxi 《釋名》髭姿也爲姿容之美也 as a standalone definition, when it is intended as a near-homophony-definition of the "moustache" sense. 【髭】 (tsje) (_noun-like_) moustache

U+9F12 鎡 (F2.34 鼒) 小鼎 (Page 612 #6: (1)鼒) A small round tripod (Kangxi: 小鼎也); a round lidded or covered ~~of a~~ tripod (Kangxi: 鼎之圜掩上者). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 𪔇 to 鼒. 【鼒】 (tsi) (_noun-like_) small-tripod-cauldron

zi2.text: U+54AB (F1.39 咫) 咫尺八寸曰咫 (Page 40|n83 #2: (2)咫) An ancient short cubit of 8 _ts(')(un_ (寸) (Kangxi: 中婦人手長八寸謂之咫周尺也), ~~same as~~ similar to an English foot; small degree of (Kangxi: 咫言少也); _(2)ch(i/) ch(')ek(8) (1)ch(i/) t(i/)(6)_ (zi2 cek3 zi1 dei6 咫尺之地) a little way, a small interval. Fan Wan entry: Corrected (second) 尺 to 寸. Williams' "same as an English foot": Similar, but not exactly the same. From Williams' entry for 丈 zoeng6, he effectively puts the _ch(')ek_ 尺 at 14.1 inches. 80% of this is 11.28 inches, which is somewhat short of an English foot. If we take the _ch(')ek_ 尺 to be 14⅝ inches per the later Ordinance No. 8 of 1885 in British Hong Kong, 80% of this is 11.7 inches, which is close enough to an English foot. Short in distance, near (Kangxi: 咫咫尺閒也).
U+5740 阯 (F1.39 址) 基址 (Page 39|n82 #3: (2)址) A foundation (Kangxi: 基也), fundamental; one's own country or origin; _(1)k(i/) (2)ch(i/)_ (gei1 zi2 基址), a foundation, a base, a dependance. A site.
U+5741 坻 (Page 11* #4: (4)坻 _(4)Ch(')(i/)_ (ci4); here corrected to _(2)Ch(i/)_ (zi2) and normalised to 坁) to stop (Kangxi 坻: 止也).

U+59CA 姉 (F2.35 姊) 姐也女之長者曰姊 (Page 613 #2: (2)姊) An elder sister (Kangxi 姉: 男子謂女子先生爲姉); a school-mistress; _(2)tsz' m(u/)i(6)_ (zi2 mui6-2 姊妹) sisters; it sometimes includes all the children, as _p(a/)t(8) (2)tsz' m(u/)i(6)_ (baat3 zi2 mui6-2 八姊妹) eight of us in all; _t(a/)i(6) (2)tsz'_ (daai6 zi2 大姊) an elder sister; _ts(')at(7) (2)tsz' m(u/)i(6)_ (cat1 zi2 mui6 七姊妹) a sort of rose; a kind of snake. 【姊】 (tsijX) (_noun-like_) elder-sister

U+5B50 㜽 (F2.35 子) 子嗣子息子者人之嘉稱故凡有德者稱之曰君子 (Page 612 #7: (2)子) A son (Kangxi: 男子之通稱), anciently it meant a child (Kangxi: 女子亦稱子); a boy, a lad, a person; an heir, posterity, issue (Kangxi: 息也嗣也); interest on money; seeds of plants; a sage, a philosopher, a venerable and worthy man (Kangxi: 子者人之嘉稱故凡成德謂之君子 etc.); Confucius; you, Sir, a term of address~~, somewhat like comrades~~; a degree of nobility, a viscount (Kangxi: 公侯伯子男凡五等); the first of the twelve stems, denoted by the rat; the third watch, from 11 P. M. to 1 A. M.; ~~the people, in distinction from their prince;~~ a spot, as of dirt or on dice; added to many nouns, it indicates that they are smaller than others of the same sort; the 39th radical (U+2F26 ⼦ "child"); _(2)tsz' (1)s(un_ (zi2 syun1 子孫), children, descendants; _t(')(a/)i(3) (2)tsz'_ (taai3 zi2 太子) the heir-apparent; _(2)tsz' ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zi2 zoek3 子爵) a viscount; _(2)ch(e/)ung (2)tsz'_ (zoeng2 zi2 長子) the eldest son; _(1)sh(u (1)t(a/)i (2)tsz'_ (syu1 daai1 zi2 書獃子) a stupid scholar; _ch(')ik(8) (2)tsz'_ (cik3 zi2 赤子) an infant; _h(i/)(3) (2)tsz'_ (hei3 zi2 戲子) a play-actor; _h(a/)u(3) (2)tsz'_ (haau3 zi2 孝子) a son in mourning; a dutiful son; _(2)tsz' ~~(4)m(o\)~~ (5)m(o\) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zi2 mou5 cin4 子母錢), cash marked with blood of mother and child; _(1)s(i/)n (2)tsz'_ (sin1 zi2 先子) my deceased father; _(1)f(u/) (2)tsz'_ (fu1 zi2 夫子) a teacher, a rabbi, a sage; _(1)ting (1)h(e/)ung (2)tsz'_ (ding1 hoeng1 zi2 丁香子) best cloves; _(2)si(u/) (2)tsz'_ (siu2 zi2 小子) a boy, a pupil; my lad, my child; _noi(6) (2)tsz'_ (noi6 zi2 內子) my wife; _(1)f(a/) (2)tsz'_ (faa1 zi2 花子) a beggar; _(5)l(o\) (2)tsz'_ (lou5 zi2 老子) father, your father; _long(6) (2)tsz'_ (long6 zi2 浪子) a prodigal son; _(5)y(e/)ung (2)tsz'_ (joeng5 zi2 養子) a foster-child; _(2)tsz' sik(7)_ (zi2 sik1 子息) children; _(1)kung (2)tsz'_ (gung1 zi2 公子) a rich man's son; _(2)ch(e/)ung (2)tsz'_ (zoeng2 zi2 長子) the eldest son. Williams' "the people, ...": This is a misreading of Kangxi 子庶民也. This is an example from 《中庸》, where 子 is a verb (to treat as children). It is *not* a zero-copula statement explaining 子 as 庶民. Williams' 子母錢: Corrected _(4)m(o\)_ (mou4) to _(5)m(o\)_ (mou5). Williams' 長子: Appears twice. 【夫子】 (pju tsiX) (_noun-like_) master 【子】 (tsiX) (_noun-like_) child, son, daughter (_noun-like_) master, (_met._) thou (_noun-like_) numerator (_noun-like_) rat-branch Used in 夫子, 赤子.
U+5E0B (F1.39 紙) 字紙 (F1.39 帋) 帋帛 (Page 39|n82 #11: (2)帋(2)紙) Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰糸氐 to 紙.

U+5FB5 徴 (F1.39 徵) 五音之一 (_music_) The note a perfect fifth (ratio 81:54 = 3:2 per 《史記》 tuning) above 宮 in the olden Chinese pentatonic scale, roughly equivalent to solfege _sol_ (Kangxi: 宮徵也, ...五音配夏). 【徵-rising】 (triX) (_noun-like_) sol

zing1.text: U+5FB5 徴 征 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 徵) 証也明也又徵辟 (Page 19* #1: (1)徵) ~~To act;~~ ~~to set in motion;~~ to witness, to testify; to cite, to summon (Kangxi: 召也); to verify; evidence (Kangxi: 證也明也); to inquire after (Kangxi: 問也); to gather together (Kangxi: 斂也); ~~to aim at;~~ to raise, as troops; to collect, as taxes; fullfilment, proof; _(4)ming (1)ching_ (ming4 zing1 明徵) plain proof; _(4)m(o\) (1)ching_ (mou4 zing1 無徵), no proof; _(1)ching (1)ping_ (zing1 bing1 徵兵), to enlist troops; _kwai(3) (1)ching_ (gwai3 zing1 貴徵), a noble bearing, courteous; to seek a good market; _(5)yau (1)ching_ (jau5 zing1 有徵), proved; _(1)ching chi(u/)(6)_ (zing1 ziu6 徵召) to cite, called upon by government; _(1)ching p(')ing(3)_ (zing1 ping3 徵聘) to induce by a present; _(1)ching (i/)m(6)_ (zing1 jim6 徵驗) accomplished. To seek (Kangxi: 求也). A sign, an omen. 病徵 (beng6 zing1): "Sign of disease." 徵兆 (zing1 siu6): "Omen". The completion-gift (of the marriage rites) (Kangxi: 成也). 【徵-level】 (tring) (_verb-like_) to call, to summon (_verb-like_) to evidence (_verb-like_) to collect (_verb-like_) to seek (_noun-like_) evidence, sign (_noun-like_) completion-gift

zi2.text: U+6307 (F1.39 指) 手指又指示也 (Page 39|n82 #9: (2)指) A finger (Kangxi: 手指也 etc.), a toe (Kangxi: 將指...足大指也); to point, to refer to; ~~to teach, to command~~ to give directions (Kangxi: 指麾也); ~~a particular, a mode;~~ to point out (Kangxi: 示也); _(2)ch(i/) (4)n(a/)m ~~(1)ch(')(e/)~~ (1)k(u_ (zi2 naam4 geoi1 指南車), the ~~compass~~ south-pointing chariot; _shap(9) (2)ch(i/) (4)t(')(a/)n (1)pang_ (sap6 zi2 taan4 bang1 十指彈崩), to snap the fingers in vexation; _(1)m(a/) (2)ch(i/)_ (maa1 zi2 孖指), a double finger; _(2)ch(i/) (2)shau w(a/)k(9) k(e/)uk(8)_ (zi2 sau2 waak6 goek3 指手畫腳) gesticulation; _(2)ch(i/) mong(6)_ (zi2 mong6 指望) to expect; _(4)m(o\) (2)ch(i/) (5)(i/)_ (mou4 zi2 ji5 無指擬), no chance of, cannot obtain; _(2)ch(i/) (1)tung (2)ch(i/) (1)sai_ (zi2 dung1 zi2 sai1 指東指西), pointing this way and that, befooling; _(2)ch(i/) sh(i/)(6)_ (zi2 si6 指示) to point out; _(2)shau (2)ch(i/) (1)kung_ (sau2 zi2 gung1 手指公), the thumb; _shik(9) (2)ch(i/)_ (sik6 zi2 食指), forefinger; _(4)m(o\) (4)ming (2)ch(i/)_ (mou4 ming4 zi2 無名指) ring-finger; _(2)ch(i/) (2)t(i/)m_ (zi2 dim2 指點), to show how; _(2)ch(i/) k(a/)p(8)_ (zi2 gaap3 指甲) a finger nail; _(2)ch(i/) k(a/)p(8) (1)f(a/)_ (zi2 gaap3 faa1 指甲花), the henna _(Lawsonia inermis);_ _(2)ch(i/) shat(9)_ (zi2 sat6 指實) certain, sure. Williams' 指南車: Corrected _(1)ch(')(e/)_ (ce1) to _(1)k(u_ (geoi1). Strictly, this is the south-pointing chariot. The compass is now called 指南針. Williams' 指手畫腳: Figuratively, to make overt criticism, to assume authority and give out orders, etc. To rebuke, to criticise (Kangxi: 斥也). To rely on, to hope for. 【指】 (tsyijX) (_noun-like_) finger (_verb-like_) to point 【尾指】 (mei5-1 zi2) The pinky. 【手指公】 (sau2 zi2 gung1) The thumb. 【手指尾】 (sau2 zi2 mei5-1) The pinky. 【食指】 (sik6 zi2) The index finger. 【指擬】 (zi2 ji5) To rely on. 指擬佢就弊 (zi2 ji5 keoi5 zau6 bai6): "Relying on him we'd be stuffed." To hope for. 唔使指擬買屋 (m4 sai2 zi2 ji5 maai5 uk1): "Needn't bother hoping to buy a house."

U+65E8 恉 (for "intention" senses) 指 (for "intention" and "fine" senses) (F1.39 旨) 意也甘也 (Page 39|n82 #8: (2)旨) Meaning, intention (Kangxi: 意也志也); excellent (Kangxi: 美也); pleasant tasted, delicate; a decretal, orders (Kangxi: 凡天子諭吿臣民曰詔旨下承上曰奉旨); _fung(6) (2)ch(i/)_ (fung6 zi2 奉旨), to receive orders; _(2)ch(i/) (2)tsau_ (zi2 zau2 旨酒), good liquor; _(2)ch(i/) (i/)(3)_ (zi2 ji3 旨意) the import of the imperial will; _shing(3) (2)ch(i/)_ (sing3 zi2 聖旨), H. I. M.'s orders; _(2)ts(')ing (2)ch(i/)_ (cing2 zi2 請旨), to request commands; _yat(7) (1)ch(e/)ung (1)ch(i/) t(a/)i(6) (2)ch(i/)_ (jat1 zoeng1 zi1 daai6 zi2 一章之大旨), an important remark, a synopsis. (Page 39|n82 #9: (2)指) used for the last (旨) (Kangxi 指: 與旨恉通意向也, 歸趣也, 美也); 【旨】 (tsyijX) (_adjective-like_) fine-tasting, fine, excellent (_noun-like_) intent

U+6893 杍 榟 (F2.35 梓) 木名 (Page 612 #10: (2)梓) A sort of tree (Kangxi: 楸也), considered to be the best of all trees (Kangxi: 梓爲百木長故呼梓爲木王 etc.) (a sort of cedar?); to cut blocks for books (Kangxi: 俗謂鋟文書於板曰梓); one's village; _(2)tsz' (5)l(i/)_ (zi2 lei5 梓里), my village; _(1)song (2)tsz'_ (song1 zi2 桑梓) one's birthplace; _(2)tsz' (4)hang_ (zi2 hang4 梓行), printed by ....; ~~_(2)tsz' (4)t(')(a/)n_ (zi2 taan4 梓檀), a solid kind of black wood.~~ Williams' 梓檀: Should probably be 紫檀. Woodwork (Kangxi: 治木器曰梓). 【梓】 (tsiX) (_noun-like_) catalpa

U+6B62 (F1.39 止) 息也定也但也 (Page 39|n82 #2: (2)止) To stop (Kangxi: 停也足也); to lodge, to dwell (Kangxi: 居也), to rest (Kangxi: 息也); that which the mind rests in (Kangxi: 心之所安爲止), an object (Kangxi: 止者必至於是而不遷之謂); ~~to detain;~~ interrupted, stopped (Kangxi: 已也); to cease from, to desist, to be still (Kangxi: 靜也, 不妄動也); to remain, to wait; the 77th radical (U+2F4C ⽌ "stop") of characters mostly relating to rest; _(1)ch(i/) (2)ch(i/)_ (zi1 zi2 知止) to know when to stop; _(2)ch(i/) pat(7) ch(u(6)_ (zi2 bat1 zyu6 止不住) will not stop, cannot be stopped; _(2)ch(i/) n(o\)(6)_ (zi2 nou6 止怒) to appease; _(2)ch(i/) suk(7)_ (zi2 suk1 止宿) to lodge at; _(4)m(o\) (2)tai (2)ch(i/)_ (mou4 dai2 zi2 無底止), nothing to stop at. Williams' "to detain": Either a poor rendering of Kangxi 留也 or a misreading of Kangxi 凡戰而被獲曰止. To keep (Kangxi: 留也). To be captured in battle (Kangxi: 凡戰而被獲曰止). Demeanour, bearing (Kangxi: 容止). Behaviour (Kangxi: 舉止). A mallet used for a certain musical instrument (Kangxi: 所以鼓柷謂之止, 止者其椎名也). Speech-assist (Kangxi: 語辭), specifically a final particle. 【止】 (tsyiX) (_verb-like_) to halt, to cease, to rest, to stay (_noun-like_) deportment (_speech-assist_)

U+6C9A (F1.39 沚) 沼也 (Page 39|n82 #4: (2)沚) An islet (Kangxi: 小渚曰沚); to take up one's lodging on an island (Kangxi: 止息也可以止息其上); _(2)chi(u/) (2)ch(i/)_ (ziu2 zi2 沼沚), an islet in a pond. 【沚】 (tsyiX) (_noun-like_) islet

U+6CF2 zai2 (per 《集韻》子禮切) zai3 (common) (F2.35 泲) 水名 (Page 613 #3: (2)泲) Name of a river on the east of China (Kangxi: 泲沇也東流於海); to strain spirits (Kangxi: 莤泲釃酒也); ~~a strainer made of plants.~~ Kangxi has 《玉篇》古文濟字. The common reading zai3 in departing tone is probably a result of using the wrong reading of 濟. The reading of 濟 corresponding to the proper-name sense is rising-tone 子禮切 _(2)tsai_ (zai2).

U+6ED3 zi1 (per Kangxi 又平聲...滓音湽) zoi2 (common) (F2.35 滓) 洒滓渣滓 (Page 613 #1: (2)滓) Sediments, dregs (Kangxi: 澱也); _chap(7) (2)tsz'_ (zap1 zi2 汁滓) grains from spirits; _(1)ch(a/) (2)tsz'_ (zaa1 zi2 渣滓) grounds, residuum, dregs; _(4)nai (2)tsz'_ (nai4 zi2 泥滓) muddy settlings. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(2)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》阻史切. The common reading zoi2 (after the phonetic 宰) is considered unlearned; I have not yet encountered a dictionary that records it.

U+7947 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 152 #7: (4)祇 _(4)K(')(i/)_ (kei4); _(2)Ch(i/)_ (zi2) implied) This character is easily confused with 祗 (see 祗 zi2).

U+7949 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. ci2 (per 《廣韻》敕里切) (F1.39 祉) 福祉 (Page 39|n82 #5: (2)祉) Happiness (Kangxi: 福也); _fuk(7) (2)ch(i/)_ (fuk1 zi2 福祉), blessed, happy, enduring felicity; _(1)k(a/) (2)ch(i/)_ (gaa1 zi2 嘉祉), good fortune. 【祉】 (trhiX) (_noun-like_) blessing, felicity

U+79ED (F2.35 秭) 數也十億曰兆十兆曰京十京曰秭 (Page 613 #4: (2)秭) A stack of corn; ~~to number;~~ ~~the ninth place in notation, a hundred millions;~~ a weight of 640 peculs (Kangxi: 六萬四千斤也). Williams' "to number": This is a misreading of Kangxi 數也. Here, 數 is a noun (departing), not a verb (rising). Williams' "ninth place ...": By "ninth place in notation", Williams intends 10<sup>8</sup>, which is incorrect. Here, Williams has been misled by Fan Wan's progression (億兆京秭), which is missing 垓 before 秭. A large number (Kangxi: 數也). Based on the progression 億兆京垓秭 etc., one of the following: 10<sup>9</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>5</sup> and going up by factors of 10); 10<sup>12</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>8</sup> and going up by factors of 10); 10<sup>24</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>8</sup> and going up by factors of 10<sup>4</sup>); 10<sup>128</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>8</sup> and going up by squares). 【秭】 (tsijX) (_noun-like_) haystack

U+7D19 帋 纸 (Mainland simplified) (F1.39 紙) 字紙 (F1.39 帋) 帋帛 (Page 39|n82 #11: (2)帋(2)紙) Paper (Kangxi 紙: 絮一苫也 etc.); a document; _yat(7) (1)ch(e/)ung (2)ch(i/)_ (jat1 zoeng1 zi2 一張紙), a sheet of paper; _(1)sh(a/) (2)ch(i/)_ (saa1 zi2 紗紙), wrapping paper; _(2)ts(')(o\) (2)ch(i/)_ (cou2 zi2 草紙), coarse paper; _(2)ch(i/) (4)m(u/)i_ (zi2 mui4 紙煤), a paper match; _(2)ch(i/) (1)t(')ung (1)f(a/)_ (zi2 tung1 faa1 紙蓪花), artificial flowers; _(2)ch(i/) (4)p(')(a/)i_ (zi2 paai4-2 紙牌), cards; _(2)ch(i/) p(a/)k(9)_ (zi2 baak6 紙帛) paper houses and clothes burned in sacrifices; _(1)king (un(6) (2)ch(i/)_ (ging1 jyun6 zi2 ？？紙), cotton paper; _(1)kai (4)p(')(i/) (2)ch(i/)_ (gai1 pei4 zi2 雞皮紙), brown wrapping paper; _(2)ch(i/) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (zi2 cin4 紙錢), scolloped pieces of paper used at funerals to buy the road; _(4)f(a/)n (2)ch(i/)_ (faan4 zi2 幡紙), sized paper; _(5)l(a/)ng (1)kam (1)ts(i/)n (2)ch(i/)_ (laang5 gam1 zin1 zi2 冷金箋紙), gold dusted paper; _king(3) sik(7) tsz'(6) (2)ch(i/)_ (ging3 sik1 zi6 zi2 敬惜字紙), respect written paper; _yat(7) (2)ch(i/) (1)sh(u_ (jat1 zi2 syu1 一紙書), one letter; _fong(3) (2)ch(i/) (4)i(u/)_ (fong3 zi2 jiu4-2 放紙鷂), to fly a kite; _(2)t(a/) (1)shi(u/) (2)ch(i/)_ (daa2 siu1 zi2 打燒紙), to torture in prison; _ch(')an(3) (2)ch(i/)_ (can3 zi2 襯紙), a fly leaf. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰糸氐 to 紙. Williams' 草紙: Also dated for toilet paper. 【紙】 (tsyeX) (_noun-like_) paper 【花紙】 (faa1 zi2) Gift wrapping paper. 【膠紙】 (gaau1 zi2) Sticky tape. 【雞皮紙】 (gai1 pei4 zi2) Kraft paper. 【紙】 (zi2) Currency. 港紙 (gong2 zi2): "Hong Kong currency." 澳紙 (ou3 zi2): "Australian currency."

U+7D2B May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font.
