(F2.35 紫) 黑赤間色也 (Page 613 #7: (2)紫) A reddish blue (Kangxi: 帛靑赤色), ~~a clay color,~~ a nankeen tint; ~~a fugacious, undecided hue;~~ _(2)tsz' (4)t(')ong shik(7)_ (zi2 tong4 sik1 紫棠色) a dark complexion; _(2)tsz' (2)fan_ (zi2 fan2 紫粉), purple; _(2)tsz' (4)t(')(a/)n_ (zi2 taan4 紫檀), orange red; _(2)tsz' (2)fan_ (zi2 fan2 紫粉), cudbear; _(2)tsz' (4)l(i/) (2)k(o\)m shik(7)_ (zi2 lei4 gam2 sik1 紫梨噉色) black and blue, like a bruise; _(2)tsz' (1)pi(u/)_ (zi2 biu1 紫摽), a violet; _(2)tsz' (1)f(a/) p(o\)(3)_ (zi2 faa1 bou3 紫花布) nankeen cloth; _(2)tsz' (4)shan_ (zi2 san4 紫宸), the court or palace, the rising sun; _(2)tsz' (4)m(i/)_ (zi2 mei4 紫薇), the _Lagerstroemia_, or crape myrtle; a god worshiped for protection against malaria. Williams' "fugacious, undecided hue": This is an attempt at rendering Kangxi 紫閒色... (with 閒 departing). A better rendering would be "mixed hue". Note that the intent of the original Chinese is merely to note that purple is an *instance* of mixed hue (非正色 = not one of 青黃赤白黑). The intent is not to define the character 紫 as meaning "mixed hue" in the general sense. 【紫】 (tsjeX) (_adjective-like_) purple
U+8014 秄 (F2.35 耔) 農人壅禾根也 (Page 612 #9: (2)耔) To ~~weed and hoe~~ heap earth around the roots of plants, to hill (Kangxi: 壅苗本也). 【耔】 (tsiX) (_verb-like_) to earth roots

U+80CF (F2.35 胏) 乾肉之帶骨者 (Page 613 #5: (2)胏) The remnants of a meal (Kangxi: 食所遺也); dried meat with the bones in it (Kangxi: 脯有骨也); _(1)kon (2)tsz'_ (gon1 zi2 乾胏) dried meat. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _(2)ch(i/)_ per 《廣韻》阻史切. 【胏】 (tsriX) (_noun-like_) boneful-meat
U+8A3F May appear with 止 having 3 strokes (+5) or 4 strokes (+6 assumed here), depending on the font. (F2.35 訿 _(2)Ts(')z'_ (ci2)) 相詆也詩翕翕訿訿

U+8DBE 止 (for "foot" sense) 阯 (for "toe" sense) (F1.39 趾) 脚趾 (Page 39|n82 #6: (2)趾) The toes; a foundation of a wall (Kangxi: 趾城足也); the feet (Kangxi: 趾足也); _(2)k(u (2)ch(i/) (1)k(o\)_ (geoi2 zi2 gou1 舉趾高), to step high, to trip along; _(4)hang (2)ch(i/)_ (hang4 zi2 行趾), to walk. 【趾】 (tsyiX) (_noun-like_) foot, toe 【腳趾公】 (goek3 zi2 gung1) The big toe. 【腳趾尾】 (goek3 zi2 mei5-1) The little toe.

U+8EF9 轵 (Mainland simplified) (Page 40|n83 #4: (2)軹) The hole in the hub of a wheel (Kangxi: 車輪小穿), where the ~~nave~~ axle projects; the end of the ~~nave~~ axle projecting from the hub (Kangxi: 軹指也如指而見于轂頭也, 軹謂轊頭也); diverging, like the forks of a road (Kangxi: 岐也).

U+962F 趾 (in 交阯 spelt 交趾) (F1.39 阯) 交阯夷國名 (Page 39|n82 #7: (2)阯) Used for the last (趾); _(1)K(a/)u (2)ch(i/)_ (gaau1 zi2 交阯), Cochinchina (Kangxi: 交阯漢郡名), said to be applied to it because men and women bathed together (Kangxi: 其俗男女同川而浴故曰交阯). Williams' 交阯: That is, "interlocking toes".

U+9EF9 (Page 39|n82 #10: (2)黹) To embroider (Kangxi: ...黹謂刺繡也); embroidered, braided; to put on braid or lace; the 204th radical (U+2FCB ⿋ "embroidery"), relating to embroidery; _(1)cham (2)ch(i/)_ (zam1 zi2 針黹), to sew, to do needle work. Needlework (Kangxi: 箴縷所紩衣). 【黹】 (trijX) (_noun-like_) embroidery

zi3.text: U+2BAA6 (Page 40|n83 #5: 𫪦(3)) A colloquial particle, implying doubt; _(4)loi m(i/)(6) ch(i/)(3)_ (loi4 mei6 zi3 來未𫪦) I doubt if he is here yet.
U+5BD8 May appear as either ⿱宀眞 or ⿱宀真 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.41 置) 立也又安厝也又棄也 (F1.41 寘) 同上 (Page 9* #10: 置(3)寘(3))

U+5FD7 (F1.41 志) 心之所之也 (Page 40|n83 #6: 志(3)) The will, the inclination (Kangxi: 志者心之所之也); a good resolution, a resolve; a sense of right, firm purpose; _t(a/)i(6) ch(i/)(3)_ (daai6 zi3 大志) high thoughts; _ch(')ut(7) tak(7) ch(i/)(3)_ (ceot1 dak1 zi3 出得志) not abashed by ridicule, conscious of power; _ch(i/)(3) h(e/)ung(3)_ (zi3 hoeng3 志向) desire, inclination; _ch(i/)(3) (4)shing_ (zi3 sing4 志誠), ingenuous, guileless. 【志】 (tsyiH) (_noun-like_) will, mind, (_met._) aims 【志在】 (zi3 zoi6) To care about, to care. 完全唔志在 (jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi3 zoi6): "I completely do not care."

U+646F 挚 (Mainland simplified) (F1.41 摯) 至也又握持也又絆其足也 (Page 9* #4: 摯(3)) To seize with the hand, to grasp (Kangxi: 握持也); to arrive at, to reach to (Kangxi: 一曰至也, 臻也); ~~to extend;~~ to advance (Kangxi: 進也)~~, to enter, to go to the edge~~; to break down (Kangxi: 傷折也), as trees from weight of snow; _(4)ts(')ing ch(i/)(3)_ (cing4 zi3 情摯) a great liking for; _ch(i/)(3) (2)t(o\)_ (zi3 dou2 摯倒), to stumble down; _ch(i/)(3) (2)h(i/)_ (zi3 hei2 摯起), to pick one up. Extreme, utmost (Kangxi: 極也). Sincere, earnest. 【摯】 (tsyijH) (_verb-like_) to seize, to hold (_verb-like_) to arrive

U+667A 知 (F1.41 智) 心之明哲能辨道理也 (Page 37|n80 #7: (1)知 _(1)Ch(i/)_ (zi1); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3) and normalised to 智) (...), wisdom; (Page 9* #9: 智(3)) Wisdom, understanding (Kangxi: 智知也無所不知也)~~, talent~~; knowledge; prudence; wise, considerate, discreet; able to manage; clever, sharp, shrewd; _ch(i/)(3) shik(7)_ (zi3 sik1 智識) good judgment; _ch(i/)(3) (5)yung_ (zi3 jung5 智勇), wise and brave; _(4)m(o\) ch(i/)(3)_ (mou4 zi3 無智) indiscreet. 【智】 (trjeH) (_noun-like_) knowledge, (_met._) wisdom
U+690D May appear with right component as 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font.

zi6.text: U+690D May appear with right component as 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font.

zik6.text: U+690D May appear with right component as 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. 㯰 zi6 (per 《廣韻》直吏切 for verb "plant" sense and Kangxi 直吏切 for "lean" sense) (F1.78 植) 立也置也栽也種也 (Page 13* #7: 植(9)) To plant (Kangxi: 種也), to set up (Kangxi: 樹立也), to transplant or set out; erect, standing upright (Kangxi: 立也); to lean on, as a staff (Kangxi: 倚也); _(1)tsoi chik(9)_ (zoi1 zik6 栽植) to set out; _chik(9) (4)k(')(i/) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (zik6 kei4 zoeng6 植其杖) ~~put his staff down~~; _(u/)(6) chik(9)_ (wu6 zik6 戶植) door-posts (Kangxi: 植謂戸之維持鏁者也植木爲之); _chik(9) muk(9)_ (zik6 muk6 植木) to transplant trees. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 裁 to 栽. Williams' 植其杖: Legge's rendering, "planted his staff", is better. Kangxi instead interprets this as "leant upon his staff" under the reading _ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6). For "put his staff down", this would instead be under the reading _ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3) for 置. A plant (Kangxi: 根生之屬曰植). 【植】 (dzyik, driH) (_verb-like_) to plant (_verb-like_) to set up

zi3.text: U+6F2C 渍 (Mainland simplified) zi6 (per 《廣韻》疾智切) (Page 611 #11: (1)漬 _(1)Tsz'_ (zi1); here corrected to _Tsz'(3)_ (zi3)) ~~Usually pronounced _tsik(7)_ (zik1).~~ To soak, to steep (Kangxi: 漚也); to dye (Kangxi: 染也); water-soaked, moldy, damaged by soaking; _tsam(3) ~~tsz'~~ tsz'(3)_ (zam3 zi3 浸漬) under water; 【漬】 (dzjeH) (_verb-like_) to soak

zik1.text: U+6F2C 渍 (Mainland simplified) (Page 611 #11: (1)漬) Usually pronounced _tsik(7)_ (zik1). _(2)shui tsik(7)_ (seoi2 zik1 水漬) damaged by wet, as cargo; _yan(3) tsik(7)_ (jan3 zik1 印漬) discolored, spotted, marks of wetting. When used as a noun, better translated as "stain".

zi3.text: U+7590 (F1.41 疐) 礙不行也 (Page 9* #11: 疐(3)) Hindered, embarrassed, prevented from acting or advancing (Kangxi: 頓也, 礙不行也); ~~to slink away, as a dog does.~~ Fan Wan entry: Corrected 癡 to 礙. Williams' "embarrassed": In the (now) archaic sense of "impeded", "obstructed". To tumble, to stumble (Kangxi: 頓也跲也, 疐仆也). 【疐】 (trijH) (_verb-like_) to stumble
U+75E3 誌 (F1.41 痣) 疤痣 (Page 40|n83 #8: 痣(3)) A mole, a hair-mole (Kangxi: 黑子也); black or red spots on the body; _m(i/)n(6) ch(i/)(3)_ (min6 zi3 面痣) spots on the face.

U+7DFB May appear with right component ⿰至夊 (+9 assumed here) or ⿰至攵 (+10), depending on the font. 致 (for "fine/delicate" senses) zi6 (per 《廣韻》直利切) (F1.41 緻) 精緻 (Page 9* #1: 緻(3)) To mend clothes (Kangxi: 補也, 縫補敝衣也); close, fine, as cloth (Kangxi: 密也); soft, delicate; ~~tattered;~~ handsome, elegant; _(1)tsing ch(i/)(3)_ (zing1 zi3 精緻) beautiful, fine, delicate; _sai(3) ch(i/)(3)_ (sai3 zi3 細緻) careful, particular. Williams' "tattered": This is a misreading of Kangxi 其敝者謂之緻. This is an example from 《揚子方言》 describing the *mending* of tattered clothes as 緻, not the tattered clothes themselves.

U+7F6E May appear with bottom component as the right component of 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. 寘 植 (F1.41 置) 立也又安厝也又棄也 (F1.41 寘) 同上 (Page 9* #10: 置(3)寘(3)) To make firm, to establish (Kangxi 置: 立也, 設也), to place; to appoint; to arrange (Kangxi 置: 安置也); to purchase for one's self; ~~to employ;~~ to reject, to dismiss (Kangxi 置: 赦也, ...與罷同意置之則去之也); to put aside; to determine, to judge, to decide; _(2)ch(')(u ch(i/)(3)_ (cyu2 zi3 處置) to punish, treat as a criminal; _ch(i/)(3) p(a/)n(6)_ (zi3 baan6 置辦) to buy; _ch(i/)(3) (1)k(a/)_ (zi3 gaa1 置家), to take a wife; _(1)on ch(i/)(3)_ (on1 zi3 安置) to arrange a place for, as to spend the night; _fai(3) ch(i/)(3)_ (fai3 zi3 廢置) to refuse, to remove; _ch(i/)(3) (1)shan sz'(6) ngoi(6)_ (zi3 san1 si6 ngoi6 置身事外) it is none of my business; _n(i/)m(6) n(i/)m(6) pat(7) ch(i/)(3)_ (nim6 nim6 bat1 zi3 念念不置) unceasingly thinking of it; _ch(i/)(3) (1)shan (4)m(o\) t(i/)(6)_ (zi3 san1 mou4 dei6 置身無地) ashamed, no place to hide myself. (Page 13* #7: 植(9) _Chik(9)_ (zik6); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(3)_ (zi3)) to place, to lay down (Kangxi 植: 通置); A relay station for horses (Kangxi: 置若今之驛也). 【置】 (triH) (_verb-like_) to put, to set 【寘】 (tsyeH) (_verb-like_) to put

U+81F3 (F1.41 至) 到也極也 (Page 40|n83 #9: 至(3)) To come (Kangxi: 來也), to go to, to reach (Kangxi: 達也由此達彼也); to arrive, the summit or end; a preposition, to, at, even, till, up to; as to, respecting, in order to; ~~an adverb, much, greatly;~~ most, ~~very,~~ the superlative degree (Kangxi: 極也, 至謂至極也); the solstice (Kangxi: 冬至隂之復也夏至陽之復也); the 133d radical (U+2F84 ⾄ "arrive"); _ch(i/)(3) kik(9)_ (zi3 gik6 至極) at the very extreme; _tsz'(6) (2)k(u/) ch(i/)(3) (1)kam_ (zi6 gu2 zi3 gam1 自古至今), from of old till now; _(4)m(o\) (2)sho pat(7) ch(i/)(3)_ (mou4 so2 bat1 zi3 無所不至) he goes every where, he is very wild; _ch(i/)(3) (1)kw(a/)n (2)kan i(u/)(3)_ (zi3 gwaan1 gan2 jiu3 至關緊要) of the highest moment; _(1)tung ch(i/)(3)_ (dung1 zi3 冬至) the winter solstice; _ch(i/)(3) (1)(u_ (zi3 jyu1 至於), with respect to; _ch(i/)(3) (2)shi(u/)_ (zi3 siu2 至少), the least of; _hak(7) ch(i/)(3)_ (hak1 zi3 刻至) he will come soon; _ch(i/)(3) t(o\)(3)_ (zi3 dou3 至到) to arrive; _ch(i/)(3) (2)h(o\)_ (zi3 hou2 至好), the best; _ch(i/)(3) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zi3 zoek6 至着) everything proper; _ch(i/)(3) (4)shing_ (zi3 sing4 至誠), wholly sincere; _ch(i/)(3) (2)kan_ (zi3 gan2 至緊), urgent; _kat(7) ch(i/)(3)_ (gat1 zi3 訖至) a little while, presently. Williams' 至到: In the vernacular register, "until". Williams' 至着: Corrected _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) to _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6). Perfect, good (Kangxi: 善也). Great (Kangxi: 大也). 【至】 (tsyijH) (_verb-like_) to arrive, to reach (_preposition-like_) unto (_adverb-like_) most (_adjective-like_) utmost (_noun-like_) solstice Used in 至於. 【至於】 (tsyijH 'jo) (_preposition-like_) as to 【至】 (zi3) Short for 先至 (only, only then). (TODO) 噉至得𠺢嘛 (gam2 zi3 dak1 ga1 maa3): "Only like so will it work."

U+81F4 May appear as either ⿰至夊 (+3 assumed here) or ⿰至攵 (+4), depending on the font. (F1.41 致) 使也又到也極也推也 (Page 40|n83 #10: 致(3)) ~~Interchanged with the last (至).~~ To go, to cause to go; to convey to (Kangxi: 送詣也); leading to, tending; to accompany; to visit; to communicate (Kangxi: 傳致也), to intimate to; to resign, to give over to (Kangxi: 納也); to induce, bring on (Kangxi: 招致也); to jeopard, to hazard (Kangxi: 委也); to regulate, to control, to order (Kangxi: 制也); an aim, object, or end; a tendency; to investigate fully (Kangxi: 致猶㴱審也); used before a verb, implies what is caused to be done; that, in order to; to put forth; ~~the extreme;~~ _ch(i/)(3) ~~shai(3)~~ (2)shai (5)k(')(u (4)loi_ (zi3 sai2 keoi5 loi4 致使佢來), make him come; _ch(i/)(3) (i/)(3)_ (zi3 ji3 致意) to intimate to, to inform in any way; _ch(i/)(3) sz'(6)_ (zi3 si6 致仕) to throw up an office; _ch(i/)(3) ming(6)_ (zi3 ming6 致命) delivered his orders. Williams' "Interchanged with the last": Kangxi has the sense 至也, but this should not be regarded as an interchanging. Williams' "tending": In the sense of contributing toward an outcome. Williams' 致使佢來: Corrected _shai(3)_ (sai3) to _(2)shai_ (sai2). Williams' 致命: Now "fatal". To arrive (Kangxi: 至也). To do fully, to the utmost (Kangxi: 極也). 【致】 (trijH) (_verb-like_) to convey (_verb-like_) to hand over, (_met._) to retire (_verb-like_) to bring about (_verb-like_) to arrive (_verb-like_) to utmost, to do utmostly

U+89F6 觗 觯 (Mainland simplified) zi1 (alternative per 《廣韻》章移切) (F1.41 觶) 酒器實曰觴虛曰觶 (Page 9* #3: 觶(3)) A goblet or cup (Kangxi: 鄕飮酒角也, 酒觴也) holding three _(1)shing_ (sing1 升) or gills (Kangxi: 三升曰觶觶適也); a cup; ~~to fine one so many cups.~~ To punish with drink in a drinking game (Kangxi: 罰爵也). 【觶】 (tsyeH, tsye) (_noun-like_) drinking-vessel

U+8A8C 志 識 (for "remember" and "record" senses) (F1.41 誌) 記也 (F1.41 識) 同上 (Page 40|n83 #6: 志(3)) to record (Kangxi 志: 又記也與誌同或作識); history, annals; statistical or topographical works; (Page 40|n83 #7: 誌(3)識(3)) To remember (Kangxi 識: 與誌同記也); to record (Kangxi 誌: 記誌也); to write, to inscribe; ~~used for the last (志);~~ _m(o\)(6) ch(i/)(3)_ (mou6 zi3 墓誌) an epitaph, a eulogy; _(1)s(a/)m kwok(8) ch(i/)(3)_ (saam1 gwok3 zi3 三國誌) annals of the Three States; _ch(i/)(3) (1)sh(u_ (zi3 syu1 誌書), history, records; _ch(i/)(3) (1)(u (2)ts(')z'_ (zi3 jyu1 ci2 誌於此) mind is fixed on this. 【誌】 (tsyiH) (_verb-like_) to remember, to record

U+8D04 摯 質 贽 (Mainland simplified) (F1.41 贄) 初相見之禮物或玉帛或禽鳥 (Page 9* #4: 摯(3)) to present to; used for the next (贄) (Kangxi 摯: 執物以爲相見之禮也與贄質通); (Page 9* #5: 贄(3)) A present to make way for one, given at an audience or first interview, or when entering school; to present gifts; _ch(i/)(3) (4)(i/)_ (zi3 ji4 贄儀), presents; _ch(i/)(3) k(i/)n(3)_ (zi3 gin3 贄見) to visit with a present. 【贄】 (tsyijH) (_noun-like_) first-meeting-gift

U+8E93 疐 踬 (Mainland simplified) (F1.41 躓) 顚蹶 (Page 9* #8: 躓(3)) To stumble (Kangxi: 跲也); to trip and fall down; _(1)t(i/)n ch(i/)(3)_ (din1 zi3 顛躓) fell headlong. 【躓】 (trijH) (_verb-like_) to stumble

U+8F0A 轾 (Mainland simplified) (F1.41 輊) 車之覆而前也 (Page 9* #2: 輊(3)) A carriage with a front lower than the back, or turning down, from the lading (Kangxi: 低也, 車前重也). 【輊】 (trijH) (_noun-like_) low-fronted (chariot), front-heavy (chariot)

U+9DD9 摯 鸷 (Mainland simplified) (F1.41 鷙) 惡鳥 (Page 9* #6: ~~？~~鷙(3)) Birds of prey, accipitrine birds (Kangxi 鷙: 擊殺鳥也, 猛鳥也); violent, ruthless, hawklike (Kangxi 鷙: 又凡鳥之勇獸之猛者皆曰鷙); ~~to seize by violence.~~ Williams' "to seize by violence": This is a misreading of Kangxi 鷙執也. This describes the "bird-of-prey" sense as "a bird that seizeth". It does not define a verb. 【鷙】 (tsyijH) (_noun-like_) bird-of-prey (_verb-like_) to prey (upon)

zi6.text: U+4F3A 司 si1 (per 《廣韻》息兹切) si3 (per 《廣韻》相吏切) si6 (alternative) (F2.35 伺) 窺竊也候也 (Page 614 #4: 伺(6)) To wait upon, to wait for; to spy, to narrowly examine (Kangxi: 偵𠋫也又察也); _tsz'(6) hau(6)_ (zi6 hau6 伺候) in readiness, waiting.

U+4FDF 䇃 竢 (F2.35 俟) 待也候也 (Page 614 #2: 俟(6)竢(6)) To wait, to stay (Kangxi 俟: 待也); to wait upon; to expect, to look for, to hope; to prepare for; until, expecting; _tsz'(6) hau(6)_ (zi6 hau6 俟候) waiting for; _lap(9) tsz'(6) (4)(u/)i (1)yam_ (lap6 zi6 wui4 jam1 立俟回音), wait for an answer; _tsz'(6) h(a/)(6) (ut(9)_ (zi6 haa6 jyut6 俟下月) till next month. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _ch(i/)(6)_ per 《廣韻》牀史切. Used in 俟俟 (walking slowly in a large group) (Kangxi: 俟俟衆多徐行貌). 【俟】 (zriX) (_verb-like_) to await (_adjective-like_) ambling together
U+5024 (F1.34 値 _Chai(6)_ (zai6)) 遇也當也又音直作價值 (Page 10* #1: 値(6))

zik6.text: U+5024 (F1.78 値) 適也遇也又音滯 (Page 13* #5: 値(9))

zi6.text: U+503C 値 (F1.34 値 _Chai(6)_ (zai6)) 遇也當也又音直作價值 (Page 10* #1: 値(6); here normalised to 值) To manage, to take hold of (Kangxi 値: 又持也); (Page 13* #5: 値(9) _Chik(9)_ (zik6); here corrected to _Ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6) and normalised to 值) (...), to hold in the hand; 【值-hold】 (driH) (_verb-like_) to hold

zik6.text: U+503C 値 直 zi6 (per Kangxi 直吏切 for "meet/happen" sense and as alternative for "worth" sense) (F1.78 値) 適也遇也又音滯 (Page 10* #1: 値(6) _Ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6); here normalised to 值 _Chik(9)_ (zik6)) to occur, to meet with, to happen (Kangxi 値: 又遇也); _shik(7) ~~ch(i/)(6)~~ chik(9)_ (sik1 zik6 適值) it so happened. (Page 13* #4: 直(9)) price of; used for the ~~three~~ next (値~~, 殖, 植~~); (Page 13* #5: 値(9); here normalised to 值) Price, value, worth of (Kangxi 値: 物價曰値或作直); just; to meet; happened, chanced, occurred; a turn, (...); to manage, to attend to; _chik(9) (4)'m chik(9)_ (zik6 m4 zik6 值唔值) is this cheap or not? _(4)'m chik(9) yat(7) ko(3) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (m4 zik6 jat1 go3 cin4 唔值一個錢), not worth a cash; _(4)'m chik(9) (4)ts(')(i/)n_ (m4 zik6 cin4-2 唔值錢), not worth much; _shik(7) chik(9)_ (sik1 zik6 適值) it happened; _chik(9) yat(9)_ (zik6 jat6 值日) ruling days, are days when certain officers serve in rotation; _chik(9) sz'(6)_ (zik6 si6 值事) do it in turn; _(4)'m (2)h(o\) chik(9) (u(6)_ (m4 hou2 zik6 jyu6 唔好值遇) an unlucky event. In modern usage, the reading _ch(i/)(6)_ (zi6) for the "meet/happen" sense (and as an alternative for the "worth" sense) is obsolete. 【值-worth】 (drik, driH) (_verb-like_) to withstand, to face (_verb-like_) to stand for, to be worth (_noun-like_) worth

zi6.text: U+55E3 孠 (F2.35 嗣) 子息也繼也 (Page 614 #5: 嗣(6)) To connect, as a family; ~~to adopt;~~ to inherit, to succeed to (Kangxi: 嗣續也繼也); children, posterity, heirs, descendants; an ~~adopted~~ heir; to practice, to learn fully (Kangxi: 嗣習也); till; hereafter, then; _hau(6) tsz'(6)_ (hau6 zi6 後嗣) descendants; _kai(3) tsz'(6)_ (gai3 zi6 繼嗣) an ~~adopted~~ heir; _ts(ut(9) tsz'(6)_ (zyut6 zi6 絕嗣) posterity cut off; _(4)m(o\) tsz'(6) (4)t(')(a/)n_ (mou4 zi6 taan4 無嗣壇), an orbate temple; _tsz'(6) wai(6)_ (zi6 wai6 嗣位) to succeed to the throne; _tsz'(6) (1)yan p(i/)t(9) k(u/)(3)_ (zi6 jan1 bit6 gu3 嗣因別故) from other causes following it. Williams' 繼嗣: Not necessarily adopted. 【嗣】 (ziH) (_verb-like_) to succeed, to inherit (_verb-like_) to continue (_noun-like_) successor

U+5B57 (F2.35 字) 文字女子嫁人亦曰字又撫也愛也慈也乳也生也 (Page 613 #9: 字(6)) A character (Kangxi: 文字 etc.), a letter; lettered, marked, written on; a writing, a letter, an order; a word, a symbol of thought; to bear, to nourish, to love, to suckle (Kangxi: 乳也又愛也); the style or title (Kangxi: 名字, 男子二十冠而字) ~~taken at marriage~~ (Kangxi: 女子許嫁筓而字); ~~a name,~~ a designation; to betroth a daughter (Kangxi: 女許嫁曰字); _(2)s(e/) tsz'(6)_ (se2 zi6 寫字) to write; _tsz'(6) (5)m(o\) tsz'(6) (4)t(')au_ (zi6 mou5 zi6 tau4 字母字頭), finals and initials, as used by the Chinese to express a third sound; _tsz'(6) (5)m(o\)_ (zi6 mou5 字母), letters of an alphabet; _(5)m(o\) tsz'(6) mak(9)_ (mou5 zi6 mak6 冇字墨) unlearned, unskilled in writing; _(4)man tsz'(6)_ (man4 zi6 文字) composition, writing; _yat(7) (1)ch(e/)ung tsz'(6)_ (jat1 zoeng1 zi6 一張字) a note, an order; _(5)m(o\) tsz'(6) (4)(un_ (mou5 zi6 jyun4 冇字緣), no mind for learning; _(1)f(a/) (5)m(a/) tsz'(6)_ (faa1 maa5 zi6 花碼字) contracted forms of the ten digits; _tsz'(6) h(o\)(6)_ (zi6 hou6 字號) name of a shop; a "chop," as of tea; _chuk(7) tsz'(6) shat(7)_ (zuk1 zi6 sat1 捉字蝨) to seek flaws in a writing; _tsz'(6) (5)ng(a/)n_ (zi6 ngaan5 字眼), a set phrase, an expression; _pat(7) tsz'(6)_ (bat1 zi6 不字) not betrothed; _(u/)t(9) tsz'(6)_ (wut6 zi6 活字) or _tsz'(6) nap(7)_ (zi6 nap1 字粒) a type; _(1)ts(un tsz'(6)_ (zyun1 zi6 尊字) what is your respected style? _p(i/)t(9) tsz'(6)_ (bit6 zi6 別字) the familiar style, taken on entering life; _yan(3) tsz'(6) k(a/)k(8)_ (jan3 zi6 gaak3-2 印字格) a copy-slip; _tsz'(6) k(a/)k(8)_ (zi6 gaak3 字格) black lines; _tsz'(6) tsik(7)_ (zi6 zik1 字跡) a mark, traces of writing. Williams' "taken at marriage": Per 《禮記》, men are styled at twenty, whilst women are styled at betrothal (whence 待字 "awaiting style-name" for a daughter unbetrothed). 【字】 (dziH) (_verb-like_) to bear child, to breed (_verb-like_) to nurture, to love (_noun-like_) character (_noun-like_) style (_verb-like_) (_met._) to betroth 【字】 (zi6) A point within an hour, corresponding to one of the markings 1 through 11 on an analogue clock. 五點十個字 (ng5 dim2 sap6 go3 zi6): "Five fifty" (shortenable to 五點十). 七點三個字 (cat1 dim2 saam1 go3 zi6): "Seven fifteen" (shortenable to 七點三). 踏四個字 (daap6 sei3 go3 zi6): "Twenty past" (shortenable to 踏四). 踏四個半字 (daap6 sei3 go3 bun3 zi6): "Twenty-two and a half minutes past" (shortenable to 踏四個半). A duration of five minutes. 遲四個字 (ci4 sei3 go3 zi6): "Late by twenty minutes." 爭兩個字六點 (zaang1 loeng5 go3 zi6 luk6 dim2): "Ten minutes short of six o'clock."

U+5BFA 䦙 zi6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F2.36 寺) 僧舍也又官名如大理寺之類又寺人閹宦也 (F2.36 䦙) 亦作寺閹宦也 (Page 614 #12: 寺(6)) An official residence, chambers about a court; a court, an office, a hall (Kangxi: 廷也有法度者也); an eunuch (Kangxi: 宦寺); a monastery, a Budhist temple (Kangxi: ...後名浮屠所居皆曰寺); Budhists; _tsz'(6) (4)m(u/)n_ (zi6 mun4 寺門), Budhists; _yap(9) tsz'(6)_ (jap6 zi6-2 入寺) to become a priest; _t(a/)i(6) (5)l(i/) tsz'(6)_ (daai6 lei5 zi6-2 大理寺) the Court of Appeal at Peking (北京); _tsz'(6) (4)shing_ (zi6 sing4 寺丞), chief clerk in a court; _(4)yau tsz'(6)_ (jau4 zi6 遊寺) to be changed from one office to another; to saunter in a monastery. ~~Used for the next (䦙).~~ (Page 614 #13: 䦙(6); here normalised to 寺) A court, a hall where officers hold sittings (Kangxi 䦙: 廷也有法度者也本作寺); an eunuch (Kangxi 寺: 宦寺); a chamberlain, an officer in waiting; _tsz'(6) (4)yan_ (zi6 jan4 寺人), an eunuch. 【寺】 (ziH) (_noun-like_) court, (_met._) eunuch (_noun-like_) temple Used in 寺人. 【寺人】 (ziH nyin) (_noun-like_) eunuch
U+5DF3 (F2.36 巳) 時辰也 (Page 614 #9: 巳(6)) The sixth of the 12 branches, denoted by a snake (Kangxi: ...故巳爲蛇象形), and corresponding to 9--11 A. M. 【巳】 (ziX) (_noun-like_) snake-branch

U+5F58 zai6 (per 《廣韻》直例切) (F1.43 彘) 豬母也 (Page 10* #4: 彘(6)) A sow, a pig (Kangxi: 豕也, 豬也); _(4)yan ch(i/)(6)_ (jan4 zi6 人彘) ~~a corpse cut to pieces,~~ alludes to a ~~speech of a princess~~ designation made by an empress of the H(a/)n (漢) dynasty. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿱彑⿲土矢比 to 彘. Williams' 人彘: Neither "a corpse cut to pieces" nor "of a princess", but a designation made by Empress L(u (呂后) after horrifically maiming her rival Lady Ts(')ik (戚夫人), as alleged in 《呂太后本紀》. The weight of this phrase cannot be fully comprehended until one reads that text, which describes extreme cruelty such as I will not quote here. For them that wish to spare themselves from that text, the result is that 人彘 "human swine" is used to refer to victims of horrific cruelty. 【彘】 (drjejH) (_noun-like_) swine

U+6D98 (F2.35 涘) 水涯又音哀 (Page 614 #3: 涘(6)) The banks of a river (Kangxi: 水厓也), the shores or mouth of a stream; _(2)shui tsz'(6)_ (seoi2 zi6 水涘) the bank. Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _ch(i/)(6)_ per 《廣韻》牀史切. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword 竢 to 涘. 【涘】 (zriX) (_noun-like_) riverbank, bank
U+7278 (F2.36 牸) 牝牛 (Page 614 #1: 牸(6)) A cow (Kangxi: 牝牛); the female of domesticated animals (Kangxi: 牝馬亦曰牸, 牸雌也); _tsz'(6) (5)m(a/)_ (zi6 maa5 牸馬), a mare.

U+75D4 (F1.43 痔) 痔瘡 (Page 10* #5: 痔(6)) The piles (Kangxi: 後病也, 隱瘡也); ~~to gnaw, as insects do;~~ _ch(i/)(6) (1)ch(')ong_ (zi6 cong1 痔瘡), piles; _noi(6) ch(i/)(6)_ (noi6 zi6 內痔) bloody piles; _ngoi(6) ch(i/)(6)_ (ngoi6 zi6 外痔) blind piles; _(1)ch(')(un (4)ch(')(e/)ung ch(i/)(6)_ (cyun1 coeng4 zi6 穿腸痔) fistula in ano. Williams' "to gnaw, as insects do": This is a misreading of Kangxi 痔食也蟲食之也, which is an (erroneous) explanation from 《釋名》 that haemorrhoids are (or are caused by) some parasite feeding on the person. 【痔】 (driX) (_noun-like_) piles

U+7940 May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. 禩 (F2.36 祀) 祭祀 (Page 614 #10: 祀(6)) To sacrifice to gods or ~~devils~~ ancestral spirits, to offer sacrifices (Kangxi: 祭也); sacrificial; a sacrifice; a year (Kangxi: 年也); like, as if (Kangxi: 祀者似也); _(4)m(o\) tsz'(6)_ (mou4 zi6 無祀) no descendants; _(4)(un tsz'(6)_ (jyun4 zi6 元祀) first year of a reign; _tsz'(6) (4)shan_ (zi6 san4 祀神), to sacrifice to the gods; _tsz'(6) (2)ts(o\)_ (zi6 zou2 祀祖), to worship ancestors. 【祀】 (ziX) (_verb-like_) to sacrifice (_noun-like_) annus

U+7A1A 稺 穉 (F1.43 稚) 幼小之稱 (F1.43 穉) 同上 (Page 10* #3: 穉(6)稚(6)) Small, delicate (Kangxi 稺: 凡人物幼小皆曰稺); young, tender; young grain, or that which ripens late (Kangxi 稺: 幼禾也, 晚禾); _(4)t(')ung ch(i/)(6)_ (tung4 zi6 童稚) a youngster; _ch(i/)(6) h(i/)(3)_ (zi6 hei3 稚氣) childish, immature; _ch(i/)(6) (2)tsz'_ (zi6 zi2 稚子) a boy. 【稚】 (drijH) (_noun-like_) immature-grain (_adjective-like_) immature (_verb-like_) to sow late
U+7AE2 (Page 614 #2: 俟(6)竢(6)) Strictly, the pre-merger reading should be _ch(i/)(6)_ per 《廣韻》牀史切. Fan Wan entry: The headword 竢 is a misprint of 涘.

U+7B25 si3 (per 《廣韻》相吏切) (F2.36 笥) 竹筒 (Page 614 #6: 笥(6)) A hamper, a basket (Kangxi: 飯及衣之器也); _(1)sh(u tsz'(6)_ (syu1 zi6 書笥) a portable book and writing-case; _fuk(7) tsz'(6)_ (fuk1 zi6 腹笥) learned, well read. 【笥】 (siH) (_noun-like_) hamper

U+801C 枱 ci5 (not recast to departing) (F2.36 耜) 耒耜耕田所以起土者 (Page 614 #11: 耜(6)) A ploughshare (Kangxi: 臿也, 耜者耒之金也); a colter, the part of a plough which enters the earth; a plough. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 𮋦 to 耜. 【耜】 (ziX) (_noun-like_) ploughshare, plough

U+81EA (F2.35 自) 自己獨也從來也由也 (Page 613 #8: 自(6)) A preposition, from, commencing at (Kangxi: 由也, 從也); a pronoun, self, I (Kangxi: 己也); my own, myself, personally; to use (Kangxi: 用也); the 132d radical (U+2F83 ⾃ "self"); _tsz'(6) (2)k(i/)_ (zi6 gei2 自己), myself, my own; _(5)n(i/) tsz'(6) (2)k(i/)_ (nei5 zi6 gei2 你自己), you yourself; _tsz'(6) (4)wai_ (zi6 wai4 自為), I did it; _tsz'(6) (O\)(3) ch(i/)(3) (4)sheng_ (zi6 ou3 zi3 seng4-2 自澳至城), from Macao to Canton; _tsz'(6) (4)(i/)n_ (zi6 jin4 自然), natural, spontaneous, self-existent; certainly, surely; _tsz'(6) tsz'(6) (4)(i/)n (4)(i/)n (5)(u/)i (2)hi(u/)_ (zi6 zi6 jin4 jin4 wui5 hiu2 自自然然會曉), it will soon become natural and easy to understand; _tsz'(6) (4)(i/)n (4)t(')ung_ (zi6 jin4 tung4 自然銅), native copper; _pat(7) (2)ts(')ing tsz'(6) (4)loi_ (bat1 cing2 zi6 loi4 不請自來), he came uninvited on his own lookout, _i. e._ the responsibility is his own, as a patient undergoing an operation; _tsz'(6) 'ng(6)_ (zi6 ng6 自誤) my fault; _tsz'(6) sh(i/)(6)_ (zi6 si6 自是) self-confident, self-righteous; _tsz'(6) ts(o\)(6)_ (zi6 zou6 自造) our own manufacture; _tsz'(6) tsz'(6) tsoi(6) tsoi(6)_ (zi6 zi6 zoi6 zoi6 自自在在) in high spirits; _tsz'(6) hau(6)_ (zi6 hau6 自後) henceforth; _tsz'(6) (5)yau (2)ch(u (i/)(3)_ (zi6 jau5 zyu2 ji3 自有主意) I will manage it; _tsz'(6) (4)ts(')am (2)t(un k(i/)n(3)_ (zi6 cam4 dyun2 gin3 自尋短見) self destruction, suicide; _tsz'(6) tsok(8) tsz'(6) shau(6)_ (zi6 zok3 zi6 sau6 自作自受) he gets what he gave; _tsz'(6) shik(9) tsz'(6)_ (zi6 sik6 zi6 自食自) I find my own food; _tsz'(6) (4)loi ~~ko(3)~~ (2)ko (4)sh(i/)_ (zi6 loi4 go2 si4 自來嗰時), ever since that time; _tsz'(6) (1)ch(i/) t(')(a/)i(3) kwo(3)_ (zi6 zi1 taai3 gwo3 自之太過) presumptuous. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 巳 to 己. Williams' 自來嗰時: Changed _ko(3)_ (go3) to modern _(2)ko_ (go2). Of itself, naturally (Kangxi: 自然無勉强也). 【自】 (dzijH) (_pronoun-like_) self (_adjective-like_) own (_preposition-like_) since, from (_adverb-like_) naturally (_conjunction-like_) if (_conjunction-like_) though

U+96C9 (F1.43 雉) 野雞 (Page 10* #2: 雉(6)) A pheasant (Kangxi: 雉有十四種 etc.), including also francolins; an embrasure on a wall; ~~to rule;~~ ~~to put in order;~~ _ch(i/)(6) (5)m(i/)_ (zi6 mei5 雉尾), pheasant's tail feathers, used by actors; _ch(i/)(6) t(i/)p(9)_ (zi6 dip6 雉堞) parapet walls; _ch(i/)(6) (1)kai_ (zi6 gai1 雉雞), the Tartar pheasant; _ch(i/)(6) (4)m(u/)n_ (zi6 mun4 雉門), the south door of a seraglio. Williams' "to rule", "to put in order": These are attempts at rendering Kangxi 雉理也. The text of 《揚子方言》 is 紕繹督雉理也...凡物曰督之絲曰繹之. The common meaning of the characters presented in this passage is beyond me, but my guess would be _to elicit_. A unit of wall area (Kangxi: 方丈曰堵三堵曰雉). 【雉】 (drijX) (_noun-like_) pheasant (_noun-like_) perch

U+98DF 飤 飼 (F2.35 食) 以食餵物曰食又飯也 (Page 614 #7: 飤(6)飼(6)) Interchanged with the next (食). (Page 614 #8: 食(6)) To feed, to set food before (Kangxi: 以食與人也); to bring up (Kangxi: 食謂乳養之也, 食養生也); food (Kangxi: 食飯屬也), provision (Kangxi: 糧也); _(4)ngau (4)y(e/)ung (4)yan (2)sho tsz'(6)_ (ngau4 joeng4 jan4 so2 zi6 牛羊人所食) men rear sheep and oxen. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 偎 to 餵. In addition to the light-departing tone marker (6), Williams prints the headword 食 with an explicit classical departing-tone marker ◌ (U+302C). Font support for classical departing-tone markers is known to be poor on Windows and iOS/macOS; check the Font test page. 【食-departing】 (ziH) (_verb-like_) to feed
U+98E4 May appear with left component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. (Page 614 #7: 飤(6)飼(6))

U+98FC May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 飤 饲 (Mainland simplified) (F2.35 飼) 以食食人也 (Page 614 #7: 飤(6)飼(6)) To feed, to nourish (Kangxi 飤: 以食食人也); to set food before; to rear, as animals; feed, provisions, eatables (Kangxi 飤: 糧也, 食也與飼同).

zik1.text: U+52E3 𪟝 (Mainland simplified) (F1.74 勣) 功也勞也 (Page 569 #3: 勣(7)) Merit, praiseworthy acts (Kangxi: 功也); meritorious deeds, conduct worthy of reward.

U+5373 卽 皍 ze1 (lazy elision in 即係) (F1.74 卽) 就也山也則也 (Page 568 #8: 卽(7); here normalised to 即) ~~Eating, about~~ Nearing to eat (Kangxi 卽: 卽猶就也就食也); an adverb, now, immediately, soon, presently, when, then, forthwith; now (Kangxi 卽: 今也); near (Kangxi 卽: 卽尼也, 尼近也); if, perhaps (Kangxi 卽: 卽猶若也); ~~this,~~ that is, or, alias; the snuff of a candle (Kangxi 卽: 燭炬之燼曰卽); _tsik(7) tsik(7)_ (zik1 zik1 即即) an abundance, full of; _tsik(7) hak(7)_ (zik1 hak1 即刻) instantly; _tsik(7) yat(9)_ (zik1 jat6 即日) the same day; _tsik(7) hai(6)_ (zik1 hai6 即係) just that, it is so; _tsik(7) (1)kam_ (zik1 gam1 即今), just now; _tsik(7) ~~(4)sh(i/)~~ (2)sz' (1)k(a/)n_ (zik1 si2 gaan1 即使間), supposing it to be; _(4)n(i/)n (5)m(a/)n tsoi(6) tsik(7)_ (nin4 maan5 zoi6 zik1 年晚在即) the end of the year is near; _tsik(7) tsik(7) (1)f(a/)n ~~(4)loi~~ (4)lai_ (zik1 zik1 faan1 lai4 即即返嚟), come back immediately; _tsik(7) (4)sh(i/) (2)tang (2)kan_ (zik1 si4 dang2 gan2 即時等緊), it is wanted very soon; _tsik(7) tsik(7) (i/)n(6)_ (zik1 zik1 jin6 即即現) money on the nail. Williams' 即使間: Corrected _(4)sh(i/)_ (si4) to _(2)sz'_ (si2). Williams' 即即返嚟: Corrected _(4)loi_ (loi4) to _(4)lai_ (lai4). To ascend, to assume a position. (_copula_) To be (precisely). 【即】 (tsik) (_verb-like_) to approach (_verb-like_) to take place (_adverb-like_) forthwith (_adverb-like_) that is, which is (_verb-like_) to be (_conjunction-like_) though
U+537D (F1.74 卽) 就也山也則也 (Page 568 #8: 卽(7))

U+5832 May appear as either ⿱即土 (+7 assumed here) or ⿱卽土 (+9), depending on the font. zat1 (per 《廣韻》資悉切 for "fired-brick" and "ember" senses) zik6 (per 《廣韻》秦力切 for "abhor" senses) (F1.75 堲) 疾也書經堲讒說 (Page 568 #10: 堲(7)) To make bricks (Kangxi: 火熟曰堲); ~~to make an arched grave;~~ the snuff of a candle, embers (Kangxi: 火之餘燼曰堲); to dislike, to have a horror of, to snuff at (Kangxi: 堲疾也). The reading _tsik(7)_ (zik1) is not unattested for the "fired-brick" sense; 《集韻》 has the reading 節力切, explained 燒土周棺也. Kangxi has the "abhor" sense under 子力切 _tsik(7)_ (zik1). However, 《廣韻》 explains this reading as 風堲 (which I do not comprehend), with the "abhor" sense instead given under 秦力切 _tsik(9)_ (zik6). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰糸⿱免丿 to 讒. Williams' "to make an arched grave": This is a poor rendering of Kangxi 堲者冶土爲？而四周于棺之坎也. The idea here is that fired-brick is used to encase about the four sides of a coffin (四周于棺). 【堲-abhor】 (dzik) (_verb-like_) to abhor 【堲-fired-brick】 (tsit) (_noun-like_) fired-brick
U+5E58 帻 (Mainland simplified) zaak3 (per 《廣韻》側革切) (F1.75 幘) 巾幘 (Page 569 #8: 幘(7)) A turban or cloth wound around the head (Kangxi: 髮有巾曰幘 etc.); a kerchief used instead of a cap.

U+755F cik1 (per 《廣韻》初力切) (F1.75 畟) 田器之尖利者 (Page 569 #10: ~~？~~畟(7)) ~~A~~ sharp ~~agricultural instrument~~ like a mattoc (Kangxi 畟: 治稼畟畟進也, 畟畟耜也, 言嚴利); ~~to attend to husbandry.~~ The reading _tsik(7)_ (zik1) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 節力切, explained 畟畟耜利也. Whilst 《廣韻》 also has the reading 子力切, it is without explanation (it simply cross-references _ch(')ik(7)_ (cik1) as 又初力切). Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿳由儿夂 to 畟, and corrected 犬 to 尖. 【畟】 (tsrhik, tsik) (_adjective-like_) sharp

U+7A4D 积 (Mainland simplified) zi3 (per 《廣韻》子智切 for "store" sense) (F1.74 積) 聚也蓄也累也 (Page 569 #5: 積(7)) To gather, to hoard up, to accumulate (Kangxi: 聚也), to store (Kangxi: 聚也儲蓄也); to increase, to add to, to pile upon (Kangxi: 累也); increasingly; _f(a/)t(8) tsik(7)_ (faat3 zik1 發積) to accomplish, to succeed in; _(2)shui tsik(7) (4)m(a/)i_ (seoi2 zik1 maai4 水積埋), water standing, as in puddles; _(1)t(u/)i tsik(7)_ (deoi1 zik1 堆積) to heap up, as rubbish; _tsik(7) fuk(7)_ (zik1 fuk1 積福) much happiness derived from good works; _tsik(7) (4)n(i/)n_ (zik1 nin4 積年), during many years, for a long time; _tsik(7) ch(')uk(7)_ (zik1 cuk1 積蓄) to hoard or lay by. A product (result of multiplication), area, or volume. 【積】 (tsjek, tsjeH) (_verb-like_) to accumulate (_noun-like_) product, area, volume

U+7E3E 勣 (for "achievement" and "merit" senses) 绩 (Mainland simplified) (F1.74 績) 襞績紡績又功績 (Page 569 #3: 勣(7)) Interchanged with the next (績) (Kangxi 勣: 通作績). (Page 569 #4: 績(7)) To twist hempen threads (Kangxi: 緝也) on the knee; ~~to split hempen fibres;~~ merit by laudable works (Kangxi: 績功也); ~~an affair, a business;~~ to complete, to bring to a conclusion (Kangxi: 事也成也); ~~to join, to piece;~~ _tsik(7) (4)m(a/)_ (zik1 maa4 績麻), to twist hemp; _(1)kung tsik(7)_ (gung1 zik1 功績) works of ~~public~~ merit. Williams' "public merit": Public is 公, not 功. An achievement (Kangxi: 績業也). To continue (Kangxi: 績繼也). 【績】 (tsek) (_verb-like_) to twist (thread) (_noun-like_) achievement

U+8077 軄 职 (Mainland simplified) (F1.76 職) 官職品秩也職任職掌 (Page 13* #1: 職(7)) To govern, to rule (Kangxi: 執掌也); to attend to; ~~to record;~~ ~~to act officially;~~ having the direction of (Kangxi: 職主也); official duty (Kangxi: 職事也); title, office; tribute, offerings or presents of other states (Kangxi: 貢也); _chik(7) (2)shau_ (zik1 sau2 職守), to direct; _chik(7) yam(6)_ (zik1 jam6 職任) in office, the duties of an office; _(1)k(a/) chik(7)_ (gaa1 zik1 加職) to confer a title; _(1)p(i/) chik(7)_ (bei1 zik1 卑職) my office; _chik(7) (4)(un_ (zik1 jyun4 職員), honorary title; _(1)k(u/)n chik(7)_ (gun1 zik1 官職) official title; _chik(7) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (zik1 zoeng2 職掌), to superintend; _k(a/)k(8) chik(7)_ (gaak3 zik1 革職) to deprive of a title; _lok(9) chik(7)_ (lok6 zik1 落職) to deprive of office; _shau(6) chik(7)_ (sau6 zik1 受職) to hold an office; _chik(7) chik(7)_ (zik1 zik1 職職) many (Kangxi: 職職多也); _chik(7) fan(6)_ (zik1 fan6 職分) a title, official duties. Williams' "to record": This is a misreading of Kangxi 記微也, "knower of minutiae". Here, 記 means "know", not "record". Williams' 職員: In modern usage, "employee". Exclusively (Kangxi: 專也). 【職】 (tsyik) (_noun-like_) office, duty (_verb-like_) to officiate (_adverb-like_) exclusively

U+8DE1 蹟 迹 (F1.74 蹟) 足蹟 (F1.74 跡) 形跡踪跡 (F1.74 迹) 同上 (Page 569 #7: 迹(7)跡(7)蹟(7)) A trace, a foot-mark, a foot-step (Kangxi 迹: 步處也, 足跡也); vestiges, effects, consequences, signs (Kangxi 迹: 凡有形可見者皆曰迹); the results of previous conduct (Kangxi 迹: 凡功業可見者曰迹); to trace out, to follow up, to search for the effects of (Kangxi 迹: 循實而考之亦曰迹); _k(e/)uk(8) tsik(7)_ (goek3 zik1 腳跡) a foot-print; _(4)shan tsik(7)_ (san4 zik1 神跡) evidences of divine power, miracles; _(2)ying tsik(7) (2)ho (4)(i/)_ (jing2 zik1 ho2 ji4 影跡可疑), a suspicious appearance; _(4)m(o\) (2)ying tsik(7)_ (mou4 jing2 zik1 無影跡) no clue of him; _shing(3) tsik(7)_ (sing3 zik1 勝跡) renowned, magnificent, as a view; _ping(6) (4)m(o\) (1)tsung tsik(7)_ (bing6 mou4 zung1 zik1 並無蹤跡) I can find out nothing about him; _yan(3) tsik(7)_ (jan3 zik1 印跡) a stain; _(4)han tsik(7)_ (han4 zik1 痕跡) a streak, as of dirt; bad feelings left in the mind. A vestige, a remnant (Kangxi 迹: 凡前人所遺留者曰迹). To follow, to adhere to (Kangxi 迹: 凡有所遵循亦曰迹). 【跡】 (tsjek) (_noun-like_) footprint, footstep, trace, (_met._) accomplishment

U+8E16 cik1 (per 《集韻》七迹切 for "with demeanour/bearing" sense) zik6 (per 《廣韻》秦昔切 and 《集韻》祥亦切 for "stride/tread over" sense) (Page 569 #12: 踖(7)) To stride (Kangxi: 長脛行也); to straddle or step over or step on a thing (Kangxi: 踖猶躐也, 踐也); to walk reverently, to step in a formal manner, to measure one's steps (Kangxi: 一曰踧踖也, 踧踖敬貌, 踧踖恭敬也). Williams' "step over": Or, to step *on*. 躐也 is ambiguous. With (reverent?) demeanour or bearing (Kangxi: ...有容也, ...有容儀也). 【踖-step】 (dzjek) (_verb-like_) to step on, to step over 【踖-demeanour】 (tshjek) Used in 踖踖. 【踖踖】 (tshjek tshjek) (_adverb-like_) with reverent demeanour 【踖-reverential】 (tsjek) Used in 踧踖. 【踧踖】 (tsjuwk tsjek) (_adjective-like_) moving reverently, reverential

U+965F (F1.76 陟) 我也進也 (Page 13* #3: 陟(7)) To ascend, to enter on a higher office (Kangxi: 陟陞也, 登也); promoted, advanced (Kangxi: 進也); ~~to mount, to go up;~~ to advance, to proceed to; _chik(7) (4)lam_ (zik1 lam4 陟臨), to behold from on high, as God does; _chik(7) kong(3)_ (zik1 gong3 陟降) promotion and degradation. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿰阝歩 to 陟. The explanation 我也 is erroneous. 【陟】 (trik) (_verb-like_) to ascend

zik6.text: U+57F4 May appear with right component as 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.78 埴) 土之黏膩者 (Page 14* #1: 埴(9)) Adhesive clay (Kangxi: 黏土也); _(4)t(')(un chik(9)_ (tyun4 zik6 摶埴) to mold in clay; _ch(a/)k(9) chik(9)_ (zaak6 zik6 擿埴) to feel one's way with a stick (Kangxi: 瞽者以杖擿地而後行謂之擿埴). 【埴】 (dzyik) (_noun-like_) clay

U+5915 (F1.78 夕) 朝夕 (Page 570 #5: 夕(9)) Evening, dusk (Kangxi: 晨之對暮也); late; last day of, as a year or month; out of the perpendicular (Kangxi: 斜也); the 36th radical (U+2F23 ⼣ "evening"); _(1)chi(u/) tsik(9)_ (ziu1 zik6 朝夕) morning and evening; _(4)ch(')(u tsik(9)_ (ceoi4 zik6 除夕) last day of the year; _(1)kam tsik(9)_ (gam1 zik6 今夕) this evening. An evening meeting (Kangxi: 朝見曰朝夕見曰夕). 【夕】 (zjek) (_noun-like_) evening

U+5BC2 (F1.78 寂) 寂寞幽靜也 (Page 570 #8: 寂(9)) Still, silent, as an uninhabited house (Kangxi: 無人聲也); quiet, unmoved, like a recluse (Kangxi: 靜也安也); solitary, desolate, lonesome; _tsik(9) tsing(6)_ (zik6 zing6 寂靜) a dead silence; _(4)(un tsik(9)_ (jyun4 zik6 圓寂) completely silent, said of a priest's death. Williams' "recluse": In the (now) archaic sense of a place of seclusion. 【寂】 (dzek) (_adjective-like_) still, silent

U+6B96 May appear with right component as 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.78 殖) 貨殖生殖 (Page 13* #6: 殖(9)) To grow, to increase, to flourish (Kangxi: 生也, 蕃也長也)~~,~~; to enrich, to amass~~;~~, as money (Kangxi: 興生財利曰殖); to plant (Kangxi: 種也); ~~to raise the price of;~~ gain; ~~price, value;~~ rotten ~~bones~~ (Kangxi: 脂膏久殖也); _(1)shang chik(9)_ (sang1 zik6 生殖) to grow, to increase; _chik(9) fo(3)_ (zik6 fo3 殖貨) to ~~raise the price~~ accumulate commodities; _(2)ch(e/)ung chik(9) m(a/)n(6) mat(9)_ (zoeng2 zik6 maan6 mat6 長殖萬物) nature flourishes. In modern usage, "colonise" (殖民). To cultivate (Kangxi: 封殖也). To establish (Kangxi: 立也). Level and upright (Kangxi: 殖殖平正也). 【殖】 (dzyik) (_verb-like_) to grow (_verb-like_) to cultivate (_verb-like_) to set up (_adjective-like_) level
U+6C50 (F1.78 汐) 潮汐朝曰潮夕曰汐 (Page 570 #6: 汐(9)) The evening tide, high tide at sunset (Kangxi: 海濤早曰潮夕曰汐); the name of a stream (Kangxi: 水名).

U+6E5C 㵓 sat6 (common) (F1.78 湜) 水淸見底也 (Page 14* #4: 湜(9)) Pure, limpid water, through which the bottom can be seen (Kangxi: 水淸底見也); pure-minded; to maintain firmly (Kangxi: 一曰持正貌). Fan Wan entry: Corrected 㡳 to 底. 【湜】 (dzyik) (_adjective-like_) clear

U+76F4 May appear as the right component of 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. zik6-2 (rising second in vernacular 直直地) (F1.78 直) 正直不偏開也伸也常也但也 (Page 13* #4: 直(9)) To look straight ahead (Kangxi: 正見也); straight, direct (Kangxi: 正也, 不曲也); straightforward, upright, true; just, exactly; to stretch off (Kangxi: 伸也), to proceed, to go direct; to make straight, to straighten; only, merely, but (Kangxi: 猶但也); purposely (Kangxi: 猶故也); stiff and straight; _ching(3) chik(9)_ (zing3 zik6 正直) upright; _chik(9) (4)(i/)n_ (zik6 jin4 直言), to speak the truth; _(2)kang chik(9)_ (gang2 zik6 梗直) inflexibly right; _chik(9) (4)ch(')ing h(u(3)_ (zik6 cing4 heoi3 直程去) go directly there; _yat(7) chik(9) h(u(3)_ (jat1 zik6 heoi3 一直去) go on straight; _chik(9) tai(6) (2)sh(a/)ng_ (zik6 dai6 saang2 直隸省), the superintending province (_i. e._ Chihl(i/) (直隸)); _chik(9) tai(6) (1)chau_ (zik6 dai6 zau1 直隸州), an inferior department; _mok(9) sun(3) chik(9) (1)chung chik(9)_ (mok6 seon3 zik6 zung1 zik6 莫信直中直) do not believe everything called true; _chik(9) (4)loi (1)n(i/) ch(')(u(3)_ (zik6 loi4 ni1 cyu3 直來呢處) came straight here; _(1)shan chik(9) k(e/)uk(8)_ (san1 zik6 goek3 伸直腳) legs stretched out, _i. e._ dead; _chik(9) sz'(6)_ (zik6 si6 直士) a headman in a neighborhood. Smooth (Kangxi: 順也). Suitable (Kangxi: 猶宜也). To right a wrong (Kangxi: 理枉曰直). Speech-assist, specifically an initial particle (Kangxi: 語發聲). 【直】 (drik) (_adjective-like_) straight (_adjective-like_) straightforward, direct (_adverb-like_) just 【直程】 (zik6 cing4) Directly. 直程返去 (zik6 cing4 faan1 heoi3): "Directly go back." Simply, truly, clearly, especially used exaggeratively. 直程冇得頂 (zik6 cing4 mou5 dak1 ding2): "Straight up can't be beat." 直程係啦 (zik6 cing4 hai6 laa1): "It clearly is!" Used to imply decisiveness or extremeness of an action. 我直程報警㗎 (ngo5 zik6 cing4 bou3 ging2 gaa3): "I won't hesitate to just call the police!" 直程走咗 (zik6 cing4 zau2 zo2): "He simply left." 【直頭】 (zik6 tau4) Synonym of 直程.

U+7A19 May appear with right component as 値 or 值 (assumed here), depending on the font. zik1 (per 《廣韻》竹力切) (F1.78 稙) 早種曰稙 (Page 14* #2: 稙(9)) Grain planted early, the first crop (Kangxi: 早種禾也); to sow in good time (Kangxi: 先種曰稙後種曰穉); the first wife (Kangxi: 靑徐人謂長婦曰稙長). 【稙】 (trik) (_verb-like_) to sow early

U+7A78 夕 (F1.78 穸) 窀穸墓穴幽堂也穸夜也言穴中厚暗如長夜也 (Page 570 #7: 穸(9)) Dark, obscure, as a winter night (Kangxi: 窀厚也穸夜也言穴中厚暗如長夜也一曰長埋謂之窀長夜謂之穸); a vault; ~~a niche or recess in~~ a sepulchre (Kangxi: 窀穸也); _(1)chun tsik(9)_ (zeon1 zik6 窀穸) the tomb, the grave.

U+7C4D 藉 (F1.78 籍) 書籍典籍又册籍也 (Page 570 #3: ~~？~~籍(9)) A book for records (Kangxi 籍: 書籍)~~, a tablet~~; a list, a register of the people (Kangxi 籍: 戸籍); the place for enroling, one's native place; _(1)sh(u tsik(9)_ (syu1 zik6 書籍) books; _(4)(u/)i tsik(9)_ (wui4 zik6 回籍) to return to one's home; _(4)(un tsik(9)_ (jyun4 zik6 原籍) place where one's family originated; _lok(9) tsik(9)_ (lok6 zik6 落籍) to be registered; _(1)sh(e/)ung tsik(9)_ (soeng1 zik6 雙籍) enrolled in two places; _(4)m(o\) tsik(9) (4)yau (4)man_ (mou4 zik6 jau4 man4 無籍遊民), vagrants, gypsey-like, without origin. Williams misprints 籍 as ⿱𥫗⿰耒⿱龷月; here corrected. (The character 籍 appears correctly on Page 792 in the character index.) Williams' 雙籍: Now 雙重國籍 for "dual nationality". Land tax (Kangxi: 租籍). (The emperor) personally tilling the field (Kangxi: 籍田 etc.). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【籍】 (dzjek) (_noun-like_) register, book (_adjective-like_) personally-tilled

U+85C9 籍 ze3 (common for "mat" and "borrow" senses) ze6 (per 《廣韻》慈夜切 for "mat" and "borrow" senses and Kangxi 慈夜切 for "generous" sense) (F1.78 藉) 賴也借也 (Page 570 #3: ~~？~~籍(9); here normalised to 藉) _(4)long tsik(9)_ (long4 zik6 狼藉) notorious, infamous; (Page 570 #4: 藉(9)) A mat on which things can be presented (Kangxi: 祭藉也); to borrow; ~~to assist, to help;~~ to use for a while; to borrow from, to avail of, to make a means; by; in all which senses it is often read _ts(e/)(3)_ (ze3)_;_ in confusion (Kangxi: 狼藉離披雜亂貌)~~, disturbed~~; liberal, generous (Kangxi: 寬博有餘也); to lead, as by a ~~string~~ rope (Kangxi: 藉繩也); _tsik(9) fuk(7)_ (zik6 fuk1 藉福) by your kindness, I am well; _tsik(9) (2)hau_ (zik6 hau2 藉口), to make a pretext, to gammon; _tsik(9) (4)shan p(i/)(3) yau(6)_ (zik6 san4 bei3 jau6 藉神庇佑) he relied on Divine help; _ts(e/)(6) tsik(9)_ (ze6 zik6 謝藉) to rely on for assistance; _tsik(9) shai(3)_ (zik6 sai3 藉勢) to use the authority of others. Williams' "to assist, to help": This is a misreading of Kangxi 助者藉也. This is an example from Mencius, where 藉也 "borrowing/dependence" is used to explain the specific instance of 助 in the earlier 殷人七十而助. It does *not* define 藉 as "assist/help". Tribute (Kangxi: 藉謂貢獻). 【藉-departing】 (dzjaeH) (_noun-like_) straw-mat (_verb-like_) to depend (upon) (_verb-like_) to borrow, to lend 【藉-entering】 (dzjek) (_noun-like_) tribute

zim3.text: U+4F54 占 (Mainland simplified) (F2.50 占) 霸占擅據也 (Page 16* #8: 占(3)佔(3))

zim1.text: U+5360 詹 zem1 (for Cantonese "jam" sense) (F2.47 占) 騐也測也候也 (Page 15* #5: (1)占) To divine, to cast lots; divination, casting lots (Kangxi: 視兆問也); to observe, to wait for a verification (Kangxi: 𠋫也, 視也); to look towards (Kangxi: 占亦瞻也); _(1)ch(i/)m pat(7) (4)ling_ (zim1 bat1 ling4 占不靈), a false prediction; _(1)ch(i/)m s(un(3) (5)h(a/)_ (zim1 syun3 haa5 占算吓), cast a lot about it; _(1)ch(i/)m kw(a/)(3)_ (zim1 gwaa3 占卦) to prognosticate; _(1)ch(i/)m (i/)m(6)_ (zim1 jim6 占驗) a verification of lots; _(1)ch(i/)m hau(6)_ (zim1 hau6 占候) to foretell seasons; _(1)ch(i/)m ~~chi(u/)(6)~~ shi(u/)(6)_ (zim1 siu6 占兆) to see signs, to foretell by signs. Williams' 占兆: Changed _chi(u/)(6)_ (ziu6) to common reading _shi(u/)(6)_ (siu6). 【占-level】 (tsyem) (_verb-like_) to prognosticate 【占】 (zem1, zim1) Jam (fruit preserve). 果占 (gwo2 zem1): "Fruit jam." 油占多 (jau4 zim1 do1): "Butter jam toast." The spelling 占 is arbitrary (but well established).

zim3.text: U+5360 佔 (F2.50 占) 霸占擅據也 (Page 16* #8: 占(3)佔(3)) To usurp, to seize, to take forcibly (Kangxi 占: 固有也, 擅據也著位也); to assume, to arrogate, to take the liberty; to possess (Kangxi 占: 有也); _p(a/)(3) ch(i/)m(3)_ (baa3 zim3 霸占) to take possession of; _ch(i/)m(3) (1)s(i/)n h(u(3)_ (zim3 sin1 heoi3 占先去) to assume precedence; _ch(i/)m(3) (2)si(u/) sh(i/)n(6)_ (zim3 siu2 sin6 占小善) ~~to praise one's self~~; _ch(i/)m(3) (4)p(')(i/)n (4)(i/)_ (zim3 pin4 ji4-2 占便宜), to take what one likes, to assume more for one's self; _ch(i/)m(3) (1)shan fan(6)_ (zim3 san1 fan6 占身份) to regard one's place, to exercise one's rights. The second character (佔) is commonly but incorrectly used in this sense. Fan Wan entry: Corrected illegible character to 據. Williams' "to praise one's self": This is a misreading of 占小善 from Kangxi's example 《韓愈進學解》占小善者率以錄, which should be rendered "they that possess even a little quality are all employed". Williams' "incorrectly used": The form 佔 is "incorrect" to the extent that, in classical usage, it is an alternative form of 覘 rather than departing-tone 占. See 覘 zim1. 【占-departing】 (tsyemH) (_verb-like_) to occupy (_verb-like_) to possess

zim1.text: U+5C16 鑯 (F2.48 尖) 小也 (Page 571 #5: (1)尖) Sharp, pointed, acute, tapering to a peak or point (Kangxi: 末銳也小也); wedge-like, pyramidal, conical, or needle-shaped; clever, ingenious; _(2)ting (1)ts(i/)m_ (ding2 zim1 頂尖), ready at, smart; _yuk(9) (1)ts(i/)m_ (juk6 zim1 玉尖), a lady's fingers (Kangxi: 玉尖十尖指也); _(1)ts(i/)m l(i/)(6)_ (zim1 lei6 尖利) sharp, quick-witted; _(2)t(a/) (1)ts(i/)m_ (daa2 zim1 打尖), to wedge in, to work one's self in; _(1)p(a/)n (1)ts(i/)m (4)h(a/)i_ (baan1 zim1 haai4 班尖鞋), to dress in women's shoes, to act the female parts. Harsh or ear-piercing (of sound). 【打尖】 (daa2 zim1) To push in. 【尖隊】 (zim1 deoi6-2) To push in line.

U+6CBE 霑 (F2.47 沾) 漬也濡也又沾恩 (Page 15* #6: (1)沾) To moisten, to tinge (Kangxi: 漬也濡也); to receive benefits; to participate in; to be a recipient of; obliged, benefited; imbued with; infected, affected; _(1)ch(i/)m (1)kwong_ (zim1 gwong1 沾光), got it through your favor; _(2)f(u/) lok(9) (1)kwan (1)ch(i/)m_ (fu2 lok6 gwan1 zim1 苦樂均沾), sorrow and joy equally bestowed; _(1)ch(i/)m (1)yan ~~ch(a/)k(8)~~ ch(a/)k(9)_ (zim1 jan1 zaak6 沾恩澤) received benefits; _(1)ch(i/)m peng(6)_ (zim1 beng6 沾病) to catch a disease; _(1)ch(i/)m (5)(i/)m shai(3) (4)ts(')ing_ (zim1 jim5 sai3 cing4 沾染世情), to be corrupted by bad influences; _(5)n(i/) (1)ch(i/)m ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (5)yau tik(7) (4)'m (2)h(o\) (4)p(')(i/) h(i/)(3)_ (nei5 zim1 zoek6 jau5 dik1 m4 hou2 pei4 hei3 你沾着有滴唔好脾氣) you have contracted a bad temper. (Page 15* #7: (1)霑) Interchanged with the last (沾). Williams' 沾恩澤: Corrected _ch(a/)k(8)_ (zaak3) to _ch(a/)k(9)_ (zaak6). Williams' 你沾着有滴唔好脾氣: Corrected _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) to _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6). 【沾】 (trjem) (_verb-like_) to moisten, to soak

U+77BB 詹 (F2.47 瞻) 瞻仰 (Page 16* #3: (1)~~？~~瞻) To look up to, to reverence, to regard with respect (Kangxi 瞻: 仰視曰瞻); _(1)ch(i/)m (5)y(e/)ung_ (zim1 joeng5 瞻仰), to look up to; to have an audience; _(5)y(e/)ung (1)ch(i/)m (1)sh(a/)n (2)tau_ (joeng5 zim1 saan1 dau2 仰瞻山斗), I look up to you, said to a sage or magnate; _(1)ch(i/)m mong(6)_ (zim1 mong6 瞻望) to long for, to anticipate; _(1)ch(i/)m (2)p(i/) yat(9) (ut(9)_ (zim1 bei2 jat6 jyut6 瞻彼日月) I look at the sun and moon, _i. e._ on my conscience; _(1)ch(i/)m sh(i/)(6)_ (zim1 si6 瞻視) to expect. Williams misprints 瞻 as ⿰目⿸广⿱儿言; here corrected. (The character 瞻 appears correctly on Page 788 in the character index.) To look forward. 【瞻】 (tsyem) (_verb-like_) to look (at) (_verb-like_) to look up (to)

U+7C98 黏 (F2.47 粘) ？也 (F2.47 秥) 秥米 (Page 15* #9: (1)粘) (Page 16* #1: (1)黏; here normalised to 粘) Used for the preceding (粘); rice; _(1)ch(i/)m (5)mai_ (zim1 mai5 粘米), white rice, of which there are many kinds, as _s(ut(8) (1)ch(i/)m_ (syut3 zim1 雪粘), _(2)ai (4)mi(u/) (1)ch(i/)m_ (ai2 miu4 zim1 矮苖粘), _(1)ch(i/)m (2)tsai_ (zim1 zai2 粘仔), &c. Fan Wan entry: The first character of the explanation for 粘 is incomprehensible, but appears like ⿰苗月.

U+8998 佔 占 沾 䀡 觇 (Mainland simplified) cim1 (per 《廣韻》丑廉切) cim3 (per 《廣韻》丑豔切) (F2.47 覘) 闚視也 (Page 15* #8: (1)覘) To peep, to spy at, to glance at (Kangxi: 窺也); _(1)ch(i/)m hau(6)_ (zim1 hau6 覘候) to wait for; _(1)ch(i/)m k(i/)n(3)_ (zim1 gin3 覘見) to take a look at. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿰古見 to 覘. 【覘】 (trhjem, trhjemH) (_verb-like_) to spy (upon)

U+8A79 譫 (for "verbose" sense) (F2.47 詹) 姓亦竹名 (F2.47 𦧕) 同上 (Page 16* #2: (1)詹) ~~Tattling~~, wordy (Kangxi: 多言也); to reach (Kangxi: 至也); ~~at, extreme, such a time;~~ to examine and direct; _(1)ch(i/)m (1)ch(i/)m_ (zim1 zim1 詹詹), loquacious; _(2)kan (1)ch(i/)m_ (gan2 zim1 謹詹), carefully ~~provide~~ select. Fan Wan entry: Corrected headword ⿸厃⿳八土口 to 𦧕. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【詹】 (tsyem) (_adjective-like_) verbose (_verb-like_) to arrive

U+8B6B 噡 谵 (Mainland simplified) (F2.47 譫) 多言也 (Page 16* #6: (1)譫) Wordy, loquacious (Kangxi: 多言也); _peng(6) (1)ch(i/)m_ (beng6 zim1 病譫), out of his head, incoherent; _(1)ch(i/)m (5)(u_ (zim1 jyu5 譫語), wandering talk. Delirium (Kangxi: 病也).

U+9711 (F2.47 霑) 霑足雨之多也 (Page 15* #7: (1)霑) A drizzling, dripping, pattering, rain (Kangxi: 雨𩃵也); to wet through (Kangxi: 霑濕也又濡也漬也); soaked, saturated; _(1)ch(i/)m tsuk(7)_ (zim1 zuk1 霑足) wet to the skin; _(1)ch(i/)m (1)(i/)_ (zim1 ji1 霑衣), wet clothes. 【霑】 (trjem) (_verb-like_) to moisten, to soak
U+9ECF (F2.47 粘) ？也 (F2.47 秥) 秥米 (Page 16* #1: (1)黏) Fan Wan entry: The first character of the explanation for 粘 is incomprehensible, but appears like ⿰苗月.

zim6.text: U+9B59 zaam2 (per Kangxi 側減切) (Page 728 #2: 魙(6)) A prince of demons (Kangxi: 鬼名), at the sight of whom ogres and vampires flee; used as a charm (Kangxi: 辟邪也符尾也).

zin1.text: U+5103 sin4 (per 《廣韻》市連切) taan4 (per 《廣韻》徒干切) (F1.20 儃) 態也又儃回不進也 (Page 16* #11: (1)儃) Manner, air, figure (Kangxi: 態也); look; _(1)ch(i/)n ~~(1)(u/)i~~ (4)(u/)i_ (zin1 wui4 儃佪), undecided whether to go on, irresolute (Kangxi: 儃佪不進貌). Williams' 儃佪: Corrected _(1)(u/)i_ (wui1) to _(4)(u/)i_ (wui4). 【儃-level】 (dzyen) (_adjective-like_) hesitating

U+65C3 旜 (F1.20 旃) 通白之器又解曰之 (Page 16* #10: (1)旃) A silken banner (Kangxi: 通帛爲旃); a flag with a crooked flag-staff (Kangxi: 旗曲柄也); ~~to signalize one to come.~~ Contraction of 之焉. 【旃】 (tsyen) (_noun-like_) banner Contraction of 之焉 (tsyi hjen).
U+6BE1 (F1.20 氊) 以毛爲物曰氊 (F1.20 毡) 同上 (Page 16* #12: (1)毡(1)氊)

U+6C08 旃 毡 氊 (F1.20 氊) 以毛爲物曰氊 (F1.20 毡) 同上 (Page 16* #12: (1)毡(1)氊; here normalised to 氈) Hair or wool worked into a felt (Kangxi 氈: 撚毛也); coarse woolens, as blankets, carpets, rugs; _t(i/)(6) (1)ch(i/)n_ (dei6 zin1 地氈), a carpet; _(1)ch(i/)n m(o\)(6)_ (zin1 mou6-2 氈帽) a felt hat; _p(a/)k(9) (1)ch(i/)n_ (baak6 zin1 白氈), a blanket; _(4)h(a/)i (1)ch(i/)n_ (haai4 zin1 鞋氈), felt for soles; _ch(')(e/)uk(8) (1)ch(i/)n_ (coek3 zin1 桌氈), a table-cover; _(1)ch(i/)n (1)p(a/)u_ (zin1 baau1 氈包), a carpet-bag; _(1)ch(i/)n (2)ch(i/)_ (zin1 zi2 氈紙), coarse rough paper. 【氈】 (tsyen) (_noun-like_) felt
U+6C0A (F1.20 氊) 以毛爲物曰氊 (F1.20 毡) 同上 (Page 16* #12: (1)毡(1)氊)
U+6E54 (F1.20 湔) 湔洗 (Page 573 #1: (1)湔) To sprinkle with the hand, to bespatter (Kangxi: 手瀚也灑也傍沾也); name of a river in Sz'chuen (四川) (Kangxi: 水名). To wash.

U+714E 㷙 (F1.20 煎) 熬煎 (Page 572 #12: (1)煎) To fry, to roast, to decoct in a pan (Kangxi: 熬也, 火去汁也, 熟煑也, 火乾也, etc.); to vex, to harass; _(1)ts(i/)n (1)k(o\)_ (zin1 gou1 煎膏), to express lard; _yung(6) (4)yau (1)ts(i/)n_ (jung6 jau4 zin1 用油煎), use fat in frying it; _m(a/)n(6) (2)fo (1)ts(i/)n (4)(u_ (maan6 fo2 zin1 jyu4-2 慢火煎魚), a slow fire tries fish; _i. e._ small bets will erelong drain the purse; _(1)ts(i/)n ~~(4)nung~~ (1)nung_ (zin1 nung1 煎燶), to fry brown; _~~ng(o\)(6)~~ (4)ng(o\) (1)ts(i/)n_ (ngou4 zin1 熬煎), to simmer, to decoct~~; vexed, irritated~~. Williams' 煎燶: Corrected _(4)nung_ (nung4) to _(1)nung_ (nung1). Williams' 熬煎: Corrected _ng(o\)(6)_ (ngou6) to _(4)ng(o\)_ (ngou4). To shallow-fry. To smelt. 【煎】 (tsjen) (_verb-like_) to decoct

zin3.text: U+714E 㷙 (Page 572 #12: (1)煎) Read _ts(i/)n(3)_ (zin3)_;_ to decoct, to boil, to digest with heat; to simmer; _ts(i/)n(3) chap(7)_ (zin3 zap1 煎汁) to fry in its own juices, as fruit; _ts(i/)n(3) (1)t(')ong_ (zin3 tong1 煎湯), to boil slowly; _ts(i/)n(3) y(e/)uk(9)_ (zin3 joek6 煎藥) to decoct medicines. Classically, the "decoct" sense is in the level tone. The (vernacular?) reading in the departing tone is perhaps to distinguish it from the "shallow-fry" sense. Used in 甲煎 (a fragrant concoction) (Kangxi: 甲煎香名).

zin1.text: U+76BD (Page 17* #1: (1)皽) ~~To tear off, as a scab or placard;~~ to flay; to rip up; _(1)ch(i/)n (2)h(i/)_ (zin1 hei2 皽起), rip it up; _(1)ch(i/)n lat(7)_ (zin1 lat1 皽甩) rip it off.

zin2.text: U+76BD ziu1 (alternative per 《廣韻》止遥切) (Page 17* #1: (1)皽 _(1)Ch(i/)n_ (zin1); here corrected to _(2)Ch(i/)n_ (zin2)) thin scurf skin, a scab (Kangxi: 離也, 皮寬也, 皮肉之上魄膜也); 【皽】 (trjenX, tsyenX) (_noun-like_) skin-crust

zin1.text: U+7B8B 牋 笺 (Mainland simplified) (F1.20 箋) 簡牒 (Page 573 #3: (1)箋) Tablets or slips on which to make memoranda (Kangxi: 表識書也); a letter, a writing (Kangxi: 書也); note paper with water-line or stamped pictures; writings handed to the monarch; _(1)ts(i/)n (2)ch(i/)_ (zin1 zi2 箋紙), fancy notepaper; _ts(')at(7) (4)hong (1)ts(i/)n_ (cat1 hong4 zin1 七行箋), seven lined billet paper; _l(a/)p(9) (1)ts(i/)n_ (laap6 zin1 蠟箋), glazed billet paper. A commentary at a lower level than a 傳 or 註, used self-deprecatingly (Kangxi: 聖人制作曰經賢者著述曰傳...謙敬不敢言註但表識其不明者耳). 【箋】 (tsen) (_noun-like_) lesser-note

U+7C5B 篯 (Mainland simplified) (F1.20 籛) 彭祖姓 (Page 573 #4: (1)籛) A man's name, called _(1)Ts(i/)n (1)Hang_ (zin1 hang1 籛鏗), or Tsien Hing, who lived in the Sh(a/)ng (商) and Chau (周) dynasties, to the age of 767, ~~and then vanished~~ yet waned not (Kangxi: 彭祖姓籛名鏗...歷夏殷周年七百六十七歲而不衰). Williams' "man's name": Specifically, a surname (Kangxi: 姓也).

U+7FB6 䍹 羴 膻 sin1 (per 《廣韻》式連切) (F1.20 羶) 腥羶羊脂也 (Page 17* #2: (1)羶) The rank oder of goats (Kangxi: 羊臭也, 羊脂也羊氣也); frowzy; ~~sheep's fat, mutton tallow;~~ _ch(')au(3) (1)ch(i/)n_ (cau3 zin1 臭羶), fetid, rank; _(1)seng (1)ch(i/)n_ (seng1 zin1 腥羶), frowzy. Williams' "sheep's fat, mutton tallow": Here, Williams has been misled by Kangxi 羊脂也, which (I think) is intended not just as "sheep's fat", but should be interpolated to "the smell of sheep's fat". 【羶】 (syen) (_noun-like_) rank-odour
U+81BB

U+9085 zin6 (per 《廣韻》持碾切 for "turn" sense and 除善切 for "shift/move" sense) (F1.20 邅) 迍邅 (Page 17* #3: (1)邅) Unable to advance (Kangxi: 迍邅難行不進貌); _(1)chun (1)ch(i/)n_ (zeon1 zin1 迍邅), making no progress, unlucky in life, unfortunate. Kangxi erroneously has 𧾍上聲 and 𧾍去聲 the wrong way round. To turn (Kangxi: 轉也逐也). To shift, to move (Kangxi: 移也). 【邅-departing】 (drjenH) (_verb-like_) to turn 【邅-level】 (trjen) (_adjective-like_) hindered
U+986B 颤 (Mainland simplified) sin1 (per 《集韻》尸連切) (F1.20 顫) 四肢奏掉曰顫 (Page 17* #4: (1)顫) Discerning of smells (Kangxi: 謂審於氣臭也). 【顫-level】 (syen) (_noun-like_) discernment of smells

zin3.text: U+986B 颤 (Mainland simplified) zin1 (per Fan Wan) (F1.20 顫 _(1)Ch(i/)n_ (zin1)) 四肢奏掉曰顫 (Page 17* #4: (1)顫 _(1)Ch(i/)n_ (zin1); here normalised to _Ch(i/)n(3)_ (zin3)) ~~The head awry (Kangxi: 頭不正也);~~ shivering with cold; the limbs cold and trembling (Kangxi: 四支寒動也); fearful, frightened; _sz'(3) (1)ch(i/) ~~(1)ch(i/)n~~ ch(i/)n(3) tung(6)_ (si3 zi1 zin3 dung6 四肢顫動) trembling all over; _(4)hon ~~(1)ch(i/)n~~ ch(i/)n(3)_ (hon4 zin3 寒顫), shivering. Williams' "The head awry": According to 段玉裁's annotations of 《說文》, 頭不正也 should instead be 頭不定也 "the head not steady". In other words, shaking or trembling. 【顫-departing】 (tsyenH) (_verb-like_) to tremble

zin1.text: U+9958 May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 𫗴 (Mainland simplified) zin2 (alternative per 《廣韻》旨善切) (F1.20 饘) 粥也 (F1.20 飦) 同上 (Page 17* #5: (1)饘) Congee or gruel made from rice, thoroughly boiled (Kangxi: 糜也); _(1)ch(i/)n chuk(7)_ (zin1 zuk1 饘粥) congee. 【饘】 (tsyen, tsyenX) (_noun-like_) porridge

U+9C63 鳣 (Mainland simplified) (F1.20 鱣) 魚名 (Page 17* #6: (1)鱣) ~~A sea-monster;~~ a large sturgeon, or perhaps a grampus (Kangxi: 大魚似鱏 etc.); _(1)ch(i/)n (4)k(')ing_ (zin1 king4 鱣鯨), whales and grampuses, applied to an unscrupulous, grasping man. 【鱣】 (trjen) (_noun-like_) great-sturgeon

U+9E07 鹯 (Mainland simplified) (F1.20 鸇) 食雀之鳥 (Page 17* #7: (1)鸇) A falcon, goshawk, or kite (Kangxi: 鷙鳥); a yellow bird which pursues pigeons (Kangxi: 鸇似鷂黃色...擊鳩鴿燕雀食之); a sparrow-hawk. 【鸇】 (tsyen) (_noun-like_) hawk

zin2.text: U+526A 翦 (F1.22 剪) 裁也又較剪 (F1.22 翦) 齊也截以殺也 (Page 573 #6: (2)翦(2)剪) to cut off smooth, to clip even (Kangxi 翦: 翦齊也); to shear; shears, scissors; _yat(7) (2)p(a/) (2)ts(i/)n (1)t(o\)_ (jat1 baa2 zin2 dou1 一把剪刀), a pair of scissors; _t(a/)i(6) k(a/)u(3) (2)ts(i/)n_ (daai6 gaau3 zin2 大鉸剪), shears; _~~ch(a/)p(8)~~ ch(a/)p(9) (2)ts(i/)n_ (zaap6 zin2 鈒剪), betel-nut shears; _(4)ts(')oi (2)ts(i/)n_ (coi4 zin2 裁剪), to cut out garments; to manage, to plan; Fan Wan entry: Corrected 栽 to 裁 and ⿰糸殳 to 殺. Williams does not provide separate entries for 剪 and 翦. In modern usage, the "scissors" and "cut" senses is spelt 剪, whilst the other (classical) senses are spelt 翦. I have split things up accordingly, with duplication where appropriate. Williams' 鈒剪: Corrected _ch(a/)p(8)_ (zaap3) to _ch(a/)p(9)_ (zaap6). 【鉸剪】 (gaau3 zin2) Scissors. (Note that Fan Wan spells this 較剪.) 把鉸剪鈍 (baa2 gaau3 zin2 deon6): "The pair of scissors is blunt." 鉸剪腳 (gaau3 zin2 goek3): "Scissor legs" (i.e. a neck-locking scissor-kick in martial arts).

U+5C55 㞡 (F1.22 展) 舒展 (Page 17* #8: (2)展) To open out, to unroll (Kangxi: 開也)~~, and inspect~~; to exhibit (Kangxi: 展陳也), to disentangle; to stretch out at one's ease (Kangxi: 舒也), to expand; to inspect, to judge of, to look into (Kangxi: 審也視也, 展省閱也); true, sincere (Kangxi: 一曰誠也); cheerful, pleasant; ~~gratified;~~ _yuk(9) (2)ch(i/)n_ (juk6 zin2 玉展), may you open this; _(2)ch(i/)n hon(3)_ (zin2 hon3 展看) to open and look at; _(2)ch(i/)n (1)hoi_ (zin2 hoi1 展開), to spread out, to open (as a letter); _(2)ch(i/)n (4)m(i/)_ (zin2 mei4 展眉), a pleasant face; _(2)ch(i/)n (u/)n(6)_ (zin2 wun6 展緩) to defer, to put off to get time; _(2)ch(i/)n h(a/)n(6)_ (zin2 haan6 展限) to extend the time. To record (Kangxi: 展猶錄也). To implement, to bring about. 【展】 (trjenX) (_verb-like_) to unfurl, to exhibit (_verb-like_) to examine (_adverb-like_) verily

U+6229 戬 (Mainland simplified) (F1.22 戩) 盡也 (Page 573 #8: (2)戩) to finish, to exhaust; entirely (Kangxi: 盡也); _pat(7) (2)ts(i/)n_ (bat1 zin2 不戩), unlimited. A blessing. 【戩】 (tsjenX) (_adjective-like_) complete
U+78BE (F1.22 碾) 轢也又音研 (Page 17* #9: (2)碾)

U+7FE6 前 剪 戩 (F1.22 剪) 裁也又較剪 (F1.22 翦) 齊也截以殺也 (Page 573 #6: (2)翦(2)剪) Even, regular, as feathers grow (Kangxi 翦: 羽生也); to cut off smooth, to clip even (Kangxi 翦: 翦齊也, 齊斷也); to kill, to destroy (Kangxi 翦: 殺也, 翦斷滅之言也); to reduce, to clip off (Kangxi 翦: 翦削也); light, as a dye (Kangxi 翦: 翦淺也); _(2)ts(i/)n (2)ts(i/)n_ (zin2 zin2 翦翦), subtle at argument; _(2)ts(i/)n t(i/)(6) (4)k(')au (4)wo_ (zin2 dei6 kau4 wo4 翦地求和), to give up territory and beg for peace. (Page 573 #8: (2)戩; here normalised to 翦) To destroy, to kill, to exterminate (Kangxi 戩: 與翦通, 滅也); to clip, to shear; Fan Wan entry: Corrected 栽 to 裁 and ⿰糸殳 to 殺. Williams does not provide separate entries for 剪 and 翦. In modern usage, the "scissors" and "cut" senses is spelt 剪, whilst the other (classical) senses are spelt 翦. I have split things up accordingly, with duplication where appropriate. Utterly (Kangxi: 翦盡也). Pale (Kangxi: 翦淺也). 【翦】 (tsjenX) (_verb-like_) to clip, to cut, (_met._) to annihilate (_adverb-like_) utterly (_adjective-like_) pale

U+8AD3 𬣡 (Mainland simplified) cin5 (per 《廣韻》慈演切) zin1 (alternative per 《集韻》將先切) zin6 (per 《廣韻》才線切) (F1.20 諓 _(1)Ts(i/)n_ (zin1)) 巧言也 (Page 573 #5: (2)諓) To flatter (Kangxi: 諂也); pleasant, kind words (Kangxi: 善言也); sly insinuations (Kangxi: 巧讒貌); _(2)ts(i/)n (2)ts(i/)n_ (zin2 zin2 諓諓), shallow, artful talk (Kangxi: 巧言也, 淺薄貌). The reading _(2)ts(i/)n_ (zin2) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 子淺切, explained 諓諓淺薄皃一曰巧言也一曰善也. 【諓】 (dzjenX, dzjenH) (_adjective-like_) artful
U+8B2D (F1.22 謭) 謭劣粗也陋也 (Page 573 #7: (2)謭)

U+8B7E 謭 谫 (Mainland simplified) (F1.22 謭) 謭劣粗也陋也 (Page 573 #7: (2)謭; here normalised to 譾) Shallow-pated, superficial, not profound; unskilled, shallow, not deep (Kangxi 譾: 淺也); _(4)ts(')oi (2)ts(i/)n_ (coi4 zin2 材譾), mediocre, of small capacity; _(2)ts(i/)n ~~l(ut(8)~~ l(ut(9)_ (zin2 lyut6 譾劣) mean, insignificant. Williams' 譾劣: Changed _l(ut(8)_ (lyut3) to _l(ut(9)_ (lyut6).

U+8F3E 展 辗 (Mainland simplified) (F1.22 輾) 轉之半曰輾 (Page 17* #10: (2)輾) To roll over half way (Kangxi: 輾者轉之半也); to turn over (Kangxi: 轉也); _(2)ch(i/)n (2)ch(un (2)f(a/)n ~~ch(')ak(7)~~ chak(7)_ (zin2 zyun2 faan2 zak1 輾轉反側) to turn back and forth, to think on. Williams' 輾轉反側: Corrected _ch(')ak(7)_ (cak1) to _chak(7)_ (zak1). 【輾】 (trjenX) (_verb-like_) to roll (over), (_met._) to toss

zin3.text: U+6230 战 (Mainland simplified) (F1.25 戰) 閩戰又恐懼貌 (Page 17* #12: 戰(3)) To fight (Kangxi: 鬭也); ~~to be alarmed,~~ struck with dread (Kangxi: 懼也); fearful~~, anxious~~; a battle, an engagement; war, hostilities; military, pertaining to war; _h(ut(8) ch(i/)n(3)_ (hyut3 zin3 血戰) a bloody fight; _ch(i/)n(3) shing(3)_ (zin3 sing3 戰勝) a victory; _(2)t(a/) ch(i/)n(3)_ (daa2 zin3 打戰) terrified; _ch(i/)n(3) tau(3)_ (zin3 dau3 戰鬥) or _(1)k(a/)u ch(i/)n(3)_ (gaau1 zin3 交戰) to join battle; _ch(i/)n(3) ~~(4)ch(')an~~ chan(6)_ (zin3 zan6 戰陳), troops drawn up for battle; _ch(i/)n(3) ~~p(a/)i(3)~~ p(a/)i(6)_ (zin3 baai6 戰敗) to be discomfited; _ch(i/)n(3) ch(i/)n(3) (1)king (1)king_ (zin3 zin3 ging1 ging1 戰戰兢兢), frightened, afraid of; _ch(i/)n(3) (4)sh(un_ (zin3 syun4 戰船), a war-junk, a ship of war; _ch(i/)n(3) (1)sh(u_ (zin3 syu1 戰書), a challenge to fight. Fan Wan entry: 閩 is probably a typo for 鬪 or similar. Williams' 戰陳: Corrected _(4)ch(')an_ (can4) to _chan(6)_ (zan6). Williams' 戰敗: Corrected _p(a/)i(3)_ (baai3) to _p(a/)i(6)_ (baai6). 【戰】 (tsyenH) (_verb-like_) to battle (_verb-like_) to tremble

U+6D0A 瀳 zin6 (per 《廣韻》在甸切) (F1.23 洊) 重復也 (Page 573 #12: 洊(3)) ~~Water flowing on;~~ a stream bursting forth again; repeated (Kangxi: 通薦); _ts(i/)n(3) lik(9)_ (zin3 lik6 洊歷) successively. Water arriving (Kangxi 瀳: 水至也).
U+726E (F1.23 牮) 屋斜用牮 (Page 574 #1: 牮(3)) A prop to shore up a leaning house (Kangxi: 屋斜用牮); a sluice or weir of earth or stone to lead water (Kangxi: 以土石遮水亦曰牮). Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰余刂 to 斜.

U+7BAD (F1.23 箭) 弓箭 (Page 573 #9: 箭(3)) An arrow (Kangxi: 矢也); an archer; a bowshot; to dart out very quickly; swift, like an arrow; a slender sort of bamboo (Kangxi: 竹之小者曰箭, 箭篠也); ~~bristling;~~ _sh(e/)(6) ts(i/)n(3)_ (se6 zin3 射箭) to shoot an arrow; _(1)kung ts(i/)n(3)_ (gung1 zin3 弓箭) bow and arrow; _lau(6) ts(i/)n(3)_ (lau6 zin3 漏箭) the gauge in a clepsydra; _(2)fo ts(i/)n(3)_ (fo2 zin3 火箭) a fire arrow; _(2)h(e/)ung ts(i/)n(3)_ (hoeng2 zin3 響箭) a whirring arrow; _(2)h(o\) ts(i/)n(3)_ (hou2 zin3 好箭) a good shot; _(5)m(a/) ts(i/)n(3)_ (maa5 zin3 馬箭) mounted archers; _(o\)m(3) ts(i/)n(3) (1)sh(e/)ung (4)yan_ (am3 zin3 soeng1 jan4 暗箭傷人), to injure one with a secret arrow---slander; _fong(3) ~~(5)lang~~ (5)l(a/)ng ts(i/)n(3)_ (fong3 laang5 zin3 放冷箭) to shoot at privily; _yat(7) ts(i/)n(3) (1)ch(i/) t(i/)(6)_ (jat1 zin3 zi1 dei6 一箭之地) a bowshot, or 120 _ch(')ek(8)_ (cek3 尺). Williams' 火箭: Now "rocket". Williams' 放冷箭: Changed _(5)lang_ (lang5) to common reading _(5)l(a/)ng_ (laang5). 【箭】 (tsjenH) (_noun-like_) arrow (_noun-like_) small-bamboo 【箭嘴】 (zin3 zeoi2) An arrow. 紅箭嘴 (hung4 zin3 zeoi2): "Red arrow." 綠箭嘴 (luk6 zin3 zeoi2): "Green arrow."

U+8350 洊 薦 zin6 (per 《廣韻》在甸切) (F1.23 薦) 舉薦祭亦曰薦 (F1.23 荐) 同上 (Page 573 #11: 荐(3)) also to continue; ~~some;~~ to succeed, to recur repeatedly (Kangxi: 重也, 仍也), as a famine; repeatedly, again. Nomadically (Kangxi: 荐草也言逐水草而居徙無常處). 【荐】 (dzenH) (_noun-like_) grass, (_met._) nomadically (_adverb-like_) repeatedly

U+85A6 墊 (for "padding" senses) 荐 din3 (for 墊 "padding") din6 (per Williams for 墊 "padding") zin3-2 (vernacular rising-tone for "padding" senses) (F1.23 薦) 舉薦祭亦曰薦 (F1.23 荐) 同上 (Page 519 #11: 墊(6) _T(i/)n(6)_ (din6); here normalised to 薦 _Ts(i/)n(3)_ (zin3)) To lay down, to place on; to place under, to wedge; _(2)(i/) ~~t(i/)n(3)~~ ts(i/)n(3)_ (ji2 zin3 椅薦) a chair cushion; _(4)t(')ang ~~t(i/)n(6)~~ ts(i/)n(3)_ (tang4 zin3-2 藤薦) rattan table mats; _k(')ong(3) ~~t(i/)n(6)~~ ts(i/)n(3)_ (kong3 zin3 炕薦) a long sofa cushion; _~~t(i/)n(6)~~ ts(i/)n(3) yuk(9)_ (zin3 juk6-2 薦褥) a mattress; (Page 573 #10: 薦(3)) Grass eaten by animals (Kangxi: 獸之所食草也); pasturage; ~~to lead animals to good pastures;~~ to introduce, to recommend; to lay out (Kangxi: 進也) food (Kangxi: 未食未飮曰薦 etc.); to adore, to worship without a victim (Kangxi: 無牲而祭曰薦); to wedge, to wedge in; _ts(i/)n(3) (4)t(')oi k(e/)uk(8)_ (zin3 toi4-2 goek3 薦檯腳) to wedge the table; _ts(i/)n(3) (2)ts(o\)_ (zin3 zou2 薦祖), to worship ancestors; _(2)k(u ts(i/)n(3)_ (geoi2 zin3 舉薦) to recommend one; _(2)s(e/) ts(i/)n(3) (1)sh(u_ (se2 zin3 syu1 寫薦書), to write an introductory letter; _(5)yau ts(i/)n(3) (4)t(')au_, (jau5 zin3 tau4 有薦頭) there is some opening; _f(u/)(6) ts(i/)n(3)_ (fu6 zin3 附薦) to get a soul out of purgatory by priests; _ts(i/)n(3) ts(')oi(3)_ (zin3 coi3 薦菜) take a little greens---with your wine; said to a guest; _ts(i/)n(3) (2)h(i/)_ (zin3 hei2 薦起) raise it up. (Page 573 #11: 荐(3)) Interchanged with the last (薦); A straw mat (Kangxi 荐: 荐薦席也). 【薦】 (tsenH) (_noun-like_) grass-fodder (_noun-like_) padding (_verb-like_) to present, to recommend 【薦-noun】 (zin3, zin3-2) A pad, cushion, or mat. 杯薦 (bui1 zin3): "A cup-coaster." 鞋薦 (haai4 zin3-2): "Shoe padding". 【薦-verb】 (zin3) To pad or cushion underneath. 薦底 (zin3 dai2): "Padding out the bottom" (i.e. coming last, especially in a higher division or more prestigious environment). 薦鐺底 (zin3 caang1 dai2): "To cushion under the bottom of the pot." 冇嘢薦住 (mou5 je5 zin3 zyu6): "Nothing cushioning it underneath." Olden attestation for 薦 meaning "mat/cushion": 《說文》葬：藏也从死在茻中一其中所以薦之... 《說文》枕：臥所薦首者... 《廣韻》作甸切 薦 薦席又薦進也... Strictly speaking, the original word for "mat/cushion" is 荐 _ts(i/)n(6)_ (zin6), with 薦 _ts(i/)n(3)_ (zin3) being a later spelling based on phonetic nearness. In modern usage, the spelling 墊 is common for _ts(i/)n(3)_ (zin3), from appropriation of formal 墊 _t(i/)n(3)_ (din3). However, note that 墊 _t(i/)n(3)_ (din3) meaning "padding" is not attested in the Middle Chinese rime books.

U+991E May appear with radical component 𩙿 or 飠 (assumed here), depending on the font. 䬻 饯 (Mainland simplified) cin5 (per 《廣韻》慈演切) zin6 (per 《廣韻》才線切) (F1.23 餞) 以酒食送行曰餞 (Page 574 #2: 餞(3)) To present food to one, to give a farewell dinner to (Kangxi: 送去也, 酒食送也); ~~to send food to;~~ parting present of ~~money or~~ food (Kangxi: 餞者進飮食之名也); comfits; _ts(i/)n(3) (4)hang_ (zin3 hang4 餞行), to give a dinner to one traveling; _ts(i/)n(3) p(i/)t(9)_ (zin3 bit6 餞別) a leave-taking dinner; _mat(9) ts(i/)n(3) (4)t(')ong (2)kwo_ (mat6 zin3 tong4 gwo2 蜜餞糖果), comfits and sweetmeats; _ts(i/)n(3) (5)lai_ (zin3 lai5 餞禮), presents to a traveler. To send off by accompanying (Kangxi: 凡送皆曰餞). 【餞】 (dzjenX, dzjenH) (_verb-like_) to departure-feast, to send off

zin6.text: U+8CE4 賎 贱 (Mainland simplified) (F1.25 賤) 卑下也 (Page 574 #4: 賤(6)) Worthless, vile, mean, low, ignoble, base (Kangxi: 卑下也不貴也); cheap, low-priced (Kangxi: 賈少也); to disesteem, to depreciate, to lower (Kangxi: 輕賤); used for what belongs to one's self; _(4)p(')an ts(i/)n(6)_ (pan4 zin6 貧賤) poor and mean; _ts(i/)n(6) noi(6)_ (zin6 noi6 賤內) my wife; _ts(i/)n(6) sing(3) Wai(6)_ (zin6 sing3 wai6 賤姓衛) my surname is Wai (衛); _ts(i/)n(6) s(e/)ung(3)_ (zin6 soeng3 賤相) a poor physiognomy, a thief's face; _ts(i/)n(6) kwat(7) (4)t(')au_ (zin6 gwat1 tau4 賤骨頭), a miserable stick; _ts(i/)n(6) (4)yan_ (zin6 jan4 賤人), you poor baggage! said of women; _k(a/)(3) (4)ts(')(i/)n (2)h(o\) ts(i/)n(6)_ (gaa3 cin4 hou2 zin6 價錢好賤) the price is very low; _ts(i/)n(6) k(a/)k(8)_ (zin6 gaak3 賤格) a miserable lot, of poor talents; _ts(i/)n(6) mat(9) tau(3) (4)k(')ung (4)yan_ (zin6 mat6 dau3 kung4 jan4 賤物鬥窮人), the poor may meddle with cheap things; _tsok(8) ts(i/)n(6)_ (zok3 zin6 作賤) he disgraced himself. Williams' 賤人: Now (and in classical illeism) said of both sexes. 【賤】 (dzjenH) (_adjective-like_) cheap, lowly (_verb-like_) to hold cheap 【賤格】 (zin6 gaak3) Vile, base, despicable.

zing1.text: U+5075 侦 (Mainland simplified) cing1 (per 《廣韻》丑貞切) (F1.68 偵) 伺探也 (Page 18* #5: (1)偵) A spy (vulgo, _y(e/)(6) pat(7) ~~(4)shau~~ (1)shau_ (je6 bat1 sau1 夜不收)), a scout; to reconnoitre, to inquire (Kangxi: 𠋫也探伺也); _(4)yau (1)ching_ (jau4 zing1 遊偵) or _(1)ching t(')(a/)m(3)_ (zing1 taam3 偵探) to spy. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 何 to 伺. Williams' 夜不收: Corrected _(4)shau_ (sau4) to _(1)shau_ (sau1).

U+5F81 徰 正 (F1.68 征) 往也取也伐也又正也 (Page 18* #3: (1)征) To go (Kangxi: 行也), to expedition; to take (Kangxi: 征取也); to collect taxes; to go out to chastise, to reduce refractory states (Kangxi: 征伐也, 征者上伐下也), to subjugate, to conquer; ~~to spy;~~ _(1)ching ~~f(a/)t(9)~~ fat(9)_ (zing1 fat6 征伐) to reduce to subjection; _(1)ching (2)t(')(o\)_ (zing1 tou2 征討), to ~~collect tribute~~ punish by force; _(1)ching (1)f(u/)_ (zing1 fu1 征夫), warriors; _(1)ching (1)shau_ (zing1 sau1 征收), to assess taxes; _(1)ching (1)ch(u_ (zing1 zyu1 征誅), to exterminate; _ch(')ut(7) (1)ching_ (ceot1 zing1 出征), to go abroad on an expedition; _(1)ching shui(3) (4)l(e/)ung_ (zing1 seoi3 loeng4 征稅糧), to levy taxes; _(1)ching (2)tsi(u/)_ (zing1 ziu2 征勦), to exterminate rebels. Williams' 征伐: Changed _f(a/)t(9)_ (faat6) to modern _fat(9)_ (fat6). 【征】 (tsyeng) (_verb-like_) to (make) expedition (_verb-like_) to correct punitively (_verb-like_) to take (_verb-like_) to levy

U+65CC sing1 (common) (F1.67 旌) 旌旗又旌表 (Page 575 #6: (1)旌) A banner, a standard having plumes, which when waved encourage the troops (Kangxi: 析羽注旄首所以進士卒); to make signals; insignia, signals; ~~to discriminate,~~ to make manifest, to prove, to show forth (Kangxi: 旌旗所以表識貴賤故傳以旌爲識, 旌章也, 旌表也, 旌明也); _(1)tsing (4)k(')(i/)_ (zing1 kei4 旌旗), flags; _(4)ming (1)tsing_ (ming4 zing1 明旌), red banners hung by a corpse; _(1)tsing (2)pi(u/)_ (zing1 biu2 旌表), testimonials of merit granted by the sovereign, and often placed over the door. Williams' "to discriminate": This is a misreading of Kangxi 《書畢命》旌別淑慝《傳》言當識別頑民之善惡《疏》旌旗所以表識貴賤故傳以旌爲識. Here, 旌 means "signify". It is 別 which means "discriminate". 【旌】 (tsjeng) (_noun-like_) pennon (_verb-like_) to signify

U+6676 (F1.67 晶) 日之光也又水晶 (Page 576 #1: (1)晶) Lustre, brightness (Kangxi: 精光也); clear, pure, light; crystal; crystaline; _(2)shui (1)tsing_ (seoi2 zing1 水晶), quartz crystal; _(4)ch(')(a/) (1)tsing_ (caa4 zing1 茶晶), tea-stone, cairngorm stone; _f(a/)t(8) (1)tsing_ (faat3 zing1 髮晶), moss agate; _mak(9) (1)tsing_ (mak6 zing1 墨晶), smoky quartz; _(4)hung (1)tsing_ (hung4 zing1 紅晶), rose quartz; _(1)t(')(i/)n h(i/)(3) (1)tsing_ (tin1 hei3 zing1 天氣晶), clear weather; _(2)shui (1)tsing (1)kung_ (seoi2 zing1 gung1 水晶宮), Neptune's palace.

U+6968 桢 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 楨) 楨榦 (Page 18* #6: (1)楨) ~~A kind of fir;~~ _(5)n(u (1)ching_ (neoi5 zing1 女楨), a coniferae growing on T(a/)ish(a/)n (太山) in Sh(a/)ntung (山東) (Kangxi: 太山之上多楨木, 女楨也); _(5)n(u (1)ching (2)tsz'_ (neoi5 zing1 zi2 女楨子) the seeds of this tree; _(1)ching kon(3)_ (zing1 gon3 楨榦) posts and planks with which adobie walls are made (Kangxi: 楨榦築牆所立兩木也); ~~vulgo, _k(a/)p(8) (4)ts(')(e/)ung (2)p(a/)n_ (gaap3 coeng4 baan2 夾牆板)~~. Fan Wan entry: Corrected ⿰龺余 to 榦. Williams' 楨榦: Here, 楨 refers to *posts*, not planks. It is 榦 that refers to planks (vulgo 夾牆板). Kangxi has 《孔傳》題曰楨旁曰榦楨當牆兩端者也榦在牆兩邊者也. Hardwood (Kangxi: 剛木也). A support, a pillar. 【楨】 (trjeng) (_noun-like_) support-post

U+70DD 㷥 蒸 (F1.68 烝) 衆也 (F1.68 蒸) 衆也進也又薰蒸又冬祭曰蒸 (Page 18* #8: (1)烝) a multitude, all (Kangxi: 衆也); ~~to enter,~~ to advance (Kangxi: 進也); clouds of dust (Kangxi: 塵也, 人衆所以生塵埃); ~~liberal~~ stately, princely (Kangxi: 君也); a winter sacrifice (Kangxi: 冬祭曰烝, 進品物也); to commit ~~incest~~ adultery with superiors in rank (Kangxi: 上淫曰烝); ~~to lay down;~~ _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)shang (1)ching (4)man_ (tin1 sang1 zing1 man4 天生烝民) heaven produced all men; _(1)ching (4)sh(e/)ung_ (zing1 soeng4 烝嘗), sacrifice ~~in winter~~; property left by a person; _(1)ching tsun(3)_ (zing1 zeon3 烝進) to intrude one's self; (Page 18* #9: (1)蒸) Used for the last (烝) (Kangxi 蒸: 通烝). all, numerous (Kangxi 蒸: 衆也); In classical usage, "steam" is typically spelt 烝, whilst 蒸 typically refers to "twig". In modern usage, "steam" is usually spelt 蒸. I have split Williams' entries up according to modern usage. Williams' 烝嘗: Not just winter sacrifice, but sacrifice in general (烝 for winter, and 嘗 for autumn). To convect upward (Kangxi: 火气上行也), to steam. Speech-assist, specifically an initial particle (Kangxi: 烝發語辭). 【烝】 (tsying) (_verb-like_) to convect upward, to steam (_verb-like_) (_met._) to adulter upward (_verb-like_) to put forth, to advance (_adjective-like_) multitudinous (_adjective-like_) stately (_noun-like_) winter-sacrifice (_speech-assist_)

U+7665 症 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 癥) 腹内結疾 (Page 19* #2: (1)癥) Colic arising from obstruction (Kangxi: 腹結病也); obstinate constipation; _(1)ching ~~(1)h(a/)~~ (2)k(a/)_ (zing1 gaa2 癥瘕), obstruction of the bowels with griping. Williams' 癥瘕: Corrected _(1)h(a/)_ (haa1) to _(2)k(a/)_ (gaa2). Used in 癥結 (sticking point or deadlock).

U+775B May appear as either ⿰目靑 or ⿰目青 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.67 睛) 眼睛 (Page 576 #2: (1)睛) The ball of the eye; the pupil; _(5)ng(a/)n hak(7) (1)tsing_ (ngaan5 hak1 zing1 眼黑睛), the iris; _p(a/)k(9) (1)tsing_ (baak6 zing1 白睛), the white of the eye; _f(a/)t(8) (1)tsing (1)kwong_ (faat3 zing1 gwong1 發睛光), night blindness; _muk(9) pat(7) (2)ch(un (1)tsing_ (muk6 bat1 zyun2 zing1 目不轉睛), eyes fixed. Kangxi 目珠子也 is, to me, a poor definition. It is not clear whether 珠子 is the whole eyeball, from the iris inward, or just the pupil.

U+798E May appear with radical component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. 祯 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 禎) 祥也又善也 (Page 18* #7: (1)禎) A favourable omen (Kangxi: 祥也); felicitous, lucky; _(1)ching (4)ts(')(e/)ung_ (zing1 coeng4 禎祥), a happy sign. 【禎】 (trjeng) (_noun-like_) good-omen

U+84B8 䒱 (for "twig" sense) 烝 (for "steam" senses) (F1.68 烝) 衆也 (F1.68 蒸) 衆也進也又薰蒸又冬祭曰蒸 (Page 18* #8: (1)烝; here normalised to 蒸) A vapor made by heat, steam; vapor, mist; to steam, to cook by steaming, to distil; _(1)ching shuk(9) (5)h(a/)_ (zing1 suk6 haa5 蒸熟吓), steam it thoroughly; _(1)ching f(a/)n(6)_ (zing1 faan6 蒸飯) to steam rice; _(1)ching (2)tsau_ (zing1 zau2 蒸酒), to distil spirit; _(1)ching (4)lung_ (zing1 lung4 蒸籠), a steaming basket; _(1)ching (4)ngo_ (zing1 ngo4-2 蒸鵝) a ~~boiled~~ steamed goose. (Page 18* #9: (1)蒸) Twigs of hemp for burning (Kangxi: 折麻中榦也); small firewood (Kangxi: 麤曰薪細曰蒸); ~~hemp torches;~~ vapor, steam; to rise, as vapor or steam; _(1)ching (1)ching yat(9) (5)sh(e/)ung_ (zing1 zing1 jat6 soeng5 蒸蒸日上), daily rising better and higher. In classical usage, "steam" is typically spelt 烝, whilst 蒸 typically refers to "twig". In modern usage, "steam" is usually spelt 蒸. I have split Williams' entries up according to modern usage. Williams' "to rise, as vapor or steam": Kangxi has this sense under departing-tone _ching(3)_ (zing3) (see 蒸 zing3). 【蒸】 (tsying) (_noun-like_) twig

zing3.text: U+84B8 (Page 18* #9: (1)蒸) Read _ching(3)_ (zing3). The hot reflection of the sun; the sun striking on one; _(i/)t(9) (4)t(')au ching(3) ch(u(6)_ (jit6 tau4-2 zing3 zyu6 熱頭蒸住) the sun strikes on me. Vapour or air rising (Kangxi: 氣之上達也).

zing1.text: U+8C9E 偵 贞 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 貞) 正也潔也淸白也又易元亨利貞 (Page 18* #4: (1)貞) To divine by shells (Kangxi: 卜問也); chaste, virtuous; pure, correct, moral (Kangxi: 貞正也); uncorrupted; well principled; _(1)ching k(i/)t(8)_ (zing1 git3 貞潔) chaste; _(1)ping (1)ching_ (bing1 zing1 冰貞), a pure woman; _(1)ching ts(i/)t(8)_ (zing1 zit3 貞節) a chaste widow; _(1)ching l(i/)t(9)_ (zing1 lit6 貞烈) inflexibly upright or virtuous. The inner (i.e. lower) trigram of a hexagram (Kangxi: 內卦曰貞外卦曰悔). Resolved, resolute (Kangxi: 貞定也精定不動惑也). 【貞】 (trjeng) (_verb-like_) to divine (_noun-like_) inner-trigram (_adjective-like_) correct, proper, (_met._) determined

U+9266 钲 (Mainland simplified) (F1.68 鉦) 鐃也 (Page 19* #3: (1)鉦) ~~Cymbals set in a frame~~ Bronze bells with a vertical stick through the middle, used to signalize a halt in armies (Kangxi: 鐃類也 etc., 鉦以靜之鼓以動之); a cymbal used by priests, a brass tamborine; _kw(a/)(3) (4)t(')ung (1)ching_ (gwaa3 tung4 zing1 掛銅鉦), to hang up the cymbal. 【鉦】 (tsyeng) (_noun-like_) halting-bell

zing2.text: U+6574 𢿫 (F1.72 整) 修造也齊也葺也理也 (Page 19* before #4: (2)整) (The two next characters (整, 正) are often pronounced _cheng_ (zeng).) (Page 19* #4: (2)整) To even off, to place evenly (Kangxi 𢿫: 齊也); to repair, to mend, to put in order, to make; to arrange; to adjust; to adorn; to make new, to trim up; _(2)ching shik(7) (2)shui_ (zing2 sik1 seoi2 整色水) or _(2)ching (2)k(u/) ts(o\)(6) kw(a/)i(3)_ (zing2 gu2 zou6 gwaai3 整古做怪) to sham, as poverty; to dissemble, to simulate; _(2)ching (5)k(')(u (2)kwai (5)m(a/)_ (zing2 keoi5 gwai2 maa5 整佢鬼馬), set a catch for him, as in play; _(2)ching (4)ts(')ai_ (zing2 cai4 整齊), to put things in order, to settle; _(2)ching (1)pi(u/)_ (zing2 biu1 整錶), to mend a watch; _(2)ching (4)t(')(i/)n_ (zing2 tin4 整田), to prepare fields for planting; _(2)ching (2)h(o\)_ (zing2 hou2 整好), or _(2)ching (1)f(a/)n_ (zing2 faan1 整返), to repair; _~~(2)cheng~~ (2)ching ~~(1)k(')i(u/)~~ (4)k(')i(u/) (1)sau l(o\)(6)_ (zing2 kiu4 sau1 lou6 整橋修路) to mend bridges and repair roads; _(2)ching ch(i/)(6) (4)yan_ (zing2 zi6 jan4 整治人), to correct a man; _(2)ching ~~(4)w(a/)i~~ w(a/)i(6)_ (zing2 waai6 整壞), to spoil, to injure. Williams considers _(2)cheng_ (zeng2) a possible reading variation for 整. However, I have never heard 整 read _(2)cheng_ (zeng2). Williams' 整色水: More commonly 整色整水. Williams' 整橋修路: Changed _(2)cheng_ (zeng2) to _(2)ching_ (zing2), and corrected _(1)k(')i(u/)_ (kiu1) to _(4)k(')i(u/)_ (kiu4). Williams' 整壞: Corrected _(4)w(a/)i_ (waai4) to _w(a/)i(6)_ (waai6). Whole, entire. Whole (of a number). 【整】 (tsyengX) (_verb-like_) to arrange, to straighten 【整】 (zing2) To make, to create. 整緊蛋糕 (zing2 gan2 daan6 gou1): "Making a cake." 整嘢食 (zing2 je5 sik6): "Make something to eat."
