To cause to become, to render. 整熱啲 (zing2 jit6 di1): "Make it hotter." 整損手 (zing2 syun2 sau2): "Abrased my hand." 整冧咗 (zing2 lam3 zo2): "Made it fall over". 整爛咗 (zing2 laan6 zo2): "I broke it" (physically). 整壞咗 (zing2 waai6 zo2): "I broke it" (functionally). 【整蠱】 (zing2 gu2) To play a trick or prank on. 【整色整水】 (zing2 sik1 zing2 seoi2) To do the superficial (as cover for lack of substance), to window-dress.

zing3.text: U+653F May appear with 正 having 4 strokes (+4) or 5 strokes (+5 assumed here), depending on the font. 正 (F1.72 政) 國政所以止人之不正也又典法曰政 (Page 19* #6: 政(3)) To rule, to govern (Kangxi: 正也 etc.); a standard, a regulator; a treatise, a guide on a subject; government, politics; laws, regulations; _ching(3) sz'(6)_ (zing3 si6 政事) governmental affairs; _(1)k(a/) ching(3)_ (gaa1 zing3 家政) family regulations; _sh(i/)n(6) ching(3)_ (sin6 zing3 善政) good rule; _(4)ts(')ung ching(3)_ (cung4 zing3 從政) in official employ; _(4)nung ching(3)_ (nung4 zing3 農政) farming encyclopedia; a supervisor of agriculture; _ts(')at(7) ching(3)_ (cat1 zing3 七政) the sun, moon, and five planets; _ching(3) ling(6)_ (zing3 ling6 政令) official orders. Williams' 家政: Now "home economics". Williams' 從政: Or, "pursuing politics". 【政】 (tsyengH) (_noun-like_) governance

U+75C7 (Page 20* #3: 症(3)) An unauthorized character. Disease, ailments, disorder; _peng(6) ching(3)_ (beng6 zing3 病症) sickness; _kap(7) ching(3)_ (gap1 zing3 急症) ~~a dangerous~~ acute sickness; _ts(a/)p(9) ching(3)_ (zaap6 zing3 雜症) unusual malady.
U+8A3C 证 (Mainland simplified) (F1.72 証) 騐也考也 (F1.72 證) 騐也質也明也 (Page 20* #2: 証(3)) To remonstrate with, to admonish, to expostulate (Kangxi: 諫也). 【証】 (tsyengH) (_verb-like_) to remonstrate (with)

U+8B49 証 证 (Mainland simplified) (F1.72 証) 騐也考也 (F1.72 證) 騐也質也明也 (Page 20* #1: 證(3)) To prove, to confront, to testify (Kangxi: 告也); to substantiate (Kangxi: 驗也, 𠋫也質也); to prove by authorities; evidence; _ching(3) (4)yan_ (zing3 jan4 證人), a witness; _ching(3) k(i/)n(3)_ (zing3 gin3 證見) an eyewitness; _(1)kon ching(3)_ (gon1 zing3 干證) a witness; _ching(3) (i/)m(6)_ (zing3 jim6 證驗) to verify; _ching(3) ~~k(u(6)~~ k(u(3)_ (zing3 geoi3 證據) evidence. (Page 20* #2: 証(3)) Interchanged with the above (證). Williams' 證據: Corrected _k(u(6)_ (geoi6) to _k(u(3)_ (geoi3). 【證】 (tsyingH) (_verb-like_) to attest, to prove

zing6.text: U+9756 May appear as either ⿰立靑 or ⿰立青 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.73 靖) 安也又謀也理也審也 (Page 577 #3: 靖(6)) To become ~~clean and~~ quiet; small, fine (Kangxi: 一曰細貌); to plan (Kangxi: 謀也), to think carefully on (Kangxi: 思也); to tranquillize, to restore peace, to clear (Kangxi: 和也, 安也), as the sea from pirates; to regulate, to settle disturbances (Kangxi: 理也, 靖治也); _t(i/)(6) (1)fong (1)on tsing(6)_ (dei6 fong1 on1 zing6 地方安靖) the land is now quiet; _tsing(6) yik(9)_ (zing6 jik6 靖逆) to put down the rebels. Williams' "clean": Here, Williams has been misled by Kangxi 立淨也, which is a typo for 立竫也 "standing quiet". Respectful, observant, of few words (Kangxi: 恭己鮮言曰靖). 【靖】 (dzjengX) (_verb-like_) to tranquilise, to (be) quiet (_adjective-like_) tranquil, quiet, (_met._) observant

U+975A May appear as either ⿰靑見 or ⿰青見 (assumed here), depending on the font. 靓 (Mainland simplified) (F1.73 靚) 女容徐靚粉白黛黑謂之靚粧 (Page 577 #2: 靚(6)) To call, to invite (Kangxi: 召也); ~~to allure;~~ to ornament, to bedizen (Kangxi: 裝飾也); _tsing(6) shik(7)_ (zing6 sik1 靚飾) dark eyebrows and clear skin.

U+975C May appear as either ⿰靑爭 or ⿰青爭 (assumed here), depending on the font. 静 靚 zing6-2 (rising second in vernacular 靜靜地, 靜靜雞) (F1.73 靜) 寂也定也 (Page 577 #1: 靜(6)) Still (Kangxi: 動之對也), silent, ~~impassible,~~ imperturbable; at rest (Kangxi: 息也), quiet (Kangxi: 靜安也); peaceable, mild (Kangxi: 和也); pure (Kangxi: 澄也, 潔淸...), like a pool; no bustle; to judge (Kangxi: 審也); to ponder, to meditate on; to desist (Kangxi: 息也); _(1)sam (2)shui tsing(6)_ (sam1 seoi2 zing6 心水靜) contented, patient; _tsing(6) t(o\)(3) (5)li(u/) pat(7) tak(7)_ (zing6 dou3 liu5 bat1 dak1 靜到了不得) very still; _tsing(6) (5)y(e/)ung_ (zing6 joeng5 靜養), to cultivate quiet, to nurse one's self at home; _tsing(6) tsing(6) t(i/)(6)_ (zing6 zing6 dei6 靜靜地) keep quiet; _tsing(6) (1)si(u/) (1)si(u/)_ (zing6 siu1 siu1 靜蕭蕭), solitary; no business, no bustle; _(4)p(')ing tsing(6)_ (ping4 zing6 平靜) at peace, as a country; _y(e/)(6) tsing(6)_ (je6 zing6 夜靜) the stilly night. (Page 577 #2: 靚(6); here normalised to 靜) still; To plan, to plot (Kangxi: 靜謀也). Chaste (Kangxi: 靜貞靜也). 【靜】 (dzjengX) (_verb-like_) to (be) quiet (_adjective-like_) quiet, still (_adjective-like_) pure 【靜雞雞】 (zing6 gai1 gai1) Synonym of 靜靜雞. 【靜靜雞】 (zing6 zing6-2 gai1) Quietly, stealthily.

zip3.text: U+56C1 嗫 (Mainland simplified) jip6 (alternative per 《廣韻》而涉切) (Page 22* #2: 囁(8)) An unbridled tongue (Kangxi: 口無節也); ~~vilifying,~~ grumbling, privately scolding (Kangxi: 私罵也)~~, slandering~~; _ch(i/)p(8) ~~(1)s(u~~ (4)(u_ (zip3 jyu4 囁嚅), chattering, querulous (Kangxi: 囁嚅多言也). Williams' 囁嚅: Corrected _(1)s(u_ (seoi1) to _(4)(u_ (jyu4). The mouth moving (Kangxi: 口動也).
U+6174 (F2.51 褶) 衣也 (F2.51 襵) 同上 (F2.51 慴) 同上 (Page 22* #3: 慴(8)) Fan Wan erroneously has 慴 as an alternative form of 褶.

U+63A5 (F2.50 接) 相續也運也受也待也 (Page 579 #2: 接(8)) To receive in the hand (Kangxi: 持也受也承也); to receive, to connect, to join (Kangxi: 接續也連也), to succeed; combined with, united to (Kangxi: 合也); to take in, as jobs; to meet, to associate with (Kangxi: 交也, 會也); to take, as reflected light; quick (Kangxi: 捷也); _(4)ying ts(i/)p(8)_ (jing4 zip3 迎接) to greet, to go and meet, as a visitor; _ts(i/)p(8) (4)p(')(u/)i_ (zip3 pui4 接陪), to conduct a visitor to a seat; _ts(i/)p(8) tsuk(9)_ (zip3 zuk6 接續) to succeed to, to continue; _(4)m(o\) tak(7) ts(i/)p(8) tsuk(9)_ (mou4 dak1 zip3 zuk6 無得接續) nothing comes after it; _ts(i/)p(8) yan(3)_ (zip3 jan3 接印) to receive the seals; _ts(i/)p(8) (1)fung_ (zip3 fung1 接風), to welcome a friend back; _(4)shing ts(i/)p(8) (4)nai (2)shui_ (sing4 zip3 nai4 seoi2 承接泥水), orders received for masonwork; _ts(i/)p(8) (5)l(a/)m (5)n(i/)_ (zip3 laam5 nei5 接？你), I'll divide the present with you; _ts(i/)p(8) k(a/)(3) (5)m(a/)_ (zip3 gaa3 maa5 接駕馬), paranymphs sent for the bride; _kwai(6) ts(i/)p(8)_ (gwai6 zip3 跪接) to kneel and receive, as a subaltern does; _(5)ngo tak(7) ts(i/)p(8)_ (ngo5 dak1 zip3 我得接) I have got it; _ts(i/)p(8) (1)k(u/)n ~~(4)t(')eng~~ (4)t(')ing_ (zip3 gun1 ting4 接官亭), a porch for receiving officers on landing. Williams' 接官亭: Corrected _(4)t(')eng_ (teng4) to _(4)t(')ing_ (ting4). To catch. To pick up. 【接】 (tsjep) (_verb-like_) to connect, to contact (_verb-like_) to succeed (_verb-like_) to receive (_adjective-like_) (_met._) near (_adverb-like_) quickly

U+647A 折 (Mainland simplified) (F2.51 摺) 摺叠 (Page 22* #1: 摺(8)) To fold, to double up (Kangxi: 摺疊也); (...), to destroy (Kangxi: 敗也), (...); to pile up; to bend, as the knee; a fold, a doubling over; _yat(7) ch(i/)p(8) ch(i/)p(8)_ (jat1 zip3 zip3 一摺摺) folds, as of a fan; _ch(i/)p(8) (4)m(a/)i (1)k(a/)n p(')(o\)(3)_ (zip3 maai4 gaan1 pou3 摺埋間舖) to fold (or close) a shop's business; _(2)p(')(a/)u ch(i/)p(8) (2)tsz'_ (paau2 zip3 zi2 跑摺子), a fleet courier; _ch(i/)p(8) (2)tsz'_ (zip3 zi2 摺子) a document or report for the emperor; _ch(i/)p(8) ~~t(')(i/)p(8)~~ t(i/)p(9)_ (zip3 dip6 摺疊) to heap up or on; _ch(i/)p(8) (4)m(a/)i_ (zip3 maai4 摺埋), to shut up, as a book; _ch(i/)p(8) (2)ch(i/)_ (zip3 zi2 摺紙), to fold paper; _ch(i/)p(8) kok(8)_ (zip3 gok3 摺角) to turn down dog's ears; _(2)shau ch(i/)p(8)_ (sau2 zip3 手摺) a folded paper for memoranda; _ch(i/)p(8) (1)kam (4)ngan_ (zip3 gam1 ngan4 摺金銀), to fold paper to burn as clothes. Williams' 跑摺子: Inferred unprinted characters _(')(a/)_ in _p(')(a/)u_, and fixed missing apostrophe at the end of _(2)tsz'_. Williams' 摺疊: Corrected _t(')(i/)p(8)_ (tip3) to _t(i/)p(9)_ (dip6). A folded booklet. 【摺埋】 (zip3 maai4) To fold, to shut up (of a business).
U+696B 檝 艥 (Page 578 #4: 楫(8)) An oar, a paddle, or whatever is used to propel a boat (Kangxi: 舟櫂也, 行舟具); to row; to avail of for one's purposes. 【楫】 (tsjep) (_noun-like_) oar

U+6D79 浃 (Mainland simplified) (F2.50 浹) 浹洽融？通徹也 (Page 578 before #5: 浹(8)) (This character (浹) is also read _h(a/)p_ (haap) ~~and _h(i/)p_ (hip)~~.) (Page 578 #5: 浹(8)) ~~Interchanged with _h(i/)p_ (hip) 挾 to assist.~~ Water flowing through (Kangxi: 徹也); moistened, imbibed, damp (Kangxi: 謂潤澤浹洽相霑徹也); to instil, to penetrate; a complete turn of, a circuit (Kangxi: 周浹猶周匝也); _ts(i/)p(8) yat(9)_ (zip3 jat6 浹日) a decade (Kangxi: 浹日謂從甲至癸也); _ts(i/)p(8) (4)shan_ (zip3 san4 浹辰) twelve days or hours, a circuit of the 12 branches; _ts(i/)p(8) ~~h(a/)p(9)~~ hap(7)_ (zip3 hap1 浹洽) fully imbued with, to interpenetrate; to treat cordially, as friends. Fan Wan entry: The incomprehensible character looks like 液 minus 亻. Williams records _h(a/)p_ (haap) and _h(i/)p_ (hip) as alternative readings without specifying the tone. The former is consistent with 《集韻》轄夾切 _h(a/)p(9)_ (haap6) for 浹 used in 浹渫. The latter is dubious. Note that the similar character 𠗉 has three readings: 胡頰切 _h(i/)p(9)_ (hip6), explained 𠗉𠗨冰凍. 子協切 _ts(i/)p(8)_ (zip3), explained 𠗉𠗨 with cross reference 又音狎. 胡甲切 _h(a/)p(9)_ (haap6), explained 𠗉𠗨冰凍相著. Williams' 浹日: Here, "decade" means ten days (甲 through 癸). Williams' 浹洽: Changed _h(a/)p(9)_ (haap6) to common reading _hap(7)_ (hap1). 【浹】 (tsep) (_verb-like_) to soak through (_noun-like_) cycle
U+776B (F2.50 睫) 目睫目旁毛也 (Page 579 #1: 睫(8)) Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword (with right component like 㨗) to 睫.

zit6.text: U+776B 䀹 zip3 (per 《廣韻》即葉切) zit3 (common) (F2.50 睫 _Ts(i/)p(8)_ (zip3)) 目睫目旁毛也 (Page 579 #1: 睫(8) _Ts(i/)p(8)_ (zip3); here normalised to _Ts(i/)t(9)_ (zit6)) The eye-lashes (Kangxi: 同䀹, 目旁毛也); _met._ the eye; _sh(e/)ung(6) ~~ts(i/)p(8)~~ ts(i/)t(9)_ (soeng6 zit6 上睫) the upper eye-lashes. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword (with right component like 㨗) to 睫. 【睫】 (tsjep) (_noun-like_) eyelash

zip3.text: U+8975 褶 (F2.51 褶) 衣也 (F2.51 襵) 同上 (F2.51 慴) 同上 (Page 22* #4: 襵(8)) To fold garments (Kangxi: 詘也); to plait, to double; plaits, frounces, gathers (Kangxi: 謂衣襞積), like those of a Chinese lady's petticoat; plaited. For the vernacular word, see 褶 zaap3.

U+8F12 輙 辄 (Mainland simplified) zit3 (common) (F2.51 輒) 急然也專也卽也就也 (Page 22* #6: 輒(8)) The sides of a ~~a~~ carriage (Kangxi: 車兩輢也), where arms are stuck; unceremoniously, suddenly, abruptly (Kangxi: 忽然也); directly, without permission (Kangxi: 專輒也); _ch(i/)p(8) (4)(i/)n_ (zip3 jin4 輒然), forthwith. Williams' 輒然: Also "unmoving". The feet unable to move past (or cross over) one another (Kangxi: 足疾也, 輒者何兩足不能相過也 etc.). Immediately. Always, invariably, consistently. 【輒】 (trjep) (_adverb-like_) immediately (_adverb-like_) consistently

_(5)m(a/)i (1)kw(a/)n ts(i/)t(8)_ (maai5 gwaan1 zit3 買關節) to get degrees by bribery, to bribe; _ts(i/)t(8) tsau(3)_ (zit3 zau3 節奏) ~~to mark the time in music~~ musical beat; _(1)to (1)shang (1)ch(i/) ts(i/)t(8)_ (do1 sang1 zi1 zit3 多生枝節) full of cares and business; _(5)n(a/) (4)sh(i/) ts(i/)t(8)_ (naa5 si4 zit3 那時節) on that occasion; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)chung ts(i/)t(8)_ (tin1 zung1 zit3 天中節) dragon-boat festival; _(1)shau ts(i/)t(8) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (sau1 zit3 zoeng3 收節賬) to collect bills at four terms; _ts(i/)t(8) ts(i/)t(8) (1)k(o\)_ (zit3 zit3 gou1 節節高), gradually rising in rank or wealth; _ts(i/)t(8) ~~k(i/)m(3)~~ k(i/)m(6)_ (zit3 gim6 節儉) frugal, within the limits. Williams' 買關節: Dated. Williams' 節儉: Corrected _k(i/)m(3)_ (gim3) to _k(i/)m(6)_ (gim6). The reading variation _ts(i/)t(9)_ (zit6) is a complicated matter. The rabbit hole goes like this: Kangxi gives the reading 《集韻》昨結切 _ts(i/)t(9)_ (zit6) with the example 《詩小雅》節彼南山, but gives no explanation. The entry in 《集韻》 does not have this example, but gives the explanation 山高峻貌 "lofty", with the alternative forms 𡵒 and 𡾃. Of these, the form 𡵒 is perhaps a sloppy version of ⿱㔾山, i.e. "knot" + "mountain". In 《廣韻》 under the reading 昨結切 _ts(i/)t(9)_ (zit6) there is the character ⿱⿴㔾丶山. The top component 𭅲 is a stylised 卪, so again we have "knot" + "mountain". The explanation is 山峯又子結切, i.e. "mountain summit" with the alternative reading 子結切 _ts(i/)t(8)_ (zit3) (which appears to be a genuine alternative, *not* a cross-reference). Kangxi has neither 𡵒 nor ⿱㔾山 nor 𭅲, but instead has an entry for 岊 (⿱巴山). This seems to be sloppy formatting of the "knot" component as 巴 based on the similar shape of the seal character for 卪 "knot". *Only* the reading 子結切 _ts(i/)t(8)_ (zit3) is given, which makes this entry's citations of 《集韻》 erroneous. In 《說文》 the glyph is "knot" + "mountain" (从山从卪). So what is the conclusion? Well, it seems like the "lofty" sense comes from the notion of being "crested", which seems to be the intent behind the glyph being "mountain knot". So, in my opinion, we read _ts(i/)t(8)_ (zit3) for "crested", and either _ts(i/)t(8)_ (zit3) or _ts(i/)t(9)_ (zit6) for "lofty". But it would just be easier if the "lofty" sense did not exist. Crested (of a mountain). Lofty (of a mountain). 【節】 (tset) (_noun-like_) joint, node, juncture, (_met._) division (_noun-like_) moral restraint, (_met._) regulation, chastity (_verb-like_) to restrain, (_met._) to regulate (_noun-like_) token (_adjective-like_) (_met._) crested

Williams' "three imaginary organs": The "triple burner" (三膲) of Chinese medicine.

U+940E ciu4 (alternative per 《廣韻》昨焦切) (F2.3 鐎) 鐎斗卽刀斗其器可受二升晝炊夜擊 (Page 581 #1: (1)鐎) A ~~soldier's~~ brass kettle or skillet, about the size of a peck (斗) measure (Kangxi: 鐎斗也, 溫器三足而有柄, etc.); a brass pan. Fan Wan entry: Corrected 書 to 晝.

U+9DE6 焦 (in 鷦䳟 spelt 焦明) 鹪 (Mainland simplified) (F2.3 鷦) 鷦鷯鳥名 (Page 581 #3: (1)鷦) A wren (Kangxi: 鷦𪃦桃蟲也一名鷦鷯); _(1)tsi(u/) (4)li(u/)_ (ziu1 liu4 鷦鷯), a wren, tarin, tody, or some such small bird, which nestles on high grass; _hok(9) tak(7) k(o\)m(3) (1)tsi(u/) (4)li(u/)_ (hok6 dak1 gam3 ziu1 liu4 學得咁鷦鷯), playful, skittish, inattentive. 【鷦】 (tsjew) Used in 鷦鷯. 【鷦鷯】 (tsjew lew) (_noun-like_) wren

ziu2.text: U+6CBC (F2.5 沼) 池沼圓曰池方曰沼 (Page 24* #2: (2)沼) A pool or tank (Kangxi: 池也一說圓曰池曲曰沼), used for a fishpond; _(4)l(i/)n (2)chi(u/)_ (lin4 ziu2 蓮沼), a water-lily pond; _(4)ch(')(i/) (2)chi(u/)_ (ci4 ziu2 池沼), ponds. In modern usage, used in 沼氣 (swamp gas). 【沼】 (tsyewX) (_noun-like_) pond

ziu3.text: U+7167 炤 㷖 燳 (F2.6 照) 明也燭也 (F2.6 炤) 同上 (Page 24* #3: 照(3)炤(3)) Light; to illuminate, to brighten, to shine on (Kangxi 照: 明所燭也); to patronize, to regard, to care for, to oversee, to assist; conformably to, as, according to, like, same as; _chi(u/)(3) keng(3)_ (ziu3 geng3 照鏡) to look in a glass; _chi(u/)(3) (1)shan keng(3)_ (ziu3 san1 geng3 照身鏡) a pier-glass; _chi(u/)(3) pik(7)_ (ziu3 bik1 照壁) a wall opposite offices or temples; _(1)k(o\) chi(u/)(3)_ (gou1 ziu3 高照) a high lantern used to lead processions; _(2)f(a/)n chi(u/)(3)_ (faan2 ziu3 反照) reflected light; reillumined; to shine again; _chi(u/)(3) k(u/)(3)_ (ziu3 gu3 照顧) to assist, to patronize, to buy of; _chi(u/)(3) y(e/)ung(6) ts(o\)(6)_ (ziu3 joeng6-2 zou6 照樣做) make it like the pattern; _chi(u/)(3) sz'(6) (4)hang sz'(6)_ (ziu3 si6 hang4 si6 照事行事) do what you've begun; _(2)t(a/) chi(u/)(3) m(i/)n(6)_ (daa2 ziu3 min6 打照面) catch a glimpse of; _chi(u/)(3) (1)(i/) (5)k(')(u_ (ziu3 ji1 keoi5 照依佢), do as he does; _chi(u/)(3) ch(u(6) (5)k(')(u_ (ziu3 zyu6 keoi5 照住佢), light him with a lantern; _chi(u/)(3) k(i/)n(3) (5)n(i/) k(e/)(3) (1)sam (1)kon_ (ziu3 gin3 nei5 ge3 sam1 gon1 照見你嘅心肝), I can see through your design. To reflect. To inform. (_adverb_) Still (used to describe an action being done despite reasons against it). 【照】 (tsyewH) (_verb-like_) to illume 【照計】 (ziu3 gai3) Used to emphasise an expectation associated with normal or unexceptional circumstances.

U+8A54 诏 (Mainland simplified) (F2.6 詔) 告也上命也又敎導之也 (Page 24* #4: 詔(3)) To promulge, to announce, to proclaim (Kangxi: 吿也); to teach, to exhort, to instruct ~~the empire~~ (Kangxi: 導也 etc.); a proclamation; ~~to encourage;~~ _(1)yan chi(u/)(3)_ (jan1 ziu3 恩詔) a gracious command, as a pardon; _chi(u/)(3) ming(6)_ (ziu3 ming6 詔命) a royal mandate; _chi(u/)(3) k(o\)(3)_ (ziu3 gou3 詔告) to proclaim; _chi(u/)(3) t(u/)i(3)_ (ziu3 deoi3 詔對) to be called into the presence. Williams' "to encourage": This is a misreading of Kangxi 謂贊勉. Here, 贊勉 is to guide, not to encourage. An order from above, especially from the emperor (上命也秦漢以下天子獨稱之). Written proclamation (Kangxi: 播吿之書也). 【詔】 (tsyewH) (_verb-like_) to inform (_verb-like_) to promulge

U+91AE (F2.7 醮) 祭名酌酒而無酧酢曰醮又醮席又建醮 (Page 581 #5: 醮(3)) To sacrifice to ancestors and spirits (Kangxi: 醮祭也); a sacrifice, a requiem (Kangxi: 凡僧道設壇祈禱曰醮); to give a cup of wine to a son at his wedding (Kangxi: 父親醮子 etc.); finished, used up (Kangxi: 盡也); to ~~complete~~ exhaust; ~~to burn moxa;~~ _(2)t(a/) tsi(u/)(3)_ (daa2 ziu3 打醮) or _k(i/)n(3) tsi(u/)(3)_ (gin3 ziu3 建醮) to celebrate the all-souls' festival; _(4)w(a/)n (1)t(')(i/)n tsi(u/)(3)_ (waan4 tin1 ziu3 還天醮) a thanksgiving service for heaven's mercy; _tsoi(3) tsi(u/)(3)_ (zoi3 ziu3 再醮) to remarry, said mostly of widows; _(2)t(a/) (2)fo (1)sing tsi(u/)(3)_ (daa2 fo2 sing1 ziu3 打火星醮) the autumnal festival to the God of Fire. Williams' "to give a cup of wine to a son at his wedding": Also at the capping ceremony where a twenty-year-old son is given his style-name. See below. Williams' 打醮: Also called 太平清醮. The giving of a cup of wine from father to son at a capping or wedding cermony (Kangxi: 冠娶禮祭), where the son does not return a cup to the father (Kangxi: 酌而無酬酢曰醮). To marry (of a woman), especially to remarry. 【醮】 (tsjewH) (_verb-like_) to serve the ceremonial cup (_verb-like_) to finish

ziu6.text: U+5146 (F2.7 兆) 億兆十億曰兆又宅兆墓域也又吉兆兆者以求吉爲主故以召言吉又京兆猶言京師也 (Page 24* #7: 兆(6))

U+53EC (F2.7 召) 呼也 (Page 24* #5: 召(6)) To call, to summon (Kangxi: 𧦝也, 以手曰招以言曰召), to invoke, to cite; to order one to be present; _chi(u/)(6) (2)ting_ (ziu6 ding2 召頂), to issue proposals to take a stock in trade; _chi(u/)(6) k(i/)n(3)_ (ziu6 gin3 召見) to call to court; _chi(u/)(6) pat(7) t(o\)(3)_ (ziu6 bat1 dou3 召不到) not to appear when summoned. 【召】 (drjewH) (_verb-like_) to summon
U+56BC May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font.

zoek3.text: U+56BC May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font. zoek6 (per 《廣韻》在爵切) (F1.94 嚼 _Ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6)) 咀嚼咬嚼 (Page 565 #5: 嚼(9) _Ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6); here normalised to _Ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) To chew, to bite, ~~to ruminate,~~ to craunch, to mumble, to munch, to masticate (Kangxi: 齧也); a mouthful, a bite; _(5)ng(a/)u ~~ts(e/)uk(9)~~ ts(e/)uk(8)_ (ngaau5 zoek3 咬嚼) to chew; _~~ts(e/)uk(9)~~ ts(e/)uk(8) l(a/)n(6)_ (zoek3 laan6 嚼爛) chewed it to pieces; _(4)h(o\)m (4)ch(')(a/) ~~ts(e/)uk(9)~~ ts(e/)uk(8) f(a/)n(6)_ (ham4 caa4 zoek3 faan6 含茶嚼飯) to mumble for a child; _(5)ng(a/)u (4)man ~~ts(e/)uk(9)~~ ts(e/)uk(8) tsz'(6)_ (ngaau5 man4 zoek3 zi6 咬文嚼字) to bite and chew phrases---pedantry.

zoek6.text: U+56BC May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font. (F1.94 嚼) 咀嚼咬嚼 (Page 565 #5: 嚼(9))

ziu6.text: U+8D99 赵 (Mainland simplified) (F2.7 趙) 趨也久也利也又姓 (Page 24* #6: 趙(6)) To hasten to (Kangxi: 趨趙也); to announce to a suzerain (Kangxi: 趙朝也本小邑朝事于大國也); a long time; ~~sharp, acute;~~ a few; a feudal state (Kangxi: 國名) in the south of Sh(a/)ns(i/) (山西) and Chihl(i/) (直隸), its capital was the present Ch(a/)uching (趙城) in Sh(a/)ns(i/) (山西). Williams' "a long time", "a few": Per 久也 and 少也 from 《廣韻》. I am not aware of any texts that use these senses. Williams' "sharp": This is perhaps a rendering of Fan Wan 利也, which is likely erroneous. Williams' "acute": This is a misreading of 刺也, which belongs under the reading _(5)t(')i(u/)_ (tiu5) per 《集韻》徒了切. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【趙-hasten】 (drjewX) (_verb-like_) to hasten (unto)

zo2.text: U+4FCE 爼 (F2.60 爼) 爼豆祭器 (Page 25* #7: (2)爼; here normalised to 俎) A basin or bowl like a tripod, used in sacrifice (Kangxi 俎: 祭享之器); _(2)cho tau(6)_ (zo2 dau6 俎豆) a basin used in worship. A small table (Kangxi: 俎几也). A chopping board (Kangxi: 刀俎, 俎椹版也). 【俎】 (tsrjoX) (_noun-like_) sacrificial-stand

U+5497 唨 (Cantonese) 阻 (Cantonese) (Page 25* #8: (2)阻; here normalised to 咗) A colloquial word. A sign of ~~the past tense~~ completion, placed after verbs, like _(1)hi(u/)_ (hiu1 嘵)_;_ _~~(1)ning~~ (1)ling (2)cho (4)lai_ (ling1 zo2 lai4 拎咗嚟), brought it; _h(u(3) (2)cho_ (heoi3 zo2 去咗), gone. Williams' 拎咗嚟: Changed _(1)ning_ (ning1) to _(1)ling_ (ling1). 【咗】 (zo2) Marker of the perfective aspect (whole completion of an action). 走咗 (zau2 zo2): "He's gone." 死咗 (sei2 zo2): "He's died." 笨咗添 (ban6 zo2 tim1): "Oh, I've been foolish!" 瞓着咗 (fan3 zoek6 zo2): "Fallen asleep." 畢咗業 (bat1 zo2 jip6): "I've graduated." 食咗飯未 (sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6): "Have you eaten dinner yet?" Used with certain imperatives. 飲咗佢吖 (jam2 zo2 keoi5 a1): "Drink it up." 剷咗條片啦 (caan2 zo2 tiu4 pin3-2 laa1): "Delete that video!" 噉炒咗佢囉 (gam2 caau2 zo2 keoi5 lo1): "So just fire him!" The spelling 咗 is arbitrary (but well established).

U+5DE6 𠂇 (F2.61 左) 左右又姓 (Page 582 #5: (2)左) The left (Kangxi: 左右之對), the left hand; second; an assistant; deflected (Kangxi: 僻左不正也); depraved, bad (Kangxi: 手足便右以左爲僻故凡幽猥皆曰僻左); to degrade, to reduce in rank (Kangxi: 漢時依古法朝廷之列以右爲尊故謂降秩爲左遷); _(2)tso (i/)m(6)_ (zo2 jim6 左驗) to verify, to prove, as a coadjutor can (Kangxi: 左證左也); _(2)tso p(i/)n(6)_ (zo2 bin6 左便) on the left; _(2)shai kw(a/)n(3) (2)tso (2)shau_ (sai2 gwaan3 zo2 sau2 使慣左手), left-handed; _(2)tso sing(3)_ (zo2 sing3 左性) crotchetty, set in his way; _~~(2)ch(un~~ ch(un(3) (1)w(a/)n (2)tso p(i/)n(6)_ (zyun3 waan1 zo2 bin6 轉彎左便) turn to the left hand; _(1)s(e/)ung (2)tso_ (soeng1 zo2 相左), a mutual mistake; not to suit, disagreeing; _m(i/)n(6) (2)tso (2)tso_ (min6 zo2 zo2 面左左), to dislike; _(2)tso (1)sz' yau(6) (2)s(e/)ung_ (zo2 si1 jau6 soeng2 左思右想), thinking of this way and that; _(2)tso (2)shau (1)k(a/)u yau(6) (2)shau_ (zo2 sau2 gaau1 jau6 sau2 左手交右手), to exchange from hand to hand, _i. e._ not to give credit; _l(i/)t(9) (1)(u (2)tso_ (lit6 jyu1 zo2 列於左), written as follows. Williams' 轉彎左便: Corrected _(2)ch(un_ (zyun2) to _ch(un(3)_ (zyun3). Now simply 轉左. Williams' 列於左: Perhaps this should be 列如左. The idea here is that Chinese is (classically) written right to left, so text that comes afterward will be on the left. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【左】 (tsaX) (_adjective-like_) left (_adverb-like_) left, aleft, (_met._) below, east

U+963B 岨 (for "mountain-pass" sense) (F2.60 阻) 阻滯阻隔險阻 (F2.60 岨) 險岨 (Page 25* #8: (2)阻) To hinder, to impede (Kangxi: 隔也), to stop, to make delay; grieved (Kangxi: 憂也); dangerous (Kangxi: 險也); an impediment; a defile; to suspect, to doubt (Kangxi: 疑也); _(2)h(i/)m (2)cho_ (him2 zo2 險阻), an obstruction in the way; _(2)cho chai(6)_ (zo2 zai6 阻滯) prevented from being ready; _(2)cho k(a/)k(8)_ (zo2 gaak3 阻隔) to prevent going; _(2)cho (4)n(a/)n_ (zo2 naan4 阻難), difficulties; _(2)cho ch(u(6)_ (zo2 zyu6 阻住) to hinder, blocked up; _(2)cho (2)tong_ (zo2 dong2 阻擋), to stand in the way of; _(2)cho (4)ch(')(i/)_ (zo2 ci4 阻遲), to delay; _(2)cho 'ng(6) sz'(6) kon(3)_ (zo2 ng6 si6 gon3 阻誤事幹) to retard or interrupt business. (Page 26* #1: (2)岨) Used instead of the last (阻). Cliffs; a defile; _(2)h(i/)m (2)cho_ (him2 zo2 險岨), a dangerous pass. A difficulty (Kangxi: 阻艱難也). To rely upon (Kangxi: 阻恃也). To reject. 【阻】 (tsrjoX) (_noun-like_) difficult-pass, dangerous-pass, obstruction (_adjective-like_) difficult, dangerous (_verb-like_) to difficult, to obstruct (_verb-like_) to rely (upon)

zo3.text: U+4F50 左 zo2 (alternative per 《集韻》子我切, common in 佐敦) (F2.61 佐) 輔佐 (Page 582 #6: 佐(3)) To assist, to second; an assistant, a deputy, a second (Kangxi: 輔也貳也), a substitute; _tso(3) (5)ling_ (zo3 ling5 佐領), a major-general, a resident among the Mongols; _(4)wong tso(3) (1)ch(i/) (4)ts(')oi_ (wong4 zo3 zi1 coi4 王佐之才) talents of the prime minister; _tso(3) ts(a/)p(9) (1)k(u/)n_ (zo3 zaap6 gun1 佐雜官), low officers assisting in a y(a/)mun (衙門). To encourage (to drink or to eat). 【佐】 (tsaH) (_verb-like_) to aid (aleft) (_noun-like_) aid

zok3.text: U+4F5C 乍 (F1.102 作) 起也造也爲也 (Page 592 #2: 作(8)) To act, to do, to make (Kangxi: 爲也); to begin (Kangxi: 始也), to discover, to invent (Kangxi: 造也); to arise, to appear (Kangxi: 興起也); to rouse, to animate (Kangxi: 振也), as to a reform; work, workmanship; _tsok(8) (4)wai_ (zok3 wai4 作為) acts, conduct, doings; _tsok(8) fuk(7)_ (zok3 fuk1 作福) to supplicate blessings; _peng(6) f(a/)t(8) tsok(8)_ (beng6 faat3 zok3 病發作) my ailment has come again; _h(a/)(6) tsok(8)_ (haa6 zok3 下作) mean acts; _tsok(8) (1)k(a/)_ (zok3 gaa1 作家), a writer, an essayist; _(2)h(o\) tsok(8) (1)k(a/)_ (hou2 zok3 gaa1 好作家), fine, delicate work; well set out; _sai(3) tsok(8)_ (sai3 zok3 細作) a spy; _tsok(8) (4)man (1)ch(e/)ung_ (zok3 man4 zoeng1 作文章), to compose essays; _tsok(8) (2)f(a/)n_ (zok3 faan2 作反), to turn rebel; _tsok(8) hai(6) (2)k(o\)m_ (zok3 hai6 gam2 作係噉), well, let it be this way; _tsok(8) (2)sz' (4)lai lok(8)_ (zok3 sei2 lai4 lok3 作死嚟咯) you wish to die, I think, said in anger to a careless man; _(1)kung tsok(8)_ (gung1 zok3 工作) workmanship. Williams' 工作: Now "work". 【作】 (tsak) (_verb-like_) to arise, to raise (_verb-like_) to construct, to make (_verb-like_) to compose, to write (_verb-like_) to work (_verb-like_) to be, (_met._) as 【老作】 (lou5 zok3) To make up, to fabricate.

zo6.text: U+52A9 (F2.62 助) 輔助益也 (Page 26* #3: 助(6)) To assist, to help (Kangxi: 左也); strengthening, beneficial (Kangxi: 益也); to succor; _(1)s(e/)ung cho(6)_ (soeng1 zo6 相助) to help each other; _cho(6) (4)shing ~~ko(3)~~ (2)ko k(i/)n(6) sz'(6)_ (zo6 sing4 go2 gin6 si6 助成嗰件事) help finish that business; _cho(6) (4)(i/)n_ (zo6 jin4 助言), a helping word; _cho(6) (5)n(i/) yat(7) p(i/)(3) (1)ch(i/) lik(9)_ (zo6 nei5 jat1 bei3 zi1 lik6 助你一臂之力) lend you a helping hand; _(4)ts(')ui (4)yan lok(9) cho(6)_ (ceoi4 jan4 lok6 zo6 隨人樂助) each one helping willingly. Williams' 助成嗰件事: Changed _ko(3)_ (go3) to modern _(2)ko_ (go2). 【助】 (dzrjoH) (_verb-like_) to help

U+5EA7 坐 zo6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun for "base" sense) (F2.62 座) 位也 (Page 582 #7: 坐(6); here normalised to 座) a seat, a place; (Page 583 #1: 座(6)) A seat (Kangxi: 牀座也, 坐具), a throne; a shrine; a classifier of houses, towers, hills, cities, pagodas, movable pavilions, &c.; _(1)hoi (1)kwong (1)shing tso(6)_ (hoi1 gwong1 sing1 zo6 開光陞座) to vivify and enshrine an idol; _yat(7) tso(6) t(')(a/)p(8)_ (jat1 zo6 taap3 一座塔) one division of a hong (行); _~~h(i/)(3)~~ (2)h(i/) tak(7) (1)s(a/)m tso(6) uk(7)_ (hei2 dak1 saam1 zo6 uk1 起得三座屋) can build three houses there; _(1)kung tso(6) (2)(i/)_ (gung1 zo6 ji2 公座椅), an easy chair; _p(a/)t(8) tso(6)_ (baat3 zo6 八座) eight chair-bearers. Williams' 起得三座屋: Corrected _h(i/)(3)_ (hei3) to _(2)h(i/)_ (hei2). A stand or base. Short for 星座 (constellation). 【座】 (dzwaH) (_noun-like_) seat, (_met._) place

zoek3.text: U+5981 soek6 (alternative per 《廣韻》市若切) (F1.94 妁) 媒妁 (Page 32|n75 #2: 妁(8)) A go-between (Kangxi: 媒也); to consult about a marriage; _(4)m(u/)i ch(e/)uk(8)_ (mui4 zoek3 媒妁) a match-maker. 【妁】 (tsyak, dzyak) (_noun-like_) go-between

U+65AB (F1.94 斫) 斬截也 (Page 32|n75 #9: 斫(8)) To cut with a sword or knife (Kangxi: 刀斫); to amputate; to chop, to hew (Kangxi: 擊也); _ch(e/)uk(8) (1)hoi_ (zoek3 hoi1 斫開), to cut open. 【斫】 (tsyak) (_verb-like_) to hack (off), (_met._) to hew
U+6753 (F1.94 杓) 杯杓 (Page 32|n75 #6: 杓(8)) a beam ~~for a~~ bridge (Kangxi: 橫木橋).
U+6AE1 May appear with 者 dotless (+14 assumed here) or dotted (+15), depending on the font. 鐯 A tool for hacking or chopping (Kangxi: 斫謂之櫡, 櫡謂之钁).

zyu6.text: U+6AE1 May appear with 者 dotless (+14 assumed here) or dotted (+15), depending on the font.

zoek3.text: U+721D May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font. 焳 熦 ziu3 (alternative per 《廣韻》子肖切) zoek6 (alternative per 《廣韻》在爵切) (F1.94 爝 _Ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6)) 炬火也 (Page 565 #6: 爝(9) _Ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6); here normalised to _Ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) A flambeau, a torch, a link; a lighted match burned at night on an alarm. Per 《說文》苣火祓也, a torch specifically for warding off evil. Both the dark-entering reading 即略切 _ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) and the light-entering reading 在爵切 _ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6) are attested in 《廣韻》, explained 炬火 "torch fire", along with departing 子肖切 _tsi(u/)(3)_ (ziu3), which is simply explained 火 "fire". 【爝】 (tsjak, dzjak, tsjewH) (_noun-like_) torch

zoek6.text: U+721D May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font. (F1.94 爝) 炬火也 (Page 565 #6: 爝(9))

zoek3.text: U+7235 May appear with bottom-left component as the bottom of 飠 (+13 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+14), depending on the font. (F1.94 爵) 鳥名又酒爵又爵祿 (Page 565 #4: 爵(8)) A cyathus with three legs, a cup for libations (Kangxi: 禮器也 etc.), a metallic wine cup; a bamboo wine pottle (Kangxi: 竹器所以酌酒也); a degree of nobility, rank, station (Kangxi: 爵位也, 封也 etc.); nobility; _ts(e/)uk(8) (1)p(u/)i_ (zoek3 bui1 爵杯), a wine cup; _(5)'ng ts(e/)uk(8)_ (ng5 zoek3 五爵) the five orders of nobility; _ts(e/)uk(8) wai(6)_ (zoek3 wai6 爵位) of noble rank; _(1)t(')(i/)n ts(e/)uk(8)_ (tin1 zoek3 天爵) heaven's nobility --- is a love of virtue; _ts(e/)uk(8) luk(9)_ (zoek3 luk6 爵祿) income of a nobleman. 【爵】 (tsjak) (_noun-like_) sparrow-cup (_noun-like_) nobility, noble-rank (_verb-like_) to ennoble

U+76AD May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font. ziu3 (per 《廣韻》子肖切) zoek6 (per 《廣韻》在爵切) (F1.94 皭 _Ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6)) 白色又？淨也 (Page 565 #7: 皭(9) _Ts(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6); here normalised to _Ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) A white color (Kangxi: 白色), pure, unsullied, clean (Kangxi: 淨貌); nice, clean looking. The reading _ts(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) is not unattested; 《集韻》 has the reading 即約切, explained 白色. Fan Wan entry: The unidentified character is ⿰正朿, possibly a badly typed 疎 (same as 疏).

zoek6.text: U+76AD May appear with bottom-left of right component as the bottom of 飠 (+17 assumed here) or 𩙿 (+18), depending on the font. (F1.94 皭) 白色又？淨也 (Page 565 #7: 皭(9)) Fan Wan entry: The unidentified character is ⿰正朿, possibly a badly typed 疎 (same as 疏).

zoek3.text: U+7740 著 (F1.94 着) 被服也又置也 (Page 32|n75 #1: 着(8)著(8)) to cover over, to put on, as clothes (Kangxi 著: 被服也); _(2)h(o\) ch(e/)uk(8)_ (hou2 zoek3 好着) sets well, as a garment; _ch(e/)uk(8) (1)(i/) fuk(9)_ (zoek3 ji1 fuk6 着衣服) to dress; This character is ~~often~~ to be distinguished into _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) & _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6). Williams (following Fan Wan) does not provide separate entries for 陰入 _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) ("wear" sense) and 陽入 _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6) (other senses). I have split things up accordingly. 【著-unvoiced】 (trjak) (_verb-like_) to wear 【着-wear】 (zoek3) To wear, to put on. 着褲 (zoek3 fu3): "Wearing pants." 唔着衫 (m4 zoek3 saam1): "Not wearing clothes." Olden attestation for 著 (alternative form 着) _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) meaning "wear": 《廣韻》張略切 著 服衣於身又直略張豫二切 《康熙字典》著 ...又《類篇》陟略切音芍被服也...

zoek6.text: U+7740 著 (F1.94 着 _Ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3)) 被服也又置也 (Page 32|n75 #1: 着(8)著(8) _Ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3); _Ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6) optional, here enforced) Right, correct; according to; to cause, to order, to send; a particle placed after verbs, showing a transitive and present action, and is like _ch(u(6)_ (zyu6 住) in colloquial; before verbs, let, make, permit; _(4)'m ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (m4 zoek6 唔着) unsuitable; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) kwo(3) (4)t(')au_ (zoek6 gwo3 tau4 着過頭), just right; _sh(e/)ung(6) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (soeng6 zoek6 上着) best for use; _fan(3) (4)'m ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (fan3 m4 zoek6 瞓唔着) I cannot sleep; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) shat(9) (2)t(a/)_ (zoek6 sat6 daa2 着實打), gave him a flogging; _(u(6) (1)k(a/) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (4)mong_ (jyu6 gaa1 zoek6 mong4 愈加着忙), he was still more vexed; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) sh(o\)(3)_ (zoek6 sou3 着數) cheap, good for the price; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) yung(6)_ (zoek6 jung6 着用) useful; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (1)shing (4)'m ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (2)tau_ (zoek6 sing1 m4 zoek6 dau2 着升唔着斗), it will do for a gill if not for a peck, serve for this if not for that; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (i/)(3)_ (zoek6 ji3 着意) to suit one; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) lik(9)_ (zoek6 lik6 着力) to exert one's self; _(5)yau ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) lok(9)_ (jau5 zoek6 lok6 有着落) all right, settled satisfactorily; _(1)shi(u/) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (siu1 zoek6 燒着) it is on fire; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) shat(9)_ (zoek6 sat6 着實) entirely right; _(4)ts(')am ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (cam4 zoek6 尋着) or _(2)wan ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (wan2 zoek6 搵着) found it; _~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (4)'m ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6 m4 zoek6 着唔着) is it right or not? _(2)t(i/)m (u(6) tak(7) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9)_ (dim2 jyu6 dak1 zoek6 點遇得着) how shall I get to him? _(4)m(o\) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) lok(9)_ (mou4 zoek6 lok6 無着落) I ~~dont~~ don't know what to do; _p(u/)i(3) ~~ch(e/)uk(8)~~ ch(e/)uk(9) (4)yan ts(o\)(6)_ (bui3 zoek6 jan4 zou6 背着人做) hidden, sub rosa, underhand. This character is ~~often~~ to be distinguished into _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) & _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6). Williams (following Fan Wan) does not provide separate entries for 陰入 _ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zoek3) ("wear" sense) and 陽入 _ch(e/)uk(9)_ (zoek6) (other senses). I have split things up accordingly. To put (Kangxi 著: 著置也). To attach (Kangxi 著: 附也). To contact, to touch (Kangxi 著: 著地無足). A plan, a stratagem. To catch fire, to ignite. 【著-voiced】 (drjak) (_verb-like_) to put (_verb-like_) to attach, to apply 【着-on】 (zoek6) To turn on. 着燈 (zoek6 dang1): "Turn on the light." 部機開着咗 (bou6 gei1 hoi1 zoek6 zo2): "The machine is turned on."

zoek3.text: U+799A May appear with left component 示 or 礻 (assumed here), depending on the font. (F1.94 禚) 齊地 (Page 32|n75 #8: 禚(8)) A city in the feudal state of ~~Ts(i/)~~ Ts(')(i/) (齊) (Kangxi: 齊地名), now a place in Sh(a/)ntung (山東) province.

U+914C 勺 (F1.94 酌) 注也斟也益也挹取也沽也又叅酌審擇量度也 (Page 32|n75 #3: 勺(8); here normalised to 酌) to bale or pour out; to adopt, to follow; (Page 32|n75 #5: 酌(8)) To pour out liquor, to fill a cup (Kangxi: 盛酒行觴也, 酌猶斟也); a cup, a glass; _met._ wine, liquor (Kangxi: 淸酌酒也); a dinner, a feast; to avail of, to choose the good and act upon it (Kangxi: 取善而行曰酌, 酌猶取也); to deliberate (Kangxi: 參酌); to imitate or adopt; _~~(1)sham~~ (1)ts(')(a/)m ch(e/)uk(8)_ (caam1 zoek3 參酌) or _ch(e/)uk(8) (5)(i/)_ (zoek3 ji5 酌議), to deliberate; _pok(9) ch(e/)uk(8)_ (bok6 zoek3 薄酌) a slight repast; _ch(e/)uk(8) (4)l(e/)ung (5)t(')o tong(3)_ (zoek3 loeng4 to5 dong3 酌量妥當) it is all settled right; _(1)k(e/)ung ch(e/)uk(8)_ (goeng1 zoek3 薑酌) a feast on a birth; _sh(e/)ung(6) ch(e/)uk(8)_ (soeng6 zoek3 上酌) a sumptuous feast; _(1)chung ch(e/)uk(8)_ (zung1 zoek3 中酌) the servants' course; _~~ts(u/)i(3)~~ tsi(u/)(3) ch(e/)uk(8)_ (ziu3 zoek3 醮酌) a wedding entertainment to a son; _~~(4)mi(u/)~~ (4)m(u/)i ch(e/)uk(8)_ (mui4 zoek3 梅酌) a return feast given by a bridegroom. Williams' 參酌: Corrected _(1)sham_ (sam1) to _(1)ts(')(a/)m_ (caam1). Williams' 醮酌: Corrected _ts(u/)i(3)_ (zeoi3) to _tsi(u/)(3)_ (ziu3). Williams' 梅酌: Corrected _(4)mi(u/)_ (miu4) to _(4)m(u/)i_ (mui4). 【酌】 (tsyak) (_verb-like_) to fill cup, to pour (cup) (_verb-like_) to deliberate, to consider

U+96C0 爵 䲵 zoek3-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.94 雀) 孔雀又小鳥亦曰雀 (Page 565 #3: 雀(3)) A sparrow (Kangxi: 依人小鳥也); a term for small birds (Fan Wan: 小鳥亦曰雀), like the finch or lark; ~~a kind of cap;~~ a kind of wheat (Kangxi: 蘥雀麥, 卽燕麥也); _ts(e/)uk(8) lap(9)_ (zoek3 lap6 雀立) to skip, to hop, as a sparrow (Kangxi: 雀立踊也); _(2)hung ts(e/)uk(8)_ (hung2 zoek3-2 孔雀) a peacock; _(4)m(a/) ts(e/)uk(8)_ (maa4 zoek3-2 麻雀) a sparrow; _(1)sh(a/)n (4)m(a/) ts(e/)uk(8)_ (saan1 maa4 zoek3-2 山麻雀) a lark; _ts(e/)uk(8) kok(8)_ (zoek3 gok3 雀角) litigation; _(4)wo (1)f(a/) ts(e/)uk(8)_ (wo4 faa1 zoek3-2 禾花雀) rice-birds, ortolans; _(4)m(u/)i (1)f(a/) ts(e/)uk(8)_ (mui4 faa1 zoek3-2 梅花雀) the avedevat _(Fringilla amanduva);_ _(4)sh(i/) (4)shan ts(e/)uk(8)_ (si4 san4 zoek3-2 時辰雀) a canary-bird; _ts(e/)uk(8) ~~sh(i/)t(9)~~ sh(i/)t(8) (1)f(a/)_ (zoek3 sit3 faa1 雀舌花), the _Gardenia radicans_. (Page 565 #4: 爵(8)) occurs for the preceding (雀); Williams' "a kind of cap": This is a misreading of Kangxi 雀韋弁. The subcommentary makes it clear that 雀 is an adjective describing the *colour* of the cap (Kangxi: 雀言如雀頭色也). Williams' 雀舌花: Changed _sh(i/)t(9)_ (sit6) to common reading _sh(i/)t(8)_ (sit3). 【雀】 (tsjak) (_noun-like_) sparrow 【麻雀】 (maa4 zoek3, maa4 zoek3-2) Mahjong. 打麻雀 (daa2 maa4 zoek3-2): "Play mahjong." 麻雀館 (maa4 zoek3 gun2): "Mahjong parlour." A mahjong tile. 跌咗隻麻雀 (dit3 zo2 zek3 maa4 zoek3-2): "Dropped a mahjong-tile." 【雀局】 (zoek3 guk6) Mahjong games (bundled with dinner at a restaurant). Erroneously spelt 鵲局.

zoeng1.text: U+5ADC 傽 (F1.89 嫜) 姑嫜 (Page 33|n76 #8: (1)嫜) A husband's father (Kangxi: 夫之父母也); _(1)k(u/) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (gu1 zoeng1 姑嫜), a husband's parents; _(1)hing (1)ch(e/)ung_ (hing1 zoeng1 兄嫜), a husband's older brother (Kangxi: 夫之兄曰兄嫜).

U+5F35 张 (Mainland simplified) zoeng3 (per Kangxi 知亮切 for "boast" sense) (F1.89 張) 開也設山？也又宿名 (Page 33|n76 #6: (1)張) To draw a bow (Kangxi: 施弓弦也); to extend, to stretch, to open (Kangxi: 開也); to draw up, as a list; to increase; to boast (Kangxi: 自侈大也); to state, to proclaim, to publish; a classifier of things spread out, as a table, chair, bed, paper, &c.; _(1)ch(e/)ung kw(a/)(3)_ (zoeng1 gwaa3 張掛) to hang out, as festoons; _(1)hoi (1)ch(e/)ung_ (hoi1 zoeng1 開張), to open quick or strongly; _(1)san (1)hoi (1)ch(e/)ung_ (san1 hoi1 zoeng1 新開張), to open a new shop; _(1)ch(e/)ung t(a/)i(6)_ (zoeng1 daai6 張大) to make much of, boasting; _(1)p(')(o\) (1)ch(e/)ung (4)w(a/) lai(6)_ (pou1 zoeng1 waa4 lai6 鋪張華麗) to make a great show; _(1)kw(a/)i (1)ch(e/)ung_ (gwaai1 zoeng1 乖張), crossgrained; _(1)ch(e/)ung (4)y(e/)ung_ (zoeng1 joeng4 張揚) to make known; _(1)ch(e/)ung (1)hoi (2)hau_ (zoeng1 hoi1 hau2 張開口), open your mouth; _(2)ch(u (1)ch(e/)ung_ (zyu2 zoeng1 主張), to direct, to lord over; _yat(7) (1)ch(e/)ung (4)m(u/)n (4)l(i/)m_ (jat1 zoeng1 mun4 lim4-2 一張門簾), a door-curtain. Fan Wan entry: The unidentified character is ⿵𡗜弓, where 𡗜 is ⿻大丷. Williams' 主張: Dated; 主張 now means to assert or hold a position or opinion. Large (Kangxi: 大也). To spread (Kangxi: 施也). To set out, to arrange (Kangxi: 設也). To string (a string instrument) (Kangxi: 施絃曰張). To spread a net to catch animals (Kangxi: 羅取鳥獸曰張). A surname (Kangxi: 姓). A position, an opinion. To look. 【張-level】 (trjang) (_verb-like_) to tension (_verb-like_) to string (_verb-like_) to extend, to spread (_verb-like_) to set out, to arrange (_verb-like_) to boast (_adjective-like_) large 【張】 (zoeng1) (_mahjong_) Classifier for tiles (especially when revealed). Also spelt 章. 九張 (gau2 zoeng1): "Nine tiles revealed" (three melds). 十二張 (sap6 ji6 zoeng1): "Twelve tiles revealed" (four melds). 跟張 (gan1 zoeng1): "Follow the revealed tile" (which is safe). 凸張 (dat6 zoeng1): "Having an extra unmeldable tile" (which might result in a loss on discard).

zoeng3.text: U+5F35 张 (Mainland simplified) To swell, to inflate. 【張-departing】 (trjangH) (_verb-like_) to swell, to inflate

zoeng1.text: U+5F70 (F1.89 彰) 著也明也 (Page 33|n76 #9: (1)彰) Luminous (Kangxi: 明也, 著也); beautiful; elegant; to manifest (Kangxi: 著明之也); variegated plumage or pelage (Kangxi: 毛髮貌謂鳥獸羽毛之文); _(1)ch(e/)ung (4)ming_ (zoeng1 ming4 彰明), clearly exhibited. Adorned (Kangxi: 文彰也, 文章飾也). 【彰】 (tsyang) (_adjective-like_) manifest, decorated (_verb-like_) to manifest
U+615E 傽 (F1.89 慞) 惶恐 (Page 33|n76 #10: (1)慞) Alarm; apprehensive; _(1)ch(e/)ung (4)wong_ (zoeng1 wong4 慞惶), terrified, fearful (Kangxi: 慞惶懼也); a horrified look.

U+6A1F (F1.89 樟) 木名 (Page 33|n76 #11: (1)樟) The camphor _(Laurus camphora)_ (Kangxi: 豫樟木也 etc.)_;_ _(1)ch(e/)ung muk(9)_ (zoeng1 muk6 樟⽊) camphor wood; _(1)ch(e/)ung (5)n(o\)_ (zoeng1 nou5 樟腦), gum camphor; _(1)h(e/)ung (1)ch(e/)ung_ (hoeng1 zoeng1 香樟), a camphor odor. 【樟】 (tsyang) (_noun-like_) camphor-tree
U+6F33 (F1.89 漳) 水名 (Page 34|n77 #1: (1)漳) Name of a river (Kangxi: 水名); the prefecture of Ch(a/)ngchau (漳州) (Kangxi: 州名) in Fuhkien (福建) near Amoy (廈門).

U+6F3F 䊢 浆 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 漿) 水漿酒漿 (F1.89 䊢) 米䊢 (Page 566 #1: (1)漿(1)䊢) Thick, half fluid, pasty (Kangxi 漿: 一曰水米汁相將也); starch, syrup, pus, or matter; to starch; broth boiled down thick, congee; _(4)nai (1)ts(e/)ung_ (nai4 zoeng1 泥漿), mire; _(2)tsau (1)ts(e/)ung_ (zau2 zoeng1 酒漿), a banquet; _(1)ts(e/)ung (1)(i/) fuk(9)_ (zoeng1 ji1 fuk6 漿衣服) to starch clothes; _(1)ts(e/)ung (4)(u/)_ (zoeng1 wu4 漿糊), paste; _~~m(o\)(6)~~ mo(6) (1)ts(e/)ung_ (mo6 zoeng1 磨漿), to prepare starch. The second form (䊢) is unauthorized. Williams' 磨漿: Corrected _m(o\)(6)_ (mou6) to _mo(6)_ (mo6). A sour(?) syrup (Kangxi 漿: 酢漿也). 【漿】 (tsjang) (_noun-like_) thick-liquid

U+7350 麞 (F1.89 獐) 鹿屬無角 (F1.89 麞) 獸名 (Page 34|n77 #4: (1)麞; here normalised to 獐) A kind of chevrotain or gazelle, hornless, and of elegant shape (Kangxi 麞: 與獐同, 麋屬, 麞如小鹿而美); _(4)ngan (1)ch(e/)ung_ (ngan4 zoeng1 銀獐), the white gazelle---appears in good reigns (Kangxi 麞: 符瑞志有銀麞白色王者𠛬罰中理則出).
U+748B (F1.89 璋) 玉名 (Page 34|n77 #2: (1)璋) A kind of plaything made of jade (Kangxi: 剡上爲圭半圭爲璋); _lung(6) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (lung6 zoeng1 弄璋), to bear a son. 【璋】 (tsyang) (_noun-like_) jade-ornament

U+7AE0 彰 (for "manifest" sense) (F1.89 章) 文章采章章明表章 (Page 33|n76 #7: (1)章) A piece of music (Kangxi: 樂竟爲一章); a chapter, a section (Kangxi: 篇章); a composition; a statement; rules, laws, regulations (Kangxi: 條也程也); clear (Kangxi: 明也), beautiful (Kangxi: 文章也), manifest; a display; ~~a grove;~~ a metonic cycle (Kangxi: ...十九年爲一章...); _(2)ts(')oi (1)ch(e/)ung_ (coi2 zoeng1 彩章), variegated; _h(i/)n(3) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (hin3 zoeng1 憲章), magistrate's orders; _(1)ch(e/)ung k(u(3)_ (zoeng1 geoi3 章句) sections and paragraphs; _sh(o\)(3) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (sou3 zoeng1 數章), many papers or statements; _(1)ch(e/)ung (4)ch(')ing_ (zoeng1 cing4 章程), regulations, rule of conduct; _(4)wong (1)ch(e/)ung_ (wong4 zoeng1 王章), laws of the land; _(4)t(')(o\) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (tou4 zoeng1 圖章) or _yan(3) (1)ch(e/)ung_ (jan3 zoeng1 印章), a seal (Kangxi: 印章). Colourful decoration (Kangxi: 采也). A completed matter or composition (Kangxi: 成事成文曰章). An emblem. Great forest trees (Kangxi: 大林木曰章). Order. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). 【章】 (tsyang) (_adjective-like_) manifest, decorated, (_met._) magnificent (_verb-like_) to manifest (_noun-like_) decoration (_noun-like_) emblem (_noun-like_) composition (_noun-like_) chapter, section (_noun-like_) statute

U+8523 蒋 (Mainland simplified) (Page 566 #5: (2)蔣 _(2)Ts(e/)ung_ (zoeng2); here corrected to _(1)Ts(e/)ung_ (zoeng1)) _(1)k(u/) ~~(2)ts(e/)ung~~ (1)ts(e/)ung_ (gu1 zoeng1 菰蔣), an aquatic grain (Kangxi: 苽蔣); wild rice; _~~(2)ts(e/)ung~~ (1)ts(e/)ung ~~(4)mau~~ (4)m(a/)u_ (zoeng1 maau4 蔣茅), stubble, straw. Williams' 菰蔣: Specifically, _Zizania latifolia_ (or Manchurian wild rice). Williams' 蔣茅: Corrected _(4)mau_ (mau4) to _(4)m(a/)u_ (maau4).

zoeng2.text: U+8523 蒋 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 蔣) 地名周公子封于蔣後遂爲姓 (Page 566 #5: (2)蔣) A surname (Kangxi: 姓);

zoeng1.text: U+87BF 螀 (Mainland simplified) (F1.89 螿) 寒螿虫名 (Page 566 #2: (1)螿) Small species of cicada or grasshopper, whose elytra are green (Kangxi: 寒螿蟬屬 etc.).

U+9123 (F1.89 鄣) 地名 (Page 34|n77 #3: (1)鄣) A feudal state, now part of T(a/)i-ng(a/)n f(u/) (泰安府) in ~~Shantung~~ Sh(a/)ntung (山東); an ancient city in K(u (莒), also in the modern Sh(a/)ntung (山東). The two senses in Kangxi are 《說文》紀邑也 and 莒邑. It is not clear to me whether these are states or cities (or one each).
U+9E9E (F1.89 獐) 鹿屬無角 (F1.89 麞) 獸名 (Page 34|n77 #4: (1)麞)

zoeng2.text: U+596C (F1.92 奬) 褒奬勸也勵也稱舉也 (Page 566 #3: (2)奬)

U+638C (F1.91 掌) 手掌又主也掌握掌管又鞅掌失容也 (Page 34|n77 #5: (2)掌) The palm of the hand (Kangxi: 手中也, 手心也謂指本也); the paw or sole of animals; a webbed foot; to grasp; to rule, to control (Kangxi: 職掌主也); a control, a jurisdiction; _(2)shau (2)ch(e/)ung_ (sau2 zoeng2 手掌), the palm; _(2)t(a/) yat(7) (1)p(a/) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (daa2 jat1 baa1 zoeng2 打一巴掌), a slap of the hand; _(2)ch(e/)ung (2)k(u/)n (1)kung (4)yan_ (zoeng2 gun2 gung1 jan4 掌管工人), to oversee workmen; _h(o\)p(9) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (hap6 zoeng2 合掌), to clasp the hands, as in prayer; _(2)ch(e/)ung ak(7) (1)ping (4)k(')(un_ (zoeng2 ak1 bing1 kyun4 掌握兵權), to command the forces; _(2)ch(e/)ung k(a/)u(3)_ (zoeng2 gaau3 掌教) to teach graduates; _hon(3) (2)shau (2)ch(e/)ung_ (hon3 sau2 zoeng2 看手掌), to examine the hand, palmistry; _p(')(a/)k(8) (2)ch(e/)ung_ (paak3 zoeng2 拍掌), to clap the hands; _(2)ch(e/)ung kwai(6)_ (zoeng2 gwai6-2 掌櫃) a bookkeeper, a salesman; _(i/)(6) (4)(u (2)f(a/)n (2)ch(e/)ung_ (ji6 jyu4 faan2 zoeng2 易如反掌), as easy as to turn the hand over. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𬋩 to 管. Used in 鞅掌 (uncomposed, bustling) (Kangxi: 鞅掌失容也, 言促遽也, 言事煩不暇爲容儀也). To slap. 【鞅掌】 ('jangX tsyangX) (_adjective-like_) uncomposed, bustling 【掌】 (tsyangX) (_noun-like_) palm, (_met._) paw (_verb-like_) to have charge (of), to take charge (of) Used in 鞅掌.

U+69F3 桨 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 槳) 船槳 (Page 566 #4: (2)槳) An oar (Kangxi: 楫屬 etc.); _ch(a/)u(6) (2)ts(e/)ung_ (zaau6 zoeng2 櫂槳), to row; _(2)ts(e/)ung (4)sh(un_ (zoeng2 syun4 槳船), a revenue cutter, because it has many oars.

U+734E 奬 㢡 奖 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 奬) 褒奬勸也勵也稱舉也 (Page 566 #3: (2)奬; here normalised to 獎) To exhort, to animate, to excite, to encourage (Kangxi 奬: 勸勉也); to laud, to praise, to commend (Kangxi 奬: 褒美也); ~~to vindicate,~~ to give efficacy to (Kangxi 奬: 助也); ~~to set on, as dogs;~~ _(2)ts(e/)ung h(un(3)_ (zoeng2 hyun3 獎勸) to exhort; _(2)ts(e/)ung (2)sh(e/)ung_ (zoeng2 soeng2 獎賞) to hold out rewards to; a reward; _(4)ho yung(6) kwo(3) (2)ts(e/)ung_ (ho4 jung6 gwo3 zoeng2 何用過獎), why so much overpraise? Williams' "to set on, as dogs": This is a misreading of Kangxi 嗾犬厲之也. This is the 《說文》 explanation of the hound radical, and should be rendered "to sound at an hound to encourage it". A reward, a prize.

zoeng6.text: U+4ED7 杖 (for "rely" sense) zoeng6-3 (for "battle" sense, except in 陣仗) (F1.93 仗) 兵器刀劍總名又儀衞曰仗又倚仗憑依也 (Page 35|n78 #7: 仗(6)) ~~A sharp weapon~~ Weaponry (Kangxi: 劒戟總名); to fight; to rely on, to lean on, to look up to (Kangxi: 憑倚也); _(2)t(a/) shing(3) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (daa2 sing3 zoeng6-3 打勝仗) to get the victory; _ts(i/)p(8) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (zip3 zoeng6-3 接仗) in battle; _(2)t(a/) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (daa2 zoeng6-3 打仗) to fight, at war; _tak(7) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (dak1 zoeng6 得仗) to have a friend; _(5)y(e/)ung ch(e/)ung(6)_ (joeng5 zoeng6 仰仗) to look to for aid; _ch(e/)ung(6) wai(6)_ (zoeng6 wai6 仗衛) imperial guard; _(1)ping ch(e/)ung(6)_ (bing1 zoeng6 兵仗) arms; _(2)(i/) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (ji2 zoeng6 倚仗) to trust to. Battle. To hold, to wield. 【大陣仗】 (daai6 zan6 zoeng6) A big scene, or to make a big fuss. (Literally, "great battle-array".) 好大陣仗 (hou2 daai6 zan6 zoeng6): "A very big fuss."

zoeng3.text: U+5E33 張 帐 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 帳) 帷幕也 (Page 34|n77 #8: 帳(3)) A curtain, a screen (Kangxi: 帳張也張施於牀上也, 帷也張也幬也); a tent; ~~a house;~~ ~~to calculate;~~ to spread; ~~a reason, a plan;~~ _p(o\)(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (bou3 zoeng3 布帳) an awning; _ch(e/)ung(3) (4)l(i/)m_ (zoeng3 lim4-2 帳簾), a hanging door-screen; _ch(')(i/)t(8) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (cit3 zoeng3 設帳) to pitch one's tent, to become a teacher; _(1)man ch(e/)ung(3)_ (man1 zoeng3 蚊帳) a bed-curtain; _wan(6) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (wan6 zoeng3 混帳) unreasonable, incoherent; _(4)p(')ing ch(e/)ung(3)_ (ping4 zoeng3 屏帳) a movable screen of silk; _shau(6) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (sau6 zoeng3 壽帳) a scroll given to old people.

U+6F32 涨 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 漲) 大水貌又水泛溢 (F1.92 涱) 同上 (Page 35|n78 #1: 漲(3)) An inundation (Kangxi: 水大貌); to overflow (Kangxi: 溢也); a sheet of water; the southern sea (Kangxi: 南海名); _(2)shui ch(e/)ung(3)_ (seoi2 zoeng3 水漲) water is rising, overflowing.

U+7634 (F1.93 瘴) 瘴癘熱病 (Page 35|n78 #3: 瘴(3)) Malaria (Kangxi: 瘴癘也, 熱病); pestilential vapors; pestiferous air; _(1)(i/)n ch(e/)ung(3)_ (jin1 zoeng3 煙瘴) unwholesome climate; _(4)l(a/)m ch(e/)ung(3)_ (laam4 zoeng3 嵐瘴) noxious vapor; _h(i/)(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (hei3 zoeng3 氣瘴) deleterious malaria. Fan Wan entry: Normalised 𤍠 to 熱.

U+8139 張 漲 痮 胀 (Mainland simplified) zoeng3-2 (rising second in vernacular 脹脹地) (F1.92 脹) 腫脹 (Page 35|n78 #2: 脹(3)) A swelled belly (Kangxi: 腹滿也); a swelling; dropsical; _(2)shui ch(e/)ung(3)_ (seoi2 zoeng3 水脹) dropsy of the belly, ascites; _ch(e/)ung(3) (5)m(u/)n_ (zoeng3 mun5 脹滿), belly hard or puffy; _(2)p(a/)u ch(e/)ung(3)_ (baau2 zoeng3 飽脹) a bellyful, a feeling of fullness; _ch(e/)ung(3) (5)m(u/)n (4)hung (4)t(')ong_ (zoeng3 mun5 hung4 tong4 脹滿紅堂), swelling with rage, incensed.

U+8CEC 帳 账 (Mainland simplified) (F1.92 賬) 賬目 (Page 34|n77 #8: 帳(3)) an account, for which the next (賬) is used (Kangxi 帳: 計簿也); (Page 34|n77 #9: 賬(3)) An unauthorized character. A debt, a claim, an account, a charge; to reckon, to sum up; to calculate~~.~~; ~~A colloquial word.~~ ~~A time, an occasion;~~ ~~_(4)lai kwo(3) yat(7) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (lai4 gwo3 jat1 zoeng3 嚟過一賬) I have been here once;~~ _(4)'m s(un(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (m4 syun3 zoeng3 唔算賬) do not put it to my account, it's none of my business; _ngan(6) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (ngan6 zoeng3 韌賬) a tough account, a refused bill; _ch(e/)ung(3) muk(9)_ (zoeng3 muk6 賬目) accounts; _(1)shau ch(e/)ung(3)_ (sau1 zoeng3 收賬) to receive money on account; _ch(e/)ung(3) (1)t(a/)n_ (zoeng3 daan1 賬單), a bill; _(1)chui ch(e/)ung(3)_ (zeoi1 zoeng3 追賬) to dun; _ch(e/)ung(3) (4)fong_ (zoeng3 fong4 賬房), a counting-room; _hau(6) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (hau6 zoeng3 候賬) waiting for a settlement; _s(un(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (syun3 zoeng3 算賬) to reckon accounts; _ch(e/)ung(3) (2)p(o\)_ (zoeng3 bou6-2 賬簿), an account book; _t(u/)i(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (deoi3 zoeng3 對賬) to balance accounts by offsetting; _(1)ts(')ing ch(e/)ung(3)_ (cing1 zoeng3 清賬) or _(4)w(a/)n ch(e/)ung(3)_ (waan4 zoeng3 還賬) to pay off an account; _h(i/)m(3) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (him3 zoeng3 欠賬) to owe. A colloquial word. A time, an occasion; _(4)lai kwo(3) yat(7) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (lai4 gwo3 jat1 zoeng3 嚟過一賬) I have been here once. "A colloquial word" applies only to the "time/occasion" sense. I have fixed this by moving that sense to the bottom.

U+91AC 酱 (Mainland simplified) (F1.93 醬) 醢也肉醬謂之醢又豉醬 (Page 566 #6: 醬(3)) A sort of sauce, pickle or condiment (Kangxi: 醢也, 醢肉醬也又豉醬又菜茹亦謂之醬), made of salt and sugar; relishes, seasoning, like oilmen's stores; salted preparations; _(1)kon ts(e/)ung(3)_ (gon1 zoeng3 乾醬) dried seasoning; _ts(e/)ung(3) (4)(un_ (zoeng3 jyun4-2 醬園), a shop where condiments are sold; _ts(e/)ung(3) li(u/)(6)_ (zoeng3 liu6-2 醬料) materials for preserves; _(4)l(u/)i ts(e/)ung(3)_ (leoi4 zoeng3 擂醬) to mix sauces; _(5)'ng m(i/)(6) ts(e/)ung(3)_ (ng5 mei6 zoeng3 五味醬) a compounded sauce; _m(i/)n(6) sh(i/)(6) ts(e/)ung(3)_ (min6 si6-2 zoeng3 麪豉醬) a sort of bean relish. 【醬】 (tsjangH) (_noun-like_) paste

U+969C 鄣 zoeng1 (alternative per 《廣韻》諸良切) (F1.92 障) 隔也蔽也塞也 (Page 35|n78 #4: 障(3)) To separate (Kangxi: 隔也); to divide (Kangxi: 界也); to shut up, to include; to raise an embankment; something which prevents progress; an intervening distance; a barricade (Kangxi: 障衞也), a trench, a fence; a protection~~, as a carpet~~; a dike, a terminus; _(2)p(a/)n ch(e/)ung(3)_ (baan2 zoeng3 板障) a board partition; _ch(e/)ung(3) sak(7)_ (zoeng3 sak1 障塞) a hindrance or stoppage; _(2)p(o\) ch(e/)ung(3)_ (bou2 zoeng3 保障) a defense or embankment; to defend a barrier; _ch(e/)ung(3) pai(3)_ (zoeng3 bai3 障蔽) to close against ingress. A screen (Kangxi: 步障也). Used in 故障 (malfunction, failure). 【障】 (tsyang, tsyangH) (_verb-like_) to barrier, to embank, (_met._) to shield (_noun-like_) barrier

zoeng6.text: U+4E08 zoeng6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun in 姑丈, 姨丈) (F1.93 丈) 十尺曰丈又大丈夫 (Page 35|n78 #5: 丈(6)) Ten _ch(')ek_ (尺) (Kangxi: 十尺曰丈) or 141 English inches; to measure; an elder (Kangxi: 長老之稱); _ch(e/)ung(6) (4)l(e/)ung_ (zoeng6 loeng4 丈量), to measure land; _ch(e/)ung(6) (1)f(u/)_ (zoeng6 fu1 丈夫), my husband; _(5)l(o\) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (lou5 zoeng6 老丈) or _ch(e/)ung(6) (4)yan (1)kung_ (zoeng6 jan4 gung1 丈人公), a wife's father; _t(a/)i(6) ch(e/)ung(6) (1)f(u/)_ (daai6 zoeng6 fu1 大丈夫), a talented man; _(1)fong ch(e/)ung(6)_ (fong1 zoeng6 方丈) the abbot of a monastery. Williams' 141 English inches: The Ts(')ing Dynasty _ch(')ek_ (尺) was only standardised to 14⅝ inches by the British in Hong Kong in Ordinance No. 8 of 1885. See also commentary at 咫 zi2. Williams' "abbot of a monastery": Originally the *residence* of the abbot (Kangxi: 釋氏所居曰方丈). 【丈】 (drjangX) (_noun-like_) measure, rod (_noun-like_) old-man, man

U+50CF May appear as either ⿰亻象 (assumed here) or ⿰亻𧰼, depending on the font. (F1.93 像) 形像又倣摸也 (Page 566 #9: 像(6)) like, similar (Kangxi: 形象也肖似也); a figure, image, likeness; a statue, an idol; to resemble, to imitate (Kangxi: 摹倣也); _(5)ngau ts(e/)ung(6)_ (ngau5 zoeng6 偶像) a statue; _(4)shan ts(e/)ung(6)_ (san4 zoeng6 神像) an idol; _ts(e/)ung(6) (1)shang_ (zoeng6 sang1 像生) like life; _(4)m(o\) ts(e/)ung(6)_ (mou4 zoeng6 模像) to limn a copy; _(4)yan ts(e/)ung(6)_ (jan4 zoeng6 人像) a portrait; _(2)s(e/)ung ts(e/)ung(6)_ (soeng2 zoeng6 想像) an idea, an illustration; _(4)'m ts(e/)ung(6) y(e/)ung(6)_ (m4 zoeng6 joeng6-2 唔像樣) not according to rule. 【像】 (zjangX) (_verb-like_) to image, to depict

U+5320 匞 (F1.93 匠) 工匠 (Page 567 #1: 匠(6)) A workman, a mechanic, an artisan of any kind (Kangxi: 工匠); _(2)t(a/) (4)ngan ts(e/)ung(6)_ (daa2 ngan4-2 zoeng6 打銀匠) a silversmith; _muk(9) ts(e/)ung(6)_ (muk6 zoeng6 木匠) a joiner, a carpenter; _(4)nai (2)shui ts(e/)ung(6)_ (nai4 seoi2 zoeng6 泥水匠) a bricklayer; _(1)kung ts(e/)ung(6)_ (gung1 zoeng6 工匠) a mechanic. Originally, a carpenter (Kangxi: 木工也). 【匠】 (dzjangH) (_noun-like_) carpenter, artisan

U+6756 丈 zoeng6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.93 杖) 梃也 (Page 35|n78 #6: 杖(6)) A cane, a staff (Kangxi: 所以扶行也); a cudgel, a club (Kangxi: 木梃也); to lean on (Kangxi: 憑倚也); to hold (Kangxi: 持也); to beat; aged, an old man; to mourn; _(2)kw(a/)i ch(e/)ung(6)_ (gwaai2 zoeng6-2 拐杖) a staff for old folks; _(1)ch(')(i/) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (ci1 zoeng6 笞杖) to bamboo; _(5)m(u/)n ch(e/)ung(6)_ (mun5 zoeng6 滿杖) to beat 8O strokes; _ch(e/)ung(6) (1)(u (1)h(e/)ung_ (zoeng6 jyu1 hoeng1 杖於鄉), a village sexagenarian; _~~sik(7)~~ sek(8) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (sek3 zoeng6 錫杖) a crosier; _ch(e/)ung(6) (1)k(i/) (1)f(u/)_ (zoeng6 gei1 fu1 杖期夫), mourners of one year; _(4)hang ch(e/)ung(6)_ (hang4 zoeng6 行杖) bambooing, beating; _chap(7) ch(e/)ung(6)_ (zap1 zoeng6 執杖) to carry a staff at a funeral. Williams' 錫杖: Changed _sik(7)_ (sik1) to common reading _sek(8)_ (sek3). 【杖-rising】 (drjangX) (_noun-like_) staff, rod 【杖-departing】 (drjangH) (_verb-like_) to lean (upon) (_verb-like_) to hold

U+6A61 May appear as either ⿰木象 (assumed here) or ⿰木𧰼, depending on the font. 様 樣 Acorn, the fruit of the oak (Kangxi: 栩實也). Rubber (from the rubber tree), used in compounds. 【橡】 (zjangX) (_noun-like_) acorn 【橡筋】 (zoeng6 gan1) A rubber band. 畀橡筋紮住 (bei2 zoeng6 gan1 zaat3 zyu6): "Bound by rubber band." Jellyfish (as food).

U+8C61 像 (for "resemble", "imitate", and "image" senses) 𧰼 (F1.93 象) 獸名又似也 (Page 566 #8: 象(6)) An elephant (Kangxi: 長鼻牙南越大獸 etc.); a figure, a form, an image; the shape things take (Kangxi: 象形也); superstitious auguries or fancy; imagination, resemblance; a law (Kangxi: 法也); to imitate; ~~pantomime;~~ _ts(e/)ung(6) (4)ng(a/)_ (zoeng6 ngaa4 象牙) ivory; _ts(e/)ung(6) pat(9)_ (zoeng6 bat6 象拔) a proboscis; _ts(e/)ung(6) (4)p(')(i/)_ (zoeng6 pei4 象皮), elephant's skin, a medicine; a name for india rubber; _ts(e/)ung(6) k(o\)m(3) t(a/)i(6) chek(8) k(e/)uk(8)_ (zoeng6 gam3 daai6 zek3 goek3 象咁大隻腳) my leg is as heavy as an elephant's --- I'm ashamed to go back; _t(a/)i(6) pan(6) ts(e/)ung(6)_ (daai6 ban6 zoeng6 大笨象) stupid, dull. (Page 566 #9: 像(6)) Interchanged with the preceding (象); Williams' 象皮: The "rubber" sense is now spelt 橡皮. 【象】 (zjangX) (_noun-like_) elephant (_noun-like_) image, depiction 【大笨象】 (daai6 ban6 zoeng6) An elephant.

zoi1.text: U+54C9 才 㦲 (F2.43 哉) 語助詞又始也 (Page 588 #3: (1)哉) An interjection (Kangxi: 言之閒也) of praise or surprise; an interrogative particle, intimating doubt or conviction, according to the scope (Kangxi: 疑辭也); a superlative; a particle placed after important words to draw attention (Kangxi: 語助), but the regimen alters its meaning much; to begin (Kangxi: 哉始也); ~~to burst forth, as plants in spring;~~ _(4)k(')(i/) k(u/)(3) (4)ho (1)tsoi_ (kei4 gu3 ho4 zoi1 其故何哉), on what account, pray? _(4)ho (5)yau (1)(u (5)ngo (1)tsoi_ (ho4 jau5 jyu1 ngo5 zoi1 何有於我哉), what is this to me? _(2)h(i/) (2)ho sik(7) (1)tsoi_ (hei2 ho2 sik1 zoi1 豈可惜哉), would you pity him! _(4)yan (5)(un ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/) (1)tsoi_ (jan4 jyun5 fu4 zoi1 仁遠乎哉), has humanity so far gone! _(1)on pat(7) (1)p(i/) (1)tsoi_ (on1 bat1 bei1 zoi1 安不悲哉), how could I forbear pity? _sik(7) (1)tsoi_ (sik1 zoi1 惜哉), sad indeed! _t(a/)i(6) (1)tsoi man(6)_ (daai6 zoi1 man6 大哉問) ah! truly an important question; _t(a/)i(6) (1)tsoi (2)Hung (2)tsz'_ (daai6 zoi1 hung2 zi2 大哉孔子) Confucius, oh, how great! _(1)(u/) (1)f(u/) (1)oi (1)tsoi_ (wu1 fu1 oi1 zoi1 嗚呼哀哉), alas, sad indeed! _(5)y(e/) (1)tsoi (4)Yau ~~y(a/)(6)~~ (5)y(a/)_ (je5 zoi1 jau4 jaa5 野哉由也) what a clown is Yau! _(1)k(u/) (1)ch(i/) (1)tsoi, (1)k(u/) (1)ch(i/) (1)tsoi_ (gu1 zi1 zoi1, gu1 zi1 zoi1 沽之哉沽之哉), sell it! sell it! The alternative form U+39B2 㦲 (⿹𢦏勹) is known to appear incorrectly in at least one sans-serif font; check the Font test page. Williams' "to burst forth, as plants in spring": This is a misreading of Kangxi 說文云才草木之初也以聲近借爲哉始之哉, which says that the "begin" sense of 哉 was sometimes spelt 才 due to the phonetic nearness and the (now considered incorrect) explanation of 才 as a sprouting plant in 《說文》. Williams' 仁遠乎哉: Changed _(4)(u/)_ (wu4) to common reading _(4)f(u/)_ (fu4). Williams' 野哉由也: Corrected _y(a/)(6)_ (jaa6) to _(5)y(a/)_ (jaa5). Two of Williams' examples (大哉問, 野哉由也) are suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.14 (_Examples of ts(a/)i_, 哉, _and n(a/)i_, 乃) of J. G. Bridgman's 1847 translation of Premare's ''Notitia Linguae Sinicae''. A further four examples (其故何哉, 何有於我哉, 仁遠乎哉, 安不悲哉) are identical or suspiciously similar to those in Section 2.17 (_Interrogative Particles_) of the same. 【哉】 (tsoj) (_speech-assist_) (_verb-like_) to begin

U+683D (F2.43 栽) 種植也 (Page 588 #4: (1)栽) To plant seed (Kangxi: 種也); to set out saplings, to put suckers in the ground (Kangxi: 草木之殖曰栽); to hill, to heap up earth at the roots; a sapling (Kangxi: 穉曰栽長曰樹); to assist; _(1)f(a/) (1)tsoi_ (faa1 zoi1 花栽), flower suckers; _(1)tsoi (4)p(')(u/)i_ (zoi1 pui4 栽培), to put earth to, as to roots; _(2)ho (5)(i/) (1)tsoi (4)p(')(u/)i_ (ho2 ji5 zoi1 pui4 可以栽培), he is worthy of your care. To tumble, to fall. 【栽-level】 (tsoj) (_verb-like_) to plant

zoi6.text: U+683D To erect long panelling used to construct walls (Kangxi: 築牆長板, 設築板). 【栽-departing】 (dzojH) (_verb-like_) to erect construction-panelling

zoi1.text: U+707D 灾 烖 甾 菑 (F2.43 災) 災禍災害 (F2.43 灾) 同上 (F2.43 烖) 同上 (F2.43 菑) 古灾字又音兹 (Page 588 #5: (1)災(1)灾(1)烖) Natural calamities (Kangxi 災: 天火也), as floods or drought; divine judgments, plagues; misfortunes, miseries, dangers (Kangxi 災: 害也); adverse, calamitous, unfortunate; _(1)tsoi hoi(6)_ (zoi1 hoi6 災害) injurious, afflictive; _(1)tsoi wo(6)_ (zoi1 wo6 災禍) miserable; afflictions; _kau(3) (1)tsoi_ (gau3 zoi1 救災), to relieve sufferings; _(1)chi(u/) (1)tsoi_ (ziu1 zoi1 招災), to bring evil on one's self; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)tsoi (4)w(a/)ng wo(6)_ (tin1 zoi1 waang4 wo6 天災橫禍) divine and unforeseen judgments; _sung(3) (2)fo (1)tsoi_ (sung3 fo2 zoi1 送火災), to dismiss all risk of fire, as is done at a _~~(2)ta~~ (2)t(a/) tsi(u/)(3)_ (daa2 ziu3 打醮)_;_ _(2)shui (1)tsoi_ (seoi2 zoi1 水災), a flood; _(1)t(')(i/)n (1)tsoi (4)lau (4)hang_ (tin1 zoi1 lau4 hang4 天災流行), an epidemic; _(1)tsoi (1)y(e/)ung kok(8) t(i/)(6) (4)t(')au_ (zoi1 joeng1 gok3 dei6 tau4 災殃各地頭), each place has its own calamity. Fan Wan entry: Added (hypothesised) homophone 兹 for 菑. Williams' 打醮: Corrected _(2)ta_ to _(2)t(a/)_. 【災】 (tsoj) (_noun-like_) calamity

zoi2.text: U+5BB0 (F2.44 宰) 主宰烹宰又邑宰家宰 (Page 588 #6: (2)宰) To govern, to rule, to superintend (Kangxi: 治也, 主也, 制也, 爲事物主也); ~~to fashion to one's liking;~~ a ruler, a headman, a governor (Kangxi: 官稱); to slaughter animals, to butcher, to skin and dress animals (Kangxi: 屠也烹也); ~~to cook;~~ _(2)tsoi s(e/)ung(3)_ (zoi2 soeng3 宰相) a prime-minister; _(2)ch(u (2)tsoi_ (zyu2 zoi2 主宰), the ruler of all, the chief governor; the mind; _(1)k(a/) (2)tsoi_ (gaa1 zoi2 家宰), a steward; _kam(3) (2)ch(i/) (4)t(')(o\) (2)tsoi_ (gam3 zi2 tou4 zoi2 禁止屠宰), prohibited the butchering of animals, as in time of drought; _(un(6) (2)tsoi_ (jyun6 zoi2 縣宰), a district magistrate; _(2)tsoi (4)ngau_ (zoi2 ngau4 宰牛), to kill an ox. A surname (Kangxi: 姓). A steward (Kangxi: 家臣之長曰宰). Used in 宰父 (a compound surname) (Kangxi: 宰父複姓). 【宰】 (tsojX) (_noun-like_) steward, minister, governor (_verb-like_) to rule over (_verb-like_) to butcher

U+8F09 载 (Mainland simplified) (F2.44 載) 年也 (Page 589 #1: (2)載) A year (Kangxi: 年也); to commence, as after a full revolution (Kangxi: 載始也取物終更始之義); _p(u/)n(3) (2)tsoi_ (bun3 zoi2 半載), half a year; _(1)ts(')(i/)n (2)tsoi h(a/)(6)_ (cin1 zoi2 haa6 千載下) handed down a thousand years; _(2)k(i/) (2)tsoi_ (gei2 zoi2 幾載), several years. 【載-rising】 (tsojX) (_noun-like_) year

zoi3.text: U+8F09 载 (Mainland simplified) zoi6 (per 《集韻》昨代切 for "load" senses) (F2.45 載) 裝載又載籍 (Page 589 #2: 載(3)) To contain, to hold, as a carriage or ship (Kangxi: 乗也); to fill in, to load on, to bear, to sustain (Kangxi: 承也勝也); to act, to do (Kangxi: 行也), to ~~fullfil~~ fulfil (Kangxi: 成也), to effect; to record (Kangxi: 記載也); to adorn, to beautify (Kangxi: 飾也); to load in and transport (Kangxi: 舟車運物也); written, recorded; filled, loaded (Kangxi: 滿也); an auxiliary word, then, thereupon (Kangxi: 則也助語辭); an incalculably high number; _(1)chong tsoi(3)_ (zong1 zoi3 裝載) to store, to load, as a carriage; _tsoi(3) (5)m(u/)n_ (zoi3 mun5 載滿), loaded full; _tsoi(3) lok(9) (4)ho (1)sh(u_ (zoi3 lok6 ho4 syu1 載落何書), in what book is it recorded? _(4)'m kau(3) tsoi(3)_ (m4 gau3 zoi3 唔夠載) not enough to load it; _(5)m(o\) (5)y(e/) tsoi(3) ~~ch(u(3)~~ ch(u(6)_ (mou5 je5 zoi3 zyu6 冇嘢載住) I've nothing to put it in; _(2)p(i/) ko(3) (5)t(')(o\) tsoi(3)_ (bei2 go3 tou5 zoi3 畀個肚載) he lays it up in his mind, he'll remember it; _(4)nang tsoi(3) (2)k(i/) t(a/)m(3)_ (nang4 zoi3 gei2 daam3 能載幾擔) she carries several peculs. The reading 昨代切 _tsoi(6)_ (zoi6) is very poorly explained in the Middle Chinese rime books: 《廣韻》 has the extremely vague explanation 運也 "transport". 《集韻》 has the better explanation 舟車運物也 "transported objects on boats and chariots". Kangxi uses the second of these for the example 《詩小雅》其車旣載. This is not entirely satisfying, because the 《集韻》 explanation appears to be for "load" the noun, but the 《詩小雅》 example appears to be for "load" the *verb*. The reading 昨代切 _tsoi(6)_ (zoi6) appears to have survived as vernacular 儎. See 儎 zoi6. Williams' "incalculably high number": Based on the progression 億兆京垓秭壤溝澗正載, one of the following: 10<sup>14</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>5</sup> and going up by factors of 10); 10<sup>17</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>8</sup> and going up by factors of 10); 10<sup>44</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>8</sup> and going up by factors of 10<sup>4</sup>); 10<sup>4096</sup> (starting from 億 = 10<sup>8</sup> and going up by squares). Actually, it is unclear whether this sense should be read _(2)tsoi_ (zoi2) "year's-worth(?)", _tsoi(3)_ (zoi3) "carry(?)", or _tsoi(6)_ (zoi6) "load(?)". Williams' 冇嘢載住: Corrected _ch(u(3)_ (zyu3) to _ch(u(6)_ (zyu6). Deeds, works (Kangxi: 事也). 【載-voiced】 (dzojH) (_verb-like_) to load 【載-departing】 (tsojH) (_verb-like_) to carry, to load, (_met._) to fill, to fulfil (_verb-like_) to record (_verb-like_) to carry out (_noun-like_) work (_speech-assist_)

U+518D (F2.46 再 _Tsoi(6)_ (zoi6)) 又也乃也 (Page 589 #3: 再(3)) Again; doubled, repeated (Kangxi: 兩也, 重也); a second time (Kangxi: 一舉而二也); then, further, continued, longer (Kangxi: 仍也); to repeat; _(2)ts(')ing tsoi(3) (2)kong_ (cing2 zoi3 gong2 請再講), please say it again; _tsoi(3) i(u/)(3) (1)t(')(i/)m_ (zoi3 jiu3 tim1 再要添), I shall want some more; _(4)ming yat(9) tsoi(3) (4)loi_ (ming4 jat6 zoi3 loi4 明日再來), come back to-morrow; _tsoi(3) kwo(3) (2)k(i/) yat(9)_ (zoi3 gwo3 gei2 jat6 再過幾日) again some days elapsed; _tsoi(3) (1)shang_ (zoi3 sang1 再生) another life; _tsoi(3) (1)s(a/)m tsoi(3) sz'(3)_ (zoi3 saam1 zoi3 si3 再三再四) again and again I ordered him; _tsoi(3) (4)'m (2)k(u/) t(o\)(3)_ (zoi3 m4 gu2 dou3-2 再唔估到) I should not have guessed it; _tsoi(3) hai(6) (2)k(o\)m (4)'m tak(7)_ (zoi3 hai6 gam2 m4 dak1 再係噉唔得) it will not do for you to do so again; _tsoi(3) (2)ch(e/)_ (zoi3 ze2 再者), further; _tsoi(3) tuk(9) kwo(3)_ (zoi3 duk6 gwo3 再讀過) read it again; _tsoi(3) pat(7) (4)loi_ (zoi3 bat1 loi4 再不來), I shall not return. 【再】 (tsojH) (_adverb-like_) twice, again

zoi6.text: U+510E 傤 (Mainland simplified) (Page 589 #4: 儎(6)) A colloquial word. The cargo, the loading of a boat; the tonnage or capacity of a vessel; _(2)k(i/) shap(9) tsoi(6)_ (gei2 sap6 zoi6 幾十儎) several scores of cargoes; _(4)sh(un (5)m(u/)n tsoi(6)_ (syun4 mun5 zoi6 船滿儎) the ship is loaded; _ch(a/)k(8) tsoi(6) shek(9)_ (zaak3 zoi6 sek6 矺儎石) stone ballast; _tsoi(6) k(e/)uk(8)_ (zoi6 goek3 儎腳) freight money; _(1)chong m(a/)n(6) p(a/)t(8) tsoi(6)_ (zong1 maan6 baat3 zoi6 裝萬八儎) she carries 18,000 catties (斤). Williams' "A colloquial word": Probably from the reading 昨代切 _tsoi(6)_ (zoi6) of 載. See commentary at 載 zoi3.

U+5728 才 扗 (F2.46 在) 居也存也 (Page 589 #5: 在(6)) To be in, to pertain to, to be at; to reside, to remain, to live, to dwell at (Kangxi 𡉈: 居也); to belong to, to consist in; involved in, depending on; to be preserved or continue; existing, being, alive (Kangxi 𡉈: 存也); is in, in, at; to examine (Kangxi 𡉈: 察也); a place, a home; _(4)'m tsoi(6) uk(7)_ (m4 zoi6 uk1 唔在屋) not at home; _(4)'m tsoi(6) ch(')(u(3)_ (m4 zoi6 cyu3 唔在處) not in, not here; _(i/)n(6) tsoi(6)_ (jin6 zoi6 現在) at this moment, now; _(4)w(a/)n tsoi(6)_ (waan4 zoi6 還在) still here; _tsoi(6) hok(9) (4)t(')ong_ (zoi6 hok6 tong4-2 在學堂), at school; _tsoi(6) wai(6) (2)k(i/) noi(6) ~~(1)n(i/)~~ (1)n(e/)_ (zoi6 wai6 gei2 noi6 ne1 在位幾耐呢), how long has he reigned? _f(u/)(6) (5)m(o\) tsoi(6)_ (fu6 mou5 zoi6 父母在) parents are alive; _tsoi(6) h(a/)(6) ~~(2)tai~~ (1)tai_ (zoi6 haa6 dai1 在下低), is down stairs; _(4)'m tsoi(6)_ (m4 zoi6 唔在) he's not in; dead; no occasion, no need, --- a polite phrase; _tsoi(6) (1)k(a/) (1)to_ (zoi6 gaa1 do1 在家多), remains much at home; _(5)n(i/) tsoi(6) (1)sam_ (nei5 zoi6 sam1 你在心), remember it; _(4)'m tsz'(6) tsoi(6)_ (m4 zi6 zoi6 唔自在) not feeling well; _tsoi(6) (5)ngo tsau(6) (2)k(o\)m y(e/)ung(6)_ (zoi6 ngo5 zau6 gam2 joeng6-2 在我就噉樣) I've made up my mind; _(4)n(i/)n (5)m(a/)n tsoi(6) tsik(7)_ (nin4 maan5 zoi6 zik1 年晚在即) new year's eve is at hand; _(2)sho tsoi(6) p(i/)t(7) (5)yau_ (so2 zoi6 bit1 jau5 所在必有), it is everywhere, they are in all places; _ts(')o(3) tsoi(6) (5)ngo_ (co3 zoi6 ngo5 錯在我), it is my fault; _(2)sz' tsoi(6) (2)ts(o\) (5)m(a/)n_ (sei2 zoi6 zou2 maan5 死在早晚), his ailment is imminent; he does things blunderingly; _pat(7) tsoi(6) ~~(4)(u/)~~ (4)f(u/)_ (bat1 zoi6 fu4 不在乎), does not consist in; _tsoi(6) (1)p(i/)n ch(')(u(3)_ (zoi6 bin1 cyu3 在邊處) where is it? _tsoi(6) (5)n(i/)_ (zoi6 nei5 在你), it's your affair. Williams' 在位幾耐呢: Changed _(1)n(i/)_ (ni1) to modern _(1)n(e/)_ (ne1). Williams' 在下低: Corrected _(2)tai_ (dai2) to _(1)tai_ (dai1). Williams' 不在乎: Changed _(4)(u/)_ (wu4) to common reading _(4)f(u/)_ (fu4). Whereabouts (Kangxi: 所在也). 【在】 (dzojX, dzojH) (_verb-like_) to be (present), to be at, to be in, to be on (_preposition-like_) at, in, on (_verb-like_) to examine Used in 所在. 【所在】 (srjoX dzojX, srjoX dzojH) (_noun-like_) whereabouts

zok6.text: U+6628 zok3 (common) (F1.103 昨) 昔日也 (Page 592 #3: 昨(9)) Yesterday (Kangxi: 累日也, 昨日隔一宵也); time past; recently; _tsok(9) yat(9)_ (zok6 jat6 昨日) yesterday; _tsok(9) (5)m(a/)n_ (zok6 maan5 昨晚), last evening, last night; _tsok(9) (4)man_ (zok6 man4 昨聞), I recently heard it. 【昨】 (dzak) (_noun-like_) yesterday, yester

zok3.text: U+7CF3 鑿 𥽦 𥽿 zok6 (common) This character has 20 residual strokes, the same as 鑿. However, the Unihan Database records only 16 residual strokes, presumably because its authors have confused it with 𥽦. Finely polished rice (Kangxi 𥽿: 精細米). 【糳】 (tsak) (_noun-like_) intricate-grain

zok6.text: U+600D (F1.103 怍) 愧怍 (Page 592 #4: 怍(9)) Ashamed (Kangxi: 慚也), disconcerted, out of countenance (Kangxi: 顏色變也, 色不和曰怍); to blush, to redden; blushing, shamefaced. 【怍】 (dzak) (_verb-like_) to be ashamed (_verb-like_) to change countenance

U+6FEF zaau6 (alternative per 《廣韻》直敎切 for "wash" sense) (F1.104 濯) 洗濯又肥澤貌 (Page 26* #12: 濯(9)) To rinse, to wash (Kangxi: 𤃬也, 濯滌也, 濯漑也); fat (Kangxi: 濯濯肥也), sleek, bright (Kangxi: 光明也); ~~to drink (Kangxi: 飮也);~~ _chok(9) chok(9)_ (zok6 zok6 濯濯) sleek, as fat animals; _(2)sh(a/) chok(9)_ (saa2 zok6 灑濯) to sprinkle (_i. e._ cleanse) the heart (Kangxi: 洗心亦曰洒濯). Williams' "to drink": Kangxi 將飮之而跪之曰賜濯 is erroneous. Here, 賜濯 should be 賜灌 from the Record of Rites. Without vegetation (of a hill) (Kangxi: 山無草木之貌). 【濯-wash】 (draewk, draewH) (_verb-like_) to wash 【濯-sheeny】 (draewk) (_adjective-like_) sheeny

U+7BE7 籗 籱 kok3 (per Fan Wan) zok3 (alternative per 《廣韻》側角切) (F1.102 篧 _K(')ok(8)_ (kok3)) 取魚之器 (Page 172 #5: 篧(8) _K(')ok(8)_ (kok3); here normalised to _Chok(9)_ (zok6)) A lifting-net for fish (Kangxi: 魚𦋇 etc.), made of fine bamboo network (Kangxi: 李巡云編細竹以爲𦋇捕魚也). Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱𥫗寉 to 篧.

U+947F 䥣 凿 (Mainland simplified) zok3 (per 《廣韻》則落切 for "bright/clear" sense) zok6-2 (vernacular rising-tone noun) (F1.103 鑿) 鏨鑿又精也實也 (Page 592 #7: 鑿(9)) A chissel, a punch (Kangxi: 鏨也, 鑿所以穿木也); a cold chissel; to cut, to bore into, to chissel (Kangxi: 穿木也); to dig, as a well; to open out, as a road (Kangxi: 開也); to brand, to mark (Kangxi: 黥𠛬), as a thief; _shek(9) tsok(9)_ (sek6 zok6-2 石鑿) a stone chissel; _tsok(9) shek(9)_ (zok6 sek6 鑿石) to cut stone; _ts(un(3) tsok(9)_ (zyun3 zok6 鑽鑿) to bore a bole, to punch the face; _(1)k(u/)n (4)ts(')oi tsok(9)_ (gun1 coi4 zok6-2 棺材鑿) you coffin chissel! you impertinent fellow! _(4)ngo (4)m(i/) tsok(9)_ (ngo4 mei4 zok6-2 蛾眉鑿) a half-moon gouge; _(4)(i/)n (1)ch(i/) tsok(9) tsok(9) (2)ho ~~t(')eng(3)~~ t(')ing(3)_ (jin4 zi1 zok6 zok6 ho2 ting3 言之鑿鑿可聽) he will believe if he has repeated proofs. Fan Wan entry: Normalised headword ⿱⿰凿殳金 to 鑿, and corrected ⿱⿰車⿱𠂉力金 to 鏨. Williams' 言之鑿鑿可聽: Corrected _t(')eng(3)_ (teng3) to _t(')ing(3)_ (ting3). To employ far-fetched or outlandish reasoning (Kangxi: 恣意不求合義理謂之鑿). Bright, clear (Kangxi: 鮮明貌). Definite, reliable, irrefutable. 【鑿-voiced】 (dzak) (_verb-like_) to chisel, to bore, (_met._) to dig 【鑿-unvoiced】 (tsak) (_adjective-like_) clear, bright

U+9DDF 𬸦 (Mainland simplified) zuk6 (per Kangxi 叶昨木切 and Fan Wan) (F1.66 鷟 _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6)) 鸑鷟鳥名 (Page 599 #5: 鷟(9) _Tsuk(9)_ (zuk6); here normalised to _Chok(9)_ (zok6)) A phoenix of a carnation color (Kangxi: 鸑鷟也, 紫鳳曰鷟); a large species of duck near river banks (Kangxi: 江中有鸑鷟似鳧而大此別一種); an albatross.

zong1.text: U+599D 娤 粧 䊋 糚 裝 妆 (Mainland simplified) (F1.95 粧) 粧飾又嫁粧 (F1.95 妝) 同上 (Page 27* #3: (1)粧(1)妝) To adorn (Kangxi 妝: 飾也) the head; ornamented, dressed; to dress; to rouge, to adorn; to feign, to appear in false guise; _(1)sho (1)chong_ (so1 zong1 梳妝), to dress the hair; _(1)chong p(a/)n(6)_ (zong1 baan6 妝扮) the dress, the style; _(1)chong p(a/)n(6) (2)h(i/) (4)lai_ (zong1 baan6 hei2 lai4 妝扮起嚟), her toilet is made; _(i/)m(6) (1)chong_ (jim6 zong1 豔妝), elegantly dressed; _(1)chong shik(7)_ (zong1 sik1 妝飾) dressed out, elegant, adorned; _(1)chong (4)l(i/)m_ (zong1 lim4 妝奩), or _k(a/)(3) (1)chong_ (gaa3 zong1 嫁妝), a bride's trousseau, or dowry; _(1)sho (1)chong (4)p(')(u/)n_ (so1 zong1 pun4 梳妝盆), a paper toilette burned to Diana in the 7th moon; _s(o\)(3) (1)chong_ (sou3 zong1 素妝), plainly dressed; _(1)chong (1)hong_ (zong1 hong1 妝腔), proud, distant; _(4)yung (1)chong_ (jung4 zong1 濃妝), overdressed, bedizened. (Page 27* #4: (1)裝) Used for the preceding (妝);
